translations.translation: parama karuNAmaYa ati daYAlu AllAhara nAme|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini sRSTikulera rava|
daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu, parama karuNAmaYa, ati daYAlu|
vicAra divasera mAlika|
ApanArai AmarA ivAdAta kari evaM ApanArai nikaTa AmarA sAhAyya cAi|
AmAderake sarala patha dekhAna| pathera hidAYAta dina|
tAdera patha, yAdera upara Apani anugraha karechena| yAderake niYAmata diYechena|yAdera upara (ApanAra) krodha Apatita haYani evaM yArA pathabhraSTao naYa|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|* *e akSaragulo kuraAnera ekaTi mu‘jiyA- yAra prakRta artha ekamAtra AllAhai jAnena|
ei sei kitAva, yAte kona sandeha nei, muttAkIdera janya hidAYAta|
gAYevera prati ImAna Ane, sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA theke vyaYa kare|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane tAte, yA tomAra prati nAyila karA haYeche evaM yA tomAra pUrve nAyila karA haYeche| Ara AkhirAtera prati tArA iYAkIna rAkhe|
tArA tAdera ravera pakSa theke hidAYAtera upara raYeche evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche, tumi tAderake satarka kara kiMvA nA kara, ubhaYai tAdera janya varAvara, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
AllAha tAdera antare evaM tAdera kAne mohara lAgiYe diYechena evaM tAdera cokhasamUhe raYeche pardA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|
Ara mAnuSera madhye kichu emana Ache, yArA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati evaM zeSa dinera prati’, athaca tArA mumina naYa|
tArA AllAhake evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake dho~kA dicche| athaca tArA nijaderakei dho~kA dicche evaM tArA tA anudhAvana kare nA|
tAdera antarasamUhe raYeche vyAdhi| sutarAM AllAha tAdera vyAdhi vAr3iYe diYechena| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva| kAraNa tArA mithyA valata|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA yamIne phAsAda karo nA’, tArA vale, ‘AmarA to kevala saMzodhanakArI’|
jene rAkha, nizcaYa tArA phAsAdakArI; kintu tArA vujhe nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA ImAna Ana yemana lokerA ImAna eneche’, tArA vale, ‘AmarA ki ImAna Anava yemana nirvodharA ImAna eneche’? jene rAkha, nizcaYa tArAi nirvodha; kintu tArA jAne nA|

Ara yakhana tArA muminadera sAthe milita haYa, takhana vale ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ evaM yakhana tAdera zaYatAnadera sAthe ekAnte milita haYa, takhana vale, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAdera sAthe Achi| AmarA to kevala upahAsakArI’|
AllAha tAdera prati upahAsa karena evaM tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa vibhrAnta haYe ghorAra avakAza dena|
erAi tArA, yArA hidAYAtera vinimaYe pathabhraSTatA kraYa kareche| kintu tAdera vyavasA lAbhajanaka haYani evaM tArA hidAYAtaprApta chila nA|
tAdera upamA ai vyaktira mata, ye Aguna jvAlAla| erapara yakhana Aguna tAra cArapAza Alokita karala, AllAha tAdera Alo ker3e nilena evaM tAderake cher3e dilena emana andhakAre ye, tArA dekhache nA|
tArA vadhira-mUka-andha| tAi tArA phire Asave nA|

kiMvA AkAzera varSaNamukhara meghera nyAYa, yAte raYeche ghana andhakAra, vajradhvani o vidyutcamaka| vajrera garjane tArA mRtyura bhaYe tAdera kAne AGula diYe rAkhe| Ara AllAha kAphiraderake pariveSTana kare Achena|

vidyutcamaka tAdera dRSTi ker3e neYAra upakrama haYa| yakhanai tA tAdera janya Alo deYa, tArA tAte calate thAke| Ara yakhana tA tAdera upara andhakAra kare deYa, tArA dA~r3iYe par3e| Ara AllAha yadi cAitena, avazyai tAdera zravaNa o cokhasamUha niYe nitena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
he mAnuSa, tomarA tomAdera ravera ivAdAta kara, yini sRSTi karechena tomAderake evaM tomAdera pUrve yArA chila tAderake, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara|

yini tomAdera janya yamInake karechena vichAnA, AsamAnake chAda evaM AsamAna theke nAyila karechena vRSTi| ataHpara tA~ra mAdhyame utpanna karechena phala-phalAdi, tomAdera janya riykasvarUpa| sutarAM tomarA jene-vujhe AllAhara janya samakakSa nirdhAraNa karo nA|

Ara Ami AmAra vAndAra upara yA nAyila karechi, yadi tomarA se samparke sandehe thAka, tave tomarA tAra mata ekaTi sUrA niYe Asa evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera sAkSIsamUhake DAka; yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
ataeva yadi tomarA tA nA kara- Ara kakhano tomarA tA karave nA- tAhale Agunake bhaYa kara yAra jvAlAnI have mAnuSa o pAthara, yA prastuta karA haYeche kAphiradera janya|

yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka kAja kareche tumi tAderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAtasamUha, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita have nadIsamUha| yakhanai tAderake jAnnAta theke kona phala khete deYA have, tArA valave, ‘eTAi to pUrve AmAderake khete deYA haYechila’| Ara tAderake tA deYA have sAdRzyapUrNa kare evaM tAdera janya tAte thAkave pavitra strIgaNa evaM tArA sekhAne have sthAYI|

nizcaYa AllAha mazA kiMvA tAra ceYeo choTa kichura upamA dite lajjA karena nA| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche tArA jAne, nizcaYa tA tAdera ravera pakSa theke satya| Ara yArA kupharI kareche tArA vale, AllAha era mAdhyame upamA diYe kI ceYechena? tini e diYe anekake pathabhraSTa karena evaM e diYe anekake hidAYAta dena| Ara era mAdhyame kevala phAsikaderakei pathabhraSTa karena|
yArA AllAhara dRr3hakRta aGgIkAra bhaGga kare evaM AllAha yA jor3A lAgAnora nirdeza diYechena tA chinna kare evaM yamIne phAsAda kare| tArAi kSatigrasta|

kIbhAve tomarA AllAhara sAthe kupharI karacha athaca tomarA chile mRta? ataHpara tini tomAderake jIvita karechena| erapara tini tomAderake mRtyu devena ataHpara jIvita karavena| erapara tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake phiriYe neYA have|
tinii yamIne yA Ache sava tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena| tArapara AsamAnera prati kheYAla karalena evaM tAke sAta AsamAne suvinyasta karalena| Ara sava kichu samparke tini samyaka jJAta|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAderake valalena, ‘nizcaYa Ami yamIne ekajana khalIphA sRSTi karachi’, tArA valala, ‘Apani ki sekhAne emana kAuke sRSTi karavena, ye tAte phAsAda karave evaM rakta pravAhita karave? Ara AmarA to ApanAra prazaMsAYa tAsavIha pATha karachi evaM ApanAra pavitratA ghoSaNA karachi| tini valalena, nizcaYa Ami jAni yA tomarA jAna nA|
Ara tini Adamake nAmasamUha sava zikSA dilena tArapara tA pherezatAdera sAmane upasthApana karalena| sutarAM valalena, ‘tomarA AmAke egulora nAma jAnAo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
tArA valala, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna| Apani AmAderake yA zikhiYechena, tA chAr3A AmAdera kona jJAna nei| nizcaYa Apani sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa’|

tini valalena, ‘he Adama, egulora nAma tAderake jAnAo’| ataHpara yakhana se egulora nAma tAderake jAnAla, tini valalena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake valini, nizcaYa Ami AsamAnasamUha o yamInera gAYeva jAni evaM jAni yA tomarA prakAza kara evaM yA tomarA gopana karate’?
Ara yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAma, ‘tomarA Adamake sijadA kara’| takhana tArA sijadA karala, ivalIsa chAr3A| se asvIkAra karala evaM ahaGkAra karala| Ara se hala kAphiradera antarbhukta|

Ara Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama, tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara evaM tA theke AhAra kara svAcchandye, tomAdera icchAnuyAYI evaM ei gAchaTira nikaTavartI haYo nA, tAhale tomarA yAlimadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

ataHpara zaYatAna tAderake jAnnAta theke skhalita karala| evaM tArA yAte chila tA theke tAderake vera kare dila, Ara Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA neme yAo| tomarA eke aparera zatru| Ara tomAdera janya yamIne raYeche nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta AvAsa o bhoga-upakaraNa’|
ataHpara Adama tAra ravera pakSa theke kichu vANI pela, phale AllAha tAra tAovA kavUla karalena| nizcaYa tini tAovA kavUlakArI, ati daYAlu|

Ami valalAma,‘tomarA savAi tA theke neme yAo| ataHpara yakhana AmAra pakSa theke tomAdera kAche kona hidAYAta Asave, takhana yArA AmAra hidAYAta anusaraNa karave, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA’|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, tArAi Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

he vanI isarAIla, tomarA AmAra niAmatake smaraNa kara, ye niAmata Ami tomAderake diYechi evaM tomarA AmAra aGgIkAra pUrNa kara, tAhale Ami tomAdera aGgIkAra pUrNa karava| Ara kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ara tomAdera sAthe yA Ache tAra satyAYanakArIsvarUpa Ami yA nAyila karechi tAra prati tomarA ImAna Ana evaM tomarA tA prathama asvIkArakArI haYo nA| Ara tomarA AmAra AYAtasamUha sAmAnyamUlye vikri karo nA evaM kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|
Ara tomarA hakake vAtilera sAthe mizrita karo nA evaM jene-vujhe hakake gopana karo nA|
Ara tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM rukUkArIdera sAthe rukU kara|
tomarA ki mAnuSake bhAla kAjera Adeza diccha Ara nijaderake bhule yAccha? athaca tomarA kitAva tilAoYAta kara| tomarA ki vujha nA?
Ara tomarA dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya cAo| nizcaYa tA vinaYI chAr3A anyadera upara kaThina|
yArA vizvAsa kare ye, tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAt karave evaM tArA tA~ra dike phire yAve|
he vanI isarAIla, tomarA AmAra niAmatake smaraNa kara, ye niAmata Ami tomAderake diYechi evaM nizcaYa Ami tomAderake vizvavAsIra upara zreSThatva diYechi|

Ara tomarA se dinake bhaYa kara, yedina keu kAro kona kAje Asave nA| Ara kAro pakSa theke kona supAriza grahaNa karA have nA evaM kArao kAcha theke kona vinimaYa neYA have nA| Ara tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tomAderake phira‘Aunera dala theke rakSA karechilAma| tArA tomAderake kaThina AyAva dita| tomAdera putra santAnaderake yaveha karata evaM tomAdera nArIderake vA~ciYe rAkhata| Ara ete tomAdera ravera pakSa theke chila mahA parIkSA|
Ara yakhana tomAdera janya Ami samudrake vibhakta karechilAma, ataHpara tomAderake nAjAta diYechilAma evaM phira‘Auna dalake DuviYe diYechilAma, Ara tomarA dekhachile|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAke calliza rAtera oYAdA diYechilAma ataHpara tomarA tAra yAoYAra para vAchurake (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karechile, Ara tomarA chile yAlima|
tArapara Ami tomAderake e savera para kSamA karechi, yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAke diYechilAma kitAva o phurakAna* yAte tomarA hidAYAtaprApta hao| *- satya-mithyAra madhye pArthakyakArI tAorAtera vANIsamagra|

Ara yakhana mUsA tAra kaomake valechila, ‘he AmAra kaoma, nizcaYa tomarA vAchurake (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa kare nijadera upara yulama karecha| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera sRSTikartAra kAche tAovA kara| ataHpara tomarA nijaderake hatyA kara| eTi tomAdera janya tomAdera sRSTikartAra nikaTa uttama| ataHpara AllAha tomAdera tAovA kavUla karalena| nizcaYa tini tAovA kavUlakArI, parama daYAlu|
Ara yakhana tomarA valale, ‘he mUsA, AmarA tomAra prati ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA AmarA prakAzye AllAhake dekhi’| phale vajra tomAderake pAkar3Ao karala Ara tomarA tA dekhachile|
ataHpara Ami tomAdera mRtyura para tomAderake punaHjIvana dAna karalAma, yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|

Ara Ami tomAdera upara meghera chAYA dilAma evaM tomAdera prati nAyila karalAma ‘mAnnA’* o ‘sAlaoYA’**| tomarA se pavitra vastta theke AhAra kara, yA Ami tomAderake riyka diYechi| Ara tArA AmAra prati yulama kareni, varaM tArA nijaderakei yulama karata| *‘mAnnA’ eka dharaNera susvAdu khAvAra, yA zizirera mata gAchera pAtAYa o ghAsera upara jame thAkata| AllAha vizeSabhAve tA vanI isarAIlera janya preraNa karechilena|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA praveza kara ei janapade| Ara tA theke AhAra kara tomAdera icchAnuyAYI, svAcchandye evaM darajAYa praveza kara mAthA nIcu kare| Ara vala ‘kSamA’| tAhale Ami tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare deva evaM nizcaYa Ami satkarmazIladerake vAr3iYe deva’|
ataHpara yAlimarA pavivartana kare phelala se kathA yA tAderake valA haYechila, bhinna anya kathA diYe| phale Ami tAdera upara AsamAna theke AyAva nAyila karalAma, kAraNa tArA pApAcAra karata|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra kaomara janya pAni cAila, takhana Ami valalAma, ‘tumi tomAra lAThi dvArA pAtharake AghAta kara’| phale tA theke utsArita hala vAraTi jharanA| pratiTi dala tAdera pAni pAnera sthAna jene nila| tomarA AllAhara riyka theke AhAra kara o pAna kara evaM phAsAdakArI haYe yamIne ghure ver3iYo nA|

Ara yakhana tomarA valale, ‘he mUsA, AmarA eka khAvArera upara kakhano dhairya dharava nA| sutarAM tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa do‘A kara, yena tini AmAdera janya vera karena, bhUmi ye savji, kA~kar3a, rasuna, masura o pe~YAja utpanna kare, tA’| se valala, ‘tomarA ki yA uttama tAra parivarte emana jinisa grahaNa karacha yA nimnamAnera? tomarA kona eka nagarIte avataraNa kara| tave nizcaYa tomAdera janya (sekhAne) thAkave, yA tomarA ceYecha’| Ara tAdera upara Aropa karA haYeche lAJchanA o dAridrya evaM tArA AllAhara krodhera zikAra hala| tA ei kAraNe ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata evaM anyAYabhAve navIderake hatyA karata| tA ei kAraNe ye, tArA nApharamAnI karechila evaM tArA sImAlaGghana karata|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche, yArA iYAhUdI haYeche evaM nAsArA o sAviIrA* -(tAdera madhye) yArA ImAna eneche AllAha o zeSa dinera prati evaM neka kAja kareche - tave tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera pratidAna| Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA| *sAviI- vibhinna graha-nakSatrera pUjArI matAntare pherezatAdera upAsanAkArI|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tomAdera aGgIkAra grahaNa karalAma evaM tUra pAhAr3ake tomAdera upara uThAlAma Ami (valalAma) ‘tomAderake yA diYechi, tA zaktabhAve dhara evaM tAte yA raYeche tA smaraNa kara, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAra’|
ataHpara tomarA e savera para vimukha haYe phire gele| Ara yadi tomAdera upara AllAhara anugraha o rahamata nA hata, tomarA avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hate|
Ara tomAdera madhye yArA zanivArera vyApAre sImAlaGghana karechila, tAderake avazyai tomarA jAna| ataHpara Ami tAderake valalAma, ‘tomarA nikRSTa vAnara haYe yAo’|
Ara Ami eke vAniYechi dRSTAnta, se samaYera evaM tatparavartI janapadasamUhera janya evaM muttAkIdera janya upadeza|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra kaomake valala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tomAderake nirdeza dicchena ye, tomarA ekaTi gAbhI yaveha karave’| tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera sAthe upahAsa karacha’? se valala, ‘Ami mUrkhadera antarbhukta haoYA theke AllAhara AzraYa cAcchi’|

tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa do‘A kara, tini yena AmAdera janya spaSTa kare dena gAbhITi kemana have’| se valala, ‘nizcaYa tini valachena, nizcaYa tA have garu, vur3o naYa evaM vAccAo naYa| era mAjhAmAjhi dharanera| sutarAM tomarA kara yA tomAderake nirdeza deYA hacche’|

tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa do‘A kara, tini yena AmAdera janya spaSTa kare dena, kemana tAra raGa’? se valala, ‘nizcaYa tini valachena, nizcaYa tA have haluda raGera gAbhI, tAra raGa ujjvala, darzakaderake yA Ananda deve’|

tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa do‘A kara, tini yena AmAdera janya spaSTa kare dena, tA kemana? nizcaYa garuTi AmAdera janya sandehapUrNa haYe giYeche| Ara nizcaYa AmarA AllAha cAhe to pathaprApta hava’|

se valala, ‘nizcaYa tini valachena, ‘nizcaYa tA emana gAbhI, yA vyavahRta haYani jami cASa karAYa Ara nA kSete pAni deYAYa| sustha yAte kona khu~ta nei’| tArA valala, ‘ekhana tumi satya niYe esecha’| ataHpara tArA tA yaveha karala athaca tArA tA karAra chila nA|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA ekajanake hatyA karale ataHpara se vyApAre eke aparake doSAropa karale| Ara AllAha prakAza kare dilena tomarA yA gopana karachile|
ataHpara Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA tAke AghAta kara gAbhITira (gozatera) kichu aMza diYe| ebhAve AllAha jIvita karena mRtaderake| Ara tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanasamUha dekhAna, yAte tomarA vujha|

ataHpara tomAdera antarasamUha era pare kaThina haYe gela yena tA pAtharera mata kiMvA tAra ceYeo zakta| Ara nizcaYa pAtharera madhye kichu Ache, yA theke nahara utsArita haYa| Ara nizcaYa tAra madhye kichu Ache yA cUrNa haYa| phale tA theke pAni vera haYa| Ara nizcaYa tAra madhye kichu Ache yA AllAhara bhaYe dhvase par3e| Ara AllAha tomarA yA kara, se samparke gAphela nana|
tomarA ki ei AzA karacha ye, tArA tomAdera prati ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera ekaTi dala chila yArA AllAhara vANI zunata ataHpara tA vujhe neYAra para tA tArA vikRta karata jene vujhe|

Ara yakhana tArA muminadera sAthe sAkSAt kare takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’| Ara yakhana eke aparera sAthe ekAnte milita haYa takhana vale, ‘tomarA ki tAdera sAthe se kathA AlocanA kara, yA AllAha tomAdera upara ummukta karechena, yAte tArA era mAdhyame tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAdera viruddhe dalIla peza karave? tave ki tomarA vujha nA’?
tArA ki jAne nA ye, tArA yA gopana kare evaM yA prakAza kare, tA AllAha jAnena?
Ara tAdera madhye Ache nirakSara, tArA mithyA AkAGkhA chAr3A kitAvera kona jJAna rAkhe nA evaM tArA zudhui dhAraNA kare thAke|

sutarAM dhvaMsa tAdera janya yArA nija hAte kitAva likhe| tArapara vale, ‘eTi AllAhara pakSa theke’, yAte tA tuccha mUlye vikri karate pAre| sutarAM tAdera hAta yA likheche tAra pariNAme tAdera janya dhvaMsa, Ara tArA yA upArjana kareche tAra kAraNeo tAdera janya dhvaMsa|

Ara tArA vale, ‘gonA-kaYekadina chAr3A Aguna AmAderake kakhano sparza karave nA’| vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAhara nikaTa oYAdA niYecha, phale AllAha tA~ra oYAdA bhaGga karavena nA? nAki AllAhara upara emana kichu valacha, yA tomarA jAna nA’?
hA~, ye manda upArjana karave evaM tAra pApa tAke veSTana kare neve, tArAi Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne have sthAYI|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka Amala kareche, tArA jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne have sthAYI|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami vanI isarAIlera aGgIkAra grahaNa karalAma ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta karave nA evaM sadAcAra karave pitA-mAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma o misakInadera sAthe| Ara mAnuSake uttama kathA vala, sAlAta kAYema kara evaM yAkAta pradAna kara| ataHpara tomAdera madhya theke svalpa saMkhyaka chAr3A tomarA sakale upekSA kare mukha phiriYe nile|

Ara yakhana Ami tomAdera aGgIkAra grahaNa karalAma ye, tomarA nijadera rakta pravAhita karave nA evaM nijaderake tomAdera gRhasamUha theke vera karave nA| ataHpara tomarA svIkAra kare nile| Ara tomarA tAra sAkSI|

ataHpara tomarAi to tArA, yArA nijaderake hatyA karacha evaM tomAdera madhya theke ekaTi dalake tAdera gRha theke vera kare diccha; pApa o samIlaGghanera mAdhyame tAdera viruddhe sahAYatA karacha| Ara tArA yadi vandI haYe tomAdera nikaTa Ase, tomarA muktipaNa diYe tAderake mukta kara| athaca tAderake vera karA tomAdera janya hArAma chila| tomarA ki kitAvera kichu aMze ImAna rAkha Ara kichu aMza asvIkAra kara? sutarAM tomAdera madhye yArA tA kare duniYAra jIvane lAJchanA chAr3A tAdera kI pratidAna hate pAre? Ara kiYAmatera dine tAderake kaThinatama AyAve nikSepa karA have| Ara tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke gAphila nana|
tArA AkhirAtera vinimaYe duniYAra jIvanake kharida kareche| sutarAM tAdera theke AyAva hAlakA karA have nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

Ara Ami nizcaYa mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra pare ekera para eka rAsUla preraNa karechi evaM mAraiYAma putra IsAke diYechi suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha| Ara tAke zaktizAlI karechi ‘pavitra AtmA’ra* mAdhyame| tave ki tomAdera nikaTa yakhanai kona rAsUla emana kichu niYe eseche, yA tomAdera manaHpUta naYa, takhana tomarA ahaGkAra karecha, ataHpara (navIdera) ekadalake tomarA mithyAvAdI valecha Ara ekadalake hatyA karecha| *pavitra AtmA artha jivarIla(A.)
Ara tArA valala, AmAdera antarasamUha AcchAdita; varaM tAdera kupharIra kAraNe AllAha tAderake lA‘nata karechena| ataHpara tArA khuva kamai ImAna Ane|

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche, tAdera sAthe yA Ache, AllAhara pakSa theke tAra satyAYanakArI kitAva ela, athaca tArA pUrve kAphiradera upara vijaYa kAmanA karata| sutarAM yakhana tAdera nikaTa ela yA tArA cinata, takhana tArA tA asvIkAra karala| ataeva kAphiradera upara AllAhara lA‘nata|

yAra vinimaYe tArA nijaderake vikraYa kareche tA kata jaghanya (tA ei) ye, AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA tArA asvIkAra kareche ei jidera vazavartI haYe ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAke icchA tAra upara tA~ra anugraha nAyila karechena| sutarAM tArA krodhera upara krodhera adhikArI hala| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara AyAva|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAha yA nAyila karechena tomarA tAra prati ImAna Ana’| tArA vale, ‘AmAdera prati yA nAyila haYeche AmarA tA vizvAsa kari’| Ara era vAire yA Ache tArA tA asvIkAra kare| athaca tA satya, tAdera sAthe yA Ache tAra satyAYanakArI| vala, ‘tave kena tomarA AllAhara navIderake pUrve hatyA karate, yadi tomarA mumina haYe thAka’?
Ara avazyai mUsA tomAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe eseche| ataHpara tomarA tAra pare vAchurake (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karale| Ara tomarA to yAlima|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tomAdera pratizruti grahaNa karechilAma evaM tomAdera upara tUrake uThiYechilAma- (valechilAma) ‘Ami tomAderake yA diYechi tA zaktabhAve dhara evaM zona’| tArA valechila, ‘AmarA zunalAma evaM amAnya karalAma| Ara tAdera kupharIra kAraNe tAdera antare go-vAchura prIti siJcita karA haYechila| vala, ‘tomAdera ImAna yAra nirdeza deYa kata manda tA! yadi tomarA mumina haYe thAka’|
vala, ‘yadi anyAnya mAnuSa chAr3A AllAhara nikaTa AkhirAtera AvAsa zudhu tomAdera janyai nirdiSTa thAke, tave tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka’|
Ara tArA kakhano tA kAmanA karave nA, tAdera hAta yA pAThiYeche tAra kAraNe| Ara AllAha yAlimadera samparke adhika jJAta|

Ara tumi tAderake pAve jIvanera prati sarvAdhika lobhI mAnuSarUpe| emanaki tAdera thekeo yArA ziraka kareche| tAdera ekajana kAmanA kare, yadi hAjAra vachara tAke jIvana deYA hata! athaca dIrghajIvI halei tA tAke AyAva theke niSkRti dite pArave nA| Ara tArA yA kare AllAha se samparke samyaka draSTA|

vala, ‘ye jivarIlera zatru have (se anuzocanAYa maruka) kenanA nizcaYa jivarIla tA AllAhara anumatite tomAra antare nAyila kareche, tAra sAmane thAkA kitAvera samarthaka, hidAYAta o muminadera janya susaMvAdarUpe’|
‘ye zatru have AllAhara, tA~ra pherezatAdera, tA~ra rAsUlagaNera, jivarIlera o mIkAIlera tave nizcaYa AllAha kAphiradera zatru’|
Ara Ami avazyai tomAra prati suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha nAyila karechi, phAsikarA chAr3A anya keu tA asvIkAra kare nA|
tave ki yakhanai tArA kona oYAdA kareche, takhanai tAdera madhya theke kona eka dala tA chur3e mereche? varaM tAdera adhikAMza ImAna rAkhe nA|

Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa AllAhara kAcha theke ekajana rAsUla ela, tAdera sAthe yA Ache tA samarthana kare, takhana Ahale kitAvera ekaTi dala AllAhara kitAvake tAdera pechane phele dila, (ebhAve ye) mane haYa yena tArA jAne nA|

Ara tArA anusaraNa kareche, yA zaYatAnarA sulAimAnera rAjatve pATha karata| Ara sulAimAna kupharI kareni; varaM zaYatAnarA kupharI kareche| tArA mAnuSake yAdu zekhAta evaM (tArA anusaraNa kareche) yA nAyila karA haYechila vAvelera dui pherezatA hArUta o mArUtera upara| Ara tArA kAuke zekhAta nA ye paryanta nA valata ye, ‘AmarA to parIkSA, sutarAM tomarA kupharI karo nA| eraparao tArA edera kAcha theke zikhata, yAra mAdhyame tArA puruSa o tAra strIra madhye viccheda ghaTAta| athaca tArA tAra mAdhyame kAro kona kSati karate pArata nA AllAhara anumati chAr3A| Ara tArA zikhata yA tAdera kSati karata, tAdera upakAra karata nA evaM tArA avazyai jAnata ye, ye vyakti tA kraYa karave, AkhirAte tAra kona aMza thAkave nA| Ara tA nizcitarUpe katai-nA manda, yAra vinimaYe tArA nijaderake vikraYa kareche| yadi tArA jAnata|
Ara yadi tArA ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, tave avazyai AllAhara pakSa theke (tAdera janya) pratidAna uttama hata| yadi tArA jAnata|

he muminagaNa, tomarA ‘rA‘inA’* valo nA; varaM vala, ‘unajuranA’ Ara zona, kAphiradera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva| *- راعنا rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma era sAthe kathopakathana vA tA~ra kAcha theke zikSA grahaNera samaYa muminagaNera vujhate samasyA hale tArA valatena ‘rA‘inA’ arthAt AmAdera prati lakSya karuna evaM dhIre valuna| zavdaTira Ara ekaTi artha ‘vokA’| iYAhUdirA tA zone se arthe vyavahAra zuru karala evaM nijerA hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala| takhana AllAha tAAlA ukta dvyarthavodhaka zavdaTira parivarte pariSkAra arthavodhaka zavda ‘unajuranA’ arthAt AmAdera prati najara dina- zavdaTi vyavahAra karAra nirdeza dilena|

Ahale kitAva o muzarikadera madhya theke yArA kupharI kareche, tArA cAYa nA ye, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera upara kona kalyANa nAyila hoka| Ara AllAha yAke icchA tAke tA~ra rahamata dvArA khAsa karena evaM AllAha mahAna anugrahera adhikArI|
Ami ye AYAta rahita kari kiMvA bhuliYe dei, tAra ceYe uttama kiMvA tAra mata AnaYana kari| tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva AllAhara? Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|
nAki tomarA cAo tomAdera rAsUlake prazna karate, yemana pUrve mUsAke prazna karA haYechila? Ara ye ImAnake kuphare parivartana karave, se nizcaYa sojA pathavicyuta hala|

Ahale kitAvera anekei cAYa, yadi tArA tomAderake ImAna AnAra para kAphira avasthAYa phiriYe nite pArata! satya spaSTa haoYAra para tAdera pakSa theke hiMsAvazata (tArA erUpa kare thAke)| sutarAM tomarA kSamA kara evaM er3iYe cala, yatakSaNa nA AllAha tA~ra nirdeza dena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta dAo evaM ye neka Amala tomarA nijadera janya Age pAThAve, tA AllAhara nikaTa pAve| tomarA yA karacha nizcaYa AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
Ara tArA vale, iYAhUdI kiMvA nAsArA chAr3A anya keu jAnnAte praveza karave nA| eTA tAdera mithyA AzA| vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera pramANa niYe Asa, yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka’|
hyA~, ye nijake AllAhara kAche soparda kareche evaM se satkarmazIlao, tave tAra janya raYeche tAra ravera nikaTa pratidAna| Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

Ara iYAhUdIrA vale, ‘nAsArAdera kona bhitti nei’ evaM nAsArArA vale ‘iYAhUdIdera kona bhitti nei’| athaca tArA kitAva pATha kare| ebhAvei, yArA kichu jAne nA, tArA tAdera kathAra mata kathA vale| sutarAM ye viSaYe tArA matavirodha karata AllAha kiYAmatera dina se viSaYe tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena|

Ara tAra ceYe adhika yAlema ke, ye AllAhara mAsajidasamUhe tA~ra nAma smaraNa karA theke vAdhA pradAna kare evaM tA virANa karate ceSTA kare? tAdera to ucit chila bhIta haYe tAte praveza karA| tAdera janya duniYAYa raYeche lAJchanA Ara AkhirAte tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|
Ara pUrva o pazcima AllAharai| sutarAM tomarA ye dikei mukha phirAo, se dikei AllAhara cehArA| nizcaYa AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
Ara tArA vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena| tini pavitra mahAna; varaM AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai | sava tA~rai anugata|
tini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sraSTA| Ara yakhana tini kona viSaYera siddhAnta nena, takhana kevala valena ‘hao’ phale tA haYe yAYa|

Ara yArA jAne nA, tArA vale, ‘kena AllAha AmAdera sAthe kathA valena nA kiMvA AmAdera kAche kona nidarzana Ase nA’? ebhAvei, yArA tAdera pUrve chila tArA tAdera kathAra mata kathA valeche| tAdera antarasamUha ekai rakama haYe giYeche| Ami to AYAtasamUha suspaSTa kare diYechi emana kaomera janya, yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
nizcaYa Ami tomAke preraNa karechi satyasaha, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe evaM tomAke Agunera adhivAsIdera samparke prazna karA have nA|

Ara iYAhUdI o nAsArArA kakhano tomAra prati santuSTa have nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi tAdera millAtera anusaraNa kara| vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara hidAYAtai hidAYAta’ Ara yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kara tomAra kAche ye jJAna eseche tAra para, tAhale AllAhara viparIte tomAra kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi, tArA tA pATha kare yathArthabhAve| tArAi tAra prati ImAna Ane| Ara ye tA asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
he vanI isarAIla, tomarA AmAra niAmatake smaraNa kara, yA Ami tomAderake diYechi| Ara nizcaYa Ami tomAderake zreSThatva diYechi sRSTikulera upara|
Ara tomarA bhaYa kara sedinake, yedina keu kAro kona kAje Asave nA evaM kona vyakti theke vinimaYa grahaNa karA have nA Ara kona supAriza tAra upakAre Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhImake tAra rava kaYekaTi vANI diYe parIkSA karalena, ataHpara se tA pUrNa karala| tini valalena, ‘Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya netA vAnAva’| se valala, ‘AmAra vaMzadharadera thekeo’? tini valalena, ‘yAlimarA AmAra oYAdAprApta haYa nA’|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami kAvAke mAnuSera janya milanakendra o nirApada sthAna vAnAlAma evaM (Adeza dilAma ye,) ‘tomarA mAkAme ivarAhImake sAlAtera sthAnarUpe grahaNa kara’| Ara Ami ivarAhIma o isamAIlake dAYitva diYechilAma ye, ‘tomarA AmAra gRhake tAoYAphakArI, ‘itikAphakArI o rukUkArI-sijadAkArIdera janya pavitra kara’|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani eke nirApada nagarI vAnAna evaM era adhivAsIderake phala-mulera riyka dina yArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna eneche’| tini valalena, ‘ye kupharI karave, tAke Ami svalpa bhogopakaraNa diva| ataHpara tAke Agunera AyAve praveza karate vAdhya karava| Ara tA kata manda pariNati’|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma o isamAIla kAvAra bhitgulo uThAcchila (evaM valachila,) ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera pakSa theke kavUla karuna| nizcaYa Apani sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI’|

‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake ApanAra anugata karuna evaM AmAdera vaMzadharera madhya theke ApanAra anugata jAti vAnAna| Ara AmAderake AmAdera ivAdAtera vidhi-vidhAna dekhiYe dina evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna| nizcaYa Apani kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

‘he AmAdera rava, tAdera madhye tAdera theke ekajana rAsUla preraNa karuna, ye tAdera prati ApanAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karave evaM tAderake kitAva o hikamata zikSA dive Ara tAderake pavitra karave| nizcaYa Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|
Ara ye nijake nirvodha vAniYeche, se chAr3A ke ivarAhImera Adarza theke vimukha hate pAre? Ara avazyai Ami tAke duniYAte veche niYechi evaM nizcaYa se AkhirAte nekakAradera antarbhukta thAkave|
yakhana tAra rava tAke valalena, ‘tumi AtmasamarpaNa kara’| se valala, ‘Ami sakala sRSTira ravera kAche nijake samarpaNa karalAma’|

Ara erai upadeza diYeche ivarAhIma tAra santAnaderake evaM iYAkUvao (ye,) ‘he AmAra santAnerA, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera janya ei dInake caYana karechena| sutarAM tomarA musalima haoYA chAr3A mArA yeYo nA|

nAki tomarA sAkSI chile, yakhana iYAkUvera nikaTa mRtyu upasthita haYechila? yakhana se tAra santAnaderake valala, ‘AmAra para tomarA kAra ivAdAta karave’? tArA valala, ‘AmarA ivAdAta karava ApanAra ilAhera, ApanAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera ilAhera, yini eka ilAha| Ara AmarA tA~rai anugata’|
seTA emana eka ummata yA vigata haYeche| tArA yA arjana kareche tA tAdera janyai, Ara tomarA yA arjana karecha tA tomAdera janyai| Ara tArA yA karata se samparke tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘tomarA iYAhUdI kiMvA nAsArA haYe yAo, hidAYAta peYe yAve’| vala, ‘varaM AmarA ivarAhImera millAtera anusaraNa kari, ye ekaniSTha chila evaM ye muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA’|

tomarA vala, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara upara evaM yA nAyila karA haYeche AmAdera upara o yA nAyila karA haYeche ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAdera santAnadera upara Ara yA pradAna karA haYeche mUsA o IsAke evaM yA pradAna karA haYeche tAdera ravera pakSa hate navIgaNake| AmarA tAdera kAro madhye tAratamya kari nA| Ara AmarA tA~rai anugata’|

ataeva yadi tArA ImAna Ane, tomarA yerUpe tAra prati ImAna enecha, tave avazyai tArA hidAYAtaprApta have| Ara yadi tArA vimukha haYa tAhale tArA raYeche kevala virodhitAYa, tAi tAdera vipakSe tomAra janya AllAha yatheSTa| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
(vala,) AmarA AllAhara raM grahaNa karalAma| Ara raM era dika diYe AllAhara ceYe ke adhika sundara? Ara AmarA tA~rai ivAdAtakArI|

vala, ‘tomarA ki AmAdera sAthe AllAhara vyApAre vitarka karacha athaca tini AmAdera rava o tomAdera rava? Ara AmAdera janya raYeche AmAdera AmalasamUha evaM tomAdera janya raYeche tomAdera AmalasamUha evaM AmarA tA~ra janyai ekaniSTha|

nAki tomarA valacha, ‘nizcaYa ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAdera santAnerA chila iYAhUdI kiMvA nAsArA? vala, ‘tomarA adhika jJAta nAki AllAha’? Ara tAra ceYe adhika yAlima ke, ye AllAhara pakSa theke tAra kAche ye sAkSya raYeche tA gopana kare? Ara tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke gAphila nana|
seTA chila ekaTi ummata, yArA vigata haYeche| tArA yA arjana kareche, tA tAdera janya Ara tomarA yA arjana karecha tA tomAdera janya| Ara tArA yA karata, se samparke tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA|
acirei nirvodha lokerA valave, 'kIse tAderake tAdera kivalA theke phirAla, yAra upara tArA chila?' vala, 'pUrva o pazcima AllAharai| tini yAke cAna sojA patha dekhAna'|

Ara ebhAvei Ami tomAderake madhyapanthI ummata vAniYechi, yAte tomarA mAnuSera upara sAkSI hao evaM rAsUla sAkSI hana tomAdera upara| Ara ye kivalAra upara tumi chile, tAke kevala e janyai nirdhAraNa karechilAma, yAte Ami jene nei ye, ke rAsUlake anusaraNa kare evaM ke tAra pechane phire yAYa| yadio tA ati kaThina (anyadera kAche) tAdera chAr3A yAderake AllAha hidAYAta karechena evaM AllAha emana nana ye, tini tomAdera ImAnake vinaSTa karavena| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati atyanta snehazIla, parama daYAlu|

AkAzera dike vAra vAra tomAra mukha phirAno Ami avazyai dekhachi| ataeva Ami avazyai tomAke emana kivalAra dike phirAva, yA tumi pachanda kara| sutarAM tomAra cehArA mAsajidula hArAmera dike phirAo evaM tomarA yekhAnei thAka, tAra dikei tomAdera cehArA phirAo| Ara nizcaYa yArA kitAvaprApta haYeche, tArA avazyai jAne ye, tA tAdera ravera pakSa theke satya evaM tArA yA kare, se vyApAre AllAha gAphila nana|

Ara yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tumi yadi tAdera nikaTa sava nidarzana niYe Asa, tArA tomAra kivalAra anusaraNa karave nA Ara tumio tAdera kivalAra anusaraNakArI nao evaM tArA eke aparera kivalAra anusaraNakArI naYa| Ara yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kara tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para, tave nizcaYa tumi takhana yAlimadera antarbhukta|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi, tArA tAke cine, yemana cine tAdera santAnaderake| Ara nizcaYa tAdera madhya theke ekaTi dala satyake avazyai gopana kare, athaca tArA jAne|
satya tomAra ravera pakSa theke| sutarAM tumi kakhano sandeha poSaNakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

Ara pratyekera raYeche ekaTi dika, yedike se cehArA phirAYa| sutarAM tomarA kalyANakarme pratiyogitA kara| tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, AllAha tomAdera savAike niYe Asavena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao, tomAra cehArA mAsajidula hArAmera dike phirAo| Ara nizcaYa tA satya tomAra ravera pakSa theke evaM tomarA yA kara, AllAha tA theke gAphila nana|

Ara tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao, tomAra cehArA mAsajidula hArAmera dike phirAo evaM tomarA yekhAnei thAka, tAra dike tomAdera cehArA phirAo, yAte tomAdera vipakSe mAnuSera vitarka karAra kichu nA thAke| tave tAdera madhya theke yArA yulama kareche, tArA chAr3A| sutarAM tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo nA, AmAke bhaYa kara| Ara yAte Ami AmAra niAmata tomAdera upara pUrNa karate pAri evaM yAte tomarA hidAYAtaprApta hao|

yebhAve Ami tomAdera madhye ekajana rAsUla preraNa karechi tomAdera madhya theke, ye tomAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare, tomAderake pavitra kare evaM kitAva o hikamata zikSA deYa| Ara tomAderake zikSA deYa emana kichu yA tomarA jAnate nA|
ataeva, tomarA AmAke smaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake smaraNa karava| Ara AmAra zokara AdAYa kara, AmAra sAthe kupharI karo nA|

he muminagaNa, dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya cAo| nizcaYa AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|* *pavitra kuraAnera aneka sthAne AllAha nekakAradera sAthe Achena, dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena ityAdi valA haYeche| tini Arazera upara thekeo vAndAke sAhAyya sahayogitA karAra mAdhyame tAra sAthe raYechena vale vujhe nite have|
yArA AllAhara rAstAYa nihata haYa, tAderake mRta valo nA| varaM tArA jIvita; kintu tomarA anubhava karate pAra nA|
Ara Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava kichu bhaYa, kSudhA evaM jAna-mAla o phala-phalAdira svalpatAra mAdhyame| Ara tumi dhairyazIladera susaMvAda dAo|
yArA, tAderake yakhana vipada AkrAnta kare takhana vale, nizcaYa AmarA AllAhara janya evaM nizcaYa AmarA tA~ra dike pratyAvartanakArI|
tAdera uparai raYeche tAdera ravera pakSa theke mAgaphirAta o rahamata evaM tArAi hidAYAtaprApta|

nizcaYa sAphA o mAraoYA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera antarbhukta| sutarAM ye vAitullAhara hajja karave kiMvA umarA karave tAra kona aparAdha have nA ye, se egulora tAoYApha karave| Ara ye svataHsphUrtabhAve kalyANa karave, tave nizcaYa zokarakArI, sarvajJa|

nizcaYa yArA gopana kare su-spaSTa nidarzanasamUha o hidAYAta yA Ami nAyila karechi, kitAve mAnuSera janya tA spaSTabhAve varNanA karAra para, tAderake AllAha lA‘nata karena evaM lA‘natakArIgaNao tAderake lA‘nata kare|
tArA chAr3A, yArA tAovA kareche, zudhare niYeche evaM spaSTabhAve varNanA kareche| ataeva, Ami tAdera tAovA kavUla karava| Ara Ami tAovA kavUlakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche evaM kAphira avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kareche, tAdera upara AllAha, pherezatAgaNa o sakala mAnuSera lA’nata|
tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| tAdera theke AyAva hAlakA karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|
Ara tomAdera ilAha eka ilAha| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tini ati daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTite, rAta o dinera vivartane, se naukAYa yA samudre mAnuSera janya kalyANakara vastta niYe cale evaM AsamAna theke AllAha ye vRSTi varSaNa karechena ataHpara tAra mAdhyame mare yAoYAra para yamInake jIvita karechena evaM tAte char3iYe diYechena sakala prakAra vicaraNazIla prANI o vAtAsera parivartane evaM AsamAna o yamInera madhyavartI sthAne niYojita meghamAlAYa raYeche nidarzanasamUha emana kaomera janya, yArA vivekavAna|

Ara mAnuSera madhye emanao Ache, yArA AllAha chAr3A anyake AllAhara samakakSarUpe grahaNa kare, tAderake AllAhake bhAlavAsAra mata bhAlavAse| Ara yArA ImAna eneche, tArA AllAhara janya bhAlavAsAYa dRr3hatara| Ara yadi yAlimagaNa dekhe- yakhana tArA AyAva dekhave ye, nizcaYa sakala zakti AllAhara janya evaM nizcaYa AllAha AyAva dAne kaThora|
yakhana, yAderake anusaraNa karA haYeche, tArA anusArIdera theke AlAdA haYe yAve evaM tArA AyAva dekhate pAve| Ara tAdera sava samparka chinna haYe yAve|

Ara yArA anusaraNa kareche, tArA valave, ‘yadi AmAdera phire yAoYAra suyoga hata, tAhale AmarA tAdera theke AlAdA haYe yetAma, yebhAve tArA AlAdA haYe giYeche’| ebhAve AllAha tAderake tAdera AmalasamUha dekhAvena, tAdera janya AkSepasvarUpa| Ara tArA Aguna theke vera hate pArave nA|
he mAnuSa, yamIne yA raYeche, tA theke hAlAla pavitra vastu AhAra kara evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYa se tomAdera janya suspaSTa zatru|
nizcaYa se tomAderake Adeza deYa manda o azlIla kAjera evaM AllAhara vyApAre emana kichu valate, yA tomarA jAna nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA anusaraNa kara, yA AllAha nAyila karechena’, tArA vale, ‘varaM AmarA anusaraNa karava AmAdera pitR-puruSaderake yAra upara peYechi’| yadi tAdera pitR-puruSarA kichu nA vujhe evaM hidAYAtaprApta nA haYa, tAhaleo ki?
Ara yArA kupharI kareche tAdera udAharaNa tAra mata, ye emana kichura janya citkAra karache, hA~ka-DAka chAr3A ye kichu zone nA| tArA vadhira, vovA, andha| tAi tArA vujhe nA|
he muminagaNa, AhAra kara Ami tomAderake ye hAlAla riyaka diYechi tA theke evaM AllAhara janya zokara kara, yadi tomarA tA~rai ivAdAta kara|

nizcaYa tini tomAdera upara hArAma karechena mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera gozta evaM yA gAYarullAhara nAme yaveha karA haYeche| sutarAM ye vAdhya have, avAdhya vA sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYe, tAhale tAra kona pApa nei| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa yArA gopana kare ye kitAva AllAha nAyila karechena evaM era vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa kare, tArA zudhu Agunai tAdera udare pure| Ara AllAha kiYAmatera dine tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA, tAderake parizuddha karavena nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
tArAi hidAYAtera parivarte pathabhraSTatA evaM mAgaphirAtera parivarte AyAva kraYa kareche| Agunera upara tArA katai nA dhairyazIla|
tA ei kAraNe ye, AllAha yathArtharUpe kitAva nAyila karechena| Ara nizcaYa yArA kitAve matavirodha kareche, tArA avazyai sudUra matAnaikye raYeche|

bhAlo kAja eTA naYa ye, tomarA tomAdera cehArA pUrva o pazcima dike phirAve; varaM bhAlo kAja hala ye ImAna Ane AllAha, zeSa divasa, pherezatAgaNa, kitAva o navIgaNera prati evaM ye sampada pradAna kare tAra prati Asakti sattveo nikaTAtmIYagaNake, iYAtIma, asahAYa, musAphira o prArthanAkArIke evaM vandimuktite evaM ye sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM yArA aGgIkAra kare tA pUrNa kare, yArA dhairyadhAraNa kare kaSTa o durdazAYa o yuddhera samaYe| tArAi satyavAdI evaM tArAi muttAkI|

he muminagaNa, nihatadera vyApAre tomAdera upara ‘kisAsa’ pharaya karA haYeche| svAdhInera vadale svAdhIna, dAsera vadale dAsa, nArIra vadale nArI| tave yAke kichuTA kSamA karA have tAra bhAiYera pakSa theke, tAhale satatAra anusaraNa karave evaM sundarabhAve tAke AdAYa kare deve| eTi tomAdera ravera pakSa theke hAlakAkaraNa o rahamata| sutarAM erapara ye sImAlaGghana karave, tAra janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara he vivekasampannagaNa, kisAse raYeche tomAdera janya jIvana, AzA karA yAYa tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave|

tomAdera upara pharaya karA haYeche ye, yakhana tomAdera kAro mRtyu upasthita have, yadi se kona sampada rekhe yAYa, tave pitA-mAtA o nikaTAtmIYadera janya nyAYabhittika asiYata karave| eTi muttAkIdera dAYitva|
ataeva ye tA zravaNa karAra para parivartana karave, tave era pApa tAdera have, yArA tA parivartana kare| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|
tave keu yadi asiYatakArIra pakSa theke pakSapAtitva o pApera AzaGkA kare, ataHpara tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, tAhale tAra kona pApa nei| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa, tomAdera upara siYAma pharaya karA haYeche, yebhAve pharaya karA haYechila tomAdera pUrvavartIdera upara| yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara|

nirdiSTa kaYeka dina| tave tomAdera madhye ye asustha have, kiMvA saphare thAkave, tAhale anyAnya dine saMkhyA pUraNa kare neve| Ara yAdera janya tA kaSTakara have, tAdera kartavya phidaYA- ekajana daridrake khAvAra pradAna karA| ataeva ye svecchAYa atirikta satkAja karave, tA tAra janya kalyANakara have| Ara siYAma pAlana tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi tomarA jAna|

ramayAna mAsa, yAte kuraAna nAyila karA haYeche mAnuSera janya hidAYAtasvarUpa evaM hidAYAtera suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI o satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArIrUpe| sutarAM tomAdera madhye ye mAsaTite upasthita have, se yena tAte siYAma pAlana kare| Ara ye asustha have athavA saphare thAkave tave anyAnya divase saMkhyA pUraNa kare neve| AllAha tomAdera sahaja cAna evaM kaThina cAna nA| Ara yAte tomarA saMkhyA pUraNa kara evaM tini tomAderake ye hidAYAta diYechena, tAra janya AllAhara var3atva ghoSaNA kara evaM yAte tomarA zokara kara|

Ara yakhana AmAra vAndAgaNa tomAke AmAra samparke jijJAsA karave, Ami to nizcaYa nikaTavartI| Ami AhavAnakArIra DAke sAr3A dei, yakhana se AmAke DAke| sutarAM tArA yena AmAra DAke sAr3A deYa evaM AmAra prati ImAna Ane| AzA karA yAYa tArA saThika pathe calave|

siYAmera rAte tomAdera janya tomAdera strIdera nikaTa gamana hAlAla karA haYeche| tArA tomAdera janya paricchada evaM tomarA tAdera janya paricchada| AllAha jenechena ye, tomarA nijadera sAthe khiYAnata karachile| ataHpara tini tomAdera tAovA kavUla karechena evaM tomAderake kSamA karechena| ataeva, ekhana tomarA tAdera sAthe milita hao evaM AllAha tomAdera janya yA likhe diYechena, tA anusandhAna kara| Ara AhAra kara o pAna kara yatakSaNa nA phajarera sAdA rekhA kAla rekhA theke spaSTa haYa| ataHpara rAta paryanta siYAma pUrNa kara| Ara tomarA mAsajide itikApharata avasthAYa strIdera sAthe milita haYo nA| eTA AllAhara sImArekhA, sutarAM tomarA tAra nikaTavartI haYo nA| ebhAvei AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUha mAnuSera janya spaSTa karena yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

Ara tomarA nijadera madhye tomAdera sampada anyAYabhAve kheYo nA evaM tA vicArakaderake (ghuSa hiseve) pradAna karo nA| yAte mAnuSera sampadera kona aMza pApera mAdhyame jene vujhe kheYe phelate pAra|

tArA tomAke natuna cA~dasamUha samparke prazna kare| vala, ‘tA mAnuSera o hajjera janya samaYa nirdhAraka’| Ara bhAlo kAja eTA naYa ye, tomarA pechana dika diYe gRhe praveza karave| kintu bhAla kAja hala, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| Ara tomarA gRhasamUhe tAra darajA diYe praveza kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphala hao|
Ara tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kara, yArA tomAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kare evaM sImAlaGghana karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

Ara tAderake hatyA kara yekhAne tAderake pAo evaM tAderake vera kare dAo yekhAna theke tArA tomAderake vera karechila| Ara phitanA hatyAra ceYe kaThinatara evaM tomarA mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTa tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA tomAdera viruddhe sekhAne lar3Ai kare| ataHpara tArA yadi tomAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kare, tave tAderake hatyA kara| eTAi kAphiradera pratidAna|
tave yadi tArA virata haYa, tave nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kara ye paryanta nA phitanA khatama haYe yAYa evaM dIna AllAhara janya haYe yAYa| sutarAM tArA yadi virata haYa, tAhale yAlimarA chAr3A (kAro upara) kona kaThoratA nei|

hArAma mAsa hArAma mAsera vadale evaM pavitra viSaYasamUha kisAsera antarbhukta| sutarAM ye tomAdera upara AkramaNa kareche, tomarA tAra upara AkramaNa kara, yerUpa se tomAdera upara AkramaNa kareche| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha muttAkIdera sAthe Achena|
Ara tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa vyaYa kara evaM nija hAte nijaderake dhvaMse nikSepa karo nA| Ara sukarma kara| nizcaYa AllAha sukarmazIladerake bhAlavAsena|

Ara haja o umarA AllAhara janya pUrNa kara| ataHpara yadi tomarA ATake par3a tave ye pazu sahaja have (tA yaveha kara)| Ara tomarA tomAdera mAthA munDana karo nA, yatakSaNa nA pazu tAra yathAsthAne pau~che| Ara tomAdera madhye ye asustha kiMvA tAra mAthAYa yadi kona kaSTa thAke tave siYAma kiMvA sadAkA athavA pazu yaveha era mAdhyame phidaYA deve| Ara yakhana tomarA nirApada have takhana ye vyakti umarAra para haja sampAdanapUrvaka tAmAttu karave, tave ye pazu sahaja have, tA yaveha karave| kintu ye tA pAve nA tAke haje tina dina evaM yakhana tomarA phire yAve, takhana sAta dina siYAma pAlana karave| ei hala pUrNa daza| ei vidhAna tAra janya, yAra parivAra mAsajidula hArAmera adhivAsI naYa| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha AyAvadAne kaThora|

hajera samaYa nirdiSTa mAsasamUha| ataeva ei mAsasamUhe ye nijera upara haja Aropa kare nila, tAra janya haje azlIla o pApa kAja evaM jhagar3A-vivAda vaidha naYa| Ara tomarA bhAla kAjera yA kara, AllAha tA jAnena evaM pAtheYa grahaNa kara| nizcaYa uttama pAtheYa tAkaoYA| Ara he viveka sampannagaNa, tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|

tomAdera upara kona pApa nei ye, tomarA tomAdera ravera pakSa theke anugraha anusandhAna karave| sutarAM yakhana tomarA ArAphA theke vera haYe Asave, takhana mAzaAre hArAmera nikaTa AllAhake smaraNa kara evaM tAke smaraNa kara yebhAve tini tomAderake dikanirdezanA diYechena| yadio tomarA era pUrve avazyai pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta chile|
ataHpara tomarA pratyAvartana kara, yekhAna theke mAnuSerA pratyAvartana kare evaM AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tArapara yakhana tomarA tomAdera hajera kAjasamUha zeSa karave, takhana AllAhake smaraNa kara, yebhAve tomarA smaraNa karate tomAdera vApa-dAdAderake, emanaki tAra ceYe adhika smaraNa| Ara mAnuSera madhye emanao Ache ye vale, he AmAdera rava, AmAderake duniYAtei diYe dina| vastuta AkhirAte tAra janya kona aMza nei|
Ara tAdera madhye emanao Ache, yArA vale, he AmAdera rava, AmAderake duniYAte kalyANa dina| Ara AkhirAteo kalyANa dina evaM AmAderake Agunera AyAva theke rakSA karuna|
tArA yA arjana kareche tAra hisyA tAdera raYeche| Ara AllAha hisAva grahaNe druta|

Ara AllAhake smaraNa kara nirdiSTa dinasamUhe| ataHpara ye tAr3Ahur3A kare du’dine cale Asave| tAra kona pApa nei| Ara ye vilamva karave, tArao kona aparAdha nei| (e vidhAna) tAra janya, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche| Ara tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa tomAderake tA~rai kAche samaveta karA have|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emanao Ache, yAra kathA duniYAra jIvane tomAke avAka kare evaM se tAra antare yA raYeche, tAra upara AllAhake sAkSI rAkhe| Ara se kaThina jhagar3AkArI|
Ara yakhana se phire yAYa, takhana yamIne praceSTA cAlAYa tAte phAsAda karate evaM dhvaMsa karate zasya o prANI| Ara AllAha phAsAda bhAlavAsena nA|
Ara yakhana tAke valA haYa, ‘AllAhake bhaYa kara’ takhana AtmAbhimAna tAke pApa karate utsAha deYa| sutarAM jAhAnnAma tAra janya yatheSTa evaM tA katai nA manda ThikAnA|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache ye AllAhara santuSTira uddezye nijake vikiYe deYa| Ara AllAha (tA~ra) vAndAdera prati snehazIla|
he muminagaNa, tomarA isalAme pUrNarUpe praveza kara evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA | nizcaYa se tomAdera janya spaSTa zatru|
ataeva tomarA yadi padaskhalita hao, tomAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha AsAra para, tave jene rAkha ye, AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tArA ki erai apekSA karache ye, meghera chAYAYa AllAha o pherezatAgaNa tAdera nikaTa Agamana karavena evaM sava viSaYera phaYasAlA kare deYA have| Ara AllAhara nikaTai sava viSaYa pratyAvartita have|
vanI isarAilake jijJAsA kara, Ami tAderake kata suspaSTa nidarzana diYechi| Ara ye AllAhara ni‘Amata tAra kAche AsAra para tA vadale deve tAhale nizcaYa AllAha AyAva dAne kaThora|

yArA kupharI kareche, duniYAra jIvanake tAdera janya suzobhita karA haYeche| Ara tArA muminadera niYe upahAsa kare| Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, tArA kiYAmata divase tAdera upare thAkave| Ara AllAha yAke cAna, vehisAva riyka dAna karena|

mAnuSa chila eka ummata| ataHpara AllAha susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe navIderake preraNa karalena evaM satyasaha tAdera sAthe kitAva nAyila karalena, yAte mAnuSera madhye phaYasAlA karena, ye viSaYe tArA matavirodha karata| Ara tArAi tAte matavirodha karechila, yAderake tA deYA haYechila, tAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzana AsAra parao parasparera madhye vidveSavazata| ataHpara AllAha nija anumatite muminaderake hidAYAta dilena ye viSaYe tArA matavirodha karachila| Ara AllAha yAke icchA karena sarala pathera dike hidAYAta dena|

nAki tomarA bhevecha ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave athaca ekhano tomAdera nikaTa tAdera mata kichu Aseni, yArA tomAdera pUrve vigata haYeche| tAderake sparza karechila kaSTa o durdazA evaM tArA kampita haYechila| emanaki rAsUla o tAra sAthi muminagaNa valachila, ‘kakhana AllAhara sAhAyya (Asave)’? jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAhara sAhAyya nikaTavartI|

tArA tomAke jijJAsA kare, tArA kI vyaYa karave? vala, ‘tomarA ye sampada vyaYa karave, tA pitA-mAtA, AtmIYa, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphiradera janya| Ara ye kona bhAla kAja tomarA kara, nizcaYa se vyApAre AllAha suparijJAta’|

tomAdera upara lar3AiYera vidhAna deYA haYeche, athaca tA tomAdera kAche apachandanIYa evaM hate pAre kona viSaYa tomarA apachanda karacha athaca tA tomAdera janya kalyANakara| Ara hate pAre kona viSaYa tomarA pachanda karacha athaca tA tomAdera janya akalyANakara| Ara AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

tArA tomAke hArAma mAsa samparke, tAte lar3Ai karA viSaYe jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘tAte lar3Ai karA var3a pApa; kintu AllAhara pathe vAdhA pradAna, tA~ra sAthe kupharI karA, mAsajidula hArAma theke vAdhA deYA evaM tAra adhivAsIderake tA theke vera kare deYA AllAhara nikaTa adhika var3a pApa| Ara phitanA hatyAra ceYeo var3a’| Ara tArA tomAdera sAthe lar3Ai karate thAkave, yatakSaNa nA tomAderake tomAdera dIna theke phiriYe deYa, tArA yadi pAre| Ara ye tomAdera madhya theke tA~ra dIna theke phire yAve, ataHpara kAphira avasthAYa mRtyu varaNa karave, vastuta edera AmalasamUha duniYA o AkhirAte vinaSTa haYe yAve evaM tArAi Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche o yArA hijarata kareche evaM AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kareche, tArA AllAhara rahamatera AzA kare| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tArA tomAke mada o juYA samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, e du’ToYa raYeche var3a pApa o mAnuSera janya upakAra| Ara tAra pApa tAra upakAritAra ceYe adhika var3a| Ara tArA tomAke jijJAsA kare, tArA kI vyaYa karave| vala, ‘yA praYojanera atirikta’| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA cintA kara|

duniYA o AkhirAtera vyApAre| Ara tArA tomAke jijJAsA kare iYAtImadera samparke| vala, saMzodhana karA tAdera janya uttama| Ara yadi tAderake nijadera sAthe miziYe nAo, tave tArA tomAderai bhAi| Ara AllAha jAnena ke phAsAdakArI, ke saMzodhanakArI evaM AllAha yadi cAitena, avazyai tomAdera janya (viSaYaTi) kaThina kare ditena| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tomarA muzarika nArIdera viYe karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane evaM mumina dAsI muzarika nArIra ceYe nizcaYa uttama, yadio se tomAderake mugdha kare| Ara muzarika puruSadera sAthe viYe diYo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| Ara ekajana mumina dAsa ekajana muzarika puruSera ceYe uttama, yadio se tomAderake mugdha kare| tArA tomAderake Agunera dike AhavAna kare, Ara AllAha tA~ra anumatite tomAderake jAnnAta o kSamAra dike AhavAna karena evaM mAnuSera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha spaSTarUpe varNanA karena, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa karate pAre|

Ara tArA tomAke hAYeya samparke prazna kare| vala, tA kaSTa| sutarAM tomarA hAYeyakAle strIdera theke dUre thAka evaM tArA pavitra nA haoYA paryanta tAdera nikaTavartI haYo nA| ataHpara yakhana tArA pavitra have takhana tAdera nikaTa Asa, yebhAve AllAha tomAderake nirdeza diYechena| nizcaYa AllAha tAovAkArIderake bhAlavAsena evaM bhAlavAsena adhika pavitratA arjanakArIderake|

tomAdera strI tomAdera phasalakSetra| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera phasalakSetre gamana kara, yebhAve cAo| Ara tomarA nijadera kalyANe uttama kAja sAmane pAThAo| Ara AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa tomarA tA~ra sAthe sAkSAt karave | Ara muminaderake susaMvAda dAo|

Ara AllAhake tomarA tomAdera zapatha pUraNe prativandhaka vAniYo nA ye, tomarA (AllAhara nAme ei vale zapatha karave ye) bhAlo kAja karave nA, tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA evaM mAnuSera madhye saMzodhana karave nA| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AllAha tomAderake tomAdera arthahIna zapathera janya pAkar3Ao karavena nA| kintu pAkar3Ao karavena yA tomAdera antarasamUha arjana kareche| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe milita nA haoYAra zapatha karave tArA cAra mAsa apekSA karave| ataHpara tArA yadi phiriYe neYa, tave nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yadi tArA tAlAkera dRr3ha icchA kare neYa tave nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

Ara tAlAkaprAptA nArIrA tina kurU* paryanta apekSAYa thAkave evaM tAdera janya hAlAla have nA ye, AllAha tAdera garbhe yA sRSTi karechena, tA tArA gopana karave, yadi tArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati vizvAsa rAkhe| Ara era madhye tAdera svAmIrA tAderake phiriYe neYAra vyApAre adhika hakadAra, yadi tArA saMzodhana cAYa| Ara nArIdera raYeche vidhi motAveka adhikAra| yemana Ache tAdera upara (puruSadera) adhikAra| Ara puruSadera raYeche tAdera upara maryAdA evaM AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa| *‘kurU’ dvArA haYeya matAntare tuhUra vA pavitrAvasthAke vujhAno haYeche|

tAlAka du’vAra| ataHpara vidhi motAveka rekhe deve kiMvA sundarabhAve cher3e deve| Ara tomAdera janya hAlAla naYa ye, tomarA tAderake yA diYecha, tA theke kichu niYe neve| tave ubhaYe yadi AzaGkA kare ye, AllAhara sImArekhAYa tArA avasthAna karate pArave nA| sutarAM tomarA yadi AzaGkA kara ye, tArA AllAhara sImArekhA kAYema rAkhate pArave nA tAhale strI yA diYe nijake mukta kare neve tAte kona samasyA nei| eTA AllAhara sImArekhA| sutarAM tomarA tA laGghana karo nA| Ara ye AllAhara sImArekhAsamUha laGghana kare, vastuta tArAi yAlima|

ataeva yadi se tAke tAlAka deYa tAhale se puruSera janya hAlAla have nA yatakSaNa paryanta bhinna ekajana svAmI se grahaNa nA kare| ataHpara se (svAmI) yadi tAke tAlAka deYa, tAhale tAdera ubhaYera aparAdha have nA ye, tArA eke aparera nikaTa phire Asave, yadi dRr3ha dhAraNA rAkhe ye, tArA AllAhara sImArekhA kAYema rAkhate pArave| Ara eTA AllAhara sImArekhA, tini tA emana sampradAYera janya spaSTa kare dena, yArA jAne|

Ara yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka deve ataHpara tArA tAdera iddate pau~che yAve takhana haYato vidhi motAveka tAderake rekhe deve athavA vidhi motAveka tAderake cher3e deve| tave tAderake kaSTa diYe sImAlaGghanera uddezye tAderake ATake rekho nA| Ara ye tA karave se to nijera prati yulama karave| Ara tomarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake upahAsarUpe grahaNa karo nA| Ara tomarA smaraNa kara tomAdera upara AllAhara niAmata evaM tomAdera upara kitAva o hikamata yA nAyila karechena, yAra mAdhyame tini tomAderake upadeza dena| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha ye, nizcaYa AllAha sava viSaYa samparke suparijJAta|

Ara yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka deve ataHpara tArA tAdera iddate pau~chave takhana tomarA tAderake vAdhA diYo nA ye, tArA tAdera svAmIderake viYe karave yadi tArA paraspare tAdera madhye vidhi motAveka sammata haYa| eTA upadeza tAke deYA hacche, ye tomAdera madhye AllAha o zeSa divasera prati vizvAsa rAkhe| eTi tomAdera janya adhika zuddha o adhika pavitra| Ara AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|

Ara mAYerA tAdera santAnaderake pUrNa du’vachara dudha pAna karAve, (eTA) tAra janya ye dudha pAna karAvAra samaYa pUrNa karate cAYa| Ara pitAra upara kartavya, vidhi motAveka mAderake khAvAra o pozAka pradAna karA| sAdhyera atirikta kona vyaktike dAYitva pradAna karA haYa nA| kaSTa deYA yAve nA kona mAke tAra santAnera janya, kiMvA kona vAvAke tAra santAnera janya| Ara oYArizera upara raYeche anurUpa dAYitva| ataHpara tArA yadi paraspara sammati o parAmarzera mAdhyame dudha chAr3Ate cAYa, tAhale tAdera kona pApa have nA| Ara yadi tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake anya kAro theke dudha pAna karAte cAo, tAhaleo tomAdera upara kona pApa nei, yadi tomarA vidhi motAveka tAderake yA devAra tA diYe dAo| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha tomarA yA kara, se samparke samyaka draSTA|

Ara tomAdera madhya theke yArA mArA yAve evaM strIderake rekhe yAve, tAdera strIgaNa cAra mAsa daza dina apekSAYa thAkave| ataHpara yakhana tArA iddatakAla pUrNa karave, takhana tArA nijadera vyApAre vidhi motAveka yA karave, se vyApAre tomAdera kona pApa nei| Ara tomarA yA kara, se vyApAre AllAha samyaka avagata|

Ara ete tomAdera kona pApa nei ye, tomarA nArIderake izArAYa ye prastAva karave kiMvA mane gopana kare rAkhave| AllAha jenechena ye, tomarA avazyai tAderake smaraNa karave| kintu vidhi motAveka kona kathA valA chAr3A gopane tAderake (kona) pratizruti diYo nA| Ara AllAhara nirdeza (iddata) tAra samaYa pUrNa karAra pUrve vivAha vandhanera saMkalpa karo nA| Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera antare yA raYeche tA jAnena| sutarAM tomarA tAke bhaYa kara evaM jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|

tomAdera kona aparAdha nei yadi tomarA strIderake tAlAka dAo emana avasthAYa ye, tomarA tAderake sparza karani kiMvA tAdera janya kona mohara nirdhAraNa karani| Ara uttamabhAve tAderake bhoga-upakaraNa diYe dAo, dhanIra upara tAra sAdhyAnusAre evaM saMkaTApannera upara tAra sAdhyAnusAre| sukarmazIladera upara eTi Avazyaka|

Ara yadi tomarA tAderake tAlAka dAo, tAderake sparza karAra pUrve evaM tAdera janya kichu mohara nirdhAraNa kare thAka, tAhale yA nirdhAraNa karecha, tAra ardheka (diYe dAo)| tave strIrA yadi mApha kare deYa, kiMvA yAra hAte vivAhera vandhana se yadi mApha kare deYa| Ara tomAdera mApha kare deYA tAkaoYAra adhika nikaTatara| Ara tomarA parasparera madhye anugraha bhule yeYo nA| tomarA yA kara, nizcaYa AllAha se samparke samyaka draSTA|
tomarA sAlAtasamUha o madhyavartI sAlAtera hiphAyata kara evaM AllAhara janya dA~r3Ao vinIta haYe|
kintu yadi tomarA bhaYa kara, tave he~Te kiMvA ArohaNa kare (AdAYa kare nAo)| erapara yakhana nirApada have takhana AllAhake smaraNa kara, yebhAve tini tomAderake zikhiYechena, yA tomarA jAnate nA|

Ara tomAdera madhya theke yArA mArA yAve evaM strIderake rekhe yAve, tArA tAdera strIdera janya eka vacharera bharaNa-poSaNera osiYata karave vera nA kare diYe; kintu yadi tArA (svecchAYa) vera haYe yAYa, tAhale tArA nijadera vyApAre vidhi motAveka yA kareche, se vyApAre tomAdera kona pApa nei| Ara AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara tAlAkaprAptA nArIdera janya thAkave vidhi motAveka bharaNa-poSaNa| (eTi) muttAkIdera upara Avazyaka|
ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA kare dena, yAte tomarA upalavdhi kara |

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA tAdera gRhasamUha theke vera haYeche mRtyura bhaYe evaM tArA chila hAjAra-hAjAra? ataHpara AllAha tAderake valalena, ‘tomarA mare yAo’! tArapara tini tAderake jIvita karalena| nizcaYa AllAha to mAnuSera upara anugrahazIla| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa zukariYA AdAYa kare nA|
Ara tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai kara evaM jene rAkha nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
ke Ache, ye AllAhake uttama RNa deve, phale tini tAra janya vahu guNe vAr3iYe devena? Ara AllAha saMkIrNa karena o prasArita karena evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake phirAno have|

tumi ki mUsAra para vanI isarAIlera pradhAnaderake dekhani? yakhana tArA tAdera navIke valechila, ‘AmAdera janya ekajana rAjA pAThAna, tAhale AmarA AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai karava’| se valala, ‘emana ki have ye, yadi tomAdera upara lar3Ai Avazyaka karA haYa, tomarA lar3Ai karave nA’? tArA valala, AmAdera kI haYeche ye, AmarA AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai karava nA, athaca AmAderake AmAdera gRhasamUha theke vera karA haYeche evaM AmAdera santAnadera theke (vicchinna karA haYeche)’? ataHpara yakhana tAdera upara lar3Ai Avazyaka karA hala, takhana tAdera madhya theke svalpa saMkhyaka chAr3A tArA vimukha hala| Ara AllAha yAlimadera samparke samyaka avagata|

Ara tAderake tAdera navI valala, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera janya tAlUtake rAjArUpe pAThiYechena| tArA valala, ‘AmAdera upara kIbhAve tAra rAjatva have, athaca AmarA tAra ceYe rAjatvera adhika hakadAra? Ara tAke sampadera prAcuryao deYA haYani’| se valala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tAke tomAdera upara manonIta karechena evaM tAke jJAne o dehe aneka vAr3iYe diYechena| Ara AllAha yAke cAna, tAke tA~ra rAjatva dena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa’|

Ara tAderake tAdera navI valala, nizcaYa tAra rAjatvera nidarzana ei ye, tomAdera nikaTa tAvUta* Asave, yAte thAkave tomAdera ravera pakSa theke prazAnti evaM mUsAra parivAra o hArUnera parivAra yA rekhe giYeche tAra avaziSTa, yA vahana kare Anave pherezatAgaNa| nizcaYa tAte raYeche tomAdera janya nidarzana, yadi tomarA mumina hao| *artha sinduka| ete vanI isarAIlera kichu nidarzana chila| tAi tArA eTike pavitra mane karata evaM yuddhera samaYa sAmane rAkhata|

ataHpara yakhana tAlUta sainyavAhinI niYe vera hala, takhana se valala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tomAderake ekaTi nadI dvArA parIkSA karavena| ataeva, ye tA hate pAna karave, se AmAra dalabhukta naYa| Ara ye tA khAve nA, tAhale nizcaYa se AmAra dalabhukta| tave ye tAra hAta diYe eka AjalA parimANa khAve, se chAr3A; kintu tAdera madhya theke svalpasaMkhyaka chAr3A tA theke tArA pAna karala| ataHpara yakhana se o tAra sAthi muminagaNa tA atikrama karala, tArA valala, ‘Aja AmAdera jAlUta o tAra sainyavAhinIra sAthe lar3Ai karAra kSamatA nei’| yArA dRr3ha dhAraNA rAkhata ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe milita have, tArA valala, ‘kata choTa dala AllAhara hukume var3a dalake parAjita kareche’! Ara AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|

Ara yakhana tArA jAlUta o tAra sainyavAhinIra mukhomukhi hala, takhana tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera upara dhairya Dhele dina, AmAdera pA sthira rAkhuna evaM AmAderake kAphera jAtira viruddhe sAhAyya karuna’|

ataHpara tArA AllAhara hukume tAderake parAjita karala evaM dAUda jAlUtake hatyA karala| Ara AllAha dAUdake rAjatva o prajJA dAna karalena evaM tAke yA icchA zikSA dilena| Ara AllAha yadi mAnuSera katakake katakera dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tave avazyai yamIna phAsAdapUrNa haYe yeta| kintu AllAha vizvavAsIra upara anugrahazIla|
egulo AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami tomAra upara yathAyathabhAve tilAoYAta kari| Ara nizcaYa tumi rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|

ai rAsUlagaNa, Ami tAdera kAuke kAro upara zreSThatva diYechi, tAdera madhye kAro sAthe AllAha kathA valechena evaM kAro kAro maryAdA u~cu karechena| Ara Ami IsA ivane mAraYAmake diYechi suspaSTa pramANAdi evaM Ami tAke zaktizAlI karechi rUhula kudusa era mAdhyame| Ara yadi AllAha icchA karatena, tAdera paravartIrA lar3Ai karata nA, tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa pramANasamUha AsAra para| kintu tArA matavirodha kareche| phale tAdera madhye keu ImAna eneche, Ara tAdera keu kupharI kareche| Ara AllAha yadi cAitena, tAhale tArA lar3Ai karata nA| kintu AllAha yA cAna, tA karena|
he muminagaNa, Ami tomAderake ye riyka diYechi tA hate vyaYa kara, se dina AsAra pUrve, ye dina thAkave nA kona-vecAkenA, nA kona vandhutva evaM nA kona supAriza| Ara kAphirarAi yAlima|

AllAha, tini chADa়A kona (satya) ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva, supratiSThita dhAraka| tA~ke tandrA o nidrA sparza kare nA| tA~ra janyai AsamAnasamUhe yA raya়eche tA evaM yamIne yA Ache tA| ke se, ye tA~ra nikaTa supAriza karave tA~ra anumati chADa়A? tini jAnena yA Ache tAdera sAmane evaM yA Ache tAdera pechane| Ara tArA tA~ra jJAnera sAmAnya parimANao Aya়tva karate pAre nA, tave tini yA cAna tA chADa়A | tA~ra kurasI AsamAnasamUha o yamIna parivyApta kare Ache evaM e du'Tora saMrakSaNa tA~ra janya vojhA haya় nA| Ara tini suucca, mahAna|

dIna grahaNera vyApAre kona javaradasti nei| nizcaYa hidAYAta spaSTa haYeche bhraSTatA theke| ataeva, ye vyakti tAgUtake asvIkAra kare evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, avazyai se majavuta razi A~kar3e dhare, yA chinna havAra naYa| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

yArA ImAna eneche AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka, tini tAderake andhakAra theke Alora dike vera kare Anena| Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAdera abhibhAvaka hala tAgUta| tArA tAderake Alo theke vera kare andhakAre niYe yAYa| tArA Agunera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

tumi ki se vyaktike dekhani, ye ivarAhImera sAthe tAra ravera vyApAre vitarka kareche ye, AllAha tAke rAjatva diYechena? yakhana ivarAhIma valala, ‘AmAra rava tinii’ yini jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna| se valala, Amii jIvana dAna kari evaM mRtyu ghaTAi| ivarAhIma valala, nizcaYa AllAha pUrvadika theke sUrya Anena| ataeva tumi tA pazcima dika theke Ana| phale kAphira vyakti hatabhamva haYe gela| Ara AllAha yAlima sampradAYake hidAYAta dena nA|

athavA se vyaktira mata, ye kona janapada atikrama karachila, yA tAra chAdera upara vidhvasta chila| se valala, ‘AllAha eke kibhAve jIvita karavena mare yAoYAra para’? ataHpara AllAha tAke eka’za vachara mRta rAkhalena| erapara tAke punarjIvita karalena| valalena, ‘tumi katakAla avasthAna karecha’? se valala, ‘Ami ekadina athavA dinera kichu samaYa avasthAna karechi’| tini valalena, ‘varaM tumi eka’za vachara avasthAna karecha| sutarAM tumi tomAra khAvAra o pAnIYera dike tAkAo, seTi parivartita haYani evaM tumi tAkAo tomarA gAdhAra dike, Ara yAte Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya dRSTAnta vAnAte pAri evaM tumi tAkAo hAr3agulora dike, kibhAve Ami tA saMyukta kari, ataHpara tAke AvRta kari gozta dvArA’| pare yakhana tAra nikaTa spaSTa hala, takhana se valala, ‘Ami jAni, nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna’|

Ara yakhana ivarAhIma valala ‘he, AmAra rava, AmAke dekhAna, kibhAve Apani mRtaderake jIvita karena| tini valalena, tumi ki vizvAsa karani’? se valala, ‘avazyai hyA~, kintu AmAra antara yAte prazAnta haYa’| tini valalena, ‘tAhale tumi cAraTi pAkhi nAo| tArapara seguloke tomAra prati poSa mAnAo| ataHpara pratiTi pAhAr3e segulora Tukaro aMza rekhe Asa| tArapara seguloke DAka, segulo daur3e Asave tomAra nikaTa| Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|

yArA AllAhara pathe tAdera sampada vyaYa kare, tAdera upamA ekaTi vIjera mata, yA utpanna karala sAtaTi zISa, pratiTi zISe raYeche ekaza’ dAnA| Ara AllAha yAke cAna tAra janya vAr3iYe dena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yArA AllAhara rAstAYa tAdera sampada vyaYa kare, ataHpara tArA yA vyaYa kareche, tAra pechane kho~TA deYa nA evaM kona kaSTao deYa nA, tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera pratidAna raYeche evaM tAdera kona bhaYa nei, Ara tArA cintita have nA|
uttama kathA o kSamA pradarzana zreYa, ye dAnera para kaSTa deYA haYa tAra ceYe| Ara AllAha abhAvamukta, sahanazIla|

he muminagaNa, tomarA kho~TA o kaSTa deYAra mAdhyame tomAdera sadAkA vAtila karo nA| se vyaktira mata, ye tAra sampada vyaYa kare loka dekhAnora uddezye evaM vizvAsa kare nA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati| ataeva tAra upamA emana ekaTi masRNa pAthara, yAra upara raYeche mATi| ataHpara tAte pravala vRSTi par3ala, phale tAke ekevAre pariSkAra kare phelala| tArA yA arjana kareche tAra mAdhyame tArA kona kichu karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA| Ara AllAha kAphira jAtike hidAYAta dena nA|

Ara yArA AllAhara santuSTi lAbha o nijaderake sudRr3ha rAkhAra lakSye sampada vyaYa kare, tAdera upamA u~cu bhUmite avasthita vAgAnera mata, yAte par3eche pravala vRSTi| phale tA dviguNa phala-phalAdi utpanna kareche| Ara yadi tAte pravala vRSTi nAo par3e, tave hAlakA vRSTi (yatheSTa)| Ara AllAha tomarA yA Amala kara, se vyApAre samyaka draSTA|

tomAdera keu ki kAmanA kare, tAra janya AGgura o khejurera emana ekaTi vAgAna thAkave, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita have nada-nadI, sekhAne tAra janya thAkave sava dharanera phala-phalAdi, Ara vArdhakya tAke AkrAnta karave evaM tAra janya thAkave durvala santAna-santati| ataHpara vAgAnaTite AghAta hAnala ghUrNijhar3a, yAte raYeche Aguna, phale seTi jvale gela? ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA cintA kara|

he muminagaNa, tomarA vyaYa kara uttama vastta, tomarA yA arjana karecha evaM Ami yamIna theke tomAdera janya yA utpanna karechi tA theke evaM nikRSTa vasttara icchA karo nA ye, tA theke tomarA vyaYa karave| athaca cokha vandha karA chAr3A yA tomarA grahaNa karo nA| Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha abhAvamukta, saprazaMsita|
zaYatAna tomAderake daridratAra pratizruti deYa evaM azlIla kAjera Adeza kare| Ara AllAha tomAderake tAra pakSa theke kSamA o anugrahera pratizruti dena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tini yAke cAna prajJA dAna karena| Ara yAke prajJA deYA haYa, tAke aneka kalyANa deYA haYa| Ara viveka sampannagaNai upadeza grahaNa kare|
tomarA yA kichu vyaYa kara athavA ye kona mAnnata kara tA avazyai AllAha jAnena| Ara yAlimadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tomarA yadi sadAkA prakAza kara, tave tA uttama| Ara yadi tA gopana kara evaM phakIraderake tA dAo, tAhale tAo tomAdera janya uttama evaM tini tomAdera gunAhasamUha muche devena| Ara tomarA ye Amala kara, AllAha se samparke samyaka avahita|

tAderake hidAYAta karAra dAYitva tomAra naYa, kintu AllAha yAke cAna hidAYAta karena evaM tomarA ye sampada vyaYa kara, tA tomAdera nijadera janyai| Ara tomarA to AllAhara santuSTira uddezye vyaYa kara evaM tomarA kona uttama vyaYa karale tA tomAderake paripUrNabhAve deYA have| Ara tomAdera prati yulama karA have nA|

(sadAkA) sesava daridrera janya yArA AllAhara rAstAYa ATake giYeche, tArA yamIne calate pAre nA| nA cAoYAra kAraNe anavagata vyakti tAderake abhAvamukta mane kare| tumi tAderake cinate pArave tAdera ci‎hna dvArA| tArA mAnuSera kAche nAchor3a haYe cAYa nA| Ara tomarA ye sampada vyaYa kara, avazyai AllAha se samparke pUrNa jJAnI|
yArA tAdera sampada vyaYa kare rAte o dine, gopane o prakAzye| ataeva, tAdera janyai raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera pratidAna| Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|

yArA suda khAYa, tArA tAra nyAYa (kavara theke) uThave, yAke zaYatAna sparza kare pAgala vAniYe deYa| eTA e janya ye, tArA vale, vecA-kenA sudera matai| athaca AllAha vecA-kenA hAlAla karechena evaM suda hArAma karechena| ataeva, yAra kAche tAra ravera pakSa theke upadeza AsAra para se virata hala, yA gata haYeche tA tAra janyai icchAdhIna| Ara tAra vyApAraTi AllAhara hAolAYa| Ara yArA phire gela, tArA Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
AllAha sudake miTiYe dena evaM sadAkAke vAr3iYe dena| Ara AllAha kona ati kupharakArI pApIke bhAlavAsena nA|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane o neka Amala kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare, Ara yAkAta pradAna kare, tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa pratidAna| Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM sudera yA avaziSTa Ache, tA parityAga kara, yadi tomarA mumina hao|

kintu yadi tomarA tA nA kara tAhale AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke yuddhera ghoSaNA nAo, Ara yadi tomarA tAovA kara, tave tomAdera mUladhana tomAderai thAkave| tomarA yulama karave nA evaM tomAdera yulama karA have nA|
Ara yadi se asacchala haYa, tAhale sacchalatA AsA paryanta tAra avakAza raYeche| Ara sadAkA kare deYA tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
Ara tomarA se dinera bhaYa kara, ye dina tomAderake AllAhara dike phiriYe neYA have| ataHpara pratyeka vyaktike se yA upArjana kareche, tA puropuri deYA have| Ara tAdera yulama karA have nA|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA nirdiSTa samaya়era janya paraspara RNera lena-dena karave, takhana tA likhe rAkhave| Ara tomAdera madhye ekajana lekhaka yena inasAphera sAthe likhe rAkhe evaM kona lekhaka AllAha tAke yerUpa zikSA diya়echena, tA likhate asvIkAra karave nA| sutarAM se yena likhe rAkhe evaM yAra upara pAonA se (RNa grahItA) yena tA likhiya়e rAkhe| Ara se yena tAra rava AllAhara tAkaoya়A avalamvana kare evaM pAonA theke yena sAmAnyao kama nA deya়| ataHpara yAra upara pAonA raya়eche se (RNa grahItA) yadi nirvodha vA durvala haya়, athavA se lekhAra viSaya়vastta valate nA pAre, tAhale yena tAra abhibhAvaka nyAya়era sAthe lekhAra viSaya়vastta vale deya়| Ara tomarA tomAdera puruSadera madhya hate du’jana sAkSI rAkha| ataHpara yadi tArA ubhaya়e puruSa nA haya়, tAhale ekajana puruSa o du’jana nArI- yAderake tomarA sAkSI hiseve pachanda kara| yAte tAdera (nArIdera) ekajana bhula karale aparajana smaraNa kariya়e deya়| sAkSIrA yena asvIkAra nA kare, yakhana tAderake DAkA haya়| Ara tA choTa hoka kiMvA vaDa় tA nirdhArita samaya় paryanta lipivaddha karate tomarA virakta haya়o nA| eTi AllAhara nikaTa adhika inasAphapUrNa evaM sAkSya dAnera janya yathAyatha| Ara tomarA sandihAna nA haoya়Ara adhika nikaTavartI| tave yadi nagada vyavasA haya় yA tomarA hAte hAte lenadena kara, tAhale tA nA likhale tomAdera kona doSa nei| Ara tomarA sAkSI rAkha, yakhana tomarA vecA-kenA karave evaM kona lekhaka o sAkSIke kSatigrasta karA have nA| Ara yadi tomarA kara, tAhale nizcaya় tA have tomAdera sAthe anAcAra| Ara tomarA AllAhara tAkaoya়A avalamvana kara evaM AllAha tomAderake zikSA devena| Ara AllAha sava viSaya়e samyaka jJAnI|

Ara yadi tomarA saphare thAka evaM kona lekhaka nA pAo, tAhale hastAntarita vandhaka rAkhave| Ara yadi tomarA eke aparake vizvasta mane kara, tave yAke vizvasta mane karA haYa, se yena svIYa AmAnata AdAYa kare evaM nija rava AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| Ara tomarA sAkSya gopana karo nA evaM ye keu tA gopana kare, avazyai tAra antara pApI| Ara tomarA yA Amala kara, AllAha se vyApAre savizeSa avahita|

AllAhara janyai yA raYeche AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA raYeche yamIne| Ara tomarA yadi prakAza kara yA tomAdera antare raYeche athavA gopana kara, AllAha se viSaYe tomAdera hisAva nevena| ataHpara tini yAke cAna kSamA karavena, Ara yAke cAna AyAva devena| Ara AllAha savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|

rAsUla tAra nikaTa tAra ravera pakSa theke nAyilakRta viSaYera prati ImAna eneche, Ara muminagaNao| pratyeke ImAna eneche AllAhara upara, tA~ra pherezatAkula, kitAvasamUha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera upara, AmarA tA~ra rAsUlagaNera kArao madhye tAratamya kari nA| Ara tArA vale, AmarA zunalAma evaM mAnalAma| he AmAdera rava! AmarA ApanArai kSamA prArthanA kari, Ara ApanAra dikei pratyAvartanasthala|

AllAha kona vyaktike tAra sAmarthyera vAire dAYitva dena nA| se yA arjana kare tA tAra janyai evaM se yA kAmAi kare tA tAra uparai vartAve| he AmAdera rava! AmarA yadi bhule yAi, athavA bhula kari tAhale Apani AmAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera upara vojhA cApiYe devena nA, yemana AmAdera pUrvavartIdera upara cApiYe diYechena| he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake emana kichu vahana karAvena nA, yAra sAmarthya AmAdera nei| Ara Apani AmAderake mArjanA karuna evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna, Ara AmAdera upara daYA karuna| Apani AmAdera abhibhAvaka| ataeva Apani kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya karuna|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva, cirapratiSThita dhAraka|
tini tomAra upara kitAva nAyila karechena yathAyathabhAve, era pUrve yA eseche tAra satyAYanakArI hiseve evaM nAyila karechena tAorAta o inajIla|

itaHpUrve mAnuSera janya hidAYAtasvarUpa| Ara tini phurakAna nAyila karechena| nizcaYa yArA asvIkAra kare AllAhara AYAtasamUha, tAdera janyai raYeche kaThina AyAva| Ara AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodhagrahaNakArI|
nizcaYa AllAha, tA~ra nikaTa gopana thAke nA kona kichu yamIne evaM nA AsamAne |
tinii mAtRgarbhe tomAderake AkRti dAna karena yebhAve tini cAna| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii tomAra upara kitAva nAyila karechena, tAra madhye Ache muhakAma AYAtasamUha| segulo kitAvera mUla, Ara anyagulo mutAzAvih| phale yAdera antare raYeche satyavimukha pravaNatA, tArA phitanAra uddezye evaM bhula vyAkhyAra anusandhAne mutAzAvih AYAtagulora pechane lege thAke| athaca AllAha chAr3A keu era vyAkhyA jAne nA| Ara yArA jJAne paripakka, tArA vale, AmarA egulora prati ImAna AnalAma, savagulo AmAdera ravera pakSa theke| Ara viveka sampannarAi upadeza grahaNa kare|
he AmAdera rava, Apani hidAYAta deYAra para AmAdera antarasamUha vakra karavena nA evaM ApanAra pakSa theke AmAderake rahamata dAna karuna| nizcaYa Apani mahAdAtA|
he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa Apani mAnuSake samaveta karavena emana ekadina, yAte kona sandeha nei| nizcaYa AllAha pratizruti bhaGga karena nA|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kare, tAdera mAla-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara AyAva theke kakhanao kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArAi Agunera jvAlAni|

phira‘Auna sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvera lokadera svabhAvera nyAYa, tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche| phale tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAdareke pAkar3Ao karechena| Ara AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|
tumi kAphiraderake vala, ‘tomarA acirei parAjita have evaM tomAderake jAhAnnAmera dike samaveta karA have| Ara seTi katainA nikRSTa AvAsasthala’!

nizcaYa tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche du’Ti dalera madhye, yArA paraspara mukhomukhi haYechila| ekaTi dala lar3Ai karachila AllAhara pathe evaM apara dalaTi kAphira| tArA vAhyika dRSTite tAderake odera dviguNa dekhachila| Ara AllAha nija sAhAyya dvArA yAke cAna zaktizAlI karena| nizcaYa ete raYeche cakSuSmAnadera janya zikSA|

mAnuSera janya suzobhita karA haYeche pravRttira bhAlavAsA- nArI, santAnAdi, rAzi rAzi sonA-rUpA, ci‎‎hnata ghor3A, gavAdi pazu o zasyakSeta| egulo duniYAra jIvanera bhogasAmagrI| Ara AllAha, tA~ra nikaTa raYeche uttama pratyAvartanasthala|

vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake era ceYeo uttama vastura saMvAda deva? yArA tAkaoYA arjana kare, tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa naharasamUha| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| Ara pavitra strIgaNa o AllAhara pakSa theke santuSTi’| Ara AllAha vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa AmarA ImAna AnalAma| ataeva, AmAdera pApasamUha kSamA karuna evaM AmAderake Agunera AyAva theke rakSA karuna’|
yArA dhairyazIla, satyavAdI, AnugatyazIla o vyaYakArI evaM zeSa rAte kSamAprArthanAkArI|
AllAha sAkSya dena ye, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei, Ara pherezatA o jJAnIgaNao| tini nyAYa dvArA pratiSThita| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa dIna hacche isalAma| Ara yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche, tAdera nikaTa jJAna AsAra parai tArA matAnaikya kareche, paraspara vidveSavazata| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara AYAtasamUhera sAthe kupharI kare, nizcaYa AllAha hisAva grahaNe druta|

yadi tArA tomAra sAthe vitarka kare, tave tumi vala, ‘Ami AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karalAma evaM AmAra anusArIrAo’| Ara yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAderake evaM nirakSaraderake vala, ‘tomarA ki isalAma grahaNa karecha’? takhana yadi tArA isalAma grahaNa kare, tAhale tArA avazyai hidAYAtaprApta have| Ara yadi phire yAYa, tAhale tomAra dAYitva zudhu pau~chiYe deYA| Ara AllAha vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|

nizcaYa yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhera sAthe kupharI kare evaM anyAYabhAve navIderake hatyA kare, Ara mAnuSera madhya theke yArA nyAYa-parAYaNatAra nirdeza deYa tAderake hatyA kare, tumi tAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda dAo|
orAi, yAdera AmalasamUha duniYA o AkhirAte niSphala haYeche evaM tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani? yAderake kitAvera aMzavizeSa deYA haYeche, tAderake AllAhara kitAvera dike AhavAna karA hacche, yAte tA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare| ataHpara tAdera ekadala phire yAcche vimukha haYe|
era kAraNa hala, tArA vale, ‘guTi kaYekadina chAr3A Aguna AmAderake kakhanai sparza karave nA’| Ara tArA yA mithyA racanA karata, tA tAderake tAdera dInera vyApAre pratArita kareche|
sutarAM kI avasthA have? yakhana Ami tAderake emana dine samaveta karava, yAte kona sandeha nei| Ara pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratidAna pUrNabhAve deYA have evaM tAderake yulama karA have nA|
