vala, ‘he AllAha, rAjatvera mAlika, Apani yAke cAna rAjatva dAna karena, Ara yAra theke cAna rAjatva ker3e nena evaM Apani yAke cAna sammAna dAna karena| Ara yAke cAna apamAnita karena, ApanAra hAtei kalyANa| nizcaYa Apani sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna’|

‘Apani rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna| Ara mRta theke jIvitake vera karena evaM jIvita theke mRtake vera karena| Ara yAke cAna vinA hisAve riyka dAna karena’|

muminarA yena muminadera chAr3A kAphiraderake vandhu nA vAnAYa| Ara ye keu erUpa karave, AllAhara sAthe tAra kona samparka nei| tave yadi tAdera pakSa theke tomAdera kona bhaYera AzaGkA thAke| Ara AllAha tomAderake tA~ra nijera vyApAre satarka karachena evaM AllAhara nikaTai pratyAvartana|

vala, ‘tomarA yadi tomAdera antarasamUhe yA Ache tA gopana kara athavA prakAza kara, AllAha tA jAnena| Ara AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA Ache, tAo tini jAnena| AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna’|

yedina pratyeke upasthita pAve ye bhAla Amala se kareche evaM ye manda Amala se kareche tA| takhana se kAmanA karave, yadi manda kAja o tAra madhye vahudUra vyavadhAna hata! Ara AllAha tomAderake tAra nijera vyApAre sAvadhAna karachena evaM AllAha vAndAdera prati atyanta snehazIla|
vala, ‘yadi tomarA AllAhake bhAlavAsa, tAhale AmAra anusaraNa kara, AllAha tomAderake bhAlavAsavena evaM tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare devena| Ara AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
vala, ‘tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara’| tArapara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave nizcaYai AllAha kAphiraderake bhAlavAsena nA|
nizcaYai AllAha Adama, nUha o ivarAhImera parivArake evaM imarAnera parivArake sRSTijagatera upara manonIta karechena|
tArA eke aparera vaMzadhara| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

yakhana imarAnera strI valechila, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra garbhe yA Ache, nizcaYa Ami tA khAlesabhAve ApanAra janya mAnata karalAma| ataeva, Apani AmAra pakSa theke tA kavula karuna| nizcaYa Apani zravaNakArI, sarvajJa’|

ataHpara se yakhana tA prasava karala, valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa Ami tA prasava karechi kanyArUpe’| Ara AllAhai bhAla jAnena se yA prasava kareche tA samparke| ‘Ara putra santAna kanyA santAnera mata naYa evaM nizcaYa Ami tAra nAma rekhechi mAraiYAma| Ara nizcaYa Ami tAke o tAra santAnaderake vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke ApanAra AzraYa dicchi’|

ataHpara tAra rava tAke uttamabhAve kavula karalena evaM tAke uttamabhAve gar3e tulalena| Ara tAke yAkAriYyAra dAYitve dilena| yakhanai yAkAriYyA tAra kAche tAra kakSe praveza karata, takhanai tAra nikaTa khAdyasAmagrI peta| se valata, ‘he mAraiYAma, kothA theke tomAra janya eTi’? se valata, ‘eTi AllAhara pakSa theke| nizcaYa AllAha yAke cAna vinA hisAve riyka dAna karena’|
sekhAne yAkAriYyA tAra ravera kAche prArthanA karechila, se valala, ‘he Amara rava, AmAke ApanAra pakSa theke uttama santAna dAna karuna| nizcaYa Apani prArthanA zravaNakArI’|

ataHpara pherezatArA tAke Deke valala, se yakhana kakSe dA~r3iYe sAlAta AdAYa karachila, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tomAke iYAhaiYA samparke susaMvAda dicchena, ye have AllAhara pakSa theke vANIra satyAYanakArI, netA o nArI sambhogamukta evaM nekakAradera madhya theke ekajana navI’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, kIbhAve AmAra putra have? athaca AmAra to vArdhakya ese giYeche, Ara AmAra strI vandhA’| tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei AllAha yA icchA tA karena’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke dena ekaTi nidarzana’| tini valalena, ‘tomAra nidarzana hala, tumi tina dina paryanta mAnuSera sAthe izArA chAr3A kathA valave nA| Ara tomAra ravake adhika smaraNa kara evaM sakAla-sandhyA tAra tAsavIha pATha kara’|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma, nizcaYa AllAha tomAke manonIta karechena o pavitra karechena evaM nirvAcita karechena tomAke vizvajagatera nArIdera upara’ |
‘he mAraiYAma, tomAra ravera janya anugata hao| Ara sijadA kara evaM rukUkArIdera sAthe rukU kara’|

eTi gAYevera saMvAdasamUhera antarbhukta, yA Ami tomAra prati ohI pAThAcchi| Ara tumi tAdera nikaTa chile nA, yakhana tArA tAdera kalama nikSepa karachila, tAdera madhye ke mAraiYAmera dAYitva neve? Ara tumi tAdera nikaTa chile nA, yakhana tArA vitarka karachila |

smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma, nizcaYa AllAha tomAke tA~ra pakSa theke ekaTi kAlemAra susaMvAda dicchena, yAra nAma masIha IsA ivane mAraiYAma, ye duniYA o AkhirAte sammAnita evaM naikaTyaprAptadera antarbhukta’|
Ara se mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave dolanAYa o pariNata vaYase evaM se nekakAradera antarbhukta|

mAraiYAma valala, ‘he AmAra rava, kibhAve AmAra santAna have? athaca kona mAnuSa AmAke sparza kareni’! AllAha valalena, ‘ebhAvei’ AllAha yA cAna sRSTi karena| tini yakhana kona viSaYera siddhAnta nena, takhana tAke zudhu valena, ‘hao’| phale tA haYe yAYa|
‘Ara tini tAke kitAva, hikamAta, tAorAta o inajIla zikSA devena’|

Ara vanI isarAIladera rAsUla vAnAvena (se valave) ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ravera pakSa theke nidarzana niYe esechi ye, avazyai Ami tomAdera janya kAdAmATi diYe pAkhira AkRti vAnAva, ataHpara Ami tAte phu~ka deva| phale AllAhara hukume seTi pAkhi haYe yAve| Ara Ami AllAhara hukume janmAndha o kuSTha rugIke sustha karava evaM mRtake jIvita karava| Ara tomarA yA AhAra kara evaM tomAdera ghare yA jamA kare rAkha tA Ami tomAderake jAniYe deva| nizcaYa ete tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche, yadi tomarA mumina hao’|

‘Ara AmAra sAmane pUrvavartI kitAva tAorAtera yA raYeche tAra satyAYanakArIrUpe evaM tomAdera upara yA hArAma karA haYechila tAra kichu tomAdera janya hAlAla karate evaM Ami tomAdera nikaTa esechi tomAdera ravera pakSa theke nidarzana niYe| ataeva, tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘nizcaYa AllAha AmAra rava o tomAdera rava| ataeva tomarA tA~ra ivAdAta kara| eTi sarala patha’|

ataHpara yakhana IsA tAdera pakSa hate kupharI upalavdhi karala, takhana valala, ‘ke AllAhara janya AmAra sAhAyyakArI have’? hAoYArIgaNa valala, ‘AmarA AllAhara sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi| Ara tumi sAkSI thAka ye, nizcaYa AmarA musalima’|
he AmAdera rava, Apani yA nAyila karechena tAra prati AmarA ImAna enechi evaM AmarA rAsUlera anusaraNa karechi| ataeva, AmAderake sAkSyadAtAdera tAlikAbhukta karuna’|
Ara tArA kuTakauzala kareche evaM AllAha kauzala karechena| Ara AllAha uttama kauzalakArI|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha valalena, ‘he IsA, nizcaYa Ami tomAke parigrahaNa karava, tomAke AmAra dike uThiYe neva evaM kAphiradera theke tomAke pavitra karava| Ara yArA tomAra Anugatya kareche tAderake kiYAmata paryanta avizvAsIdera upare prAdhAnya deva| ataHpara AmAra nikaTai tomAdera pratyAvartana have| takhana Ami tomAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deva, ye vyApAre tomarA matavirodha karate’ |
ataHpara yArA kupharI kareche, Ami tAderake kaThina AyAva deva duniYA o AkhirAte, Ara tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka Amala kareche, tini tAderake paripUrNa pratidAna devena| Ara AllAha yAlimaderake bhAlavAsena nA|
eTi Ami tomAra upara tilAoYAta karachi, AYAtasamUha o prajJApUrNa upadeza theke|
nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa IsAra dRSTAnta Adamera mata, tini tAke mATi dvArA sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tAke valalena, ‘hao’, phale se haYe gela|
satya tomAra ravera pakSa theke, sutarAM tumi sandeha poSaNakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

ataHpara tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para ye tomAra sAthe e viSaYe jhagar3A kare, tave tumi tAke vala, ‘esa AmarA Deke nei AmAdera santAnaderake o tomAdera santAnaderake| Ara AmAdera nArIderake o tomAdera nArIderake evaM AmAdera nijaderake o tomAdera nijaderake, tArapara AmarA vinIta prArthanA kari, ‘mithyAvAdIdera upara AllAhara lA’nata kari’|
nizcaYa eTi satya vivaraNa| Ara AllAha chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei evaM nizcaYa AllAha, tinii halena parAkramazAlI, prajJApUrNa|
tavuo yadi tArA upekSA kare, tave nizcaYa AllAha phAsAda sRSTikArIdera samparke avagata|

vala, ‘he kitAvIgaNa, tomarA emana kathAra dike Asa, yeTi AmAdera madhye o tomAdera madhye samAna ye, AmarA ekamAtra AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta nA kari| Ara tAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka nA kari evaM AmAdera keu kAuke AllAha chAr3A rava hisAve grahaNa nA kari’| tArapara yadi tArA vimukha haYa tave vala, ‘tomarA sAkSI thAka ye, nizcaYa AmarA musalima’|
he kitAvIgaNa, tomarA ivarAhImera vyApAre kena vitarka kara? athaca tAorAta o inajIla to tAra parai avatIrNa haYeche| sutarAM tomarA ki vujhave nA?
sAvadhAna! tomarA to sesava loka, vitarka karale emana viSaYe, yAra jJAna tomAdera raYeche| tave kena tomarA vitarka karacha se viSaYe yAra jJAna tomAdera nei? Ara AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|
ivarAhIma iYAhUdIo chila nA, nAsArAo chila nA; varaM se chila ekaniSTha musalima| Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
nizcaYa mAnuSera madhye ivarAhImera savaceYe nikaTavartI tArA, yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche evaM ei navI o muminagaNa| Ara AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka|
kitAvIrA ekadala kAmanA kare, yadi tArA tomAderake vipathagAmI karate pArata! kintu tArA nijaderake chAr3A anya kAuke vipathagAmI karache nA| athaca tArA anubhava karate pAre nA|
he kitAvIrA, tomarA kena AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera sAthe kupharI karacha, athaca tomarAi tAra sAkSya diccha?
he kitAvIrA, kena tomarA satyake mithyAra sAthe mizrita karacha evaM satyake gopana karacha, athaca tomarA tA jAna?
Ara kitAvIdera ekadala vale, ‘muminadera upara yA nAyila karA haYeche, tomarA tAra prati dinera prathamabhAge ImAna Ana, Ara zeSa bhAge tA kupharI kara; yAte tArA phire Ase’|

‘Ara tomarA kevala tAderake vizvAsa kara, yArA tomAdera dInera anusaraNa kare’| vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara hidAYAtai hidAYAta| eTA e janya ye, kona vyaktike deYA have yerUpa tomAderake deYA haYeche| athavA tArA tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAdera sAthe vitarka karave’| vala, ‘nizcaYa anugraha AllAhara hAte, tini yAke cAna, tA dAna karena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa’|
tini yAke cAna, tA~ra rahamata dvArA ekAnta kare nena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahera adhikArI|

Ara kitAvIdera madhye emana vyakti Ache, yadi tAra nikaTa tumi aDhela sampada AmAnata rAkha, tavuo se tA tomAra nikaTa AdAYa kare deve evaM tAdera madhye emana vyaktio Ache, yadi tumi tAra nikaTa eka dInAra AmAnata rAkha, tave sarvocca tAgAdA chAr3A se tA tomAke pherata deve nA| eTi e kAraNe ye, tArA vale, ‘ummIdera vyApAre AmAdera upara kona pApa nei’| Ara tArA jene-zune AllAhara prati mithyA vale|
hyA~, avazyai ye nija pratizruti pUrNa kare evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tave nizcaYa AllAha muttAkIderake bhAlavAsena|

nizcaYa yArA AllAhara aGgIkAra o tAdera zapathera vinimaYe kharida kare tuccha mUlya, parakAle edera janya kona aMza nei| Ara AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA evaM kiYAmatera dina tAdera dike tAkAvena nA, Ara tAderake pavitrao karavena nA evaM tAdera janyai raYeche marmantuda AyAva|

tAdera madhye ekadala raYeche, yArA nijadera jihavA dvArA vikRta kare kitAva pATha kare, yAte tomarA seTA kitAvera aMza mane kara, athaca seTi kitAvera aMza naYa| tArA vale, ‘eTi AllAhara pakSa theke’, athaca tA AllAhara pakSa theke naYa| Ara tArA AllAhara upara mithyA vale, athaca tArA jAne|

kona mAnuSera janya saMgata naYa ye, AllAha tAke kitAva, hikamAta o navuoYAta dAna karAra para se mAnuSake valave, ‘tomarA AllAhake cher3e AmAra vAndA haYe yAo’| varaM se valave, ‘tomarA ravavAnI hao| yehetu tomarA kitAva zikSA dite evaM tA adhyaYana karate’|
Ara tini tomAderake nirdeza karena nA ye, tomarA pherezatA o navIderake rava rUpe grahaNa kara| tomarA musalima haoYAra para tini ki tomAderake kupharIra nirdeza divena?

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha navIdera aGgIkAra niYechena- Ami tomAderake ye kitAva o hikamAta diYechi, ataHpara tomAdera sAthe yA Ache tA satyAYanakArIrUpe ekajana rAsUla tomAdera kAche Asave- takhana avazyai tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anave evaM tAke sAhAyya karave| tini valalena, ‘tomarA ki svIkAra karecha evaM era upara AmAra pratizruti grahaNa karecha’? tArA valala, ‘AmarA svIkAra karalAma’| AllAha valalena, ‘tave tomarA sAkSI thAka evaM Amio tomAdera sAthe sAkSI railAma’|
sutarAM erapara yArA phire yAve, tArA to phAsika|
tArA ki AllAhara dInera parivarte anya kichu tAlAza karache? athaca AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA Ache tA tA~rai Anugatya kare icchAYa kiMvA anicchAYa evaM tAderake tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartana karA have|

vala, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati evaM yA nAyila karA haYeche AmAdera upara, Ara yA nAyila haYeche ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAdera santAnadera upara| Ara yA deYA haYeche mUsA, IsA o anyAnya navIke tAdera ravera pakSa theke, AmarA tAdera kAro madhye pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tArai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI’|
Ara ye isalAma chAr3A anya kona dIna cAYa tave tAra kAcha theke tA kakhano grahaNa karA have nA evaM se AkhirAte kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

kemana kare AllAha se kaomake hidAYAta devena, yArA ImAna AnAra para kupharI kareche, Ara tArA sAkSya diYeche ye, nizcaYa rAsUla satya evaM tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa eseche| Ara AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta dena nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera pratidAna hala, nizcaYa tAdera upara AllAhara, pherezatAdera o sakala mAnuSera lA’nata|
tArA tAte sthAYI have, tAdera theke AyAva zithila karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|
kintu tArA chAr3A yArA erapare tAovA kareche evaM zudhare niYeche tave nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche ImAna AnAra para, tArapara tArA kupharIte ver3e giYeche, tAdera tAovA kakhano kavula karA have nA| Ara tArAi pathabhraSTa|

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche evaM kAphera avasthAYa mArA geche, tAdera kAro kAcha theke yamIna bharA svarNa vinimaYasvarUpa pradAna karaleo grahaNa karA have nA, tAdera janyai raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva, Ara tAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
tomarA kakhano saoYAva arjana karate pArave nA, yatakSaNa nA vyaYa karave tA theke, yA tomarA bhAlavAsa| Ara yA kichu tomarA vyaYa karave, tave nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|

sakala khAvAra vanI isarAIlera janya hAlAla chila| tave isarAIla tAra nijera upara yA hArAma karechila tAorAta avatIrNa haoYAra pUrve| vala, ‘tAhale tomarA tAorAta niYe Asa, ataHpara tA tilAoYAta kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
ataeva yArA eraparao AllAhara vyApAre mithyA raTanA kare, tArA avazyai yAlima|
vala, ‘AllAha satya valechena| sutarAM tomarA ivarAhImera millAtera anusaraNa kara ekaniSThabhAve| Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA’|
nizcaYa prathama ghara, yA mAnuSera janya sthApana karA haYeche, tA makkAYa| yA varakatamaYa o hidAYAta vizvavAsIra janya|

tAte raYeche spaSTa nirdazanasamUha, mAkAme ivarAhIma| Ara ye tAte praveza karave, se nirApada haYe yAve evaM sAmarthyavAna mAnuSera upara AllAhara janya vAYatullAhara hajja karA pharaya| Ara ye kupharI kare, tave AllAha to nizcaYa sRSTikula theke amukhApekSI|
vala, ‘he Ahale kitAva, tomarA kena AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra karacha? Ara AllAha tomarA yA karacha se vyApAre sAkSI|

vala, ‘he Ahale kitAva, tomarA kena AllAhara patha theke vAdhA diccha tAderake, yArA ImAna eneche? tomarA tAte vakratA anusandhAna kara, athaca tomarA sAkSI| Ara tomarA yA kara, tA theke AllAha gAphela nana’|
he muminagaNa, yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche, tomarA yadi tAdera ekaTi dalera Anugatya kara, tArA tomAdera ImAnera para tomAderake kAphira avasthAYa phiriYe neve|

Ara kibhAve tomarA kupharI kara, athaca tomAdera kAche AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA hacche evaM tomAdera madhye raYeche tA~ra rAsUla| Ara ye vyakti AllAhake dRr3habhAve dhAraNa karave tAke avazyai sarala pathera dizA deYA have|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yathAyatha bhaYa| Ara tomarA musalamAna haoYA chAr3A mArA yeo nA|

Ara tomarA sakale AllAhara rajjuke dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara evaM vibhakta haYo nA| Ara tomarA tomAdera upara AllAhara niYAmatake smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA paraspare zatru chile| tArapara AllAha tomAdera antare bhAlavAsAra saJcAra karechena| ataHpara tA~ra anugrahe tomarA bhAi-bhAi haYe gela| Ara tomarA chile Agunera gartera kinArAYa, ataHpara tini tomAderake tA theke rakSA karechena| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha vaYAna karena, yAte tomarA hidAYAtaprApta hao|
Ara yena tomAdera madhya theke emana ekaTi dala haYa, yArA kalyANera prati AhavAna karave, bhAla kAjera Adeza deve evaM manda kAja theke niSedha karave| Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
Ara tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA vibhakta haYeche evaM matavirodha kareche tAdera nikaTa spaSTa nidarzanasamUha AsAra para| Ara tAdera janyai raYeche kaThora AyAva|

sedina kataka cehArA sAdA have evaM kataka cehArA have kAlo| Ara yAdera cehArA kAlo have (tAderake valA have) ‘tomarA ki ImAna AnAra para kupharI karechile? sutarAM tomarA AyAva AsvAdana kara| kAraNa tomarA kupharI karate’|
Ara yAdera cehArA sAdA have, tArA to AllAhara rahamate thAkave| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
egulo AllAhara nirdazana, yA Ami tomAra upara yathAyathabhAve tilAoYAta karachi| Ara AllAha sRSTikulera prati yulama karate cAna nA|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA raYeche, tA AllAhara janyai evaM AllAhara dikei yAvatIYa karmakAnDa pratyAvartita have|

tomarAi hale sarvottama ummata,yAderake mAnuSera janya vera karA haYeche| tomarA bhAla kAjera Adeza deve evaM manda kAja theke vAraNa karave, Ara AllAhara prati ImAna poSaNa karave| Ara yadi Ahale kitAva ImAna Anata, tave avazyai tA tAdera janya kalyANakara hata| tAdera kataka ImAnadAra| tAdera adhikAMzai phAsika|
tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA kaSTa deYA chAr3A| Ara yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare, tave tArA tomAderake pRSThapradarzana kare pAlAve, tArapara tAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|

tArA yekhAnei thAkuka nA kena, tAdera upara nirdhAraNa kare deYA haYeche lAJchanA, tave AllAhara pakSa theke kona pratizruti evaM mAnuSera pakSa theke pratizruti thAkale AlAdA kathA| Ara tArA AllAhara pakSa theke gayava niYe phire eseche| Ara tAdera upara dAridrya nirdhAraNa kare deYA haYeche| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata evaM navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| tA e janya ye, tArA nApharamAnI kareche, Ara tArA sImAlaGghana karata|
tArA samAna naYa| Ahale kitAvera madhye ekadala nyAYera upara pratiSThita raYeche| tArA rAtera velAYa AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare evaM tArA sijadA kare|
tArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkhe evaM tArA bhAla kAjera Adeza deYa o manda kAja theke niSedha kare| Ara tArA kalyANakara kAje druta dhAvita haYa evaM tArA nekakAradera antarbhukta|
Ara tArA ye bhAla kAja kare, tA kakhano asvIkAra karA have nA| Ara AllAha muttAkIdera samparke samyaka jJAta|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kare, AllAhara vipakSe tAdera dhana-sampada nA tAdera kona kAje Asave, Ara nA tAdera santAnAdi| Ara tArA Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

tArA duniYAra jIvane yA vyaYa kare, tAra upamA sei vAtAsera nyAYa, yAte raYeche pracanDa ThAnDA, yA pau~che emana kaomera zasyakSete, yArA nijadera upara yulama karechila| ataHpara tA zasyakSetake dhvaMsa kare deYa| Ara AllAha tAdera upara yulama karenani, varaM tArA nijerAi nijadera upara yulama kare|

he muminagaNa, tomarA tomAdera chAr3A anya kAuke antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| tArA tomAdera sarvanAza karate truTi karave nA| tArA tomAdera mArAtmaka kSati kAmanA kare| tAdera mukha theke to zatrutA prakAza peYe giYeche| Ara tAdera antarasamUha yA gopana kare tA adhika bhaYAvaha| avazyai Ami tomAdera janya AYAtasamUha spaSTa varNanA karechi| yadi tomarA upalavdhi karate|

zona, tomarAi to tAderake bhAlavAsa evaM tArA tomAderake bhAlavAse nA| athaca tomarA sava kitAvera prati ImAna rAkha| Ara yakhana tArA tomAdera sAthe sAkSAt kare, takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’| Ara yakhana tArA ekAnte milita haYa, tomAdera upara rAge AGgula kAmar3AYa| vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera rAga niYe mara’! nizcaYa AllAha antarera gopana viSaYa samparke pUrNa jJAta|

yadi tomAderake kona kalyANa sparza kare, takhana tAdera kaSTa haYa| Ara yadi tomAderake manda sparza kare, takhana tArA tAte khuzi haYa| Ara yadi tomarA dhairya dhara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tAhale tAdera Sar3ayantra tomAdera kichu kSati karave nA| nizcaYa AllAha tArA yA kare, tA pariveSTanakArI|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tumi tomAra parivAra parijana theke sakAla velAYa vera haYe muminaderake lar3AiYera sthAnasamUhe vinyasta karechile; Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

yakhana tomAdera madhya theke du’dala* pichu haTAra icchA karala, athaca AllAha tAdera ubhaYera abhibhAvaka| Ara AllAhara uparai yena muminagaNa tAoYAkkula kare| *uhuda yuddhera samaYa munAphika sardAra AvadullAha ivane uvAiYera sAthe tinazata jana sainya yuddhera maYadAna theke pherat cale yAYa| edera dekhAdekhi vanu sAlAmA o vanU hArechAra lokerAo cale yete ceYechila| kintu AllAhara rahamate tArA yAYani|
Ara avazyai AllAha tomAderake vadare sAhAyya karechena athaca tomarA chile hInavala| ataeva tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AzA karA yAYa, tomarA zokaragujAra have|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tumi muminaderake valachile, ‘tomAdera janya ki yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAdera rava tomAderake tina hAjAra nAyilakRta pherezatA dvArA sAhAyya karavena’?
hyA~, yadi tomarA dhairya dhara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, Ara tArA haThAt tomAdera mukhomukhi ese yAYa, tave tomAdera rava pA~ca hAjAra ci‎‎hnata pherezatA dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karavena|
Ara AllAha tomAdera janya tA kevala susaMvAdasvarUpa nirdhAraNa karechena evaM yAte tomAdera antarasamUha era dvArA prazAnta haYa| Ara sAhAyya kevala parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke|
yAte tini kAphiradera ekaTi aMzake nizci‎hna karena athavA tAderake lAJchita karena| phale tArA nirAza haYe phire yAve|
e viSaYe tomAra kona adhikAra nei- haYato tini tAderake kSamA karavena athavA tini tAderake AyAva devena| kAraNa nizcaYa tArA yAlima|
Ara AllAhara janyai yA Ache AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA Ache yamIne | tini yAke icchA kSamA karena, Ara yAke icchA AyAva dena| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa, tomarA suda khAve nA vahuguNa vRddhi kare| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphala hao|
Ara tomarA Agunake bhaYa kara, yA kAphiradera janya tairi karA haYeche|
Ara tomarA Anugatya kara AllAha o rAsUlera, yAte tomAderake daYA karA haYa|
Ara tomarA druta agrasara hao tomAdera ravera pakSa theke mAgaphirAta o jAnnAtera dike, yAra paridhi AsamAnasamUha o yamInera samAna, yA muttAkIdera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
yArA susamaYe o duHsamaYe vyaYa kare evaM krodha saMvaraNa kare o mAnuSake kSamA kare| Ara AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

Ara yArA kona azlIla kAja karale athavA nijadera prati yulama karale AllAhake smaraNa kare, ataHpara tAdera gunAhera janya kSamA cAYa| Ara AllAha chAr3A ke gunAha kSamA karave? Ara tArA yA kareche, jene zune tA tArA vAra vAra kare nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera pratidAna tAdera ravera pakSa theke mAgaphirAta o jAnnAtasamUha yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche naharasamUha| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| Ara AmalakArIdera pratidAna katai nA uttama!
avazyai tomAdera pUrve aneka rIti-nIti ativAhita haYeche, ataeva tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara, dekha asvIkArakArIdera pariNati kirUpa haYechila|
eTA mAnuSera janya spaSTa varNanA o hidAYAta evaM upadeza muttAkIdera janya|
Ara tomarA durvala haYo nA evaM duHkhita haYo nA, Ara tomarAi vijaYI yadi mumina haYe thAka|

yadi tomAderake kona AghAta sparza kare thAke tave tAra anurUpa AghAta ukta kaomakeo sparza kareche| Ara eisava dina Ami mAnuSera madhye pAlAkrame Avartana kari evaM yAte AllAha ImAnadAraderake jene nena evaM tomAdera madhya theke zahIdaderake grahaNa karena| Ara AllAha yAlimaderake bhAlavAsena nA|
Ara yAte AllAha parizuddha karena ImAnadAraderake evaM dhvaMsa kare dena kAphiraderake|
tomarA ki mane kara ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave? athaca AllAha ekhano jAnenani tAderake yArA tomAdera madhya theke jihAda kareche evaM jAnenani dhairyazIladerake|
Ara tomarA avazyai mRtyu kAmanA karate, tAra sAthe sAkSAtera pUrve| ataeva tomarA to tA dekhechai ematAvasthAYa ye, tomarA tAkAcchile |

Ara muhAmmAda kevala ekajana rAsUla| tAra pUrve nizcaYa aneka rAsUla vigata haYeche| yadi se mArA yAYa athavA tAke hatyA karA haYa, tave tomarA ki tomAdera pechane phire yAve? Ara ye vyakti pechane phire yAYa, se kakhano AllAhara kona kSati karate pAre nA| Ara AllAha acirei kRtajJadera pratidAna devena|

Ara kona prANI AllAhara anumati chAr3A mArA yAYa nA, tA nirdiSTabhAve likhita Ache| Ara ye duniYAra pratidAna cAYa, Ami tA theke tAke diYe dei, Ara ye AkhirAtera vinimaYa cAYa, Ami tA theke tAkeo dei evaM Ami acirei kRtajJadera pratidAna deva|

Ara kata navI chila, yAra sAthe theke aneka AllAhaoYAlA lar3Ai kareche| tave AllAhara pathe tAdera upara yA Apatita haYeche tAra janya tArA hatodyama haYani| Ara tArA durvala haYani evaM tArA nata haYani| Ara AllAha dhairyazIladerake bhAlavAsena|

Ara tAdera kathA zudhu ei chila ye, tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera pApa o AmAdera karme AmAdera sImAlaGaghana kSamA karuna evaM avicala rAkhuna AmAdera pAsamUhake, Ara kAphira kaomera upara AmAderake sAhAyya karuna’|
ataHpara AllAha tAderake dilena duniYAra pratidAna evaM AkhirAtera uttama saoYAva| Ara AllAha satkarmazIladerake bhAlavAsena|
he muminagaNa, yadi tomarA kAphiradera Anugatya kara, tArA tomAderake tomAdera pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe niYe yAve| phale tomarA kSatigrasta haYe phire yAve|
varaM AllAha tomAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tini uttama sAhAyyakArI|

acirei Ami kAphiradera antarasamUhe AtaGka Dhele deva| kAraNa tArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka kareche, ye samparke AllAha kona pramANa nAyila karenani| Ara tAdera AzraYasthala hala Aguna evaM yAlimadera ThikAnA katai nA nikRSTa!

Ara AllAha tomAdera kAche tA~ra oYAdA satye pariNata karena, yakhana tomarA tAderake hatyA karachile tA~ra nirdeze| avazeSe yakhana tomarA durvala haYe gele evaM nirdeza samparke vivAda karale Ara tomarA avAdhya hale tomarA yA bhAlavAsate tA tomAderake dekhAnora para| tomAdera madhye keu duniYA cAYa Ara keu cAYa AkhirAta| tArapara AllAha tomAderake tAdera theke phiriYe dilena yAte tini tomAderake parIkSA karena| Ara avazyai AllAha tomAderake kSamA kare diYechena evaM AllAha muminadera upara anugrahazIla|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA upare uThachile evaM kAro dike phire dekhachile nA, Ara rAsUla tomAderake DAkachila tomAdera pechana theke| phale tini tomAderake duzcintAra para duzcintA diYechilena, yAte tomAdera yA hAriYe giYeche evaM tomAdera upara yA Apatita haYeche tAra janya duHkha nA kara| Ara tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha samyaka avagata|

tArapara tini tomAdera upara duzcintAra para nAyila karalena prazAnta tandrA, yA tomAdera madhya theke ekadalake Dheke phelechila, Ara aparadala nijarAi nijaderake cintAgrasta karechila| tArA AllAha samparke jAhilI dhAraNAra nyAYa asatya dhAraNA poSaNa karachila| tArA valachila, ‘AmAdera ki kona viSaYe adhikAra Ache’? vala, ‘nizcaYa sava viSaYa AllAhara’| tArA tAdera antare lukiYe rAkhe emana viSaYa yA tomAra kAche prakAza kare nA| tArA vale, ‘yadi kona viSaYe AmAdera adhikAra thAkata, tAhale AmAderake ekhAne hatyA karA hata nA’| vala, ‘tomarA yadi tomAdera ghare thAkate tAhaleo yAdera vyApAre nihata haoYA avadhArita raYeche, avazyai tArA tAdera nihata haoYAra sthalera dike vera haYe yeta| Ara yAte tomAdera mane yA Ache AllAha tA parIkSA karena evaM tomAdera antarasamUhe yA Ache tA pariSkAra karena| Ara AllAha tomAdera antarera viSaYa samparke pUrNa jJAta’|

nizcaYai tomAdera madhya theke yArA pichu haTe giYechila sedina, yedina du’dala mukhomukhi haYechila, zaYatAnai tAdera kichu kRtakarmera phale tAderake padaskhalita karechila| Ara avazyai AllAha tAderake kSamA karechena| nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|

he muminagaNa, tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA kupharI kareche evaM tAdera bhAiderake valeche- yakhana tArA yamIne saphare vera haYechila athavA tArA chila yoddhA (ataHpara nihata haYechila)-‘yadi tArA AmAdera kAche thAkata, tave tArA mArA yeta nA evaM tAderake hatyA karA hata nA’| yAte AllAha tA tAdera antare AkSepe pariNata karena evaM AllAha jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu dena| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha se viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
Ara tomAderake yadi AllAhara rAstAYa hatyA karA haYa athavA tomarA mArA yAo, tAhale avazyai AllAhara pakSa theke kSamA o daYA tArA yA jamA kare tA theke uttama|
Ara yadi tomarA mArA yAo athavA tomAderake hatyA karA haYa, tave tomAderake AllAhara nikaTai samaveta karA have|

ataHpara AllAhara pakSa theke rahamatera kAraNe tumi tAdera janya namra haYechile| Ara yadi tumi kaThora svabhAvera, kaThina hRdaYasampanna hate, tave tArA tomAra AzapAza theke sare par3ata| sutarAM tAderake kSamA kara evaM tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara| Ara kAje-karme tAdera sAthe parArmaza kara| ataHpara yakhana saMkalpa karave takhana AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula karave| nizcaYa AllAha tAoYAkkulakArIderake bhAlavAsena|

yadi AllAha tomAderake sAhAyya karena tave tomAdera upara vijaYI keu nei| Ara yadi tini tomAderake lAJchita karena tave ke emana Ache ye, tomAderake era pare sAhAyya karave? Ara AllAhara uparai yena muminagaNa tAoYAkkula kare|

Ara kona navIra janya ucita naYa ye, se khiYAnata karave| Ara ye khiYAnata karave, kiYAmatera dine upasthita have tA niYe yA se khiYAnata kareche| ataHpara pratyeka vyaktike puropuri deYA have yA se upArjana kareche evaM tAderake yulama karA have nA|
ye AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa kareche seki tAra mata ye AllAhara krodha niYe phire eseche? Ara tAra AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma evaM tA katai nA manda pratyAvartanasthala!
tArA AllAhara nikaTa vibhinna maryAdAra| Ara tArA yA kare, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

avazyai AllAha muminadera upara anugraha karechena, yakhana tini tAdera madhya theke tAdera prati ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechena, ye tAdera kAche tA~ra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare evaM tAderake parizuddha kare Ara tAderake kitAva o hikamAta zikSA deYa| yadio tArA itaHpUrve spaSTa bhrAntite chila|

Ara yakhana tomAdera upara vipada ela, (athaca) tomarA to era dviguNa vipade AkrAnta hale (vadara yuddhe)| tomarA valechile eTA kottheke? vala, ‘tA tomAdera nijadera theke’| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara tomAdera upara ye vipada esechila dui dala mukhomukhi haoYAra dina tA AllAhara anumatikrame evaM yAte tini muminaderake jene nena|

Ara yAte tini jene nena munAphikaderake| Ara tAderake valA haYechila, ‘eso, AllAhara pathe lar3Ai kara athavA pratirodha kara’| tArA valechila, ‘yadi AmarA lar3Ai have jAnatAma* tave avazyai tomAderake anusaraNa karatAma’| sedina tArA kupharIra vezi kAchAkAchi chila tAdera ImAnera tulanAYa| tArA tAdera mukhe vale, yA tAdera antarasamUhe nei| Ara tArA yA gopana kare se samparke AllAha adhika avagata| *era du’Ti artha hate pAre- yadi AmarA lar3Ai karate jAnatAma athavA lar3Ai saMghaTita have vale jAnatAma|
yArA tAdera bhAiderake valechila evaM vasechila, ‘yadi tArA AmAdera anukaraNa karata, tArA nihata hata nA’| vala, ‘tAhale tomarA tomAdera nija theke mRtyuke dUre sarAo yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
Ara yArA AllAhara pathe jIvana diYeche, tAderake tumi mRta mane karo nA, varaM tArA tAdera ravera nikaTa jIvita| tAderake riyka deYA haYa|

AllAha tAderake ye anugraha karechena, tAte tArA khuzi| Ara tArA utphula¬ haYa, paravartIdera theke yArA ekhano tAdera sAthe milita haYani tAdera viSaYe| ejanya ye, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArA AllAhara pakSa theke niAmata o anugraha lAbhe khuzi haYa| Ara nizcaYa AllAha muminadera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|
yArA AllAha o rAsUlera DAke sAr3A diYeche yakhamaprApta haoYAra parao, tAdera madhya theke yArA satkarma kareche evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche tAdera janya raYeche mahApuraskAra|

yAderake mAnuSerA valechila ye, ‘nizcaYa lokerA tomAdera viruddhe samaveta haYeche| sutarAM tAderake bhaYa kara’| kintu tA tAdera ImAna vAr3iYe diYechila evaM tArA valechila, ‘AllAhai AmAdera janya yatheSTa evaM tini katai nA uttama karmavidhAYaka’!
ataHpara tArA phire eseche AllAhara pakSa theke niAmata o anugrahasaha| kona manda tAderake sparza kareni evaM tArA AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa karechila| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|
se to zaYatAna| se tomAderake tAra vandhudera bhaYa dekhAYa| tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo nA, varaM AmAke bhaYa kara, yadi tomarA mumina hao|

yArA kupharIte druta dhAvita haYa tArA yena tomAke duHzcintAgrasta nA kare, nizcaYa tArA AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha cAna ye, tAdera janya AkhirAte kona aMza rAkhavena nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|
nizcaYa yArA ImAnera vinimaYe kupharI kraYa kareche, tArA kakhanoi AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

Ara yArA kupharI kareche tArA yena mane nA kare ye, Ami tAdera janya ye avakAza dei, tA tAdera nijadera janya uttama| Ami to tAderake avakAza dei yAte tArA pApa vRddhi kare| Ara tAdera janya raYeche apamAnajanaka AyAva|

AllAha emana nana ye, tini muminaderake (emana avasthAYa) cher3e devena yAra upara tomarA Acha| yatakSaNa nA tini pRthaka karavena apavitrake pavitra theke| Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tini tomAderake gAYeva samparke jAnAvena| tave AllAha tA~ra rAsUladera madhya theke yAke cAna veche nena| sutarAM tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana| Ara yadi tomarA ImAna Ana evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave tomAdera janya raYeche mahApratidAna|

Ara AllAha yAderake tA~ra anugraha theke yA dAna karechena tA niYe yArA kRpaNatA kare tArA yena dhAraNA nA kare ye, tA tAdera janya kalyANakara| varaM tA tAdera janya akalyANakara| yA niYe tArA kRpaNatA karechila, kiYAmata divase tA diYe tAdera ver3i parAno have| Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamInera uttarAdhikAra AllAharai janya| Ara tomarA yA Amala kara se vyApAre AllAha samyaka jJAta|

nizcaYa AllAha tAdera kathA zunechena, yArA valeche, ‘nizcaYa AllAha daridra evaM AmarA dhanI’| acirei Ami likhe rAkhava tArA yA valeche evaM navIderake tAdera anyAYabhAve hatyAra viSaYaTio evaM Ami valava, ‘tomarA uttapta AyAva AsvAdana kara’|
e hala tomAdera hAta yA AgAma peza kareche eTA se kAraNe| Ara nizcaYa AllAha vAndAdera prati yAlima nana|

yArA vale, ‘nizcaYa AllAha AmAderake aGgIkAra diYechilena ye, AmarA yena kona rAsUlera prati vizvAsa nA kari, yatakSaNa nA se AmAdera nikaTa niYe Ase emana kuravAnI yAke Aguna kheYe phelave’| vala, ‘AmAra pUrve rAsUlagaNa tomAdera nikaTa eseche spaSTa pramANasamUha niYe evaM tomarA yA valacha tA niYe| sutarAM tomarA tAderake kena hatyA karechile yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka’?
ataeva yadi tArA tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tomAra pUrve rAsUlagaNake mithyAvAdI valA haYechila| tArA spaSTa pramANasamUha, sahIphA o AlokamaYa kitAvasaha esechila|

pratiTi prANI mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| Ara ‘avazyai kiYAmatera dine tAdera pratidAna paripUrNabhAve deYA have| sutarAM yAke jAhAnnAma theke dUre rAkhA have evaM jAnnAte praveza karAno have se-i saphalatA pAve| Ara duniYAra jIvana zudhu dho~kAra sAmagrI|

avazyai tomAderake tomAdera dhana-sampada o tomAdera nija jIvana samparke parIkSA karA have| Ara avazyai tomarA zunave tomAdera pUrve yAdera kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera pakSa theke evaM muzarikadera pakSa theke aneka kaSTadAYaka kathA| Ara yadi tomarA dhairya dhara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave nizcaYa tA have dRr3ha saMkalpera kAja|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha kitAvaprAptadera aGgIkAra niYechilena ye, ‘avazyai tomarA tA mAnuSera nikaTa spaSTabhAve varNanA karave evaM tA gopana karave nA’| kintu tArA tA tAdera pechane phele deYa evaM tA vikri kare tuccha mUlye| ataeva tArA yA kraYa kare, tA katainA manda!
yArA tAdera kRtakarmera prati khuzI haYa evaM yA tArA kareni tA niYe prazaMsita hate pachanda kare, tumi tAderake AyAva theke mukta mane karo nA| Ara tAdera janyai raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara AllAhara janyai AsamAna o yamInera rAjatva| Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTi evaM rAta o dinera vivartanera madhye raYeche vivekasampannadera janya vahu nirdazana|

yArA AllAhake smaraNa kare dA~r3iYe, vase o kAta haYe evaM AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTi samparke cintA kare| (vale) ‘he AmAdera rava, tumi esava anarthaka sRSTi karani| tumi pavitra mahAna| sutarAM tumi AmAderake Agunera AyAva theke rakSA kara’|
‘he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa tumi yAke Agune praveza karAve, avazyai tAke tumi apamAna karave| Ara yAlimadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei’|

‘he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa AmarA zunechilAma ekajana AhavAnakArIke, ye ImAnera dike AhavAna kare ye, ‘tomarA tomAdera ravera prati ImAna Ana’| tAi AmarA ImAna enechi| he AmAdera rava AmAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA karuna evaM vidUrita karuna AmAdera truTi-vicyuti, Ara AmAderake mRtyu dina nekakAradera sAthe’|

‘he AmAdera rava, Ara Apani AmAderake tA pradAna karuna yAra oYAdA Apani AmAderake diYechena ApanAra rAsUlagaNera mAdhyame| Ara kiYAmatera dine Apani AmAderake apamAna karavena nA| nizcaYa Apani aGgIkAra bhaGga karena nA’|

ataHpara tAdera rava tAdera DAke sAr3A dilena ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera kona puruSa athavA mahilA AmalakArIra Amala naSTa karava nA| tomAdera eke aparera aMza| sutarAM yArA hijarata kareche evaM yAderake tAdera ghara theke vera kare deYA haYeche evaM yAderake AmAra rAstAYa kaSTa deYA haYeche, Ara yArA yuddha kareche evaM nihata haYeche, Ami avazyai tAdera truTi-vicyutisamUha vilupta kare deva evaM tAderake praveza karAvo jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra taladeze pravAhita hacche naharasamUha; AllAhara pakSa theke pratidAnasvarUpa| Ara AllAhara nikaTa raYeche uttama pratidAna|
nagarasamUhe sesava lokera calA-pherA tomAke yena dho~kAYa nA phele yArA kupharI kareche|
esava alpa bhogyasAmagrI| erapara tAdera AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma; Ara tA katainA manda vichAnA!

kintu yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta, yAra taladeze pravAhita have naharasamUha, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| eTA AllAhara pakSa theke mehamAnadArI| Ara AllAhara nikaTa yA raYeche tA nekakAra lokadera janya uttama|

Ara nizcaYa Ahale kitAvadera madhye emana loka raYeche, ye AllAhara janya vinIta haYe ImAna Ane AllAhara prati evaM yA nAyila karA haYeche tomAdera prati, Ara yA nAyila karA haYeche tAdera prati| tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha svalpamUlyera vinimaYe vikraYa kare nA| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa puraskAra| nizcaYa AllAha ati druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
he muminagaNa, tomarA dhairya dhara o dhairye aTala thAka evaM pAhArAYa niYojita thAka| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphala hao|

he mAnuSa, tomarA tomAdera ravake bhaYa kara, yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena eka naphsa theke| Ara tA theke sRSTi karechena tAra strIke evaM tAdera theke char3iYe diYechena vahu puruSa o nArI| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra mAdhyame tomarA eke aparera kAche ceYe thAka| Ara bhaYa kara rakta-samparkita AtmIYera vyApAre| nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera upara paryavekSaka|

Ara tomarA iYAtImaderake tAdera dhana-sampada diYe dAo evaM tomarA apavitra vasttake pavitra vastta dvArA parivartana karo nA evaM tAdera dhana-sampadake tomAdera dhana-sampadera sAthe kheYo nA| nizcaYa tA var3a pApa|

Ara yadi tomarA AzaGkA kara ye, iYAtImadera vyApAre tomarA inasApha karate pArave nA, tAhale tomarA viYe kara nArIdera madhye yAke tomAdera bhAla lAge; du’Ti, tinaTi athavA cAraTi| Ara yadi bhaYa kara ye, tomarA samAna AcaraNa karate pArave nA, tave ekaTi athavA tomAdera DAna hAta yAra mAlika haYeche| eTA adhikatara nikaTavartI ye, tomarA yulama karave nA|
Ara tomarA nArIderake santuSTacitte tAdera mohara diYe dAo, ataHpara yadi tArA tomAdera janya tA theke khuzi haYe kichu chAr3a deYa, tAhale tomarA tA sAnande tRptisahakAre khAo|

Ara tomarA nirvodhadera hAte tomAdera dhana-sampada dio nA, yAke AllAha tomAdera janya karechena jIvikAra mAdhyama evaM tomarA tA theke tAderake AhAra dAo, tAderake paridhAna karAo evaM tAdera sAthe uttama kathA vala|

Ara tomarA iYAtImaderake parIkSA kara yatakSaNa nA tArA vivAhera vaYase pau~che| sutarAM yadi tomarA tAdera madhye vivekera paripakkatA dekhate pAo, tave tAdera dhana-sampada tAderake diYe dAo| Ara tomarA tAdera sampada kheYo nA apacaYa kare evaM tArA var3a haoYAra Age tAr3Ahur3A kare| Ara ye dhanI se yena saMyata thAke, Ara ye daridra se yena nyAYasaGgatabhAve khAYa| ataHpara yakhana tomarA tAdera dhana-sampada tAdera nikaTa soparda karave takhana tAdera upara tomarA sAkSI rAkhave| Ara hisAva grahaNakArI hiseve AllAha yatheSTa|

puruSadera janya mAtA pitA o nikaTAtmIYarA yA rekhe giYeche tA theke ekaTi aMza raYeche| Ara nArIdera janya raYeche mAtA pitA o nikaTAtmIYarA yA rekhe giYeche tA theke ekaTi aMza- tA theke kama hoka vA vezi hoka- nirdhArita hAre|
Ara yadi vaNTane nikaTAtmIYa evaM iYAtIma o misakInarA upasthita haYa, tAhale tomarA tAderake tA theke AhAra deve evaM tAdera sAthe tomarA uttama kathA valave|
Ara tAdera bhaYa karA ucit ye, yadi tArA tAdera pechane asahAYa santAna rekhe yeta, tAhale tArA tAdera viSaYe udvigna hata| sutarAM tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM yena saThika kathA vale|
nizcaYa yArA iYAtImadera dhana-sampada anyAYabhAve bhakSaNa kare tArA to tAdera peTe Aguna khAcche; Ara acirei tArA prajjvalita Agune praveza karave|

AllAha tomAderake tomAdera santAnadera samparke nirdeza dicchena, eka chelera janya dui meYera aMzera samaparimANa| tave yadi tArA duiYera adhika meYe haYa, tAhale tAdera janya have, yA se rekhe geche tAra tina bhAgera dui bhAga; Ara yadi ekajana meYe haYa takhana tAra janya ardheka| Ara tAra mAtA pitA ubhaYera pratyekera janya chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga se yA rekhe geche tA theke, yadi tAra santAna thAke| Ara yadi tAra santAna nA thAke evaM tAra oYAricha haYa tAra mAtA pitA takhana tAra mAtAra janya tina bhAgera eka bhAga| Ara yadi tAra bhAi-vona thAke tave tAra mAYera janya chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga| asiYata pAlanera para, yA dvArA se asiYata kareche athavA RNa parizodhera para| tomAdera mAtA pitA o tomAdera santAna-santatidera madhya theke tomAdera upakAre ke adhika nikaTavartI tA tomarA jAna nA| AllAhara pakSa theke nirdhArita| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tomAdera janya tomAdera strIgaNa yA rekhe geche tAra ardheka, yadi tAdera kona santAna nA thAke| Ara yadi tAdera santAna thAke, tave tArA yA rekhe geche tA theke tomAdera janya cAra bhAgera eka bhAga| tArA ye asiYata kare geche tA pAlanera para athavA RNa parizodhera para| Ara strIdera janya tomarA yA rekhe giYecha tA theke cAra bhAgera ekabhAga, yadi tomAdera kona santAna nA thAke| Ara yadi tomAdera santAna thAke tAhale tAdera janya ATa bhAgera eka bhAga, tomarA yA rekhe giYeche tA theke| tomarA ye asiYata karecha tA pAlana athavA RNa parizodhera para| Ara yadi mA vAvA evaM santAna-santati nAi emana kona puruSa vA mahilA mArA yAYa evaM tAra thAke eka bhAi athavA eka vona, takhana tAdera pratyekera janya chaYa bhAgera ekabhAga| Ara yadi tArA era theke adhika haYa tave tArA savAi tina bhAgera eka bhAgera madhye samaaMzIdAra have, ye asiYata karA haYeche tA pAlanera para athavA RNa parizodhera para| kAro kona kSati nA kare| AllAhara pakSa theke asiYatasvarUpa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

egulo AllAhara sImArekhA| Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare AllAha tAke praveza karAvena jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche naharasamUha| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| Ara eTA mahA saphalatA |
Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera nApharamAnI kare evaM tA~ra sImArekhA laGghana kare AllAha tAke Agune praveza karAvena| sekhAne se sthAYI have| Ara tAra janyai raYeche apamAnajanaka AyAva|

Ara tomAdera nArIdera madhya theke yArA vyabhicAra kare, tomarA tAdera upara tomAdera madhya theke cAra jana sAkSI upasthita kara| ataHpara yadi tArA sAkSya deYa tave tomarA tAderake gharera madhye Avaddha rAkha yatakSaNa nA mRtyu tAdera jIvana zeSa kare deYa| athavA AllAha tAdera janya kona patha tairi kare dena|

Ara tomAdera madhya theke ye du’jana apakarma karave, tAderake tomarA AyAva dAo| ataHpara yadi tArA tAovA kare evaM zudhariYe neYa tave tomarA tAdera theke virata thAka| nizcaYa AllAha tAovA kavUlakArI, daYAlu |
nizcaYa tAovA kavUla karA AllAhara jimmAYa tAdera janya, yArA ajJatAvazata manda kAja kare| tArapara zIghrai tAovA kare| ataHpara AllAha edera tAovA kavula karavena Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAovA nAi tAdera, yArA anyAYa kAja karate thAke, avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAro mRtyu ese yAYa, takhana vale, Ami ekhana tAovA karalAma, Ara tAovA tAdera janya naYa, yArA kAphira avasthAYa mArA yAYa; Ami edera janyai tairI karechi yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

he muminagaNa, tomAdera janya hAlAla naYa ye, tomarA jora kare nArIdera oYAricha have| Ara tomarA tAderake Avaddha kare rekho nA, tAderake yA diYecha tA theke tomarA kichu niYe neYAra janya, tave yadi tArA prakAzya azlIlatAYa lipta haYa| Ara tomarA tAdera sAthe sadbhAve vasavAsa kara| Ara yadi tomarA tAderake apachanda kara, tave emanao hate pAre ye, tomarA kona kichuke apachanda karacha Ara AllAha tAte aneka kalyANa rAkhavena|

Ara yadi tomarA eka strIra sthale anya strIke vadalAte cAo Ara tAdera kAuke tomarA pradAna karecha pracura sampada, tave tomarA tA theke kona kichu nio nA| tomarA ki tA neve apavAda evaM prakAzya gunAhera mAdhyame?
Ara tomarA tA kIbhAve neve athaca tomarA eke aparera sAthe ekAnte milita haYecha; Ara tArA tomAdera theke niYechila dRr3ha aGgIkAra?

Ara tomarA vivAha karo nA nArIdera madhya theke yAderake vivAha kareche tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNa| tave pUrve yA saMghaTita haYeche (tA kSamA karA hala)| nizcaYa tA hala azlIlatA o ghRNita viSaYa evaM nikRSTa patha|

tomAdera upara hArAma karA haYeche tomAdera mAtAderake, tomAdera meYederake, tomAdera vonaderake, tomAdera phuphuderake, tomAdera khAlAderake, bhAtijIderake, bhAgnIderake, tomAdera se sava mAtAke yArA tomAderake dudhapAna kariYeche, tomAdera dudhavonaderake, tomAdera zvAzur3Iderake, tomarA yesava strIra sAthe milita haYecha sesava strIra apara svAmI theke yesava kanyA tomAdera kole raYeche tAderake, Ara yadi tomarA tAdera sAthe milita nA haYe thAka tave tomAdera upara kona pApa nei evaM tomAdera aurasajAta putradera strIderake evaM dui vonake ekatra karA(tomAdera upara hArAma karA haYeche)| tave atIte yA haYe geche tA bhinna kathA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara (hArAma karA haYeche) nArIdera madhya theke sadhavAderake| tave tomAdera DAna hAta yAdera mAlika haYeche (dAsIgaNa) tArA chAr3A| eTi tomAdera upara AllAhara vidhAna evaM erA chAr3A sakala nArIke tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche ye, tomarA tomAdera arthera vinimaYe tAderake cAive vivAha kare, avaidha yaunAcAre lipta haYe naYa| sutarAM tAdera madhye tomarA yAderake bhoga karecha tAderake tAdera nirdhArita mohara diYe dAo| Ara nirdhAraNera para ye vyApAre tomarA paraspara sammata have tAte tomAdera upara kona aparAdha nei| nizcaYa AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tomAdera madhye ye vyakti svAdhIna-mumina nArIderake vivAha karAra sAmarthya rAkhe nA, se (vivAha karave) tomAdera mumina yuvatIdera madhya theke, tomAdera hAta yAdera mAlika haYeche tAdera kAuke| Ara AllAha tomAdera ImAna samparke adhika jJAta| tomarA eke anyera theke (esecha)| sutarAM tomarA tAderake tAdera mAlikadera anumatikrame vivAha kara evaM nyAYasaGgatabhAve tAderake tAdera mohara diYe dAo ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA have satI-sAdhvI, vyabhicAriNI kiMvA gopana yaunasaGgI grahaNakAriNI naYa| ataHpara yakhana tArA vivAhita have takhana yadi vyabhicAre lipta haYa tAhale tAdera upara svAdhIna nArIra ardheka AyAva have| eTA tAdera janya, tomAdera madhye yArA vyabhicArera bhaYa kare evaM dhairyadhAraNa karA tomAdera janya uttama| Ara AlalAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha cAna tomAdera janya vistArita varNanA karate, tomAderake tomAdera pUrvavartIdera Adarza pradarzana karate evaM tomAdera tAovA kavUla karate| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara AllAha cAna tomAdera tAovA kavUla karate| Ara yArA pravRttira anusaraNa kare tArA cAYa ye, tomarA pravalabhAve (satya patha theke) vicyuta hao|
AllAha tomAdera theke (vidhAna) sahaja karate cAna, Ara mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche durvala kare|

he muminagaNa, tomarA parasparera madhye tomAdera dhana-sampada anyAYabhAve kheYo nA, tave pArasparika sammatite vyavasAra mAdhyame hale bhinna kathA| Ara tomarA nijerA nijaderake hatyA karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera vyApAre parama daYAlu|
Ara ye ai kAja karave sImAlaGghana o anyAYabhAve, Ami acirei tAke Agune praveza karAva| Ara seTi have AllAhara upara sahaja|
tomarA yadi sesava kavIrA gunAha parihAra kara, yA theke tomAdera vAraNa karA haYeche, tAhale Ami tomAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA kare deva evaM tomAderake praveza karAva sammAnajanaka pravezasthale|

Ara tomarA AkAGkSA karo nA se savera, yAra mAdhyame AllAha tomAdera eka janake anya janera upara prAdhAnya diYechena| puruSadera janya raYeche aMza, tArA yA upArjana kare tA theke evaM nArIdera janya raYeche aMza, yA tArA upArjana kare tA theke| Ara tomarA AllAhara kAche tA~ra anugraha cAo| nizcaYa AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka jJAta|

Ara Ami pratyekera janya nirdhAraNa karechi uttarAdhikArI, pitA-mAtA o nikaTa AtmIYa-svajana yA rekhe yAYa evaM yAdera sAthe tomarA cukti karecha, tA theke* | sutarAM tomarA tAderake tAdera aMza diYe dAo| nizcaYa AllAha savakichura upara sAkSI| * cuktibhittika uttarAdhikArera viSaYaTi jAhilI yugera prathA, isalAmera sUcanAte eTi valavat thAkaleo pare tA rahita karA haYa|

puruSarA nArIdera tattvAvadhAYaka, e kAraNe ye, AllAha tAdera ekera upara anyake zreSThatva diYechena evaM yehetu tArA nijadera sampada theke vyaYa kare| sutarAM puNyavatI nArIrA anugata, tArA lokacakSura antarAle hiphAyAtakArinI ai viSaYera yA AllAha hiphAyata karechena| Ara tomarA yAdera avAdhyatAra AzaGkA kara tAderake sadupadeza dAo, vichAnAYa tAderake tyAga kara evaM tAderake (mRdu) prahAra kara| erapara yadi tArA tomAdera Anugatya kare tAhale tAdera viruddhe kona patha anusandhAna karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha samunnata mahAna|

Ara yadi tomarA tAdera ubhaYera madhye vicchedera AzaGkA kara tAhale svAmIra parivAra theke ekajana vicAraka evaM strIra parivAra theke ekajana vicAraka pAThAo| yadi tArA mImAMsA cAYa tAhale AllAha ubhaYera madhye mila kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJAnI, samyaka avagata|

tomarA ivAdAta kara AllAhara, tA~ra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karo nA| Ara sadvyavahAra kara mAtA-pitAra sAthe, nikaTa AtmIYera sAthe, iYAtIma, misakIna, nikaTa AtmIYa- prativezI, anAtmIYa- prativezI, pArzvavartI sAthI, musAphira evaM tomAdera mAlikAnAbhukta dAsa-dAsIdera sAthe| nizcaYa AllAha pachanda karena nA tAderake yArA dAmbhika, ahaGkArI|
yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSake kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa; Ara gopana kare tA, yA AllAha tAderake svIYa anugrahe dAna karechena| Ara Ami prastuta kare rekhechi kAphiradera janya lAJchanAkara AyAva|
Ara yArA nija dhana-sampada loka dekhAnora uddezye vyaYa kare evaM ImAna Ane nA AllAhara prati evaM nA zeSa dinera prati| Ara zaYatAna yAra saGgI haYa, saGgI hiseve katainA nikRSTa se!
tAdera emana kI kSati hata yadi tArA ImAna Anata AllAha o zeSa divasera prati evaM AllAha tAdera ye riyka diYechena tA theke vyaYa karata? AllAha tAdera samparke samyaka jJAta|
nizcaYa AllAha aNu parimANao yulama karena nA| Ara yadi seTi bhAla kAja haYa, tini tAke dviguNa kare dena evaM tA~ra pakSa theke mahA pratidAna pradAna karena|
ataeva kemana have yakhana Ami pratyeka ummata theke ekajana sAkSI upasthita karava evaM tomAke upasthita karava tAdera upara sAkSIrUpe?
yArA kupharI kareche evaM rAsUlera avAdhya haYeche tArA sedina kAmanA karave, yadi yamInake tAdera sAthe (miziYe) samAna kare deYA hata, Ara tArA AllAhara kAche kona kathA gopana karate pArave nA|

he muminagaNa, nezAgrasta avasthAYa tomarA sAlAtera nikaTavartI haYo nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA vujhate pAra yA tomarA vala evaM apavitra avasthAYao nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA gosala kara, tave yadi tomarA patha atikramakArI hao*| Ara yadi tomarA asustha hao vA saphare thAka athavA tomAdera keu prasrAva-pAYakhAnA theke Ase kiMvA tomarA strI sambhoga kara, tave yadi pAni nA pAo tAhale pavitra mATite tAYAmmuma kara** | sutarAM tomAdera mukhamanDala o hAta mAseha kara| nizcaYa AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla| * tAhale tAra kathA bhinna, se gosala nA kareo zudhu tAYAmmuma kare nAmAya par3ate pArave| keu keu valechena, ekhAne sAlAta artha sAlAta AdAYasthala| tAhale artha have, tomarA apavitra avasthAYa sAlAta AdAYasthala tathA masajide yete pArave nA| tave patha atikramera uddezye yAoYA yAve| (yuvadAtuta-tAphasIra)|
tumi ki se sava lokake dekhani, yAderake kitAvera kichu aMza deYA haYeche? tArA pathabhraSTatA kraYa kare evaM cAYa ye, tomarAo pathabhraSTa haYe yAo|
Ara AllAha tomAdera zatrudera samparke adhika avagata| Ara abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAha yatheSTa evaM AllAha yatheSTa sAhAyyakArI hiseveo|

iYAhUdIdera madhye kichu loka Ache yArA kAlAmasamUhake tAra sthAna theke parivartana kare phele evaM vale, ‘AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma’| Ara tumi zona nA zonAra mata, tArA nijadera jihavA vA~kA kare evaM dInera prati kho~cA mere vale, ‘rA‘inA’* | Ara tArA yadi valata, ‘AmarA zunalAma o mAnya karalAma evaM tumi zona o AmAdera prati lakSya rAkha’ tAhale eTi hata tAdera janya kalyANakara o yathArtha| kintu tAdera kupharIra kAraNe AllAha tAderake lA‘nata karechena| tAi tAdera kama saMkhyaka lokai ImAna Ane| * AravIte ‘rA’inA zavdera artha ‘AmAdera tattvAvadhAna karuna’| iYAhUdIrA zavdaTike vikRta kare uccAraNa karata, yA tAdera bhASAYa (hivrute) gAli hiseve vyavahRta hata| e samparke Aro dra. sUrA vAkArAra 104 naM AYAtera TIkA|

he kitAvaprAptagaNa, tomarA ImAna Ana, tAra prati yA Ami nAyila karechi tomAdera sAthe yA Ache tAra satyAYanakArIrUpe| Ami cehArAsamUhake vikRta kare tA tAdera piThera dike phiriYe deYA athavA tAderake lA‘nata karAra pUrve yemanibhAve lA‘nata karechi AsahAvus sAvatake* | Ara AllAhara nirdeza kAryakara haYei thAke| * dAuda (AH) era ummatera upara sAvata vA zanivAre ivAdAta karA pharaya chila evaM parIkSAsvarUpa e dine mAcha zikAra karA niSiddha chila| e niSedhAjJA upekSA kare mAcha zikAra karAYa AllAha tAYAlA tAderake AyAvasvarUpa vAnare pariNata karechilena|
nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra sAthe zarIka karAke kSamA karena nA| tini kSamA karena e chAr3A anyAnya pApa, yAra janya tini cAna| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare se avazyai mahApApa racanA kare|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA nijaderake pavitra mane kare? varaM AllAha yAke cAna tAke pavitra karena| Ara tAderake sUtA parimANa yulamao karA have nA|
dekha, kemana kare tArA AllAhara upara mithyA raTanA kare| Ara prakAzya pApa hiseve eTii yatheSTa|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yAderake kitAvera eka aMza deYA haYeche? tArA jivata* o tAgUtera prati ImAna Ane evaM kAphiraderake vale, erA muminadera tulanAYa adhika saThika pathaprApta| * jivata الجبتartha: mUrti, pratimA, yAdukara, bhelakivAja, yAdu, bhelaki ityAdi|
erAi tArA yAderake AllAha lA‘nata karechena| Ara AllAha yAke lA‘nata karena tumi kakhano tAra kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
tave ki tAdera janya rAjatve kona aMza Ache? tAhale takhanato tArA mAnuSake khejuravIcira uparera AvaraNa parimANao kichu deve nA|

varaM tArA ki lokaderake hiMsA kare, AllAha svIYa anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tAra kAraNe? tAhale to Ami ivarAhImera vaMzadharake kitAva o hikamata dAna karechi evaM tAderake diYechi vizAla rAjatva|
ataHpara tAdera aneke era prati ImAna eneche evaM aneke e theke virata thekeche| Ara dagdhakArI hiseve jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

nizcaYa yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, acirei Ami tAderake praveza karAva Agune| yakhanai tAdera cAmar3Agulo pur3e yAve takhanai Ami tAderake pAlaTe deva anya cAmar3A diYe yAte tArA AsvAdana kare AyAva| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka Amala kareche, acirei Ami tAderake praveza karAva jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra taladeze pravAhita raYeche naharasamUha| sekhAne tArA have sthAYI| sekhAne tAdera janya raYeche pavitra strIgaNa evaM tAderake Ami praveza karAva vistRta ghana chAYAYa|

nizcaYa AllAha tomAderake Adeza dicchena AmAnatasamUha tAra hakadAradera kAche pau~che dite| Ara yakhana mAnuSera madhye phaYasAlA karave takhana nyAYabhittika phaYasAlA karave| nizcaYa AllAha tomAderake katainA sundara upadeza dicchena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he muminagaNa, tomarA Anugatya kara AllAhara o Anugatya kara rAsUlera evaM tomAdera madhya theke kartRtvera adhikArIdera| ataHpara kona viSaYe yadi tomarA matavirodha kara tAhale tA AllAha o rAsUlera dike pratyArpaNa karAo- yadi tomarA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkha| eTi uttama evaM pariNAme utkRSTatara|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA dAvI kare ye, nizcaYa tArA ImAna eneche tAra upara, yA nAyila karA haYeche tomAra prati evaM yA nAyila karA haYeche tomAra pUrve| tArA tAgUtera kAche vicAra niYe yete cAYa athaca tAderake nirdeza deYA haYeche tAke asvIkAra karate| Ara zaYatAna cAYa tAderake ghora vibhrAntite vibhrAnta karate|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA Asa yA AllAha nAyila karechena tAra dike evaM rAsUlera dike’, takhana munAphikaderake dekhave tomAra kAcha theke sampUrNarUpe phire yAcche|

sutarAM takhana kemana have, yakhana tAdera upara kona musIvata Asave, sei kAraNe yA tAdera hAta pUrvei preraNa kareche? tArapara tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha karA avasthAYa tomAra kAche Asave ye, AmarA kalyANa o samprIti bhinna anya kichu cAini|
orA hala sesava loka, yAdera antare ki Ache AllAha tA jAnena| sutarAM tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo evaM tAderake sadupadeza dAo| Ara tAderake tAdera nijadera vyApAre marmasparzI kathA vala|

Ara Ami ye kona rAsUla preraNa karechi tA kevala e janya, yena AllAhara anumatikrame tAdera Anugatya karA haYa| Ara yadi tArA- yakhana nijadera prati yulama karechila takhana tomAra kAche Asata ataHpara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAita evaM rAsUlao tAdera janya kSamA cAita tAhale avazyai tArA AllAhake tAovA kavUlakArI, daYAlu peta|

ataeva tomAra ravera kasama, tArA mumina have nA yatakSaNa nA tAdera madhye sRSTa vivAdera vyApAre tomAke vicAraka nirdhAraNa kare, tArapara tumi ye phaYasAlA deve se vyApAre nijadera antare kona dvidhA anubhava nA kare evaM pUrNa sammatite mene neYa|

Ara yadi Ami tAdera upara likhe ditAma ye, tomarA nijadera hatyA kara kiMvA nija gRha theke vera haYe yAo, tAhale tAdera kama saMkhyaka lokai tA vAstavAYana karata| Ara ye upadeza tAderake deYA haYa yadi tArA tA vAstavAYana karata, tAhale seTi hata tAdera janya uttama evaM sthiratAYa sudRr3ha|
Ara takhana Ami avazyai tAderake AmAra pakSa theke pradAna karatAma mahApuraskAra|
Ara avazyai Ami pradarzana karatAma tAderake sarala patha|
Ara yArA AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya kare tArA tAdera sAthe thAkave, AllAha yAdera upara anugraha karechena navI, siddIka, zahIda o satkarmazIladera madhya theke| Ara sAthI hiseve tArA have uttama|
ei anugraha AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara sarvajJa hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
he muminagaNa, tomarA tomAdera satarkatA avalamvana kara| ataHpara kSudra kSudra dala haYe veriYe par3a athavA ekasAthe vera hao|

Ara tomAdera madhye keu keu emana Ache, ye avazyai vilamva karave| sutarAM tomAdera kona vipada Apatita hale se valave, ‘AllAha AmAra upara anugraha karechena ye, Ami tAdera sAthe upasthita chilAma nA’|

Ara tomAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke kona anugraha ese pau~chale avazyai se valave yena tomAdera o tAra madhye kona hRdyatA chila nA, ‘hAYa! yadi Ami tAdera sAthe thAkatAma, tAhale Ami mahAsaphalatA arjana karatAma|

sutarAM yArA AkhirAtera vinimaYe duniYAra jIvana vikraYa kare tArA yena AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai kare| Ara ye AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai karave ataHpara se nihata hoka kiMvA vijaYI, acirei Ami tAke deva mahA puraskAra|

Ara tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai karacha nA! athaca durvala puruSa, nArI o zizurA valache, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake vera karuna e janapada theke yAra adhivAsIrA yAlima evaM AmAdera janya ApanAra pakSa theke ekajana abhibhAvaka nirdhAraNa karuna| Ara nirdhAraNa karuna ApanAra pakSa theke ekajana sAhAyyakArI|’

yArA ImAna eneche tArA lar3Ai kare AllAhara rAstAYa, Ara yArA kupharI kareche tArA lar3Ai kare tAgUtera pathe| sutarAM tomarA lar3Ai kara zaYatAnera vandhudera viruddhe| nizcaYa zaYatAnera cakrAnta durvala|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani yAderake valA haYechila, tomarA tomAdera hAta guTiYe nAo evaM sAlAta kAYema kara o yAkAta pradAna kara? ataHpara tAdera upara yakhana lar3Ai pharaya karA hala, takhana tAdera ekadala mAnuSake bhaYa karate lAgala AllAhake bhaYa karAra anurUpa athavA tAra ceYe kaThina bhaYa| Ara valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAdera upara lar3Ai pharaya karalena kena? AmAderake kena Aro kichukAlera avakAza dilena nA’? vala, ‘duniYAra sukha sAmAnya| Ara ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAra janya AkhirAta uttama| Ara tomAdera prati sUtA parimANa yulamao karA have nA’|

tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena mRtyu tomAdera nAgAla pAve, yadio tomarA sudRr3ha durge avasthAna kara| Ara yadi tAdera kAche kona kalyANa pau~che tave vale, ‘eTi AllAhara pakSa theke’| Ara yadi kona akalyANa pau~che, takhana vale, ‘eTi tomAra pakSa theke’| vala, ‘sava kichu AllAhara pakSa theke’| sutarAM ei kaomera kI hala, tArA kona kathA vujhate cAYa nA!

tomAra kAche ye kalyANa pau~che tA AllAhara pakSa theke, Ara ye akalyANa tomAra kAche pau~che tA tomAra nijera pakSa theke| Ara Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechi evaM sAkSI hiseve AllAha yatheSTa|
ye rAsUlera Anugatya karala, se AllAharai Anugatya karala| Ara ye vimukha hala, tave Ami tomAke tAdera upara tattvAvadhAYaka kare preraNa karini|

Ara tArA vale, ‘Anugatya (kari)’; ataHpara yakhana tArA tomAra kAcha theke vera haYe yAYa, tAdera ekadala yA vale, rAte tAra viparIta parikalpanA kare| Ara AllAha likhe rAkhena, tArA rAte yA parikalpanA kare| sutarAM tumi tAderake er3iYe cala evaM AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kara| karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
tArA ki kuraAna niYe gaveSaNA kare nA? Ara yadi tA AllAha chAr3A anya kAro pakSa theke hata, tave avazyai tArA ete aneka vaiparItya dekhate peta|

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche zAnti kiMvA bhItijanaka kona viSaYa Ase, takhana tArA tA pracAra kare| Ara yadi tArA seTi rAsUlera kAche evaM tAdera kartRtvera adhikArIdera kAche pau~che dita, tAhale avazyai tAdera madhye yArA tA udbhAvana kare tArA tA jAnata| Ara yadi tomAdera upara AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra rahamata nA hata, tave avazyai alpa kaYekajana chAr3A tomarA zaYatAnera anusaraNa karate|

ataeva tumi AllAhara rAstAYa lar3Ai kara| tumi zudhu tomAra nijera vyApAre dAYitvaprApta evaM muminaderake udvuddha kara| AzA karA yAYa AllAha acirei kAphiradera zakti pratihata karavena| Ara AllAha zaktite pravalatara evaM zAstidAne kaThoratara|
ye bhAla supAriza karave, tA theke tAra janya ekaTi aMza thAkave evaM ye manda supAriza karave tAra janyao tA theke ekaTi aMza thAkave| Ara AllAha pratiTi viSaYera saMrakSaNakArI|
Ara yakhana tomAderake sAlAma deYA have takhana tomarA tAra ceYe uttama sAlAma deve| athavA javAve tAi deve| nizcaYa AllAha sava viSaYe pUrNa hisAvakArI|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| avazyai tini tomAderake ekatra karavena kiYAmatera dine| ete kona sandeha nei| Ara kathAYa AllAhara ceYe adhika satyavAdI ke?

sutarAM munAphikadera vyApAre tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA du’ dala haYe gele? athaca AllAha tArA yA kAmAi kareche tAra janya tAderake pUrvAvasthAYa phiriYe diYechena| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karechena tomarA ki tAke hidAYAta karate cAo? Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tumi kakhano tAra janya kona patha pAve nA|

tArA kAmanA kare, yadi tomarA kupharI karate yebhAve tArA kupharI kareche| ataHpara tomarA samAna haYe yete| sutarAM AllAhara rAstAYa hijarata nA karA paryanta tAdera madhya theke kAuke tomarA vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| ataeva tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tAderake pAkar3Ao kara evaM tAderake yekhAne pAo hatyA kara| Ara tAdera kAuke abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karo nA evaM nA sAhAyyakArIrUpe|

tave (tAderake hatyA karo nA) yArA milita haYa emana kaomera sAthe, yAdera madhye o tomAdera madhye sandhicukti raYeche| athavA tomAdera kAche Ase emana avasthAYa ye, tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate kiMvA tAdera kaomera viruddhe yuddha karate tAdera mana saGkucita haYe giYeche| Ara AllAha cAile avazyai tAderake tomAdera upara kSamatA dite pAratena| ataHpara nizcitarUpe tArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karata| ataeva tArA yadi tomAdera theke sare yAYa ataHpara tomAdera viruddhe yuddha nA kare evaM tomAdera kAche zAnti prastAva upasthApana kare, tAhale AllAha tomAdera janya tAdera viruddhe kona patha rAkhenani|

tomarA acirei anya lokake pAve, yArA tomAdera kAche nirApattA cAive evaM nirApattA cAive tAdera kaomera kAche| yakhanai tAderake phitanAra dike phirAno haYa, tArA sekhAne phire yAYa| sutarAM yadi tArA tomAdera theke sare nA yAYa evaM tomAdera kAche sandhi prastAva upasthApana nA kare evaM nijadera hAta guTiYe nA neYa, tAhale tAderake pAkar3Ao karave evaM hatyA karave yekhAnei tAdera nAgAla pAve| Ara orAi tArA, yAdera viruddhe Ami tomAderake suspaSTa kSamatA diYechi|

Ara kona muminera kAja naYa anya muminake hatyA karA, tave bhulavazata (hale bhinna kathA)| ye vyakti bhulakrame kona muminake hatyA karave, tAhale ekajana mumina dAsake mukta karate have evaM diYAta (rakta paNa dite have) yA hastAntara karA have tAra parijanadera kAche| tave tArA yadi sadAkA (kSamA) kare deYa (tAhale dite have nA)| Ara se yadi tomAdera zatru kaomera haYa evaM se mumina, tAhale ekajana mumina dAsa mukta karave| Ara yadi emana kaomera haYa yAdera madhye o tomAdera madhye sandhicukti raYeche tAhale diYAta dite have, yA hastAntara karA have tAra parivArera kAche evaM ekajana mumina dAsa mukta karate have| tave yadi nA pAYa tAhale ekAdhAre du’mAsa siYAma pAlana karave| eTi AllAhara pakSa theke kSamAsvarUpa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara ye icchAkRta kona muminake hatyA karave, tAra pratidAna hacche jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se sthAYI have| Ara AllAha tAra upara kruddha havena, tAke lA‘nata karavena evaM tAra janya vizAla AyAva prastuta kare rAkhavena|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa vera have takhana yAcAi karave evaM ye tomAderake sAlAma deve duniYAra jIvanera sampadera AzAYa tAke valave nA ye, ‘tumi mumina nao’| vasttataH AllAhara kAche pracura ganImata Ache| tomarAto pUrve erUpai chile| ataHpara AllAha tomAdera prati anugraha karalena| sutarAM tomarA yAcAi karave| nizcaYa tomarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avagata|

vase thAkA muminagaNa, yArA oyaragrasta naYa evaM nijadera jAna o mAla dvArA AllAhara rAstAYa jihAdakArIgaNa eka samAna naYa| nijadera jAna o mAla dvArA jihAdakArIdera maryAdA AllAha vase thAkAdera upara aneka vAr3iYe diYechena| Ara AllAha pratyekakei kalyANera pratizruti diYechena evaM AllAha jihAdakArIderake vase thAkAdera upara mahA puraskAra dvArA zreSThatva dAna karechena|
tA~ra pakSa theke aneka maryAdA, kSamA o rahamata| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa yArA nijadera prati yulamakArI, pherezatArA tAdera jAna kavaja karAra samaYa vale, ‘tomarA kI avasthAYa chile’? tArA vale, ‘AmarA yamIne durvala chilAma’| pherezatArA vale, ‘AllAhara yamIna ki prazasta chila nA ye, tomarA tAte hijarata karate’? sutarAM orAi tArA yAdera AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma| Ara tA manda pratyAvartanasthala|
tave ye durvala puruSa, nArI o zizurA kona upAYa avalamvana karate pAre nA evaM kona rAstA khu~je pAYa nA|
ataHpara AzA karA yAYa ye, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena| Ara AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

Ara ye AllAhara rAstAYa hijarata karave, se yamIne vahu AzraYera jAYagA o sacchalatA pAve| Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera uddezye muhAjira haYe nija ghara theke vera haYa tArapara tAke mRtyu peYe vase, tAhale tAra pratidAna AllAhara upara avadhArita haYa| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara yakhana tomarA yamIne saphara karave, takhana tomAdera sAlAta kasara karAte kona doSa nei| yadi AzaGkA kara ye, kAphirarA tomAderake phitanAYa phelave*| nizcaYa kAphirarA tomAdera prakAzya zatru| * zatrudera AkramaNera AzaGkA nA thAkaleo saphare sAlAta ‘kasara’ karA yAve| kenanA mahAnavI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma sakala sapharei sAlAta ‘kasara’ karechena|

Ara yakhana tumi tAdera madhye thAkave| ataHpara tAdera janya sAlAta kAYema karave, takhana yena tAdera madhya theke ekadala tomAra sAthe dA~r3AYa evaM tArA tAdera astra dhAraNa kare| erapara yakhana sijadA kare phelave, takhana tArA yena tomAdera pechane avasthAna neYa| Ara apara ekaTi dala yArA sAlAta AdAYa kareni tArA yena tomAra sAthe ese sAlAta AdAYa kare evaM tArA yena tAdera satarkatA avalamvana o astra dhAraNa kare| kAphirarA kAmanA kare yadi tomarA tomAdera astra-zastra o AsavAva-patra samvandhe asatarka hao tAhale tArA tomAdera upara ekasAthe jhA~piYe par3ave| Ara yadi vRSTira kAraNe tomAdera kona kaSTa haYa athavA tomarA asustha hao tAhale astra rekhedeYAte tomAdera kona doSa nei| Ara tomarA tomAdera satarkatA avalamvana karave| nizcaYa AllAha kAphiradera janya prastuta karechena lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva|

ataHpara yakhana tomarA sAlAta pUrNa karave takhana dA~r3Ano, vasA o zoYA avasthAYa AllAhara smaraNa karave| ataHpara yakhana nizcinta have takhana sAlAta (pUrvera niYame) kAYema karave| nizcaYa sAlAta muminadera upara nirdiSTa samaYe pharaya|

Ara zatru sampradAYa anusandhAne tomarA durvala haYo nA| yadi tomarA vyathA peYe thAka tAhale tArAo to vyathA pAcche, yebhAve tomarA vyathA pAccha| Ara tomarA AllAhara nikaTa theke AzA karacha yA tArA AzA karache nA| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati yathAyathabhAve kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte tumi mAnuSera madhye phaYasAlA kara se anuyAYI yA AllAha tomAke dekhiYechena| Ara tumi khiYAnatakArIdera pakSe vitarkakArI haYo nA|
Ara tumi AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yArA nijadera khiYAnata kare tumi tAdera pakSe vitarka karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha bhAlavAsena nA tAke, ye khiYAnatakArI, pApI|

tArA mAnuSera kAcha theke lukAte cAYa, Ara AllAhara kAcha theke lukAte cAYa nA| athaca tini tAdera sAthei thAkena yakhana tArA rAte emana kathAra parikalpanA kare yA tini pachanda karena nA| Ara AllAha tArA yA kare tA pariveSTana kare Achena|
he, tomarAi to tArA, yArA duniYAra jIvane tAdera pakSe vitarka karecha| sutarAM kiYAmatera dina tAdera pakSe AllAhara sAthe ke vitarka karave? kiMvA ke have tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka?
Ara ye vyakti manda kAja karave kiMvA nijera prati yulama karave tArapara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAive, se AllAhake pAve kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara ye pApa kAmAi karave, vasttata, seto nijera viruddhei tA kAmAi karave| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
Ara ye vyakti kona aparAdha vA pApa arjana kare, ataHpara kona nirdoSa vyaktira upara tA Aropa kare, tAhale se to mithyA apavAda o prakAzya gunAhera vojhA vahana karala|

Ara tomAra upara yadi AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra daYA nA hata tave tAdera madhya theke ekadala tomAke pathabhraSTa karAra saMkalpa karei phelechila! Ara tArA nijadera chAr3A kAuke pathabhraSTa kare nA evaM tArA tomAra konai kSati karate pAre nA| Ara AllAha tomAra prati nAyila karechena kitAva o hikamAta evaM tomAke zikSA diYechena yA tumi jAnate nA| Ara tomAra upara AllAhara anugraha raYeche mahAna|

tAdera gopana parAmarzera adhikAMze kona kalyANa nei| tave (kalyANa Ache) ye nirdeza deYa sadAkA kiMvA bhAlo kAja athavA mAnuSera madhye mImAMsAra| Ara ye tA AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera uddezye karave tave acirei Ami tAke mahApuraskAra dAna karava|

Ara ye rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare tAra janya hidAYAta prakAza pAoYAra para evaM muminadera pathera viparIta patha anusaraNa kare, Ami tAke pherAva yedike se phire evaM tAke praveza karAva jAhAnnAme| Ara AvAsa hiseve tA khuvai manda|
nizcaYa AllAha kSamA karena nA tA~ra sAthe zarIka karAke evaM e chAr3A yAke cAna kSamA karena| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare se to ghora pathabhraSTatAYa pathabhraSTa hala|
AllAha chAr3A tArA zudhu nArImUrtike DAke evaM kevala* avAdhya zaYatAnake DAke| * arthAt upAsanA kare|
AllAha tAke lA‘nata karechena evaM se valeche, ‘avazyai Ami tomAra vAndAdera eka nirdiSTa aMzake (anusArI hiseve) grahaNa karava’|

‘Ara avazyai Ami tAderake pathabhraSTa karava, mithyA AzvAsa deva evaM avazyai tAderake Adeza deva, phale tArA pazura kAna chidra karave evaM avazyai tAderake Adeza karava, phale avazyai tArA AllAhara sRSTi vikRta karave’| Ara yArA AllAhara parivarte zaYatAnake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, tArA to spaSTai kSatigrasta hala|
se tAderake pratizruti deYa evaM tAderake mithyA AzvAsa deYa| Ara zaYatAna tAderake kevala pratAraNAmUlaka pratizrutii deYa|
ederai AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma| Ara tArA sekhAna theke pAlAvAra jAYagA pAve nA|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka Amala kareche, acirei tAderake Ami praveza karAva jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra taladeze pravAhita hacche naharasamUha| sekhAne tArA have sthAYI| AllAhara pratizruti satya| Ara kathAYa AllAha apekSA adhika satyavAdI ke?
nA tomAdera AzAYa evaM nA kitAvIdera AzAYa (kAja have)| ye mandakAja karave tAke tAra pratiphala deYA have| Ara se tAra janya AllAha chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
Ara puruSa kiMvA nArIra madhya theke ye nekakAja karave ematAvasthAYa ye, se mumina, tAhale tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati khejura vIcira AvaraNa parimANa yulamao karA have nA|

Ara dInera vyApAre tAra tulanAYa ke uttama, ye satkarmaparAYaNa avasthAYa AllAhara kAche nijake pUrNa samarpaNa karala evaM ekaniSThabhAve ivarAhImera Adarza anusaraNa karala? Ara AllAha ivarAhImake parama vandhurUpe grahaNa karechena|
Ara yA AsamAnasamUhe Ache evaM yA Ache yamIne sava AllAharai| Ara AllAha savakichuke pariveSTanakArI|

tArA tomAra kAche nArIdera vyApAre samAdhAna cAYa| vala, AllAha tAdera vyApAre tomAderake samAdhAna dicchena evaM samAdhAna dicche ai AYAtasamUha yA kitAve tomAderake pATha kare zunAno haYa iYAtIma nArIdera vyApAre| yAderake tomarA pradAna kara nA yA tAdera janya nirdhAraNa karA haYeche, athaca tomarA tAderake vivAha karate AgrahI hao| Ara durvala zizudera vyApAre o iYAtImadera prati tomAdera inasApha pratiSThA samparke| Ara tomarA ye kona bhAlo kAja kara, nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe parijJAta|

yadi kona nArI tAra svAmIra pakSa theke kona durvyavahAra kiMvA upekSAra AzaGkA kare, tAhale tArA ubhaYe kona mImAMsA karale tAdera kona aparAdha nei| Ara mImAMsA kalyANakara evaM mAnuSera madhye kRpaNatA vidyamAna raYeche| Ara yadi tomarA satkarma kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave AllAha tomarA yA kara se viSaYe samyaka avagata|

Ara tomarA yatai kAmanA kara nA kena tomAdera strIdera madhye samAna AcaraNa karate kakhano pArave nA| sutarAM tomarA (ekajanera prati) sampUrNarUpe jhu~ke par3o nA, yAra phale tomarA (aparake) jhulantera mata kare rAkhave| Ara yadi tomarA mImAMsA kare nAo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yadi tArA ubhaYe vicchinna haYe yAYa tave AllAha pratyekake nija prAcurya dvArA abhAvamukta karavena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, prajJAvAna|

AllAhara janyai raYeche AsamAnasamUhe yA Ache evaM yA Ache yamIne| Ara tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAderake evaM tomAderake Ami nirdeza diYechi ye, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| Ara yadi kupharI kara tAhale AsamAnasamUhe yA Ache evaM yA Ache yamIne sava AllAharai| Ara AllAha abhAvahIna, prazaMsita|
Ara AllAhara janyai raYeche, yA Ache AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA Ache yamIne| Ara karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
he mAnuSa, yadi AllAha cAna tomAderake sariYe devena evaM aparake Anavena| Ara AllAha era upara sakSama|
ye duniYAra pratidAna cAYa tave AllAhara kAche duniYA o AkhirAtera pratidAna raYeche| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he muminagaNa, tomarA nyAYera upara supratiSThita thAkave AllAhara janya sAkSIrUpe| yadio tA tomAdera nijadera kiMvA pitA-mAtAra athavA nikaTAtmIYadera viruddhe haYa| yadi se vittazAlI haYa kiMvA daridra, tave AllAha ubhaYera ghaniSThatara| sutarAM nyAYa pratiSThA karate tomarA pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| Ara yadi tomarA ghuriYe- pe~ciYe kathA vala kiMvA er3iYe yAo tave AllAha tomarA yA kara se viSaYe samyaka avagata|

he muminagaNa, tomarA ImAna Ana AllAhara prati, tA~ra rAsUlera prati evaM se kitAvera prati yA tini tA~ra rAsUlera upara nAyila karechena evaM se kitAvera prati yA tini pUrve nAyila karechena| Ara ye AllAha, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa, tA~ra kitAvasamUha, tA~ra rAsUlagaNa evaM zeSa dinake asvIkAra karave, se ghora vibhrAntite vibhrAnta have|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche tArapara kupharI kareche, AvAra ImAna eneche tArapara kupharI kareche, erapara kupharIke vAr3iYe diYeche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karAra nana evaM tAderake patha pradarzana karAra nana|
munAphikadera susaMvAda dAo ye, nizcaYa tAdera janyai raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
yArA muminadera parivarte kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare, tArA ki tAdera kAche sammAna cAYa? athaca yAvatIYa sammAna AllAhara|

Ara tini to kitAve tomAdera prati nAyila karechena ye, yakhana tomarA zunave AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karA hacche evaM segulo niYe upahAsa karA hacche, tAhale tomarA tAdera sAthe vasave nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya kathAYa niviSTa haYa, tA nA hale tomarAo tAdera mata haYe yAve| nizcaYa AllAha munAphika o kAphiradera sakalake jAhAnnAme ekatrakArI|

yArA tomAdera vyApAre (akalyANera) apekSAYa thAke, ataHpara AllAhara pakSa theke yadi tomAdera vijaYa haYa tave tArA vale, ‘AmarA ki tomAdera sAthe chilAma nA’? Ara yadi kAphiradera AMzika vijaYa haYa, tave tArA vale, ‘AmarA ki tomAdera upara kartRtva karini evaM muminadera kavala theke tomAderake rakSA karini’? sutarAM AllAha kiYAmatera dina tomAdera madhye vicAra karavena| Ara AllAha kakhano muminadera vipakSe kAphiradera janya patha rAkhavena nA|

nizcaYa munAphikarA AllAhake dho~kA deYa| Ara tini tAderake dho~kAYa phelena| Ara yakhana tArA sAlAte dA~r3AYa takhana alasabhAve dA~r3AYa, tArA lokaderake dekhAYa evaM tArA AllAhake kamai smaraNa kare|
tArA era madhye dodulyamAna, nA edera dike Ara nA odera dike| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tumi kakhano tAra janya kona patha pAve nA|
he muminagaNa, tomarA muminagaNa chAr3A kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| tomarA ki AllAhara janya tomAdera vipakSe kona spaSTa dalIla sAvyasta karate cAo?
nizcaYa munAphikarA jAhAnnAmera sarvanimna stare thAkave| Ara tumi kakhanao tAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

tave yArA tAovA kare nijaderake zudhare neYa, AllAhake dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhare evaM AllAhara janya nijadera dInake khAlesa kare, tArA muminadera sAthe thAkave| Ara acirei AllAha muminaderake mahApuraskAra dAna karavena|
yadi tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara evaM ImAna Ana tAhale tomAderake AyAva diYe AllAha kI karavena? AllAha puraskAra dAnakArI, sarvajJa|
manda kathAra pracAra AllAha pachanda karena nA, tave kAro upara yulama karA hale bhinna kathA| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|
yadi tomarA bhAlo kichu prakAza kara, kiMvA gopana kara athavA manda kSamA kare dAo, tave nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, kSamatAvAna|

nizcaYa yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera sAthe kupharI kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye pArthakya karate cAYa evaM vale, ‘AmarA katakake vizvAsa kari Ara katakera sAthe kupharI kari’ evaM tArA era mAjhAmAjhi ekaTi patha grahaNa karate cAYa |
tArAi prakRta kAphira evaM Ami kAphiradera janya prastuta karechi apamAnakara AyAva|
Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna eneche evaM tAdera kAro madhye pArthakya kareni, tAderake acirei tini tAdera pratidAna divena evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

kitAvIgaNa tomAra nikaTa cAYa ye, AsamAna theke tumi tAdera upara ekaTi kitAva nAyila kara| athaca tArA mUsAra kAche era ceYe var3a kichu ceYechila, yakhana tArA valechila, ‘AmAderake sAmanAsAmani AllAhake dekhAo’| phale tAderake tAdera anyAYera kAraNe vajra pAkar3Ao karechila| ataHpara tArA vAchurake (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karala, tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANasamUha AsAra parao| tArapara Ami tA kSamA kare diYechilAma evaM mUsAke diYechilAma suspaSTa pramANa|

Ara tAdera aGgIkAra grahaNera janya tUrake tAdera upara tule dharechilAma evaM tAderake valechilAma, ‘darajAYa praveza kara avanata haYe’| tAderake Ami Arao valechilAma, ‘zanivAre sImAlaGghana karo nA’ evaM Ami tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra niYechilAma|

ataHpara (tAdera zAsti deYA haYechila) tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGga, AllAhara AYAtasamUhera sAthe kupharI karA, anyAYabhAve navIgaNake hatyA karA evaM e kathA valAra kAraNe ye, ‘AmAdera antarasamUha AcchAdita’| varaM AllAha tAdera kupharIra kAraNe antarera upara mohara e~Te diYechilena| sutarAM svalpasaMkhyaka chAr3A tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ara tAdera kupharIra kAraNe evaM mAraiYAmera viruddhe mArAtmaka apavAda deYAra kAraNe|

evaM tAdera e kathAra kAraNe ye, ‘AmarA AllAhara rAsUla mAraiYAma putra IsA mAsIhake hatyA karechi’| athaca tArA tAke hatyA kareni evaM tAke zUleo car3AYani| varaM tAderake dhA~dhAYa phelA haYechila| Ara nizcaYa yArA tAte matavirodha karechila, avazyai tArA tAra vyApAre sandehera madhye chila| dhAraNAra anusaraNa chAr3A e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAna nei| Ara eTA nizcita ye, tArA tAke hatyA kareni|
varaM AllAha tA~ra kAche tAke tule niYechena evaM AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

kitAvIdera madhye emana keu nei, ye tAra mRtyura pUrve tAra prati ImAna Anave nA* evaM kiYAmatera dine se tAdera viruddhe sAkSI have| * kiYAmatera pUrve IsA AH yakhana avataraNa karavena, takhana se yugera iYAhUdI o nAsArArA puro viSaYaTi upalavdhi karate sakSama have evaM sakalei mRtyura muhUrte tA~ra prati ImAna Anave; kintu phira‘Aunera mata tAdera ImAna takhana kona kAje Asave nA|
sutarAM iYAhUdIdera yulamera kAraNe Ami tAdera upara uttama khAvAragulo hArAma karechilAma, yA tAdera janya hAlAla karA haYechila evaM AllAhara rAstA theke anekake tAdera vAdhA pradAnera kAraNe|
