Ara tAdera suda grahaNera kAraNe, athaca tA theke tAderake niSedha karA haYechila evaM avaidhabhAve mAnuSera sampada khAoYAra kAraNe| Ara Ami tAdera madhya theke kAphiradera janya prastuta karechi yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jJAne paripakka evaM muminagaNa- yArA tomAra prati yA nAyila haYeche evaM yA nAyila haYeche tomAra pUrve- tAte ImAna Ane| Ara yArA sAlAta pratiSThAkArI o yAkAta pradAnakArI evaM AllAha o zeSa dine ImAna AnaYanakArI, tAderake acirei Ami mahApuraskAra pradAna karava|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra nikaTa ohI pAThiYechi, yemana ohI pAThiYechi nUha o tAra paravartI navIgaNera nikaTa evaM Ami ohI pAThiYechi ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYA‘kUva, tAra vaMzadharagaNa, IsA, AiYUva, iunusa, hArUna o sulAYamAnera nikaTa evaM dAUdake pradAna karechi yAvUra|
Ara aneka rAsUla, yAdera varNanA tomAke pUrve diYechi evaM aneka rAsUla, yAdera varNanA tomAke deini Ara AllAha mUsAra sAthe suspaSTabhAve kathA valechena|
Ara (pAThiYechi) rAsUlagaNake susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe, yAte AllAhara vipakSe rAsUladera para mAnuSera janya kona ajuhAta nA thAke| Ara AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa |
kintu AllAha sAkSya dicchena, yA tomAra nikaTa tini nAyila karechena tAra mAdhyame| tini tA nAyila karechena nija jJAne evaM pherezatArAo sAkSya dicche| Ara AllAhai sAkSIrUpe yatheSTa|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche evaM AllAhara patha theke vAdhA diYeche,tArA avazyai cUr3AntabhAve pathabhraSTa haYeche|
nizcaYai yArA kupharI kareche evaM yulama kareche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA evaM tAderake kona patha dekhAvena nA|
jAhAnnAmera patha chAr3A| tArA tAte sthAYI have evaM tA AllAhara janya sahaja|

he mAnuSa, avazyai tomAdera nikaTa rAsUla eseche, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke satya niYe| sutarAM tomarA ImAna Ana, tA tomAdera janya uttama have| Ara yadi kupharI kara, tave nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA raYeche, tA AllAhara janyai evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he kitAvIgaNa, tomarA tomAdera dInera madhye vAr3AvAr3i karo nA evaM AllAhara upara satya chAr3A anya kichu valo nA| mAraiYAmera putra mAsIha IsA kevalamAtra AllAhara rAsUla o tA~ra kAlimA, yA tini preraNa karechilena mAraiYAmera prati evaM tA~ra pakSa theke rUha| sutarAM tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati ImAna Ana evaM valo nA, 'tina'| tomarA virata hao, tA tomAdera janya uttama| AllAhai kevala eka ilAha, tini pavitra mahAna e theke ye, tA~ra kona santAna have| AsamAnasUhe yA raYeche evaM yA raYeche yamIne, tA AllAharai| Ara karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

mAsIha kakhano AllAhara vAndA hate (nijake) heYa mane kare nA evaM naikaTyaprApta pherezatArAo nA, Ara yArA tA~ra ivAdAtake heYa jJAna kare evaM ahaGkAra kare, tave acirei AllAha tAdera savAike tA~ra nikaTa samaveta karavena|

pakSAntare yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tini tAderake tAdera puraSkAra paripUrNa devena evaM tA~ra anugrahe tAderake vAr3iYe devena| Ara yArA heYa jJAna kareche evaM ahaGkAra kareche, tini tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena evaM tArA tAdera janya AllAha chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
he mAnuSa, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera nikaTa pramANa eseche evaM Ami tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa Alo nAyila karechi|
ataHpara yArA AllAhara prati ImAna eneche evaM tAke A~kar3e dhareche tini avazyai tAderake tA~ra pakSa theke daYA o anugrahe praveza karAvena evaM tA~ra dike sarala patha dekhAvena|

tArA tomAra kAche samAdhAna cAYa| vala, ‘AllAha tomAderake samAdhAna dicchena ‘kAlAlA’* samparke| kona vyakti yadi mArA yAYa emana avasthAYa ye, tAra kona santAna nei evaM tAra eka vona raYeche, tave se yA rekhe giYeche vonera janya tAra ardheka, Ara se (mahilA)yadi santAnahInA haYa tave tAra bhAi tAra uttarAdhikArI have| kintu yadi tArA (vonerA) du’jana haYa, tave se yA rekhe giYeche tAdera janya tAra dui tRtIYAMza| Ara yadi tArA kaYeka bhAi vona puruSa o nArI haYa, tave puruSera janya dui nArIra aMzera samAna have’| AllAha tomAderake vyAkhyA dicchena, yAte tomarA pathabhraSTa nA hao evaM AllAha pratiTi viSaYa samparke sarvajJa’| * yAra pitA mAtA jIvita nei evaM ye santAnahIna tAke ‘kAlAlA’ valA haYa|

he muminagaNa, tomarA aGgIkArasamUha pUrNa kara| tomAdera janya gRhapAlita catuspada jantu hAlAla karA haYeche, tomAdera nikaTa yA varNanA karA hacche tA chAr3A| tave iharAma avasthAYa zikArake hAlAla karave nA| nizcaYa AllAha yA icchA vidhAna dena|

he muminagaNa, tomarA asammAna karo nA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera, hArAma mAsera, hArAme prerita kuravAnIra pazura, galAYa ci‎hna deYA pazura evaM Apana ravera anugraha o santuSTira anusandhAne pavitra gRhera abhimukhIdera| yakhana tomarA hAlAla hao, takhana zikAra kara| kona kaomera zatrutA ye, tArA tomAderake masajide hArAma theke vAdhA pradAna kareche, tomAderake yena kakhano prarocita nA kare ye, tomarA sImAlaGghana karave| satkarma o tAkaoYAYa tomarA parasparera sahayogitA kara| mandakarma o sImAlaGghane parasparera sahayogitA karo nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha AyAva pradAne kaThora|

tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche mRta prANI, rakta o zUkarera gozata evaM yA AllAha bhinna kAro nAme yaveha karA haYeche; galA cipe mArA jantu, prahAre marA jantu, u~cu theke par3e marA jantu anya prANIra ziGera AghAte marA jantu evaM ye jantuke hiMsra prANI kheYeche- tave yA tomarA yaveha kare niYecha tA chAr3A, Ara yA mUrti pU~jAra vedite vali deYA haYeche evaM juYAra tIra dvArA vaNTana karA haYa, egulo gunAha| yArA kupharI kareche, Aja tArA tomAdera dInera vyApAre hatAza haYe par3eche| sutarAM tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo nA, varaM AmAke bhaYa kara| Aja Ami tomAdera janya tomAdera dInake pUrNa karalAma evaM tomAdera upara AmAra niAmata sampUrNa karalAma evaM tomAdera janya dIna hiseve pachanda karalAma isalAmake| tave ye tIvra kSudhAYa vAdhya have, kona pApera prati jhu~ke naYa (tAke kSamA karA have), nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tArA tomAke prazna kare, tAdera janya kI vaidha karA haYeche? vala, ‘tomAdera janya vaidha karA haYeche sava bhAla vastu evaM zikArI pazu-pAkhI, yAderake tomarA zikAra prazikSaNa diYecha; seguloke tomarA zekhAo, yA AllAha tomAderake zikhiYechena| sutarAM tomarA tA theke khAo, yA tomAdera janya dhare eneche evaM tAte tomarA AllAhara nAma smaraNa kara Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha hisAva grahaNe druta|

Aja tomAdera janya vaidha karA hala sava bhAla vastu evaM yAderake kitAva pradAna karA haYeche, tAdera khAvAra tomAdera janya vaidha evaM tomAdera khAvAra tAdera janya vaidha| Ara mumina saccaritrA nArI evaM tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche, tAdera saccaritrA nArIdera sAthe tomAdera vivAha vaidha| yakhana tomarA tAderake mohara deve, vivAhakArI hiseve, prakAzya vyabhicArakArI vA gopanapatnI grahaNakArI hiseve naYa| Ara ye ImAnera sAthe kupharI karave, avazyai tAra Amala varavAda have evaM se AkhirAte kSatigrastadera antarbhukta|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA sAlAte danDAYamAna hate cAo, takhana tomAdera mukha o kanui paryanta hAta dhauta kara, mAthA mAseha kara evaM TAkhanu paryanta pA (dhauta kara)| Ara yadi tomarA apavitra thAka, tave bhAlobhAve pavitra hao| Ara yadi asustha hao kiMvA saphare thAka athavA yadi tomAdera keu pAYakhAnA theke Ase athavA tomarA yadi strI sahavAsa kara ataHpara pAni nA pAo, tave pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma kara| sutarAM tomAdera mukha o hAta tA dvArA mAseha kara| AllAha tomAdera upara kona samasyA sRSTi karate cAna nA, varaM tini cAna tomAdera pavitra karate evaM tAra niAmata tomAdera upara pUrNa karate, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA jJApana kara|

Ara smaraNa kara, tomAdera upara AllAhara niAmata evaM tA~ra aGgIkAra, yA tini tomAdera theke niYechena| yakhana tomarA valale, ‘AmarA zunechi evaM Anugatya karechi’ Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha antarera viSaYa samparke vizeSa avagata|

he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhara janya nyAYera sAthe sAkSadAnakArI hiseve sadA danDAYamAna hao| kona kaomera prati zatrutA yena tomAderake konabhAve prarocita nA kare ye, tomarA inasApha karave nA| tomarA inasApha kara, tA tAkaoYAra nikaTatara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa tomarA yA kara, AllAha se viSaYe savizeSa avahita|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM neka kAja kareche AllAha oYAdA diYechena, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, tArAi prajvalita Agunera adhivAsI|

he muminagaNa, tomarA smaraNa kara tomAdera upara AllAhara niAmata, yakhana ekaTi kaoma tomAdera prati tAdera hAta prasArita karate manastha karala; kintu tini tAdera hAtake tomAdera theke nivRtta rAkhalena| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AllAhara uparai muminarA yena tAoYAkkula kare|

Ara avazyai AllAha vanI isarAIlera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilena evaM Ami tAdera madhya theke vAra jana dalanetA pAThiYechilAma evaM AllAha valechilena, nizcaYa Ami tomAdera sAthe Achi, yadi tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo, AmAra rAsUladera prati ImAna Ana, tAderake sahayogitA kara evaM AllAhake uttama RNa dAo, tave nizcaYa Ami tomAdera theke tomAdera pApasamUha muche deva| Ara avazyai tomAderake praveza karAva jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra nica diYe pravAhita have nadIsamUha| tomAdera madhya theke eraparao ye kupharI kareche, se avazyai sojA patha hAriYeche|

sutarAM tArA tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera kAraNe Ami tAderake lA‘nata diYechi evaM tAdera antarasamUhake karechi kaThora| tArA zavdaguloke Apana sthAna theke vikRta kare evaM tAderake ye upadeza deYA haYeche, tAra ekaTi aMza tArA bhule giYeche evaM tumi tAdera theke khiYAnata samparke avagata hate thAkave, tAdera alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A| sutarAM tumi tAderake kSamA kara evaM er3iYe yAo| nizcaYa AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

Ara yArA vale, ‘AmarA nAsArA’, Ami tAdera theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma| ataHpara tAderake ye upadeza deYA haYechila, tArA tAra ekaTi aMza bhule giYeche| phale Ami tAdera madhye kiYAmatera dina paryanta zatrutA o ghRNA usake diYechi evaM tArA yA karata se samparke acirei AllAha tAderake avahita karavena|

he kitAvIgaNa, tomAdera nikaTa AmAra rAsUla eseche, kitAva theke yA tomarA gopana karate, tAra aneka kichu tomAdera nikaTa se prakAza karache evaM aneka kichu cher3e diYeche| avazyai tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara pakSa theke Alo o spaSTa kitAva eseche|

era mAdhyame AllAha tAderake zAntira patha dekhAna, yArA tA~ra santuSTira anusaraNa kare evaM tA~ra anumatite tini tAderake andhakAra theke Alora dike vera karena| Ara tAderake sarala pathera dike hidAYAta dena|

avazyai tArA kupharI kareche yArA vale ‘nizcaYa mAraiYAma putra mAsIhai AllAha’| vala, yadi AllAha dhvaMsa karate cAna mAraiYAma putra mAsIhake o tAra mAke evaM yamIne yArA Ache tAdera sakalake ‘tAhale ke AllAhara vipakSe kona kichura kSamatA rAkhe? Ara AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o tAdera madhyavartI yA raYeche, tAra rAjatva AllAhara janyai| tini yA icchA tA sRSTi karena evaM AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

iYAhUdI o nAsArArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAhara putra o tAra priYajana’| vala, ‘tave kena tini tomAderake tomAdera pApera kAraNe AyAva dena? varaM tomarA tAdera antarbhukta mAnuSa, yAderake tini sRSTi karechena| tini yAke icchA tAke kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA AyAva dena| Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM tAdera madhyavartI yA Ache tAra sArvabhaumatva AllAhara evaM tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartana’|

he kitAvIrA, tomAdera nikaTa AmAra rAsUla eseche, rAsUladera ekaTi viratira para tomAdera janya tini spaSTa varNanA karachena. yena tomarA nA vala ye, ‘AmAdera nikaTa kona susaMvAdadAtA kiMvA satarkakArI Aseni’| avazyai tomAdera nikaTa susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI eseche| Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

Ara yakhana mUsA tAra kaomake valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, smaraNa kara tomAdera upara AllAhara niAmata, yakhana tini tomAdera madhye navI vAniYechena evaM tomAderake rAjA-vAdazAha vAniYechena, Ara tomAderake dAna karechena emana kichu yA sakala sRSTira madhye kAuke dAna karenani’|
‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA pavitra bhUmite praveza kara, yA AllAha tomAdera janya likhe diYechena evaM tomarA tomAdera pechane phire yeYo nA, tAhale kSatigrasta haYe pratyAvartana karave’|

tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, nizcaYa sekhAne raYeche eka zaktizAlI jAti evaM AmarA nizcaYa sekhAne praveza karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA sekhAna theke vera haYa| ataHpara yadi tArA sekhAna theke vera haYa, tave nizcaYa AmarA praveza karava’|

yArA bhaYa kare, tAdera madhya theke emana du’vyakti valala, ‘yAdera upara AllAha niAmata diYechena, ‘tomarA tAdera nikaTa darajA diYe praveza kara| yakhana sekhAne praveza karave, takhana nizcaYa jaYI have| Ara AllAhara uparai tAoYAkkula kara, yadi tomarA mumina hao’|
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, AmarA sekhAne kakhano praveza karava nA, yatakSaNa tArA sekhAne thAke| sutarAM, tumi o tomAra rava yAo evaM lar3Ai kara| AmarA ekhAnei vase railAma’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami AmAra o AmAra bhAi chAr3A kAro upare adhikAra rAkhi nA| sutarAM Apani AmAdera o phAsika kaomera madhye viccheda kare dina|
tini valalena, ‘tAhale nizcaYa tA tAdera janya calliza vachara niSiddha; tArA yamIne udbhrAnta haYe ghurate thAkave| sutarAM tumi phAsika kaomera janya Aphasosa karo nA’|

Ara tumi tAdera nikaTa Adamera dui putrera saMvAda yathAyathabhAve varNanA kara, yakhana tArA ubhaYe kuravAnI peza karala| ataHpara tAdera ekajana theke grahaNa karA hala, Ara aparajana theke grahaNa karA hala nA| se valala, ‘avazyai Ami tomAke hatyA karava’| anyajana valala, ‘AllAha kevala muttAkIdera theke grahaNa karena’|

‘yadi tumi AmAra prati tomAra hAta prasArita kara AmAke hatyA karAra janya, Ami tomAke hatyA karAra janya AmAra hAta tomAra prati prasArita karava nA| nizcaYa Ami sRSTikulera rava AllAhake bhaYa kari’|
‘nizcaYa Ami cAi ye, tumi AmAra o tomAra pApa niYe phire yAo, phale tumi Agunera adhivAsI hao| Ara seTii hacche yAlimadera pratidAna’|
sutarAM tAra naphasa tAke vaza karala tAra bhAike hatyA karate| phale se tAke hatyA karala evaM kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hala|

ataHpara AllAha ekaTi kAka pAThAlena, yA mATi khu~r3achila, yAte tAke dekhAte pAre, kIbhAve se bhAiYera lAza gopana karave| se valala, ‘hAYa! Ami ei kAkaTira mata hateo akSama haYechi ye, AmAra bhAiYera lAza gopana karava’| phale se lajjita hala|

e kAraNei, Ami vanI isarAIlera upara ei hukuma dilAma ye, ye vyakti kAuke hatyA karA kiMvA yamIne phAsAda sRSTi karA chAr3A ye kAuke hatyA karala, se yena sava mAnuSake hatyA karala| Ara ye tAke vA~cAla, se yena sava mAnuSake vA~cAla| Ara avazyai tAdera nikaTa AmAra rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe eseche| tA sattveo erapara yamIne tAdera aneke avazyai sImAlaGghanakArI|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe yuddha kare evaM yamIne phAsAda kare ver3AYa, tAdera AyAva kevala ei ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zUle car3Ano have kiMvA viparIta dika theke tAdera hAta o pA keTe phelA have athavA tAderake deza theke vera kare deYA have| eTi tAdera janya duniYAYa lAJchanA evaM tAdera janya AkhirAte raYeche mahAAyAva|
tArA chAr3A, yArA tAovA kare tomarA tAdera upara niYantraNa lAbhera pUrve; sutarAM jene rAkha ye, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa, AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tAra naikaTyera anusandhAna kara, Ara tAra rAstAYa jihAda kara, yAte tomarA saphala hao|

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche, yadi yamIne yA Ache tAra sava o tAra sAthe samaparimANao tAdera janya thAke, yAte tArA tAra mAdhyame kiYAmatera AyAva theke rakSAra muktipaNa dite pAre, tAhaleo tAdera theke tA grahaNa karA have nA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
tArA cAive Aguna theke vera hate, kintu tArA sekhAna theke vera havAra naYa evaM tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI AyAva|
Ara puruSa cora o nArI cora tAdera ubhaYera hAta keTe dAo tAdera arjanera pratidAna o AllAhara pakSa theke zikSaNIYa AyAvasvarUpa evaM AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
ataHpara ye tAra yulamera para tAovA karave evaM nijake saMzodhana karave, tave nizcaYa AllAha tAke kSamA karavena| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, nizcaYa AllAha, tA~ra janyai AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva, tini yAke icchA AyAva dena evaM yAke icchA kSamA karena, Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

he rAsUla, tomAke yena tArA cintita nA kare, yArA kuphare druta chuTache- tAdera theke, yArA tAdera mukhe vale ‘ImAna enechi’ kintu tAdera antara ImAna Aneni| Ara yArA iYAhUdI tArA mithyA adhika zravaNakArI, anyAnya kaomera prati, yArA tomAra nikaTa Aseni tAdera pakSe tArA kAna pete thAke| tArA zavdaguloke yathAyatha suvinyasta thAkAra parao Apana sthAna theke vikRta kare| tArA vale, ‘yadi tomAderake eTi pradAna karA haYa, tave grahaNa kara| Ara yadi tA tomAderake pradAna nA karA haYa, tAhale varjana kara’; Ara AllAha yAke phitanAYa phelate cAna, tumi tAra pakSe AllAhara viruddhe kichurai kSamatA rAkha nA| erAi hacche tArA, yAdera antarasamUhake AllAha pavitra karate cAna nA| tAdera janya raYeche duniYAte lAJchanA evaM AkhirAte tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|

tArA mithyAra prati adhika zravaNakArI, hArAmera adhika bhakSaNakArI| sutarAM yadi tArA tomAra kAche Ase, tave tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kara athavA tAderake upekSA kara Ara yadi tAderake upekSA kara, tave tArA tomAra kichu kSati karate pArave nA, Ara yadi tumi phaYasAlA kara, tave tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kara nyaYabhittika| nizcaYa AllAha nyaYaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|
Ara kIbhAve tArA tomAke phaYasAlAkArI vAnAYa? athaca tAdera kAche raYeche tAorAta, yAte Ache AllAhara vidhAna, tA sattveo tArA erapara mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tArA muminao naYa|

nizcaYa Ami tAorAta nAyila karechi, tAte chila hidAYAta o Alo, era mAdhyame iYAhUdIdera janya phaYasAlA pradAna karata anugata navIgaNa evaM ravavAnI o dharmavidagaNa| kAraNa tAderake AllAhara kitAvera rakSaka karA haYechila evaM tArA chila era upara sAkSI| sutarAM tomarA mAnuSake bhaYa karo nA, AmAke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhera vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya kraYa karo nA| Ara yArA AllAha yA nAyila karechena, tAra mAdhyame phaYasAlA kare nA, tArAi kAphira|

Ara Ami ete tAdera upara avadhArita karechi ye, prANera vinimaYe prANa, cokhera vinimaYe cokha, nAkera vinimaYe nAka, kAnera vinimaYe kAna o dA~tera vinimaYe dA~ta evaM jakhamera vinimaYe samaparimANa jakhama| ataHpara ye tA kSamA kare deve, tAra janya tA kAphphArA have| Ara AllAha yA nAyila karechena, tAra mAdhyame yArA phaYasAlA karave nA, tArAi yAlima|

Ara Ami tAdera pechane mAraiYAma putra IsAke pAThiYechilAma tAra sammukhe vidyamAna tAorAtera satyAYanakArIrUpe evaM tAke diYechilAma inajIla, ete raYeche hidAYAta o Alo evaM (tA chila) tAra sammukhe avaziSTa tAorAtera satyAYanakArI, hidAYAta o muttAkIdera janya upadezasvarUpa|
Ara inajIlera anusArIgaNa tAte AllAha yA nAyila karechena tAra mAdhyame yena phaYasAlA kare Ara AllAha yA nAyila karechena tAra mAdhyame yArA phaYasAlA kare nA, tArAi phAsika|

Ara Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi yathAyathabhAve, era pUrvera kitAvera satyAYanakArI o era upara tadArakakArIrUpe| sutarAM AllAha yA nAyila karechena, tumi tAra mAdhyame phaYasAlA kara evaM tomAra nikaTa ye satya eseche, tA tyAga kare tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| tomAdera pratyekera janya Ami nirdhAraNa karechi zarIAta o spaSTa panthA evaM AllAha yadi cAitena, tave tomAderake eka ummata vAnAtena| kintu tini tomAderake yA diYechena, tAte tomAderake parIkSA karate cAna| sutarAM tomarA bhAla kAje pratiyogitA kara| AllAharai dike tomAdera savAra pratyAvartanasthala| ataHpara tini tomAderake avahita karavena, yA niYe tomarA matavirodha karate|

Ara tAdera madhye tAra mAdhyame phaYasAlA kara, yA AllAha nAyila karechena evaM tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| Ara tAdera theke satarka thAka ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, tAra kichu theke tArA tomAke vicyuta karave| ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tAhale jene rAkha ye, AllAha to kevala tAderake tAdera kichu pApera kAraNei AyAva dite cAna| Ara mAnuSera anekei phAsika|
tArA ki tave jAhiliYyAtera vidhAna cAYa? Ara nizcita vizvAsI kaomera janya vidhAna pradAne AllAhara ceYe ke adhika uttama?

he muminagaNa, iYAhUdI o nAsArAderake tomarA vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| tArA eke aparera vandhu| Ara tomAdera madhye ye tAdera sAthe vandhutva karave, se nizcaYa tAderai ekajana| nizcaYa AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta dena nA|

sutarAM tumi dekhate pAve, yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche, tArA kAphiradera madhye (vandhutvera janya) chuTache| tArA vale, ‘AmarA AzaGkA karachi ye, kona vipada AmAderake AkrAnta karave’| ataHpara hate pAre AllAha dAna karavena vijaYa kiMvA tA~ra pakSa theke emana kichu, yAra phale tArA tAdera antare yA lukiYe rekheche, tAte lajjita have|
Ara muminagaNa valave, ‘erAi ki tArA, yArA AllAhara nAme kaThina zapatha kareche ye, nizcaYa tArA tomAdera sAthe Ache’? tAdera AmalasamUha varavAda haYeche, phale tArA kSatigrasta haYeche|

he muminagaNa, tomAdera madhye ye vyakti tAra dIna theke phire yAve tAhale acirei AllAha emana kaomake Anavena, yAderake tini bhAlavAsavena evaM tArA tA~ke bhAlavAsave| tArA muminadera upara vinamra evaM kAphiradera upara kaThora have| AllAhara rAstAYa tArA jihAda karave evaM kona kaTAkSakArIra kaTAkSake bhaYa karave nA| eTi AllAhara anugraha, yAke icchA tini tAke tA dAna karena| Ara AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
tomAdera vandhu kevala AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminagaNa, yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM yAkAta pradAna kare vinIta haYe|
Ara ye AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminadera sAthe vandhutva kare, tave nizcaYa AllAhara dalai vijaYI|

he muminagaNa, tomarA tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, yArA tomAdera dvInake upahAsa o khela-tAmAzArUpe grahaNa kareche, tAdera madhya theke tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche o kAphiraderake| Ara AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, yadi tomarA mumina haYe thAka|
Ara yakhana tomarA sAlAtera dike DAka, takhana tArA eke upahAsa o khela-tAmAzArUpe grahaNa kare| tA ei kAraNe ye, tArA emana kaoma, yArA vujhe nA|

vala, ‘he kitAvIrA, kevala e kAraNe ki tomarA AmAdera prati vidveSa poSaNa kara ye, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati evaM yA AmAdera prati nAyila haYeche evaM pUrve nAyila haYeche tAra prati? Ara nizcaYa tomAdera adhikAMza phAsika|’

vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake AllAhara nikaTa pariNatira vicAre era ceYe manda kichura saMvAda deva? yAke AllAha lA‘nata diYechena evaM yAra upara tini krodhAnvita haYechena? Ara yAdera madhya theke vA~dara o zUkara vAniYechena evaM tArA tAgUtera upAsanA kareche| tArAi avasthAne manda evaM sojA patha theke sarvAdhika vicyuta’|

Ara yakhana tArA tomAdera nikaTa Ase, takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’| athaca avazyai tArA kupharI niYe praveza kareche evaM tArA tA niYei veriYe geche| Ara AllAha se samparke adhika jJAta, yA tArA gopana karata|
Ara tumi tAdera madhya theke anekake dekhate pAve ye, tArA pApe, sImAlaGghane evaM hArAma bhakSaNe chuTochuTi karache| tArA yA karache, nizcaYa tA katainA manda!
kena tAderake ravavAnI o dharmavidagaNa tAdera pApera kathA o hArAma bhakSaNa theke niSedha kare nA? tArA yA karache, nizcaYa tA katainA manda!

Ara iYAhUdIrA vale, ‘AllAhara hAta vA~dhA’| tAdera hAtai ve~dhe deYA haYeche evaM tArA yA valeche, tAra janya tArA lA‘natagrasta haYeche| varaM tAra du’hAta prasArita| yebhAve icchA tini dAna karena evaM tomAra upara tomAra ravera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kupharI vAr3iYei dicche| Ara Ami tAdera madhye kiYAmatera dina paryanta zatrutA o ghRNA Dhele diYechi| yakhanai tArA yuddhera Aguna prajvalita kare, AllAha tA nibhiYe dena| Ara tArA yamIne phAsAda kare ver3AYa evaM AllAha phAsAdakArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|
Ara yadi kitAvIrA ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tave avazyai Ami tAdera theke pApagulo dUra kare ditAma evaM avazyai tAderake ArAmadAYaka jAnnAtasamUhe praveza karAtAma|

Ara yadi tArA tAorAta, inajIla o tAdera nikaTa tAdera ravera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche, tA kAYema karata, tave avazyai tArA AhAra karata tAdera upara theke evaM tAdera padatala theke| tAdera madhya theke saThika pathera anusArI ekaTi dala raYeche evaM tAdera anekei yA karache, tA katainA manda!

he rAsUla, tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra nikaTa yA nAyila karA haYeche, tA pau~che dAo Ara yadi tumi nA kara tave tumi tA~ra risAlAta pau~chAle nA| Ara AllAha tomAke mAnuSa theke rakSA karavena| nizcaYa AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|

vala, ‘he kitAvIrA, tomarA kona bhittira upara nei, yatakSaNa nA tomarA tAorAta, inajIla o tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ravera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche, tA kAYema kara’| Ara tomAra nikaTa tomAra ravera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche, tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o kupharI vRddhi karave| sutarAM tumi kAphira kaomera upara hatAza haYo nA|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche, iYAhUdI haYeche evaM sAviI o nAsArArA (tAdera madhya theke) ye ImAna eneche AllAha o AkhirAta divase evaM nekakAja kareche, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|

avazyai Ami vanI isarAIlera aGgIkAra niYechi evaM tAdera nikaTa pAThiYechi aneka rAsUla| yakhanai tAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla emana kichu niYe eseche, yA tAdera mana cAYa nA, takhana tArA ekadalake asvIkAra kareche evaM ekadalake hatyA kareche|

Ara tArA bheveche ye, kona viparyaYa have nA| phale tArA andha o vadhira haYe giYeche| ataHpara AllAha tAdera tAovA kavUla karechena| ataHpara tAdera aneke andha o vadhira haYe giYeche| Ara tArA yA Amala kare AllAha tAra draSTA|

avazyai tArA kupharI kareche, yArA valeche, ‘nizcaYa AllAha hacchena mAraiYAma putra mAsIha’| Ara mAsIha valeche, ‘he vanI isarAIla, tomarA AmAra rava o tomAdera rava AllAhara ivAdAta kara’| nizcaYa ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare, tAra upara avazyai AllAha jAnnAta hArAma kare diYechena evaM tAra ThikAnA Aguna| Ara yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

avazyai tArA kupharI kareche, yArA vale, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tina janera tRtIYajana’| yadio eka ilAha chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| Ara yadi tArA yA valache, tA theke virata nA haYa, tave avazyai tAdera madhya theke kAphiraderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva sparza karave|
sutarAM tArA ki AllAhara nikaTa tAovA karave nA evaM tA~ra nikaTa kSamA cAive nA? Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAsIha ivane mAraiYAma ekajana rAsUla chAr3A Ara kichui naYa; tAra pUrve Arao vahu rAsUla gata haYeche, Ara tAra mA ekajana parama satyavAdinI, tArA ubhaYe khAdya AhAra karata| lakSya kara! Ami kirUpe tAdera nikaTa pramANasamUha varNanA karachi| AvAra lakSya kara! tArA ulTA kona dike yAcche?
vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A emana kichura ivAdAta karave, yA tomAdera janya kona kSati o upakArera kSamatA rAkhe nA? Ara AllAha, tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa’|

vala, ‘he kitAvIrA, satya chAr3A tomarA tomAdera dharmera vyApAre sImAlaGghana karo nA evaM emana kaomera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA, yArA pUrve pathabhraSTa haYeche, Ara anekake pathabhraSTa kareche evaM sojA patha vicyuta haYeche|
vanI isarAIlera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tAderake dAUda o mAraiYAma putra IsAra mukhe lA‘nata karA haYeche| tA e kAraNe ye, tArA avAdhya haYeche evaM tArA sImAlaGghana karata|
tArA parasparake manda theke niSedha karata nA, yA tArA karata| tArA yA karata, tA katainA manda!

tAdera madhye anekake tumi dekhate pAve, yArA kAphiradera sAthe vandhutva kare| tArA yA nijadera janya peza kareche, tA kata manda ye, AllAha tAdera upara krodhAnvita haYechena evaM tArA AyAvei sthAYI have|
Ara yadi tArA AllAha o navIra prati evaM yA tAra nikaTa nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati ImAna rAkhata, tave tAderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa karata nA| kintu tAdera madhye aneke phAsika|

tumi avazyai muminadera janya mAnuSera madhye zatrutAYa adhika kaThora pAve iYAhUdIderake evaM yArA ziraka kareche tAderake| Ara muminadera janya vandhutve tAdera madhye nikaTatara pAve tAderake, yArA vale, ‘AmarA nAsArA’| tA ei kAraNe ye, tAdera madhye aneka panDita o saMsAravirAgI Ache evaM tArA nizcaYa ahaGkAra kare nA|

‘Ara rAsUlera prati yA nAyila karA haYeche yakhana tArA tA zune, tumi dekhave tAdera cakSu azrute bhese yAcche, kAraNa tArA satya hate jeneche| tArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA ImAna enechi| sutarAM Apani AmAderake sAkSya dAnakArIdera saGge lipivaddha karuna’|

Ara AmAdera kI haYeche ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM ye satya AmAdera kAche eseche tAra prati ImAna Anava nA? Ara AmarA AzA karava nA ye, AmAdera rava AmAderake praveza karAvena nekakAra sampradAYera sAthe’|
sutarAM tArA yA valeche era kAraNe AllAha tAderake puraskAra devena jAnnAtasamUha, yAra nIce nadIsamUha pravAhita haYa, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| Ara eTA hala satkarmaparAYaNadera pratidAna|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, tArAi prajvalita Agunera adhivAsI|
he muminagaNa, AllAha ye sava pavitra vastu tomAdera janya hAlAla karechena, tomarA tA hArAma karo nA evaM tomarA sImAlaGghana karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera pachanda karena nA|
Ara AhAra kara AllAha yA tomAdera riyka diYechena tA theke hAlAla, pavitra vastu| Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara AllAhara yAra prati tomarA mumina|

AllAha tomAderake pAkar3Ao karena nA tomAdera arthahIna kasamera vyApAre, kintu ye kasama tomarA dRr3habhAve kara se kasamera janya tomAderake pAkar3Ao karena| sutarAM era kAphaphArA hala daza jana misakInake khAvAra dAna karA, madhyama dharanera khAvAra, yA tomarA svIYa parivArake khAiYe thAka, athavA tAdera vastra dAna, kiMvA ekajana dAsa-dAsI mukta karA| ataHpara ye sAmarthya rAkhe nA tave tina dina siYAma pAlana karA| eTA tomAdera kasamera kAphphArA, yadi tomarA kasama kara, Ara tomarA tomAdera kasama hephAyata kara| emanibhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|
he muminagaNa, nizcaYa mada, juYA, pratimA-vedI o bhAgyanirdhAraka tIrasamUha to nApAka zaYatAnera karma| sutarAM tomarA tA parihAra kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|
zaYatAna zudhu mada o juYA dvArA tomAdera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa saJcAra karate cAYa| Ara (cAYa) AllAhara smaraNa o sAlAta theke tomAdera vAdhA dite| ataeva, tomarA ki virata have nA?
Ara tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM Anugatya kara rAsUlera Ara sAvadhAna hao| tArapara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tave jene rAkha ye, AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu suspaSTa pracAra|

yArA ImAna eneche o neka Amala kareche tArA yA AhAra kareche tAte kona pApa nei, yakhana tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM ImAna Ane Ara neka Amala kare, tArapara tAkaoYA avalamvana kare o ImAna Ane| eraparao tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM satkarma kare| Ara AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

he muminagaNa, avazyai AllAha tomAderake parIkSA karavena zikArera emana vastu dvArA tomAdera hAta o varzA yAra nAgAla pAYa, yAte AllAha jene nena ke tA~ke gAYevera sAthe bhaYa kare| sutarAM erapara ye sImAlaGghana karave tAra janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva |

he muminagaNa, iharAme thAkA avasthAYa tomarA zikArake hatyA karo nA evaM ye tomAdera madhye icchAkRtabhAve tA hatyA karave tAra vinimaYa hala yA hatyA kareche, tAra anurUpa gRhapAlita pazu, yAra phaYasAlA karave tomAdera madhye du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa loka- kuravAnIra jantu hisAve kA’vAYa pau~chate have| athavA misakInake khAvAra dAnera kAphphArA kiMvA samasaMkhyaka siYAma pAlana, yAte se nija karmera zAsti AsvAdana kare| yA gata haYeche tA AllAha kSamA karechena| ye punarAYa karave AllAha tAra theke pratizodha nevena| Ara AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|

tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche samudrera zikAra o tAra khAdya; tomAdera o musAphiradera bhogera janya| Ara sthalera zikAra tomAdera upara hArAma karA haYeche yatakSaNa tomarA iharAma avasthAYa thAka| Ara tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, yAra dike tomAderake ekatra karA have|

AllAha sammAnita gRha kA‘vAke, sammAnita mAsake*, hAdaYi** o kAlAYida*** keo mAnuSera kalyANera janya pratiSThA karechena| eTA e janya ye, tomarA yena jAnate pAra, AllAha AsamAnasamUhe yA Ache evaM yamIne yA Ache tA jAnena| Ara AllAha sava kichu samparke samyaka jJAta| * hijarI mAsera muhArarama, rajava, jilakada o jilahaja e cAra mAsake sammAnita mAsa valA haYa|
jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora Ara nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
pracAra vyatIta rAsUlera kona dAYitva nei| Ara tomarA yA prakAza kara evaM yA gopana kara AllAha tA jAnena|
vala, ‘apavitra o pavitra samAna naYa, yadio apavitrera Adhikya tomAke mugdha kare| ataeva he vuddhimAna vyaktirA, AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara| yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao’|

he muminagaNa, tomarA emana viSaYAvalI samparke prazna karo nA yA tomAdera kAche prakAza karA hale tA tomAderake pIr3A deve| Ara kuraAna avataraNa kAle yadi tomarA se samparke prazna kara tAhale tA tomAdera janya prakAza karA have| AllAha tA kSamA karechena| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama sahanazIla|
tomAdera pUrve ekaTi kaoma erUpa prazna karechila; tArapara tArA era kAraNe kAphira haYe gela|

AllAha tairI karenani vAhIrA*, sAYevA**, oYAsIlA*** o hAma**** | kintu yArA kupharI kareche tArA AllAhara upara mithyA raTanA kare| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai vujhe nA| * vAhIrAH ye jantura dudha pratimAra uddezye utsarga karA haYa tAke vAhIrA valA haYa|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAha yA nAyila karechena tAra dike o rAsUlera dike Asa’, tArA vale, ‘AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSadera yAra upara peYechi tAi AmAdera janya yatheSTa|’ yadio tAdera pitRpuruSarA kichui jAnata nA evaM hidAYAtaprApta chila nA tavuo?

he muminagaNa, tomAdera upara tomAdera nijadera dAYitva| yadi tomarA saThika pathe thAka tAhale ye pathabhraSTa haYeche se tomAdera kSati karate pArave nA| AllAhara dikei tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana; takhana tini tomarA yA Amala karate tA tomAdera jAniYe devena|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomAdera kAro nikaTa mRtyu upasthita haYa, takhana osiYatakAle tomAdera mAjhe tomAdera madhya theke du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa vyakti sAkSI have, athavA anyadera theke du’jana, yadi tomarA yamIne saphare thAka, ataHpara tomAderake mRtyura vipada peYe vase| yadi tomAdera sandeha haYa, tave ubhaYake sAlAtera para apekSamANa rAkhave| ataHpara tArA ubhaYe AllAhara nAme kasama karave ye, ‘AmarA era vinimaYe kona mUlya grahaNa karava nA, yadio se AtmIYa haYa| Ara AllAhara sAkSya AmarA gopana karava nA, karale avazyai AmarA gunAhagAradera antarbhukta hava’|

kintu yadi jAnA yAYa ye, tArA pApe lipta haYeche, tAhale tAdera madhya theke yAdera svArthahAnI ghaTeche- anya du’vyakti prathamokta du’janera sthalAbhiSikta have| ataHpara tArA AllAhara nAme kasama kare valave, ‘avazyai AmAdera sAkSya tAdera sAkSya theke adhika satya evaM AmarA sImAlaGghana karini; karale avazyai AmarA yAlimadera antarbhukta hava’|

eTi nikaTatama ye, tArA sAkSya saThikabhAve upasthApana karave athavA tArA (mithyA sAkSya pradAnakArIrA) bhaYa karave ye, tAdera (nikaTAtmIYadera) kasamera para (pUrvokta) kasama pratyAkhyAna karA have| Ara AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM zuna! Ara AllAha phAsika kaomake hidAYAta karena nA|

(smaraNa kara) yedina AllAha rAsUlagaNake ekatra karavena, ataHpara valavena, ‘tomAderake kI javAva deYA haYechila’? tArA valave, ‘AmAdera kona ilama nei, nizcaYa Apani gAYevI viSaYasamUhera sarvajJAnI’|

yakhana AllAha valavena,‘he mAraiYAmera putra IsA, tomAra upara o tomAra mAtAra upara AmAra ni‘Amata smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tomAke zaktizAlI karechilAma pavitra AtmA* diYe, tumi mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate dolanAYa o pariNata vaYase| Ara yakhana Ami tomAke zikSA diYechilAma kitAva, hikamAta, tAorAta o inajIla; Ara yakhana AmAra Adeze kAdAmATi theke pAkhira AkRtira mata gaThana karate evaM tAte phu~ka dite, phale AmAra Adeze tA pAkhi haYe yeta| Ara tumi AmAra Adeze janmAndha o kuSTha rogIke sustha karate evaM yakhana AmAra Adeze tumi mRtake jIvita vera karate| Ara yakhana tumi spaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechile takhana Ami vanI isarAIlake tomAra theke phiriYe rekhechilAma| ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tArA valechila, eto spaSTa yAdu| *‘pavitra AtmA’ vale jivarIla (AH ke vujhAno haYeche|

Ara yakhana Ami hAoYArI* gaNake e Adeza diYechilAma ye, ‘AmAra prati tomarA ImAna Ana o AmAra rAsUlera prati’| tArA valechila, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma evaM Apani sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA avazyai musalima’| * IsA A. era vizeSa anusArIdera hAoYArI valA haYa|

yakhana hAoYArIgaNa valechila, ‘he mAraiYAmera putra IsA, tomAra rava ki pAre AmAdera upara AsamAna theke khAvArapUrNa dastarakhAna nAyila karate?’ se valechila, ‘AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, yadi tomarA mumina hao’|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA tA theke khete cAi| Ara AmAdera hRdaYa prazAnta have evaM AmarA jAnava ye, tumi AmAderake satyai valecha, Ara AmarA e vyApAre sAkSIdera antarbhukta hava|’

mAraiYAmera putra IsA valala, ‘he AllAha, he AmAdera rava, AsamAna theke AmAdera prati khAvArapUrNa dastarakhAna nAyila karuna; eTA AmAdera janya Ida have| AmAdera pUrvavartI o paravartIdera janya| Ara ApanAra pakSa theke eka nidarzana have| Ara AmAderake riyka dAna karuna, Apanii zreSTha riykadAtA’|
AllAha valalena, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera prati tA nAyila karava; kintu erapara tomAdera madhye ye kupharI karave tAke nizcaYa Ami emana AyAva deva, ye AyAva sRSTikulera kAuke deva nA|’

Ara AllAha yakhana valavena, ‘he mAraiYAmera putra IsA, tumi ki mAnuSaderake valechile ye, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A AmAke o AmAra mAtAke ilAharUpe grahaNa kara?’ se valave, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna, yAra adhikAra AmAra nei tA valA AmAra janya sambhava naYa| yadi Ami tA valatAma tAhale avazyai Apani tA jAnatena| AmAra antare yA Ache tA Apani jAnena, Ara ApanAra antare yA Ache tA Ami jAni nA; nizcaYa Apani gAYevI viSaYasamUhe sarvajJAta’|

‘Ami tAderake kevala tAi valechi, yA Apani AmAke Adeza karechena ye, tomarA AmAra rava o tomAdera rava AlalAhara ivAdAta kara| Ara yatadina Ami tAdera madhye chilAma tatadina Ami tAdera upara sAkSI chilAma| ataHpara yakhana Apani AmAke uThiYe nilena takhana Apani chilena tAdera paryavekSaNakArI| Ara Apani sava kichura upara sAkSI|
yadi Apani tAderake zAsti pradAna karena tave tArA ApanArai vAndA, Ara tAderake yadi kSamA karena, tave nizcaYa Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|’

AllAha valavena, ‘eTA hala sei dina yedina satyavAdIgaNake tAdera satatA upakAra karave| tAdera janya Ache jAnnAtasamUha yAra nIce pravAhita have nadIsamUha| sekhAne tArA have cirasthAYI| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena, tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa haYeche| eTA mahAsAphalya|
AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM tAdera madhye yA kichu Ache tAra rAjatva AllAharai evaM tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya yini sRSTi karechena AsamAna o yamIna evaM sRSTi karechena andhakAra o Alo| tArapara kAphirarA tAdera ravera samatulya sthira kare|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena kAdA mATi theke tArapara nirdhAraNa karechena ekaTi kAla, Ara tA~ra kAche Ache ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla, tArapara tomarA sandeha kara|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne tinii AllAha, tini jAnena tomAdera gopana o prakAzya evaM jAnena yA tomarA arjana kara|
Ara tAdera kAche tAdera ravera AYAtasamUhera kona AYAta Asalei tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ataHpara avazyai tArA satyake asvIkAra kareche, yakhana tA tAdera kAche eseche| sutarAM acirei tAdera kAche se viSaYera saMvAda Asave yA niYe tArA upahAsa karata|

tArA ki dekhe nA, Ami tAdera pUrve vahu prajanmake dhvaMsa karechi? yAderake yamIne emanabhAve pratiSThita karechilAma yebhAve tomAderake pratiSThita karini| Ara tAdera upara vRSTi pAThiYechilAma muSaladhAre evaM sRSTi karechilAma nadIsamUha yA tAdera nIce pravAhita hata| ataHpara tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake dhvaMsa karechi evaM tAdera pare anya prajanmake sRSTi karechi|
Ara yadi Ami kAgaje likhita kitAva tomAra upara nAyila karatAma ataHpara tArA tA hAta diYe sparza karata tavuo yArA kupharI kareche tArA valata, ‘e to prakAzya yAdu chAr3A kichu nA|’
Ara tArA vale, ‘kena tAra upara kona phereztA nAyila karA haYani?’ yadi Ami phereztA nAyila karatAma tAhale viSaYaTi phaYasAlA haYe yeta, tArapara tAdera suyoga deYA hata nA|
Ara yadi rAsUlake pherezatA vAnAtAma tave tAke puruSa mAnuSai vAnAtAma| phale tArA ye sandeha kare, se sandehei tAderake rekhe ditAma|
Ara avazyai tomAra pUrve rAsUlagaNake niYe upahAsa karA haYechila| phale yArA tAdera sAthe upahAsa karechila, tAderake tAdera upahAsa veSTana kare niYeche|
vala, ‘tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara tArapara dekha, asvIkArakArIdera pariNAma kemana haYeche|’

vala, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA Ache tA kAra’? vala, ‘AllAhara janya’; tini tA~ra nijera upara rahamata likhe niYechena| tini avazyai tomAderake ekatra karavena kiYAmatera dine, ete kona sandeha nei| yArA nijadera kSati kareche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
yA kichu rAte o dine sthita haYa tA tA~rai| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

vala, ‘Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anyake abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa karava, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sraSTA? tini AhAra dena, tA~ke AhAra deYA haYa nA|’ vala, ‘nizcaYa Ami AdiSTa haYechi ye, yArA isalAma grahaNa kareche yena Ami tAdera prathama hai’| Ara tumi kakhano muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA’|
vala, ‘yadi Ami AmAra ravera avAdhya hai tave nizcaYa Ami bhaYa kari mahA divasera AyAvake|
sedina yAra theke AyAva sariYe neYA have tAkei tini anugraha karavena, Ara eTAi prakAzya saphalatA|
Ara yadi AllAha tomAke kona durdazA dvArA sparza karena, tave tini chAr3A tA dUrakArI keu nei| Ara yadi kona kalyANa dvArA sparza karena tave tinii to sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara tinii tA~ra vAndAdera upara kSamatAvAna; Ara tini prajJAmaYa, samyaka avahita|

vala, ‘sAkSya hiseve savaceYe var3a vastu kI?’ vala, ‘AllAha sAkSI AmAra o tomAdera madhye| Ara e kuraAna AmAra kAche ohI kare pAThAno haYeche yena tomAderake o yAra kAche eTA pau~chave tAderake era mAdhyame Ami satarka kari| tomarAi ki sAkSya dAo ye, AllAhara sAthe raYeche anyAnya upAsya? vala, ‘Ami sAkSya dei nA’| vala, ‘tini kevala eka ilAha Ara tomarA yA zarIka kara Ami nizcaYai tA theke mukta’|
yAderake Ami kitAva diYechi tArA tAke cine yerUpa cine tAdera chele-santAnaderake| yArA nijadera kSati kareche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ara tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke ye AllAhara upara mithyA raTanA kare athavA tAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare? nizcaYai yAlimarA saphalakAma haYa nA|
Ara yedina Ami tAdera sakalake samaveta karava tArapara yArA zir‌ka kareche tAderake valava, ‘tomAdera zarIkarA kothAYa, yAderake tomarA (zarIka) mane karate?’
ataHpara tAdera parIkSAra javAva zudhu e have ye, tArapara tArA valave, ‘AmAdera rava AllAhara kasama! AmarA muzarika chilAma nA’|
dekha, tArA kIbhAve mithyA valeche nijadera upara, tArA ye mithyA raTanA karata, tA tAdera theke hAriYe gela|

Ara tAdera keu tomAra prati kAna pete zone, kintu Ami tAdera antarera upara rekhe diYechi AvaraNa yena tArA anudhAvana nA kare, Ara tAdera kAne rekhechi chipi| Ara yadi tArA pratiTi AYAtao dekhe, tArA tAra prati ImAna Anave nA; emanaki yakhana tArA tomAra kAche ese vAdAnuvAde lipta haYa, yArA kupharI kareche tArA vale, ‘eTA pUrvavartIdera kalpakAhinI chAr3A kichui naYa|’
Ara tArA tAra theke niSedha kare evaM tAra theke dUre thAke| Ara tArA dhvaMsa kare kevala nijaderake, athaca tArA anubhava kare nA|

Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana tAderake Agunera upara ATakAno have, takhana tArA valave, ‘hAYa! yadi AmAderake pherata pAThAno hata| Ara AmarA AmAdera ravera AYAtasamUha asvIkAra nA karatAma evaM AmarA muminadera antarbhukta hatAma!’

varaM tAdera kAche prakAza haYe giYeche pUrve yA tArA gopana karata| Ara yadi tAdera pherata pAThAno haYa avazyai yA theke tAderake niSedha karA haYeche tArA tAte phire yeta evaM nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|
Ara tArA valechila, ‘AmAdera e duniYAra jIvana chAr3A kichu nei evaM AmarA punarujjIvita hava nA|’

Ara yadi tumi dekhate yakhana tAderake dA~r3a karAno have tAdera ravera sAmane evaM tini valavena ‘eTA ki satya naYa’? tArA valave, ‘hyA~, AmAdera ravera kasama!’ tini valavena, ‘sutarAM tomarA ye kupharI karate tAra kAraNe AyAva AsvAdana kara|’

yArA AllAhara sAkSAt asvIkAra kareche tArA avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche, emanaki yakhana haThAt tAdera kAche kiYAmata ese yAve, tArA valave, ‘hAYa Aphasosa! sekhAne AmarA ye truTi karechi tAra upara|’ tArA tAdera pApasamUha tAdera piThe vahana karave; sAvadhAna! tArA yA vahana karave tA kata nikRSTa!
Ara duniYAra jIvana khelAdhulA o tAmAzA chAr3A kichu nA| Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya AkhirAtera AvAsa uttama| ataeva tomarA ki vujhave nA?
Ami avazyai jAni ye, tArA yA vale tA tomAke duHkha deYa| kintu tArA to tomAke asvIkAra kare nA, varaM yAlimarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare|

Ara avazyai tomAra pUrve aneka rAsUlake asvIkAra karA haYeche, ataHpara tArA tAderake asvIkAra karA o kaSTa deYAra kSetre dhairyadhAraNa kareche, yatakSaNa nA AmAra sAhAyya tAdera kAche eseche| Ara AllAhara vANIsamUhera kona parivartanakArI nei evaM avazyai rAsUlagaNera kichu saMvAda tomAra kAche eseche|

Ara yadi tAdera upekSA tomAra upara kaThina mane haYa, tAhale yadi tumi pAra yamIne kona sur3aGga athavA AsamAne kona si~r3i anusandhAna karate, ataHpara tAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe Asate (tave kara)| yadi AllAha cAitena tini avazyai tAderake hidAYAtera upara ekatra karatena| sutarAM tumi kakhano mUrkhadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
tArAi sAr3A deYa yArA zune| Ara mRtaderake AllAha punarAYa jIvita karavena| tArapara tAra dikei pratyAvartita have|
Ara tArA vale, ‘kena tAra upara tAra ravera pakSa theke kona nidarzana nAyila karA haYani’? vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha ye kona nidarzana nAyila karate sakSama| kintu tAdera adhikAMza jAne nA’|

Ara yamIne vicaraNakArI pratiTi prANI evaM du’DAnA diYe ur3e emana pratiTi pAkhi, tomAdera mata eka ekaTi ummata| Ami kitAve kona truTi karini| ataHpara tAderake tAdera ravera kAche samaveta karA have|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, tArA vovA o vadhira, andhakAre raYeche| AllAha yAke cAna, tAke pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke cAna tAke sarala pathe aTala rAkhena|
vala, ‘tomarA ki vivecanA kara, yadi tomAdera kAche AllAhara AyAva ese yAYa athavA kiYAmata Agamana kare, tave ki tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke DAkave, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?
varaM tAkei tomarA DAkave| ataHpara yadi tini cAna, ye janya tAke DAkacha, tA tini dUra kare devena| Ara tomarA yA zarIka kara, tA tomarA bhule yAve|
Ara Ami tomAdera pUrvekAra jAtisamUhera kAche vahu rAsUla pAThiYechi, Ami tAdera prati kSudhA, dAridratA o roga vyAdhi cApiYe diYechi, yena tArA namratA prakAza kare AmAra sAmane nati svIkAra kare|
sutarAM tArA kena vinIta haYani, yakhana AmAra AyAva tAdera kAche Asala? kintu tAdera hRdaYa niSThura haYe giYeche| Ara tArA yA karata, zaYatAna tAdera janya tA zobhita kareche|

ataHpara tAderake ye upadeza deYA haYechila, tArA yakhana tA bhule gela, Ami tAdera upara sava kichura darajA khule dilAma| avazeSe yakhana tAderake yA pradAna karA haYechila tAra kAraNe tArA utphulla hala, Ami haThAt tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma| phale takhana tArA hatAza haYe gela|
ataeva yAlima sampradAYera mUla keTe phelA hala| Ara sakala prazaMsA rAvavula AlAmIna AllAhara janya|

vala, ‘tomarA AmAke jAnAo, yadi AllAha tomAdera zravaNa o dRSTisamUha ker3e nena evaM tomAdera antarasamUhe mohara e~Te dena, ke Ache ilAha, AllAha chAr3A, ye tomAdera egulo niYe Asave?’ dekha, kIbhAve Ami vibhinnarUpe nidarzanasamUha varNanA kari, tArapara tArA er3iYe cale|
vala, ‘tomarA AmAke jAnAo, yadi AllAhara AyAva haThAt kiMvA prakAzye tomAdera kAche ese yAYa, yAlima kaoma chAr3A anya kAuke dhvaMsa karA have ki?’
Ara Ami rAsUladerake kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve preraNa kari| ataeva yArA ImAna eneche o zudhare niYeche, tAdera upara kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA ci‎‎ntita have nA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche tAderake sparza karave AyAva, e kAraNe ye, tArA nApharamAnI karata|

vala, ‘tomAderake Ami vali nA, AmAra kAche AllAhara bhAnDArasamUha raYeche evaM Ami gAYeva jAni nA evaM tomAderake vali nA, nizcaYa Ami pherezatA| Ami kevala tAi anusaraNa kari yA AmAra kAche ohI preraNa karA haYa’| vala, ‘andha Ara cakSuSmAna ki samAna hate pAre? ataeva tomarA ki cintA karave nA?’

Ara e dvArA tumi tAderake satarka kara, yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera ravera dike samaveta karA have, (e avasthAYa ye) tini chAr3A tAdera janya thAkave nA kona sAhAyyakArI Ara nA supArizakArI| haYata tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave|

Ara tumi tAr3iYe diYo nA tAderake, yArA nija ravake sakAla sandhyAYa DAke, tArA tAra santuSTi cAYa| tAdera kona hisAva tomAra upara nei evaM tomAra kona hisAva tAdera upara nei, phale tumi tAderake tAr3iYe dive evaM tumi yAlimadera antarbhukta have|
Ara ebhAvei Ami ekake anyera dvArA parIkSA karechi, yAte tArA vale, ‘erAi ki, AmAdera madhya theke yAdera upara AllAha anugraha karechena? AllAha ki kRtajJadera vyApAre pUrNa jJAta naYa?

Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera upara ImAna Ane, tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase, takhana tumi vala, ‘tomAdera upara sAlAma’| tomAdera rava tA~ra nijera upara likhe niYechena daYA, nizcaYa ye tomAdera madhya theke nA jene khArApa kAja kare tArapara tAovA kare evaM zudhare neYa, tave tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara ebhAvei Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari| Ara yAte aparAdhIdera patha spaSTa haYe yAYa|

vala, ‘nizcaYa AmAke niSedha karA haYeche tAdera ivAdAta karate, yAderake tomarA DAka AllAha chAr3A| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kari nA, (yadi kari) nizcaYa takhana pathabhraSTa hava evaM Ami hidAYAtaprAptadera antarbhukta hava nA|

vala, ‘nizcaYa Ami AmAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera upara raYechi Ara tomarA tA asvIkAra karacha| tomarA yA niYe tAr3Ahur3A karacha tA AmAra kAche nei| hukuma kevala AllAhara kAche| tini satya varNanA karena evaM tini sarvottama phaYasAlAkArI’|
vala, ‘tomarA yA niYe tAr3Ahur3A karacha, tA yadi AmAra kAche thAkata, avazyai AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe viSaYaTira mImAMsA haYe yeta| Ara AllAha yAlimadera vyApAre adhika jJAta’|

Ara tA~ra kAche raYeche gAYevera cAvisamUha, tini chAr3A e viSaYe keu jAne nA evaM tini avagata raYechena sthale o samudre yA kichu Ache| Ara kona pAtA jhare nA, kintu tini tA jAnena evaM yamInera andhakAre kona dAnA par3e nA, nA kona bhejA evaM nA kona zuSka kichu; kintu raYeche suspaSTa kitAve|

Ara tinii rAte tomAderake mRtyu dena evaM dine tomarA yA kAmAi kara tini tA jAnena| tArapara tini tomAderake dine punarAYa jAgiYe tulena, yAte nirdiSTa meYAda pUrNa karA haYa| tArapara tA~ra dikei tomAdera pratyAvartana| tArapara tomarA yA karate tini tomAderake se viSaYe avahita karavena|

Ara tinii nija vAndAdera upara kSamatAvAna evaM tomAdera upara preraNa karena hiphAyatakArIderake| avazeSe yakhana tomAdera kAro kAche mRtyu Ase, AmAra prerita dUtagaNa tAra mRtyu ghaTAYa| Ara tArA kona truTi kare nA|
tArapara tAderake pratyAvartita karA haYa tAdera satya mAolA AllAhara kAche| sAvadhAna! hukuma pradAnera kSamatA tA~rai| Ara tini hacchena khuva druta hisAvakArI|

vala, ‘ke tomAderake nAjAta dena sthala o samudrera yAvatIYa andhakAra theke? tomarA tAke DAka anunaYa vinaYa kare o cupisAre ye, yadi tini AmAderake e theke nAjAta dena, AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava’|
vala, ‘AllAha tA theke tomAderake nAjAta dena evaM pratyeka vipada theke| tArapara tomarA ziraka kara’|

vala, ‘tini to sakSama tomAdera upara theke athavA tomAdera pAYera nIca theke tomAdera upara AyAva preraNa karate, athavA tomAderake vibhinna sandehapUrNa dale vibhakta karate evaM tomAdera ekadalake anya dalera bhIti AsvAdana karAte’| dekha, kIbhAve Ami AYAtasamUha nAnAbhAve varNanA kari, yAte tArA bhAlabhAve vujhate pAre|
Ara tomAra kaoma tA asvIkAra kareche, athaca tA satya| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera upara tattvAvadhAYaka nai’|
pratyeka saMvAdera nirdhArita samaYa raYeche evaM acirei tomarA jAnave|

Ara yakhana tumi tAderake dekha, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre upahAsamUlaka samAlocanAYa rata Ache, tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya kathAvArtAYa lipta haYa| Ara yadi zaYatAna tomAke bhuliYe deYa, tave smaraNera para yAlima sampradAYera sAthe vaso nA|
Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, yAlimadera kona hiseva tAdera upara nei| kintu (tAdera kartavya hacche) upadeza deYA, yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

Ara tumi parityAga kara tAderake, yArA nijadera dInake grahaNa kareche khela-tAmAzA rUpe evaM pratArita kareche yAderake duniYAra jIvana| Ara tumi kuraAna dvArA upadeza dAo, yAte kona vyakti tAra kRtakarmera daruna dhvaMsera zikAra nA haYa, tAra janya AllAha chAr3A nei kona abhibhAvaka evaM nei kona supArizakArI| Ara yadi se sava dharaNera muktipaNao deYa, tAra theke tA grahaNa karA have nA| erAi tArA, yArA dhvaMsera zikAra haYeche tAdera kRtakarmera daruna| tAdera janya raYeche phuTanta pAnIYa evaM vedanAdAYaka AyAva, yehetu tArA kupharI karata|

vala, ‘AmarA ki DAkava AllAha chAr3A emana kichuke, yA AmAderake kona upakAra kare nA evaM kSati kare nA? Ara AllAha AmAderake patha dekhAnora para AmAderake ki phirAno have AmAdera pazcAte sei vyaktira nyAYa yAke zaYatAna yamIne emana zaktabhAve peYe vaseche ye, se dizehArA? tAra raYeche sahacaravRnda, tArA tAke saThika pathera dike DAke, ‘AmAdera kAche Asa|’ vala, ‘AllAhara pathai saThika patha| Ara AmarA rAvvula AlAmInera Anugatya karate AdiSTa haYechi’ |
Ara (AdiSTa haYechi ye,) tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara evaM tA~ra tAkaoYA avalamvana kara| Ara tinii, yAra kAche tomAderake samaveta karA have|

Ara tinii, AsamAnasamUha o yamIna yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena| Ara yedina tini valavena, ‘hao’ takhana haYe yAve| tA~ra kathAi yathArtha| Ara tA~ra janyai raYeche sedinera rAjatva, yedina ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have| tini gAYeva o upasthita viSaYe parijJAta evaM tini prajJAmaYa, adhika avahita|
Ara (smaraNa kara) yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA Ayarake valechila, ‘tumi ki mUrtiguloke ilAharUpe grahaNa karacha? nizcaYa Ami tomAke tomAra kaomake spaSTa gomarAhIte dekhachi’|
Ara ebhAvei Ami ivarAhImake AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva dekhAi evaM yAte se dRr3ha vizvAsIdera antarbhukta haYa|
ataHpara yakhana rAta tAra upara Acchanna hala, se tArakA dekhala, valala, ‘e AmAra rava’| ataHpara yakhana tA Duve gela, takhana se valala, ‘yArA Duve yAYa Ami tAderake bhAlavAsi nA’|

ataHpara yakhana se cA~da ujjvalarUpe udIYamAna dekhala, valala, ‘e AmAra rava’| pare yakhana tA Duve gela, valala, ‘yadi AmAra rava AmAke hidAYAta nA karena, nizcaYa Ami pathahArA kaomera antarbhukta haYe yAva’|

ataHpara yakhana se sUrya ujjvalarUpe udIYamAna dekhala, valala, ‘e AmAra rava, e savaceYe var3a’| pare yakhana tA Duve gela, takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA yA zarIka kara, nizcaYa Ami tA theke mukta’|
‘nizcaYa Ami niviSTa karechi AmAra cehArA ekaniSThabhAve tA~ra janya, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena| Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai’|

Ara tAra kaoma tAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karala| se valala, tomarA ki vAdAnuvAda karacha AmAra sAthe AllAhara vyApAre, athaca tini AmAke hidAYAta diYechena? tomarA tA~ra sAthe yA zarIka kara, Ami tAke bhaYa kari nA, tave AmAra rava yadi kichu karate cAna| AmAra rava ilama dvArA sava kichu parivyApta kare Achena| ataHpara tomarA ki upadeza grahaNa karave nA’?

‘tomarA yA zarIka karecha kIbhAve Ami tAke bhaYa karava? athaca tomarA bhaYa karacha nA ye, tomarA zarIka karecha AllAhara sAthe emana kichu, yAra pakSe tini tomAdera upara kona pramANa nAyila karenani| ataeva kon dala nirApattAra vezi hakadAra, yadi tomarA jAna’?
yArA ImAna eneche evaM nija ImAnake yulamera sAthe saMmizraNa kareni, tAdera janyai nirApattA evaM tArAi hidAYAtaprApta|
Ara e hacche AmAra dalIla, Ami tA ivarAhImake tAra kaomera upara dAna karechi| Ami yAke cAi, tAke maryAdAYa u~cu kari| nizcaYa tomAra rava prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Ara Ami tAke dAna karechi isahAka o iYAkUvake| pratyekake Ami hidAYAta diYechi evaM nUhake pUrve hidAYAta diYechi| Ara tAra santAnadera madhya theke dAUda, sulAimAna, AiYuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArUnake| Ara Ami ebhAvei satkarmazIladerake pratidAna dei|
Ara yAkAriYyA, iYAhaiYA, IsA o ilaYAsake| pratyekei nekakAradera antarbhukta|
Ara isamAIla, Ala iYAsA‘, iunusa o lUtake| pratyekake Ami sRSTikulera upara zreSThatva dAna karechi|
Ara (Ami hidAYAta dAna karechi) tAdera pitRpuruSa, vaMzadhara o bhAidera madhya theke, Ara tAderake Ami vAchAi karechi evaM tAderake sarala pathera dike paricAlita karechi|
e hacche AllAhara hidAYAta, e dvArA tini nija vAndAdera madhya theke yAke icchA hidAYAta karena| Ara yadi tArA zir‌ka karata, tave tArA yA Amala karachila tA avazyai varavAda haYe yeta|
erAi tArA, yAderake Ami dAna karechi kitAva, hukuma o navuoYAta| ataeva yadi tArA era sAthe kupharI kare, tave Ami egulora tattvAvadhAYaka emana kaomake karechi, yArA era vyApAre kAphira naYa|
erAi tArA, yAderake AllAha hidAYAta karechena| ataeva tAdera hidAYAta tumi anusaraNa kara| vala, ‘Ami tomAdera kAche era upara kona vinimaYa cAi nA| eTA to sRSTikulera janya upadezamAtra|

Ara tArA AllAhake yathArtha sammAna deYani, yakhana tArA valache, AllAha kona mAnuSera upara kichui nAyila karenani| vala, ‘ke nAyila kareche se kitAva, yA mUsA niYe eseche mAnuSera janya Alo o pathanirdezasvarUpa, tomarA tA vibhinna kAgaje likhe rAkhate, tomarA tA prakAza karate Ara aneka aMza gopana rAkhate; Ara tomAderake zikSA deYA haYechila yA jAnate nA tomarA o tomAdera pitRpuruSa’? vala, ‘AllAha’| tArapara tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA tAdera ayAcita samAlocanAYa khelate thAkuka|

Ara eTi ekaTi kitAva, Ami tA nAyila karechi, varakatamaYa, yA tAdera sAmane Ache tAra satyAYanakArI| Ara yAte tumi satarka kara ummula kurA (makkA) o tAra Aza-pAze yArA Ache tAderake| Ara yArA AkherAtera prati ImAna rAkhe tArA e kitAvera prati ImAna Ane evaM tArA tAdera sAlAtera upara yatnavAna thAke|

Ara tAra ceYe var3a yAlima ke, ye AllAhara upara mithyA raTanA kare, athavA vale, ‘AmAra upara ohI preraNa karA haYeche’, athaca tAra prati kona kichui preraNa karA haYani? evaM ye vale ‘Ami acirei nAyila karava, yerUpa AllAha nAyila karechena’| Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana yAlimarA mRtyu kaSTe thAke, ematAvasthAYa pherezatArA tAdera hAta prasArita kare Ache (tArA vale), ‘tomAdera jAna vera kara| Aja tomAderake pratidAna deYA have lAJchanAra AyAva, kAraNa tomarA AllAhara upara asatya valate evaM tomarA tAra AYAtasamUha samparke ahaGkAra karate|

Ara nizcaYa tomarA esecha AmAra kAche ekA ekA, yerUpa sRSTi karechi Ami tomAderake prathamavAra evaM Ami tomAderake yA dAna karechi, tA tomarA cher3e rekhecha tomAdera piThera pechane| Ara Ami tomAdera sAthe tomAdera supArizakArIdera dekhachi nA, yAdera tomarA mane karecha ye, nizcaYa tArA tomAdera madhye (AllAhara) aMzIdAra| avazyai chinna haYe geche tomAdera parasparera samparka| Ara tomarA yA dhAraNA karate, tA tomAdera theke hAriYe giYeche|
nizcaYa AllAha vIja o A~Ti vidIrNakArI| tini mRta theke jIvitake vera karena evaM jIvita theke mRtake verakArI| tinii AllAha, sutarAM (satpatha theke) kothAYa tomAderake phiriYe neYA hacche?
(tini) prabhAta udbhAsaka| tini vAniYechena rAtake prazAnti evaM sUrya o candrake samaYa nirUpaka| eTA sarvajJa parAkramazAlIra nirdhAraNa|

Ara tinii sRSTi karechena tomAdera janya tArakArAji, yAte tomarA e dvArA pathaprApta hao sthala o samudrera andhakAre| avazyai Ami AYAtasamUhake vistArita varNanA karechi emana kaomera janya yArA jAne|
Ara tinii sRSTi karechena tomAderake eka naphasa theke| ataHpara raYeche AvAsasthala o samAdhisthala| avazyai Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA karechi, emana kaomera janya yArA bhAlabhAve vujhe|

Ara tinii AsamAna theke varSaNa karechena vRSTi| ataHpara Ami e dvArA utpanna karechi sava jAtera udbhida| ataHpara Ami tA theke vera karechi savuja DAla-pAlA| Ami tA theke vera kari ghana sanniviSTa zasyadAnA| Ara khejura vRkSera mAthi theke (vera kari) jhulanta thokA| Ara (utpanna kari) AGgurera vAgAna evaM sAdRzyapUrNa o sAdRzyahIna yaYatuna o AnAra| dekha tAra phalera dike, yakhana se phalavAna haYa evaM tAra pAkAra prati| nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche emana kaomera janya yArA ImAna Ane|

Ara tArA jinake AllAhara janya zarIka sAvyasta kareche, athaca tini tAderake sRSTi karechena| Ara tArA ajJatAvazata managar3AbhAve nirdhAraNa kareche tAra janya putra o kanyA santAna| tini pavitra mahAna evaM tArA yA vivaraNa deYa tA theke Urdhve|
tini asamAnasamUha o jaminera sraSTA| kIbhAve tA~ra santAna have athaca tA~ra kona saGginI nei! Ara tini savakichu sRSTi karechena evaM tini pratiTi jinisera vyApAre sarvajJa|
tinii AllAha, tomAdera rava| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tini pratiTi jinisera sraSTA| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ivAdAta kara| Ara tini pratiTi jinisera upara tattvAvadhAYaka|
cakSusamUha tAke AYatva karate pAre nA| Ara tini cakSusamUhake AYatva karena| Ara tini sUkSmadarzI, samyaka avahita|

nizcaYa tomAdera kAche cAkSuSa nidarzanAvalI eseche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke| ataeva ye cakSuSmAna have, tave se tAra nijera janyai have| Ara ye andha sAjave, tave tA tAra uparai (vartAve)| Ara Ami tomAdera upara saMrakSaka nai|
Ara ebhAvei Ami nAnAbhAve AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari evaM yAte tArA vale, tumi pATha karecha evaM Ami yAte varNanA kari, e kuraAna emana kaomera janya yArA jAne|
tumi anusaraNa kara tAra, tomAra prati yA ohI preraNa karA haYeche tomAra ravera pakSa theke| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| Ara muzarikadera theke tumi vimukha thAka|
Ara yadi AllAha cAitena, tArA zir‌ka karata nA evaM Ami tomAke tAdera upara hiphAyatakArI vAnAini| Ara tumi tAdera upara tattvAvadhAYaka nao|

Ara tomarA tAderake gAlamanda karo nA, AllAha chAr3A yAderake tArA DAke, phale tArA gAlamanda karave AllAhake, zatrutA poSaNa kare ajJatAvazata| ebhAvei Ami pratyeka ummatera janya tAdera karma zobhita kare diYechi| tArapara tAdera ravera kAche tAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara tini jAniYe devena tAderake, yA tArA karata|

Ara tArA AllAhara nAme kaThina kasama kareche, yadi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana Ase, tave tArA avazyai tAra prati ImAna Anave| vala, ‘samasta nidarzana to kevala AllAhara kAche| Ara kise tomAdera upalavdhi ghaTAve ye, yakhana tA ese yAve, tArA ImAna Anave nA?
Ara Ami tAdera antara o dRSTisamUha pAlaTe deva yemana tArA kuraAnera prati prathamavAra ImAna Aneni evaM Ami tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa ghurapAka khAoYA avasthAYa cher3e deva|

Ara yadi Ami tAdera nikaTa pherezatA nAyila karatAma evaM mRtarA tAdera sAthe kathA valata| Ara savakichu sarAsari tAdera sAmane samaveta karatAma, tAhaleo tArA ImAna Anata nA, yadi nA AllAha cAitena; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mUrkha|

Ara ebhAvei Ami pratyeka navIra zatru karechi mAnuSa o jinera madhya theke zaYatAnaderake, tArA pratAraNAra uddezye eke aparake cAkacikyapUrNa kathAra kumantraNA deYa evaM tomAra rava yadi cAitena, tave tArA tA karata nA| sutarAM tumi tAderake o tArA ye mithyA raTAYa, tA tyAga kara|

Ara kumantraNA e kAraNe ye, yArA AkhirAtera upara ImAna rAkhe nA tAdera antara yena era (cAkacikyapUrNa kathAra) prati AkRSTa haYa evaM yAte tArA tA pachanda kare, Ara tArA yA (ye pApa) arjana karache, tA yena arjana kare|

Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke vicAraka hiseve tAlAza karava? athaca tinii tomAdera nikaTa vistArita kitAva nAyila karechena| Ara yAderake Ami kitAva diYechilAma tArA jAnata ye, tA tomAra ravera pakSa theke yathAyathabhAve nAyilakRta| sutarAM tumi kakhano sandehakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
Ara tomAra ravera vANI satya o nyAYaparAYaNatAra dika theke paripUrNa haYeche| tA~ra vANIsamUhera kona parivartanakArI nei| Ara tinii sarvazrotA o sarvajJAnI|
Ara yadi tumi yArA yamIne Ache tAdera adhikAMzera Anugatya kara, tave tArA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| tArA zudhu dhAraNArai anusaraNa kare evaM tArA zudhu anumAnai kare|
nizcaYa tomAra rava adhika avagata tAra samparke, ye tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYa evaM tini adhika avagata hidAYAtaprAptadera samparke|
sutarAM tomarA AhAra kara tA theke, yAra upara AllAhara nAma neYA haYeche, yadi tomarA tA~ra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre vizvAsI hao|

Ara tomAdera kI hala ye tomarA tA theke AhAra karo nA, yAra upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYeche! athaca tini tomAdera janya vistArita varNanA karechena, yA tomAdera upara hArAma karechena| tave yAra prati tomarA vAdhya haYecha evaM nizcaYa aneke nA jene tAdera kheYAla-khuzi dvArA pathabhraSTa kare| nizcaYa tomAra rava sImAlaGghanakArIdera samparke adhika jJAta|
Ara tomarA prakAzya o gopana pApa tyAga kara| nizcaYa yArA pApa arjana kare, tAderake acirei pratidAna deYA have, tArA yA arjana kare tAra vinimaYe|

Ara tomarA tA theke AhAra karo nA, yAra upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYani evaM nizcaYa tA sImAlaGghana evaM zaYatAnarA tAdera vandhuderake prarocanA deYa, yAte tArA tomAdera sAthe vivAda kare| Ara yadi tomarA tAdera Anugatya kara, tave nizcaYa tomarA muzarika|

ye chila mRta, ataHpara Ami tAke jIvana diYechi evaM tAra janya nirdhAraNa karechi Alo, yAra mAdhyame se mAnuSera madhye cale, se ki tAra mata ye ghora andhakAre raYeche, yekhAna theke se vera hate pAre nA? ebhAvei kAphiradera janya tAdera kRtakarma suzobhita karA haYa|
Ara ebhAve Ami pratiTi janapade tAra aparAdhIdera sardAraderake cher3e diYechi, yAte tArA sekhAne cakrAnta kare| Ara tArA zudhu nijedera sAthei cakrAnta kare athaca tArA upalavdhi kare nA|

Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana Ase, tArA vale, AmarA kakhanai ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA AllAhara rAsUladerake yA deYA haYeche AmAderake tAra anurUpa deYA haYa| AllAha bhAlo jAnena, tini kothAYa tA~ra risAlAta arpaNa karavena| yArA aparAdha kareche, acirei tAderake AkrAnta karave AllAhara nikaTa lAJchanA o kaThora AyAva, kAraNa tArA cakrAnta karata|

sutarAM yAke AllAha hidAYAta karate cAna, isalAmera janya tAra vuka unmukta kare dena| Ara yAke bhraSTa karate cAna, tAra vuka saGkIrNa-saGkucita kare dena, yena se AsamAne ArohaNa karache| emanibhAve AllAha akalyANa dena tAdera upara, yArA ImAna Ane nA|
Ara e hacche tomAra ravera sarala patha| Ami to vistAritabhAve AYAtasamUha varNanA karechi emana kaomera janya, yArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa raYeche zAntira AvAsa evaM tArA ye Amala karata, tAra kAraNe tini tAdera abhibhAvaka|

Ara yedina AllAha tAdera savAike samaveta karavena| sedina valavena, ‘he jinera dala, mAnuSera anekake tomarA vibhrAnta karechile’ evaM mAnuSadera madhya theke tAdera abhibhAvakarA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA eke aparera dvArA lAbhavAna haYechi evaM AmarA se samaYe upanIta haYechi, yA Apani AmAdera janya nirdhAraNa kare diYechena’| tini valavena, ‘Aguna tomAdera ThikAnA, tomarA sekhAne sthAYI have| tave AllAha yA cAna (tA bhinna)’| nizcaYa tomAra rava prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Ara ebhAvei Ami yAlimadera katakake katakera vandhu vAniYe dei, tArA yA arjana karata se kAraNe|

‘he jina o mAnuSera dala, tomAdera madhya theke ki tomAdera nikaTa rAsUlagaNa Aseni, yArA tomAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha varNanA karata evaM tomAdera ei dinera sAkSAtera vyApAre tomAderake satarka karata?’ tArA valave, ‘AmarA AmAdera nijadera viruddhe sAkSya dilAma|’ Ara duniYAra jIvana tAderake pratArita kareche evaM tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye, tArA chila kAphira|
tA ei kAraNe ye, tomAra rava yulamera kAraNe janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa karena nA tAra adhivAsIrA gAphila thAkA avasthAYa |
Ara tArA yA kare, se anusAre pratyekera maryAdA raYeche evaM tomAra rava tArA yA kare se samparke gAphila nana|
Ara tomAra rava amukhApekSI, daYAlu| yadi tini cAna, tomAderake sariYe nevena evaM tomAdera pare yA icche sthalAbhiSikta karavena, yemana tini tomAderake anya kaomera vaMza theke sRSTi karechena|
nizcaYa tomAderake ye oYAdA deYA hacche, tA avazyai Asave evaM (e vyApAre tA~ke) tomarA akSama karate pArave nA|
vala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA tomAdera avasthAne theke kAja kara, nizcaYa Amio kAja karachi| acirei tomarA jAnate pArave kAra janya have AkhirAtera pariNati| nizcaYa yAlimarA saphala haYa nA|’

Ara AllAha ye zasya o catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechena, sekhAna theke tArA AllAhara janya ekaTi aMza nirdhAraNa kare| ataHpara tAdera dhAraNA anusAre tArA vale, ‘eTi AllAhara janya evaM eTi AmAdera zarIkadera janya|’ ataHpara yA tAdera zarIkadera janya, tA AllAhara nikaTa pau~che nA, Ara yA AllAhara janya tA tAdera zarIkadera nikaTa pau~che yAYa| tArA ye phaYasAlA kare, tA katai nA manda!

Ara ebhAve aneka muzarikera janya tAdera zarIkarA tAdera santAnaderake hatyA karA zobhita kareche, yAte tAderake dhvaMsa karate pAre evaM tAdera nikaTa tAdera dInake saMzaYapUrNa karate pAre| Ara AllAha yadi cAitena, tArA tA karata nA| sutarAM tArA ye mithyA vAnAYa, tA niYe tumi tAderake thAkate dAo|

Ara tArA tAdera dhAraNA anusAre vale, ‘ei catuSpada jantugulo o zasya niSiddha| AmarA yAke cAi, se chAr3A keu tA khAve nA’ evaM kichu catuSpada jantu, yAra piThe car3A hArAma karA haYeche, Ara kichu catuSpada jantu raYeche yAra upara tArA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare nA, AllAhara upara mithyA apavAdasvarUpa| tArA ye mithyA vAnAYa, tAra kAraNe tAderake acirei tini pratiphala devena|

Ara tArA vale, ‘ei catuSpada jantugulora peTe yA Ache, tA AmAdera puruSadera janya nirdiSTa evaM AmAdera strIdera janya hArAma| Ara yadi tA mRta haYa, tave tArA savAi tAte zarIka’| acirei tini tAderake tAdera kathAra pratidAna devena| nizcaYa tini prajJAvAna, jJAnI|

avazyai tArA kSatigrasta haYeche yArA tAdera santAnaderake nirvuddhitAvazata hatyA kareche nA jene evaM AllAhara upara mithyA apavAdasvarUpa AllAha tAderake ye riyka diYechena tA hArAma kareche| avazyai tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM tArA hidAYAtaprApta haYani|

Ara tinii sRSTi karechena emana vAgAnasamUha yAra kichu mAcAYa tolA haYa Ara kichu tolA haYa nA* evaM khejura gAcha o zasya, yAra svAda vibhinna rakama, yAYatuna o AnAra yAra kichu dekhate ekarakama, Ara kichu bhinna rakama| tomarA tAra phala theke AhAra kara, yakhana tA phaladAna kare evaM phala kATAra dinei tAra haka diYe dAo| Ara apacaYa karo nA| nizcaYai tini apacaYakArIderake bhAlavAsena nA| * معروشات era artha ai samasta latAgulma, yeguloke paricaryAra uddezye mAcAYa uThiYe deYA haYa| Ara غيرمعروشات era artha hacche ye gAcha mAcAYa uThAnora praYojana haYa nA; varaM svIYa kAnDera upara tA ver3e uThe|

Ara catuSpada jantu theke (kichuke sRSTi karechena) vojhA vahanakArI o kSudrAkRtira| tomarA AhAra kara tA theke, yA AllAha tomAderake riyka diYechena evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYa se tomAdera janya spaSTa zatru|

(tini sRSTi karechena) ATa prakArera jor3A| meSa theke du’Ti, chAgala theke du’Ti| vala, ‘nara du’Tike tini hArAma karechena nAki mAdi du’Tike? nAki tA, yA mAdi du’Tira peTe Ache? tomarA jene-zune AmAke jAnAo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka|’

Ara uTa theke du’Ti o gAbhI theke du’Ti| vala, ‘nara du’Tike tini hArAma karechena nAki mAdi du’Tike? nAki tA, yA mAdi du’Tira peTe Ache? athavA tomarA ki hAjira chile, yakhana AllAha tomAderake era nirdeza diYechilena?’ sutarAM tAra ceYe adhika yAlima ke, ye nA jene mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra janya AllAhara upara mithyA apavAda deYa? nizcaYa AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta karena nA|

vala, ‘AmAra nikaTa ye ohI pAThAno haYa, tAte Ami AhArakArIra upara kona hArAma pAi nA, yA se AhAra kare| tave yadi mRta kiMvA pravAhita rakta athavA zUkarera gozta haYa- kAraNa, nizcaYa tA apavitra kiMvA emana avaidha yA AllAha chAr3A anya kAro janya yaveha karA haYeche| tave ye vyakti nirupAYa haYe avAdhya o sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYe tA grahaNe vAdhya haYeche, tAhale nizcaYa tomAra rava kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara iYAhUdIdera upara Ami nakhaviziSTa sava jantu hArAma karechilAma evaM garu o chAgalera carvio tAdera upare hArAma karechilAma- tave yA egulora piThe o bhu~r3ite thAke, kiMvA yA kona hAr3era sAthe lege thAke, tA chAr3A| eTi tAderake pratiphala diYechilAma tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe| Ara nizcaYa Ami satyavAdI|
ataHpara yadi tArA tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tumi vala, tomAdera rava sarvavyApI daYAra adhikArI| Ara tAra AyAva aparAdhI kaoma theke pherAno haYa nA|

acirei muzarikarA valave, ‘AllAha yadi cAitena, AmarA ziraka karatAma nA evaM AmAdera pitRpuruSarAo nA evaM AmarA kona kichu hArAma karatAma nA’| ebhAvei tAdera pUrvavartIrA mithyAropa kareche, ye paryanta nA tArA AmAra AyAva AsvAdana kareche| vala, ‘tomAdera kAche ki kona jJAna Ache, yA tomarA AmAdera janya prakAza karave? tomarA to zudhu dhAraNAra anusaraNa karacha evaM tomarA to kevala anumAna karacha’|
vala, ‘cUr3Anta pramANa AllAharai| sutarAM yadi tini cAna, avazyai tomAdera savAike hidAYAta devena|’

vala, ‘tomAdera sAkSIderake niYe Asa, yArA sAkSya deve ye, AllAha eTi hArAma karechena’| ataeva yadi tArA sAkSya deYa, tave tumi tAdera sAthe sAkSya diYo nA| Ara tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA evaM yArA tAdera ravera samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare|

vala, ‘eso, tomAdera upara tomAdera rava yA hArAma karechena, tA tilAoYAta kari ye, tomarA tAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karave nA evaM mA-vAvAra prati ihasAna karave Ara dAridrera kAraNe tomAdera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA| Amii tomAderake riyka dei evaM tAderakeo| Ara azlIla kAjera nikaTavartI have nA- tA theke yA prakAza pAYa evaM yA gopana thAke| Ara vaidha kAraNa chAr3A tomarA sei prANake hatyA karo nA, AllAha yA hArAma karechena| egulo AllAha tomAderake nirdeza diYechena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

Ara tomarA iYAtImera sampadera nikaTavartI haYo nA, sundara panthA chAr3A| yatakSaNa nA se pariNata vaYase upanIta haYa, Ara parimApa o oyana inasAphera sAthe paripUrNa deve| Ami kAuke tAra sAdhya chAr3A dAYitva arpaNa kari nA| Ara yakhana tomarA kathA valave, takhana inasApha kara, yadio se AtmIYa haYa evaM AllAhara oYAdA pUrNa kara| egulo tini tomAderake nirdeza diYechena| yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

Ara eTi to AmAra sojA patha| sutarAM tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara evaM anyAnya patha anusaraNa karo nA, tAhale tA tomAderake tA~ra patha theke vicchinna kare deve| egulo tini tomAderake nirdeza diYechena, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara|

ataHpara Ami mUsAke pradAna karechi kitAva, ye satkarma kareche tAra janya paripUrNatAsvarUpa, pratiTi viSaYera vistArita vyAkhyA, hidAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa| yAte tArA tAdera ravera sAkSAtera vyApAre ImAna rAkhe|
Ara eTi kitAva- yA Ami nAyila karechi- varakatamaYa| sutarAM tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, yAte tomarA rahamataprApta hao|
yena tomarA nA vala ye, kitAva to nAyila karA haYechila AmAdera pUrvera du’Ti dalera upara evaM AmarA to tAdera adhyaYana samparke chilAma gAphela|

kiMvA yena nA vala ye, yadi AmAdera upara kitAva avatIrNa karA hata, tave avazyai AmarA tAdera ceYe adhika hidAYAtaprApta hatAma| vastuta tomAdera nikaTa eseche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa, hidAYAta o rahamata| sutarAM tAra ceYe adhika yAlima ke, ye AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM tA theke vimukha haYeche? acirei Ami tAderake manda AyAva deva, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha theke vimukha haYa, tAdera vimukha haoYAra kAraNe|

tArA ki erai apekSA karache ye, tAdera nikaTa pherezatAgaNa hAyira have, kiMvA tomAra rava upasthita have athavA prakAza pAve tomAra ravera nidarzanasamUhera kichu? yedina tomAra ravera nidarzanasamUhera kichu prakAza pAve, sedina kona vyaktirai tAra ImAna upakAre Asave nA, ye pUrve ImAna Aneni, kiMvA se tAra ImAne kona kalyANa arjana kareni| vala, ‘tomarA apekSA kara, AmarAo apekSA karachi’|

nizcaYa yArA tAdera dInake vicchinna kareche evaM dala-upadale vibhakta haYeche, tAdera kona vyApAre tomAra dAYitva nei| tAdera viSaYaTi to AllAhara nikaTa| ataHpara tArA yA karata, tini tAderake se viSaYe avagata karavena|
ye satkAja niYe eseche, tAra janya have tAra daza guNa| Ara ye asatkAja niYe eseche, tAke anurUpai pratidAna deYA have evaM tAderake yulama karA have nA|
vala, ‘nizcaYa AmAra rava AmAke sojA pathera hidAYAta diYechena| tA supratiSThita dIna, ivarAhImera Adarza, se chila ekaniSTha evaM se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA’|
vala, ‘nizcaYa AmAra sAlAta, AmAra kuravAnI, AmAra jIvana o AmAra mRtyu AllAhara janya, yini sakala sRSTira rava’|
‘tA~ra kona zarIka nei evaM AmAke erai nirdeza pradAna karA haYeche| Ara Ami musalamAnadera madhye prathama’|

vala, ‘Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya kona rava anusandhAna karava’ athaca tini sava kichura rava’? Ara pratiTi vyakti yA arjana kare, tA zudhu tArai upara vartAYa Ara kona bhAravahanakArI anyera bhAra vahana karave nA| ataHpara tomAdera ravera nikaTai tomAdera pratyAvartanasthala| sutarAM tini tomAderake sei saMvAda devena, yAte tomarA matavirodha karate|

Ara tini se sattA, yini tomAderake yamInera khalIphA vAniYechena evaM tomAdera katakake katakera upara maryAdA diYechena, yAte tini tomAderake yA pradAna karechena, tAte tomAderake parIkSA karena| nizcaYa tomAra rava druta zAstidAnakArI evaM nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-sAda|
eTi kitAva, yA tomAra prati nAyila karA haYeche| sutarAM tAra samparke tomAra mane yena kona saMkIrNatA nA thAke| yAte tumi tAra mAdhyame satarka karate pAra evaM tA muminadera janya upadeza|
tomAdera prati tomAdera ravera pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche, tA anusaraNa kara evaM tAke chAr3A anya abhibhAvakera anusaraNa karo nA| tomarA sAmAnyai upadeza grahaNa kara|
Ara emana vahu janavasati raYeche, yA Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi| vastuta sekhAne AmAra AyAva eseche rAte, kiMvA yakhana tArA dviprahare vizrAmarata chila|
sutarAM yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra AyAva eseche, takhana tAdera dAvI kevala ei chila ye, tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa AmarA yAlima chilAma’|
sutarAM Ami avazyai tAderake jijJAsAvAda karava yAdera nikaTa rAsUla prerita haYechila evaM avazyai Ami preritaderake jijJAsAvAda karava|
ataHpara avazyai Ami tAdera nikaTa jJAnera bhittite varNanA karava| Ara Ami to anupasthita chilAma nA|
Ara sedina parimApa have yathAyatha| sutarAM yAdera pAllA bhAri have tArAi have saphalakAma|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have, tArAi have sei sava loka, yArA nijaderake kSatigrasta kareche| kAraNa tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati (asvIkAra karAra mAdhyame) yulama karata|
Ara avazyai Ami to tomAderake yamIne pratiSThita karechi evaM tomAdera janya tAte rekhechi jIvanopakaraNa| tomarA alpai kRtajJa hao|

Ara avazyai Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi| tArapara tomAdera AkRti diYechi| tArapara pherezatAderake valechi, ‘tomarA Adamake sijadA kara’| ataHpara tArA sijadA kareche, ivalIsa chAr3A| se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta chila nA|

tini valalena, ‘kise tomAke vAdhA diYeche ye, sijadA karacha nA, yakhana Ami tomAke nirdeza diYechi’? se valala, ‘Ami tAra ceYe uttama| Apani AmAke Aguna theke sRSTi karechena, Ara tAke sRSTi karechena kAdAmATi theke’|
tini valalena, ‘sutarAM tumi ekhAna theke neme yAo| tomAra e adhikAra nei ye, ekhAne tumi ahaGkAra karave| sutarAM vera hao| nizcaYa tumi lAJchitadera antarbhukta’|
se valala, ‘sedina paryanta AmAke avakAza dina, yedina tAderake punarujjIvita karA have’|
tini valalena, ‘nizcaYa tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta’|
se valala, ‘Apani AmAke pathabhraSTa karechena, se kAraNe avazyai Ami tAdera janya ApanAra sojA pathe vase thAkava|
‘tArapara avazyai tAdera nikaTa upasthita hava, tAdera sAmane theke o tAdera pechana theke evaM tAdera DAna dika theke o tAdera vAma dika theke| Ara Apani tAdera adhikAMzake kRtajJa pAvena nA’|
tini valalena, ‘tumi ekhAna theke vera hao lAJchita vitAr3ita avasthAYa| avazyai tAdera madhya theke ye tomAra anusaraNa karave, Ami tomAdera savAike diYe jAhAnnAma bhare devai’|
‘Ara he Adama, tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vAsa kara| ataHpara tomarA AhAra kara yekhAna theke cAo evaM ei gAchaTira nikaTavartI haYo nA| tAhale tomarA ubhaYe yAlimadera antarbhukta have’|

ataHpara zaYatAna tAderake prarocanA dila, yAte se tAdera janya prakAza kare deYa tAdera lajjAsthAna, yA tAdera theke gopana karA haYechila evaM se valala, ‘tomAdera rava tomAderake kevala e janya e gAcha theke niSedha karechena ye, (khele) tomarA pherezatA haYe yAve athavA tomarA cirasthAYIdera antarbhukta haYe yAve’|
Ara se tAdera nikaTa zapatha karala ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera ubhaYera janya kalyANakAmIdera ekajana’|

ataHpara se tAderake pratAraNAra mAdhyame padaskhalita karala| tAi tArA yakhana gAchaTira phala AsvAdana karala, tAdera sAmane tAdera lajjAsthAna prakAzita haYe gela| Ara tArA jAnnAtera pAtA diYe nijaderake DhAkate lAgala evaM tAdera rava tAderake DAkalena ye, ‘Ami ki tomAderake ai gAchaTi theke niSedha karini evaM tomAderake valini ye nizcaYa zaYatAna tomAdera janya spaSTa zatru’?
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA nijadera upara yulama karechi| Ara yadi Apani AmAderake kSamA nA karena evaM AmAderake daYA nA karena tave avazyai AmarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hava’|
tini valalena, ‘tomarA neme yAo| tomarA eke aparera zatru evaM yamIne tomAdera janya kSaNasthAYI AvAsa o bhoga-upakaraNa raYeche’|
tini valalena, ‘tomarA tAte jIvana yApana karave evaM tAte mArA yAve| Ara tA theke tomAderake vera karA have’|

he vanI Adama, Ami to tomAdera janya pozAka avatIrNa karechi, yA tomAdera lajjAsthAna DhAkave evaM yA saundaryasvarUpa| Ara tAkaoYAra pozAka, tA uttama| egulo AllAhara AYAtasamUhera antarbhukta| yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

he vanI Adama, zaYatAna yena tomAderake vibhrAnta nA kare, yebhAve se tomAdera pitA-mAtAke jAnnAta theke vera karechila; se tAdera pozAka Tene nicchila, yAte se tAderake tAdera lajjAsthAna dekhAte pAre| nizcaYa se o tAra dalavala tomAderake dekhe yekhAne tomarA tAderake dekha nA| nizcaYa Ami zaYatAnaderake tAdera janya abhibhAvaka vAniYechi, yArA ImAna grahaNa kare nA|

Ara yakhana tArA kona azlIla kAja kare takhana vale, ‘AmarA ete AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake peYechi evaM AllAha AmAderake era nirdeza diYechena’| vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha azlIla kAjera nirdeza dena nA| tomarA ki AllAhara vyApAre emana kichu valacha, yA tomarA jAna nA’?
