vala, ‘AmAra rava nyAYavicArera nirdeza diYechena Ara tomarA pratyeka sijadAra samaYa tomAdera cehArA sojA rAkhave evaM tA~rai ivAdAtera janya ekaniSTha haYe tA~ke DAka’| yebhAve tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena, sebhAve tomarA prathame phire Asave|

eka dalake tini hidAYAta diYechena evaM Areka dalera upara pathabhraSTatA sAvyasta haYeche| nizcaYa tArA zaYatAnaderake AllAha chAr3A abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareche| Ara tArA mane kare ye, nizcaYa tArA hidAYAtaprApta|
he vanI Adama, tomarA prati sAlAte tomAdera veza-bhUSA grahaNa kara evaM khAo, pAna kara o apacaYa karo nA| nizcaYa tini apacaYakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

vala, ‘ke hArAma kareche AllAhara saundaryopakaraNa, yA tini tA~ra vAndAdera janya sRSTi karechena evaM pavitra riyka’? vala, ‘tA duniYAra jIvane muminadera janya, vizeSabhAve kiYAmata divase’| ebhAve Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari emana kaomera janya, yArA jAne|

vala,‘AmAra rava to hArAma karechena azlIla kAja- yA prakAza pAYa evaM yA gopana thAke, Ara pApa o anyAYabhAve sImAlaGghana evaM AllAhara sAthe tomAdera zarIka karA, ye vyApAre AllAha kona pramANa avatIrNa karenani evaM AllAhara uApare emana kichu valA yA tomarA jAna nA’|
Ara pratyeka jAtira raYeche ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa| ataHpara yakhana tAdera samaYa Asave, takhana tArA eka muhUrta vilamva karate pArave nA evaM egiYeo Anate pArave nA|

he vanI Adama, yadi tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera madhya theke rAsUlagaNa Ase yArA tomAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtasamUha varNanA karave, tave yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave evaM (Amala) saMzodhana karave, tAdera upara kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM tAra vyApAre ahaGkAra kareche, tArAi Agunera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne have sthAYI|

sutarAM tAra ceYe ke adhika yAlima, ye AllAhara upara mithyA apavAda raTAYa kiMvA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare| tAdera bhAgye likhita aMza tAdera kAche pau~chave| avazeSe yakhana AmAra pherezatArA tAdera nikaTa Asave tAdera jAna kavaja karate, takhana tArA valave, ‘kothAYa tArA, AllAha chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAkate’? tArA valave, ‘tArA AmAdera theke hAriYe giYeche’ evaM tArA nijadera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye, nizcaYa tArA chila kAphira |

tini valavena, ‘Agune praveza kara jina o mAnuSera dalagulora sAthe, yArA tomAdera pUrve gata haYeche’| yakhanai ekaTi dala praveza karave, takhana pUrvera dalake tArA lA‘nata karave| avazeSe yakhana tArA savAi tAte ekatrita have takhana tAdera paravartI dalaTi pUrvera dala samparke valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, erA AmAderake pathabhraSTa kareche| tAi Apani tAderake Agunera dviguNa AyAva dina’| tini valavena, ‘savAra janya dviguNa, kintu tomarA jAna nA’|
Ara tAdera pUrvavartI dala paravartI dalake valave, ‘tAhale AmAdera upara tomAdera kona zreSThatva nei| ataeva tomarA yA arjana karechile, tAra kAraNe tomarA AyAva AsvAdana kara’|

nizcaYa yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM tAra vyApAre ahaGkAra kareche, tAdera janya AsamAnera darajAsamUha kholA have nA evaM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave nA, yatakSaNa nA uTa sU~cera chidrate praveza kare|* Ara ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIderake pratidAna dei| * e dvArA tAdera jAnnAte praveza karA asambhava vujhAno haYeche|
tAdera janya thAkave jAhAnnAmera vichAnA evaM tAdera upare thAkave (Agunera) AcchAdana| Ara ebhAvei Ami yAlimaderake pratidAna dei|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche, Ami kona vyaktike tAra sAdhyera vAire dAYitva arpaNa kari nA| tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne have sthAYI|

Ara tAdera antare ye IrSA chila, Ami tA vera kare niYechi| tAdera nIca diYe naharasamUha pravAhita have| Ara tArA valave, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini era janya AmAderake hidAYAta diYechena| Ara AmarA hidAYAta pAoYAra chilAma nA, yadi nA AllAha AmAderake hidAYAta ditena| avazyai AmAra ravera rAsUlagaNa satya niYe esechena’ evaM tAderake DAkA have ye, ‘ai hala jAnnAta, tomarA yA Amala karecha, tAra vinimaYe tomAderake era oYArisa karA haYeche’|

Ara takhana jAnnAtavAsIrA jAhAnnAmavAsIderake (upahAsa kare) valaveH AmAdera rAvva yesava aGgIkAra o pratizruti AmAderake diYechilena, AmarA vAstave tA satya rUpe peYechi, tomarAo ki tomAdera rAvvera o‘YAdA satya o vAstava rUpe peYecho? takhana tArA valaveH hyA~ peYechi| ataHpara janaika ghoSaka ghoSaNA karave, yAlimadera upara AllAhara abhisampAta|
‘yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA pradAna karata evaM tAte vakratA sandhAna karata evaM tArA chila AkhirAtake asvIkArakArI’|

Ara tAdera madhye thAkave pardA evaM A‘rAphera* upara thAkave kichu loka, yArA pratyekake tAdera ci‎‎hna dvArA cinave| Ara tArA jAnnAtera adhivAsIderake DAkave ye,‘tomAdera upara sAlAma’| tArA (ekhano) tAte praveza kareni tave tArA AzA karave| * jAnnAta o jAhAnnAmera madhyavartI prAcIrake A‘rApha vale|
Ara yakhana tAdera dRSTike Agunera adhivAsIdera prati pherAno have, takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake yAlima kaomera antarbhukta karavena nA’|
Ara A‘rAphera adhivAsIrA emana lokaderake DAkave, yAderake tArA cinave tAdera ci‎‎hnara mAdhyame, tArA valave, ‘tomAdera dala evaM ye var3Ai tomarA karate tA tomAdera upakAre Aseni’|
erAi ki tArA yAdera vyApAre tomarA kasama karate ye, AllAha tAderake rahamate zAmila karavena nA? ‘tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara| tomAdera upara kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA duHkhita have nA’|

Ara Agunera adhivAsIrA jAnnAtera adhivAsIderake Deke valave, ‘AmAdera upara kichu pAni athavA tomAderake AllAha ye riyka diYechena, tA Dhele dAo’| tArA valave, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tA kAphiradera upara hArAma karechena’|

‘yArA tAdera dInake grahaNa kareche khelA o tAmAzArUpe evaM tAderake duniYAra jIvana pratArita kareche’| sutarAM Aja Ami tAderake (jAhAnnAme) cher3e rAkhava*, yemana tArA tAdera e dinera sAkSAtera janya kAja karA cher3e diYechila| Ara (yebhAve) tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata| * نسيان zavdaTi du’Ti arthe vyavahRta haYa| (1) bhule yAoYA-e arthaTi AllAhara janya saGgatipUrNa naYa| (2) cher3e deYA| ekhAne dvitIYa arthaTi neYA haYeche|
Ara Ami to tAdera nikaTa emana kitAva niYe esechi, yA Ami jJAnera bhittite vistArita varNanA karechi| tA hidAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa emana jAtira janya, yArA ImAna rAkhe|

tArA ki zudhu tAra pariNAmera apekSA karache? yedina tAra pariNAma prakAza have, takhana pUrve yArA tAke bhule chila, tArA valave, ‘AmAdera ravera rAsUlagaNa to satya niYe esechilena| sutarAM AmAdera janya ki supArizakArIdera keu Ache, ye AmAdera janya supAriza karave, kiMvA AmAdera pratyAvartana karAno have, tArapara AmarA yA karatAma tA bhinna anya Amala karava’? tArA to nijaderake kSatigrasta kareche evaM tArA ye mithyA raTAta, tA tAdera theke vilupta haYe giYeche|

nizcaYa tomAdera rava AsamAnasamUha o yamIna chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| ataHpara Araze uThechena| tini rAtake dvArA dinake Dheke dena| pratyekaTi eke aparake druta anusaraNa kare| Ara (sRSTi karechena) sUrya, cA~da o tArakArAjI, yA tA~ra nirdeze niYojita| jene rAkha, sRSTi o nirdeza tA~rai| AllAha mahAna, yini sakala sRSTira rava|
tomarA tomAdera ravake DAka anunaYa vinaYa kare o cupisAre| nizcaYa tini pachanda karena nA sImAlaGghanakArIderake|
Ara tomarA yamIne phAsAda karo nA tAra saMzodhanera para evaM tA~ke DAka bhaYa o AzA niYe| nizcaYa AllAhara rahamata satkarmazIladera nikaTavartI|

Ara tinii tA~ra rahamatera pUrve susaMvAdarUpe vAtAsa preraNa karena| avazeSe yakhana tA bhAri megha dhAraNa kare, takhana Ami tAke cAlAi mRta bhUmite, phale tAra dvArA pAni avatIrNa kari| ataHpara tAra mAdhyame vera kari pratyeka prakArera phala| ebhAvei Ami mRtaderake vera kari, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|
Ara uttama bhUmi- tAra phasala vera haYa tAra ravera anumatite| Ara yA nikRSTa, tAte to kamai utpanna haYa| ebhAvei Ami AYAtasamUha vibhinnabhAve varNanA kari emana kaomera janya, yArA kRtajJa haYa|

Ami to nUhake tAra kaomera nikaTa preraNa karechi| ataHpara se valeche, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei| nizcaYa Ami tomAdera mahAdinera AyAvera bhaYa karachi’|
tAra kaoma theke netRvarga valala, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAke spaSTa bhrAntite dekhate pAcchi’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, AmAra madhye kona bhrAnti nei; kintu Ami sakala sRSTira ravera pakSa theke rAsUla’|
‘Ami tomAdera nikaTa pau~chAcchi AmAra ravera risAlAtasamUha evaM tomAdera kalyANa kAmanA karachi| Ara Ami AllAhara kAcha theke emana kichu jAni, yA tomarA jAna nA’|

‘tomarA ki Azcarya haccho ye, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera madhya theke eka vyaktira nikaTa upadeza eseche, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare, Ara yAte tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM yAte tomarA rahamataprApta hao’?

ataHpara tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valala| phale Ami tAke o tAra sAthe naukAYa yArA chila tAderake rakSA karalAma; Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila tAderake Ami DuviYe dilAma| nizcaYa tArA chila andha kaoma|

Ara (preraNa karalAma) Ada jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi hUdake| se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei| tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
tAra kaomera kAphira netRvRnda valala, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAke nirvuddhitAYa dekhate pAcchi evaM AmarA avazyai tomAke mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta mane kari’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, AmAra madhye kona nirvuddhitA nei; kintu Ami sakala sRSTira ravera pakSa theke rAsUla’|
‘Ami tomAdera nikaTa AmAra ravera risAlAtasamUha pau~chAcchi, Ara Ami tomAdera janya kalyANakAmI vizvasta’|

‘tomarA ki Azcarya haccho ye, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera madhya theke eka vyaktira nikaTa upadeza eseche, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare? Ara tomarA smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAderake nUhera kaomera para sthalAbhiSikta karechilena evaM sRSTite tomAderake daihika gaThana o zaktite samRddha karechena| sutarAM tomarA smaraNa kara AllAhara niAmatasamUhake, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao’|

tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa ejanya esecha ye, AmarA eka AllAhara ivAdAta kari evaM tyAga kari AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa yAra ivAdAta karata? sutarAM tumi AmAderake ye oYAdA diccha, tA AmAdera kAche niYe eso, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao’|

se valala, ‘nizcaYa tomAdera upara tomAdera ravera pakSa theke AyAva o krodha patita haYeche| tomarA ki emana nAmasamUhera vyApAre AmAra sAthe vivAda karacha, yAra nAmakaraNa karecha tomarA o tomAdera pitRpuruSarA, yAra vyApAre AllAha kona pramANa nAyila karenani? sutarAM tomarA apekSA kara| Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi’|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra sAthe yArA chila, tAderake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dvArA rakSA karechi evaM tAdera mUla keTe diYechi, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila| Ara tArA mumina chila nA|

Ara sAmUdera nikaTa (preraNa karechi) tAdera bhAi sAlihake| se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei| nizcaYa tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa eseche| eTi AllAhara uSTrI, tomAdera janya nidarzanasvarUpa| sutarAM tomarA tAke cher3e dAo, se AllAhara yamIne AhAra karuka| Ara tomarA tAke manda dvArA sparza karo nA| tAhale tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva pAkar3Ao karave’|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ada jAtira para tini tomAderake sthalAbhiSikta karalena evaM tomAderake yamIne AvAsa dilena| tomarA tAra samatala bhUmite prAsAda nirmANa karacha evaM pAhAr3a keTe vAr3i vAnAccha| sutarAM tomarA AllAhara niAmatasamUhake smaraNa kara evaM yamIne phAsAdakArIrUpe ghure ver3iYo nA|

tAra kaomera ahaGkArI netRvRnda tAdera sei muminaderake valala yAderake durvala mane karA hata, ‘tomarA ki jAna ye, sAliha tAra ravera pakSa theke prerita’? tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa se yA niYe prerita haYeche, AmarA tAte vizvAsI’|
yArA ahaGkAra karechila tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa tomarA yAra prati ImAna enecha, AmarA tAra prati asvIkArakArI’|

ataHpara tArA uSTrIke yaveha karala evaM tAdera ravera Adeza amAnya karala| Ara tArA valala, ‘he sAliha, tumi AmAderake ye oYAdA diYecha, tA AmAdera kAche niYe eso, yadi tumi rAsUladera antarbhukta haYe thAka’|
phale tAderake bhUmikampa pAkar3Ao karala, tAi sakAle tArA tAdera gRhe upur3a haYe mare raila|

ataHpara se tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, Ami to tomAdera nikaTa AmAra ravera risAlAta pau~che diYechi evaM tomAdera janya kalyANa kAmanA karechi; kintu tomarA kalyANakAmIderake pachanda kara nA’|
Ara (preraNa karechi) lUtake| yakhana se tAra kaomake valala, ‘tomarA ki emana azlIla kAja karacha, yA tomAdera pUrve sRSTikulera keu kareni’?
‘tomarA to nArIdera chAr3A puruSadera sAthe kAmanA pUrNa karacha, varaM tomarA sImAlaGghanakArI kaoma’|
Ara tAra kaomera uttara kevala ei chila ye, tArA valala, ‘tAderake tomarA tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| nizcaYa tArA emana loka, yArA ati pavitra hate cAYa’|
tAi Ami tAke o tAra parivArake rakSA karalAma tAra strI chAr3A| se chila pechane theke yAoYA lokadera antarbhukta|
Ara Ami tAdera upara varSaNa karechilAma vRSTi| sutarAM dekha, aparAdhIdera pariNati kirUpa chila|

Ara mAdaiYAne (preraNa karechilAma) tAdera bhAi zu‘Aivake| se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei| tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa eseche| sutarAM tomarA parimANe o ojane paripUrNa dAo evaM mAnuSake tAdera paNye kama deve nA; Ara tomarA yamIne phAsAda karave nA tA saMzodhanera para| egulo tomAdera janya uttama yadi tomarA mumina hao’|

‘Ara yArA tA~ra prati ImAna eneche tAderake bhaYa dekhAte, AllAhara patha theke vAdhA dite evaM tAte vakratA anusandhAna karate tomarA pratiTi pathe vase theko nA’| Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA chile kama, ataHpara tini tomAderake adhika karechena evaM dekha, kirUpa haYeche phAsAdakArIdera pariNati|

Ami yA niYe prerita haYechi, tAra prati yadi tomAdera ekaTi dala ImAna Ane Ara anya dala ImAna nA Ane, tAhale dhairyadhAraNa kara, yatakSaNa nA AllAha AmAdera madhye phaYasAlA karena| Ara tini uttama phaYasAlAkArI|

tAra kaoma theke ye netRvRnda ahaGkAra karechila tArA valala, ‘he zu‘Aiva, AmarA tomAke o tomAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAderake avazyai AmAdera janapada theke vera kare deva athavA tomarA AmAdera dharme phire Asave|’ se valala, ‘yadio AmarA tA apachanda kari tavuo?’

AmarA to AllAhara prati mithyAropa karalAma yadi AmarA tomAdera dharme phire yAi- sei dharma theke AllAha AmAderake nAjAta deYAra para| Ara AmAdera janya ucita have nA tAte phire yAoYA| tave AmAdera rava AllAha cAile (seTA bhinna kathA)| AmAdera rava jJAna dvArA sava kichu parivyApta kare Achena| AllAharai upara AmarA tAoYAkkula kari| he AmAdera rava, AmAdera o AmAdera kaomera madhye yathArtha phaYasAlA kare dina| Ara Apani zreSTha phaYasAlAkArI|
Ara tAra kaoma theke ye netRvRnda kupharI karechila tArA valala, ‘yadi tomarA zu‘Aivake anusaraNa kara tAhale nizcaYa tomarA kSatigrasta have|’
ataHpara bhUmikampa tAdera pAkar3Ao karala| tArapara tArA tAdera gRhe upur3a haYe mare raila|
yArA zu‘Aivake mithyAvAdI valechila, mane haYa yena tArA sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| yArA zu‘Aivake mithyAvAdI valechila tArAi chila kSatigrasta|

ataHpara se tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, he AmAra kaoma, Ami to tomAdera kAche AmAra ravera risAlAtera dAYitva pau~che diYechi evaM tomAdera janya kalyANa kAmanA karechi| sutarAM Ami kIbhAve kAphira jAtira vyApAre duHkha karava!
ye janapadei Ami navI preraNa karechi, tAra adhivAsIke Ami artha-saMkaTa o duHkha-kaSTa dvArA pAkar3Ao karechi, yena tArA anunaYa vinaYa kare|

tArapara Ami manda avasthAke bhAla avasthA dvArA vadale diYechi| avazeSe tArA prAcurya lAbha kareche evaM valeche, ‘AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo durdazA o Ananda sparza kareche|’ ataHpara Ami tAderake haThAt pAkar3Ao karechi emanabhAve ye, tArA upalavdhio karate pAreni|

Ara yadi janapadasamUhera adhivAsIrA ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tAhale Ami avazyai AsamAna o yamIna theke varakatasamUha tAdera upara khule ditAma; kintu tArA asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA yA arjana karata tAra kAraNe Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma|
janapadagulora adhivAsIrA ki rAtera velA tAdera kAche AmAra AyAva ese yAoYA theke nirApada haYe giYeche yakhana tArA ghumiYe thAkave?
athavA janapadagulora adhivAsIrA ki dviprahare tAdera kAche AmAra AyAva ese yAoYA theke nirApada haYe giYeche yakhana tArA khelA-dhulA karate thAkave?
tArA ki AllAhara kauzala theke nirApada haYe giYeche? vastuta kSatigrasta kaoma chAr3A AllAhara kauzala theke Ara keu (nijaderake) nirApada mane kare nA|

yamInera adhivAsIdera (cale yAvAra) para yArA tAra uttarAdhikArI haYa, tAdera kAche ki e kathA pariSkAra haYani ye, Ami yadi cAi, tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake zAsti dite pAri? Ara Ami mohara mere dei tAdera hRdaYe| ataHpara tArA zone nA|

e hala se sava janapada, yAra kichu kAhinI Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi| Ara tAdera kAche to spaSTa pramANAdisaha tAdera rAsUlagaNa esechila| kintu yA tArA pUrve asvIkAra karechila tAra prati tArA ImAna AnAra chila nA| emanibhAve AllAha kAphiradera antare mohara mere dena|
Ara tAdera adhikAMza lokake Ami aGgIkAra rakSAkArI pAini| varaM tAdera adhikAMzake Ami phAsika-i peYechi|

ataHpara tAdera pare Ami mUsAke AmAra AYAtasamUha sahakAre phira‘Auna o tAra sabhAsadadera kAche pAThiYechi| ataHpara tArA era sAthe yulama kareche| sutarAM lakSya kara, phAsAdakArIdera pariNAma kIrUpa haYechila|
mUsA valala, ‘he phira‘Auna, Ami to sakala sRSTira ravera pakSa theke rAsUla|’
samIcIna ye, Ami AllAha samparke satya chAr3A valava nA| Ami tomAdera ravera nikaTa theke spaSTa pramANa niYe tomAdera kAche esechi| sutarAM tumi vanI isarAIlake AmAra sAthe pAThiYe dAo|’
se valala, ‘tumi yadi kona AYAta niYe Asa tave tA peza kara, yadi tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hao|’
takhana se cher3e dila tAra lAThi| tatkSaNAt tA eka spaSTa ajagara haYe gela|
Ara se vera karala tAra hAta, tatkSaNAt tA darzakadera kAche dhavadhave sAdA (dekhAcchila)|
phira‘Aunera kaomera sabhAsadarA valala, ‘nizcaYa e hala vijJa yAdukara|’
‘se tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera karate cAYa, sutarAM tomarA kI nirdeza deve?’
tArA valala, ‘Apani tAke o tAra bhAike suyoga dina evaM zaharagulote saMgrahakArI pAThiYe dina|’
‘tArA ApanAra kAche sakala vijJa yAdukarake niYe Asave|’
Ara yAdukararA phira‘Aunera kAche Asala| tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa AmAdera janya pArizramika Ache, yadi AmarA vijaYI hai?’
se valala, ‘hyA~, Ara avazyai tomarA AmAra ghaniSTha lokadera antarbhukta have|’
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, haYa tumi nikSepa karave, naYato AmarAi nikSepa karava|’
se valala, ‘tomarA nikSepa kara|’ ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana tArA lokadera cokhe yAdu karala evaM tAderake bhIta kare tulala| tArA var3a yAdu pradarzana karala|
Ara Ami mUsAra prati ohI pAThAlAma ye, ‘tumi tomAra lAThi cher3e dAo’ tatkSaNAt se gilate lAgala segulike ye alIka vastu tArA vAniYechila|
phale satya prakAza haYe gela evaM tArA yA kichu karachila tA vAtila haYe gela|
tAi sekhAne tArA parAjita hala evaM lAJchita haYe gela|
Ara yAdukararA sijadAYa par3e gela|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA sakala sRSTira ravera prati ImAna AnalAma,
mUsA o hArUnera ravera prati|’

phira‘Auna valala, ‘Ami tomAderake anumati deYAra Age tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale! nizcaYa eTA emana eka cakrAnta yA tomarA zahare karecha sekhAna theke tAra adhivAsIderake vera karAra janya| sutarAM tomarA acirei jAnate pArave|’
Ami avazyai tomAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke keTe deva| tArapara avazyai tomAdera savAike zUle car3Ava|’
tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa AmarA AmAdera ravera kAche pratyAvartana karava|

Ara tumi AmAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karacha zudhu e kAraNe ye, AmarA AmAdera ravera AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna enechi, yakhana tA AmAdera kAche eseche| he AmAdera rava, AmAderake paripUrNa dhairya dAna karuna evaM musalima hisAve AmAderake mRtyu dAna karuna|’

Ara phira‘Aunera kaomera sabhAsadagaNa valala, ‘Apani ki mUsA o tAra kaomake cher3e devena yAte tArA yamIne phAsAda kare evaM ApanAke o ApanAra upAsyaguloke varjana kare?’ se valala, ‘AmarA atisatvara tAdera chelederake hatyA karava Ara meYederake jIvita rAkhava| Ara nizcaYa AmarA tAdera upara kSamatAvAna|’

mUsA tAra kaomake valala, ‘AllAhara kAche sAhAyya cAo evaM dhairya dhAraNa kara| nizcaYa yamIna AllAhara| tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke tini cAna tAke tAra uttarAdhikArI vAniYe dena| Ara pariNAma muttAkIdera janya|’

tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAdera kAche AsAra pUrve AmAderake kaSTa deYA haYeche evaM tumi AmAdera kAche AsAra pareo|’ se valala, ‘AzA karA yAYa, tomAdera rava tomAdera zatruke dhvaMsa karavena evaM yamIne tomAderake sthalAbhiSikta karavena, ataHpara tini dekhavena tomarA kIbhAve Amala kara|’
Ara Ami pAkar3Ao karechi phira‘Aunera anusArIderake durbhikSa o phala- phalAdira kSaYa-kSatira mAdhyame, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche kalyANa Asata, takhana tArA valata, ‘eTA AmAdera janya|’ Ara yakhana tAdera kAche akalyANa pau~chata takhana tArA mUsA o tAra saGgIderake azubhalakSuNe mane karata| tAdera kalyANa-akalyANa to AllAhara kAche| kintu tAdera adhikAMza jAne nA|
Ara tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAderake yAdu karAra janya ye kona nidarzana AmAdera kAche niYe Asa nA kena AmarA to tomAra prati ImAna Anava nA|’
sutarAM Ami tAdera viruddhe vistArita nidarzanAvalI hisAve pAThAlAma tuphAna, paGgapAla, ukuna, vyAGa o rakta| tAra pareo tArA ahaGkAra karala| Ara tArA chila eka aparAdhI kaoma|

Ara yakhana tAdera upara AyAva patita hala takhana tArA valala, ‘he mUsA AmAdera janya tumi tomAra ravera kAche duA kara tini ye oYAdA tomAra sAthe karechena se anuyAYI| yadi tumi AmAdera upara theke AyAva sariYe dAo tAhale avazyai AmarA tomAra prati ImAna Anava evaM avazyai tomAra sAthe vanI isarAIlake pAThiYe deva|’
ataHpara yakhanai Ami tAdera theke AyAva sariYe nitAma kichu kAlera janya yA tAdera janya nirdhArita chila, takhanai tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga karata|
ataHpara Ami tAdera theke pratizodha nilAma, phale tAderake samudre DuviYe dilAma| kAraNa tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM e samparke tArA chila gAphela |

Ara ye jAtike durvala mane karA hata Ami tAderake yamInera pUrva o tAra pazcimera uttarAdhikArI vAnAlAma, yekhAne Ami varakata diYechi evaM vanI isarAIlera upara tomAra ravera uttama vANI paripUrNa hala| kAraNa tArA dhairya dhAraNa kareche| Ara dhvaMsa kare dilAma yA kichu tairi karechila phira‘Auna o tAra kaoma evaM tArA yA nirmANa karechila|

Ara vanI isarAIlake Ami samudra pAra kariYe dilAma| ataHpara tArA Asala emana eka kaomera kAche yArA nijadera mUrtigulora pUjAYa rata chila| tArA valala, ‘he mUsA, tAdera yemana upAsya Ache AmAdera janya temani upAsya nirdhAraNa kare dAo| se valala, ‘nizcaYa tomarA emana eka kaoma yArA mUrkha’|
nizcaYa erA yAte Ache, tA dhvaMsazIla evaM tArA yA karata tA vAtila|
se valala, ‘AllAha chAr3A Ami ki tomAdera janya anya ilAha sandhAna karava athaca tini tomAderake sakala sRSTira upara zreSThatva diYechena?’

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami phira‘Aunera lokadera theke tomAderake rakSA karalAma, yArA tomAdera nikRSTa zAsti dita| yArA tomAdera cheledera hatyA karata evaM nArIdera jIvita rAkhata| ete chila tomAdera ravera pakSa theke eka mahAparIkSA|

Ara smaraNa kara, ‘Ami mUsAke triza rAtera oYAdA diYechilAma evaM Aro daza dvArA tA pUrNa karechilAma| sutarAM tAra ravera nirdhArita meYAda cali¬za rAta pUrNa hala evaM mUsA tAra bhAi hArUnake valala, ‘AmAra kaomera madhye tumi AmAra pratinidhitva kara, saMzodhana kara evaM phAsAdakArIdera patha anusaraNa karo nA’|

Ara yakhana AmAra nirdhArita samaYe mUsA ese gela evaM tAra rava tAra sAthe kathA valalena| se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAke dekhA dina, Ami ApanAke dekhava|’ tini valalena, tumi AmAke kakhano dekhave nA| varaM tumi pAhAr3era dike tAkAo, ataHpara tA yadi nija sthAne sthira thAke tave tumi acirei AmAke dekhave| ataHpara yakhana tAra rava pAhAr3era upara nUra prakAza karalena takhana tA tAke cUrNa kare dila evaM mUsA vehu~za haYe par3e gela| ataHpara yakhana tAra hu~za Asala takhana se valala, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna, Ami ApanAra nikaTa tAovA karalAma evaM Ami muminadera madhye prathama|’

tini valalena, ‘he mUsA, Ami AmAra risAlAta o vAkyAlApa dvArA tomAke mAnuSera upara veche niYechi| sutarAM yA kichu Ami tomAke pradAna karalAma tA grahaNa kara evaM zokara AdAYakArIdera antarbhukta hao|’

Ara Ami tAra janya phalakasamUhe likhe diYechi pratyeka viSaYera upadeza evaM pratyeka viSaYera vistArita vyAkhyA| sutarAM tA zakta kare dhara evaM tomAra kaomake nirdeza dAo, yena tArA grahaNa kare era uttama viSaYagulo| Ami acirei tomAderake dekhAva phAsikadera AvAsa|

yArA anyAYabhAve yamIne ahaGkAra kare AmAra AYAtasamUha theke tAderake Ami avazyai phiriYe rAkhava| Ara tArA sakala AYAta dekhaleo tAte ImAna Anave nA evaM tArA saThika patha dekhaleo tAke patha hisAve grahaNa karave nA| Ara tArA bhrAnta patha dekhale tA patha hisAve grahaNa karave| eTA e janya ye, tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM se samparke tArA chila gAphela|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha o AkhirAtera sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche tAdera karmasamUha vinaSTa haYe geche| tArA yA kare tadanuyAYI tAdera pratidAna deYA have|

Ara mUsAra kaoma tAra (vera haoYAra) pare tAdera alaMkArAdi diYe vAniYe nila ekaTi go vAchura- deha, tAra chila garura AoYAya| tArA ki dekhala nA ye, eTA to tAdera sAthe kathA vale nA evaM tAdera patha dekhAYa nA? tArA tAke grahaNa karala evaM tArA chila yAlima|

Ara yakhana tArA anutapta hala evaM dekhala ye, tArA to pathabhraSTa haYeche, takhana tArA valala, ‘yadi AmAdera rava AmAdera prati rahama nA karena evaM AmAderake kSamA nA karena tave avazyai AmarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta hava’|

Ara mUsA yakhana nija kaomera kAche phire Asala rAgAnvita vikSuddha avasthAYa, takhana valala, ‘AmAra pare tomarA AmAra kata khArApa pratinidhitva karecha! tomAdera ravera nirdezera pUrve tomarA tAr3Ahur3A karale?’ Ara se phalakagulo phele dila evaM svIYa bhAiYera mAthA dhare nijera dike Tene Anate lAgala| se valala, ‘he AmAra mAYera putra, e jAti AmAke durvala mane kareche evaM AmAke hatyA karate udyata haYeche, tAi tumi AmAra vyApAre zatruderake Anandita karo nA evaM AmAke yAlima kaomera antarbhukta karo nA|
se valala, ‘AmAra rava, kSamA karuna AmAke o AmAra bhAike evaM ApanAra rahamate AmAdera praveza karAna| Ara Apanii rahamakArIdera madhye zreSTha|
nizcaYa yArA go vAchurake (upAsya hisAve) grahaNa kareche, duniYAra jIvane tAderake AkrAnta karave tAdera ravera pakSa theke gayava o lAJchanA| Ara ebhAve Ami mithyA raTanAkArIdera pratiphala dei|
Ara yArA khArApa kAja karala, tArapara tAovA karala evaM ImAna Anala, nizcaYa tomAra rava eraparao kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yakhana mUsAra krodha theme gela takhana se phalakagulo tule nila| tAra lekhAte chila hidAYAta o rahamata, tAdera janya yArA nijadera ravakei bhaYa kare|

Ara mUsA nija kaoma theke sattara jana lokake AmAra nirdhArita sthAnera janya nirvAcana karala| ataHpara yakhana bhUmikampa tAderake pAkar3Ao karala takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani cAile itaHpUrve edera dhvaMsa karate pAratena evaM AmAkeo| AmAdera madhye nirvodharA yA kareche tAra kAraNe ki AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena? eTAto ApanAra parIkSA chAr3A kichu nA| era mAdhyame yAke cAna Apani pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke cAna hidAYAta dAna karena| Apani AmAdera abhibhAvaka| sutarAM AmAdera kSamA kare dina evaM Apani uttama kSamAzIla|

Ara AmAdera janya e duniYAte o AkhirAte kalyANa likhe dina| nizcaYa AmarA ApanAra dike pratyAvartana karechi|’ tini valalena, ‘Ami yAke cAi tAke AmAra AyAva dei| Ara AmAra rahamata sava vastuke parivyApta kareche| sutarAM Ami tA likhe deva tAdera janya yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yAkAta pradAna kare| Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna Ane|

yArA anusaraNa kare rAsUlera, ye ummI navI; yAra guNAvalI tArA nijadera kAche tAorAta o iJjile likhita pAYa, ye tAderake sat kAjera Adeza deYa o vAraNa kare asat kAja theke evaM tAdera janya pavitra vastu hAlAla kare Ara apavitra vastu hArAma kare| Ara tAdera theke vojhA o zRMkhala- yA tAdera upare chila- apasAraNa kare| sutarAM yArA tAra prati ImAna Ane, tAke sammAna kare, tAke sAhAyya kare evaM tAra sAthe ye nUra nAyila karA haYeche tA anusaraNa kare tArAi saphalakAma|

vala, ‘he mAnuSa, Ami tomAdera savAra prati AllAhara rAsUla, yAra raYeche AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu dena| sutarAM tomarA AllAhara prati ImAna Ana o tA~ra prerita ummI navIra prati, ye AllAha o tA~ra vANIsamUhera prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara, AzA karA yAYa, tomarA hidAYAta lAbha karave|
mUsAra kaoma theke emana eka dala raYeche yArA saThikabhAve patha pradarzana kare evaM tA dvArA inasApha kare|

Ara Ami tAderake vibhakta karechi vAroTi jAti-gotre| Ami mUsAra kAche ohI pAThAlAma- yakhana tAra kaoma tAra kAche pAni cAila- ye, ‘tumi tomAra lAThi diYe pAthare AghAta kara’| phale e theke utsArita hala vAroTi jharNA| pratyeka gotra cine nila nijadera pAnasthAna| Ara Ami tAdera upara meghera chAYA diYechilAma evaM tAdera upara nAyila karechilAma mAnnA* o sAlaoYA** | ‘tomAderake ye riyika diYechi tA theke pavitra vastu AhAra kara’| Ara tArA AmAra prati yulama kareni, varaM tArA nijadera uparai yulama karata| * mAnnA’ eka dharaNera susvAdu khAvAra, yA zizirera mata gAchera pAtAYa o ghAsera upara jame thAkata| AllAha vizeSabhAve tA vanI isarAIlera janya preraNa karechilena|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tAderake valA hala, ‘tomarA e janapade* vasavAsa kara evaM yekhAne cAo sekhAna theke AhAra kara evaM vala ‘hittAha’** | Ara avanata mastake darajAYa praveza kara| Ami tomAdera aparAdhagulo kSamA kare deva| avazyai Ami satkarmazIladerake vAr3iYe deva|’ * vAitula mukAddAsa aJcala|
ataHpara tAdera madhya theke yArA yulama karechila, tAderake yA valA haYechila tAra parivarte tArA anya kathA valala| phale Ami AsamAna theke tAdera upara zAsti pAThAlAma, kAraNa tArA yulama karata|

Ara tAdera kAche jijJesa kara sAgarera nikaTe avasthita janapadaTi* samparke, yakhana tArA zanivAre sImAlaMghana karata| yakhana tAdera kAche zanivAre tAdera mAchagulo bhese Asata| Ara yedina tArA zanivAra yApana karata nA, sedina tAdera kAche Asata nA| ebhAve Ami tAderake parIkSA karatAma| kAraNa tArA pApAcAra karata| * lohita sAgara tIravartI ‘AYalA’ nAmaka janapada|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tAdera ekadala valala, ‘tomarA kena upadeza diccha emana kaomake, yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa karavena athavA kaThina AyAva devena’? tArA valala, ‘tomAdera ravera nikaTa oyara peza karAra uddezye| AzA karA yAYa tArA sAvadhAna have’|

ataHpara ye upadeza tAderake deYA haYechila, yakhana tArA tA bhule gela takhana Ami mukti dilAma tAderake yArA manda hate niSedha kare| Ara yArA yulama kareche tAderake kaThina AyAva dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma| kAraNa, tArA pApAcAra karata|
ataHpara yA theke tAderake niSedha karA haYechila tArA yakhana se viSaYe sImAlaGghana karala, takhana Ami tAderake valalAma, ‘tomarA nikRSTa vAnara haYe yAo’|

Ara yakhana tomAra rava ghoSaNA dilena, avazyai tini tAdera upara kiYAmatera dina paryanta emana lokaderake pAThAvena, yArA tAderake AsvAdana karAve nikRSTa AyAva| nizcaYa tomAra rava AyAva pradAne khuva druta evaM nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yamIne Ami tAderake vibhakta karechi vibhinna jAtite| tAdera keu nekakAra Ara keu anyarUpa evaM Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi bhAla o manda dvArA, haYato tArA phire Asave|

ataHpara tAdera pare sthalAbhiSikta haYeche emana vaMzadhara yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYeche, tArA e nagaNya (duniYAra) sAmagrI grahaNa kare evaM vale, ‘zIghrai AmAdera kSamA kare deYA have’| vastuta yadi tAra anurUpa sAmagrI (AvArao) tAdera nikaTa Ase tave tArA tA grahaNa karave| tAdera kAcha theke ki kitAvera aGgIkAra neYA haYani ye, tArA AllAhara vyApAre satya chAr3A valave nA? Ara tArA ete yA Ache, tA pATha kareche evaM AkhirAtera AvAsa tAdera janya uttama, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare| tomarA ki vujha nA?
Ara yArA kitAvake dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare, nizcaYa Ami satkarmazIladera pratidAna vinaSTa’ kari nA|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tAdera upara pAhAr3a tule dharalAma, yena tA ekakhanDa megha evaM tArA mane karala ye, nizcaYa tA tAdera upara par3ave| ‘Ami tomAdera yA diYechi, tA zaktabhAve dhara evaM tAte yA Ache tA smaraNa kara, yena tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAra|’

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava vanI-Adamera pRSThadeza hate tAdera vaMzadharake vera karalena evaM tAderake tAdera nijadera upara sAkSI karalena ye, ‘Ami ki tomAdera rava nai’? tArA valala, ‘hyA~, AmarA sAkSya dilAma|’ yAte kiYAmatera dina tomarA valate nA pAra ye, nizcaYa AmarA e viSaYe anavahita chilAma|

athavA tomarA yAte valate nA pAra, ‘AmAdera pitR-puruSarAi pUrve zirka kareche, Ara AmarA chilAma tAdera paravartI vaMzadhara| sutarAM vAtilapanthirA yA kareche, tAra kAraNe Apani ki AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena’?
Ara ebhAvei Ami AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA kari, yAte tArA phire Ase|

Ara tumi tAdera upara se vyaktira saMvAda pATha kara, yAke Ami AmAra AYAtasamUha diYechilAma| ataHpara se tA hate vicchinna haYe giYechila evaM zaYatAna tAra pechane legechila| phale se vipathagAmIdera antarbhukta haYe giYechila|

Ara Ami icchA karale ukta nidarzanAvalIra mAdhyame tAke avazyai ucca maryAdA ditAma, kintu se pRthivIra prati jhu~ke par3eche evaM nija pravRttira anusaraNa kareche| sutarAM tAra dRSTAnta hacche kukurera mata| yadi tAra upara vojhA cApiYe dAo tAhale se jihavA vera kare hA~pAve athavA yadi tAke cher3e dAo tAhaleo se jihavA vera kare hA~pAve| eTi hacche se kaomera dRSTAnta yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche| ataeva tumi kAhinI varNanA kara, yAte tArA cintA kare|
upamA hisAve khuvai manda se kaoma yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche evaM tArA nijadera pratii yulama karata|
yAke AllAha hidAYAta karena se-i hidAYAtaprApta Ara yAderake tini pathabhraSTa karena tArAi kSatigrasta|

Ara avazyai Ami sRSTi karechi jAhAnnAmera janya vahu jina o mAnuSake| tAdera raYeche antara, tA dvArA tArA vujhe nA; tAdera raYeche cokha, tA dvArA tArA dekhe nA evaM tAdera raYeche kAna, tA dvArA tArA zune nA| tArA catuSpada jantura mata; varaM tArA adhika pathabhraSTa| tArAi hacche gAphela|

Ara AllAhara janyai raYeche sundaratama nAmasamUha| sutarAM tomarA tA~ke sesava nAmei DAka| Ara tAderake varjana kara yArA tA~ra nAme vikRti ghaTAYa| tArA yA karata acirei tAderake tAra pratiphala deYA have|
Ara yAderake Ami sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye emana ekadala Ache yArA yathAyathabhAve patha dekhAYa evaM tadvArA inasApha kare|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, acirei Ami tAderake dhIre dhIre emanabhAve pAkar3Ao karava ye, tArA jAnateo pArave nA|
Ara Ami tAderake avakAza dicchi| nizcaYa AmAra kauzala zaktizAlI|
tArA ki cintA kareni ye, tAdera saGgIra madhye kona mastiSka vikRti nei; se to spaSTa satarkakArI|

tArA ki dRSTipAta kareni AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatve evaM AllAha yA kichu sRSTi karechena tAra prati? Ara (era prati ye) haYato tAdera nirdiSTa samaYa nikaTe ese giYeche? sutarAM tArA erapara Ara kon kathAra prati ImAna Anave?
AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra kona hidAYAtakArI nei evaM tini tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa cher3e dena, tArA dizehArA haYe ghure ver3AYa|

tArA tomAke kiYAmata samparke prazna kare, ‘tA kakhana ghaTave’? tumi vala, ‘era jJAna to raYeche AmAra ravera nikaTa| tinii era nirdhArita samaYe tA prakAza karavena| AsamAnasamUha o yamInera upara tA (kiYAmata) kaThina have| tA tomAdera nikaTa haThAt ese par3ave| tArA tomAke prazna karache yena tumi e samparke vizeSabhAve avahita| vala, ‘e viSaYera jJAna kevala AllAhara nikaTa Ache| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA’|

vala, ‘Ami AmAra nijera kona upakAra o kSatira kSamatA rAkhi nA, tave AllAha yA cAna| Ara Ami yadi gAYeva jAnatAma tAhale adhika kalyANa lAbha karatAma evaM AmAke kona kSati sparza karata nA| Amito ekajana satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA emana kaomera janya, yArA vizvAsa kare’|

tinii se sattA yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena eka vyakti theke evaM tAra theke vAniYechena tAra saGginIke, yAte se tAra nikaTa prazAnti lAbha kare| ataHpara yakhana se tAra saGginIra sAthe milita hala, takhana se hAlakA garbha dhAraNa karala evaM tA niYe calApherA karate thAkala| ataHpara yakhana se bhArI hala, takhana ubhaYe tAdera rava AllAhake DAkala, ‘yadi Apani AmAderake susantAna dAna karena tave avazyai AmarA kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava’|

ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake eka susantAna dAna karalena, takhana tAderake tini yA pradAna karechena se viSaYe tArA tA~ra vahu zarIka nirdhAraNa karala| vastuta tArA yAdera zarIka kare tAdera theke AllAha aneka Urdhve|
tArA ki emana kichuke zarIka kare, yArA kona kichu sRSTi kare nA, varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa?
Ara tArA tAderake kona sAhAyya karate pAre nA evaM tArA nijaderakeo sAhAyya karate pAre nA|
Ara tomarA yadi tAderake hidAYAtera dike AhavAna kara, tArA tomAdera anusaraNa karave nA| tomarA tAderake DAka athavA tomarA cupa thAka, tA tomAdera nikaTa samAna|
AllAha chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAka tArA tomAdera mata vAndA| sutarAM tomarA tAderake DAka| ataHpara tArA yena tomAdera DAke sAr3A deYa, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

tAdera ki pA Ache yAra sAhAyye tArA cale? vA tAdera ki hAta Ache yA dvArA tArA dhare? vA tAdera ki cakSu Ache yAra mAdhyame tArA dekhe? athavA tAdera ki kAna Ache yA dvArA tArA zune? vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera zarIkadera DAka| tArapara AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara evaM AmAke avakAza diYo nA’|
‘nizcaYa AmAra abhibhAvaka AllAha, yini kitAva nAyila karechena| Ara tini nekakAradera dekhAzonA karena’|
Ara tA~ke chAr3A tomarA yAderake DAka tArA tomAderake sAhAyya karate pAre nA evaM tArA nijaderakeo sAhAyya karate pAre nA|
tumi yadi tAderake hidAYAtera dike AhavAna kara, tArA zunave nA| Ara tumi tAderake dekhave ye, tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache, athaca tArA dekhache nA|
tumi kSamA pradarzana kara evaM bhAlo kAjera Adeza dAo| Ara mUrkhadera theke vimukha thAka|
Ara yadi zaYatAnera pakSa hate kona prarocanA tomAke prarocita kare, tave tumi AllAhara AzraYa cAo| nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
nizcaYa yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche yakhana tAderake zaYatAnera pakSa theke kona kumantraNA sparza kare takhana tArA AllAhake smaraNa kare| takhanai tAdera dRSTi khule yAYa|
Ara zaYatAnera bhAiYerA bhraSTatAYa tAderake sahayogitA kare| ataHpara tArA truTi kare nA|

Ara yakhana tumi tAdera nikaTa kona AYAta niYe nA Asa, takhana tArA vale, ‘tumi kena nijei tA vAniYe nAo nA?’ vala, ‘Amito tArai anusaraNa kari, yA AmAra kAche AmAra ravera pakSa theke ohIrUpe preraNa karA haYa| eTi tomAdera ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa| Ara tA hidAYAta o rahamata se kaomera janya yArA ImAna Ane’|
Ara yakhana kuraAna pATha karA haYa, takhana tA manoyoga diYe zona evaM cupa thAka, yAte tomarA rahamata lAbha kara|
Ara tumi nija mane Apana ravake smaraNa kara sakAla-sandhyAYa anunaYa-vinaYa o bhIti sahakAre evaM anucca svare| Ara gApheladera antarbhukta haYo nA|
nizcaYa yArA tomAra ravera nikaTa Ache tArA tA~ra ivAdAtera vyApAre ahaGkAra kare nA evaM tAra tAsavIha pATha kare, Ara tA~ra janyai sijadA kare|[sAjadAha]

lokerA tomAke ganImatera mAla samparke jijJAsA kare; vala, ganImatera mAla AllAha o rAsUlera janya| sutarAM tomarA AllAh‌ke bhaYa kara evaM parasparera madhyakAra avasthA saMzodhana kare nAo| Ara AllAh‌ o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yadi tomarA mumina hao|

mumina to tArA, yAdera antarasamUha ke~pe uThe yakhana AllAhake smaraNa karA haYa| Ara yakhana tAdera upara tA~ra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare evaM yArA tAdera ravera uparai bharasA kare|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi, tA hate vyaYa kare|
tArAi prakRta mumina| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera ravera nikaTa ucca maryAdAsamUha evaM kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|
(eTA emana) yebhAve tomAra rava tomAke nija ghara theke vera karechena yathAyathabhAve evaM nizcaYa muminadera ekaTi dala tA apachanda karachila|
tArA tomAra sAthe satya samparke vitarka karache tA spaSTa haYe yAoYAra para| yena tAderake mRtyura dike hA~kiYe neYA hacche, Ara tArA tA dekhache|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha tomAderake du’dalera ekaTira oYAdA diYechilena ye, nizcaYa tA tomAdera janya have| Ara tomarA kAmanA karachile ye, astrahIna dalaTi tomAdera janya have evaM AllAha cAcchilena tA~ra kAlemAsamUha dvArA satyake satya pramANa karavena evaM kApheradera mUla keTe devena|
yAte tini satyake satya pramANita karena evaM vAtilake vAtila karena, yadio aparAdhIrA tA apachanda kare|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA tomAdera ravera nikaTa phariYAda karachile, takhana tini tomAdera DAke sAr3A diYechilena ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAderake para para AgamanakArI eka hAjAra pherezatA dvArA sAhAyya karachi’|
Ara AllAha to tA karechena kevala susaMvAdasvarUpa evaM yAte era dvArA tomAdera antarasamUha prazAnta haYa evaM sAhAyya to AllAhara pakSa thekei| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAderake tandrAYa Acchanna karena tA~ra pakSa theke nirApattAsvarUpa evaM AkAza theke tomAdera upara vRSTi varSaNa karena, Ara yAte era mAdhyame tini tomAderake pavitra karena, Ara tomAdera theke zaYatAnera kumantraNA dUra karena, tomAdera antarasamUha dRr3ha rAkhena evaM era mAdhyame tomAdera pA-samUha sthira rAkhena|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAdera prati ohI preraNa karena ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera sAthe Achi| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche tomarA tAderake anar3a rAkha’| acirei Ami bhIti Dhele deva tAdera hRdaYe yArA kupharI kareche| ataeva tomarA AghAta kara ghAr3era upare evaM AghAta kara tAdera pratyeka AGulera agrabhAge|
eTi e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kareche| Ara ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA karave, tave nizcaYa AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|
eTi AyAva, sutarAM tomarA tA AsvAdana kara| Ara nizcaYa kAphiradera janya raYeche Agunera AyAva|
he muminagaNa, tomarA yakhana kAphiradera mukhomukhi have vizAla vAhinI niYe, takhana tAdera theke pRSTha pradarzana karo nA|

Ara ye vyakti sedina tAderake pRSTha pradarzana karave tAhale se AllAhara gayava niYe phire Asave| tave yuddhera janya (kauzalagata) dika parivartana athavA nija dale AzraYa grahaNera janya hale bhinna kathA evaM tAra AvAsa jAhAnnAma| Ara seTi katainA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|

sutarAM tomarA tAderake hatyA karani varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena| Ara tumi nikSepa karani yakhana tumi nikSepa karechile; varaM AllAhai nikSepa karechena* evaM yAte tini tA~ra pakSa theke muminaderake parIkSA karena uttama parIkSA| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa| * vadara yuddhera dina rAsUlullAha sAllallAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma ekamuSTi mATi niYe muzarikadera uddezye nikSepa karechilena, se dhUlikaNA tAdera pratyekerai cokhe, mukhe o nAke giYe pau~chechila| yAra phale tArA digvidika jJAna-zUnya haYe chuTAchuTi kare| ai samaYei tAdera aneke nihata Ara aneke vandI haYa evaM parAjaYa varaNa kare| --tAphasIre phAtahula kAdIra o tAisIrula kArImira rahamAna|
ei (hala ghaTanA) evaM nizcaYa AllAha kAphiradera Sar3ayantra durvala kare dena|

yadi tomarA vijaYa kAmanA kare thAka, tAhale to tomAdera nikaTa vijaYa ese giYeche| Ara yadi tomarA virata hao, tAhale seTi tomAdera janya kalyANakara| Ara yadi tomarA punarAYa kara, tAhale Amio punarAYa karava evaM tomAdera dala kakhano tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA yadio tA adhika haYa| Ara nizcaYa AllAha muminadera sAthe Achena|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM tAra theke mukha phiriYe nio nA, athaca tomarA zunacha|
Ara tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA vale AmarA zunechi athaca tArA zune nA|
nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa nikRSTatama vicaraNazIla prANI hacche vadhira, vovA, yArA vujhe nA|
Ara AllAha yadi tAdera madhye kona kalyANa jAnatena tAhale avazyai tAderake zunAtena| Ara yadi zunAtena tAhaleo tArA mukha phiriYe nita, ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA upekSAkArI|

he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAha o rAsUlera DAke sAr3A dAo; yakhana se tomAderake AhavAna kare tAra prati, yA tomAderake jIvana dAna kare| jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSa o tAra hRdaYera mAjhe antarAYa hana| Ara nizcaYa tA~ra nikaTa tomAderake samaveta karA have|

Ara tomarA bhaYa kara phitanAke* yA tomAdera madhya theke vizeSabhAve zudhu yAlimadera uparai Apatita have nA| Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha AyAva pradAne kaThora| * phitanA (فتنة)ekaTi vyApaka arthavodhaka zavda; yA vipada, kaSTa, parIkSA, gayava, AyAva, dAGgA, golayoga, sammohana, AkarSaNa, zirka, kuphara, niryAtana ityAdi arthe vyavahRta haYa|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA chile alpa, tomAderake durvala mane karA hata yamIne| tomarA AzaGkA karate ye, lokerA tomAderake cho~ mere tule niYe yAve| ataHpara tini tomAderake AzraYa diYechena, nija sAhAyya dvArA tomAderake zaktizAlI karechena evaM tomAderake pavitra riyka dAna karechena| yAte tomarA zukariYA AdAYa kara|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAha o rAsUlera khiYAnata karo nA| Ara khiYAnata karo nA nijadera AmAnatasamUhera, athaca tomarA jAna|
Ara jene rAkha, tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati to phitanA| Ara nizcaYa AllAha, tA~ra nikaTa Ache mahA puraskAra|

he muminagaNa, yadi tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara tAhale tini tomAdera janya phurakAna* pradAna karavena, tomAdera theke tomAdera pApasamUha dUra karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahazIla| * arthAt tini tomAdera madhye Antarika dRr3hatA, vicakSaNa kSamatA o sundara hidAYAta sRSTi kare devena yAra mAdhyame tomarA haka o vAtilera pArthakya karate pArave| (yuvadAtuta-tAphasIra)

Ara yakhana kAphirarA tomAke niYe Sar3ayantra karachila, tomAke vandI karate athavA tomAke hatyA karate kiMvA tomAke vera kare dite| Ara tArA Sar3ayantra kare evaM AllAhao Sar3ayantra karena| Ara AllAha hacchena Sar3ayantrakArIdera madhye uttama|
Ara tAdera upara yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tArA vale, zunalAma to| yadi AmarA cAi, tAhale era anurUpa AmarAo valate pAri| eto pitR-puruSadera kalpa-kAhinI chAr3A kichu nA|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tArA valechila, ‘he AllAha, yadi eTi satya haYa ApanAra pakSa theke tAhale AmAdera upara AkAza theke pAthara varSaNa karuna athavA AmAdera upara anya kona yantraNAdAYaka AyAva niYe Asuna’|
Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tAderake AyAva devena e avasthAYa ye, tumi tAdera mAjhe vidyamAna evaM AllAha tAderake AyAva dAnakArI nana ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA kSamA prArthanA karache|

Ara tAdera kI Ache ye, AllAha tAderake AyAva devena nA? athaca tArA masajidula hArAma theke vAdhA pradAna kare, Ara tArA era abhibhAvakao naYa| tAra abhibhAvaka to zudhu muttAkIgaNa; kintu tAdera adhikAMza jAne nA|
Ara kA‘vAra nikaTa tAdera sAlAta ziSa o hAta-tAli chAr3A kichu chila nA| sutarAM tomarA AsvAdana kara AyAva| kAraNa tomarA kupharI karate|

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche, tArA nijadera sampadasamUha vyaYa kare, AllAhara rAstA hate vAdhA pradAna karAra uddezye| tArA to tA vyaYa karave| ataHpara eTi tAdera upara AkSepera kAraNa have erapara tArA parAjita have| Ara yArA kupharI kareche tAderake jAhAnnAme samaveta karA have|
yAte AllAha pRthaka karena mandake bhAla hate Ara mandera katakake katakera upara rAkhavena evaM seguloke ekasAthe stUpa karavena| erapara tA jAhAnnAme nikSepa karavena| tArAi to kSatigrasta|

yArA kupharI kareche tumi tAderake vala, yadi tArA virata haYa tAhale atIte yA haYeche tAderake tA kSamA karA have| Ara yadi tArA punarAYa kare tAhale pUrvavartIdera (vyApAre AllAhara) rIti to gata haYeche|

Ara tomarA tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kara yatakSaNa nA phitanAra avasAna haYa evaM dIna pUrNarUpe AllAhara janya haYe yAYa| tave yadi tArA virata haYa tAhale nizcaYa AllAha tArA yA kare se viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
Ara yadi tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare, tAhale jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera abhibhAvaka| tini katainA uttama abhibhAvaka evaM katainA uttama sAhAyyakArI|

Ara tomarA jene rAkha, tomarA yA kichu ganImatarUpe peYecha, nizcaYa AllAhara janyai tAra eka paJcamAMza o rAsUlera janya, nikaTa AtmIYa, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphirera janya, yadi tomarA ImAna ene thAka AllAhara prati evaM haka o vAtilera phaYasAlAra dina Ami AmAra vAndAra upara yA nAyila karechi tAra prati, yedina* du’Ti dala mukhomukhi haYeche, Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna| * arthAt vadara yuddhera dina|

yakhana tomarA chile nikaTavartI prAntare, Ara tArA chila dUravartI prAntare evaM kAphelA* chila tomAdera ceYe nimnabhUmite, Ara yadi tomarA paraspara oYAdAvaddha hate, (yuddhe mukhomukhi haoYAra vyApAre) tAhale avazyai se oYAdAra kSetre tomarA matavirodha karate, kintu AllAha (tAderake ekatra karechena) yAte sampanna karena emana kAja yA haoYArai chila, ye dhvaMsa haoYAra se yAte suspaSTa pramANa pAoYAra para dhvaMsa haYa, Ara ye jIvita thAkAra se yAte suspaSTa pramANa pAoYAra para ve~ce thAke, Ara nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa| * kurAiza kAphelA|

yakhana AllAha tomAke svapnera madhye tAderake svalpa saMkhyAYa dekhiYechilena| Ara tomAke yadi tini tAderake vezi saMkhyAYa dekhAtena, tAhale avazyai tomarA sAhasahArA haYe par3ate evaM viSaYaTi niYe vitarka karate| kintu AllAha nirApattA diYechena| nizcaYa antare yA Ache tini se sava viSaYe avagata|

Ara yakhana tomarA mukhomukhi haYechile, tini tomAdera cokhe tAderake svalpa dekhiYechilena evaM tAdera cokheo tomAderake svalpa dekhiYechilena yAte AllAha sampanna karena emana kAja yA haoYArai chila evaM AllAhara dikei sakala viSaYa pherAno have|
he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA kona dalera mukhomukhi hao, takhana avicala thAka, Ara AllAhake adhika smaraNa kara, yAte tomarA saphala hao|

Ara tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM paraspara jhagar3A karo nA, tAhale tomarA sAhasahArA haYe yAve evaM tomAdera zakti niHzeSa haYe yAve| Ara tomarA dhairya dhara, nizcaYa AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|
Ara tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA tAdera ghara theke ahaGkAra o loka dekhAnora uddezye vera haYeche evaM AllAhara rAstAYa vAdhA pradAna kare, Ara tArA yA kare, AllAha tA pariveSTana kare Achena|

Ara yakhana zaYatAna tAdera janya tAdera AmalasamUha suzobhita karala evaM valala, ‘Aja mAnuSera madhya theke tomAdera upara kona vijaYI nei evaM nizcaYa Ami tomAdera pArzve avasthAnakArI’| ataHpara yakhana du’dala eke aparake dekhala, takhana se pichu haTala evaM valala, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera theke mukta, nizcaYa Ami emana kichu dekhachi, yA tomarA dekhacha nA| avazyai Ami AllAhake bhaYa kari evaM AllAha kaThina AyAvadAtA’|
yakhana munAphikarA o yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche tArA valachila, ‘ederake edera dharma dhokAYa pheleche’ evaM ye AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kare tave to AllAha nizcaYa parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|
Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana pherezatArA kAphiradera prANa haraNa karachila, tAdera cehArAYa o pazcAte AghAta kare, Ara (valachila) ‘tomarA jvalanta Agunera AyAva AsvAdana kara’|
tomAdera hAta Age yA preraNa kareche se kAraNe e pariNAma| Ara nizcaYa AllAha vAndAdera prati yulamakArI nana|

phiraAuna vaMza o tAdera pUrvera lokadera AcaraNera mata tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche, phale tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechena| nizcaYa AllAha zaktizAlI, kaThina AyAvadAtA|
tA e janya ye, AllAha kona niAmatera parivartanakArI nana, yA tini kona kaomake diYechena, yatakSaNa nA tArA parivartana kare tAdera nijadera madhye yA Ache| Ara nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

phiraAuna vaMza o tAdera pUrvera lokadera AcaraNera mata tArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche, phale Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechi tAdera pApera kAraNe evaM phiraAuna vaMzake DuviYechi, Ara tArA sakalei chila yAlima|
nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa savaceYe nikRSTa prANI tArA, yArA kupharI kare, ataHpara ImAna Ane nA|
yAdera theke tumi aGgIkAra niYecha, ataHpara tArA prativAra tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGga kare evaM tArA bhaYa kare nA|
sutarAM yadi tumi yuddhe tAderake nAgAle pAo, tAhale edera mAdhyame edera pechane yArA raYeche tAderake chatrabhaGga kare dAo, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|
Ara yadi tumi kona kaoma theke nizcitabhAve vizvAsaghAtakatAra AzaGkA kara, tAhale (tAdera cukti) tAdera dike sojA nikSepa kara, nizcaYa AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera pachanda karena nA|
Ara kAphirarA yena kakhanao mane nA kare ye, tArA (AyAvera) nAgAlera vAire cale giYeche, nizcaYa tArA (AllAhake AyAva pradAne) akSama karate pAre nA|

Ara tAdera mukAvilAra janya tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI zakti o azva vAhinI prastuta kara, tA dvArA tomarA bhaYa dekhAve AllAhara zatru o tomAdera zatruderake evaM erA chAr3A anyaderakeo, yAderake tomarA jAna nA, AllAha tAderake jAnena| Ara tomarA yA AllAhara rAstAYa kharaca kara, tA tomAderake paripUrNa deYA have, Ara tomAderake yulama karA have nA|
Ara yadi tArA sandhira prati jhu~ke par3e, tAhale tumio tAra prati jhu~ke par3a, Ara AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kara, nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Ara yadi tArA tomAke dho~kA dite cAYa, tAhale tomAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tinii tomAke zaktizAlI karechena tA~ra sAhAyya o muminadera dvArA|

Ara tini tAdera antarasamUhe prIti sthApana karechena| yadi tumi yamIne yA Ache, tAra savakichu vyaYa karate, tavuo tAdera antarasamUhe prIti sthApana karate pArate nA| kintu AllAha tAdera madhye prIti sthApana karechena, nizcaYa tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|
he navI, tomAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa evaM yesava mumina tomAra anusaraNa kareche tAdera janyao|

he navI, tumi muminaderake lar3AiYe utsAha dAo, yadi tomAdera madhya theke vizajana dhairyazIla thAke, tArA du’za janake parAsta karave, Ara yadi tomAdera madhye ekaza’ jana thAke, tArA kAphiradera eka hAjAra janake parAsta karave| kAraNa, tArA (kAphirarA) emana kaoma yArA vujhe nA|

ekhana AllAha tomAdera theke (dAYitvabhAra) hAlakA kare diYechena evaM tini jAnena tomAdera madhye durvalatA raYeche| ataeva yadi tomAdera madhye ekaza’ jana dhairyazIla thAke, tArA du’za janake parAsta karave evaM yadi tomAdera madhye eka hAjAra jana thAke, tArA AllAhara hukume du’hAjAra janake parAsta karave evaM AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe Achena|

kona navIra janya saGgata naYa ye, tAra nikaTa yuddhavandi thAkave (evaM paNera vinimaYe tini tAderake mukta karavena) yatakSaNa nA tini yamIne (tAdera) rakta pravAhita karena| tomarA duniYAra sampada kAmanA karacha, athaca AllAha cAcchena AkhirAta| Ara AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|
AllAhara likhana ativAhita nA haYe thAkale, avazyai tomarA yA grahaNa karecha, se viSaYe tomAderake mahA AyAva sparza karata|
ataeva tomarA ye ganImata peYecha, tA theke hAlAla pavitra hiseve khAo, Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he navI, tomAdera hAte ye sava yuddhavandi Ache, tAderake vala, ‘yadi AllAha tomAdera antarasamUhe kona kalyANa Ache vale jAnena, tAhale tomAdera theke yA neYA haYeche, tAra ceYe uttama kichu devena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena, Ara AllAh kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

Ara yadi tArA tomAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karAra icchA kare, tAhale tArA to pUrve AllAhara sAtheo vizvAsaghAtakatA kareche| ataHpara tini tAdera upara (tomAke) zaktizAlI karechena| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAvAna|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM nijadera mAla o jAna diYe AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kareche Ara yArA AzraYa diYeche o sahAYatA kareche, tArA eke aparera vandhu| Ara yArA ImAna eneche, kintu hijarata kareni, tAderake sAhAyyera kona dAYitva tomAdera nei, yatakSaNa nA tArA hijarata kare| Ara yadi tArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera nikaTa kona sahayogitA cAYa, tAhale sAhAyya karA tomAdera kartavya| tave emana kaomera viruddhe naYa, yAdera sAthe tomAdera eke aparera cukti raYeche evaM tomarA ye Amala kara, tAra vyApAre AllAha pUrNa dRSTimAna|
Ara yArA kupharI kare, tArA eke aparera vandhu| yadi tomarA tA nA kara, tAhale yamIne phitanA o var3a phAsAda have|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche evaM yArA AzraYa diYeche o sAhAyya kareche, tArAi prakRta mumina, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|

Ara yArA pare ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM tomAdera sAthe jihAda kareche, tArA tomAdera antarbhukta, Ara AtmIYa-svajanarA eke aparera tulanAYa agragaNya, AllAhara kitAve| nizcaYa AllAha pratiTi viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke samparkacchedera ghoSaNA se sava lokera prati muzarikadera madhya theke yAdera sAthe tomarA cuktivaddha haYechile| *sAdhAraNa niYama anusAre anya sUrA hate pRthaka karAra janya sUrAra prathame ‘visamillAha’ lipivaddha karAra kathA| kintu ei sUrAYa rAsUla sAllAllAhu ‘AlAihi oYA sAllAma uhA likhenani evaM ei sUrA kon sUrAra aMza tAo valenani| sutarAM mAsahApha-i usamAnIteo (tRtIYa khalIphA usamAna (rAH) kartRka prakAzita kuraAna) era prarAmbhe ‘visamillAha’ likhA haYani| sUrA AnaphAlera pUrve avatIrNa haoYAYa uhA era pUrve sanniviSTa haYeche| sUrATi AnaphAlera sAthe paThita hale era pUrve ‘visamillAha’ pATha karate haYanA, anyathAYa pATha karate haYa| sUrATira Ara ekaTi nAma ‘vArAA’| (isalAmika phAunDezana, vAMlAdeza kartRka prakAzita tarajamA kuraAnula kArIma draSTavya)
sutarAM tomarA yamIne vicaraNa kara cAra mAsa, Ara jene rAkha, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA, Ara nizcaYa AllAha kAphiraderake apadasthakArI|

Ara mahAna hajjera dina* mAnuSera prati AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke ghoSaNA, nizcaYa AllAha muzarikadera theke dAYamukta evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| ataeva, yadi tomarA tAovA kara, tAhale tA tomAdera janya uttama| Ara yadi tomarA phire yAo, tAhale jene rAkha, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA| Ara yArA kupharI kareche, tAdera tumi yantraNAdAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda dAo| * arthAt yilahajjera 10 tArikha kuravAnIra dina|

tave muzarikadera madhya theke yAdera sAthe tomarA cuktivaddha haYecha, ataHpara tArA tomAdera sAthe kona truTi kareni evaM tomAdera viruddhe kAuke sAhAyya kareni, tomarA tAderake deYA cukti tAdera nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta pUrNa kara| nizcaYa AllAha muttAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

ataHpara yakhana niSiddha mAsagulo ativAhita haYe yAve, takhana tomarA muzarikaderake yekhAnei pAo hatyA kara evaM tAderake pAkar3Ao kara, tAderake avarodha kara evaM tAdera janya pratiTi ghA~Tite vase thAka| tave yadi tArA tAovA kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare, Ara yAkAta deYa, tAhale tAdera patha cher3e dAo| nizcaYa AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara yadi muzarikadera keu tomAra kAche AzraYa cAYa, tAhale tAke AzraYa dAo, yAte se AllAhara kAlAma zune, ataHpara tAke pau~chiYe dAo tAra nirApada sthAne| tA ei janya ye, tArA emana eka kaoma, yArA jAne nA|

kIbhAve muzarikadera janya aGgIkAra thAkave AllAhara kAche o tA~ra rAsUlera kAche? avazya yAdera sAthe masajide hArAme tomarA aGgIkArAvaddha haYecha tAdera kathA AlAdA| ataeva yatakSaNa tArA tomAdera janya Thika thAke, tatakSaNa tomarAo tAdera janya Thika thAka| nizcaYa AllAha muttAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

kIbhAve thAkave (muzarikadera janya aGgIkAra)? athaca tArA yadi tomAdera upara jaYI haYa, tAhale tArA tomAdera AtmIYatA o aGgIkArera vyApAre lakSya rAkhe nA| tArA tAdera mukhera (kathA) dvArA tomAderake santuSTa kare, kintu tAdera antara tA asvIkAra kare| Ara tAdera adhikAMza phAsika|
tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhera vinimaYe tuccha mUlya kharida kare niYeche| phalata tArA tA~ra pathe vAdhA diYeche, nizcaYa tArA ye kAja karata tA katai nA manda!
tArA kona muminera vyApAre AtmIYatA o aGgIkArera kheYAla rAkhe nA| Ara tArAi hala sImAlaGghanakArI|
ataeva yadi tArA tAovA kare, sAlAta kAYema kare evaM yAkAta pradAna kare, tave dInera madhye tArA tomAdera bhAi| Ara Ami AYAtasamUha yathAyathabhAve varNanA kari emana kaomera janya yArA jAne|

Ara yadi tArA tAdera aGgIkArera para tAdera kasama bhaGga kare evaM tomAdera dIna samparke kaTUkti kare, tAhale tomarA kupharera netAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kara, nizcaYa tAdera kona kasama nei, yena tArA virata haYa|

tomarA kena emana kaomera viruddhe yuddha kara nA, yArA tAdera kasama bhaGga kareche evaM rAsUlake vahiSkAra karAra icchA poSaNa kareche, Ara tArAi prathame tomAdera sAthe Arambha kareche| tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa karacha? athaca AllAha adhika upayukta ye, tomarA tA~ke bhaYa karave, yadi tomarA mumina hao|

tomarA tAdera sAthe lar3Ai kara, AllAha tomAdera hAte tAderake AyAva devena evaM tAderake apadastha karavena, Ara tomAderake tAdera viruddhe sAhAyya karavena evaM mumina kaomera antarasamUhake cintAmukta karavena|
Ara tAdera antarasamUhera krodha dUra karavena evaM AllAha yAke cAna tAra tAovA kavula karena| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA ki mane karecha ye, tomAderake cher3e deYA have? athaca ekhanao AllAha yAcAi karenani ye, tomAdera madhye kArA jihAda kareche evaM kArA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o muminagaNa chAr3A kAuke vandhurUpe grahaNa kareni| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke samyaka jJAta|
muzarikadera adhikAra nei ye, tArA AllAhara masajidasamUha AvAda karave, nijadera upara kupharIra sAkSya deYA avasthAYa| ederai AmalasamUha varavAda haYeche evaM Agunei tArA sthAYI have|

ekamAtra tArAi AllAhara masajidasamUha AvAda karave, yArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkhe, sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM AllAha chAr3A kAuke bhaYa kare nA| AzA karA yAYa, orA hidAYAtaprAptadera antarbhukta have|

tomarA ki hAjIdera pAni pAna karAna o masajidula hArAma AvAda karAke ai vyaktira mata vivecanA kara, ye AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna eneche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche| tArA AllAhara kAche varAvara naYa| Ara AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta dena nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche, Ara AllAhara pathe nijadera mAla o jAna diYe jihAda kareche, AllAhara kAche tArA var3ai maryAdAvAna Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake nijera pakSa theke susaMvAda dicchena rahamata o santuSTira evaM emana jAnnAtasamUhera yAte raYeche tAdera janya sthAYI niAmata|
tathAYa tArA thAkave cirakAla| nizcaYa AllAhara kAche raYeche mahApuraskAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA nijadera pitA o bhAiderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, yadi tArA ImAna apekSA kupharIke priYa mane kare| tomAdera madhya theke yArA tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare tArAi yAlima|

vala, ‘tomAdera pitA, tomAdera santAna, tomAdera strI, tomAdera gotra, tomAdera se sampada yA tomarA arjana karecha, Ara se vyavasA yAra mandA haoYAra AzaGkA tomarA karacha evaM se vAsasthAna, yA tomarA pachanda karacha, yadi tomAdera kAche adhika priYa haYa AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o tA~ra pathe jihAda karAra ceYe, tave tomarA apekSA kara AllAha tA~ra nirdeza niYe AsA paryanta’| Ara AllAha phAsika sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|

avazyai AllAha tomAderake sAhAyya karechena vahu jAYagAYa evaM hunAinera dine, yakhana tomAdera saMkhyAdhikya tomAderake utphulla karechila, athaca tA tomAdera kona kAje Aseni| Ara yamIna prazasta haoYA sattveo tomAdera upara saMkIrNa haYe giYechila| ataHpara tomarA pRSTha pradarzana kare palAYana karechile|

tArapara AllAha tA~ra pakSa theke prazAnti nAyila karalena tA~ra rAsUlera upara o muminadera upara evaM nAyila karalena emana sainyavAhinI yAderake tomarA dekhani, Ara kAphiraderake AyAva dilena| Ara eTA kAphiradera karmaphala|
erapara AllAha yAderake icchA tAdera tAovA kavUla karavena| Ara AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa, nizcaYa muzarikarA nApAka, sutarAM tArA yena masajidula hArAmera nikaTavartI nA haYa tAdera e vacharera para| Ara yadi tomarA dAridryake bhaYa kara, tave AllAha cAile nija anugrahe tomAdera abhAvamukta karavena| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA lar3Ai kara Ahale kitAvera se sava lokera sAthe yArA AllAha o zeSa divase ImAna rAkhe nA evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla yA hArAma karechena tA hArAma mane kare nA, Ara satya dIna grahaNa kare nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA svahaste nata haYe jiyYA deYa|

Ara iYAhUdIrA vale, uyAira AllAhara putra evaM nAsArArA vale, mAsIha AllAhara putra| eTA tAdera mukhera kathA, tArA sesava lokera kathAra anurUpa valache yArA itaHpUrve kupharI kareche| AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karuna, kothAYa pherAno hacche ederake?

tArA AllAhake cher3e tAdera panDita o saMsAra-virAgIdera* rava hiseve grahaNa kareche evaM mAraiYAmaputra mAsIhakeo| athaca tArA eka ilAhera ivAdata karAra janyai AdiSTa haYeche, tini chAr3A kona (haka) ilAha nei| tArA ye zarIka kare tini tA theke pavitra| * e sthale أحبار dvArA iYAhUdIdera dharmapanDita Ara رهبان dvArA nAsArAdera dharmapanDitaderake vujhAno haYeche|
tArA AllAhara nUrake nirvApita karate cAYa tAdera mukhera (phu~ka) dvArA, kintu AllAha to tA~ra nUra paripUrNa karA chAr3A anya kichu cAna nA, yadio kAphirarA apachanda kare|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake hidAYAta o satya dIna saha preraNa karechena, yAte tini eke sakala dInera upara vijaYI karena, yadio muzarikarA apachanda kare|

he ImAnadAragaNa, nizcaYa panDita o saMsAra virAgIdera anekei mAnuSera dhana-sampada anyAYabhAve bhakSaNa kare, Ara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa evaM yArA sonA o rUpA puJjIbhUta kare rAkhe, Ara tA AllAhara rAstAYa kharaca kare nA, tumi tAdera vedanAdAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda dAo|

yedina jAhAnnAmera Agune tA garama karA have, ataHpara tA dvArA tAdera kapAle, pArzve evaM piThe se~ka deYA have| (Ara valA have) ‘eTA tA-i yA tomarA nijadera janya jamA kare rekhechile, sutarAM tomarA yA jamA karechile tAra svAda upabhoga kara’|

nizcaYa mAsasamUhera gaNanA AllAhara kAche vAra mAsa AllAhara kitAve, (sedina theke) yedina tini AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi karechena| era madhya theke cAraTi sammAnita, eTAi pratiSThita dIna| sutarAM tomarA e mAsasamUhe nijadera upara kona yulama karo nA, Ara tomarA sakale muzarikadera sAthe lar3Ai kara yemanibhAve tArA sakale tomAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare, Ara jene rAkha, nizcaYai AllAha muttAkIdera sAthe Achena|

nizcaYa kona mAsake pichiYe deYA kupharI vRddhi kare, era dvArA kAphirarA pathabhraSTa haYa, tArA eTi eka vachara hAlAla kare evaM Areka vachara hArAma kare, yAte tArA AllAha yA hArAma karechena tAra saMkhyA Thika rAkhe| phale AllAha yA hArAma karechena, tA tArA hAlAla kare| tAdera manda AmalasamUha tAdera janya suzobhita karA haYeche| Ara AllAha kAphira kaomake hidAYAta dena nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomAdera kI hala, yakhana tomAdera valA haYa, AllAhara rAstAYa (yuddhe) vera hao, takhana tomarA yamInera prati pravalabhAve jhu~ke par3a? tave ki tomarA AkhirAtera parivarte duniYAra jIvane santuSTa hale? athaca duniYAra jIvanera bhoga-sAmagrI AkhirAtera tulanAYa ekevArei nagaNya|

yadi tomarA (yuddhe) vera nA hao, tini tomAdera vedanAdAYaka AyAva devena evaM tomAdera parivarte anya eka kaomake AnaYana karavena, Ara tomarA tA~ra kichumAtra kSati karate pArave nA| Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

yadi tomarA tAke sAhAyya nA kara, tave AllAha tAke sAhAyya karechena yakhana kAphirarA tAke vera kare dila, se chila du’janera dvitIYajana| yakhana tArA ubhaYe pAhAr3era ekaTi guhAYa avasthAna karachila, se tAra saGgIke valala, ‘tumi perezAna haYo nA, nizcaYa AllAha AmAdera sAthe Achena’| ataHpara AllAha tAra upara tA~ra pakSa theke prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAke emana eka sainya vAhinI dvArA sAhAyya karalena yAderake tomarA dekhani evaM tini kAphiradera vANI ati nicu kare dilena| Ara AllAhara vANIi suucca| Ara AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|
tomarA hAlakA o bhArI ubhaYa avasthAYa yuddhe vera hao evaM tomAdera mAla o jAna niYe AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kara| eTA tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|

yadi tA nikaTalabhya hata, Ara saphara hata sahajasAdhya, tave tArA avazyai tomAra anusaraNa karata, kintu tAdera janya dUratva dIrgha hala| Ara acirei tArA AllAhara kasama karave, ‘yadi AmarA sakSama hatAma tAhale avazyai tomAdera sAthe vera hatAma’, tArA tAdera nijaderakei dhvaMsa kare| Ara AllAha jAnena, nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
AllAha tomAke kSamA karechena| tumi tAderake kena anumati dile, yatakSaNa nA tomAra kAche spaSTa haYa tArA yArA satya valeche evaM tumi jene nAo mithyAvAdIderake|
yArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkhe, tArA tomAra kAche tAdera mAla o jAna diYe jihAda karA theke virata thAkAra anumati cAYa nA, Ara AllAha muttAkIdera samparke pUrNa jJAta|
ekamAtra sesava loka anumati cAYa yArA AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkhe nA, Ara tAdera antarasamUha saMzaYagrasta haYe geche| sutarAM tArA tAdera saMzaYei ghurapAka khete thAke|

Ara yadi tArA vera haoYAra icchA karata, tave tArA tAra janya saraJjAma prastuta karata, kintu AllAha tAdera vera haoYAke apachanda karalena, phale tini tAderake pichiYe dilena, Ara valA hala, ‘tomarA vase par3A lokadera sAthe vase thAka’|

yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe vera hata, tave tomAdera madhye phAsAdai vRddhi karata evaM tomAdera mAjhe chuTochuTi karata, tomAdera madhye phitanA sRSTira anusandhAne| Ara tomAdera madhye raYeche tAdera kathA adhika zravaNakArI, Ara AllAha yAlimadera samparke pUrNa jJAta|
avazya tArA itaHpUrve phitanA anusandhAna karechila evaM tomAra kAjagulo pAlaTe diYechila, avazeSe hakera Agamana ghaTala evaM AllAhara dIna vijaYI hala, athaca tArA chila apachandakArI|
Ara tAdera madhye keu keu vale, ‘AmAke anumati dina evaM AmAke phitanAYa phelavena nA’| zune rAkha, tArA phitanAtei par3e Ache| Ara nizcaYa jAhAnnAma kAphiradera veSTanakArI|

yadi tomAra kAche kona kalyANa pau~che, tave tA tAderake kaSTa deYa| Ara yadi tomAke kona vipada AkrAnta kare, tave tArA vale, pUrvei AmarA satarkatA avalamvana karechi evaM tArA phire yAYa ‌ullasita avasthAYa|
vala, ‘AmAderake zudhu tA-i AkrAnta karave yA AllAha AmAdera janya likhe rekhechena| tinii AmAdera abhibhAvaka, Ara AllAhara uparai yena muminarA tAoYAkkula kare’|

vala, ‘tomarA kevala AmAdera janya du’Ti kalyANera ekaTira apekSA karacha, Ara AmarAo tomAdera janya apekSA karachi ye, AllAha tomAderake tA~ra pakSa theke athavA AmAdera hAta dvArA AyAva devena| ataeva tomarA apekSA kara, nizcaYa AmarA tomAdera sAthe apekSamANa’|
vala, ‘tomarA khuzi haYe dAna kara athavA vAdhya haYe, tomAdera theke tA kakhano grahaNa karA have nA| nizcaYa tomarA haccha phAsika kaoma|

Ara tAdera dAna kavUla theke ekamAtra vAdhA ei chila ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake asvIkAra kareche, Ara tArA sAlAte Ase nA, tave alasa avasthAYa evaM tArA dAna kare nA, tave apachandakArI avasthAYa|
ataeva tomAke yena mugdha nA kare tAdera dhana-sampada evaM santAnAdi, AllAha era dvArA kevala tAdera AyAva dite cAna duniYAra jIvane evaM tAdera jAna vera have kAphira avasthAYa|
Ara tArA AllAhara kasama kare ye, nizcaYa tArA tomAdera antarbhukta, athaca tArA tomAdera antarbhukta naYa| varaM tArA emana kaoma yArA bhIta haYa|
yadi tArA kona AzraYasthala, vA kona guhA athavA lukiYe thAkAra kona pravezasthala peta, tave tArA sedikei daur3e pAlAta|
Ara tAdera madhye keu Ache, ye sadAkA viSaYe tomAke doSAropa kare| tave yadi tAderake tA theke deYA haYa, tArA santuSTa thAke, Ara yadi tA theke deYA nA haYa, takhana tArA asantuSTa haYa|

Ara yadi tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera yA diYechena, tAte santuSTa thAkata evaM valata, ‘AmAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa, acirei AllAha AmAderake tA~ra anugraha dAna karavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| nizcaYa AmarA AllAhara dike dhAvita’|

nizcaYa sadAkA hacche phakIra o misakInadera janya evaM ete niYojita karmacArIdera janya, Ara yAdera antara AkRSTa karate haYa tAdera janya; (tA vaNTana karA yAYa) dAsa AyAda karAra kSetre, RNagrastadera madhye, AllAhara rAstAYa evaM musAphiradera madhye| eTi AllAhara pakSa theke nirdhArita, Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera madhye emana loka Ache, yArA navIke kaSTa deYa evaM vale, ‘tini (sava viSaYe) zravaNakArI’| vala, tomAdera janya yA kalyANera tA zravaNakArI| se AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhe evaM muminadera vizvAsa kare, Ara tomAdera madhye yArA ImAnadAra tAdera janya se rahamata evaM yArA AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deYa, tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva|
tArA tomAdera kAche AllAhara kasama kare, yAte tomAderake santuSTa karate pAre, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla adhika hakadAra ye, tArA tAke santuSTa karave, yadi tArA ImAnadAra haYe thAke|
tArA ki jAne nA, ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare, tave tAra janya avazyai jAhAnnAma, tAte se cirakAla thAkave| eTA mahAlAJchanA|

munAphikarA bhaYa kare ye, tAdera viSaYe emana ekaTi sUrA avatIrNa have, yA tAdera antarera viSaYaguli jAniYe deve| vala, ‘tomarA upahAsa karate thAka| nizcaYa AllAha vera karavena, tomarA yA bhaYa karacha’|
Ara yadi tumi tAderake prazna kara, avazyai tArA valave, ‘AmarA AlApacAritA o khela-tAmAzA karachilAma| vala, ‘AllAha, tA~ra AYAtasamUha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe tomarA vidrUpa karachile’?
tomarA oyara peza karo nA| tomarA tomAdera ImAnera para avazyai kupharI karecha| yadi Ami tomAdera theke ekaTi dalake kSamA kare dei, tave apara dalake AyAva deva| kAraNa, tArA hacche aparAdhI|

munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIrA eke aparera aMza, tArA manda kAjera Adeza deYa, Ara bhAla kAja theke niSedha kare, tArA nijadera hAtaguloke saGkucita kare rAkhe| tArA AllAhake bhule giYeche, phale tinio tAderake cher3e diYechena*, nizcaYa munAphikarA hacche phAsika| * TikA dekhuna pRSThA 205|

AllAha munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI o kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera Agunera pratizruti diYechena| tAte tArA ciradina thAkave, eTi tAdera janya yatheSTa| Ara AllAha tAdera lA‘nata karena evaM tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI AyAva|

tAdera mata, yArA tomAdera pUrve chila, tArA chila tomAdera ceYe adhika zaktizAlI, dhana-sampada o santAnAdite adhika| phale tArA tAdera aMza bhoga kareche, Ara tomarAo tomAdera aMza bhoga karecha, yemanibhAve tomAdera pUrve yArA chila tArA tAdera aMza bhoga kareche| Ara tomarA khela-tAmAzAYa matta haYecha, yemanibhAve tArA matta haYeche| ederai AmalasamUha naSTa haYe giYeche duniYA o AkhirAte| Ara tArAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera kAche ki tAdera pUrvera lokadera saMvAda pau~cheni, nUhera kaoma, Ada, sAmUda, ivarAhImera kaoma, mAdAYenavAsI o vidhvasta nagarIra? tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa pramANasamUha niYe upasthita haYeche| ataeva AllAha tAdera upara yulama karAra nana, varaM tArAi tAdera nijadera upara yulama karachila|

Ara mumina puruSa o mumina nArIrA eke aparera vandhu, tArA bhAla kAjera Adeza deYa Ara anyAYa kAja theke niSedha kare, Ara tArA sAlAta kAYima kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare| ederake AllAha zIghrai daYA karavena, nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake jAnnAtera oYAdA diYechena, yAra nica diYe pravAhita have naharasamUha, tAte tArA ciradina thAkave evaM (oYAdA dicchena) sthAYI jAnnAtasamUhe pavitra vAsasthAnasamUhera| Ara AllAhara pakSa theke santuSTi savaceYe var3a| eTAi mahAsaphalatA|
he navI, kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM tAdera upara kaThora hao, Ara tAdera ThikAnA hala jAhAnnAma; Ara tA katainA nikRSTa sthAna|

tArA AllAhara kasama kare ye, tArA valeni, athaca tArA kupharI vAkya valeche evaM isalAma grahaNera para kupharI kareche| Ara manastha kareche emana kichura yA tArA pAYani| Ara tArA ekamAtra e kAraNei doSAropa karechila ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tA~ra svIYa anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta karechena| erapara yadi tArA tAovA kare, tave tA have tAdera janya uttama, Ara yadi tArA vimukha haYa, AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte vedanAdAYaka AyAva devena, Ara tAdera janya yamIne nei kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI|
Ara tAdera madhye kataka AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra kare ye, yadi AllAha tAra svIYa anugrahe AmAdera dAna karena, AmarA avazyai dAna-khaYarAta karava evaM avazyai AmarA nekakAradera antarbhukta hava |
ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake tA~ra anugraha dAna karalena, tArA tAte kArpaNya karala evaM vimukha haYe phire gela|

sutarAM pariNAme tini tAdera antare niphAka rekhe dilena sedina paryanta, yedina tArA tA~ra sAthe sAkSAt karave, tArA AllAhake ye oYAdA diYeche tA bhaGga karAra kAraNe evaM tArA ye mithyA valechila tAra kAraNe|
tArA ki jAne nA, nizcaYa AllAha tAdera gopanIYa viSaYa o gopana parAmarza jAnena? Ara nizcaYa AllAha gAYevasamUhera vyApAre samyaka jJAta|

yArA doSAropa kare sadAkAra vyApAre muminadera madhya theke svecchAdAnakArIderake evaM tAderake yArA tAdera parizrama chAr3A kichui pAYa nA| ataHpara tArA tAderake niYe upahAsa kare, AllAhao tAderake niYe upahAsa karena evaM tAdera janyai raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

tumi tAdera janya kSamA cAo, athavA tAdera janya kSamA nA cAo| yadi tumi tAdera janya sattara vAra kSamA cAo, tavuo AllAha tAderake kakhano kSamA karavena nA| kAraNa tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche, Ara AllAha phAsika lokaderake hidAYAta dena nA |

pechane thAkA lokagulo AllAhara rAsUlera vipakSe vase thAkate pere khuzi hala, Ara tArA apachanda karala tAdera mAla o jAna niYe AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda karate evaM tArA valala, ‘tomarA garamera madhye vera haYo nA’| vala, ‘jAhAnnAmera Aguna adhikatara garama, yadi tArA vujhata’|
ataeva tArA alpa hAsuka, Ara vezi kA~duka, tArA yA arjana kareche tAra vinimaYe|

ataeva yadi AllAha tomAke tAdera kona dalera kAche phiriYe Anena evaM tArA tomAra kAche vera haoYAra anumati cAYa, tave tumi vala, ‘tomarA AmAra sAthe kakhano vera have nA evaM AmAra sAthe kona duzamanera viruddhe kakhanao lar3Ai karave nA| nizcaYa tomarA prathamavAra vase thAkAi pachanda karecha, sutarAM tomarA vase thAko pechane (vase) thAkA lokadera sAthe|

Ara tAdera madhye ye mArA giYeche, tAra upara tumi jAnAyA par3ave nA evaM tAra kavarera upara dA~r3Ave nA| nizcaYa tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake asvIkAra kareche evaM tArA phAsika avasthAYa mArA giYeche |
Ara tomAke yena mugdha nA kare tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati, AllAha era dvArA kevala tAdera duniYAra jIvane AyAva dite cAna evaM kAphira avasthAYa tAdera jAna vera haYe yAve|

Ara yakhana kona sUrA e marme nAyila karA haYa ye, ‘tomarA AllAhara prati ImAna Ana evaM tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe jihAda kara’, takhana tAdera sAmarthyavAna lokerA tomAra kAche anumati cAYa evaM vale, ‘AmAderake cher3e dAo, AmarA vase thAkA lokadera sAthe thAkava’|
tArA pechane thAkA lokadera sAthe thAkA veche nila evaM tAdera antarasamUhera upara mohara e~Te deYA hala, phale tArA vujhate pAre nA |
kintu rAsUla o tAra sAthe muminarA tAdera mAla o jAna diYe jihAda kare, Ara se sava lokera janyai raYeche yAvatIYa kalyANa evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAha tAdera janya tairi karechena jAnnAtasamUha, yAra nica diYe pravAhita have naharasamUha, tAte tArA ciradina thAkave, eTii mahAsaphalatA|

Ara grAmavAsIdera theke oyara pezakArIrA Asala, yena tAdera anumati deYA haYa evaM (jihAda nA kare) vase thAkala tArA, yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe mithyA valechila| tAdera madhya theke yArA kupharI kareche, tAderake acirei yantraNAdAYaka AyAva AkrAnta karave|

kona doSa nei durvaladera upara, asusthadera upara o yArA dAna karAra mata kichu pAYa nA tAdera upara, yadi tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera hitAkAGkSI haYa| satkarmazIladera upara (abhiyogera) kona patha nei, Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara tAdera uparao kona doSa nei, yArA tomAra kAche Ase, yAte tumi tAdera vAhana jogAte pAra| tumi valale, ‘Ami tomAderake vahana karAnora janya kichu pAcchi nA, takhana tArA phire gela, tAdera cokha azrute bhese yAoYA avasthAYa, e duHkhe ye, tArA pAcche nA emana kichu yA tArA vyaYa karave’|

kintu (abhiyogera) patha Ache tAdera upara, yArA tomAra kAche anumati cAYa athaca tArA dhanI, tArA pechane thAkA lokadera sAthe thAkA veche niYeche Ara AllAha tAdera antara- samUhera upara mohara e~Te diYechena, tAi tArA jAne nA|

tArA tomAdera nikaTa oyara peza karave yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAve| vala, ‘tomarA oyara peza karo nA, AmarA tomAderake kakhano vizvAsa karava nA| avazyai AllAha tomAdera khavara AmAderake jAniYe diYechena| Ara AllAha tomAdera Amala dekhavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao| tArapara tomAderake phiriYe neYA have gAYeva o prakAzyera jJAnIra nikaTa| ataHpara tini tomAderake yA tomarA Amala karate se samparke jAniYe devena ’|

yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAve, takhana acirei tomAdera kAche AllAhara nAme zapatha karave, yAte tomarA tAderake upekSA kara| sutarAM tomarA tAderake upakSo kara| nizcaYa tArA apavitra evaM jAhAnnAma hala tAdera AzraYasthala| tArA yA arjana karata, tAra pratiphalasvarUpa |
tArA zapatha karave tomAdera nikaTa, yAte tomarA tAdera prati santuSTa hao| ataeva tomarA yadio tAdera prati santuSTa hao, tave nizcaYa AllAha phAsika kaomera prati santuSTa hana nA|
veduInarA kuphara o kapaTatAYa kaThinatara evaM AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera upara yA nAyila karechena tAra sImArekhA nA jAnAra adhika upayogI| Ara AllAha sarvajJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara veduInadera keu keu yA (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare, tA jarimAnA gaNya kare evaM tomAdera durvipAkera pratIkSAYa thAke| durvipAka tAdera uparai evaM AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|

Ara veduInadera keu keu AllAha o zeSa dinera prati ImAna rAkhe evaM yA vyaYa kare tAke AllAhara nikaTa naikaTya o rAsUlera do‘Ara upAYa hiseve gaNya kare| jene rAkha, nizcaYa tA tAdera janya naikaTyera mAdhyama| acirei AllAha tAderake tA~ra rahamate praveza karAvena| nizcaYa AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara muhAjira o AnasAradera madhye yArA prathama agragAmI evaM yArA tAderake anusaraNa kareche sundarabhAve, AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena Ara tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa haYeche| Ara tini tAdera janya prastuta karechena jAnnAtasamUha, yAra taladeze nadI pravAhita, tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have| eTAi mahAsAphalya|

Ara tomAdera AzapAzera maruvAsIdera madhye kichu loka munAphika evaM madInAvAsIdera madhyeo kichu loka atimAtrAYa munAphikIte lipta Ache| tumi tAderake jAna nA| Ami tAderake jAni| acire Ami tAderake du’vAra AyAva deva tArapara tAderake phiriYe neYA have mahAAyAvera dike|

Ara anya kichu loka tAdera aparAdha svIkAra kareche, satkarmera saGge tArA asatkarmera mizraNa ghaTiYeche| AzA karA yAYa, AllAha tAdera tAovA kavUla karavena| nizcaYa AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
