tAdera sampada theke sadAkA nAo| era mAdhyame tAderake tumi pavitra o parizuddha karave| Ara tAdera janya do‘A kara, nizcaYa tomAra do‘A tAdera janya prazAntikara| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera tAovA kavUla karena evaM sadAkA grahaNa karena| Ara nizcaYa AllAha tAovA kavUlakArI, parama daYAlu|

Ara vala, ‘tomarA Amala kara| ataeva, acirei AllAha tomAdera Amala dekhavena, tA~ra rAsUla o muminagaNao| Ara acirei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have gAYeva o prakAzyera jJAnIra nikaTa| ataHpara tini tomAderake jAnAvena yA tomarA Amala karate se samparke’|
Ara AllAhara Adezera apekSAYa apara kichu lokera siddhAnta pichiYe deYA halo| tini tAderake AyAva devena naYato tAdera tAovA kavUla karavena| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA masajida vAniYeche kSatisAdhana, kupharI o muminadera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddezye evaM itaHpUrve AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe ye lar3Ai kareche tAra ghA~Ti hiseve| Ara tArA avazyai zapatha karave ye, ‘AmarA kevala bhAla ceYechi’| Ara AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|

tumi sekhAne kakhano (sAlAta kAYema karate) dA~r3io nA| avazyai ye masajida pratiSThita haYeche tAkaoYAra upara prathama dina theke tA vezI hakadAra ye, tumi sekhAne sAlAta kAYema karate dA~r3Ave| sekhAne emana loka Ache, yArA uttamarUpe pavitratA arjana karate bhAlavAse| Ara AllAha pavitratA arjanakArIdera bhAlavAsena|

ye tAra gRhera bhitti AllAhara tAkaoYA o santuSTira upara pratiSThA karala, se ki uttama nA ai vyakti ye tAra gRhera bhitti pratiSThA kareche eka gartera patanonmukha kinArAYa? ataHpara tAke niYe tA dhase par3ala jAhAnnAmera Agune| Ara AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta dena nA|
tAdera nirmita gRha, tAdera antare sandehera kAraNa haYe thAkave, ye paryanta nA tAdera hRdaYa Tukaro Tukaro haYe yAYa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa AllAha muminadera theke tAdera jAna o mAla kraYa kare niYechena (era vinimaYe) ye, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta| tArA AllAhara pathe lar3Ai kare| ataeva tArA mAre o mare| tAorAta, iJjila o kuraAne e samparke satya oYAdA raYeche| Ara nija oYAdA pUraNe AllAhara ceYe adhika ke hate pAre? sutarAM tomarA (AllAhara saMge) ye saodA karecha, se saodAra janya Anandita hao evaM seTAi mahAsAphalya|

tArA tAovAkArI, ivAdAtakArI, AllAhara prazaMsAkArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, rukUkArI, sijdAkArI, satkAjera AdezadAtA, asatkAjera niSedhakArI evaM AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA hephAyatakArI| Ara muminaderake tumi susaMvAda dAo|
navI o muminadera janya ucita naYa ye, tArA muzarikadera janya kSamA prArthanA karave| yadio tArA AtmIYa haYa| tAdera nikaTa eTA spaSTa haYe yAoYAra para ye, nizcaYa tArA prajvalita Agunera adhivAsI|

nija pitAra janya ivarAhImera kSamA prArthanA to chila ekaTi oYAdAra kAraNe, ye oYAdA se tAke diYechila| ataHpara yakhana tAra nikaTa spaSTa haYe gela ye, nizcaYa se AllAhara zatru, se tAra sAthe samparka chinna karala| nizcaYa ivarAhIma chila adhika prArthanAkArI o sahanazIla|

Ara AllAha emana nana ye, tini kona sampradAYake hidAYAta dAnera para tAderake pathabhraSTa karavena| yatakSaNa nA tAdera janya suspaSTabhAve varNanA karavena, yA theke tArA sAvadhAna thAkave| nizcaYa AllAha pratyeka viSaYe sarvajJa|
nizcaYa AllAha, tA~ra janyai AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera janya nA Ache kona abhibhAvaka, nA Ache kona sAhAyyakArI|

avazyai AllAha navI, muhAjira o AnasAradera tAovA kavula karalena, yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche saMkaTapUrNa muhUrte| tAdera madhye eka dalera hRdaYa satyacyUta haoYAra upakrama havAra para| tArapara AllAha tAdera tAovA kavUla karalena| nizcaYa tini tAdera prati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara se tina janera (tAovA kavUla karalena), yAdera viSaYaTi sthagita rAkhA haYechila| emanaki pRthivI prazasta haoYA sattveo tAdera janya saMkIrNa haYe giYechila evaM tAdera nikaTa tAdera jIvana durvisaha haYe uThechila| Ara tArA nizcita vujhechila ye, AllAhara AyAva theke tini chAr3A kona AzraYasthala nei| tArapara tini tAdera tAovA kavula karalena, yAte tArA tAovAYa sthira thAke| nizcaYa AllAha tAovA kavUlakArI, parama daYAlu|
he muminagaNa,tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM satyavAdIdera sAthe thAka|

madInAra adhivAsI o tAra AzapAzera maruvAsIdera janya saMgata naYa ye, rAsUlullAha theke pechane theke yAve evaM rAsUlera jIvana apekSA nijadera jIvanake adhika priYa mane karave| eTA e kAraNe ye, tAderake AllAhara pathe tRSNA, klAnti o kSudhAYa AkrAnta kare evaM tAdera emana padakSepa yA kAphiradera krodha janmAYa evaM zatruderake tArA kSatisAdhana kare, tAra vinimaYe tAdera janya satkarma lipivaddha karA haYa| nizcaYa AllAha satkarmazIladera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|
Ara tArA svalpa kiMvA adhika yA-i vyaYa kare evaM atikrama kare ye prAntarai, tA tAdera janya likhe deYA haYa, yAte tArA yA Amala karata, AllAha tAderake tAra ceYe uttama pratidAna dena|

Ara muminadera janya saMgata naYa ye, tArA sakale ekasaGge abhiyAne vera have| ataHpara tAdera pratiTi dala theke kichu loka kena vera haYa nA, yAte tArA dInera gabhIra jJAna AharaNa karate pAre evaM Apana sampradAYa yakhana tAdera nikaTa pratyAvartana karave, takhana tAderake satarka karate pAre, yAte tArA (gunAha theke) ve~ce thAke|
he muminagaNa, tomarA tomAdera nikaTavartI kAphiradera viruddhe yuddha kara| evaM tArA yena tomAdera madhye kaThoratA dekhate pAYa| Ara jene rAkha, AllAha muttAkIdera sAthe Achena|
Ara yakhanai kona sUrA nAyila karA haYa, takhana tAdera keu keu vale, ‘eTi tomAdera kAra ImAna vRddhi karala’? ataeva yArA mumina, nizcaYa tA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kareche evaM tArA Anandita haYa|
Ara yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche, eTi tAdera apavitratAra sAthe apavitratA vRddhi kare evaM tArA mArA yAYa kAphira avasthAYa|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, tArA prati vachara eka vAra kiMvA du’vAra vipadagrasta haYa? era parao tArA tAovA kare nA evaM upadeza grahaNa kare nA|

Ara yakhanai kona sUrA nAyila karA haYa, tArA eke aparera dike tAkAYa| (evaM vale) ‘tomAderake ki keu dekhache’? ataHpara tArA (cupisAre) prasthAna kare| AllAha tAdera hRdaYake satyavimukha kare dena| e kAraNe ye, tArA vodhazaktihIna kaoma|

nizcaYai tomAdera nijadera madhya theke tomAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla esechena, tA tAra janya kaSTadAYaka yA tomAderake pIr3A deYa| tini tomAdera kalyANakAmI, muminadera prati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|
ataHpara yadi tArA vimukha haYa, tave vala, ‘AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| Ami tA~rai upara tAoYAkkula karechi| Ara tinii mahAArazera rava’|
Aliph-lAma-rA| egulo prajJApUrNa kitAvera AYAta|

eTA ki mAnuSera janya Azcaryera viSaYa ye, Ami tAdera madhya theke eka vyaktira nikaTa ohI preraNa karechi ye, tumi mAnuSake satarka kara evaM muminaderake susaMvAda pradAna kara ye, tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera janya raYeche ucca maryAdA| kAphirarA vale, ‘e to spaSTa yAdukara’|

nizcaYa tomAdera rava AllAha| yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena chaYa dine, tArapara Araze uThechena| tini sava viSaYa paricAlanA karena| tAra anumati chAr3A supAriza karAra keu nei| tinii AllAha, tomAdera rava| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ivAdAta kara| tAraparao ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tA~rai kAche tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana| AllAhara oYAdA satya| nizcaYa tini sRSTira sUcanA karena| tArapara tAra punarAvartana ghaTAna| yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche tAderake inasAphapUrNa pratidAna deYAra janya| Ara yArA kupharI kareche, tAdera janya raYeche uttapta pAnIYa evaM vedanAdAYaka AyAva| e kAraNe ye tArA kupharI karata|

tinii sUryake karechena dIptimaYa evaM cA~dake AlomaYa Ara tAra janya nirdhAraNa karechena vibhinna manayila, yAte tomarA jAnate pAra vacharera gaNanA evaM (samaYera) hisAva| AllAha egulo avazyai yathArthabhAve sRSTi karechena| jJAnI sampradAYera janya tini AYAtasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karena|
nizcaYa rAta o divasera vivartane evaM AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA AllAha sRSTi karechena, tAte vahu nidarzana raYeche emana kaomera janya, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|
nizcaYa yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA evaM duniYAra jIvana niYe santuSTa Ache o tA niYe paritRpta raYeche| Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI hate gAphela |
tArA yA upArjana karata, tAra kAraNe Agunai have tAdera ThikAnA|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane evaM neka Amala kare, tAdera rava ImAnera kAraNe tAderake patha dekhAvena, ArAmadAYaka jAnnAtasamUhe yAra taladeze naharasamUha pravAhita|
sekhAne tAdera kathA have, ‘he AllAha, tumi pavitra mahAna’ evaM tAdera abhivAdana have, ‘sAlAma’| Ara tAdera zeSa kathA have ye, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini sakala sRSTira rava’|

Ara AllAha yadi mAnuSera akalyANa (prArthanAYa sAr3A dite) tAr3AtAr3i karatena yebhAve tini tAdera kalyANa (prArthanAYa sAr3A dite) tAr3AtAr3i karena, tAhale avazyai tAdera samaYa phuriYe yeta| sutarAM yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA, Ami tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAYa dizehArA haYe ghurate cher3e dei|

Ara yakhana mAnuSake vipada sparza kare, takhana se zuYe, vase vA dA~r3iYe AmAke DAke| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAra vipada dUra kare dei, takhana se emanabhAve calate thAke mane haYa yena tAke kona vipada sparza karAra kAraNe se AmAke DAkeni| ebhAvei sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya tArA yA Amala karata tA zobhita kare deYA haYeche|

Ara avazyai Ami tomAdera pUrve vahu prajanmake dhvaMsa karechi, yakhana tArA yulama kareche| Ara tAdera nikaTa tAdera rAsUlagaNa pramANAdisaha Agamana karechila, kintu tArA ImAna AnAra chila nA| ebhAve Ami aparAdhI kaomake zAsti pradAna kari|
tArapara Ami tomAderake yamIne tAdera pare sthalAbhiSikta karechi, yAte Ami dekhi tomarA kemana Amala kara|

Ara yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTarUpe pATha karA haYa, takhana, yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA, tArA vale, ‘eTi chAr3A anya kuraAna niYe eso| athavA eke vadalAo’| vala, ‘AmAra nijera pakSa theke ete kona parivartanera adhikAra nei| Amito zudhu AmAra prati avatIrNa ohIra anusaraNa kari| nizcaYa Ami yadi ravera avAdhya hai tave bhaYa kari kaThina dinera AyAvera’|

vala, ‘yadi AllAha cAitena, Ami tomAdera upara tA pATha karatAma nA| Ara tini tomAderake e samparke avahita karatena nA| kenanA, itaHpUrve Ami tomAdera madhye dIrgha jIvana ativAhita karechi| tave ki tomarA vujha nA’?
ataeva ye AllAhara upara mithyA raTanA kare athavA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale, tAra ceYe var3a yAlima ke? nizcaYa aparAdhIrA saphala have nA|

Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A emana kichura ivAdata karache, yA tAdera kSati karate pAre nA evaM upakArao karate pAre nA| Ara tArA vale, ‘erA AllAhara nikaTa AmAdera supArizakArI’| vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAhake AsamAnasamUha o yamIne thAkA emana viSaYe saMvAda diccha yA tini avagata nana’? tini pavitra mahAna evaM tArA yA zarIka kare, tA theke tini aneka Urdhve|
Ara mAnuSa to eka ummatai chila| pare tArA vibhakta haYe par3ala| Ara tomAra ravera pakSa theke vANI vigata nA hale tAdera madhye mImAMsA haYe yeta, yA niYe tArA matavirodha kare|

Ara tArA vale, ‘tA~ra ravera pakSa theke tAra upara kona nidarzana kena nAyila karA haYa nA’? vala, ‘gAYevera jJAna to kevala AllAharai| ataeva tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSAYa raYechi’|

Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSake duHkha-durdazA sparza karAra para rahamatera svAda AsvAdana karAi, takhana tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera vyApAre kUTa-kauzalera AzraYa neYa| vala, ‘AllAha kauzalakArI hiseve adhika druta’| nizcaYa AmAra pherezatArA tomAdera kuTa-kauzala likhe rAkhe|

tinii tomAderake sthale o samudre bhramaNa karAna| emanaki yakhana tomarA naukAYa thAka, Ara tA tAderake niYe calate thAke anukula hAoYAYa evaM tArA tA niYe Anandita haYa, (e samaYa) tAke peYe vase jhar3o hAoYA, Ara cAradika theke dheYe Ase taraGga evaM tAdera nizcita dhAraNA haYa ye, tAderake pariveSTana karA haYeche| takhana tArA AllAhake DAkate thAke tA~ra janya dInake ekaniSTha kare, ‘yadi Apani e theke AmAderake nAjAta dena, tAhale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava’|

ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake nAjAta dena, takhana tArA anyAYabhAve yamIne sImAlaGghana kare| he mAnuSa, tomAdera sImAlaGghana tomAdera viruddhei, e sava kichu duniYAra bhoga| ataHpara AmAra nikaTai tomAdera pratyAvartana| sutarAM takhana Ami tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarma samparke jAnAva|

nizcaYa duniYAra jIvanera tulanA to pAnira nyAYa yA Ami AkAza theke nAyila kari, ataHpara tAra sAthe yamInera udbhidera mizraNa ghaTe, yA mAnuSa o catuSpada jantu bhoga kare| avazeSe yakhana yamIna zobhita o sajjita haYa evaM tAra adhivAsIrA mane kare yamIne utpanna phasala karAYatva karate tArA sakSama, takhana tAte rAte kiMvA dine AmAra Adeza cale Ase| ataHpara Ami seguloke vAniYe dei kartita phasala, mane haYa gatakAlao ekhAne kichu chila nA| ebhAve Ami cintAzIla lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA kari|
Ara AllAha zAntira AvAsera dike AhavAna karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAta dena sarala pathera dike|
yArA bhAlo kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche zubha pariNAma (jAnnAta) evaM Arao vezi| Ara dhUlomalinatA o lAJchanA tAdera cehArAguloke Acchanna karave nA| tArAi jAnnAtavAsI| tArA tAte sthAYI have|

Ara yArA manda upArjana karave, pratiTi mandera pratidAna have tArai anurUpa; Ara lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave| AllAhara pAkar3Ao theke tAdera kona rakSAkArI nei| yena andhakAra rAtera eka aMza diYe tAdera cehArAgulo Dheke deYA haYeche| tArAi Agunera adhivAsI, tArA tAte sthAYI have|

Ara yedina Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, ataHpara yArA ziraka kareche, tAderake valava, ‘thAma, tomarA o tomAdera zarIkarA’| ataHpara Ami tAdera madhye viccheda ghaTAva| Ara tAdera zarIkarA’ valave, ‘tomarA to AmAdera ivAdAta karate nA’|
‘sutarAM AllAhai AmAdera o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa| AmarA nizcaYa tomAdera ivAdAta samparke gAphela chilAma’|
ekhAne pratyeke itipUrve yA kareche, se samparke jAnate pArave| Ara tAderake tAdera prakRta abhibhAvaka AllAhara kAche phiriYe deYA have evaM tArA yA mithyA raTAto tA tAdera theke hAriYe yAve|

vala, ‘AsamAna o yamIna theke ke tomAdera riyka dena? athavA ke (tomAdera) zravaNa o dRSTisamUhera mAlika? Ara ke mRta theke jIvitake vera karena Ara jIvita theke mRtake vera karena? ke sava viSaYa paricAlanA karena’? takhana tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha’| sutarAM, tumi vala, ‘tAraparao ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
ataeva, tinii AllAha, tomAdera prakRta rava| ataHpara satyera para bhraSTatA chAr3A kI thAke? ataeva kothAYa tomAderake ghurAno hacche?
emanibhAve tomAra ravera vANI satya vale sAvyasta haYeche tAdera upara, yArA avAdhya haYeche, ye tArA ImAna Anave nA|

vala, ‘tomAdera zarIkadera keu ki Ache, ye prathama sRSTi karave, ataHpara tAra punarAvRtti ghaTAve’? vala, ‘AllAhai prathama sRSTi karena ataHpara tAra punarAvRtti ghaTAna’| ataeva tomAderake kothAYa phirAno hacche?

vala, ‘tomAdera zarIkadera keu ki Ache, ye satyera patha dekhAve’? vala, ‘AllAhai satyera patha dekhAna| yini satyera patha dekhAna, tinii ki anusaraNa karAra adhika hakadAra, nAki se, ye patha dekhAno chAr3A patha pAYa nA| sutarAM tomAdera kI hala? tomarA kemana vicAra karacha’|
Ara tAdera adhikAMza kevala dhAraNAra anusaraNa kare| nizcaYa satyera viparIte dhAraNA kona kAryakAritA rAkhe nA | nizcaYa AllAha tArA yA kare se samparke samyaka avagata|

e kuraAna to emana naYa ye, AllAha chAr3A keu tA racanA karate pArave; varaM eTi yA tAra sAmane raYeche, tAra satyAYana evaM kitAvera vistArita vyAkhyA, yAte kona sandeha nei, yA sRSTikulera ravera pakSa theke|
nAki tArA vale, ‘se tA vAniYeche’? vala, ‘tave tomarA tAra mata ekaTi sUrA (vAniYe) niYe Asa evaM AllAha chAr3A yAke pAro DAka, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|

varaM tArA ye vyApAre pUrNa jJAna lAbha kareni, tA tArA asvIkAra kareche evaM ekhanao tAra pariNati tAdera kAche Aseni| ebhAvei tArA asvIkAra karechila, yArA chila tAdera pUrve| sutarAM tumi lakSya kara, kemana chila yAlimadera pariNAma|
Ara tAdera madhye keu era prati ImAna Ane evaM keu tAte ImAna Ane nA| Ara tomAra rava phAsAdakArIdera vyApAre adhika jJAta|
Ara tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tumi vala, ‘AmAra karma AmAra, Ara tomAdera karma tomAdera| Ami yA Amala kari tomarA tA theke mukta evaM tomarA yA Amala kara Ami tA theke mukta’|
Ara tAdera madhye kichu Ache, yArA tomAra prati manoyoga diYe zune| tave ki tumi vadhirake zonAve, tArA nA vujhaleo?
Ara tAdera madhye keu Ache emana, ye tomAra dike tAkAYa| tave ki tumi andhake patha dekhAve, tArA nA dekhaleo?
nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati kichumAtra yulama karena nA; varaM mAnuSai nijadera upara yulama kare|

Ara yedina tini tAderake ekatra karavena, yena tArA divasera muhUrtakAlamAtra avasthAna kareche| tArA eke aparake cinate pArave| tArA avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche, yArA AllAhara sAkSAt asvIkAra kareche, Ara tArA hidAYAtaprApta chila nA|
Ara Ami tAderake ye pratizruti diYechi, tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhiYe dei, athavA tomAke mRtyu dei, tave AmAra kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana| tArapara tArA yA kare AllAha tAra sAkSI|
Ara pratyeka ummatera janya raYeche rAsUla| tArapara yakhana tAdera rAsUla Ase, tAdera madhye takhana nyAYabhittika phaYasAlA karA haYa evaM tAdera yulama karA haYa nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘kakhana ei pratizruti (pUrNa have), yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’?

vala, ‘Ami nijera kSati vA upakArera adhikAra rAkhi nA, tave AllAha yA icchA karena’| pratyeka ummatera raYeche nirdiSTa ekaTi samaYa| yakhana ese yAYa tAdera samaYa, takhana eka muhUrta pichAte pAre nA evaM egoteo pAre nA|
vala, ‘tomAdera ki mane haYa ye, yadi tomAdera nikaTa tA~ra AyAva rAte kiMvA dine ese par3e, tave aparAdhIrA tAra kon aMzaTi tAr3AtAr3i cAYa’?
tave ki yakhana tA ghaTave, takhana tomarA tAte ImAna Anave? ekhana? athaca tomarA era janyai tAr3Ahur3A karate|
tArapara yArA yulama kareche tAdera valA have, sthAYI AyAva AsvAdana kara| tomarA yA arjana karate tomAderake kevala tArai pratidAna deYA hacche|
Ara tArA tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa, ‘tA ki satya’? vala, ‘hyA~, AmAra ravera kasama! nizcaYa tA satya evaM tomarA parAstakArI nao’|

Ara yamIne yA raYeche, tA yadi yulama kareche emana pratyeka vyaktira haYe yAYa, tave tA se muktipaNa hiseve diYe deve evaM tArA lajjA gopana karave, yakhana tArA AyAva dekhave| Ara tAdera madhye nyAYabhittika phaYasAlA karA have evaM tAderake yulama karA have nA|
jene rAkha, nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA Ache, tA AllAharai| jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana have|
he mAnuSa, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera kAche eseche upadeza evaM antarasamUhe yA thAke tAra ziphA, Ara muminadera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
vala, ‘AllAhara anugraha o rahamate| sutarAM e niYei yena tArA khuzi haYa’| eTi yA tArA jamA kare tA theke uttama|

vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAha tomAdera janya ye riyka nAyila karechena, pare tomarA tAra kichu vAniYecha hArAma o hAlAla’| vala, ‘AllAha ki tomAderake anumati diYechena, nAki AllAhara upara tomarA mithyA raTAccha’?
Ara yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA raTAcche, tAdera kI dhAraNA, kiYAmatera dina (tAdera pariNati) samparke? nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera upara anugrahazIla; kintu tAdera adhikAMza zokara kare nA|

Ara tumi ye avasthAtei thAka nA kena Ara yA kichu tilAoYAta kara nA kena AllAhara pakSa hate kuraAna theke evaM tomarA ye Amalai kara nA kena, Ami tomAdera upara sAkSI thAki, yakhana tomarA tAte nimagna hao| tomAra rava theke gopana thAke nA yamInera vA AsamAnera aNu parimANa kichui evaM tA theke choTa vA var3a, tave (era sava kichui) raYeche suspaSTa kitAve|
zune rAkha, nizcaYa AllAhara vandhudera kona bhaYa nei, Ara tArA perezAnao have nA|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata|
tAdera janyai susaMvAda duniYAvI jIvane evaM AkhirAte| AllAhara vANIsamUhera kona parivartana nei| eTii mahAsaphalatA|
Ara tAdera kathA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa| nizcaYa sakala maryAdA AllAhara| tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|

jene rAkha, nizcaYa AsamAnasamUhe yArA Ache evaM yamIne yArA Ache sava AllAharai evaM yArA AllAha chAr3A anyadera DAke, tArA mUlata zarIkadera anusaraNa kare nA, tArA to kevala dhAraNAra anusaraNa kare| tArA to zudhu mithyAi vale|
tinii se sattA, yini tomAdera janya rAtake sRSTi karechena, yena tomarA tAte vizrAma nAo evaM dinake karechena AlokamaYa| nizcaYa ete raYeche nidarzanAvali emana kaomera janya yArA zune|

tArA vale, ‘AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena’| tini pavitra mahAna| tini amukhApekSI| AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA raYeche tA tA~rai| tomAdera kAche e vyApAre kona pramANa nei| tomarA ki AllAhara upara emana kichu valacha, yA tomarA jAna nA?
vala, ‘nizcaYa yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA raTAYa, tArA saphala have nA’|
(tAdera janya) duniYAte raYeche bhogasAmagrI| ataHpara AmArai kAche tAdera pratyAvartana| tArapara Ami tAderake kaThina AyAva AsvAdana karAva, tArA ye kupharI karata tAra kAraNe |

Ara tAderake nUhera saMvAda par3e zunAo, yakhana se tAra kaomake valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, AmAra avasthAna evaM AllAhara AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame AmAra upadeza dAna yadi tomAdera kAche bhArI mane haYa, tave Ami AllAhara uparai tAoYAkkula karalAma| sutarAM tomarA abhinna siddhAnta grahaNa kara evaM (sAthe nAo) tomAdera zarIkadera| tArapara tomAdera viSaYaTi yena tomAdera nikaTa aspaSTa nA thAke| erapara AmAra vyApAre siddhAnta cUr3Anta kara evaM AmAke avakAza dio nA’|
‘ataHpara tomarA yadi vimukha hao, tave Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to kevala AllAhara dAYitve| Ara Ami AdiSTa haYechi musalimadera antarbhukta haoYAra’|

ataHpara tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valala| tAi Ami tAke o naukAte yArA tAra sAthe chila tAderake nAjAta dilAma evaM Ami tAderake karechi sthalAbhiSikta| Ara DuviYe dilAma tAderake, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche| ataeva dekha, kemana chila tAdera pariNati yAderake satarka karA haYeche|

ataHpara Ami tA~ra pare aneka rAsUlake tAdera kaomera nikaTa pAThiYechi evaM tArA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila; kintu tArA itaHpUrve asvIkAra karAra kAraNe ImAna AnAra chila nA| emanibhAve Ami sImAlaGghanakArIdera antare mohara e~Te dei|
ataHpara tAdera pare Ami mUsA o hArUnake phiraAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha diYe pAThiYechi| kintu tArA ahaGkAra kareche| Ara tArA chila aparAdhI kaoma|
ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra pakSa theke satya ela, tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa eTi suspaSTa yAdu’|
mUsA valala, ‘tomarA ki satyake e rakama (yAdu) valacha, yakhana tA tomAdera kAche ela? e ki yAdu? athaca yAdukararA saphala haYa nA’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi ki esecha AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake yAte peYechi tA theke AmAderake pherAte evaM yena yamIne tomAdera pratipatti pratiSThita haYa? Ara AmarA to tomAdera prati vizvAsI nai’|
evaM phira‘Auna valala, ‘tomarA pratyeka vijJa yAdukaraderake AmAra kAche niYe Asa’|
ataHpara yakhana yAdukararA ela, mUsA tAderake valala, ‘tomarA yA phelavAra phela’|
ataHpara yakhana tArA (tAdera razi o lAThi) phelala, takhana mUsA valala, ‘tomarA yA Anale, tA yAdu| nizcaYa AllAha tA vAtila kare devena| nizcaYa AllAha phAsAdakArIdera Amala parizuddha karena nA’|
Ara AllAha tA~ra vANIsamUhera mAdhyame satyake pratiSThita karena, yadio aparAdhIrA tA apachanda kare|

vastutaH mUsAra prati tAra svagotrIYa lokadera madhye (prathame) zudhu alpa saMkhyaka lokai ImAna Anala, tAo phira‘Auna o tAra pradhAnavargera ei bhaYe ye, tArA tAderake niryAtana kare; Ara vAstavika pakSe phira‘Auna sei deze (rAjya) kSamatA rAkhata, Ara eTAo chila ye, se (nyAYera) sImAtikrama kare phelato|
Ara mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA yadi AllAhara prati ImAna ene thAka, tave tA~rai upara tAoYAkkula kara, yadi tomarA musalima haYe thAka’|
takhana tArA valala, ‘AmarA AllAhara uparai tAoYAkkula karalAma| he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake yAlima kaomera phitanAra pAtra vAnAvena nA’|
‘Ara AmAderake ApanAra anugrahe kAphira kaoma theke nAjAta dina’|
Ara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAiYera kAche ohI pAThAlAma ye, ‘tomarA tomAdera kaomera janya misare gRha tairI kara evaM tomAdera gRhaguloke kivalA vAnAo Ara sAlAta kAYema kara evaM muminadera susaMvAda dAo’|

Ara mUsA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani phira‘Auna o tAra pAriSadavargake duniYAvI jIvane saundarya o dhana-sampada dAna karechena| he AmAdera rava, yAte tArA ApanAra patha theke gomarAha karate pAre| he AmAdera rava, tAdera dhana-sampada nizci‎hna kare dina, tAdera antarasamUhake kaThora kare dina| phale tArA ImAna Anave nA, yatakSaNa nA yantraNAdAYaka AyAva dekhe’|
tini valalena, ‘tomAdera do‘A kavUla karA haYeche| sutarAM tomarA dRr3ha thAka evaM yArA jAne nA tAdera patha anusaraNa karo nA’|

Ara Ami vanI isarAIlake samudra pAra kariYe nilAma| Ara phira‘Auna o tAra sainyavAhinI auddhatya prakAza o sImAlaGghanakArI haYe tAdera pichu nila| avazeSe yakhana se Duve yete lAgala, takhana valala, ‘Ami ImAna enechi ye, se sattA chAr3A kona ilAha nei, yAra prati vanI isarAIla ImAna eneche| Ara Ami musalimadera antarbhukta’|
‘ekhana athaca itaHpUrve tumi nApharamAnI karecha, Ara tumi chile phAsAdakArIdera antarbhukta’|
‘sutarAM Aja Ami tomAra dehaTi rakSA karava, yAte tumi tomAra paravartIdera janya nidarzana haYe thAka| Ara nizcaYa aneka mAnuSa AmAra nidarzanasamUhera vyApAre gAphela’|

Ara avazyai Ami vanI isarAIlake uttama vAsabhUmite AvAsa dilAma evaM tAderake uttama riyka dilAma| ataHpara tArA matavirodha kareni, yatakSaNa nA tAdera nikaTa jJAna ela| nizcaYa tomAra rava kiYAmatera dina se viSaYe phaYasAlA karavena yA niYe tArA matavirodha karata|

sutarAM Ami tomAra nikaTa yA nAyila karechi, tA niYe tumi yadi sandehe thAka, tAhale yArA tomAra pUrva thekei kitAva pATha karache tAderake jijJAsA kara| avazyai tomAra nikaTa tomAra ravera pakSa theke satya eseche| sutarAM tumi sandeha poSaNakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
Ara tumi tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche| tAhale tumi kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|
nizcaYa yAdera upara tomAra ravera vANI satya haYeche, tArA ImAna Anave nA;
yadio tAdera nikaTa sakala nidarzana ese upasthita haYa, yatakSaNa nA tArA yantraNAdAYaka AyAva pratyakSa kare|

sutarAM kena hala nA emana eka janapada, ye ImAna eneche evaM tAra ImAna tAra upakAre eseche? tave iunusera kaoma chAr3A yakhana tArA ImAna Anala, takhana Ami tAdera theke duniYAra jIvanera lAJchanAkara AyAva sariYe dilAma evaM Ami tAderake ekaTi samaYa paryanta bhoga karate dilAma|
Ara yadi tomAra rava cAitena, tave yamInera sakalei ImAna Anata| tave ki tumi mAnuSake vAdhya karave, yAte tArA mumina haYa?
Ara kArao pakSe sambhava naYa ye, AlalAhara anumati chAr3A ImAna Anave evaM yArA vujhe nA tini AyAva cApiYe devena tAdera upara|
vala, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamIne kI Ache tA tAkiYe dekha| Ara nidarzanasamUha o satarkakArIgaNa emana kaomera kAje Ase nA, yArA ImAna Ane nA’|
tave ki tArA kevala tAdera pUrve vigata lokadera anurUpa dinagulorai apekSA karache? vala, ‘tave tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna’|
tArapara Ami nAjAta dei AmAra rAsUladerake evaM tAderakeo yArA ImAna eneche| eTA AmAra dAYitva ye, muminadera nAjAta dei|

vala, ‘he mAnuSa, tomarA yadi AmAra dInera vyApAre sandehe thAka, tave AllAha chAr3A tomarA yAra ivAdAta kara Ami tAra ivAdAta kari nA, varaM Ami ivAdAta kari AllAhara, yini tomAdera mRtyu dena| Ara Ami AdiSTa haYechi muminadera antarbhukta haoYAra’|
Ara (e nirdeza) ye, ‘tumi nijeke dInera upara pratiSThita rAkha ekaniSThabhAve evaM muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA’|
‘Ara AllAha chAr3A emana kichuke Deko nA, yA tomAra upakAra karate pAre nA evaM tomAra kSatio karate pAre nA| ataeva tumi yadi kara, tAhale nizcaYa tumi yAlimadera antarbhukta have|

‘Ara AllAha yadi tomAke kona kSati pau~chAna, tave tini chAr3A tA dUra karAra keu nei| Ara tini yadi tomAra kalyANa cAna, tave tA~ra anugrahera kona pratirodhakArI nei| tini tAra vAndAdera yAke icchA tAke tA dena| Ara tini parama kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu’|

vala, ‘he mAnuSa’, tomAdera ravera pakSa theke tomAdera nikaTa satya eseche| sutarAM ye hidAYAta grahaNa karave, se nijera janyai hidAYAta grahaNa karave| Ara ye pathabhraSTa have, se nijera kSatira janya pathabhraSTa have| Ara Ami tomAdera abhibhAvaka nai|
Ara tomAra nikaTa ye ohI pAThAno hacche, tumi tAra anusaraNa kara evaM savara kara, yatakSaNa nA AllAha phaYasAlA karena| Ara tinii uttama phaYasAlAkArI|
Alipha-lAma-rA| eTi kitAva yAra AYAtasamUha susthita karA haYeche, ataHpara vistAritabhAve varNanA karA haYeche prajJAmaYa, savizeSa avahita sattvAra pakSa theke|
(e marme) ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta karo nA| nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya tA~ra pakSa theke satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

Ara tomarA tomAdera ravera kAche kSamA cAo| tArapara tAra kAche phire yAo, (tAhale) tini tomAderake nirdhArita samaYa paryanta uttama bhoga-upakaraNa devena evaM prarteka AnugatyazIlake tA~ra Anugatya mutAvika dAna karavena| Ara yadi tArA phire yAYa, tave Ami nizcaYa tomAdera upara var3a eka dinera AyAvera bhaYa karachi|
AllAhara nikaTai tomAdera pratyAvartana evaM tini sava kichura upara kSamatAzIla|

jene rAkha, nizcaYa tArA tAdera vuka phiriYe neYa, yAte tArA tAra theke Atmagopana karate pAre| jene rAkha, yakhana tArA kApar3a AvRta haYa, takhana tini jAnena yA tArA gopana kare evaM yA tArA prakAza kare| nizcaYa tini antaryAmI|

Ara yamIne vicaraNakArI pratiTi prANIra riykera dAYitva AllAharai evaM tini jAnena tAdera AvAsasthala o samAdhisthala* | sava kichu Ache spaSTa kitAve**| * ekhAne مستقر vA AvAsasthala valate mAtRgarbhe avasthAna matAntare mRtyu paryanta duniYAYa avasthAnake vujhAno haYeche| Ara مستودع dvArA kavarastha karAra sthAna matAntare janmera pUrve pitRmerudanDe avasthAna kiMvA mRtyura samaYa vA sthAna vujhAno haYeche|

Ara tinii AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena chaYa dine, Ara tA~ra Araza chila pAnira upara, yAte tini parIkSA karena, ke tomAdera madhye Amale sarvottama| Ara tumi yadi vala, ‘mRtyura para nizcaYa tomAderake punarujjIvita karA have’, tave kAphirarA avazyai valave, ‘eto zudhui spaSTa yAdu’|

Ara yadi Ami nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tAdera theke AyAva vilamvita kari, tave tArA avazyai valave, ‘kon vastu tAke ThekiYe rAkhala’? sAvadhAna! yedina tAdera upara tA neme Asave, sedina tAdera theke tA pherAno have nA evaM tArA yA niYe upahAsa karata, tAderake tA ghire phelave|
Ara yadi Ami mAnuSake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata AsvAdana karAi, ataHpara tAra theke tA ker3e nei, nizcaYa se takhana (haYe par3ave) nirAza, akRtajJa|
Ara duHkha-durdazA sparza karAra para yadi Ami tAke niAmata AsvAdana karAi, tAhale se avazyai valave, ‘AmAra theke vipada-Apada dUra haYe geche, Ara se have ati utphulla, ahaGkArI|
tave yArA savara kareche evaM satkarma kareche, tAdera janyai raYeche kSamA o mahA pratidAna|

tAhale sambhavata tumi tomAra upara avatIrNa ohIra kichu viSaYa cher3e deve evaM tomAra vuka saGkucita have e kAraNe ye, tArA vale, ‘kena tAra upara dhana-bhAnDAra avatIrNa haYani, kiMvA tAra sAthe pherezatA Aseni’? tumi to zudhu satarkakArI Ara AllAha sava kichura tattvAvadhAYaka|
nAki tArA vale, ‘se eTA raTanA kareche’? vala, ‘tAhale tomarA era anurUpa dazaTi sUrA vAniYe niYe Asa evaM AllAha chAr3A yAke pAra Deke Ana, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
ataHpara tArA yadi tomAdera AhavAne sAr3A nA deYa, tAhale jene rAkha, eTA AllAhara jJAna anusArei nAyila karA haYeche evaM tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAh nei| ataHpara tomarA ki anugata have?
ye vyakti duniYAra jIvana o tAra jaulusa kAmanA kare, Ami sekhAne tAderake tAdera Amalera phala puropuri diYe dei evaM sekhAne tAderake kama deYA have nA|
erAi tArA, AkhirAte yAdera janya Aguna chAr3A Ara kichui nei evaM tArA sekhAne yA kare tA varavAda haYe yAve Ara tArA yA karata, tA sampUrNa vAtila|

yArA tAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita evaM anusaraNa kare tA~ra pakSa theke ekajana sAkSI* evaM yAra pUrve raYeche mUsAra kitAva pathapradarzaka o rahamatasvarUpa,(tArA ki ai lokadera mata, yArA duniYA o tAra jaulusa kAmanAYa vibhora?) erAi tAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare| Ara ye sakala dala tA asvIkAra kare, Agunai have tAdera pratizruta sthAna| sutarAM tumi ete moTeo sandehera madhye theko nA, nizcaYa tA tomAra ravera pakSa theke prerita satya| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa ImAna Ane nA| * sAkSI dvArA muhAmmAda sA. ke vujhAno haYeche|

yArA AllAhara vyApAre mithyA raTanA kare, tAdera ceYe adhika yAlima ke? tAderake tAdera ravera sAmane upasthita karA have evaM sAkSIgaNa valave, ‘erAi tAdera ravera vyApAre mithyAropa karechila’| sAvadhAna, yAlimadera upara AllAhara lA‘nata|
yArA AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake vAdhA deYa evaM tAke vakra karate cAYa| Ara erAi to AkhirAta asvIkArakArI|
tArA yamIne (AllAhake) akSama karate pArata nA evaM AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI chila nA, tAdera janya AyAva dviguNa karA have| tArA zunate sakSama chila nA evaM dekhateo peta nA|
erA to nijaderai kSati kareche, Ara tArA yA raTiYe ver3Ata, tAdera theke tA hAriYe geche|
niHsandehe tArAi AkhirAte sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche, satkarma kareche evaM vinIta haYeche tAdera ravera prati, tArAi jAnnAtavAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
dala du’Tira upamA hacche andha o vadhira evaM cakSuSmAna o zravaNazaktisampannera mata, tulanAYa ubhaYa dala ki samAna? eraparao ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
Ara avazyai Ami nUhake preraNa karechilAma tAra kaomera kAche (ei vArtA diYe) ye, ‘Ami tomAdera janya spaSTa satarkakArI’|
‘yena tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta nA kara| nizcaYa Ami tomAdera upara yantraNAdAYaka divasera AyAvera bhaYa karachi’|

ataHpara tAra kaomera netRsthAnIYarA, yArA kupharI karechila, tArA valala, ‘AmarA to tomAke AmAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa chAr3A Ara kichu dekhachi nA evaM AmarA dekhachi ye, kevala AmAdera nIcu zreNIra lokerAi vivecanAhInabhAve tomAra anusaraNa kareche| Ara AmAdera upara tomAdera kona zreSThatva AmarA dekhachi nA; varaM AmarA tomAderake mithyAvAdI mane karachi’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA ki mane kara, yadi Ami AmAra ravera pakSa theke prerita pramANera upara pratiSThita hai evaM tini AmAke tA~ra pakSa theke rahamata diYe thAkena, Ara tA tomAdera kAche gopana rAkhA haYa, tave ki Ami tomAdera upara tomAdera apachanda haoYA sattveo tA cApiYe deva’?

‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, era vinimaYe Ami tomAdera kAche kona sampada cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna zudhu AllAhara kAche| yArA ImAna eneche, Ami tAdera tAr3iYe dite pAri nA| nizcaYa tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAt karave| kintu Ami to dekhachi tomarA eka ajJa jAti’|
‘he AmAra kaoma, yadi Ami tAderake tAr3iYe dei, tave AllAhara AyAva theke ke AmAke sAhAyya karave? eraparao ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA’?

‘Ara Ami tomAdera valachi nA ye, ‘AmAra kAche AllAhara bhAnDArasamUha Ache’ evaM Ami gAYeva jAni nA Ara Ami eo valachi nA ye, ‘Ami pherezatA’| tomAdera cokhe yArA hIna, tAdera samparke Ami valachi nA ye, ‘AllAha tAderake kakhano kona kalyANa dAna karavena nA’| tAdera antare yA Ache, se samparke AllAha adhika avagata| (yadi erUpa ukti kari) tAhale nizcaYa Ami yAlimadera antarbhukta hava’|

tArA valala, ‘he nUha, tumi AmAdera sAthe vAdAnuvAda karacha evaM AmAdera sAthe atimAtrAYa vivAda karecha| ataeva yAra pratizruti tumi AmAderake diccha, tA AmAdera kAche niYe Asa, yadi tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hao’|
se valala, ‘AllAhai to tomAdera kAche tA hAjira karavena, yadi tini cAna| Ara tomarA tAke akSama karate pArave nA’|
‘Ara Ami tomAderake upadeza dite cAileo AmAra upadeza tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA, yadi AllAha tomAdera vibhrAnta karate cAna| tini tomAdera rava evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have’|
nAki tArA vale, ‘se eTA racanA kareche’| vala, ‘yadi Ami tA racanA kare thAki, tave AmAra aparAdha AmAra uparai vartAve evaM tomarA ye aparAdha karacha, Ami tA theke mukta’|
Ara nUhera kAche ohI pAThAno hala ye, ‘yArA ImAna eneche, tArA chAr3A tomAra kaomera Ara keu ImAna Anave nA| sutarAM tArA yA kare se janya tumi duHkhita haYo nA’|
‘Ara tumi AmAra cokhera sAmane o AmAra ohI anusAre naukA tairI kara| Ara yArA yulama kareche, tAdera vyApAre tumi AmAra kAche kona Avedana karo nA| nizcaYa tAderake DuvAno have’|

Ara se naukA tairI karate lAgala evaM yakhanai tAra kaomera netRsthAnIYa kona vyakti tAra pAza diYe yeta, tAke niYe upahAsa karata| se valala, ‘yadi tomarA AmAdera niYe upahAsa kara, tave AmarAo tomAdera niYe upahAsa karava, yemana tomarA upahAsa karacha’|
ataeva, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave, kAra upara se AyAva Asave yA tAke lAJchita karave evaM kAra upara Apatita have sthAYI AyAva|

avazeSe yakhana AmAra Adeza Asala evaM culA uthale uThala*, Ami valalAma, ‘tumi tAte tule nAo pratyeka zreNI theke jor3A jor3A** evaM yAdera vyApAre siddhAnta haYe giYeche tAdera chAr3A tomAra parivArake evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake| Ara tAra sAthe alpasaMkhyakai ImAna enechila| * التنور era ArekaTi artha hala bhUpRSTha| plAvana zuru haoYAra Age bhUpRSThera savakhAna diYe pAni utsArita hate lAgala|
Ara se valala, ‘tomarA ete ArohaNa kara| era calA o thAmA have AllAhara nAme| nizcaYa AmAra rava ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara tA pAhAr3asama DheuYera madhye tAderake niYe calachila evaM nUha tAra putrake DAka dila, Ara se chila AlAdA sthAne- ‘he AmAra putra, AmAdera sAthe ArohaNa kara evaM kAphiradera sAthe theko nA’|

se valala, ‘acirei Ami ekaTi pAhAr3e AzraYa neva, yA AmAke pAni theke rakSA karave’| se (nUha) valala, ‘yAra prati AllAha daYA karechena se chAr3A Aja AllAhara Adeza theke kona rakSAkArI nei’| erapara tAdera ubhaYera madhye Dheu antarAYa haYe gela| ataHpara se nimajjitadera antarbhukta haYe gela |

Ara valA hala, ‘he yamIna, tumi tomAra pAni cuSe nAo, Ara he AsamAna, virata hao’| ataHpara pAni kame gela evaM (AllAhara) siddhAnta vAstavAYita hala, Ara naukA judI parvatera upara uThala evaM ghoSaNA karA hala, ‘dhvaMsa yAlima kaomera janya’|
Ara nUha tAra ravake DAkala evaM valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa AmAra santAna AmAra parivArabhukta evaM ApanAra oYAdA nizcaYa satya| Ara Apani vicArakadera madhye zreSTha vicAraka’|

tini valalena, ‘he nUha, se nizcaYa tomAra parivArabhukta naYa| se avazyai asat karmaparAYaNa| sutarAM ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei, AmAra kAche tA ceYo nA| Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi, yena mUrkhadera antarbhukta nA hao’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, ye viSaYe AmAra jJAna nei tA cAoYA theke Ami avazyai ApanAra AzraYa cAi| Ara yadi Apani AmAke mApha nA karena evaM AmAra prati daYA nA karena, tave Ami kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva’|

valA hala, ‘he nUha, tomAra o tomAra sAthe ye ummata raYeche tAdera upara AmAra pakSa theke zAnti o varakatasaha avataraNa kara| Ara Aro aneka ummatake Ami jIvana upabhoga karate deva, tArapara AmAra pakSa theke tAderake sparza karave yantraNAdAYaka AyAva’|
egulo gAYevera saMvAda, Ami tomAke ohIra mAdhyame tA jAnAcchi| itaHpUrve tA nA tumi jAnate evaM nA tomAra kaoma| sutarAM tumi savara kara| nizcaYa zubha pariNAma kevala muttAkIdera janya|

Ara Ada jAtira kAche (preraNa karechilAma) tAdera bhAi hUdake| se valechila, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera janya kona (satya) ilAha nei| tomarA to kevala mithyA raTanAkArI’|
‘he AmAra kaoma, Ami tomAdera kAche era vinimaYe kona pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna to kevala tA~rai kAche yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| eraparao ki tomarA vujhave nA’?

‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA tomAdera ravera kAche kSamA cAo ataHpara tAra kAche tAovA kara, tAhale tini tomAdera upara muSaladhAre vRSTi pAThAvena evaM tomAdera zaktira sAthe Aro zakti vRddhi karavena| Ara tomarA aparAdhI haYe vimukha haYo nA’|
tArA valala, ‘he hUda, tumi AmAdera kAche kona spaSTa pramANa niYe Asani, Ara tomAra kathAYa AmarA AmAdera upAsyadera tyAga karava nA evaM AmarA tomAra prati vizvAsIo nai’|

‘AmarA to kevala valachi ye, ‘AmAdera kona kona upAsya tomAke amaGgala dvArA AkrAnta kareche’| se valala, ‘nizcaYa Ami AllAhake sAkSI rAkhachi Ara tomarA sAkSI thAka ye, Ami avazyai tA theke mukta yAke tomarA zarIka kara,
AllAha chAr3A| sutarAM tomarA sakale AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara tArapara AmAke avakAza dio nA’|
‘Ami avazyai tAoYAkkula karechi AmAra rava o tomAdera rava AllAhara upara, pratiTi vicaraNazIla prANIrai tini niYantraNakArI| nizcaYa AmAra rava sarala pathe Achena’|

‘ataHpara tomarA yadi vimukha hao, tave yA niYe Ami tomAdera kAche prerita haYechi tA to tomAdera kAche pau~che diYechi| Ara AmAra rava tomAderake chAr3A anya eka jAtike sthalAbhiSikta karavena| Ara tomarA tA~ra kona kSati karate pArave nA| nizcaYa AmAra rava sava kichura hephAyatakArI’|
Ara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asala, Ami hUdake o yArA tAra sAthe ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dvArA rakSA karalAma evaM Ami kaThora AyAva theke tAderake nAjAta dilAma|
ei Ada jAti, tArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karechila evaM amAnya karechila tA~ra rAsUladera, Ara tArA anusaraNa karechila pratyeka uddhata, haThakArIra nirdeza|

Ara ei duniYAte lA‘nata tAdera pechane lAgiYe deYA haYeche evaM kiYAmata divaseo| jene rAkha, nizcaYa Ada jAti tAdera ravera sAthe kupharI kareche| jene rAkha, hUdera kaoma Ada jAtira janya raYeche dhvaMsa|

Ara sAmUda jAtira prati (pAThiYechilAma)tAdera bhAi sAlihake| se valala,‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei, tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya AvAdera* vyavasthA karechena | sutarAM tomarA tA~ra kAche kSamA cAo, ataHpara tA~rai kAche tAovA kara| nizcaYai AmAra rava nikaTe, sAr3AdAnakArI’| * ekhAne AvAdera vyavasthA karechena valate vujhAno haYeche tAderake adhivAsI karA athavA AvAdakArI vAnAno kiMvA tAderake dIrghajIvi karA|

tArA valala, ‘he sAliha, tumi to itaHpUrve AmAdera madhye chile pratyAzita| tumi ki AmAderake niSedha karacha tAdera ivAdAta karate AmAdera pitRpuruSarA yAdera ivAdAta karata? tumi AmAderake yAra dike AhavAna karacha, se vyApAre nizcaYa AmarA ghora sandehera madhye Achi’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA kI mane kara, yadi Ami AmAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera upara thAki evaM tini AmAke tA~ra pakSa theke rahamata dAna karena, tAhale ke AmAke AllAhara (AyAva) theke sAhAyya karave, yadi Ami tA~ra avAdhya hai? sutarAM tomarA to kevala AmAra kSatii vRddhi karacha’|

‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, eTi AllAhara uTa, tomAdera janya nidarzanasvarUpa| tAi tomarA eke cher3e dAo, se AllAhara yamIne (vicaraNa kare) khAve evaM konarUpa mandabhAve tAke sparza karo nA, tAhale tomAderake Azu AyAva pAkar3Ao karave’|
ataHpara tArA tAke hatyA karala| tAi se valala, ‘tomarA tina dina nija nija gRhe Anande kATAo| e emana eka oYAdA, yA mithyA havAra naYa’|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra Adeza ela, takhana sAliha o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dvArA nAjAta dilAma evaM (nAjAta dilAma) sei dinera lAJchanA theke| nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini zaktizAlI, parAkramazAlI|
Ara yArA yulama karechila, vikaTa AoYAja tAderake pAkar3Ao karala, phale tArA nijadera gRhe mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkala|
yena tArA segulote vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkha, nizcaYa sAmUda jAti tAdera ravera sAthe kupharI kareche| jene rAkha, sAmUda jAtira janya raYeche dhvaMsa|
Ara avazyai AmAra pherezatArA susaMvAda niYe ivarAhImera kAche Asala, tArA valala, ‘sAlAma’| seo valala, ‘sAlAma’| vilamva nA kare se ekaTi bhunA go vAchura niYe Asala|

ataHpara yakhana se dekhate pela, tAdera hAta era prati pau~chache nA, takhana tAderake asvAbhAvika mane karala evaM se tAdera theke bhIti anubhava karala| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa karo nA, nizcaYa AmarA lUtera kaomera kAche prerita haYechi’|
Ara tAra strI dA~r3Ano chila, se hese uThala| ataHpara Ami tAke susaMvAda dilAma isahAkera o isahAkera pare iYA‘kUvera|
se valala, ‘hAYa, kI Azcarya! Ami santAna prasava karava, athaca Ami vRddhA, Ara e AmAra svAmI, vRddha? eTA to avazyai eka Azcaryajanaka vyApAra’!
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara siddhAnte tumi Azcarya haccha? he navI parivAra, tomAdera upara AllAhara rahamata o tA~ra varakata| nizcaYa tini prazaMsita sammAnita’|
ataHpara yakhana ivarAhIma theke bhaYa dUra hala evaM tAra kAche susaMvAda ela, takhana se lUtera kaoma samparke AmAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karate lAgala|
nizcaYa ivarAhIma atyanta sahanazIla, adhika anunaYa vinaYakArI, AllAhamukhI|
he ivarAhIma, tumi e theke virata hao| nizcaYa tomAra ravera siddhAnta ese geche evaM nizcaYa tAdera upara Asave AyAva, yA pratihata havAra naYa|
Ara yakhana lUtera kAche AmAra pherezatA Asala, takhana tAdera (Agamanera) kAraNe tAra asvastivodha hala evaM tAra antara khuva saGkucita haYe gela| Ara se valala, ‘e to kaThina dina’|

Ara tAra kaoma tAra kAche chuTe Asala evaM itaHpUrve tArA manda kAja karata| se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, erA AmAra meYe, tArA tomAdera janya pavitra| sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra mehamAnadera vyApAre tomarA AmAke apamAnita karo nA| tomAdera madhye ki kona suvodha vyakti nei’?
tArA valala, ‘tumi avazyai jAna, tomAra meYedera vyApAre AmAdera kona praYojana nei| Ara AmarA kI cAi, tA tumi nizcaYa jAna’|

se valala, ‘tomAdera pratirodhe yadi AmAra kona zakti thAkata athavA Ami kona sudRr3ha stambhera AzraYa nite pAratAma’*! *‘sudRr3ha stambha’ valate zaktizAlI sainyasAmanta kiMvA kaoma athavA gotra vujhAno haYeche|

tArA valala, ‘he lUta, AmarA tomAra ravera prerita pherezatA, tArA kakhano tomAra kAche pau~chate pArave nA| sutarAM tumi tomAra parivAra niYe rAtera kona eka aMze raoYAnA hao, Ara tomAdera keu piche tAkAve nA| tave tomAra strI (raoYAnA have nA), kenanA tAke tA-i AkrAnta karave yA tAderake AkrAnta karave| nizcaYa tAdera (AyAvera) nirdhArita samaYa hacche sakAla| sakAla ki nikaTe naYa’?
ataHpara yakhana AmAra Adeza ese gela, takhana Ami janapadera uparake nIce ulTe dilAma evaM kramAgata por3AmATira pAthara varSaNa karalAma,
yA ci‎‎hnata chila tomAra ravera kAche| Ara tA yAlimadera theke dUre naYa|

Ara mAdaiYAne Ami (pAThiYechilAma) tAdera bhAi zu‘Aivake| se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona (satya) ilAha nei evaM mApa o oyana kama karo nA; Ami to tomAdera prAcuryazIla dekhachi, kintu Ami tomAdera upara eka sarvagrAsI dinera AyAvera bhaYa karachi’|
‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, mApa o oyana pUrNa kara inasAphera sAthe evaM mAnuSake tAdera paNya kama dio nA; Ara yamIne phAsAda sRSTi kare ver3io nA,
‘AllAhara deYA udvRtta lAbha tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi tomarA mumina hao| Ara Ami to tomAdera hiphAyatakArI nai’|

tArA valala, ‘he zu‘Aiva, tomAra sAlAta ki tomAke ei nirdeza pradAna kare ye, AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa yAdera ivAdAta karata, AmarA tAdera tyAga kari? athavA AmAdera sampade AmarA icchAmata yA kari tAo (tyAga kari?) tumi to veza sahanazIla suvodha’!

se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA kI mane kara, Ami yadi AmAra ravera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera upara thAki evaM tini AmAke tA~ra pakSa theke uttama riyka dAna kare thAkena (tAhale kI kare Ami AmAra dAYitva parityAga karava)! ye kAja theke Ami tomAderake niSedha karachi, tomAdera virodhitA kare se kAjaTi Ami karate cAi nA| Ami AmAra sAdhyamata saMzodhana cAi| AllAhara sahAYatA chAr3A AmAra kona taophIka nei| Ami tA~rai upara tAoYAkkula karechi evaM tA~rai kAche phire yAi’|

‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, AmAra sAthe vairitA tomAderake yena emana kAje prarocita nA kare yAra phale tomAdera serUpa AyAva Asave yerUpa esechila nUhera kaomera upara athavA hUdera kaomera upara athavA sAlihera kaomera upara| Ara lUtera kaoma to tomAdera theke dUre naYa’|
‘Ara tomarA tomAdera ravera kAche istigaphAra kara ataHpara tA~rai kAche tAovA kara| nizcaYa AmAra rava parama daYAlu, atIva bhAlavAsA poSaNakArI’|

tArA valala, ‘he zu‘Aiva, tumi yA vala, tAra aneka kichui AmarA vujhi nA| Ara tomAke to AmarA AmAdera madhye durvalai dekhate pAcchi| yadi tomAra AtmIYa-svajana nA thAkata, tave AmarA tomAke avazyai pAthara mere hatyA karatAma| Ara AmAdera upara tumi zaktizAlI nao’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma! AmAra svajanarA ki tomAdera kAche AllAha apekSA adhika sammAnita? Ara tomarA tA~ke ekevAre pechane Thele dile? tomarA yA kara, nizcaYa AmAra rava tA pariveSTana kare Achena’|

‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, tomarA tomAdera avasthAne kAja kare yAo, Amio kAja karachi| acirei tomarA jAnate pArave kAra kAche Asave se AyAva yA tAke lAJchita karave evaM ke mithyAvAdI| Ara tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna|

Ara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asala, takhana zu‘Aiva o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche, tAderake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dvArA nAjAta dilAma evaM yArA yulama karechila tAderake pAkar3Ao karala vikaTa AoYAja| phale tArA nija nija gRhe mukha thuvar3e par3e thAkala|
yena tArA sekhAne vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkha, dhvaMsa mAdaiYAnera janya, yerUpa dhvaMsa haYeche sAmUda jAti|
Ara Ami mUsAke AmAra AYAtasamUha* o spaSTa pramANa diYe pAThiYechi, * ekhAne ‘AYAta’ valate tAorAtake vujhAno haYeche evaM spaSTa pramANa dvArA AllAhara deYA vizeSa nidarzanasamUha vujhAno haYeche|
phira‘Auna o tAra netRvRndera kAche| ataHpara tArA phira‘Aunera nirdezera anusaraNa karala| Ara phira‘Aunera nirdeza saThika chila nA|
kiYAmata divase se tAra kaomera agrabhAge thAkave evaM tAderake Agune upanIta kare deve| yekhAne tArA upanIta have seTA upanIta haoYAra katainA nikRSTa sthAna!
Ara ekhAne (duniYAYa) lA‘nata tAdera pechane lAgiYe deYA haYeche evaM kiYAmata divaseo| ki nikRSTa pratidAna, yA tAdera deYA have|
e hacche janapadasamUhera kichu saMvAda, yA Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi| tA theke kichu Ache vidyamAna evaM kichu haYeche vilupta|

Ara Ami tAdera upara yulama karini, varaM tArA nijadera upara yulama kareche| tArapara yakhana tomAra ravera nirdeza Asala takhana AllAha chAr3A ye sava upAsyake tArA DAkata, tArA tAdera kona upakAra kareni evaM tArA dhvaMsa chAr3A tAdera Ara kichui vRddhi kareni|
Ara erUpai haYa tomAra ravera pAkar3Ao yakhana tini pAkar3Ao karena atyAcArI janapadasamUhake| niHsandehe tA~ra pAkar3Ao var3ai yantraNAdAYaka, kaThora|
nizcaYa ete raYeche nidarzana tAra janya ye AkhirAtera AyAvake bhaYa kare| seTi emana ekaTi dina, yedina sakala mAnuSake samaveta karA have evaM seTi emana eka dina, yedina savAi hAyira have|
Ara nirdiSTa kichukAlera janyai Ami tA vilamvita karachi|
yedina tA Asave sedina tA~ra anumati chAr3A keu kathA valave nA| ataHpara tAdera madhya theke keu durbhAgA, Ara keu saubhAgyavAna|
ataHpara yArA haYeche durbhAgA, tArA thAkave Agune| sekhAne thAkave tAdera cItkAra o ArtanAda|

sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, yatadina paryanta AsamAnasamUha o yamIna thAkave*, avazya tomAra rava yA cAna**| nizcaYa tomAra rava tA-i kare yA tini icchA karena| *‘yatadina paryanta AsamAnasamUha o yamIna thAkave’- e kathA dvArA AravI bhASAYa cirasthAYItvera udAharaNa deYA haYe thAke|

Ara yArA bhAgyavAna haYeche, tArA jAnnAte thAkave, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have yatadina paryanta AsamAnasamUha o yamIna thAkave, avazya tomAra rava yA cAna*, avyAhata pratidAnasvarUpa| * arthAt AllAha icchA karale tAderake jAnnAta theke vera kare dite pArena| tave tini tA karavena nA| kenanA tini nijei tAdera sthAYItvera ghoSaNA diYechena|

sutarAM erA yAdera upAsanA kare, tumi tAdera vyApAre saMzaYe theko nA| tArA to ivAdAta kare, yemana itaHpUrve ivAdAta karata tAdera pitRpuruSagaNa| nizcaYa Ami tAdera aMza hrAsa nA kare tAderake puropuri deva|

Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara tAte matavirodha karA haYechila| yadi tomAra ravera pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkata*, tave tAdera madhye mImAMsA haYe yeta| Ara nizcaYa tArA e vyApAre ghora sandehe raYeche| * arthAt aparAdhIke zAstira kSetre AllAha tAr3Ahur3A karavena nA, ei siddhAnta nA thAkale tAderake AllAha dhvaMsa kare ditena|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava savAike tAdera Amalera pratidAna puropuri dAna karavena| tArA yA Amala kare, avazyai tini se vyApAre savizeSa avahita|
sutarAM yebhAve tumi nirdezita haYecha sebhAve tumi o tomAra sAthI yArA tAovA kareche, sakale avicala thAka| Ara sImAlaGghana karo nA| tomarA yA karacha nizcaYa tini tAra samyaka draSTA|
Ara yArA yulama kareche tomarA tAdera prati jhu~ke par3o nA; anyathAYa Aguna tomAderake sparza karave evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA| ataHpara tomarA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

Ara tumi sAlAta kAYema kara divasera du’prAnte evaM rAtera prathama aMze*| nizcaYai bhAlakAja mandakAjake miTiYe deYa| eTi upadeza grahaNakArIdera janya upadeza| * dinera prathama prAnte phajarera sAlAta, dvitIYa prAnte yohara o Asarera sAlAta Ara rAtera prathama aMze mAgariva o izAra sAlAta| [tAphasIra ivana kAsIra, tAisIru kArImira rahamAna]|
tumi savara kara, nizcaYai AllAha tAAlA ihasAnakArIdera pratidAna naSTa karena nA|

ataeva tomAdera pUrvera prajanmasamUhera madhye emana prajJAvAna kena haYani, yArA yamIne phAsAda karA theke niSedha karata? alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A, yAderake Ami tAdera madhya theke nAjAta diYechilAma| Ara yArA yulama kareche, tArA vilAsitAra pechane par3e chila evaM tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ara tomAra rava emana nana ye, tini anyAYabhAve janapadasamUha dhvaMsa kare devena, athaca tAra adhivAsIrA saMzodhanakArI|
yadi tomAra rava cAitena, tave sakala mAnuSake eka ummate pariNata karatena, kintu tArA paraspara matavirodhakArI raYe geche,

tave yAderake tomAra rava daYA karechena, tArA chAr3A| Ara ejanyai tini tAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAra ravera kathA cUr3Anta haYeche ye, ‘nizcaYai Ami jAhAnnAma bhare deva jina o mAnuSa dvArA ekatre’|
Ara rAsUladera esakala saMvAda Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi yAra dvArA Ami tomAra manake sthira kari Ara ete tomAra kAche eseche satya evaM muminadera janya upadeza o smaraNa|
Ara yArA ImAna Anache nA tAderake vala, ‘tomarA sva sva avasthAne kAja kara AmarAo kAja karachi|
evaM tomarA apekSA kara AmarAo apekSamAna’|

AsamAnasamUha o yamInera gAYeva AllAharai evaM tA~rai kAche sava viSaYa pratyAvartita have| sutarAM tumi tA~ra ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ra upara tAoYAkkula kara| Ara tomarA yA kichu kara se vyApAre tomAra rava gAphela nana|
Alipha-lAma-rA| egulo suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
nizcaYa Ami eke AravI kuraAnarUpe nAyila karechi yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
Ami tomAra nikaTa sundaratama kAhinI varNanA karachi, e kuraAna AmAra ohI hiseve tomAra kAche preraNa karAra mAdhyame| yadio tumi era pUrve anavahitadera antarbhukta chile|
yakhana iusupha tAra pitAke valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, Ami dekhechi egAraTi nakSatra, sUrya o cA~dake, Ami dekhechi tAderake AmAra prati sijadAvanata avasthAYa’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra putra, tumi tomAra bhAidera nikaTa tomAra svapnera varNanA dio nA, tAhale tArA tomAra viruddhe gabhIra Sar3ayantra karave| nizcaYa zaYatAna mAnuSera prakAzya duzamana’|

Ara ebhAve tomAra rava tomAke manonIta karavena evaM tomAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA devena| Ara tomAra upara o iYAkUvera parivArera upara tA~ra niAmata pUrNa karavena yebhAve tini tA pUrve pUrNa karechilena tomAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera upara, nizcaYa tomAra rava sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
iusupha o tAra bhAidera kAhinIte jijJAsudera janya avazyai aneka nidarzana raYeche|
yakhana tArA valechila, ‘nizcaYa iusupha o tAra bhAi AmAdera pitAra nikaTa AmAdera ceYe adhika priYa, athaca AmarA ekai dala| nizcaYa AmAdera pitA suspaSTa vibhrAntitei Ache’|
‘tomarA iusuphake hatyA kara athavA tAke kona yamIne phele Asa, tAhale tomAdera pitAra AnukUlya kevala tomAdera janya thAkave evaM tomarA sat loka haYe yAve’|
tAdera madhya theke ekajana valala, ‘tomarA iusuphake hatyA karo nA, Ara yadi kichu karai, tAhale tAke kona kUpera gabhIre phele dAo, yAtrIdalera keu tAke tule niYe yAve’|
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, kI hala ApanAra, iusuphera vyApAre Apani AmAderake nirApada mane karachena nA, athaca AmarAi tAra hitAkAGkSI’?
‘Apani AgAmI kAla tAke AmAdera sAthe preraNa karuna, se sAnande ghorApherA karave o khelave| Ara avazyai AmarA tAra hephAyatakArI’|
se valala, ‘nizcaYa eTA AmAke kaSTa deve ye, tomarA tAke niYe yAve evaM Ami AzaGkA kari, nekar3e tAke kheYe phelave, yakhana tomarA tAra vyApAre gAphila thAkave’|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ekai dalabhukta thAkA sattveo yadi nekar3e tAke kheYe phele tAhale to AmarA avazyai kSatigrasta’|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke niYe gela evaM tAke kUpera gabhIre phele dite ekamata hala (takhana tArA tAi karala) evaM Ami tAra nikaTa ohI preraNa karalAma ei marme ye,‘avazyai tumi tAderake (bhaviSyate) tAdera ei karma samparke jAnAve, ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA upalavdhi karate pArave nA’|* * arthAt e anubhUti tAdera thAkave nA ye, tArA erakama kAnDa ghaTiYechila evaM iusuphake dekheo bhAi hiseve cinate pArave nA|
Ara tArA rAtera prathama bhAge kA~date kA~date tAdera pitAra nikaTa Asala|

tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmarA pratiyogitA karate giYechilAma Ara iusuphake rekhe giYechilAma AmAdera mAlapatrera nikaTa, ataHpara nekar3e tAke kheYe pheleche| Ara Apani AmAderake vizvAsa karavena nA, yadio AmarA satyavAdI hai’|

Ara tArA tAra jAmAYa mithyA rakta lAgiYe niYe esechila| se valala, ‘varaM tomAdera naphasa tomAdera janya ekaTi galpa sAjiYeche| sutarAM (AmAra karaNIYa hacche) sundara dhairya| Ara tomarA yA varNanA karacha se viSaYe AllAhai sAhAyyasthala’|

Ara ekaTi yAtrIdala Asala evaM tArA tAdera pAni saMgrahakArIke preraNa karala ataHpara se tAra vAlati phelala| se vale uThalo, ‘kI sukhavara! e ye ekaTi vAlaka’ evaM tArA tAke paNyadravya hiseve gopana kare phelala| Ara tArA yA kichu karachila se viSaYe AllAha samyaka jJAta|
Ara tArA tAke ati nagaNya mUlye kaYeka dirahAmera vinimaYe vikri kare dila evaM tArA tAra vyApAre chila anAgrahI|

Ara misarera ye vyakti tAke kraYa karechila, se tAra strIke valala, ‘era thAkAra sundara sammAnajanaka vyavasthA kara| AzA karA yAYa, se AmAdera upakAra karave athavA AmarA tAke putrarUpe grahaNa karava’ evaM ebhAvei Ami yamIne iusuphake pratiSThita karalAma evaM yena Ami tAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA dei| AllAha nija karma sampAdane pravala; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
Ara se yakhana pUrNa yauvane upanIta hala, Ami tAke hikamata o jJAna dAna karalAma evaM ebhAvei Ami ihasAnakArIdera pratidAna diYe thAki|

Ara ye mahilAra ghare se chila, se tAke kuprarocanA dila evaM darajAgulo vandha kare dila Ara valala, ‘eso’| se valala, AllAhara AzraYa (cAi)| nizcaYa tini AmAra maniva, tini AmAra thAkAra sundara vyavasthA karechena| nizcaYa yAlimagaNa saphala haYa nA|

Ara se mahilA tAra prati Asakta hala, Ara seo tAra prati Asakta hata, yadi nA tAra ravera spaSTa pramANa* pratyakSa karata| ebhAvei, yAte Ami tAra theke aniSTa o azlIlatA dUra kare dei| nizcaYa se AmAra khAlesa vAndAdera antarbhukta| * برهان artha ujjvala pramANa ekhAne nidarzana arthe vyavahRta haYeche| se nidarzanaTi kI chila e samparke vibhinna matAmata pAoYA yAYa | tAphasIre ivane kAchIre era vizada varNanA eseche| keu keu valena, tini nija pitA iYAkUvera mukhacchavi evaM tA~ra pakSa theke satarka iGgita peYechilena| AvAra keu keu valechena, AyIya misarera mukhacchavi dekhechilena| Ara kAro kAro mate sei vurahAna hacche AllAha pradatta vivekera nirdeza|

Ara tArA ubhaYe darajAra dike daur3e gela evaM mahilA pechana hate tAra jAmA chi~r3e phelala| Ara tArA mahilAra svAmIke darajAra kAche pela| mahilA valala, ‘ye loka tomAra parivArera sAthe mandakarma karate ceYeche, tAke kArAvandi karA vA yantranAdAYaka zAsti deYA chAr3A tAra Ara kI danDa hate pAre’?

se valala, ‘se-i AmAke kuprarocanA diYeche’| Ara mahilAra parivAra theke eka sAkSyadAtA sAkSya pradAna karala, ‘yadi tAra jAmA sAmanera dika theke che~r3A haYa tAhale se (mahilA) satya valeche evaM se (puruSa) mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta’|
‘Ara tAra jAmA yadi pechana theke che~r3A haYa tAhale se (mahilA) mithyA valeche evaM se (puruSa) hacche satyavAdIdera antarbhukta’|
ataHpara yakhana se dekhala, tAra jAmA pechana theke che~r3A takhana valala, ‘nizcaYa eTi tomAdera Sar3ayantra| nizcaYa tomAdera Sar3ayantra bhaYAnaka’|
‘iusupha, tumi e prasaGga er3iYe yAo, Ara (he nArI) tumi tomAra pApera janya istegaphAra kara| nizcaYa tumii pApIdera antarbhUkta’|
Ara nagarIte mahilArA valAvali karala, ‘AyIya patnI svIYa yuvakake kuprarocanA dicche| (yuvakera prati) gabhIra prema tAke Asakta kare pheleche, nizcaYa AmarA tAke prakAzya bhrAntite dekhate pAcchi’|

ataHpara yakhana se tAdera kUTakauzalera kathA zunate pela, takhana tAderake Deke pAThAla evaM tAdera janya Asana prastuta karala, Ara tAdera pratyekake ekaTi kare churi pradAna karala evaM iusuphake valala, ‘tAdera sAmane veriYe Asa’| ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke dekhala, takhana tAke vizAla saundaryera adhikArI mane karala evaM tArA nijadera hAta keTe phelala Ara valala, ‘mahimA AllAhara, eto mAnuSa naYa| e to eka sammAnita pherezatA’|

se valala, ‘e-i se, yAra vyApAre tomarA AmAke bhatrsanA karechile| Ara Amii tAke kuprarocanA diYechi; kintu se virata thekeche evaM Ami tAke yA Adeza karachi se yadi tA nA kare tave avazyai se kArAruddha have evaM nizcaYa se apadasthadera antarbhukta have’|

se (iusupha) valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tArA AmAke ye kAjera prati AhavAna karache tA theke kArAgArai AmAra nikaTa adhika priYa| Ara yadi Apani AmAra theke tAdera cakrAnta pratihata nA karena tave Ami tAdera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava evaM Ami mUrkhadera antarbhukta hava’|
ataHpara tAra rava tAra AhavAne sAr3A dilena evaM tAra theke tAdera cakrAnta pratihata karalena| nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tArapara nidarzanasamUha dekhAra pare tAdera kAche spaSTa hala, kichu kAla paryanta avazyai tArA tAke kArAruddha kare rAkhave|

Ara kArAgAre tAra sAthe praveza karala du’jana yuvaka| tAdera ekajana valala, ‘Ami svapne AmAke dekhate pelAma ye, Ami mada niMr3Acchi’| Ara apara jana valala, ‘Ami svapne AmAke dekhechi ye, Ami AmAra mAthAra upara ruTi vahana karachi tA theke pAkhi khAcche| Apani AmAderake era vyAkhyA avahita karuna| nizcaYa AmarA ApanAke ihasAnakArIdera antarbhukta dekhate pAcchi’|

se valala, ‘tomAderake ye khAdya deYA haYa tA tomAdera kAche AsAra pUrvei Ami tomAderake svapnera vyAkhyA jAniYe deva| seTi emana jJAna thekei valava yA AmAra rava AmAke zikSA diYechena| nizcaYai Ami parityAga karechi se kaomera dharma yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane nA evaM yArA AkhirAtake asvIkArakArI’|

‘Ara Ami anusaraNa karechi AmAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvera dharma| AllAhara sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karA AmAdera janya saGgata naYa| eTi AmAdera o sakala mAnuSera upara AllAhara anugraha| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA’|
he AmAra kArA saGgIdvaYa, vahu saMkhyaka bhinna bhinna rava bhAla nAki mahAparAkramazAlI eka AllAha’?

‘tomarA tA~ke vAda diYe nichaka katagulo nAmera ivAdAta karacha, yAdera nAmakaraNa tomarA o tomAdera pitRpuruSarA karecha, yAdera vyApAre AllAha pramANa nAyila karenani| vidhAna ekamAtra AllAharai| tini nirdeza diYechena ye, ‘tA~ke chAr3A Ara kAro ivAdAta karo nA’| eTii saThika dIna, kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA’|

‘he AmAra kArA saGgIdvaYa, tomAdera ekajana svIYa manivake madapAna karAve| Ara anyajanake zUle car3Ano have, ataHpara pAkhi tAra mAthA theke AhAra karave| ye viSaYe tomarA jAnate cAccha tAra siddhAnta haYe giYeche|

Ara tAdera du’janera madhye ye mukti pAve vale se dhAraNA karala tAke valala, ‘tomAra manivera kAche AmAra kathA ullekha karave’| kintu zaYatAna tAke svIYa manivera nikaTa ullekha karAra viSaYaTi bhuliYe dila| phale se kaYeka vachara kArAgAre avasthAna karala|

Ara vAdazAha valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhachi, sAtaTi moTA tAjA gAbhI, tAdera kheYe phelache sAtaTi kSINakAYa gAbhI evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o apara sAtaTi zuSka| he pAriSadavarga, tomarA AmAke AmAra svapna samvandhe vyAkhyA dAo yadi tomarA svapnera vyAkhyA diYe thAka’|
tArA valala, ‘eTi elomelo alIka svapna| Ara AmarA erUpa svapna vyAkhyAYa jJAnI nai’|
Ara se du’janera madhye ye mukti peYechila, se valala evaM dIrgha dina para tAra smaraNa hala, ‘Ami tomAderake era vyAkhyA jAniYe dicchi, ataeva tomarA AmAke pAThiYe dAo’|

‘he iusupha, he satyavAdI, Apani AmAdera vyAkhyA dina, sAtaTi moTA tAjA gAbhI samvandhe, yAdera khAcche sAtaTi kSINakAYa gAbhI evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o apara sAtaTi zuSka zISa samparke, yAte Ami lokadera kAche phire yete pAri yena tArA jAnate pAre’|
se valala, ‘tomarA sAta vachara ekAdhAre cASAvAda karave ataHpara ye zasya keTe ghare tulave tAra madhya theke ye sAmAnya parimANa khAve segulo chAr3A sava zISera madhye rekhe deve’|
‘tArapara Asave sAtaTi kaThina vachara| era janya tomarA pUrve yA saJcaYa kare rekhe deve erA (ai samaYera lokerA) segulo kheYe phelave, sAmAnya kichu chAr3A yA tomarA saMrakSaNa kare rAkhave’|
‘erapara Asave emana eka vachara yAte mAnuSa vRSTi sikta have evaM yAte tArA (phalera o yaYatunera) rasa niMr3Ave’|

Ara vAdazAha valala, ‘tomarA tAke AmAra kAche niYe Asa’| ataHpara yakhana dUta tAra kAche Asala takhana, se valala, tumi tomAra manivera nikaTa phire giYe tAke jijJAsA kara, ye sava mahilA nija nija hAta keTe phelechila tAdera avasthA kI? nizcaYa AmAra rava tAdera Sar3ayantra samparke samyaka jJAta’|

vAdazAha valala, ‘tomarA yakhana iusuphake kuprarocanA diYechile takhana tomAdera kI haYechila’? tArA valala, ‘mahimA AllAhara! AmarA tAra vyApAre khArApa kichu jAni nA’| AyIya patnI valala, ‘ekhana satya prakAza peYeche, Amii tAke kuprarocanA diYechi| Ara nizcaYa se satyavAdIdera antarbhukta’|
eTi e janya ye, yAte se jAnate pAre, Ami tAra anupasthitite tAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karini| Ara AllAha avazyai vizvAsaghAtakadera cakrAnta lakSye pau~chate dena nA|
‘Ara Ami AmAra nAphsake pavitra mane kari nA, nizcaYa nAphsa manda kajera nirdeza diYe thAke, AmAra rava yAke daYA karena se chAr3A| nizcaYa AmAra rava kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

Ara vAdazAha valala, ‘tomarA tAke AmAra nikaTa niYe Asa, Ami tAke nijera janya Apana kare neva’| ataHpara yakhana se tAra sAthe kathA valala, takhana valala, ‘nizcaYa Aja tumi AmAdera nikaTa maryAdAvAna o AsthAbhAjana’|
se valala, ‘AmAke rASTrIYa koSAgArera dAYitva dina, nizcaYa Ami yathAyatha hephAyatakArI, suvijJa’|

Ara emanibhAve Ami iusuphake yamIne kartRtva pradAna karechi, se tAra yekhAne icchA avasthAna karate pArata| Ami yAke icchA svIYa rahamata dAna kari, Ara Ami satkarmazIladera pratidAna vinaSTa kari nA|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tAdera janya AkhirAtera pratidAnai uttama|
Ara iusuphera bhAiYerA Asala evaM tAra kAche praveza karala| ataHpara se tAderake cinala, athaca tArA tAke cinate pArala nA|

Ara se yakhana tAderake tAdera rasadasAmagrI prastuta kare dila, takhana valala, ‘tomarA tomAdera pitAra pakSa hate tomAdera eka bhAike AmAra kAche niYe Asa, tomarA ki dekha nA, Ami parimApe pUrNamAtrAYa dei evaM Ami uttama atithiparAYaNa?
Ara yadi tomarA tAke niYe nA Asa, tAhale AmAra nikaTa tomAdera janya kona parimApakRta (rasada) nei evaM tomarA AmAra nikaTavartIo haYo nA’|
tArA valala, ‘tAra viSaYe AmarA tAra pitAke rAji karAva, Ara eTi AmarA karavai’|
Ara se tAra yuvaka karmacArIderake valala, ‘tAdera paNyamUlya tAdera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe dAo, yAte parivArera nikaTa phire giYe tArA tA cinate pAre| AzA kari tArA phire Asave’|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera vAvAra kAche phire Asala, takhana valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmAdera janya parimApakRta rasada niSiddha karA haYeche| ataeva AmAdera sAthe AmAdera bhAike pAThAna, yena AmarA parimApa kare rasada Anate pAri| Ara avazyai AmarA tAra hephAyata karava’|
se valala, ‘tomAderake ki Ami tAra vyApAre nirApada mane karava, yemana nirApada mane karechilAma itaHpUrve tAra bhAiYera vyApAre? tave AllAha uttama hephAyatakArI evaM tinii sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|

Ara yakhana tArA tAdera mAla-patra khulala, takhana tArA dekhate pela tAdera paNyamUlya tAdera kAche pherata deYA haYeche| tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, AmarA Ara kI cAi? ei AmAdera paNyamUlya, tA AmAderake pherat deYA haYeche| Ara AmarA AmAdera parivAravargera janya khAdyasAmagrI niYe Asava, AmAdera bhAike hephAyata karava evaM Aro eka uTa vojhAi rasada vezi Anava, (vAdazAhra janya) ai rasada (pradAna) khuvai sahaja’|

se valala, ‘Ami tomAdera sAthe tAke kakhano pAThAva nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA AmAke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra pradAna kara ye, tAke avazyai AmAra kAche niYe Asave| tave tomarA (zatru vA vipada dvArA) veSTita hale bhinna kathA’| ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke pratizruti dila, takhana se valala, ‘AmarA yA valachi se vyApAre AllAhai sAkSI’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra chelerA, tomarA eka darajA diYe praveza karo nA, varaM bhinna bhinna darajA diYe praveza kara evaM AllAhara siddhAntera viparIte Ami tomAdera kona upakAra karate pArava nA| hukuma ekamAtra AllAharai| tA~rai upara Ami tAoYAkkula karachi evaM tA~rai upara yena sakala tAoYAkkulakArI tAoYAkkula kare’|

Ara yakhana tArA praveza karala, yebhAve tAdera pitA tAderake Adeza karechila, tA AllAhara hukumera viparIte tAdera kona upakAre Aseni, tave tA chila iYA‘kUvera manera ekaTi icchA, yA se vyakta karechila| Ara se chila jJAnI, kAraNa Ami tAke zikhiYechilAma| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
Ara yakhana tArA iusuphera nikaTa praveza karala, takhana se tAra bhAike nijera kAche sthAna dila evaM valala, ‘Ami tomAra bhAi, kAjei itaHpUrve tArA yA karata, tAte tumi duHkha peYo nA’|

ataHpara se yakhana tAderake tAdera rasadapatra prastuta kare dila, takhana tAra bhAiYera mAlapatre pAnapAtraTi rekhe dila| tArapara ekajana ghoSaka ghoSaNA karala, ‘ohe kAphelAra lokajana, nizcaYa tomarA cora’|
tArA odera dike phire valala, ‘tomarA kI hAriYecha’?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA vAdazAhra pAnapAtra hAriYechi, ye tA ene deve, tAra janya raYeche eka uTa vojhAi puraskAra| Ara Amii era yAmina’|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, tomarA nizcaYai jene giYecha, AmarA e deze azAnti sRSTi karate Asini, Ara AmarA cora nai’|
tArA valala, ‘tAhale tAra zAsti ki have, yadi tomarA mithyAvAdI hao’?
tArA valala, ‘tAra zAsti have, yAra mAlapatrera bhitara oTi pAoYA yAve, se-i have tAra vinimaYa| ebhAvei AmarA yAlemaderake zAsti diYe thAki’|

tArapara se tAra bhAiYera pAtrera pUrve tAdera pAtragulo diYe (tallAzI) zuru karala, tArapara seTi tAra bhAiYera pAtra theke vera karala, ebhAve Ami iusuphera janya kauzala karalAma| AllAhara icchA chAr3A vAdazAhra Aine se tAra bhAike rekhe dite pArata nA, Ami yAke icchA tAra maryAdA u~cu kare dei evaM pratyeka jJAnIra upara raYeche ekajana mahAjJAnI|

tArA valala, ‘yadi se curi kare thAke, tave itaHpUrve tAra eka bhAi curi karechila’| iusupha viSaYaTi nijera kAche gopana rAkhala, tAdera kAche prakAza karala nA, se (mane mane) valala, ‘tomAdera avasthAna to nikRSTatara, tomarA yA valacha, se samparke AllAha bhAlabhAvei avagata’|
tArA valala, ‘he AyIya, tAra pitA var3a vRddha, Apani tAra sthale AmAdera ekajanake nina, AmarA to ApanAke dekhachi satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
se valala, ‘yAra kAche AmAdera mAla peYechi tAke chAr3A anyake pAkar3Ao karA hate AllAhara AzraYa cAcchi, emana karale AmarA haYe yAva nizcita yAlima’|

tArapara yakhana tArA tAra vyApAre nirAza hala, takhana tArA parAmarza karate ekAnte milita hala| tAdera var3ajana valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna nA ye, tomAdera pitA tomAdera kAcha theke AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra niYechena, Ara itaHpUrve tomarA iusuphera vyApAre ye anyAYa karecha? sutarAM yatakSaNa nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati devena athavA AllAha AmAra vyApAre phaYasAlA karavena, tatakSaNa paryanta Ami edeza cher3e yAva nA evaM tini sarvottama phaYasAlAkArI’|
‘tomarA tomAdera pitAra nikaTa phire yAo evaM vala, he AmAdera pitA, ApanAra chele to curi kareche, Ara AmarA yA jAni tA~rai sAkSya diYechi evaM AmarA gAYeva saMrakSaNakArI nai’|
‘Ara ye janapade AmarA chilAma tAke jijJAsA karuna evaM ye kAphelAra sAthe AmarA esechi tAderakeo, Ara avazyai AmarA satyavAdI’|

se valala, ‘varaM tomAdera nAphsa tomAdera janya ekaTi galpa sAjiYeche, sutarAM (AmAra karaNIYa hacche) sundara dhairya| AzA kari, AllAha tAdera sakalake AmAra kAche phiriYe Anavena, nizcaYai tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa’|
Ara tAdera theke se mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, ‘iusuphera janya Aphasosa’! Ara duHkhe tAra cakSudvaYa sAdA haYe gela, kintu se to saMvaraNakArI|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, Apani to iusuphake smaraNa karatei thAkavena, yatakSaNa nA Apani dhvaMsera dvAraprAnte pau~chavena athavA dhvaMsa haYe yAvena’|
se valala, ‘Ami AllAhara kAchei AmAra duHkha vedanAra abhiyoga jAnAcchi| Ara AllAhara pakSa theke Ami yA jAni, tomarA tA jAna nA’|

‘he AmAra chelerA, tomarA yAo evaM iusupha o tAra bhAiYera kho~ja khavara nAo| Ara tomarA AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA, kenanA kAphira kaoma chAr3A keui AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYa nA’|

ataHpara yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche praveza karala, takhana valala, ‘he AyIya, abhAva-anaTana AmAderake o AmAdera parivArake sparza kareche, Ara AmarA tuccha pu~ji niYe esechi| ataeva, AmAderake mApe pUrNamAtrAYa dina evaM AmAdera prati anugraha karuna, nizcaYa AllAha anugrahakArIdera pratidAna dena’|
se valala, ‘tomAdera jAnA Ache ki, iusupha o tAra bhAiYera sAthe tomarA kirUpa AcaraNa karechile, yakhana tomarA ajJa chile’?

tArA valala, ‘tumi ki satyii iusupha’? se valala, Ami iusupha, Ara e AmAra sahodara| AllAha AmAdera upara anugraha karechena| nizcaYa ye vyakti tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM savara kare, tave avazyai AllAha satkarmazIladera pratidAna vinaSTa karena nA’|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, AllAha AmAdera upara tomAke prAdhAnya diYechena, Ara AmarAi chilAma aparAdhI’|
se valala, ‘Aja tomAdera upara kona bhatrsanA nei, AllAha tomAdera kSamA karuna| Ara tini savaceYe vezi daYAlu’|
‘tomarA AmAra e jAmATi niYe yAo, ataHpara seTi AmAra pitAra cehArAYa phela| ete tini dRSTizakti phire pAvena| Ara tomarA tomAdera parivArera sakalake niYe AmAra kAche cale Asa’|
Ara yakhana kAphelA vera hala, tAdera pitA valala, ‘nizcaYa Ami iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi, yadi tomarA AmAke nirvodhavRddha mane nA kara’|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama, Apani to sei purona bhrAntitei Achena’|

ataHpara yakhana susaMvAdadAtA ela, takhana se jAmATi tAra cehArAYa phelala| ete se dRSTizakti phire pela, valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake valini, nizcaYa Ami AllAhara pakSa theke yA jAni tomarA tA jAna nA’|
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA, Apani AmAdera pApa mocanera janya kSamA cAna| nizcaYa AmarA chilAma aparAdhI’|
se valala, ‘acirei Ami tomAdera janya AmAra ravera nikaTa kSamA cAiva, nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
ataHpara yakhana tArA iusuphera nikaTa praveza karala, takhana se tAra pitAmAtAke nijera kAche sthAna kare dila evaM valala, ‘AllAhara icchAYa ApanArA nirApade misare praveza karuna’|

Ara se tAra pitAmAtAke rAjAsane uThAla evaM tArA sakale tAra sAmane sejadAYa luTiYe par3ala evaM se valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, ei hala AmAra itaHpUrvera svapnera vyAkhyA, AmAra rava tA vAstave pariNata karechena Ara tini AmAra upara ehasAna karechena, yakhana AmAke jelakhAnA theke vera karechena evaM tomAderake grAma theke niYe esechena, zaYatAna AmAra o AmAra bhAidera madhye samparka naSTa karAra para| nizcaYa AmAra rava yA icchA karena, tA vAstavAYane tini sUkSmadarzI| nizcaYa tini samyaka jJAnI, prajJAmaYa’|

‘he AmAra rava, Apani AmAke kichu rAjatva dAna karechena evaM svapnera kichu vyAkhyA zikhiYechena| he AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sraSTA, duniYA o AkhirAte Apanii AmAra abhibhAvaka, AmAke musalima avasthAYa mRtyu dina evaM nekakAradera sAthe AmAke yukta karuna’|
egulo gAYevera saMvAda, yA Ami tomAra kAche ohI karachi| tumi to tAdera nikaTa chile nA yakhana tArA tAdera siddhAnte ekamata haYechila athaca tArA Sar3ayantra karachila|
Ara tumi AkAGkhA karaleo adhikAMza mAnuSa mumina havAra naYa|
Ara tumi era upara tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAo nA, e to (kuraAna) samagra sRSTira janya upadezamAtra|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne kata nidarzana raYeche, yA tArA atikrama kare cale yAYa, athaca segulo theke tArA vimukha|
tAdera adhikAMza AllAhara prati vizvAsa kare, tave (ivAdAte) ziraka karA avasthAYa|
Ara tArA ki nirApada vodha karache ye, tAdera upara AllAhara pakSa theke kona sarvagrAsI AyAva Asave nA athavA haThAt tArA Tera nA petei kiYAmata upasthita have nA?
vala, ‘eTA AmAra patha| Ami jene-vujhe AllAhara dike dAoYAta dei evaM yArA AmAra anusaraNa kareche tArAo| Ara AllAha pavitra mahAna evaM Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai’|

Ara Ami tomAra pUrve janapadavAsI theke puruSaderakei kevala rAsUla hiseve preraNa karechi, yAdera upara Ami ohI nAyila karatAma| tArA ki yamIne vicaraNa kare nA| tAhale dekhata, tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNati kirUpa haYeche? Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya AkhirAtera AvAsanai uttama, tavuo ki tomarA vujha nA?

avazeSe yakhana rAsUlagaNa (kaomera ImAna theke) nirAza haYe gela evaM tArA* mane karala tAdera sAthe mithyA valA haYeche, takhana tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya Asala, ataHpara Ami yAke icchA nAjAta dei, Ara aparAdhI kaoma theke AmAra zAsti pherAno haYa nA| * (ka) ekhAne ‘tArA’ valate rAsUladera anusArIdera vujhAno haYeche| artha have- tAdera sAthe sAhAyyera mithyA AzvAsa deYA haYeche| (kha) athavA virodhIdera vujhAno haYeche| takhana artha have- tAderake zAstira mithyA bhIti pradarzana karA haYeche| (ga) Ara yadi ‘tArA’ valate svaYaM rAsUladera vujhAno haYa, takhana artha have- rAsUlagaNa dhAraNA karechena, tAdera prati mithyAropa karA haYeche|

tAdera e kAhinIgulote avazyai vuddhimAnadera janya raYeche zikSA, eTA kona vAnAno galpa naYa, varaM tAdera pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI evaM pratiTi viSaYera vistArita vivaraNa| Ara hidAYAta o rahamata ai kaomera janya yArA ImAna Ane|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-rA; egulo kitAvera AYAta, Ara tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra upara yA kichu nAyila haYeche tA satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa ImAna Ane nA|

AllAha, yini khu~Ti chAr3A AsamAnasamUha u~cu karechena yA tomarA dekhacha| ataHpara tini Araze uThechena evaM sUrya o cA~dake niYojita karechena| era pratyekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta calave| tini savakichu paricAlanA karena| AYAtasamUha vistArita varNanA karena, yAte tomAdera ravera sAkSAtera vyApAre tomarA dRr3havizvAsI hate pAra|

Ara tinii yamInake vistRta karechena evaM tAte sudRr3ha parvatamAlA o nada-nadI sthApana karechena| Ara pratyeka prakArera phala tini jor3A jor3A kare sRSTi karechena| tini rAta dvArA dinake Dheke dena| nizcaYa ye kaoma cintAbhAvanA kare tAdera janya ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

Ara yamIne Ache paraspara pAzApAzi bhUkhanDa, AGgura-vAgAna, zasyakSeta, khejura gAcha, yegulora madhye kichu ekai mUla theke udagata Ara kichu bhinna bhinna mUla theke udagata, yegulo ekai pAni dvArA seca karA haYa, Ara Ami khAoYAra kSetre ekaTike aparaTira tulanAYa utkRSTa kare dei, ete nidarzana raYeche ai kaomera janya yArA vujhe|

Ara yadi tumi Azcarya vodha kara, tAhale Azcaryajanaka hala tAdera e vaktavya, ‘AmarA yakhana mATi haYe yAva, takhana ki AmarA natuna sRSTite pariNata hava’? erAi tArA, yArA tAdera ravera sAthe kupharI kareche, Ara odera galAYa thAkave zikala evaM orA agnivAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

Ara tArA tomAra kAche bhAlora pUrve mandera janya tAr3Ahur3A kare, athaca tAdera pUrve aneka (anurUpa lokadera) zAsti gata haYeche| Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla tAdera yulama sattveo evaM nizcaYa tomAra rava kaThina zAstidAtA|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche, tArA vale, ‘tAra upara tAra ravera pakSa theke kona nidarzana nAyila haYa nA kena’? tumi to kevala satarkakArI, Ara pratyeka kaomera janya raYeche hidAYAtakArI|
AllAha jAnena yA pratiTi nArI garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM garbhAzaYe yA kame o vAr3e| Ara tA~ra nikaTa pratiTi vastu nirdiSTa parimANe raYeche|
tini gAYeva o prakAzyera jJAnI, mahAna, sarvocca|
tomAdera madhye keu kathA gopana rAkhuka vA prakAza karuka| Ara rAte lukiYe karuka vA dine prakAzye karuka, savai tA~ra nikaTa samAna|

mAnuSera janya raYeche, sAmane o pechane, ekera para eka AgamanakArI praharI, yArA AllAhara nirdeze tAke hephAyata kare| nizcaYa AllAha kona kaomera avasthA tatakSaNa parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| Ara yakhana AllAha kona jAtira manda cAna, takhana tA pratihata karA yAYa nA evaM tAdera janya tini chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka nei|
tinii bhaYa o AzA saJcAra karAra janya tomAderake vijalI dekhAna evaM tini bhArI meghamAlA sRSTi karena|

Ara vajra tAra saprazaMsa tAsavIha pATha kare evaM pherezatArAo tAra bhaYe| Ara tini garjanakArI vajra pAThAna| ataHpara yAke icchA tA dvArA AghAta karena evaM tArA AllAha samvandhe jhagar3A karate thAke| Ara tini zaktite pravala, zAstite kaThora|

satyera AhavAna tA~rai, Ara yArA tAke chAr3A anyaderake DAke, tArA tAdera DAke sAmAnyao sAr3A dite pAre nA, varaM (tAdera dRSTAnta) ai vyaktira mata, ye pAnira dike tAra du’hAta vAr3iYe deYa yena tA tAra mukhe pau~che athaca tA tAra kAche pau~chavAra naYa| Ara kApheradera DAka to zudhu bhraSTatAYa paryavasita haYa|
Ara AllAhara janyai AsamAnasamUha o yamInera savakichu anugata o vAdhya haYe sijadA kare evaM sakAla o sandhyAYa tAdera chAYAguloo|[sAjadAha]

vala, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rava ke’? vala, ‘AllAha’| tumi vala, ‘tomarA ki tA~ke chAr3A emana kichuke abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa karecha, yArA tAdera nijadera kona upakAra athavA apakArera mAlika nA’? vala, ‘andha o dRSTimAna vyakti ki samAna hate pAre? nAki andhakAra o Alo samAna hate pAre? nAki tArA AllAhara janya emana katagulo zarIka nirdhAraNa kareche, yegulo tA~ra sRSTira tulya kichu sRSTi kareche, phale tAdera nikaTa sRSTira viSaYaTi ekarakama mane haYeche’? vala, ‘AllAhai savakichura sRSTikartA evaM tini eka, ekacchatra kSamatAdhara’|

tini AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karena, ete upatyakAgulo tAdera parimANa anusAre plAvita haYa, phale plAvana uparasthita phenA vahana kare niYe yAYa| Ara alaMkAra o taijasapatra tairIra uddezye tArA Agune yA kichu uttapta kare tAteo anurUpa phenA haYa| emanibhAve AllAha haka o vAtilera dRSTAnta dena| ataHpara phenAgulo niHzeSa haYe yAYa, Ara yA mAnuSera upakAra kare, tA yamIne theke yAYa| emanibhAvei AllAha dRSTAntasamUha peza kare thAkena|
