yArA tAdera ravera DAke sAr3A deYa, tAdera janya raYeche uttama pratidAna| Ara yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYani, yadi tArA yamIne yA Ache tAra savakichu o era samaparimANera mAlika haYe yAYa, tAhale tArA tA muktipaNasvarUpa avazyai diYe dita| tAdera janya raYeche manda hisAva evaM tAdera AvAsa jAhAnnAma, Ara tA nikRSTatama zayyAsthala|
ye vyakti jAne tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra prati yA nAyila haYeche, tA satya, se ki tAra mata, ye andha? vuddhimAnarAi zudhu upadeza grahaNa kare|
yArA AllAhara aGgIkAra pUrNa kare evaM pratijJA bhaGga kare nA|
Ara AllAha ye samparka aTuTa rAkhAra nirdeza diYechena, yArA tA aTuTa rAkhe evaM tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, Ara manda hisAvera AzaGkA kare|

yArA tAdera ravera santuSTi lAbhera uddezye savara kare, sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAdera ye riyka pradAna karechi, tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM bhAla kAjera mAdhyame mandake dUra kare, tAdera janyai raYeche AkhirAtera zubha pariNAma|

sthAYI jAnnAtasamUha, yAte tArA evaM tAdera pitRpuruSagaNa, tAdera strIgaNa o tAdera santAnadera madhye yArA sat chila tArA praveza karave| Ara pherezatArA pratiTi darajA diYe tAdera nikaTa praveza karave|
(Ara valave) ‘zAnti tomAdera upara, kAraNa tomarA savara karecha, Ara AkhirAtera e pariNAma katai nA uttama’|

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe dRr3habhAve aGgIkAra karAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM AllAha ye samparka aTuTa rAkhAra nirdeza diYechena tA chinna kare evaM yamIne phAsAda sRSTi kare, tAdera janyai lA‘nata Ara tAdera janyai raYecha AkhirAtera manda AvAsa|
AllAha yAra janya icchA karena riyaka vAr3iYe dena evaM saGkucita karena| Ara tArA duniYAra jIvana niYe utphullatAYa Ache, athaca AkhirAtera tulanAYa duniYAra jIvana khuvai nagaNya|

Ara yArA kupharI kareche, tArA vale, ‘tAra nikaTa tAra ravera pakSa theke kona nidarzana kena nAyila haYa nA’? vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM ye tA~ra abhimukhI haYa, tAke tini tA~ra dike patha dekhAna’|
‘yArA ImAna Ane evaM AllAhara smaraNe yAdera antara prazAnta haYa; jene rAkha, AllAhara smaraNa dvArAi antarasamUha prazAnta haYa’|
‘yArA ImAna Ane evaM neka Amala kare, tAdera janya raYeche svAcchanda o sundara pratyAvartanasthala’|

emanibhAve Ami tomAke pAThiYechi emana eka jAtira nikaTa, yAra pUrve aneka jAti gata haYeche, yena Ami tomAra prati ye ohI preraNa karechi, tA tAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta kara| athaca tArA rahamAnake asvIkAra kare| vala, ‘tini AmAra rava, tini chAr3A Ara kona (satya) ilAha nei, tA~rai upara Ami tAoYAkkula karechi evaM tA~rai dike AmAra pratyAvartana’|

Ara yadi emana kona kuraAna hata, yAra dvArA pAhAr3asamUhake calamAna karA yeta athavA yamInake Tukaro-Tukaro karA yeta athavA tAra dvArA mRtake kathA valAno yeta (tave seTA ei kuraAnai hata, Ara tArA ImAna Anata nA)| varaM sava siddhAnta AllAharai| yArA ImAna eneche, tArA ki (odera ImAnera vyApAre) nirAza haYani evaM tArA jAne ye, AllAha icchA karale samagra mAnuSake hidAYAta dAna karatena? Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAdera karmera daruna sarvadA tAdera vipada ghaTate thAkave athavA tAdera AvAsera AzapAze vipada Apatita hate thAkave,* avazeSe Asave AllAhara oYAdA| nizcaYa AllAha pratizrutira vyatikrama karena nA| * musalima sainyarA tAdera vipakSe avasthAna neYA, tAdera sAthe yuddha karA, tAdera hatyA karA,tAdera bhUkhanDa musalamAnadera karAYatva haoYA ityAdi| (ivna kAsIra)
Ara avazyai tomAra pUrve rAsUladera niYe upahAsa karA haYeche| ataHpara yArA kupharI kareche, Ami tAderake avakAza diYechi, tArapara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| ataeva, kemana chila AmAra AyAva!

tave ki pratiTi nAphsa yA upArjana kare yini tAra dAYitvazIla (tinii ivAdAtera adhika upayukta, nAki ei zarIkagulo?) etadasattveo tArA AllAhara sAthe aneka zarIka sAvyasta kareche| vala, ‘tomarA edera paricaYa dAo’| nAki tomarA tAke yamInera emana kichu jAnAve ye vyApAre tini jAnena nA? nAki tomarA bhAsAbhAsA kathA valacha? varaM yArA kupharI kareche tAdera nikaTa tAdera Sar3ayantrake zobhita karA haYeche evaM tArA sarala patha hate vAdhA pradAna kareche| Ara AllAha yAke pathahArA karena, tAra kona hidAYAtakArI nei|
tAdera janyai raYeche duniYAra jIvane AyAva, Ara AkhirAtera AyAva to Aro kaThina| AllAhara AyAva theke tAdera kona rakSAkArI nei|

muttAkIdera ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deYA haYeche, seTira dRSTAnta erUpa, tAra taladeze nadIsamUha pravAhita| tAra khAdyasAmagrI o tAra chAYA sArvakSaNika| yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, eTi tAdera zubha pariNAma Ara kAphiradera pariNAma Aguna|

Ara Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tomAra upara yA nAyila haYa, tAte tArA utphulla haYa| Ara dalagulora madhye keu keu era kichu aMzake asvIkAra kare| vala, ‘AmAke kevala Adeza deYA haYeche, yena Ami AllAhara ivAdAta kari evaM tA~ra sAthe zarIka nA kari| Ami tA~rai dike dAoYAta dei evaM tA~rai nikaTa AmAra pratyAvartanasthala’|

Ara ebhAvei Ami kuraAnake vidhAnasvarUpa AravIte nAyila karechi| tomAra nikaTa jJAna pau~chAra parao yadi tumi tAdera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa kara, tave AllAha chAr3A tomAra kona abhibhAvaka o rakSAkArI nei|

Ara avazyai tomAra pUrve Ami rAsUladera preraNa karechi evaM tAderake diYechi strI o santAna-santati| Ara kona rAsUlera janya eTA sambhava naYa ye, AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana niYe Asave| pratiTi sunirdiSTa samaYera janya raYeche lipivaddha vidhAna|
AllAha yA icchA karena miTiYe dena evaM yA icchA karena sthira rAkhena, Ara tA~ra kAchei raYeche mUla kitAva|
Ara ye pratizruti Ami tAderake dicchi, yadi tAra kichu tomAke dekhAi athavA tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi (tAte kichui Ase yAYa nA)| tave tomAra kartavya kevala pau~che deYA, Ara AmAra dAYitva hisAva neYA|
tArA ki dekhe nA, Ami yamInake caturdika theke saMkIrNa kare Anachi| Ara AllAhai hukuma karena evaM tA~ra hukuma pratyAkhyAna karAra keu nei evaM tinii druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

Ara tAdera pUrvavartIrAo Sar3ayantra karechila, athaca sakala Sar3ayantra AllAhara niYantraNe| pratiTi vyakti yA arjana kare, tini tA jAnena| Ara kAphirarA acirei jAnave AkhirAtera zubhapariNati kAdera janya|
Ara yArA kupharI kare, tArA vale, ‘tumi rAsUla nao’| vala, ‘AllAha AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa evaM yAra nikaTa kitAvera jJAna Ache seo‘|
Alipha-lAma-rA; ei kitAva, yA Ami tomAra prati nAyila karechi, yAte tumi mAnuSake tAdera ravera anumatikrame andhakAra theke Alora dike vera kare Ana, parAkramazAlI sarvaprazaMsitera pathera dike|
AllAhara (patha), AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sava kichui yAra mAlikAnAYa evaM kAphiradera janya raYeche kaThina AyAvera durbhoga|
yArA duniYAra jIvanake AkhirAta theke adhika pachanda kare, Ara AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYa evaM tAte vakratAra sandhAna kare; tArA ghoratara bhraSTatAYa raYeche|

Ara Ami pratyeka rAsUlake tAra kaomera bhASAtei pAThiYechi, yAte se tAdera kAche varNanA deYa, sutarAM AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA saThika patha dekhAna| Ara tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara Ami mUsAke AmAra AYAtasamUha diYe pAThiYechi ye, ‘tumi tomAra kaomake andhakAra hate Alora dike vera kare Ana evaM AllAhara divasasamUha* tAdera smaraNa kariYe dAo’| nizcaYa ete pratiTi dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya raYeche asaMkhya nidarzana| * divasasamUha dvArA uddezya itaHpUrvera aitihAsika ghaTanAsamUha|

Ara yakhana mUsA tAra kaomake valechila, tomAdera prati AllAhara niYAmAta smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAderake phira‘Auna parivArera kavala theke rakSA karechena, tArA tomAdera jaghanya AyAva dita| Ara tArA tomAdera chelederake yaveha karata evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| Ara tAte chila tomAdera ravera pakSa theke mahAparIkSA|
Ara yakhana tomAdera rava ghoSaNA dilena, ‘yadi tomarA zukariYA AdAYa kara, tave Ami avazyai tomAdera vAr3iYe deva, Ara yadi tomarA akRtajJa hao, nizcaYa AmAra AyAva var3a kaThina’|
Ara mUsA valala, ‘yadi tomarA o yamInera sakale kupharI kara, tAhale nizcaYa AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita’|

tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera pUrvera lokadera saMvAda paucheni? nUha, Ada o sAmUda jAtira evaM yArA tAdera parera, yAderake AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA| tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila, phale tArA phiriYe dila tAdera hAta tAdera mukhe evaM valala, ‘nizcaYa tomAderake yA diYe preraNa karA haYeche, tA AmarA asvIkAra karalAma| Ara tomarA AmAdera ye viSaYera prati dAoYAta diccha, se viSaYe AmarA ghora sandehe raYechi’|

tAdera rAsUlagaNa valechila, ‘AllAhara vyApAreo ki sandeha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTikartA? tini tomAderake AhavAna karena yAte tini tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA karena evaM tini nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tomAderake avakAza dena’| tArA valala, ‘tomarA to AmAdera matai mAnuSa, ‘tomarA AmAderake AmAdera pitRpuruSarA yAra ivAdAta karata, tA theke phirAte cAo| ataeva tomarA AmAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe Asa’|

tAderake tAdera rAsUlagaNa valala, ‘AmarA to kevala tomAdera matai mAnuSa, kintu AllAha tAra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA anugraha karena| Ara AllAhara anumati chAr3A tomAdera kAche pramANa niYe AsAra sAdhya AmAdera nei| Ara kevala AllAhara uparai muminadera tAoYAkkula karA ucita’|

‘Ara AmarA kena AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula karava nA, athaca tinii AmAderake AmAdera pathera dizA diYechena| Ara tomarA AmAdera ye kaSTa diccha, AmarA tAra upara avazyai savara karava| Ara AllAhara uparai yena tAoYAkkulakArIrA tAoYAkkula kare’|

Ara yArA kupharI kareche, tArA tAdera rAsUladera valala, ‘AmarA tomAderake AmAdera bhU-khanDa theke avazyai vera kare deva, athavA tomarA avazyai AmAdera millAte phire Asave’| ataHpara tAdera rava tAdera nikaTa ohI pAThAlena, ‘Ami avazyai yAlimadera dhvaMsa kare deva’|
‘Ara nizcaYa Ami tAdera para tomAderake yamIne vAsa karate deva| eTA tAra janya, ye AmAra avasthAnake bhaYa kare evaM bhaYa kare AmAra dhamakera’|
Ara tArA vijaYa kAmanA karala, Ara vyartha hala sakala svecchAcArI, haThakArI|
era sAmane raYeche jAhAnnAma, Ara tAdera pAna karAno have galita pu~ja theke|
se tA gilate cAive evaM prAYa sahaje se tA gilate pArave nA| Ara tAra kAche sakala sthAna theke mRtyu dhe~Ye Asave, athaca se marave nA| Ara era pareo raYeche kaThina AyAva |

yArA tAdera ravera sAthe kupharI kare tAdera AmalasamUhera dRSTAnta hala emana chAiYera mata, pravala ghurNijhar3era dine vAtAsa pracanDa vege yA vahana kare niYe yAYa| tArA yA arjana kareche, tAra mAdhyame kichui karate pAre nA| e to ghoratara vibhrAnti|
tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha AsamAnasamUha evaM yamIna sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve? tini icchA karale tomAderake nizci‎hna karate pArena evaM astitve Anate pArena natuna sRSTi |
Ara eTA AllAhara janya moTei kaThina naYa|

Ara tArA savAi AllAhara sAmane hAjira have, ataHpara yArA ahaGkAra kareche durvalarA tAderake valave, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAdera anusArI chilAma| sutarAM tomarA ki AllAhara AyAvera mokAvelAYa AmAdera kona upakAre Asave’? tArA valave, ‘yadi AllAha AmAdera hidAYAta karatena, tAhale AmarAo tomAdera hidAYAta karatAma, ekhana AmarA asthira hai kiMvA savara kari, ubhaYa avasthAi AmAdera janya samAna, AmAdera pAlAnora kona jAYagA nei’|

Ara yakhana yAvatIYa viSaYera phaYasAlA haYe yAve, takhana zaYatAna valave, ‘nizcaYa AllAha tomAderake oYAdA diYechilena satya oYAdA, tomAdera upara AmAra kona Adhipatya chila nA, tave Amio tomAderake oYAdA diYechilAma, ekhana Ami tA bhaGga karalAma| tomAderake dAoYAta diYechi, Ara tomarA AmAra dAoYAte sAr3A diYecha| sutarAM tomarA AmAke bhatrsanA karo nA, varaM nijaderakei bhatrsanA kara| Ami tomAdera uddhArakArI nai, Ara tomarAo AmAra uddhArakArI nao| itaHpUrve tomarA AmAke yAra sAthe zarIka karecha, nizcaYa Ami tA asvIkAra karachi| nizcaYa yAlimadera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka AyAva’ |

Ara yArA ImAna Ane evaM neka Amala kare tAdera jAnnAte praveza karAno have, yAra taladeze naharasamUha pravAhita have, tArA tAte tAdera ravera anumatikrame sthAYI have| tathAYa tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’|
tumi ki dekha nA, AllAha kIbhAve upamA peza karechena? kAlimA tAiYevA, yA ekaTi bhAla vRkSera nyAYa, yAra mUla susthira Ara zAkhA-prazAkhA AkAze|
seTi tAra ravera anumatite sava samaYa phala dAna kare; Ara AllAha mAnuSera janya nAnA dRSTAnta pradAna karena, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ara apavitra vAkyera upamA nikRSTa vRkSera nyAYa, yAke mATira upara theke samUle upar3e phelA haYeche, yAra kona sthiti nei|
AllAha avicala rAkhena ImAnadAraderake sudRr3ha vANI dvArA duniYAra jIvane o AkhirAte| Ara AllAha yAlimadera pathabhraSTa karena evaM AllAha yA icchA tA karena|
tumi ki tAderake dekha nA, yArA AllAhara niAmatake kupharI dvArA parivartana kareche evaM tAdera kaomake dhvaMsera ghare nAmiYe diYeche?
jAhAnnAme, yAte tArA dagdha have, Ara tA katainA nikRSTa avasthAna!
Ara tArA AllAhara janya samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare, yena tArA tA~ra patha theke vibhrAnta karate pAre| vala, ‘tomarA bhoga karate thAka| kenanA, tomAdera gantavya to Agunera dike’|

AmAra vAndAdera vala, ‘yArA ImAna eneche, tArA yena sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, ai dina AsAra pUrve ye dina kona vecA-kenA thAkave nA evaM thAkave nA vandhutvao|

AllAha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena| Ara tini AsamAna theke vRSTi varSaNa karena phale tA dvArA phala-phalAdi theke tomAdera janya riyka utpAdana karena evaM tini nauyAnake tomAdera janya niYojita karechena, yAte tA~ra Adeze samudre tA calAcala kare evaM nadIsamUhake tomAdera janya niYojita karechena|
Ara tini sUrya o cA~dake tomAdera janya niYojita karechena virAmahInabhAve evaM tomAdera janya niYojita karechena rAta o dinake|

Ara tomarA yA ceYecha, tAra pratyekaTi theke tini tomAdera diYechena evaM yadi tomarA AllAhara niAmata gaNanA kara, tave tAra saMkhyA nirUpaNa karate pArave nA| nizcaYa mAnuSa adhika atyAcArI o akRtajJa|
Ara smaraNa kara ‘yakhana ivarAhIma valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani e zaharake nirApada kare dina evaM AmAke o AmAra santAnaderake mUrti pUjA theke dUre rAkhuna’|

‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa esava mUrti aneka mAnuSake pathabhraSTa kareche, sutarAM ye AmAra anusaraNa kareche, nizcaYa se AmAra dalabhukta, Ara ye AmAra avAdhya haYeche, tave nizcaYa Apani kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

‘he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa Ami AmAra kichu vaMzadharaderake phasalahIna upatyakAYa tomAra pavitra gharera nikaTa vasati sthApana karAlAma, he AmAdera rava, yAte tArA sAlAta kAYema kare| sutarAM kichu mAnuSera hRdaYa Apani tAdera dike jhu~kiYe dina evaM tAderake riyka pradAna karuna phala-phalAdi theke, AzA karA yAYa tArA zukariYA AdAYa karave’|
he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa Apani jAnena, yA AmarA gopana kari evaM yA prakAza kari, Ara kona kichu AllAhara nikaTa gopana nei, nA yamIne nA AsamAne|
‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini vRddha vaYase AmAke IsamAIla o isahAkake dAna karechena| nizcaYa AmAra rava do‘A zravaNakArI’|
‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAlAta kAYemakArI vAnAna evaM AmAra vaMzadharadera madhya thekeo, he AmAdera rava, Ara AmAra do‘A kavUla karuna’|
‘he AmAdera rava, yedina hisAva kAYema have, sedina Apani AmAke, AmAra pitAmAtAke o muminaderake kSamA kare divena’|
Ara yAlimarA yA karache, AllAhake tumi se viSaYe moTei gAphela mane karo nA, AllAha to tAdera avakAza dicchena, ai dina paryanta ye dina cokha palakahIna tAkiYe thAkave|
tArA mAthA tule daur3Ate thAkave, tAdera dRSTi nijadera dike phirave nA evaM tAdera antara have zUnya|

Ara tumi mAnuSaderake satarka kara, yedina tAdera upara AyAva neme Asave| ataHpara takhana yArA yulama kareche tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, tumi AmAderake kichu samaYera janya avakAza dAo, AmarA tomAra DAke sAr3A deva evaM rAsUladera anusaraNa karava’| itaHpUrve tomarA ki kasama karani ye, tomAdera kona patana nei?

Ara tomarA vAsa karachile sesava lokadera vAsasthAne, yArA nijadera upara yulama karata evaM tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa haYechila Ami tAdera sAthe kirUpa karechi evaM Ami tomAdera janya upamA varNanA karechi|
Ara tArA tAdera Sar3ayantra karechila, Ara AllAhara kAchei tAdera Sar3ayantra, yadio tAdera Sar3ayantra emana chila yA dvArA pAhAr3a apasArita haYe yAYa|
sutarAM tumi kakhano AllA¬hake tA~ra rAsUladera deYA pratizruti bhaGgakArI mane karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|
yedina e yamIna bhinna yamIne rUpAntarita have evaM AsamAnasamUhao| Ara tArA parAkramazAlI eka AllAhara sAmane hAyira have|
Ara se dina tumi aparAdhIdera dekhave tArA zikale vA~dhA|
tAdera pozAka have AlakAtarAra* evaM Aguna tAdera cehArAsamUhake Dheke phelave| * قطران hacche emana AlakAtarA, yAte druta Aguna dAu dAu kare jvale uThe|
eTA e janya ye, AllAha pratyekera kRtakarmera pratiphala divena, AllAha hisAva grahaNe tatpara|
eTA mAnuSera janya paYagAma| Ara yA dvArA tAderake satarka karA haYa evaM tArA jAnate pAre ye, tini kevala eka ilAha, Ara yAte vuddhimAnarA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Alipha-lAma-rA; e hala kitAva o suspaSTa kuraAnera AYAtasamUha|
kona kona samaYa kAphirerA AkAMkhA karave ye, tArA yadi musalima hata!
tAderake cher3e dAo, AhAre o bhoge tArA matta thAkuka evaM AzA tAderake gAphela kare rAkhuka, Ara acirei tArA jAnate pArave|
Ara Ami kona janapadake dhvaMsa karini tAra janya nirdhArita samaYa chAr3A|
kona jAtii tAdera sunirdhArita samaYa theke Age vAr3ate pAre nA Ara pichAteo pAre nA|
Ara tArA valala, ‘he ai vyakti, yAra upara kuraAna nAyila karA haYeche, tumi to nizcita pAgala’|
‘kena AmAdera kAche pherezatA niYe Asacha nA, yadi tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta haYe thAka’?
Ami yathAyatha kAraNa chAr3A pherezatAdera nAyila kari nA, Ara (nAyila karale) takhana tArA avakAzao peta nA|
nizcaYa Ami kuraAna* nAyila karechi, Ara Amii tAra hephAyatakArI| * الذكر dvArA uddezya kuraAna|
Ara Ami tomAra pUrve atIta sampradAYagulora madhye rAsUla preraNa karechi|
Ara yakhanai tAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla Asata tArA tAke niYe upahAsa karata|
emanibhAve Ami tA aparAdhIdera antare saJcAra kari|
tArA ete ImAna Anave nA, Ara pUrvavartIdera (vyApAre AllAhara) rIti to vigata haYeche|
Ara yadi Ami tAdera janya AsamAnera kona darajA khule ditAma, ataHpara tArA tAte ArohaNa karate thAkata |
tavuo tArA valata, nizcaYa AmAdera dRSTi ker3e neYA haYeche, varaM AmarA to yAdugrasta sampradAYa|
Ara Ami AsamAne sthApana karechi kakSapathasamUha evaM tAke saundaryamanDita karechi darzakadera janya|
Ara Ami tAke surakSita karechi pratyeka vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke|
tave ye gopane zone, tatkSaNAt suspaSTa jvalanta agnizikhA tAra pichu neYa|
Ara yamInake Ami vistRta karechi evaM tAte sudRr3ha pAhAr3a sthApana karechi| Ara tAte utpanna karechi sakala prakAra vastu sunirdiSTa parimANe |
Ara tAte tomAdera janya evaM tomarA yAra riyka dAtA nao tAdera janya rekhechi jIvanopakaraNa |
Ara pratiTi vasturai bhAnDArasamUha raYeche AmAra kAche evaM Ami tA avatIrNa kari kevala nirdiSTa parimANe|
Ara Ami vAYuke UrvarakArIrUpe preraNa kari ataHpara AsamAna theke vRSTi varSaNa kari evaM tA tomAdera pAna karAi| tave tomarA tAra saMrakSaNakArI nao|
Ara nizcaYa Ami jIvita kari o mRtyu dei evaM Amii oYArisa|
Ara avazyai Ami jAni tomAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM avazyai jAni paravartIderake|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava tAderake ekatra karavena| nizcaYa tini prajJAmaYa o sarvajJAnI|
Ara avazyai Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi zukano ThanaThane, kAlace kAdAmATi theke|
Ara itaHpUrve jinake sRSTi karechi uttapta agnizikhA theke|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAdera valalena, ‘Ami ekajana mAnuSa sRSTi karate yAcchi zukano ThanaThane kAlace mATi theke’|
‘ataeva yakhana Ami tAke pUrNAGga rUpa deva evaM tAra madhye AmAra rUha phu~ke deva, takhana tomarA tAra janya sijadAvanata hao’|
ataHpara, pherezatArA sakalei sijadA karala|
ivalIsa chAr3A| se sijadAkArIdera saGgI hate asvIkAra karala|
tini valalena, ‘he ivalIsa, tomAra kI hala ye, tumi sijadAkArIdera saGgI hale nA’?
se valala, ‘Ami to emana nai ye, ekajana mAnuSake Ami sijadA karava, yAke Apani sRSTi karechena zukano ThanaThane kAlace mATi theke’|
tini valalena, ‘tAhale tumi ekhAna theke veriYe yAo, tumi vitAr3ita’|
‘Ara nizcaYa kiYAmata divasa paryanta tomAra upara lA‘nata’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tAhale AmAke avakAza dina se dina paryanta, yedina tAderake punarujjIvita karA have’|
tini valalena, ‘tumi nizcaYa avakAzaprAptadera ekajana’|
‘nirdhArita samaYera dina paryanta’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, yehetu Apani AmAke pathabhraSTa karechena, tAi yamIne Ami tAdera janya (pApake) zobhita karava evaM nizcaYa tAdera sakalake pathabhraSTa karava’|
tAdera madhya theke ApanAra ekAnta vAndAgaNa chAr3A|
tini valalena, ‘eTA AmAra dike AnaYanakArI sarala patha’|
‘nizcaYa AmAra vAndAdera upara tomAra kona kSamatA nei, tave pathabhraSTarA chAr3A yArA tomAke anusaraNa kareche’|
‘Ara nizcaYa jAhAnnAma tAdera sakalera pratizruta sthAna’|
‘tAra sAtaTi darajA raYeche| pratiTi darajAra janya raYeche tAdera madhya theke nirdiSTa ekaTi zreNI’|
nizcaYa muttAkIgaNa thAkave jAnnAta o jharNAdhArAsamUhe|
‘tomarA tAte praveza kara zAntite, nirApada haYe’|
Ara Ami tAdera antara theke hiMsA vidveSa vera kare phelava, tArA sekhAne bhAi bhAi haYe Asane mukhomukhi vasave|
sekhAne tAderake klAnti sparza karave nA evaM tArA sekhAna theke vahiSkRtao have nA|
AmAra vAndAdera jAniYe dAo ye, Ami nizcaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara AmAra AyAvai yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara tAderake valaH ivarAhImera atithidera kathA|
yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa praveza karala, ataHpara valala, ‘sAlAma’| se valala, ‘AmarA nizcaYa tomAdera vyApAre zaGkita’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi bhIta haYo nA, nizcaYa AmarA tomAke eka jJAnI zizura susaMvAda dicchi’|
se valala, ‘tomarA ki AmAke susaMvAda diccha, yakhana vArdhakya AmAke sparza kareche? sutarAM tomarA kisera susaMvAda diccha’?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA tomAke yathArtha susaMvAda dicchi| sutarAM tumi nirAzadera antarbhukta haYo nA’|
se valala, ‘pathabhraSTarA chAr3A, ke tAra ravera rahamata theke nirAza haYa’?
se valala, ‘tave tomAdera kI kAja he preritagaNa’?
tArA valala, ‘nizcaYa AmarA prerita haYechi aparAdhI kaomera nikaTa’|
‘lUtera parivAra chAr3A, AmarA nizcaYa tAdera savAike rakSA karava’|
‘tave tAra strI chAr3A, AmarA siddhAnta niYechi ye, nizcaYa se zAstiprAptadera dalabhukta’|
erapara yakhana pherezatAgaNa lUtera parivArera kAche Asala,
se valala, ‘tomarA to aparicita loka’|
tArA valala, ‘varaM AmarA tomAra kAche emana viSaYa niYe esechi, yAte tArA sandeha karata’|
‘Ara AmarA tomAra nikaTa satya niYe esechi evaM AmarA avazyai satyavAdI’|

‘sutarAM tumi tomAra parivAra niYe veriYe par3a rAtera ekAMze, Ara tumi tAdera pechane cala, Ara tomAdera keu pechane phire tAkAve nA evaM yebhAve tomAdera nirdeza karA haYeche sebhAvei calate thAkave’|
Ara Ami tAke e siddhAnta jAniYe diYechilAma ye, nizcaYa sakAle edera zikar3a keTe phelA have|
Ara zaharera adhivAsIrA utphulla haYe hAyira hala|
se valala, ‘nizcaYa erA AmAra mehamAna, sutarAM AmAke apamAnita karo nA’|
‘tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke lAJchita karo nA’|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki jagadvAsIra kAro mehamAnadArI karate tomAke niSedha karini’?
se valala, ‘orA AmAra meYe*, yadi tomarA karatei cAo (tave vivAhera mAdhyame vaidha upAYe kara)| *‘AmAra meYe’ dvArA uddezya kaomera meYerA| kAraNa, ye kona kaomera navI tAdera pitAtulya|
tomAra jIvanera kasama, nizcaYa tArA tAderake nezAYa ghurapAka khAcchila|
ataeva sUryodaYakAle vikaTa AoYAja tAdera peYe vasala|
ataHpara Ami tAra (nagarIra) uparake nice ulaTe dilAma evaM tAdera upara varSaNa karalAma por3A mATira pAthara|
nizcaYa ete paryavekSaNakArIdera janya raYeche nidarzanamAlA|
Ara nizcaYai tA pathera pAzei vidyamAna |
nizcaYa ete muminadera janya raYeche nidarzana|
Ara nizcaYa AikAra* adhivAsIrA chila yAlima| * الأيكة valA haYa ghana udyAnake| zuAiva (A:)-era kaoma gahIna vane vasavAsa karata, tAi tAderake أصحاب الأيكة valA haYa|
ataHpara Ami tAdera theke pratizodha nilAma| Ara e (janapada) du’Ti unmukta rAstAra pAzei vidyamAna|
Ara avazyai hijarera adhivAsIrA [sAlehera (AH) kaoma] rAsUladerake asvIkAra kareche|
Ara Ami tAderake AmAra AYAtasamUha diYechilAma, tave tArA tA theke vimukha haYeche|
Ara tArA pAhAr3a keTe vAr3i vAnAta nirApade|
kintu bhore vikaTa AoYAja tAderake pAkar3Ao karala|
Ara tArA yA upArjana karata, tA tAdera kAje Asala nA|
Ara Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o e duYera madhye yA Ache, tA yathArthatA chAr3A sRSTi karini evaM nizcaYa kiYAmata Asave| sutarAM tumi sundarabhAve tAderake er3iYe yAo|
nizcaYa tomAra ravai sRSTikartA, mahAjJAnI|
Ara Ami to tomAke diYechi punaHpunaH paThita sAtaTi AYAta o mahAna kuraAna|
Ami tAdera kichu zreNIke ye bhoga-upakaraNa diYechi, tAra prati tumi du’cokha prasArita karo nA| Ara tAdera janya duHkhita haYo nA evaM muminadera janya tomAra vAhu avanata kara|
Ara vala, ‘nizcaYa Amii suspaSTa satarkakArI’|
yebhAve Ami nAyila karechilAma vibhaktakArIdera (iYAhUdI o nAsArA) upara,

yArA kuraAnake vibhinna aMze bhAga karechila|* * ‘vibhinna aMze bhAga karechila, arthAt kuraAnake tArA vibhinna nAme o vibhinna abhidhAYa ci‎‎hnata karata, yemana keu valata, eTi yAdu, keu valata, kavitA, AvAra keu valata, gaNakadera gaNanA ityAdi|
ataeva tomAra ravera kasama, Ami tAdera sakalake avazyai jerA karava,
tArA yA karata, se samparke|
sutarAM tomAke ye Adeza deYA haYeche, tA vyApakabhAve pracAra kara evaM muzarikadera theke mukha phiriYe nAo|
nizcaYa Ami tomAra janya upahAsakArIdera vipakSe yatheSTa|
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya ilAha nirdhAraNa kare| ataeva tArA acirei jAnate pArave|
Ara avazyai Ami jAni ye, tArA yA vale tAte tomAra antara saGkucita haYa|
sutarAM tumi tomAra ravera prazaMsAYa tAsavIha pATha kara evaM sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hao|
Ara iYAkIna (mRtyu) AsA paryanta tumi tomAra ravera ivAdAta kara|
AllAhara Adeza ese geche, sutarAM tAra janya tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tini pavitra evaM tArA yA ziraka kare, tA theke Urdhve|

tini pherezatAdera Apana nirdeze ohI* diYe nAyila karena tAra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA tAra prati; yena tomarA satarka kara ye, Ami chAr3A kona ilAha nei| ataeva, tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara| * rUha zavdera artha AtmA, ohIke rUha valA haYa e kAraNe ye, ohIra mAdhyamei mAnuSera antara jIvana lAbha kare|
tini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena yathAyathai, tArA yA zarIka kare, tA theke tini Urdhve|
tini mAnuSake sRSTi karechena ‘nutaphA’* theke, athaca se prakAzya vitanDAkArI| * ‘nutaphA’ hacche nArI o puruSera yautha vIrya, yA bhruNe pariNata haYa|
Ara catuSpada jantugulo tini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena tAte raYeche uSNatAra upakaraNa o vividha upakAra| Ara tA theke tomarA AhAra grahaNa kara|
Ara tomAdera janya tAte raYeche saundarya yakhana sandhyAYa tA phiriYe Ana evaM sakAle cAraNe niYe yAo|
Ara egulo tomAdera vojhA vahana kare emana deze niYe yAYa, bhISaNa kaSTa chAr3A yekhAne tomarA pau~chate sakSama hate nA| nizcaYa tomAdera rava daYAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara (tini sRSTi karechena) ghor3A, khaccara o gAdhA, tomAdera ArohaNa o zobhAra janya evaM tini sRSTi karena emana kichu, yA tomarA jAna nA|
Ara saThika patha vAtale deYA AllAhara dAYitva, evaM pathera madhye kichu Ache vakra| Ara tini yadi icchA karatena tave tomAdera sakalake hidAYAta karatena|
tinii se sattA, yini AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karena, yAte raYeche tomAdera janya pAnIYa evaM tA theke haYa udbhita, yAte tomarA jantu carAo|
tAra mAdhyame tini tomAdera janya utpanna karena phasala, yAituna, khejura gAcha, AGgura evaM sakala phala-phalAdi| nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche emana kaomera janya, yArA cintA kare|
Ara tini tomAdera janya niYojita karechena rAta o dinake evaM sUrya o cA~dake evaM tArakAsamUhao tA~ra nirdeze niYojita| nizcaYa ete aneka nidarzana raYeche emana kaomera janya yArA vujhe|
Ara tini tomAdera janya yamIne yA sRSTi karechena, vicitra raGera kare, nizcaYa tAteo nidarzana raYeche emana kaomera janya, yArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

Ara tinii se sattA, yini samudrake niYojita karechena, yAte tomarA tA theke tAjA (mAchera) gozta khete pAra evaM tA theke vera karate pAra alaMkArAdi, yA tomarA paridhAna kara| Ara tumi tAte nauyAna dekhave tA pAni cire calache evaM yAte tomarA tAra anugraha anveSaNa karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA zukariYA AdAYa kara|
Ara yamIne tini sthApana karechena sudRr3ha parvatamAlA, yAte tomAdera niYe yamIna hele nA yAYa evaM nada-nadI o pathasamUha, yAte tomarA pathaprApta hao|
Ara (dinera) patha-nirdezaka ci‎hnasamUha, ArA (rAte) tArakAra mAdhyame tArA patha pAYa|
sutarAM ye sRSTi kare, se ki tAra mata, ye sRSTi kare nA? ataeva tomarA ki upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
Ara yadi tomarA AllAhara niAmata gaNanA kara, tave tAra iYattA pAve nA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara AllAha jAnena tomarA yA gopana kara evaM yA prakAzye ghoSaNA kara|
Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A yAderake DAke, tArA kichu suSTi karate pAre nA, varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa|
(tArA) mRta, jIvita naYa evaM tArA jAne nA kakhana tAderake punarujjIvita karA have|
tomAdera ilAha eka ilAha| ataHpara yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara asvIkArakArI evaM tArA ahaGkArI|
niHsandehe tArA yA gopana kare evaM yA prakAzye ghoSaNA kare, nizcaYa tA AllAha jAnena| nizcaYa tini ahaGkArIdera pachanda karena nA|
Ara yakhana tAdera valA haYa, ‘tomAdera rava kI nAyila karechena’? tArA vale, ‘pUrvavartIdera kalpakAhinI’|
ete kare tArA kiYAmatera dine nijadera pApera vojhA puroTAi vahana karave evaM tAdera pApera vojhAo yAderake tArA ajJatA hetu pathabhraSTa kare| tArA yA vahana karave, tA katai nA nikRSTa!

tAdera pUrve yArA chila, tArA Sar3ayantra karechila, ataHpara AllAha tAdera dAlAnera bhIte AghAta karechilena, phale tAdera upara theke tAdera chAda dhvase par3echila| Ara tAdera upara AyAva esachila emanabhAve ye, tArA tA upalavdhi karate pAreni|

ataHpara kiYAmatera dina tini tAderake lAJchita karavena evaM valavena, ‘kothAYa AmAra zarIkarA, yAdera vyApAre tomarA (muminadera) virodhItA karate’? yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche, tArA valave, ‘nizcaYa lAJchanA o durgati Aja kAphiradera upara|’

nijadera upara yulamakArI thAkA avasthAYa pherezatArA yAdera mRtyu ghaTAve| ataHpara tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare valave, ‘AmarA kona pApa karatAma nA|’ hyA~, nizcaYa tomarA yA karate se viSaYe AllAha samyaka jJAta|
sutarAM tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAgulo diYe praveza kara, tAte sthAYI haYe| ataeva avazyai ahaGkArIdera AvAsa atinikRSTa|

Ara yArA tAkaoYAra avalamvana kareche, tAdera valA hala, ‘tomAdera rava kI nAyila karechena’? tArA valala, ‘kalyANa’| yArA ei duniYAYa uttama kAja kareche, tAdera janya raYeche puNya| Ara nizcaYa AkhirAtera AvAsa uttama evaM muttAkIdera AvAsa katainA uttama!
sthAYI jAnnAtasamUha yAte tArA praveza karave, yAra taladeze pravAhita hacche naharasamUha| tArA cAive, tAdera janya tAra madhye tAi thAkave| ebhAvei AllAha muttAkIdera pratidAna dena|
pherezatArA yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa uttama avasthAYa, tArA vale, ‘tomAdera upara sAlAma| jAnnAte praveza kara, ye Amala tomarA karate tAra kAraNe|

tArA zudhu pherezatA AsAra apekSA karache athavA tomAra ravera siddhAnta AsAra| emani karechila tArA, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| Ara AllAha tAdera upara yulama karenani, varaM tArAi nijadera upara yulama karechila|
sutarAM tArA yA kareche, tAra khArApa pariNati tAderake AkrAnta kareche evaM tArA yA niYe upahAsa karata, tA tAderake ghire pheleche|

Ara yArA ziraka kareche, tArA valala, yadi AllAha cAitena tave AmarA tAke chAr3A kona kichura ivAdAta karatAma nA evaM AmAdera pitRpuruSarAo nA| Ara tAra viparIte to AmarA kona kichu hArAma karatAma nA| emanii kareche, yArA tAdera pUrve chila| sutarAM spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA chAr3A rAsUladera ki kona kartavya Ache?

Ara Ami avazyai pratyeka jAtite ekajana rAsUla preraNa karechi ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara evaM parihAra kara tAgUtake| ataHpara tAdera madhya theke AllAha kAuke hidAYAta diYechena evaM tAdera madhya theke kAro upara pathabhraSTatA sAvyasta haYeche| sutarAM tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara ataHpara dekha, asvIkArakArIdera pariNati kIrUpa haYeche|
yadio tumi tAdera hidAYAtera vyApAre AkAGkSA kara, tavu nizcaYa AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAke hidAYAta dena nA evaM tAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

Ara tArA AllAhara nAme kaThina zapatha karechena ye, ye vyakti mArA yAYa. AllAha tAke punarujjIvita karavena nA| hyA~, tAra nijera upare karA oYAdA tini satye rUpa devena; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai jAne nA|
yAte tini tAdera janya spaSTa karena, yA niYe tArA matavirodha kare| Ara yArA kupharI kareche, yena tArA jAnate pAre ye, nizcaYa tArA chila mithyAvAdI|
yakhana Ami kona kichura icchA kari, takhana AmAra kathA haYa kevala ei valA ye, ‘hao’, phale tA haYe yAYa|
Ara yArA hijarata kareche AllAhara rAstAYa atyAcArita haoYAra para, Ami avazyai tAderake duniYAte uttama AvAsa dAna karava| Ara AkhirAtera pratidAna to vizAla, yadi tArA jAnata|
yArA savara kareche evaM tAdera ravera uparai tAoYAkkula kareche|
Ara Ami tomAra pUrve kevala puruSaderakei rAsUla hiseve preraNa karechi, yAdera prati Ami ohI pAThiYechi| sutarAM jJAnIdera jijJAsA kara, yadi tomarA nA jAno|

(tAdera preraNa karechi) spaSTa pramANAdi o kitAvasamUha evaM tomAra prati nAyila karechi kuraAna, yAte tumi mAnuSera janya spaSTa kare dite pAra, yA tAdera prati nAyila haYeche| Ara yAte tArA cintA kare|
yArA mandera Sar3ayantra kare tArA ki nirApada haYe geche ye, AllAha tAderasaha mATike dhvasiYe devena nA| athavA tAdera upara Asave nA, AyAva emanabhAve ye, tArA upalavdhi karave nA?
athavA tini tAdera calApherAra bhetara tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA? vastuta tArA (AllAhake) parAstakArI naYa|
kiMvA tini tAderake bhIta avasthAYa pAkar3Ao karavena nA? nizcaYa tomAdera rava atizaYa daYAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha ye sakala vastu sRSTi karechena, tArA ki se dike tAkAYani, yAra chAYAsamUha DAne o vAme hele par3e AllAhara janya sijAdArata avasthAYa, Ara tArA ekAnta vinIta?
Ara AllAhakei sijadA kare AsamAnasamUhe yA Ache evaM yamIne ye prANI Ache, Ara pherezatArA evaM tArA ahaGkAra kare nA|
tArA tAdera uparastha ravake bhaYa kare evaM tAderake yA nirdeza deYA haYa, tArA tA kare|[sAjadAha]
Ara AllAha valechena, ‘tomarA dui ilAha grahaNa karo nA| tini to kevala eka ilAha| sutarAM tomarA AmAkei bhaYa kara|’
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA Ache, tA tArai evaM sArvakSaNika Anugatya tArai| ataeva tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A anyake bhaYa karave?
Ara tomAdera kAcha ye sava niAmata Ache, tA AllAhara pakSa theke| ataHpara duHkha-durdazA yakhana tomAdera sparza kare takhana tomarA zudhu tAra kAchei phariYAda kara|
tArapara yakhana tini tomAdera theke duHkha-durdazA dUra kare dena, takhana tomAdera madhya theke ekaTi dala tAdera ravera sAthe ziraka kare|
yAte Ami tAderake yA diYechi tA tArA asvIkAra karate pAre| ataeva tomarA bhoga kara, acirei tomarA jAnate pArave|

Ara Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi, tAra ekaTi aMza tArA nirdhAraNa kare emana sattAra janya, yAra vyApAre tArA jAne nA| AllAhara kasama! tomAderake avazyai jijJAsA karA have, tomarA ye mithyA raTAccha se vyApAre|
Ara tArA AllAhara janya kanyA santAna nirdiSTa kare| tini pavitra evaM nijedera janya tA (nirdiSTa kare) yA tArA pachanda kare|
Ara yakhana tAdera kAuke kanyA santAnera susaMvAda deYA haYa; takhana tAra cehArA kAlo haYe yAYa| Ara se thAke duHkha bhArAkrAnta|
tAke ye saMvAda deYA haYeche, se duHkhe se kaoma theke Atmagopana kare| ApamAna sattveo ki eke rekhe deve, nA mATite pu~te phelave? jene rekha, tArA yA phaYasAlA kare, tA katai nA manda!
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera janya manda udAharaNa evaM AllAhara janya raYeche mahAna udAharaNa| Ara tinii parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI|

Ara AllAha yadi mAnavajAtike tAdera yulamera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karatena, tave tAte (yamIne) kono vicaraNakArI prANIkei chAr3atena nA| tave AllAha tAderake ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza dena| yakhana tAdera nirdiSTa samaYa cale Ase, takhana eka muhUrtao pechAte pAre nA, evaM AgAteo pAre nA|

Ara tArA yA apachanda kare, tAi tArA AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare| tAdera jihavA mithyA vivaraNa deYa ye, nizcaYa tAdera janya zubha pariNAma| sandeha nei ye, tAdera janya raYeche Aguna evaM nizcaYa tArA sarvAgre nikSipta have|

AllAhara zapatha, Ami tomAra pUrve vahu jAtira nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi| ataHpara zaYatAna tAdera janya tAdera karmake zobhita kareche| tAi Aja se tAdera abhibhAvaka| Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantranAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara Ami tomAra upara kitAva nAyila karechi, zudhu e janya ye, ye viSaYe tArA vitarka karache, tA tAdera janya tumi spaSTa kare deve evaM (eTi) hidAYAta o rahamata sei kaomera janya yArA ImAna Ane|
AllAha AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena evaM tadvArA tini bhUmike ora mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche ye sampradAYa kathA zone tAdera janya|

Ara nizcaYa catuSpada jantute raYeche tomAdera janya zikSA| tAra peTera bhetarera govara o raktera madhyakhAna theke tomAderake Ami dudha pAna karAi, yA khA~Ti evaM pAnakArIdera janya svAcchyandakara|

Ara tomarA khejura gAchera phala o AGgura theke mAdaka* o uttama riyka grahaNa kara| nizcaYa ete emana kaomera janya nidarzana raYeche, yArA vujhe| * imAma tAvArI valena, AYAtaTi mAdaka niSidda haoYAra pUrve avatIrNa haYeche|
Ara tomAra rava maumAchike iMgite jAniYeche ye, ‘tumi pAhAr3e o gAche evaM tArA ye gRha nirmANa kare tAte nivAsa vAnAo|’

ataHpara tumi pratyeka phala theke AhAra kara evaM tumi tomAra ravera sahaja pathe cala| tAra peTa theke emana pAnIYa vera haYa, yAra raM bhinna bhinna, yAte raYeche mAnuSera janya roga nirAmaYa| nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche se kaomera janya, yArA cintA kare|

Ara AllAha tomAdera sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena| tomAdera aneke emanao Ache, yAke ekevAre vRddha vaYase upanIta karA haYa, yAte se jJAna lAbhera pareo savakichu ajAnA haYe yAYa| AllAha sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

Ara AllAha riyka tomAdera katakake katakera upara prAdhAnya diYechena; kintu yAderake prAdhAnya deYA haYeche, tArA tAdera riyka dAsadAsIdera phiriYe deYa nA| (ei bhaYe ye,) tArA tAte samAna haYe yAve| tave tArA ki AllAhara niAmatake asvIkAra karache?

Ara AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera theke jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera jor3A theke tomAdera janya putra o nAtidera sRSTi karechena Ara tini tomAredake pavitra riyka dAna karechena tArA ki vAtile vizvAsa kare evaM AllAhara niAmatake asvIkAra kare?
Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A emana kichura upAsanA kare, yArA AsamAnasamUha o yamIne tAdera kona riyakera mAlika naYa evaM hateo pArave nA|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhara janya anya kona dRSTAnta sthApana karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha jAnena Ara tomarA jAna nA|

AllAha upamA peza karechena; ekajana adhinasta dAsa ye kona kichura upara kSamatA rAkhe nA| Ara ekajana yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke uttama riyaka diYechi, ataHpara se tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare| tArA ki samAna hate pAre? samasta prazaMsA AllAhara| varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ara AllAha upamA peza karechena, du’jana vyakti, tAdera ekajana vovA, ye kona kichura upara kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM se tAra abhibhAvakera upara vojhA| tAke yekhAnei pAThAno haYa, kona kalyANa vaYe Anate pAre nA| se Ara ai vyakti ki samAna, ye nyAYera Adeza kare evaM raYeche sarala pathera upara?
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne gAYevI viSaYa AllAharai| Ara kiYAmatera vyApAraTi zudhu cokhera palakera nyAYa| kiMvA tA Aro nikaTavartI| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

Ara AllAha tomAderake vera karechena, tomAdera mAtRgarbha theke ematAvasthAYa ye, tomarA kichui jAnate nA| tini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena zravaNazakti, cakSu o antara| yAte tomarA zukariYA AdAYa kara|
tArA ki AkAze (ur3anta avasthAYa) niYojita pAkhigulora dike tAkAYa nA? AllAha chAr3A keu tAderake dhare rAkhe nA| nizcaYa tAte nidarzanavalI raYeche sei kaomera janya yArA vizvAsa kare|

Ara AllAha tomAdera gharaguloke tomAdera janya AvAsa karechena evaM tomAdera pazura cAmar3A diYe tAvura vyavasthA karechena, yA khuva sahajei tomarA sapharakAle o avasthAnakAle vahana karate pAra| Ara tAdera pazama, tAdera loma o tAdera cula dvArA nirdiSTa samaYera janya gRhasAmagrI o bhoga-upakaraNa (tairi karechena)|

Ara AllAha yA sRSTi karechena, tA theke tomAdera janya chAYAra vyavasthA karechena evaM pAhAr3a theke tomAdera janya AzraYasthala vAniYechena, Ara vyavasthA karechena pozAkera, yA tomAderake garama theke rakSA kare evaM varmerao vyavasthA karechena yA tomAderake rakSA kare tomAdera yuddhe| ebhAvei tini tomAdera upara tAra niAmatake pUrNa karavena, yAte tomarA anugata hao|
sutarAM yadi tArA pRSTha-pradarzana kare, tave tomAra dAYitva to zudhu spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA|
tArA AllAhara niAmata cine, tAraparao tArA tA asvIkAra kare, Ara tAdera adhikAMzai kAphira|

Ara smaraNa kara, yedina Ami pratyeka ummata theke sAkSI utthita karava| tArapara yArA kupharI kareche, tAderake (oyara pezera) anumati deYA have nA evaM (AllAhake) santuSTa karateo tAderake valA have nA|
Ara yA yulama kareche, tArA yakhana AyAva dekhave, takhana tAdera upara theke tA zithila karA have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|

Ara yArA ziraka kareche, tArA yakhana tAdera zarIkadera dekhave, takhana valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, erA hala AmAdera zarIka, yAderake AmarA ApanAra parivarte AhavAna karatAma|’ ataHpara tArA tAdera prati uttare valave, ‘nizcaYa tomarA mithyAvAdI|’
sedina tArA AllAhara prati Anugatya peza karave evaM tArA ye mithyA raTAta, tA udhAo haYe yAve|
yArA kupharI kareche evaM AllAhara rAstAYa vAdhA diYeche, Ami tAderake AyAvera upara AyAva vAr3iYe deva| kAraNa tArA phyAsAda sRSTi karata|

Ara smaraNa kara, yedina Ami pratyeka ummatera kAche, tAdera thekei tAdera viruddhe ekajana sAkSI utthita karava evaM tomAke tAdera upara sAkSIrUpe hAyira karava| Ara Ami tomAra upara kitAva nAyila karechi pratiTi viSaYera spaSTa varNanA, hidAYAta, rahamata o musalimadera janya susaMvAdasvarUpa|

nizcaYa AllAha inasApha, sadAcAra o nikaTa AtmIYadera dAna karAra Adeza dena evaM tini AzlIlatA, manda kAja o sImAlaGghana theke niSedha karena| tini tomAderake upadeza dena, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

Ara tomarA yakhana aGgIkAra kara takhana AllAhara aGgIkAra pUrNa kara| tomarA pAkApokta aGgIkAra karAra para tA bhaGga karo nA evaM prakRta pakSe tomarA nijadera janya AllAhake jimmAdAra vAniYecha| nizcaYa AllAha jAnena, yA tomarA kara|

Ara tomarA se nArIra mata haYo nA, ye tAra pAkAno sUto zakta kare pAkAnora para Tukaro Tukaro kare phele| tomarA tomAdera upara aGgIkArake nijadera madhye pratAraNA hiseve grahaNa karacha (ei uddezye) ye, ekadala apara dalera ceYe var3a have| AllAha to era mAdhyame tomAdera parIkSA karena evaM nizcaYa tini tomAdera janya kiYAmatera dine spaSTa kare devena se viSaYa, yAte tomarA matavirodha karate|

Ara yadi AllAha cAitena, tomAdera sakalake eka jAtite pariNata karatena, kintu AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena, Ara yAke icchA hidAYAta dena| tomarA yA karate se samparke avazyai tomAdera jijJAsA karA have|

Ara tomarA tomAdera aGgIkAraguloke tomAdera pratAraNA hiseve grahaNa karo nA| tAhale pA dRr3ha haoYAra para pichale yAve evaM tomarA AyAva AsvAdana karave| kAraNa tomarA AllAhara rAstAYa vAdhA diYecha| Ara tomAdera janya raYeche mahA AyAva|
Ara tomarA svalpa mUlye AllAhara aGgIkAra vikri karo nA| AllAhara kAche yA Ache, tomAdera janyai tAi uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
tomAdera nikaTa yA Ache tA phuriYe yAYa| Ara AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tA sthAYI| Ara yArA savara kareche, tArA yA karata tAra tulanAYa avazyai Ami tAderake uttama pratidAna deva|
ye mumina avasthAYa neka Amala karave, puruSa hoka vA nArI, Ami tAke pavitra jIvana dAna karava evaM tArA yA karata tAra tulanAYa avazyai Ami tAderake uttama pratidAna deva|
sutarAM yakhana tumi kuraAna par3ave takhana AllAhara kAche vitAr3ita zaYatAna hate pAnAha cAo|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche evaM tAdera ravera upara tAoYAkkula kareche, tAdera upara zaYatAnera kona kSamatA nei|
tAra kSamatA to kevala tAdera upara, yArA tAke abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kara evaM yArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare|

Ara yakhana Ami ekaTi AYAtera sthAne parivartana kare ArekaTi AYAta dei- AllAha bhAla jAnena se samparke, yA tini nAyila karena- takhana tArA vale, tumi to kevala mithyA raTanAkArI; ravaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
vala, ruhula kudasa (jIvarIla) eke tomAra ravera pakSa hate yathAyathabhAve nAyila karechena| yArA ImAna eneche tAderake sudRr3ha karAra janya evaM hidAYAta o musalimadera janya susaMvAdasvarUpa|
Ara Ami avazyai jAni ye, tArA vale, tAke to zikSA deYa ekajana mAnuSa, yAra dike tArA IGgita karache, tAra bhASA hacche anAravI| athaca eTA hacche suspaSTa AravI bhASA|
nizcaYa yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa kare nA, AllAha tAderake hidAYAta karavena nA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantradAYaka AyAva|
ekamAtra tArAi mithyA raTAYa, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa kare nA| Ara tArAi mithyAvAdI|

ye ImAna AnAra para AllAhara sAthe kupharI kareche evaM yArA tAdera antara kupharI dvArA unmukta kareche, tAdera uparai AllAhara krodha evaM tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva| ai vyakti chAr3A yAke vAdhya karA haYa (kupharI karate) athaca tAra antara thAke ImAne paritRpta|
eTA e janya ye, tArA AkhirAtera tulanAYa duniYAra jIvanake pachanda kareche| Ara nizcaYa AllAha kAphira kaomake hidAYAta karena nA|
erAi tArA, yAdera antarasamUha, zravaNasamUha o dRSTisamUhera upara AllAha mohara kare diYechena evaM tArAi hacche gAphela|
sandeha nei, tArAi AkhirAte kSatigrasta|
tArapara tomAra rava tAdera janya, yArA viparyasta haoYAra para hijarata kareche, ataHpara jihAda kareche evaM savara kareche, e savera para tomAra rava avazyai kSamAzIla, duYAlu|

(smaraNa kara se dinera kathA) yedina pratyeka vyakti nijera pakSe yukti-tarka niYe upasthita have evaM pratyekake vyakti se yA Amala kareche tA paripUrNarUpe deYA have evaM tAdera prati yulama karA have nA|

Ara AllAha upamA peza karachena, ekaTi janapada, yA chila nirApada o zAnta| savadika theke tAra riyka tAte vipulabhAve Asata| ataHpara se (janapada) AllAhara niAmata asvIkAra karala| takhana tArA yA karata tAra kAraNe AllAha tAke kSudhA o bhaYera pozAka parAlena|
Ara avazyai tAdera kAche, tAdera madhya theke ekajana rAsUla esechila| tArapara tArA tAke asvIkAra karechila| phale AyAva tAdera pAkar3Ao karechila ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA chila yulamakArI|
ataeva AllAha tomAderake ye hAlAla uttama riyka diYechena, tomarA tA theke AhAra kara evaM AllAhara niYAmatera zukariYA AdAYa kara, yadi tomarA tArai ivAdAta kare thAka|

tini to tomAdera upara hArAma karechena mRta jantu, rakta, zUkarera gozta evaM ye jantura yavehakAle AllAha vyatIta anya kArao nAma neYA haYeche| tave ye nirupAYa haYe, icchAkRta avAdhyatA o sImAlaGghana vyatIta, (praYojana mutAveka grahaNa karave) tave AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

Ara tomAdera jihavA dvArA vAnAno mithyAra upara nirbhara kare valo nA ye, eTA hAlAla evaM eTA hArAma, AllAhara upara mithyA raTAnora janya| nizcaYa yArA AllAhara upara mithyA raTAYa, tArA saphala have nA|
sAmAnya bhoga evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara yArA ihUdI haYeche, tAdera uparao Ami tAi hArAma karechi, yA Ami tomAra kAche itaHpUrve varNanA karechi evaM Ami tAdera upara yulama karini; varaM tArAi tAdera nijadera upara yulama karata|
tArapara nizcaYa tomAra rava tAdera janya, yArA ajJAtasAre manda kAja kareche, erapara tArA taovA kareche evaM parizuddha haYeche| nizcaYa tomAra rava esavera para parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa ivarAhIma chilena eka ummata*, AllAhara ekAnta anugata o ekaniSTha| tini muzarikadera antarbhUkta chilena nA| * tini ummata vA jAti chilena, ei arthe ye, ekaTi jAtira mAjhe ye samasta guNAvalI pAoYA yAYa, vyakti ivarAhImera mAjhei tA vidyamAna chila| kArao kArao mate era artha ‘Adarza puruSa’ ‘imAma’ vA kalyANera zikSaka|
se chila tAra niYAmatera zukarakArI| tini tAke vAchAi karechena evaM tAke saThika pathe paricAlita karechena|
Ara Ami tAke duniYAte kalyANa dAna karechi evaM niHsandehe se AkhirAte nekakAradera dalabhukta|
tArapara Ami tomAra prati ohI paThiYechi ye, tumi millAte ivarAhImera anusaraNa kara, ye chila ekaniSTha evaM chila nA muzarikadera antarbhukta|
zanivAra to tAdera upara cApiYe deYA haYeche yArA tAte matavirodha kareche| Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava kiYAmatera dina tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena, yAte tArA matabheda karata|

tumi tomarA ravera pathe hikamata o sundara upadezera mAdhyame AhavAna kara evaM sundaratama panthAYa tAdera sAthe vitarka kara| nizcaYa ekamAtra tomAra ravai jAnena ke tAra patha theke bhraSTa haYeche evaM hidAYAtaprAptadera tini khuva bhAla karei jAnena|
Ara yadi tomarA zAsti dAo, tave Thika tataTuku zAsti dAo yataTuku tomAdera deYA haYeche| Ara yadi tomarA savara kara, tave tAi savarakArIdera janya uttama|
Ara tumi savara kara| tomAra savara to zudhu AllAhara tAophIkei| tArA yesava Sar3ayantra karache tumi se viSaYe saMkIrNamanA haYo nA|
nizcaYa AllAha tAdera sAthe, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yArA satkarmazIla|

pavitra mahAna se sattA, yini tA~ra vAndAke rAte niYe giYechena Ala mAsajidula hArAma theke Ala mAsajidula AkasA* paryanta, yAra AzapAze Ami varakata diYechi, yena Ami tAke AmAra kichu nidarzana dekhAte pAri| tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA| * philistIne avasthita vAitula mAkadisa, yA musalamAnadera prathama kivalA chila|
Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tA vanI isarAIlera janya pathanirdeza vAniYechi| yena tomarA AmAke chAr3A kona karmavidhAYaka nA vAnAo|
se tAdera vaMzadhara, yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe ArohaNa kariYechilAma, nizcaYa se chila kRtajJa vAndA|
Ara Ami vanI isarAIlake kitAve siddhAnta jAniYechilAma ye, tomarA yamIne du’vAra avazyai phAsAda karave evaM auddhatya dekhAve mArAtmakabhAve|

ataHpara yakhana e du’Yera prathama oYAdA Asala, takhana Ami tomAdera upara AmAra kichu vAndA pAThAlAma, yArA kaThora yuddhavAja| ataHpara tArA ghare ghare Dhuke dhvaMsayajJa cAlAla| Ara e oYAdA pUrNa haoYArai chila|
tArapara Ami tAdera viruddhe tomAdera janya pAlA ghuriYe dilAma, dhana-sampada o santAna-santati diYe tomAderake madada karalAma evaM janavale tomAderake saMkhyAdhikye pariNata karalAma|

tomarA yadi bhAla kara, tave nijadera janyai bhAla karave evaM yadi manda kara tave tA nijadera janyai| erapara yakhana paravartI oYAdA ela, (takhana anya vAndAdera preraNa karalAma) yAte tArA tomAdera cehArAsamUha malina kare deYa, Ara yena masajide Dhuke par3e yemana Dhuke par3echila prathamavAra evaM yAte sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare deYa yA odera kartRtve chila|
AzA karA yAYa tomAdera rava tomAdera upara rahama karavena| kintu tomarA yadi punarAYa kara, tAhale Amio punarAYa karava| Ara Ami jAhAnnAmake karechi kAphiradera janya kaYedakhAnA|
nizcaYa e kuraAna emana ekaTi patha dekhAYa yA savaceYe sarala evaM ye muminagaNa neka Amala kare tAderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya raYeche mahApuraskAra|
Ara yArA AkhirAte ImAna rAkhe nA Ami tAdera janya prasttata karechi yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara mAnuSa akalyANera doA kare, yemana tAra doA haYa kalyANera janya| Ara mAnuSa to tAr3Ahur3ApravaNa|

Ara Ami rAta o dinake karechi du’To nidarzana| ataHpara muche diYechi rAtera nidarzana evaM dinera nidarzanake karechi AlokamaYa, yAte tomarA tomAdera ravera anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA varSasaMkhyA o hisAva jAnate pAra| Ara Ami pratyeka viSaYa vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|
Ara Ami pratyeka mAnuSera karmake tAra ghAr3e saMyukta kare diYechi evaM kiYAmatera dina tAra janya Ami vera karava ekaTi kitAva, yA se pAve unmukta|
pATha kara tomAra kitAva, Aja tumi nijei tomAra hisAva-nikAzakArI hiseve yatheSTa|

ye hidAYAta grahaNa kare, se to nijera janyai hidAYAta grahaNa kare evaM ye pathabhraSTa haYa se nijera (svArthera) viruddhei pathabhraSTa haYa| Ara kona vahanakArI aparera (pApera) vojhA vahana karave nA| Ara rAsUla preraNa nA karA paryanta Ami AyAvadAtA nai|

Ara yakhana Ami kona janapada dhvaMsa karAra icchA kari, takhana tAra sampadazAlIderake (satkAjera) Adeza kari| ataHpara tArA tAte sImAlaGghana kare| takhana tAdera upara nirdezaTi sAvyasta haYe yAYa evaM Ami tA sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta kari|
Ara nUhera para Ami kata prajanma dhvaMsa karechi! tomAra rava tA~ra vAndAdera pApera vyApAre pUrNa avahita o sarvadraSTA hiseve yatheSTa|
ye duniYA cAYa Ami sekhAne tAke druta diYe dei, yA Ami cAi, yAra janya cAi| tArapara tAra janya nirdhAraNa kari jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se praveza karave nindita, vitAr3ita avasthAYa|
Ara ye AkhirAta cAYa evaM tAra janya yathAyatha ceSTA kare mumina avasthAYa, tAdera ceSTA have puraskArayogya|
edera o odera pratyekake Ami tomAra ravera dAna theke sAhAyya kari, Ara tomAra ravera dAna vandha haoYAra naYa|
bheve dekha, Ami tAdera katakake katakera upara kibhAve zreSThatva dAna karechi| Ara AkhirAta nizcaYai maryAdAYa mahAna evaM zreSThatve vRhattara|
AllAhara sAthe apara kona ilAha nirdhAraNa karo nA| tAhale tumi nindita o lAJchita haYe vase par3ave|

Ara tomAra rava Adeza diYechena ye, tomarA tA~ke chAr3A anya kAro ivAdAta karave nA evaM pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadAcaraNa karave| tAdera ekajana athavA ubhaYei yadi tomAra nikaTa vArdhakye upanIta haYa, tave tAderake ‘upha’ valo nA evaM tAderake dhamaka dio nA| Ara tAdera sAthe sammAnajanaka kathA vala|
Ara tAdera ubhaYera janya daYAparavaza haYe vinaYera DAnA nata kare dAo evaM vala, ‘he AmAra rava, tAdera prati daYA karuna yebhAve zaizave tArA AmAke lAlana-pAlana karechena’|
tomAdera antare yA Ache, se samparke tomAdera ravai adhika jJAta| yadi tomarA nekakAra hao tave tini tA~ra dike pratyAvartanakArIdera prati adhika kSamAzIla|
Ara AtmIYake tAra haka diYe dAo evaM misakIna o musAphirakeo| Ara konabhAvei apavyaYa karo nA|
nizcaYa apavyaYakArIrA zaYatAnera bhAi| Ara zaYatAna tAra ravera prati khuvai akRtajJa|
Ara yadi tumi tAdera theke vimukha thAkatei cAo tomAra ravera pakSa theke rahamatera pratyAzAYa yA tumi cAccha, tAhale tAdera sAthe namra kathA valave|

Ara tumi tomAra hAta tomAra ghAr3e Avaddha rekho nA evaM tA puropuri prasArita karo nA*, tAhale tumi nindita o niHsva haYe vase par3ave| * AYAta dvArA uddezya- ekevAre kRpaNao haYo nA, AvAra ekevAre dhana-sampada ujAr3a kareo dio nA|
nizcaYa tomAra rava yAke icchA tAra janya riyka prazasta kare dena evaM sImita kare dena| tini avazyai tA~ra vAndAdera samparke pUrNa jJAta, pUrNa draSTA|
abhAva-anaTanera bhaYe tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake hatyA karo nA| Amii tAderake riyka dei evaM tomAderakeo| nizcaYa tAderake hatyA karA mahApApa|
Ara tomarA vyabhicArera kAche yeYo nA, nizcaYa tA azlIla kAja o manda patha|

Ara tomarA sei nAphsake hatyA karo nA, yA AllAha hArAma karechena, saGgata kAraNa chAr3A| ye anyAYabhAve nihata haYa Ami avazyai tAra abhibhAvakake kSamatA diYechi| sutarAM hatyAra vyApAre se sImAlaGghana karave nA; nizcaYa se have sAhAyyaprApta|

Ara tomarA iYAtImera sampadera kAche yeYo nA sundaratama panthA* chAr3A, yatakSaNa nA se vaYasera pUrNatAYa upanIta haYa| Ara aGgIkAra pUrNa kara, nizcaYa aGgIkAra samparke jijJAsAvAda karA have| * arthAt tAra sampada vRddhi, tAra nijera kharaca evaM daridra hale vetana grahaNa vaidha|
Ara mApe paripUrNa dAo yakhana tomarA parimApa kara evaM saThika dA~r3ipAllAYa oyana kara| eTA kalyANakara o pariNAme sundaratama|
Ara ye viSaYa tomAra jAnA nAi tAra anusaraNa karo nA| nizcaYa kAna, cokha o antakaraNa- edera pratiTira vyApAre se jijJAsita have|
Ara yamIne var3Ai kare calo nA; tumi to kakhano yamInake phATala dharAte pArave nA evaM uccatAYa kakhano pAhAr3a samAna pau~chate pArave nA|
e savera yA manda tA tomAra ravera nikaTa apachandanIYa|
egulo sei hikamatabhukta, yA tomAra rava tomAra nikaTa ohIrUpe pAThiYechena| Ara tumi AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsya nirdhAraNa karo nA, tAhale tumi jAhAnnAme nikSipta have nindita o vitAr3ita haYe|
tomAdera rava ki putra santAnera janya tomAderake vAchAi karechena evaM tini pherezatAdera theke kanyA grahaNa karechena? nizcaYa tomarA sAMghAtika kathA vale thAka|
Ara avazyai Ami e kuraAne vistArita vyAkhyA diYechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare; kintu tA kevala tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi kare|
vala, ‘tA~ra sAthe yadi Aro upAsya thAkata, yemana tArA vale, tave tArA Arazera adhipati paryanta pau~chAra patha tAlAza karata’|
tini pavitra mahAna evaM tArA yA vale tA theke tini aneka Urdhve|

sAta AsamAna o yamIna evaM egulora madhye yA kichu Ache sava kichu tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare evaM emana kichu nei yA tA~ra prasaMzAYa tAsavIha pATha kare nA; kintu tAdera tAsavIha tomarA vujha nA| nizcaYa tini sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
Ara tumi yakhana kuraAna par3a takhana tomAra o yArA AkhirAte ImAna Ane nA tAdera madhye Ami eka adRzya pardA diYe dei|

Ara Ami tAdera antarera upara DhAkanA rekhe diYechi, yAte tArA tA vujhate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAne diYechi vadhiratA| Ara yakhana tumi kuraAne tomAra rava eka haoYAra kathA ullekha kara, takhana tArA pRSThapradarzana kare pAlAYa|
yakhana tArA tomAra prati kAna pete zune, takhana Ami jAni kena tArA kAna pAte evaM yakhana gopana AlocanAYa milita haYe yAlimarA vale, ‘tomarA to kevala eka yAdugrasta lokera anusaraNa karacha’|
dekha, tArA tomAra janya kemana sava upamA dicche! phale tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche, sutarAM tArA patha pAve nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘yakhana AmarA hADDi o chinna-bhinna haYe yAva, takhana ki AmarA natuna sRSTirUpe punarujjIvita hava’?
vala, ‘tomarA pAthara haYe yAo kiMvA lohA’,

‘athavA emana kona sRSTi, yA tomAdera antare var3a mane haYa|’ tavuo tArA valave, ‘ke AmAdera punarAYa (sRSTi) karave?’ vala, ‘yini tomAdera prathamavAra sRSTi karechena|’ ataHpara tArA tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3ave evaM valave, ‘kave eTA?’ vala, ‘AzA karA yAYa ye, tA nikaTei have|’
‘yedina tini tomAderake DAkavena, takhana tA~ra prazaMsAra sAthe tomarA sAr3A deve| Ara tomarA dhAraNA karave, alpa samaYai tomarA avasthAna karechile’|
Ara AmAra vAndAderake vala, tArA yena emana kathA vale, yA ati sundara| nizcaYa zaYatAna tAdera madhye vairitA sRSTi kare; nizcaYa zaYatAna mAnuSera spaSTa zatru|
tomAdera rava tomAdera samparke adhika avagata| tini yadi cAna tomAdera prati rahama karavena athavA yadi cAna tave tomAderake zAsti devena; Ami tomAke tAdera karmavidhAYaka kare preraNa karini|
Ara tomAra rava adhika avagata tAdera samparke yArA AsamAnasamUha o yamIne raYeche| Ara Ami to kataka navIke katakera upara zreSThatva diYechi evaM dAUdake diYechi yAvUra|
vala, ‘tAderake DAka, AllAha chAr3A tomarA yAderake (upAsya) mane kara| tArA to tomAdera duHkha-durdazA dUra karAra o parivartana karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA’|

tArA yAderake DAke, tArA nijerAi to tAdera ravera kAche naikaTyera mAdhyame anusandhAna kare ye, tAdera madhye ke tA~ra nikaTatara? Ara tArA tA~ra rahamatera AzA kare evaM tA~ra AyAvake bhaYa kare| nizcaYa tomAra ravera AyAva bhItikara|
Ara emana kona janapada nei, yA Ami kiYAmatera dinera pUrve dhvaMsa karava nA athavA yAke kaThora AyAva deva nA; eTA to kitAve likhita Ache|

Ara pUrvavartIgaNa kartRka nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karAi AmAke tA (nidarzanAvalI) preraNa karA hate virata rekheche| Ara Ami zikSAprada nidarzanasvarUpa sAmUda jAtike uSTrI diYechilAma, ataHpara tArA tAra upara yulama karechila| Ami kevala bhIti pradarzanera uddezye nidarzanasamUha pAThAi|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami tomAke valalAma, ‘nizcaYa tomAra rava mAnuSake ghire rekhechena| Ara ye ‘dRzya’* Ami tomAke dekhiYechi tA evaM kuraAne varNita abhizapta vRkSa** kevala mAnuSera parIkSAsvarUpa nirdhAraNa karechi’| Ami tAdera bhaYa dekhAi; kintu tA kevala tAdera carama avAdhyatA vAr3iYe deYa| * arthAt, ru’YA hacche svapne athavA vAstave svapnavat dekhA| esthale vAstave dekhA uddezya| kAraNa, rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma mirAje dekhA dRzyAvalI o ghaTanAvalI vAstave o svazarIre dekhechena|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAdera valalAma, ‘Adamake sijadA kara’, takhana ivalIsa chAr3A sakale sijadA karala| se valala, ‘Ami ki emana vyaktike sijadA karava yAke Apani kAdAmATi theke sRSTi karechena’?

se valala, ‘dekhuna, e vyakti, yAke Apani AmAra upara sammAna diYechena, yadi Apani AmAke kiYAmata paryanta samaYa dena, tave ati sAmAnya saMkhyaka chAr3A tAra vaMzadharaderake avazyai pathabhraSTa kare chAr3ava’|
tini valalena, ‘yAo, ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa karave, jAhAnnAmai have tomAdera pratidAna, pUrNa pratidAna hiseve’|

‘tomAra kaNTha diYe tAdera madhye yAke pAro prarocita kara, tAdera upara jhApiYe par3a tomAra azvArohI o padAtika vAhinI niYe evaM tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite aMzIdAra hao evaM tAderake oYAdA dAo’| Ara zaYatAna pratAraNA chAr3A tAderake kona oYAdAi deYa nA|
nizcaYa AmAra vAndAdera upara tomAra kona kSamatA nei| karmavidhAYaka hiseve tomAra ravai yatheSTa|
tomAdera rava tini, yini tomAdera janya samudre cAlita karena nauyAna, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra| nizcaYa tini tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|

Ara yakhana tomAderake samudre vipada sparza kare, takhana tini chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAka, tArA (tomAdera mana theke) hAriYe yAYa; ataHpara tini yakhana tomAderake rakSA kare sthale Anena, takhana tomarA vimukha haYe yAo| Ara mAnuSa to khuva akRtajJa|

tomarA ki nirApada haYe giYecha ye, tini tomAderasaha sthalera kona dika dhvasiYe devena nA athavA tomAdera upara zilA varSaNakArI vAtAsa preraNa karavena nA? tArapara tomarA tomAdera janya kona karmavidhAYaka pAve nA|

athavA tomarA ki nirApada haYe giYecha ye, tini tomAderake ArekavAra samudre phiriYe nevena nA, ataHpara tomAdera upara pracanDa vAtAsa pAThAvena nA evaM tomAderake DuviYe devena nA, tomarA kupharI karAra kAraNe? tArapara tomarA AmAra viruddhe e viSaYe kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

Ara Ami to Adama santAnadera sammAnita karechi evaM Ami tAderake sthale o samudre vAhana diYechi evaM tAderake diYechi uttama riyka| Ara Ami yA sRSTi karechi tAdera theke anekera upara Ami tAderake aneka maryAdA diYechi|

smaraNa kara, yedina Ami pratyeka mAnuSake tAdera imAmasaha* DAkava| ataHpara yAke tAra AmalanAmA DAna hAte deYA have tArA nijadera AmalanAmA pATha karave evaM tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANa avicAra karA have nA| * ‘imAma’ artha ekhAne netA, AmalanAmA, navI vA pratiTi jAtira sva sva aizI kitAva|
Ara ye vyakti ekhAne andha se AkhirAteo andha evaM adhikatara pathabhraSTa|

Ara tAdera avasthA emana chila ye, Ami tomAke ye ohI diYechi, tA theke tArA tomAke prAYa phitanAYa phele diYechila, yAte tumi AmAra nAme era viparIta mithyA raTAte pAra evaM takhana tArA avazyai tomAke vandhurUpe grahaNa karata|
Ara Ami yadi tomAke avicala nA rAkhatAma, tave avazyai tumi tAdera dike kichuTA jhu~ke par3ate,

takhana Ami avazyai tomAke AsvAdana karAtAma jIvanera dviguNa o maraNera dviguNa AyAva|* tArapara tumi tomAra janya AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA| * ekhAne jIvanera diguNa o maraNera diguNa AyAva dvArA duniYAvI jIvana o AkhirAtera jIvanera diguNa AyAva uddezya|
Ara tAdera avasthA emana chila ye, tArA tomAke yamIna theke utkhAta kare deve, yAte tomAke sekhAna theke vera kare dite pAre evaM takhana tArA tomAra pare svalpa samaYai Tike thAkate pArata|
tAdera niYama anusAre yAderake Ami AmAra rAsUladera madhye tomAra pUrve pAThiYechilAma evaM tumi AmAra niYame kona parivartana pAve nA|

sUrya hele par3Ara samaYa theke rAtera andhakAra paryanta sAlAta kAYema kara evaM phajarera kuraAna*| nizcaYa phajarera kuraAna (pherezatAdera) upasthitira samaYa|** *‘phajarera kuraAna’ dvArA uddezya phajarera sAlAta|
Ara rAtera kichu aMze tAhAjjuda AdAYa kara tomAra atirikta dAYitva hiseve| AzA karA yAYa, tomAra rava tomAke prazaMsita avasthAne pratiSThita karavena|

Ara vala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke praveza karAo uttamabhAve evaM vera kara uttamabhAve*| Ara tomAra pakSa theke AmAke sAhAyyakArI zakti dAna kara’| * uttamabhAve praveza karAo arthAt sasammAne o maryAdAra sAthe madInAYa praveza karAo evaM vera kara uttamabhAve arthAt makkA theke vera kara vijaYI veze| tAphasIre zAokAnI|
Ara vala, ‘haka eseche evaM vAtila vilupta haYeche| nizcaYa vAtila vilupta haoYArai chila’|
Ara Ami kuraAna nAyila kari yA muminadera janya ziphA o rahamata, kintu tA yAlimadera kSatii vAr3iYe deYa|
Ara Ami yakhana mAnuSera upara niAmata dAna kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o dUre sare yAYa evaM yakhana tAke aniSTa sparza kare takhana se khuva hatAza haYe par3e|
vala, ‘pratyekei Amala kare thAke nija paddhati anuyAYI evaM tomAra rava adhika avagata Achena ke sarvAdhika nirbhula pathe’|
Ara tArA tomAke rUha samparke prazna kare| vala, ‘rUha AmAra ravera Adeza theke, Ara tomAderake jJAna theke ati sAmAnyai deYA haYeche’|
Ara Ami icchA karale tomAra kAche ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThiYechi tA avazyai niYe nite pAratAma; ataHpara tumi e viSaYe AmAra viruddhe tomAra janya kona karmavidhAYaka pete nA|
tave tomAra ravera pakSa theke (eTA) rahamatasvarUpa; nizcaYa tomAra prati tA~ra anugraha virATa|
vala, ‘yadi mAnuSa o jina e kuraAnera anurUpa hAyira karAra janya ekatrita haYa, tavuo tArA era anurUpa hAyira karate pArave nA yadio tArA eke aparera sAhAyyakArI haYa’|
Ara avazyai mAnuSera janya e kuraAne Ami nAnAbhAve vibhinna upamA varNanA karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kupharI nA kare thAkeni|
Ara tArA vale, ‘AmarA tomAra prati kakhano ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera janya yamIna theke ekaTi jharnAdhArA utsArita karave’|
‘athavA tomAra janya khejura o AGgurera ekaTi vAgAna have, ataHpara tumi tAra madhye pravAhita karave nadI-nAlA’|
‘athavA tumi yemanaTi dhAraNA kara, se anuyAYI AsamAnake khanDa khanDa kare AmAdera upare phelave, athavA AllAha o phereztAderake AmAdera mukhomukhi niYe Asave’|

‘athavA tomAra janya svarNera ekaTi ghara have athavA tumi AsamAne uThave, kintu tomAra uThAteo AmarA ImAna Anava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera prati eka kitAva nAyila karave yA AmarA pATha karava’| vala, ‘pavitra mahAna AmAra rava! Ami to ekajana mAnava-rAsUla chAr3A kichu nai’?
Ara yakhana mAnuSera nikaTa hidAYAta Ase takhana tAdera ImAna Anate vAdhA deYa tAdera e kathA ye, ‘AllAha ki mAnuSake rAsUla hiseve pAThiYechena’?
vala, ‘phereztArA yadi yamIne calAcala karata nizcintabhAve tAhale Ami avazyai AsamAna hate tAdera kAche pherezatA pAThAtAma rAsUla hiseve’|
vala, ‘AllAhai yatheSTa AmAra o tomAdera madhye svAkSI hiseve; nizcaYa tini tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre pUrNa jJAta, pUrNa draSTA’|

Ara AllAha yAke hidAYAta dAna karena se-i hidAYAtaprApta evaM yAke tini pathahArA karena tumi kakhano tAdera janya tA~ke chAr3A abhibhAvaka pAve nA| Ara Ami kiYAmatera dine tAderake ekatra karava upur3a kare, andha, mUka o vadhira avasthAYa| tAdera AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma; yakhanai tA nisteja have takhanai Ami tAdera janya Aguna vAr3iYe deva|
eTAi tAdera pratidAna, kAraNa tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kareche evaM valeche, ‘AmarA yakhana hADDi o chinna-bhinna haYe yAva, takhana AmarA ki natuna sRSTirUpe punarujjIvita hava’?

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena, tini tAdera anurUpa sRSTi karate sakSama? Ara tini tAdera janya ekaTi samaYa nirdhAraNa karechena yAte kona sandeha nei| kintu yAlimarA kupharI nA kare thAkeni|
vala, ‘yadi tomarA AmAra ravera rahamatera bhAnDArasamUhera mAlika hate, tavuo kharaca haYe yAoYAra bhaYe tomarA tA ATake rAkhate; Ara mAnuSa to ati kRpaNa’|

Ara Ami mUsAke naYaTi spaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma, sutarAM tumi vanI isarAIlake jijJAsA kara, yakhana se tAdera kAche Asala takhana phira‘Auna tAke valala, ‘he mUsA, Amito dhAraNA kari tumi yAdugrasta’|
se valala, ‘tumi jAna ye, e sakala viSaYa kevala AsamAnasamUha o yamInera ravai nAyila karechena pratyakSa pramANa hiseve| Ara he phira‘Auna, Ami to dhAraNA kari tumi dhvaMsaprApta|
ataHpara se tAderake deza theke utkhAta karAra icchA karala; takhana Ami tAke o tAra sAthe yArA chila sakalake DuviYe dilAma|
Ara Ami erapara vanI isarAIlake valalAma, ‘tomarA yamIne vAsa kara, ataHpara yakhana AkhirAtera oYAdA Asave takhana Ami tomAderake jar3o kare niYe Asava’|
Ara Ami tA yathAyathabhAve nAyila karechi evaM yathAyathabhAve tA nAyila haYeche| Ami to tomAke kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe pAThiYechi|
Ara kuraAna Ami nAyila karechi kichu kichu kare, yena tumi tA mAnuSera kAche pATha karate pAra dhIre dhIre evaM Ami tA nAyila karechi paryAYakrame|
vala, ‘tomarA ete ImAna Ana vA ImAna nA Ana, nizcaYa era pUrve yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche, tAdera kAche yakhana eTA pATha karA haYa takhana tArA sijadAvanata haYe luTiYe par3e|
Ara tArA vale, ‘pavitra mahAna AmAdera rava! AmAdera ravera oYAdA avazyai kAryakara haYe thAke’|
‘Ara tArA kA~date kA~date luTiYe par3e evaM eTA tAdera vinaYa vRddhi kare’|[sAjadAha]

vala, ‘tomarA (tomAdera ravake) ‘AllAha’ nAme DAka athavA ‘rAhamAna’ nAme DAka, ye nAmei tomarA DAka nA kena, tA~ra janyai to raYeche sundara nAmasamUha| tumi tomAra sAlAte svara u~cu karo nA evaM tAte mRduo karo nA; varaM era mAjhAmAjhi patha avalamvana kara|

Ara vala, ‘samasta prazaMsA AlalAharai, yini kona santAna grahaNa karenani, rAjatve tA~ra kona zarIka nei evaM apamAna theke vA~cate tA~ra kona abhibhAvakera darakAra nei|’ sutarAM tumi pUrNarUpe tA~ra var3atva ghoSaNA kara|
samasta prazaMsA AllAhara, yini tA~ra vAndAra upara kitAva nAyila karechena evaM tAte rAkhenani kona vakratA |
saralarUpe, yAte se tA~ra pakSa theke kaThina AyAva samparke satarka kare evaM susaMvAda deYa, sesava muminake, yArA satkarma kare, nizcaYa tAdera janya raYeche uttama pratidAna|
tArA tAte anantakAla avasthAna karave|
Ara yena satarka kare tAderake, yArA vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena’|
e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAna nei evaM tAdera pitRpuruSaderao nA| var3a mArAtmaka kathA, yA tAdera mukha theke vera haYa| mithyA chAr3A tArA kichui vale nA!
haYato tumi tAdera pechane pechane ghure duHkhe nijake zeSa kare deve, yadi tArA ei kathAra prati ImAna nA Ane|
nizcaYa yamInera upara yA raYeche, tA Ami zobhA karechi tAra janya, yAte tAderake parIkSA kari ye, karme tAdera madhye ke uttama|
Ara nizcaYa tAra upara yA raYeche tAke Ami udbhidahIna zuSka mATite pariNata karava|

tumi ki mane karecha ye, guhA o rAkImera* adhivAsIrA chila AmAra AYAtasamUhera eka vismaYa? * rAkIma ekaTi pAhAr3era nAma, athavA ye grAma theke tArA vera haYechila se grAmera nAma, athavA ekaTi phalaka- yAte ai sava yuvakera nAma likhA chila|
yakhana yuvakarA guhAYa AzraYa nila ataHpara valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake ApanAra pakSa theke rahamata dina evaM AmAdera janya AmAdera karmakAnDa saThika kare dina’|
phale Ami guhAYa tAdera kAna vandha kare dilAma aneka vacharera janya|

tArapara Ami tAderake jAgAlAma, yAte Ami jAnate pAri, yataTuku samaYa tArA avasthAna karechila, du’dalera madhye* ke tA adhika nirNaYakArI| * guhAYa avasthAna kAla niYe du’Ti dala haYechila| ekadala valechila, AmarA avasthAna karechi eka dina athavA eka dinera kichu kama samaYa; anyadala valechila, dIrgha samaYa|
Amii tomAke tAdera saMvAda saThikabhAve varNanA karachi| nizcaYa tArA kaYekajana yuvaka, yArA tAdera ravera prati ImAna enechila evaM Ami tAdera hidAYAta vAr3iYe diYechilAma|

yakhana tArA uThechila, Ami tAdera antarake dRr3ha karechilAma| takhana tArA valala, ‘AmAdera rava AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rava| tini chAr3A kona ilAhake AmarA kakhano DAkava nA| (yadi DAki) tAhale nizcaYa AmarA garhita kathA valava’|

erA AmAdera kaoma, tArA tA~ke chAr3A anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche| kena tArA tAdera vyApAre spaSTa pramANa upasthita kare nA? ataeva ye AllAhara vyApAre mithyA raTAYa, tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke?

Ara yakhana tomarA tAdera theke AlAdA haYecha evaM AllAha chAr3A yAdera tArA upAsanA kare tAdera thekeo, takhana guhAYa AzraYa nAo| tAhale tomAdera rava tomAdera janya tAra rahamata unmukta kare devena evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera jIvanopakaraNera viSaYaTi sahaja kare devena|

Ara tumi dekhate pete, sUrya udita hale tAdera guhAra DAne tA hele par3ache, Ara asta gele tAderake vAme rekhe keTe yAcche, takhana tArA chila tAra AGinAYa| egulo AllAhara AYAtasamUhera kichu| AllAha yAke hidAYAta dena, se hedAYAtaprApta| Ara yAke bhraSTa karena, tumi tAra janya pathanirdezakArI kona abhibhAvaka pAve nA|

tumi tAderake mane karate jAgrata, athaca tArA chila ghumanta, Ami tAderake pAza parivartana karAcchi DAne o vAme evaM tAdera kukuraTi AGinAYa tAra sAmanera du’pA vAr3iYe Ache| yadi tumi tAderake u~ki mere dekhate, tave nizcaYa tAdera theke pechane phire pAliYe yete evaM avazyai tAdera kAraNe bhISaNa bhIta hate|

Ara emanibhAve Ami tAderake jAgiYe tulechilAma, yAte tArA paraspara jijJAsA kare| tAdera ekajana valala, ‘tomarA katakSaNa avasthAna karale’? tArA valala, ‘AmarA ekadina kiMvA ekadinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi| tArA valala, ‘tomarA katakSaNa avasthAna karecha, se vyApAre tomAdera ravai adhika jAnena| tAi tomarA tomAdera kAuke tomAdera ei raupyamudrAgulo diYe zahare pAThAo| ataHpara se yena dekhe zaharera kon khAvAra ekevAre bhejAlamukta, takhana se yena tomAdera janya tA theke kichu khAvAra niYe Ase| Ara se avazyai sAvadhAnatA avalamvana karave evaM kAuke yena tomAdera vyApAre nA jAnAYa’|
‘nizcaYa tArA yadi tomAdera vyApAre jene yAYa, tAhale tArA tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karave athavA tomAderake tAdera dharme phiriYe niYe yAve| Ara takhana tomarA konabhAvei saphala have nA’|

Ara emanibhAve Ami tAdera vyApAre (lokaderake) jAniYe dilAma, yAte tArA jAnate pAre ye, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM kiYAmatera vyApAre kona sandeha nei| yakhana tArA nijedera madhye tAdera viSaYaTi niYe vitarka karachila, takhana tArA valala, ‘tAdera upara tomarA ekaTi bhavana nirmANa kara’| tAdera ravai tAdera vyApAre adhika jJAta| yArA guhAvAsIdera upara prAdhAnya lAbha karechila, tArA valala, ‘AmarA avazyai tAdera upara ekaTi masajida nirmANa karava’|

vitarkakArIrA valave, ‘tArA chila tina jana, caturtha hala tAdera kukura’| Ara kataka valave, ‘tArA chila pA~cajana, SaSTha hala tAdera kukura’| esavai ajAnA viSaYe anumAna kare| Ara keu keu valave, ‘tArA chila sAta jana; aSTama hala tAdera kukura’| vala, ‘AmAra ravai tAdera saMkhyA samparke adhika jJAta’| kama saMkhyaka lokai tAderake jAne| sutarAM spaSTa AlocanA chAr3A tumi tAdera vyApAre vitarka karo nA| Ara tAdera vyApAre lokadera madhye kAro kAche jAnate ceYo nA|
Ara kona kichura vyApAre tumi moTei valave nA ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tA AgAmI kAla karava’,
tave ‘AllAha yadi cAna’| Ara yakhana bhule yAo, takhana tumi tomAra ravera yikira kara evaM vala, AzA kari, AllAha AmAke era ceYeo nikaTavartI satya pathera hidAYAta devena|
Ara tArA tAdera guhAYa avasthAna kareche tinaza’ vachara evaM era sAthe atirikta haYechila ‘naYa’|

vala, ‘tArA ye samaYaTuku avasthAna karechila, se vyApAre AllAhai adhika jAnena’| AsamAnasamUha o yamInera gAYevI viSaYa tA~rai| e vyApAre tinii uttama draSTA o uttama zrotA| tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei| tA~ra siddhAnte tini kAuke zarIka karena nA|
Ara tomAra ravera kitAva theke tomAra nikaTa ye ohI pAThAno haYa, tumi tA tilAoYAta kara| tA~ra vANIsamUhera kona parivartanakArI nei evaM tini chAr3A kona AzraYasthala tumi pAve nA|

Ara tumi nijake dhairyazIla rAkha tAdera sAthe, yArA sakAla-sandhyAYa tAdera ravake DAke, tA~ra santuSTira uddeze, evaM duniYAra jIvanera saundarya kAmanA kare tomAra du’cokha yena tAdera theke ghure nA yAYa| Ara oi vyaktira Anugatya karo nA, yAra antarake Ami AmAra yikira theke gAphela kare diYechi evaM ye tAra pravRttira anusaraNa kareche evaM yAra karma vinaSTa haYeche|

Ara vala, ‘satya tomAdera ravera pakSa theke| sutarAM ye icchA kare se yena ImAna Ane evaM ye icchA kare se yena kupharI kare| nizcaYa Ami yAlimadera janya Aguna prasttata karechi, yAra prAcIragulo tAderake veSTana kare rekheche| yadi tArA pAni cAYa, tave tAderake deYA have emana pAni yA galita dhAtura mata, yA cehArAgulo jhalase deve| kI nikRSTa pAnIYa! Ara kI manda vizrAmasthala!
nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, nizcaYa Ami emana kAro pratidAna naSTa karava nA, ye sukarma kareche|

erAi tArA, yAdera janya raYeche sthAYI jAnnAtasamUha, yAra nica diYe pravAhita haYa nadIsamUha| sekhAne tAderake alaMkRta karA have svarNera cur3i diYe evaM tArA paridhAna karave mihi o puru silkera savuja pozAka| tArA sekhAne (thAkave) Asane helAna diYe| kI uttama pratidAna evaM kI sundara vizrAmasthala!

Ara tumi tAdera janya ekaTi dRSTAnta peza kara: dui vyakti, tAdera ekajanake Ami du’Ti AGgurera vAgAna diYechi evaM ubhaYa vAgAnake ghire diYechi khejura gAcha dvArA evaM ubhaYera mAjhakhAne rekhechi zasyakSeta|
ubhaYa vAgAna phala diYeche, tAte kichui truTi kareni evaM Ami ubhaYera mAjha diYe nadI pravAhita karechi|
Ara (ete) tAra chila vipula phala-phalAdi| tAi se tAra saGgIke kathAYa kathAYa valala, ‘sampade Ami tomAra ceYe adhika evaM janavaleo aneka zaktizAlI’|
Ara se tAra vAgAne praveza karala, nijera prati yulamarata avasthAYa| se valala, ‘Ami mane kari nA ye, eTi kakhano dhvaMsa have’|
‘Ara Ami mane kari nA ye, kiYAmata saMghaTita have| Ara AmAke yadi phiriYe neYA haYa AmAra ravera kAche, tave nizcaYa Ami era ceYe uttama pratyAvartanasthala pAva’|
kathAYa kathAYa tAra saGgI valala, ‘tumi ki tAke asvIkAra karacha, yini tomAke sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara ‘vIrya’ theke, tArapara tomAke avaYava diYechena puruSera’?
‘kintu tinii AllAha, AmAra rava| Ara Ami AmAra ravera sAthe kAuke zarIka kari nA’|
‘Ara yakhana tumi tomAra vAgAne praveza karale, takhana kena tumi valale nA, ‘mAzAAllAha’! AllAhara tauphika chAr3A kona zakti nei| tumi yadi dekha ye, Ami sampade o santAne tomAra ceYe kama,
tave AzA karA yAYa ye, ‘AmAra rava AmAke tomAra vAgAnera ceYe uttama (kichu) dAna karavena evaM tAra upara AsamAna theke vajra pAThAvena| phale tA anurvara udbhidazUnya yamIne pariNata have’|
‘kiMvA tAra pAni mATira gabhIre cale yAve, phale tA tumi konabhAvei khu~je pAve nA’|

Ara (viparyaYe) tAra phala-phalAdi ghire phelA hala| phale tAte se yA vyaYa karechila, tAra janya (AkSepe) hAta kacalAte lAgala evaM seTi dhvaMsa haYechila tAra mAcAra upara| Ara se valachila, ‘hAYa AkSepa! Ami yadi AmAra ravera sAthe kAuke zarIka nA karatAma’!
Ara AllAha chAr3A tAra emana kona lokavalao chila nA yArA tAke sAhAyya karave evaM se sAhAyyaprAptao chila nA|
ekhAne abhibhAvakatva AllAhara, yini satya| tinii pratidAne uttama evaM pariNAme zreSTha|

Ara Apani tAdera janya peza karuna duniYAra jIvanera upamA tA pAnira mata, yA Ami AsamAna theke varSaNa karechi| ataHpara tAra sAthe mizrita haYa yamInera udbhida| phale tA pariNata haYa emana zukano gu~r3AYa, vAtAsa yAke ur3iYe neYa| Ara AllAha savakichura upara kSamatAvAna|
sampada o santAna-santati duniYAra jIvanera zobhA| Ara sthAYI satkAja tomAra ravera nikaTa pratidAne uttama evaM pratyAzAteo uttama|
smaraNa kara sedinera kathA yedina Ami parvatake karava saJcAlita evaM tumi pRthivIke dekhave ekaTi zUnya prAntara; sedina mAnuSake Ami ekatrita karava evaM tAdera kehakeo avyAhati diva nA|

Ara tAderake tomAra ravera sAmane upasthita karA have kAtAravaddha kare| (AllAha valavena) ‘tomarA AmAra kAche esecha temanabhAve, yemana Ami tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma; varaM tomarA to bhevechile Ami tomAdera janya kona pratizruta muhUrta rAkhini’|

Ara AmalanAmA rAkhA have| takhana tumi aparAdhIderake dekhate pAve bhIta, tAte yA raYeche tAra kAraNe| Ara tArA valave, ‘hAYa dhvaMsa AmAdera! kI hala e kitAvera! tA choTa-var3a kichui chAr3e nA, zudhu saMrakSaNa kare’ evaM tArA yA kareche, tA hAyira pAve| Ara tomAra rava kAro prati yulama karena nA|

Ara yakhana Ami pherezatAdera valechilAma, tomarA Adamake sijadA kara| ataHpara tArA sijadA karala, ivalIsa chAr3A| se chila jinadera ekajana| se tAra ravera nirdeza amAnya karala| tomarA ki tAke o tAra vaMzake AmAra parivarte abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa karave, athaca tArA tomAdera zatru? yAlimadera janya kI manda vinimaYa!
Ami tAderake AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTira sAkSI karini evaM nA tAdera nijadera sRSTira| Ara Ami pathabhraSTakArIderake sahAYatAkArI hiseve grahaNa karini|

Ara yedina tini valavena, ‘tomarA DAka AmAra zarIkadera, yAderake tomarA (zarIka) mane karate’| ataHpara tArA tAderake DAkave, kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA| Ara Ami tAdera madhye rekhe deva dhvaMsasthala|
Ara aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhave, ataHpara tArA nizcitarUpe jAnate pArave ye, nizcaYa tArA tAte nipatita have evaM tArA tA theke vA~cAra kona patha khu~je pAve nA|
Ara Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janya sakala prakAra upamA vistArita varNanA karechi| Ara mAnuSa savaceYe vezi tarkakArI|

Ara yakhana mAnuSera nikaTa hidAYAta eseche, takhana tAderake ImAna Anate kiMvA tAdera ravera kAche istigaphAra karate vAdhA pradAna kareche kevala e viSaYaTii ye, pUrvavartIdera (vyApAre AmAra nirdhArita) rIti tAdera upara punarAYa neme Asave kiMvA tAdera upara AyAva sarAsari ese upasthita have|

Ara Ami to rAsUladerake susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYechi evaM yArA kupharI kareche tArA vAtila dvArA tarka kare, yAte tAra mAdhyame satyake miTiYe dite pAre| Ara tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake evaM yA diYe tAderake satarka karA haYeche, tAke upahAsa hiseve grahaNa kare|

Ara tAra ceYe adhika yAlima Ara ke hate pAre, yAke tAra ravera AYAtasamUha smaraNa kariYe deYA haYeche, ataHpara se tA theke vimukha haYeche evaM se bhule geche yA tAra du-hAta peza kareche? nizcaYa Ami tAdera antarasamUhera upara pardA diYe diYechi, yAte tArA tA (kuraAna) vujhate nA pAre| Ara tAdera karNasamUhe raYeche vadhiratA evaM tumi tAderake hidAYAtera prati AhavAna karaleo tArA kakhano hidAYAtaprApta have nA|

Ara tomAra rava kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa| tArA yA upArjana kareche, tAra kAraNe tini yadi tAderake pAkar3Ao karatena tave avazyai tAdera janya AyAva tvarAnvita karatena| varaM tAdera janya raYeche pratizruta samaYa, yA theke tArA kona AzraYasthala pAve nA|
Ara egulo sei janapada yegulo Ami dhvaMsa karechi yakhana tArA yulama kareche evaM Ami tAdera dhvaMsera janya ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa nirdhAraNa karechi|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sahacara yuvakaTike valala, Ami calate thAkava yatakSaNa nA dui samudrera milanasthale upanIta hava kiMvA dIrgha samaYa kATiYe deva|
erapara yakhana tArA tAdera dui samudrera milanasthale upanIta hala, takhana tArA tAdera mAchera kathA bhule gela| phale mAchaTi nAlAra mata kare samudre tAra patha kare nila|
