ataHpara yakhana tArA agrasara hala takhana se tAra yuvakake valala, ‘AmAdera sakAlera khAvAra niYe Asa| AmAdera ei saphare AmarA aneka klAntira mukhomukhi haYechi’|

se valala, Apani ki lakSya karechena ye, yakhana AmarA pAtharaTite vizrAma nicchilAma, takhana Ami mAchaTi hAriYe pheli| Ara AmAke tA smaraNa karate bhuliYeche kevala zaYatAna evaM AzcaryajanakabhAve tA samudre tAra patha kare niYeche’|
se valala, ‘ai sthAnaTii AmarA khu~jachi| tAi tArA tAdera padaci‎hna anusaraNa kare pechane phire gela’|
ataHpara tArA AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke eka vAndAke pela, yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke rahamata dAna karechi evaM tAke AmAra pakSa theke jJAna zikSA diYechi|
mUsA tA~ke valala, ‘Ami ki ApanAke ei zarte anusaraNa karava ye, ApanAke ye saThika jJAna deYA haYeche, tA AmAke zikSA devena’?
se valala, ‘Apani kakhano AmAra sAthe dhairyadhAraNa karate pAravena nA’|
‘Apani tAte kIbhAve dhairya dharavena, ye samparke Apani jAnena nA’?
se valala, ‘inazAAllAha, Apani AmAke dhairyazIla pAvena evaM kona viSaYe Ami ApanAra avAdhya hava nA’|
se valala, ‘tave Apani yadi AmAke anusaraNa karena, tAhale kona viSaYa samparke AmAke prazna karavena nA, yatakSaNa nA Ami se samparke ApanAke jAnAi’|
ataHpara tArA calate thAka| avazeSe yakhana tArA jAhAje car3ala, se tA phuTo kare dila| se valala, ‘Apani ki tAra ArohIdera DuvAnora janya tA phuTo kare dilena? Apani avazyai manda kAja karalena’|
se valala, ‘Ami ki valini, Apani AmAra sAthe dhairyadhAraNa karate pAravena nA?
se valala, ‘Ami yA bhule giYechi, se vyApAre AmAke dharavena nA evaM AmAke AmAra viSaYe kaThora AcaraNa karavena nA|

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala| avazeSe yakhana tArA eka vAlakera sAkSAt pela, takhana se tAke hatyA karala| se valala, ‘Apani niSpApa vyaktike hatyA karalena, ye kAuke hatyA kareni? Apani to khuvai manda kAja karalena’|
se valala, ‘Ami ki ApanAke valini ye, Apani AmAra sAthe kakhanai dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravena nA’?
mUsA valala, ‘erapara yadi Ami ApanAke Ara kona viSaYe prazna kari, tAhale Apani AmAke Ara ApanAra sAthe rAkhavena nA| AmAra pakSa theke Apani oyara peYe gechena’|

ataHpara tArA du’jana calate zuru karala| avazeSe yakhana tArA ekaTi janapadera adhivAsIdera nikaTa pau~chala takhana tAdera kAche kichu khAvAra cAila; kintu tArA tAderake mehamAnadArI karate asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA sekhAne ekaTi prAcIra dekhate pela, yA par3e yAoYAra upakrama haYechila| se takhana prAcIraTi sojAbhAve dA~r3a kariYe dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani icchA karale era janya pArizramika nite pAratena’|
se valala, ‘ekhAnei AmAra o ApanAra madhye viccheda| ye viSaYe Apani dhairya dhAraNa karate pArenani Ami ekhana ApanAke tAra vyAkhyA dicchi’|

‘naukATira viSaYa hala, tA chila kichu daridra lokera yArA samudre kAja karata| Ami naukATike truTiyukta karate ceYechi kAraNa tAdera pechane chila eka rAjA, ye naukAgulo jorapUrvaka chiniYe nicchila’|

‘Ara vAlakaTira viSaYa hala, tAra pitA-mAtA chila mumina| ataHpara Ami AzaMkA* karalAma ye, se sImAlaMghana o kupharI dvArA tAderake atiSTha kare tulave’| * tA~ra AzaMkA nichaka dhAraNA bhittika chila nA, varaM AllAhara pakSa theke tini nizcita jAnate perechilena|
‘tAi Ami cAilAma, tAdera rava tAderake tAra parivarte emana santAna dAna karavena, ye have tAra ceYe pavitratAYa uttama evaM daYAmAYAYa adhika ghaniSTha|

‘Ara prAcIraTira viSaYa hala, tA chila zaharera du’jana iYAtIma vAlakera evaM tAra nice chila tAdera guptadhana| Ara tAdera pitA chila satkarmaparAYaNa| tAi ApanAra rava cAilena ye, tArA du’jana prAptavaYaska haYe tAdera guptadhana vera kare neve| e savai ApanAra ravera rahamata svarUpa| Ami nija theke tA karini| e halo se viSaYera vyAkhyA, ye samparke Apani dhairya dhAraNa karate pArenani|
Ara tArA tomAke yulakAranAina samparke jijJAsA karache| vala, ‘Ami ekhana tAra samparke tomAdera nikaTa varNanA dicchi’|
Ami tAke yamIne kartRtva dAna karechilAma evaM savaviSaYera upAYa- upakaraNa dAna karechilAma|
ataHpara se ekaTi patha avalamvana karala|

avazeSe yakhana se sUryAstera sthAne pau~chala, takhana se sUryake ekaTi kardamAkta pAnira jharNAYa Duvate dekhate pela evaM se era kAche ekaTi jAtira dekhA pela| Ami valalAma, ‘he yulakAranAina, tumi tAderake AyAvao dite pAra athavA tAdera vyApAre sadAcaraNao karate pAra’|
se valala, ‘ye vyakti yulama karave, Ami acirei tAke zAsti deva| ataHpara tAke tAra ravera nikaTa phiriYe neYA have| takhana tini tAke kaThina AyAva devena’|
‘Ara ye vyakti ImAna Anave evaM satkAja karave, tAra janya raYeche uttama puraskAra| Ara Ami AmAra vyavahAre tAra sAthe narama kathA valava’|
tArapara se Areka patha avalamvana karala|
avazeSe se yakhana sUryodaYera sthAne ese pau~chala takhana se dekhate pela, tA emana eka jAtira upara udita hacche yAdera janya Ami sUryera viparIte kona Ar3Alera vyavasthA karini|
prakRta ghaTanA eTAi| Ara tAra nikaTa yA chila, Ami se samparke sampUrNa avahita|
tArapara se Areka patha avalamvana karala|
avazeSe yakhana se dui parvatera madhyavartI sthAne pau~chala, takhana sekhAne se emana eka jAtike pela, yArA tAra kathA temana ekaTA vujhate pArachila nA|

tArA valala, ‘he yulakAranAina! nizcaYa iYA’jUja o mA’jUja yamIne azAnti sRSTi karache, tAi AmarA ki ApanAke e janya kichu kharaca deva ye, Apani AmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTA prAcIra nirmANa kare devena’?
se valala, ‘AmAra rava AmAke ye sAmarthya diYechena, seTAi uttama| sutarAM tomarA AmAke zrama diYe sAhAyya kara| Ami tomAdera o tAdera mAjhakhAne ekaTi sudRr3ha prAcIra nirmANa kare deva’|

‘tomarA AmAke lohAra pAta ene dAo’| avazeSe yakhana se du’pAhAr3era madhyavartI jAYagA samAna kare dila, takhana se valala, ‘tomarA phu~ka dite thAka’| ataHpara yakhana se tA Agune pariNata karala, takhana valala, ‘tomarA AmAke kichu tAmA dAo, Ami tA era upara Dhele dei’|
erapara tArA (iYA’jUja o mA’jUja) prAcIrera upara diYe atikrama karate pArala nA evaM nica diYeo tA bheda karate pArala nA|
se valala, ‘eTA AmAra ravera anugraha| ataHpara yakhana AmAra ravera oYAdAkRta samaYa Asave takhana tini tA mATira sAthe miziYe devena| Ara AmAra ravera oYAdA satya’|
Ara sedina Ami tAderake emana avasthAYa cher3e deva ye, tArA ekadala Areka dalera upara taraGgamAlAra mata Achar3e par3ave evaM ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have| ataHpara Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava|
evaM Ami sedina kAphiradera janya jAhAnnAmake sarAsari upasthita karava;
AmAra smaraNa theke yAdera cokha chila AvaraNe DhAkA evaM yArA zunateo chila akSama|
yArA kupharI karache, tArA ki mane kareche ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? nizcaYa Ami jAhAnnAmake kAphiradera ApyAYanera janya prastuta karachi|
vala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake emana lokadera kathA jAnAva, yArA Amalera dika theke savaceYe vezI kSatigrasta’?
duniYAra jIvane yAdera ceSTA vyartha haYe geche, athaca tArA mane karache ye, tArA bhAla kAjai karache’!

‘tArAi sesava loka, yArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUha evaM tA~ra sAthe sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche| phale tAdera sakala Amala niSphala haYe geche| sutarAM Ami tAdera janya kiYAmatera dina kona ojanera vyavasthA rAkhava nA’|
‘e janyai tAdera pratiphala jAhAnnAma| kAraNa tArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha o AmAra rAsUlagaNake vidrUpera viSaYa vAniYeche’|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche, tAdera mehamAnadArira janya raYeche jAnnAtula pheradAusa|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| tArA sekhAna theke anya kothAo sthAnAntarita hate cAive nA|
vala, ‘AmAra ravera kathA lekhAra janya samudra yadi kAli haYe yAYa tave samudra niHzeSa haYe yAve AmAra ravera kathA zeSa haoYAra Agei| yadio era sAhAyyArthe anurUpa Aro samudra niYe Asi’|

vala, ‘Ami tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| AmAra nikaTa ohI preraNa karA haYa ye, tomAdera ilAhai eka ilAha| sutarAM ye tAra ravera sAkSAt kAmanA kare, se yena satkarma kare evaM tAra ravera ivAdAte kAuke zarIka nA kare’|
kApha-hA-iYA-‘AIna-soYAda|
eTA tomAra ravera rahamatera vivaraNa tA~ra vAndA yAkAriYyAra prati|
yakhana se tAra ravake gopane Dekechila|
se valechila, ‘he AmAra rava! AmAra hAr3agulo durvala haYe geche evaM vArdhakyavazataH AmAra mAthAra culagulo sAdA haYe geche| he AmAra rava, ApanAra nikaTa do‘A kare Ami kakhano vyartha haini’|
‘Ara AmAra pare svagotrIYadera samparke Ami AzaMkAvodha karachi| AmAra strI to vandhyA, ataeva Apani AmAke ApanAra pakSa theke ekajana uttarAdhikArI dAna karuna’|
‘ye AmAra uttarAdhikArI have evaM iYAkUvera vaMzera uttarAdhikArI have| he AmAra rava, Apani tAke pachandanIYa vAniYe dina’|
(AllAha valalena) ‘he yAkAriYyA, Ami tomAke ekaTi putra santAnera susaMvAda dicchi, tAra nAma iYAhaiYA| itipUrve kAuke Ami e nAma deini’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, kibhAve AmAra putra santAna have, AmAra strI to vandhyA, Ara Amio to vArdhakyera zeSa paryAYe pau~che giYechi’|
se (pherezatA) valala, ‘ebhAvei’| tomAra rava valechena, ‘eTA AmAra janya sahaja| Ami to itaHpUrve tomAke sRSTi karechi, takhana tumi kichui chile nA’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra janya ekaTi nidarzana Thika kare dina’| tini valalena, ‘tomAra janya eTAi nidarzana ye, tumi sustha thekeo tina rAta kAro sAthe kathA valave nA’|
ataHpara se miharAva hate veriYe tAra lokadera sAmane Asala evaM izArAYa tAderake valala ye, ‘tomarA sakAla o sandhyAYa tAsavIha pATha kara’|

‘he iYAhaiYA, tumi kitAvaTike dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhara’| Ami tAke zaizavei prajJA* dAna karechi| * ekhAne ‘hukama’ valate hikamAta vA prajJA vujhAno haYeche| kAro mate, tA hala ilama o Amala| keu valechena, navuoYAta vA Akala| imAma zaokAnI valena, ullekhita pratiTi viSaYa ‘hukama’ dvArA uddezya hate pAre|
Ara AmAra pakSa theke tAke sneha-mamatA o pavitratA dAna karechi evaM se muttAkI chila|
Ara se chila tAra pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadAcArI, Ara chila nA ahaMkArI, avAdhya|
Ara tAra upara zAnti, yedina se janmeche evaM yedina se mArA yAve Ara yedina tAke jIvita avasthAYa uThAno have|
Ara smaraNa kara ei kitAve mAraiYAmake yakhana se tAra parivAravarga theke pRthaka haYe pUrva dikera kona eka sthAne cale gela|
Ara se tAdera nikaTa theke (nijake) Ar3Ala karala| takhana Ami tAra nikaTa AmAra rUha (jivarIla) ke preraNa karalAma| ataHpara se tAra sAmane pUrNa mAnavera rUpa dhAraNa karala|
mAraiYAma valala, ‘Ami tomAra theke parama karuNAmaYera AzraYa cAcchi, yadi tumi muttAkI hao’|
se valala, ‘Ami to kevala tomAra ravera vArtAvAhaka, tomAke ekajana pavitra putrasantAna dAna karAra janya esechi’|
mAraiYAma valala, ‘kibhAve AmAra putra santAna have? athaca kona mAnuSa AmAke sparza kareni| Ara Ami to vyabhicAriNIo nai’|
se valala, ‘ebhAvei| tomAra rava valechena, eTA AmAra janya sahaja| Ara yena Ami tAke kare dei mAnuSera janya nidarzana evaM AmAra pakSa theke rahamata| Ara eTi ekaTi siddhAntakRta viSaYa’|
tArapara se tAke garbhe dhAraNa karala evaM tA niYe dUravartI ekaTi sthAne cale gela|
ataHpara prasava-vedanA tAke khejura gAchera kAnDera kAche niYe elo| se valala, ‘hAYa! era Agei yadi Ami mare yetAma evaM sampUrNarUpe vismRta hatAma’!
takhana tAra nica theke se tAke Deke valala ye, ‘tumi cintA karo nA| tomAra rava tomAra nice ekaTi jharNA sRSTi karechena’|
‘Ara tumi khejura gAchera kAnDa dhare tomAra dike nAr3A dAo, tAhale tA tomAra upara tAjA-pAkA khejura phelave’|

‘ataHpara tumi khAo, pAna kara evaM cokha jur3Ao| Ara yadi tumi kona lokake dekhate pAo tAhale vale dio, ‘Ami parama karuNAmaYera janya cupa thAkAra mAnata karechi| ataeva Aja Ami kona mAnuSera sAthe kichutei kathA valava nA’|
tArapara se tAke kole niYe nija kaomera nikaTa Asala| tArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma! tumi to eka adbhUta viSaYa niYe esecha’!
‘he hArUnera vona! tomAra pitA to khArApa loka chila nA| Ara tomAra mA-o chila nA vyabhicAriNI’|
takhana se zizuTira dike izArA karala| tArA valala, ‘ye kolera zizu AmarA kibhAve tAra sAthe kathA valava’?
zizuTi valala, ‘Ami to AllAhara vAndA; tini AmAke kitAva diYechena evaM AmAke navI vAniYechena’|
‘Ara yekhAnei Ami thAki nA kena tini AmAke varakatamaYa karechena evaM yatadina Ami jIvita thAki tini AmAke sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYa karate Adeza karechena’|
‘Ara AmAke mAYera prati anugata karechena evaM tini AmAke ahaGkArI, avAdhya karenani’|
‘Ara AmAra upara zAnti, yedina Ami janmechi evaM yedina Ami mArA yAva Ara yedina AmAke jIvita avasthAYa uThAno have’|
ei hacche mAraiYAma putra IsA| eTAi saThika vaktavya, ye viSaYe lokerA sandeha poSaNa karache|
santAna grahaNa karA AllAhara kAja naYa| tini pavitra-mahAna| tini yakhana kona viSaYera siddhAnta grahaNa karena takhana taduddezye zudhu valena, ‘hao’, amani tA haYe yAYa|
Ara nizcaYa AllAha AmAra rava evaM tomAdera rava| sutarAM tomarA tA~ra ivAdAta kara| eTAi sarala patha|
erapara tAdera madhya theke vibhinna dala matabheda karala| kAjei mahAdivasa pratyakSakAle kAphiradera dhvaMsa anivArya|
yedina tArA AmAra kAche Asave sedina tArA katai nA spaSTabhAve zunate pAve evaM dekhate pAve! kintu yAlimarA Aja spaSTa bhraSTatAra madhye raYeche|
Ara tAderake satarka kare dAo paritApa divasa samparke yakhana sava viSaYera cUr3Anta siddhAnta haYe yAve, athaca tArA raYeche udAsInatAYa vibhora evaM tArA ImAna Anache nA|

nizcaYa Ami yamIna o era upare yA raYeche tAra cUr3Anta mAlika hava* evaM AmArai nikaTa tAdera phiriYe AnA have| * cUr3Anta oYArisa valate vujhAno haYeche cUr3Anta mAlika arthAt sava kichu dhvaMsa haYe yAoYAra para ekamAtra AllAhai thAkavena evaM savakichu thAkave tA~ra mAlikAnAdhIna|
Ara smaraNa kara ei kitAve ivarAhImake| nizcaYa se chila parama satyavAdI, navI|
yakhana se tAra pitAke valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, tumi kena tAra ivAdAta kara ye nA zunate pAYa, nA dekhate pAYa evaM nA tomAra kona upakAre Asate pAre’?
‘he AmAra pitA! AmAra kAche emana jJAna eseche yA tomAra kAche Aseni, sutarAM AmAra anusaraNa kara, tAhale Ami tomAke saThika patha dekhAva’|
‘he AmAra pitA, tumi zaYatAnera ivAdAta karo nA| nizcaYa zaYatAna hala parama karuNAmaYera avAdhya’|
‘he AmAra pitA, Ami AzaMkA karachi ye, parama karuNAmaYera (pakSa theke) tomAke AyAva sparza karave, phale tumi zaYatAnera saGgI haYe yAve|’

se valala, ‘he ivarAhIma, tumi ki AmAra upAsyadera theke vimukha? yadi tumi virata nA hao, tave avazyai Ami tomAke pAthara mere hatyA karava| Ara tumi ciratare AmAke cher3e yAo’|* * ivane AvvAsera mate e AYAtera artha hala tumi AmAra kAcha theke nirApade sare yAo| keu keu e AYAtera arthe valechena, ‘tumi AmAra sAthe dIrgha samaYera janya kathA valave nA’| (At-tAphasIra Ala-muYAs‌sAra)
ivarAhIma valala, ‘tomAra prati sAlAma| Ami AmAra ravera kAche tomAra janya kSamA cAiva| nizcaYa tini AmAra prati var3ai anugrahazIla’|
‘Ara Ami tomAdera o AllAha chAr3A yAdera ivAdAta tomarA kara tAdera parityAga karachi evaM Ami AmAra ravera ivAdAta karachi| AzA kari AmAra ravera ivAdAta kare Ami vyartha hava nA’|
ataHpara yakhana se tAderake evaM AllAha chAr3A yAdera tArA ivAdAta karata tAdera savAike parityAga karala, takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYA‘kUva evaM tAdera pratyekake navI karalAma|
Ara Ami tAderake AmAra anugraha dAna karalAma Ara tAdera sunAma sukhyAtike samucca karalAma|
Ara smaraNa kara ei kitAve mUsAke| avazyai se chila manonIta evaM se chila rAsUla, navI|
Ami tAke tUra parvatera DAna dika theke DekechilAma evaM antaraGga AlApera uddezye tAke AmAra nikaTavartI karechilAma|
Ara Ami svIYa anugrahe tAra janya tAra bhAi hArUnake navIrUpe dAna karalAma|
Ara smaraNa kara ei kitAve isamAIlake| se chila satyikArera oYAdA pAlanakArI evaM se chila rAsUla, navI|
Ara se tAra parivAra-parijanake sAlAta o yAkAtera nirdeza dita evaM se chila tAra ravera santoSaprApta|
Ara smaraNa kara ei kitAve idarIsake| se chila parama satyaniSTha navI|
Ara Ami tAke ucca maryAdAYa samunnata karechilAma|

erAi se sava navI, Adama santAnera madhya theke yAdera upara AllAha anugraha karechena evaM yAdera Ami nUhera sAthe naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma| Ara ivarAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzodbhUta evaM yAderake Ami patha pradarzana karechilAma o manonIta karechilAma| yakhana tAdera kAche parama karuNAmaYera AYAtasamUha pATha karA hata, tArA kA~date kA~date sijadAYa luTiYe par3ata|[sAjadAha]
tAdera pare Asala emana eka asat vaMzadhara yArA sAlAta vinaSTa karala evaM kupravRttira anusaraNa karala| sutarAM zIghrai tArA jAhAnnAmera zAsti pratyakSa karave|
tave tArA naYa yArA tAovA kareche, ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche; tArAi jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati kona yulama karA have nA|
tA cirasthAYI jAnnAta, yAra oYAdA parama karuNAmaYa tA~ra vAndAdera diYechena gAYevera sAthe| nizcaYa tA~ra oYAdAkRta viSaYa avazyambhAvI|
tArA sekhAne ‘zAnti’ chAr3A kona arthahIna kathA zunave nA evaM sekhAne sakAla-sandhyAYa tAdera janya thAkave tAdera riyka|
sei jAnnAta, Ami yAra uttarAdhikArI vAnAva AmAra vAndAdera madhye tAderake yArA muttAkI|

(jivarIla valala) ‘Ara AmarA ApanAra ravera nirdeza chAr3A avataraNa kari nA| yA AmAdera sAmane Ache, Ara yA Ache AmAdera pichane evaM yA raYeche etadobhaYera madhye, sava tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna| Ara ApanAra rava bhule yAna nA|
tini AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o etadobhaYera madhye yA Ache tAra rava| sutarAM tA~ra ivAdAta kara evaM tA~rai ivAdAte dhairyazIla thAka| tumi ki tA~ra samatulya kAuke jAna?
Ara mAnuSa vale, ‘AmAra mRtyu hale AmAke ki jIvita avasthAYa utthita karA have?’
mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, Ami tAke pUrve sRSTi karechi athaca se kichui chila nA?
ataeva tomAra ravera kasama, Ami avazyai tAderake o zaYatAnaderake samaveta karava, ataHpara jAhAnnAmera cArapAze natajAnu avasthAYa tAderake hAyira karava|
tArapara pratyeka dala theke parama karuNAmaYera viruddhe sarvAdhika avAdhyake Ami Tene vera karavai|
uparantu Ami sarvAdhika bhAla jAni tAdera samparke, yArA jAhAnnAme dagdhIbhUta havAra adhikatara yogya|
Ara tomAdera pratyekakei tA atikrama karate have, eTi tomAra ravera cUr3Anta siddhAnta|
tArapara Ami ederake mukti deva yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche| Ara yAlimaderake Ami sekhAne rekhe deva natajAnu avasthAYa|
Ara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTarUpe pATha karA haYa, takhana kAphirarA ImAnadAraderake vale, ‘dui dalera madhye konTi maryAdAYa zreSThatara evaM majalisa hiseve uttama?’
Ara tAdera pUrve Ami kata prajanma dhvaMsa kare diYechi yArA sAja-saraJjAma o vAhyadRSTite zreSTha chila!

vala, ‘ye vibhrAntite raYeche tAke parama karuNAmaYa pracura avakAza devena, yatakSaNa nA tArA ye viSaYe tAdera pratizruti deYA haYeche tA pratyakSa karave, cAi tA AyAva hoka athavA kiYAmata| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa o dalavale durvala|
Ara yArA saThika pathe cale AllAha tAdera hidAYAta vRddhi karena Ara sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra ravera kAche puraskAra prAptira dika diYe zreSTha evaM pariNati hiseveo zreSTha|

tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecha* ye AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare evaM vale, ‘AmAke avazyai dhana-sampada o santAna-santati deYA have|’ * ullikhita AYAta ka’Ti ‘Asa ivana oYAYela samparke nAyila haYa| tA~ra kAche khAvavAva ivanula ArAta (rA.)era kichu RNa pAonA chila| tA cAite gele se tA pratyAkhyAna kare vale,‘Ami yakhana mArA yAva, ataHpara AvAra jIvita hava takhana tumi AmAra kAche eso| takhano AmAke santAna-santati deYA have| sekhAna theke tomAra RNa parizodha karava’|
se ki gAYeva samparke avahita haYeche, nA parama karuNAmaYera kAcha theke kona pratizruti grahaNa kareche?
kakhano naYa, se yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhava evaM tAra AyAva vAr3Atei thAkava|
Ara se yA vale Ami tAra adhikArI hava evaM AmAra kAche se ekAkI Asave|
Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A vahu ‘ilAha’ grahaNa kareche, yAte orA tAdera sAhAyyakArI hate pAre|
kakhano naYa, erA tAdera ivAdAtera kathA asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera vipakSa haYe yAve|
tumi ki lakSya karani ye, Ami kAphiradera janya zaYatAnaderake cher3e diYechi; orA tAderake vizeSabhAve prarocita kare?
sutarAM tAdera vyApAre tumi tAr3Ahur3A karo nA; Ami to kevala tAdera janya nirdhArita kAla gaNanA karachi,
yedina parama karuNAmaYera nikaTa muttAkIderake sammAnita mehamAnarUpe samaveta karava,
Ara aparAdhIderake tRSNArta avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAva|
yArA parama karuNAmaYera kAcha theke pratizruti niYeche tArA chAr3A anya keu supAriza karAra kSamatA rAkhave nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘parama karuNAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena|’
avazyai tomarA eka jaghanya viSaYera avatAraNA karecha|
ete AsamAnasamUha pheTe par3Ara, yamIna vidIrNa haoYAra evaM pAhAr3asamUha cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe par3e yAoYAra upakrama have|
kAraNa tArA parama karuNAmaYera santAna Ache vale dAvI kare|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA parama karuNAmaYera janya zobhanIYa naYa|
AsamAna o yamIne emana keu nei, ye vAndA hiseve parama karuNAmaYera kAche hAyira have nA|
tini tAdera saMkhyA jAnena evaM tAderake yathAyathabhAve gaNanA kare rekhechena|
Ara kiYAmatera dina tAdera sakalei tA~ra kAche Asave ekAkI|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane evaM sat kAja kare parama karuNAmaYa avazyai tAdera janya (vAndAdera hRdaYe) bhAlavAsA sRSTi karavena|
Ara Ami to tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi, yAte tumi era dvArA muttAkIderake susaMvAda dite pAra evaM kalahapriYa kaomake tadvArA satarka karate pAra|
Ara tAdera pUrve kata prajanmake Ami dhvaMsa karechi! tumi ki tAdera kAuke dekhate pAo, kiMvA zunate pAo tAdera kona kSINa AoYAja?
tva-hA
Ami tomAra prati Ala-kuraAna ejanya nAyila karini ye, tumi durbhoga pohAve
varaM ye bhaYa kare tAra janya upadeza svarUpa|
yini yamIna o suucca AsamAnasamUha sRSTi karechena tA~ra nikaTa theke avatIrNa|

parama karuNAmaYa Arazera opara uThechena* | * e AYAte AllAhara ekaTi kriYAvAcaka guNa sAvyasta karA haYeche| seTi hacche استواء vA Arazera upara uThA| imAma mAlekake e guNa samparke jijJAsA karA hale tini valena, استواء era artha jAnA Ache| tave tAra dharana (كيفيت) jAnA nei| era prati ImAna rAkhA oYAjiva evaM dharana samparke jijJAsA karA vidaAta| e nItiTi AllAhara sakala guNera kSetre prayojya|
yA Ache AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o e du’Yera madhyavartI sthAne evaM yA Ache mATira nice sava tA~rai|
Ara yadi tumi uccasvare kathA vala tave tini gopana o ati gopana viSaYa jAnena|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; sundara nAmasamUha tA~rai|
Ara tomAra kAche ki mUsAra kathA pau~cheche?

yakhana se Aguna dekhala, takhana nija parivArake valala, ‘tomarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhate peYechi, AzA kari Ami tomAdera janya tA theke kichu jvalanta AGgAra niYe Asate pArava athavA Agunera nikaTa pathanirdeza pAva|’
yakhana se Agunera kAche Asala takhana tAke AhavAna karA hala, ‘he mUsA’
nizcaYa Ami tomAra rava; sutarAM tomAra jutA jor3A khule phela, nizcaYa tumi pavitra ‘tuoYA’ upatyakAYa raYecha’|
‘Ara Ami tomAke manonIta karechi, sutarAM yA ohIrUpe pAThAno hacche tA manoyoga diYe zuna’|
‘nizcaYa Ami AllAha, Ami chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; sutarAM AmAra ivAdAta kara evaM AmAra smaraNArthe sAlAta kAYema kara’|
‘nizcaYa kiYAmata Asave; Ami tA gopana rAkhate cAi yAte pratyekake svIYa ceSTA-sAdhanA anuyAYI pratidAna deYA yAYa’|
ataeva ye vyakti tAra prati ImAna rAkhe nA evaM svIYa pravRttira anusaraNa kare se yena kichutei tAte ImAna AnaYane tomAke vAdhA dite nA pAre; anyathAYa tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
Ara ‘he mUsA, tomAra DAna hAte oTA ki’?
se valala, ‘eTi AmAra lAThi; Ami era opara bhara kari, eTi diYe Ami AmAra meSapAlera janya gAchera pAtA pAr3i evaM eTi AmAra Aro aneka kAje lAge|’
tini valalena, ‘he mUsA! oTA phele dAo|’
ataHpara se tA phele dila; amani tA sApa haYe chuTate lAgala|
tini valalena, ‘oTA dhara evaM bhaYa karo nA, Ami oke ora pUrvera avasthAYa phiriYe deva’|
‘Ara tomAra hAta tomAra vagalera sAthe milAo, tAhale tA ujjvala haYe veriYe Asave konarUpa truTi chAr3A; ArekaTi nidarzanarUpe’|
eTA ejanya ye, Ami tomAke AmAra var3a var3a nidarzanasamUhera kichu dekhAva|
‘phira‘Aunera kAche yAo; nizcaYa se sImAlaGghana kareche’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra vuka prazasta kare dina’
‘evaM AmAra kAja sahaja kare dina,
‘Ara AmAra jihavAra jar3atA dUra kare dina-
yAte tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre’|
‘Ara AmAra parivAra theke AmAra janya ekajana sAhAyyakArI nirdhAraNa kare dina|
AmAra bhAi hArUnake’
‘tAra dvArA AmAra zakti sudRr3ha karuna
evaM tAke AmAra kAje zarIka karuna’|
‘yAte AmarA vezI kare ApanAra tAsavIha pATha karate pAri’,
evaM adhika parimANe ApanAke smaraNa karate pAri|
‘Apanii to AmAdera samyaka draSTA’|
tini valalena, ‘he mUsA, tumi yA ceYecha tA tomAke deYA hala’|
‘Ara Ami Aro ekavAra tomAra prati anugraha karechilAma’|
‘yakhana Ami tomAra mAtAke jAniYe diYechilAma yA jAnAvAra chila,

‘ye, tumi tA~ke sindhukera madhye rekhe dAo| tArapara tA dariYAYa bhAsiYe dAo| yena dariYA tAke tIre Thele deYa| phale tAke AmAra zatru o tAra zatru niYe neve| Ara Ami AmAra pakSa theke tomAra prati bhAlavAsA Dhele diYechilAma, yAte tumi AmAra cokhera sAmane pratipAlita hao’|

yakhana tomAra vona (sindukera sAthe sAthe) calachila| ataHpara se giYe valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake emana ekajanera sandhAna deva, ye era dAYitvabhAra nite pArave’? ataHpara Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera nikaTa phiriYe dilAma; yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se duHkha nA pAYa| Ara tumi eka vyaktike hatyA karechile| takhana Ami tomAke mAnovedanA theke mukti dilAma evaM tomAke Ami vibhinnabhAve parIkSA karechi| ataHpara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye avasthAna karecha| he mUsA, tArapara nirdhArita samaYe tumi ese upasthita hale’|
evaM Ami tomAke AmAra nijera janya manonIta karechi|
tumi o tomAra bhAi AmAra AYAtasamUha niYe yAo evaM AmAke smaraNa karAra kSetre konarUpa alasatA karo nA|
tomarA du’jana phira‘Aunera nikaTa yAo, kenanA se to sImAlaMghana kareche|
tomarA tAra sAthe narama kathA valave| haYatovA se upadeza grahaNa karave athavA bhaYa karave|
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA to AzaMkA karachi ye, se AmAdera upara vAr3AvAr3i karave athavA sImAlaGghana karave’|
tini valalena, ‘tomarA bhaYa karo nA| Ami to tomAdera sAthei Achi| Ami savakichu zuni o dekhi’|

sutarAM tomarA du’jana tAra kAche yAo ataHpara vala, ‘AmarA tomAra ravera du’jana rAsUla| sutarAM tumi vanI isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe yete dAo evaM tAderake niryAtana karo nA| AmarA tomAra kAche esechi tomAra ravera AYAta niYe| Ara yArA sat patha anusaraNa kare, tAdera prati zAnti’|
nizcaYa AmAdera nikaTa ohI preraNa karA haYeche ye, AyAvato tAra janya, ye mithyA Aropa kare evaM mukha phiriYe neYa|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘he mUsA, tAhale ke tomAdera rava’?
mUsA valala, ‘AmAdera rava tini, yini sakala vastuke tAra AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara saThika patha nirdeza karechena’|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘tAhale atIta yugera lokadera avasthA kI’?
mUsA valala, ‘era jJAna AmAra ravera nikaTa kitAve Ache| AmAra rava vibhrAnta hana nA evaM bhuleo yAna nA’|

‘yini tomAdera janya yamInake vichAnA vAniYechena evaM tAte tomAdera janya calAra patha kare diYechena| Ara AsamAna theke tini pAni varSaNa karena’; ataHpara tA diYe Ami vibhinna prakArera udbhida utpanna kari|
tomarA nijerA khAo evaM tomAdera gavAdi pazu carAo| avazyai ete vivekasampanna lokadera janya nidarzana raYeche|
mATi thekei Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi, mATitei Ami tomAderake phiriYe neva evaM mATi thekei tomAderake punarAYa vera kare Anava|
Ami tAke AmAra sakala nidarzana dekhiYechilAma, kintu se mithyA Aropa kareche evaM amAnya kareche|
se valala, ‘he mUsA, tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanya esecha ye, tomAra yAdura dvArA AmAderake AmAdera deza theke vera kare deve’?

‘tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAra nikaTa anurUpa yAdu niYe Asava| sutarAM ekaTA madhyavartI sthAne AmAdera o tomAra milita haoYAra janya ekaTi samaYa nirdhAraNa kara, yA AmarAo laGghana karava nA, tumio karave nA’|
mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera nirdhArita samaYa hala utsavera dina| Ara sedina pUrvAhnei yena lokajanake samaveta karA haYa’|
ataHpara phira‘Auna uThe gela| tArapara se tAra kauzala ekatra karala, tArapara se Asala|

mUsA tAderake valala, ‘tomAdera durbhAgya! tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karo nA| karale tini AyAva dvArA tomAderake samUle dhvaMsa kare devena| Ara ye vyakti mithyA Aropa kare, se-i vyartha haYa|
takhana tArA nijadera madhye tAdera karma samvandhe vAka-vitanDA karala evaM tArA gopane parAmarza karala|
tArA valala, ‘e du’jana avazyai yAdukara| tArA cAYa tAdera yAdura mAdhyame tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera kare dite evaM tomAdera utkRSTa jIvana paddhati dhvaMsa kare dite’|
‘kAjei tomarA tomAdera kalA-kauzala jamA kara| tArapara tomarA savAi sArivaddhabhAve Asa| Ara Aja ye vijaYI have, se-i saphala have’|
tArA valala, he mUsA, haYa tumi nikSepa kara, nA haYa AmarAi prathame nikSepa kari|
mUsA valala, ‘varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara| ataHpara tAdera yAdura prabhAve mUsAra kAche mane hala yena tAdera razi o lAThigulo chuTochuTi karache|
takhana mUsA tAra antare kichuTA bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, ‘tumi bhaYa peYo nA, nizcaYa tumii vijaYI have’|
‘Ara tomAra DAna hAte yA Ache, tA phele dAo| tArA yA kareche, eTA segulo grAsa kare phelave| tArA yA kareche, tAto kevala yAdukarera kauzala| Ara yAdukara yekhAnei Asuka nA kena, se saphala have nA’|
ataHpara yAdukarerA sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala| tArA valala, ‘AmarA hArUna o mUsAra ravera prati ImAna AnalAma’|

phira‘Auna valala, ‘kI, Ami tomAderake anumati deYAra Agei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYa se-i tomAdera pradhAna, ye tomAderake yAdu zikhiYeche| sutarAM Ami avazyai tomAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelava evaM Ami tomAderake khejura gAchera kAnDe zUlividdha karavai| Ara tomarA avazyai jAnate pArave, AmAdera madhye kAra AyAva vezI kaThora evaM vezI sthAYI|

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera nikaTa ye sakala spaSTa nidarzana eseche evaM yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena, tAra upara AmarA tomAke kichutei prAdhAnya deva nA| sutarAM tumi yA phaYasAlA karate cAo, tAi karo| tumito kevala e duniYAra jIvanera upara kartRtva karate pAra’|
‘nizcaYa AmarA AmAdera ravera prati ImAna enechi, yAte tini AmAdera aparAdhasamUha evaM ye yAdu tumi AmAderake karate vAdhya karecha, tA kSamA kare dena| Ara AllAha sarvazreSTha o cirasthAYI’|
ye tAra ravera nikaTa aparAdhI avasthAYa Asave, tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAma| sekhAne se maraveo nA, vA~caveo nA|
Ara yArA tA~ra nikaTa Asave mumina avasthAYa, satkarma kare tAdera janyai raYeche suucca maryAdA|
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have| Ara eTA hala yArA parizuddha haYa tAdera puraSkAra|

Ara Ami avazyai mUsAra kAche ohI preraNa karechilAma ye, ‘AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtera velAYa raoYAnA hao| ataHpara sajore AghAta kare tAdera janya zukano rAstA vAnAo| pechana theke dhare phelAra AzaMkA karo nA evaM bhaYao karo nA’|
tArapara phira‘Auna tAra senAvAhinI saha tAdera pichu nila| ataHpara samudra tAderake sampUrNarUpe nimajjita karala|
Ara phira‘Auna tAra kaomake pathabhraSTa karechila evaM se saThika patha dekhAYani|

he vanI isarAIla, Amii tomAderake tomAdera zatru theke nAjAta diYechi| Ara tomAderake oYAdA diYechilAma tUra pAhAr3era DAna pAzera* evaM Ami tomAdera janya avataraNa karechilAma ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’| * tArA tUra pAhAr3era DAnapArzve upasthita hale AllAha tA‘AlA tAderake tAorAta kitAva pradAna karavena vale oYAdA karechilena|

Ami tomAderake ye riyka dAna karechi tA theke bhAlagulo khAo evaM ete sImAlaMghana karo nA| karale tomAdera upara AmAra gayava patita have| Ara yAra upara AmAra gayava patita haYa se avazyai dhvaMsa haYa|
Ara avazyai Ami tAra prati kSamAzIla, ye tAovA kare, ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare ataHpara sat pathe calate thAke|
he mUsA, kise tAr3AtAr3i niYe eseche tomAke, tomAra kaomake pechane phele?
mUsA valala, ‘ei to tArA AmAra pichane| he AmAra rava, Ami tAr3AtAr3i kare ApanAra nikaTa esechi, yAte Apani AmAra upara santuSTa hana’|
AllAha valalena, ‘tomAra cale AsAra para Ami to tomAra kaomake parIkSAYa phele diYechi| Ara sAmerI tAderake pathabhraSTa kareche’|

tArapara mUsA krodha o duHkhabhare tAra kaomera kAche phire gela| se valala, ‘he kaoma, tomAdera rava ki tomAdera sAthe eka uttama oYAdA karenani? tomAdera kAche ki sei oYAdAra samaYa dIrgha haYe geche? nAki tomarA ceYecha ye, tomAdera upara tomAdera ravera gayava patita hoka? tAi tomarA AmAra sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karale’?

tArA valala, ‘AmarA to svecchAYa ApanAra sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karini, varaM kaomera alaMkArera vojhA AmAdera upara cApiYe deYA haYechila| tAi AmarA tA (Agune) nikSepa karechi, anurUpabhAve sAmerIo phele diYeche’|
tArapara se tAdera janya ekaTA go vAchurera pratikRti vera kare Anala, yAra chila AoYAja| takhana tArA valala, ‘eTAi tomAdera ilAha evaM mUsArao ilAha; kintu se e kathA bhule geche’|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, eTA tAdera kona kathAra javAva dite pAre nA, Ara tAdera kona kSati vA upakAra karAra kSamatAo rAkhe nA?

Ara hArUna pUrvei tAderake valechila, ‘he AmAra kaoma, eTA dvArA to kevala tomAderake parIkSAYa phelA haYeche| Ara tomAdera rava to parama karuNAmaYa| tAi tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala’|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA era uparai avicala thAkava yatakSaNa nA mUsA AmAdera kAche phire Ase’|
mUsA valala, ‘he hArUna! tumi yakhana dekhale ye, tArA pathabhraSTa haYe geche takhana tomAke kise virata rAkhala’
ye tumi AmAra anusaraNa karale nA? tAhale tumio ki AmAra Adeza amAnya karecha’?
se valala, ‘he AmAra sahodara! AmAra dAr3io dharo nA, mAthAra culao dharo nA| Ami AzaMkA karechilAma ye, tumi valave, tumi vanI isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha evaM AmAra kathA rakSA karani’|
mUsA valala, ‘he sAmerI! tomAra kI avasthA’?

se valala, ‘Ami emana kichu dekhechi yA orA dekheni| tArapara Ami dUtera (jivarIlera) pAYera cihna theke eka muSTi mATi niYechilAma| ataHpara tA nikSepa karechilAma| Ara AmAra mana AmAra janya erUpa karATA zobhana karechila’|

mUsA valala, ‘yAo, tomAra zAsti hala, jIvaddazAYa tumi valate thAkave, ‘Ami aspRzya’| Ara tomAra janya ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa raila yAra kakhano vyatikrama have nA| Ara tumi tomAra ilAhera prati ceYe dekha, yAra pUjAYa tumi rata chile, AmarA tA avazyai jvAliYe deva| tArapara vikSipta kare tA sAgare nikSepa karavai’|
‘tomAdera ilAha to kevala AllAhai| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei| sakala viSaYei tAra jJAna parivyApta’|
pUrve yA ghaTe geche tAra kichu saMvAda ebhAvei Ami tomAra kAche varNanA kari| Ara Ami tomAke AmAra pakSa theke upadeza dAna karechi|
tA theke ye vimukha have, avazyai se kiYAmatera dina pApera vojhA vahana karave|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM kiYAmatera dina eTA tAdera janya vojhA hiseve katai nA manda have!
yedina ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have, Ara sedina Ami aparAdhIderake dRSTihIna avasthAYa samaveta karava|
sedina tArA cupe cupe nijadera madhye valAvali karave, ‘tomarA mAtra dazadina avasthAna karechile’|
Ami bhAlabhAvei jAni tArA kI valave, tAdera madhye apekSAkRta satpathe chila ye lokaTi se valave, ‘tomarA mAtra ekadina avasthAna karechile’!
Ara tArA tomAke pAhAr3a samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, ‘AmAra rava eguloke samUle utpATana kare vikSipta kare divena’|
‘tArapara tini tAke masRNa samatalabhUmi kare divena’|
‘tAte tumi kona vakratA o uccatA dekhave nA’|

sedina tArA AhavAnakArIra (pherezatAra) anusaraNa karave| era kona edika sedika have nA evaM parama karuNAmaYera sAmane sakala AoYAja nicu haYe yAve| tAi mRdu AoYAja chAr3A tumi kichui zunate pAve nA|
sedina parama karuNAmaYa yAke anumati divena Ara yAra kathAYa tini santuSTa havena tAra supAriza chAr3A kAro supAriza kona kAje Asave nA|
tini tAdera Agera o parera sava kichui jAnena, kintu tArA jJAna diYe tA~ke veSTana karate pArave nA|
Ara ciraJjIva, cirapratiSThita sattAra sAmane sakalei avanata have| Ara se avazyai vyartha have ye yulama vahana karave|
evaM ye mumina avasthAYa bhAla kAja karave se kona yulama vA kSatira AzaMkA karave nA|
Ara ebhAvei Ami AravI bhASAYa kuraAna nAyila karechi evaM tAte vibhinna satarkavANI varNanA karechi, yAte tArA muttAkI hate pAre athavA tA haYa tAdera janya upadeza|
sutarAM AllAha mahAna yini satyikAra adhipati; tomAra prati ohI sampUrNa haoYAra pUrve tumi kuraAna pAThe tAr3Ahur3A karo nA evaM tumi vala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra jJAna vRddhi kare dina|’
Ara Ami itipUrve Adamera prati nirdeza diYechilAma; kintu se tA bhule giYechila evaM Ami tAra madhye saMkalpe dRr3hatA pAini|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAma, ‘tomarA Adamake sijadA kara,’ takhana ivalIsa chAr3A sakalei sijadA karala; se amAnya karala|
ataHpara Ami valalAma, ‘he Adama, nizcaYa e tomAra o tomAra strIra zatru| sutarAM se yena tomAdera ubhaYake jAnnAta theke kichutei vera kare nA deYa, tAhale tomarA durbhoga pohAve’|
‘nizcaYa tomAra janya e vyavasthA ye, tumi sekhAne kSudhArtao have nA evaM vastrahInao have nA’|
‘Ara sekhAne tumi pipAsArtao have nA evaM raudradagdhao have nA’|
ataHpara zaYatAna tAke kumantraNA dila, valala, ‘he Adama, Ami ki tomAke vale diva ananta jIvanaprada gAcha evaM akSaYa rAjatva samparke?’

ataHpara tArA ubhaYei se gAcha theke khela| takhana tAdera ubhaYera satara tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe par3ala evaM tArA jAnnAtera gAchera pAtA diYe nijaderake AvRta karate lAgala evaM Adama tAra ravera hukuma amAnya karala; phale se vibhrAnta hala|
erapara tAra rava tAke manonIta karalena, ataHpara tAra tAovA kavUla karalena evaM tAke pathanirdeza karalena|

tini valalena, ‘tomarA ubhaYei jAnnAta hate eka sAthe neme yAo| tomarA eke aparera zatru| ataHpara yakhana tomAdera kAche AmAra pakSa theke hidAYAta Asave, takhana ye AmAra hidAYAtera anusaraNa karave se vipathagAmI have nA evaM durbhAgAo have nA’|
‘Ara ye AmAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra janya have nizcaYa eka saMkucita jIvana evaM Ami tAke kiYAmata divase uThAvo andha avasthAYa|
se valave, ‘he AmAra rava, kena Apani AmAke andha avasthAYa uThAlena? athaca Ami to chilAma dRSTizakti sampanna’?
tini valavena, ‘emanibhAvei tomAra nikaTa AmAra nidarzanAvalI esechila, kintu tumi tA bhule giYechile evaM sebhAvei Aja tomAke bhule yAoYA hala’|
Ara ebhAvei Ami pratiphala dAna kari tAke, ye vAr3AvAr3i kare evaM tAra ravera nidarzanAvalIte ImAna Ane nA| Ara AkhirAtera AyAva to avazyai kaThoratara o adhikatara sthAYI|

eTi ki tAderake satpatha pradarzana karala nA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAdera vAsabhUmite tArA vicaraNa kare? nizcaYa era madhye raYeche vivekasampannadera janya nidarzana|
Ara yadi tomAra ravera pakSa theke pUrva siddhAnta o ekaTi kAla nirdhArita haYe nA thAkata, tave Azu zAsti avazyambhAvI hata|

sutarAM erA yA vale tAra upara dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM tAsavIha pATha kara tomAra ravera prazaMsA varNanAra mAdhyame, sUryodaYera pUrve, sUryAstera pUrve evaM tAsavIha pATha kara rAtera kichu aMze o dinera prAntasamUhe, yAte tumi santuSTa hate pAra|

Ara tumi kakhano prasArita karo nA tomAra du’cokha se savera prati, yA Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke duniYAra jIvanera jA~ka-jamakasvarUpa upabhogera upakaraNa hiseve diYechi| yAte Ami se viSaYe tAderake parIkSA kare nite pAri| Ara tomAra ravera pradatta riyka sarvotkRSTa o adhikatara sthAYI|
Ara tomAra parivAra-parijanake sAlAta AdAYera Adeza dAo evaM nijeo tAra upara avicala thAka| Ami tomAra kAche kona riyka cAi nA| Amii tomAke riyka dei Ara zubha pariNAma to muttAkIdera janya|
Ara tArA vale, ‘se tAra ravera kAcha theke AmAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana niYe Ase nA kena’? pUrvavartI granthasamUhe ye suspaSTa pramANa raYeche tA ki tAdera kAche Aseni?

Ara yadi Ami tAderake itaHpUrve kona AyAva dvArA dhvaMsa karatAma tave avazyai, tArA valata, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAdera kAche kona rAsUla pAThAlena nA kena? tAhale to AmarA lAJchita o apamAnita haoYAra pUrve ApanAra nidarzanAvalI anusaraNa karatAma’|
vala, ‘pratyekei pratIkSA karache, ataeva tomarAo pratIkSAYa thAka| zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave kArA saThika pathera upara raYeche evaM kArA hidAYAtaprApta’|
mAnuSera hisAva-nikAzera samaYa Asanna, athaca tArA udAsInatAYa mukha phiriYe raYeche|
yakhanai tAdera ravera pakSa theke tAdera nikaTa kona natuna upadeza Ase takhana tArA tA kautukabhare zravaNa kare|
tAdera antara thAke amanoyogI evaM yAlimarA gopane parAmarza kare, ‘e to tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| eraparao ki tomarA dekhe zune yAdura kavale par3ave’?
se (rAsUla) valala, ‘AmAra rava AsamAna o yamInera samasta kathAi jAnena evaM tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa’|

varaM tArA vale, ‘egulo alIka kalpanA, haYa se eTi mana theke vAniYeche naYato se ekajana kavi| ataeva se AmAdera kAche emana nidarzana niYe Asuka yerUpa nidarzanasaha prerita haYechila pUrvavartIgaNa’|
tAdera pUrve ye janapada ImAna Aneni tAderake Ami dhvaMsa karechi | tave ki erA ImAna Anave?
Ara tomAra pUrve Ami puruSai pAThiYechilAma, yAdera prati Ami ohI pAThAtAma| sutarAM tomarA jJAnIderake jijJAsA kara yadi tomarA nA jAna|
Ara Ami tAderake emana dehaviziSTa karini ye, tArA khAdya grahaNa karata nA, Ara tArA sthAYIo chila nA|
ataHpara Ami tAdera prati kRta oYAdA pUrNa karalAma| Ara Ami tAderake o yAderake icchA kari rakSA karalAma evaM sImAlaGghanakArIderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma|

nizcaYa Ami tomAdera prati eka kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte tomAdera janya upadeza* raYeche, tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA? * e AYAte yikara zavdaTi du’Ti arthe vyavahRta hate pAreH ekaTi upadeza Ara aparaTi sammAna o maryAdA| arthAt ye e kuraAna zikSA kare evaM tadanuyAYI jIvana paricAlanA kare sei maryAdA o sammAnera adhikArI have|
Ami kata janavasatike dhvaMsa karechi yArA chila yAlima evaM tAdera para anya jAti sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara tArA yakhana AmAra AyAva dekhala takhanai tArA janapada cher3e pAlAte lAgala|
(tAderake valA hala) ‘palAYana karo nA, varaM tomAdera bhoga-vilAsitAYa evaM gharavAr3ite phire yAo, yena tomAderake jijJAsA karA haYa’|
tArA valala, ‘hAYa AmAdera durbhoga! AmarA to avazyai yAlima chilAma|’
ataHpara tAdera ei vilApa calate thAke Ami tAderake keTe phelA zasya o nibhe yAoYA Aguna sadRza nA karA paryanta|
AsamAna-yamIna o tAdera mAjhakhAne yA kichu Ache tAra kona kichui Ami khelAcchale sRSTi karini|
Ami yadi khelAra upakaraNa grahaNa karate cAitAma, tave AmAra kAche yA Ache tA diYei karatAma| kintu Ami tA karini|
varaM Ami mithyAra upara satya nikSepa kari; phale tA mithyAke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa evaM nimiSei tA vilupta haYa| Ara tomAdera janya raYeche durbhoga tomarA yA valacha tAra janya |
Ara AsamAna-yamIne yArA Ache tArA savAi tA~ra; Ara tA~ra kAche yArA Ache tArA ahaGkAravazataH tA~ra ivAdAta hate vimukha haYa nA evaM klAntio vodha kare nA|
tArA dina-rAta tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare, tArA zithilatA dekhAYa nA|
tArA yesava mATira devatA grahaNa kareche, seguli ki mRtake jIvita karate sakSama?
yadi AsamAna o yamIne AllAha chAr3A vahu ilAha thAkata tave ubhaYai dhvaMsa haYe yeta, sutarAM tArA yA vale, Arazera rava AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tini yA karena se vyApAre tAke prazna karA yAve nA; varaM tAderakei prazna karA have|

tArA ki tA~ke chAr3A aneka ilAha grahaNa kareche? vala, ‘tomAdera pramANa niYe Asa| AmAra sAthe yArA Ache eTi tAdera janya upadeza evaM AmAra pUrve yArA chila tAdera janyao eTAi chila upadeza|’ kintu tAdera vezIrabhAgai prakRta satyake jAne nA; tAi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara tomAra pUrve emana kona rAsUla Ami pAThAini yAra prati Ami ei ohI nAyila karini ye, ‘Ami chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; sutarAM tomarA AmAra ivAdAta kara|’

Ara tArA vale, ‘parama karuNAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena|’ tini pavitra| varaM tArA* sammAnita vAndA| * vanU khuyA‘A dAvI karata, pherezatArA AllAhara kanyA| e bhula dhAraNA dUra karate AllAha valena, pherezatArA AllAhara santAna naYa; varaM tArA sammAnita vAndA| Ala-kAzzApha
tArA tA~ra Aga vAr3iYe kona kathA vale nA, tA~ra nirdezei to tArA kAja kare|

tAdera sAmane o pechane yA kichu Ache savai tini jAnena| Ara tArA zudhu tAdera janyai supAriza kare yAdera prati tini santuSTa| tArA tA~ra bhaYe bhIta|* * pherezatArA AllAhara bhaYe sarvadA bhIta thAke|
Ara tAdera madhye ye-i valave, ‘tini chAr3A Ami ilAha’, tAkei Ami pratidAna hiseve jAhAnnAma deva; ebhAvei Ami yAlimadera AyAva diYe thAki|

yArA kupharI kare tArA ki bheve dekhe nA ye, AsamAnasamUha o yamIna otaprotabhAve mize chila*, ataHpara Ami ubhaYake pRthaka kare dilAma, Ara Ami sakala prANavAna jinisake pAni theke sRSTi karalAma| tavuo ki tArA ImAna Anave nA? * Adhunika jyotirvijJAnIdera mate Adite AkAza, sUrya, nakSatra o pRthivI ityAdi pRthaka sattAYa chila nA; varaM savakichui otaprotabhAve mize chila| takhana mahAvizva chila asaMkhya gyAsIYa kaNAra samaSTi| paravartIkAle mahAvisphoraNera mAdhyame nakSatra, sUrya, pRthivI o grahasamUha sRSTi haYa| eTii viga vyAM vA mahAvisphoraNa thiorI|

Ara Ami yamIne sRSTi karechi sudRr3ha parvata, yena tA parvatasamUha niYe ekadike hele nA par3e*, Ara Ami tAte tairI karechi prazasta rAstA, yena tArA calate pAre| * Adhunika bhU-tattvavidagaNa valena, pRthivIra abhyantarastha uttapta galita padArthera tApa char3Anora kAraNe pRthivIra pRSThadeza saGkucita haYe tAte bhA~ja sRSTi haYa evaM tAra uparera aMzai hala parvata| parvatamAlA pRthivI-pRSThera bhArasAmya rakSA kare|
Ara Ami AsamAnake karechi surakSita chAda; kintu tArA tAra nidarzanAvalI hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara tinii rAta o dina evaM sUrya o cA~da sRSTi karechena; savAi nija nija kakSapathe vicaraNa kare|
Ara tomAra pUrve kona mAnuSake Ami sthAYI jIvana dAna karini; sutarAM tomAra mRtyu hale tArA ki ananta jIvanasampanna haYe thAkave?
pratiTi prANa mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave; Ara bhAla o manda dvArA Ami tomAderake parIkSA kare thAki evaM AmAra kAchei tomAderake phire Asate have|

Ara yArA kupharI kare tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tomAke kevala upahAsera pAtra hiseve grahaNa kare| tArA vale, ‘e ki sei vyakti, ye tomAdera devatAdera samAlocanA kare?’ athaca tArAi ‘rahamAna’-era AlocanAra virodhitA kare| * rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma kAphiradera devatAdera asvIkAra karatena vale tArA rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma era samAlocanA karata| AvAra tA~rAi ekamAtra ilAha AllAhara guNavAcaka nAma ‘rahamAna’ zavdaTi zunatei cAito nA| eTi cUr3Anta paryAYera ajJatA o svavirodhitA| Ala-kuratuvI|
mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche tAr3Ahur3Ara pravaNatA diYe| acirei Ami tomAderake dekhAva AmAra nidarzanAvalI| sutarAM tomarA tAr3Ahur3A karo nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, e oYAdA kakhana pUrNa have?’
hAYa, kAphirarA yadi se samaYera kathA jAnata, yakhana tArA tAdera sAmane o pechana theke Aguna phirAte pArave nA| Ara tAderake sAhAyyao karA have nA;
varaM akasmAt tAdera upara tA ese par3ave| ataHpara tAderake hatavAka kare deve| phale tArA tA phirAte sakSama have nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|

Ara tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlake ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYechila; pariNAme tArA yA niYe ThATTA karata tAi vidrUpakArIderake ghire phelechila|* * rAsUlagaNa AyAva AsAra bhaYa dekhAle kAphirarA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata| parizeSe tAdera ThATTAra vastta arthAt AyAva ese tAderake ghire phelata evaM se AyAvai tAderake grAsa karata|
vala, ‘rAte evaM dine parama karuNAmaYa theke ke tomAderake rakSA karave?’ tavuo tArA tAdera ravera smaraNa hate mukha phiriYe neYa|

Ami chAr3A tAdera ki emana kona deva-devI Ache yArA tAderake rakSA karate pAre? tArA to nijaderakei sAhAyya karate sakSama naYa evaM AmAra viruddhe tArA kona saGgIo pAve nA|* * يصحبون era artha-tArA saGgI pAve nA| ivana AvavAsa (rAH) valena, ekhAne era artha hala يجارون arthAt AllAhara zAsti hate mukti pete tAderake sAhAyya karave emana kAuke tArA pAve nA|

varaM Amii tAderake o tAdera pUrvapuruSaderake upabhoga karate diYechilAma; uparantu tAdera hAYAtao dIrgha haYechila| tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami caturdika theke tA~dera dezake saGkucita kare dicchi? tavuo ki tArA jaYI have?
vala, ‘Ami to kevala ohI dvArAi tomAderake satarka kari’| kintu yArA vadhira tAderake yakhana satarka karA haYa, takhana tArA se AhavAna zone nA|
Ara tomAra ravera AyAvera sAmAnya kichuo yadi tAderake sparza kare, tave tArA avazyai vale uThave-‘hAYa, durbhoga AmAdera! AmarAto avazyai yAlima chilAma’|

Ara kiYAmatera dina Ami nyAYavicArera mAnadanDa sthApana karava| sutarAM kAro prati kona avicAra karA have nA| kAro karma yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa, Ami tA hAyira karava| Ara hisAva grahaNakArIrUpe Amii yatheSTa|
Ara Ami to mUsA o hArUnake satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArI diYechilAma evaM muttAkIdera janya diYechilAma jyoti o upadeza|
yArA nA dekheo tAdera ravake bhaYa kare evaM kiYAmata samparke thAke bhIta-santrasta|
Ara eTA varakatamaYa upadeza, yA Ami nAyila karechi| tavuo ki tomarA tA asvIkAra karave?
Ara Ami to itaHpUrve ivarAhImake saThika pathera jJAna diYechilAma evaM Ami tAra samparke chilAma samyaka avagata|
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra kaomake valala, ‘e mUrtigulo kI, yegulora pUjAYa tomarA rata raYecha’?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake edera pUjA karate dekhechi’|
se valala, ‘tomarA nijerA evaM tomAdera pUrvapuruSarA savAi raYecha spaSTa vibhrAntite’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa satya niYe esecha, nAki tumi khela-tAmAzA karacha’?
se valala, ‘nA, varaM tomAdera rava to AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rava; yini e savakichu sRSTi karechena| Ara e viSaYe Ami anyatama sAkSI’|
‘Ara AllAhara kasama, tomarA cale yAoYAra para Ami tomAdera mUrtigulora vyApAre avazyai kauzala avalamvana karava’|
ataHpara se mUrtiguloke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dila tAdera var3aTi chAr3A, yAte tArA tA~ra dike phire Ase|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera devadevIgulora sAthe ke emanaTi karala? nizcaYa se yAlima’|
tAdera keu keu valala, ‘AmarA zunechi eka yuvaka ei mUrtigulora samAlocanA kare| tAke valA haYa ivarAhIma’|
tArA valala, ‘tAhale tAke lokajanera sAmane niYe eso, yAte tArA dekhate pAre’|
tArA valala, ‘he ivarAhIma, tumii ki AmAdera devadevIgulora sAthe erUpa karecha’?
se valala, ‘varaM tAdera e var3aTii ekAja kareche| tAi ederakei jijJAsA kara, yadi erA kathA valate pAre’|
takhana tArA nijadera dike phire gela* evaM eke anyake valate lAgala, ‘tomarAi to yAlima’| * e vAkyera artha ‘tArA mane mane cintA karala tArA viveka vuddhi khATAla’ o hate pAre|
ataHpara tAdera mAthA avanata haYe gela evaM valala, ‘tumi to jAnai ye, erA kathA valate pAre nA’|
se (ivarAhIma) valala, ‘tAhale ki tomarA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kara, yA tomAdera kona upakAra karate pAre nA evaM kona kSatio karate pAre nA’?
‘dhika tomAderake evaM AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAdera ivAdAta kara tAderake! ‘tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA’?
tArA valala, ‘tAke Agune pur3iYe dAo evaM tomAdera devadevIderake sAhAyya kara, yadi tomarA kichu karate cAo’|
Ami valalAma, ‘he Aguna, tumi zItala o nirApada haYe yAo ivarAhImera janya’ |
Ara tArA tAra viruddhe cakrAnta karechila, kintu Ami tAderake savaceYe vezI kSatigrasta kare dilAma|
Ara Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare se deze niYe gelAma, yekhAne Ami vizvavAsIra janya varakata rekhechi|
Ara Ami tAke dAna karechilAma isahAka o iYAkUvake atirikta hiseve; Ara tAdera pratyekakei Ami satkarmazIla karechilAma|

Ara tAderake Ami netA vAniYechilAma, tArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre mAnuSake saThika patha dekhAta| Ami tAdera prati satkAja karAra, sAlAta kAYema karAra evaM yAkAta pradAna karAra janya ohI preraNa karechilAma| Ara tArA AmArai ivAdAta karata|
Ara lUtake Ami prajJA o jJAna dAna karechilAma| Ami tAke emana eka janapada theke uddhAra karechilAma, yAra adhivAsIrA azlIla kAje lipta chila| tArA chila eka manda o pApAcArI kaoma|
Ara Ami tAke AmAra rahamatera madhye zAmila kare niYechilAma| se chila satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
Ara smaraNa kara nUhera kathA, itaHpUrve yakhana se AmAke Dekechila, takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma| ataHpara tAke o tAra parivAravargake Ami mahAvipada theke uddhAra karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAke sei sampradAYera viruddhe sAhAyya karechilAma, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila| tArA chila eka manda kaoma| tAi Ami tAdera sakalakei pAnite DuviYe merechilAma|
Ara smaraNa kara dAUda o sulAYamAnera kathA, yakhana tArA zasyakSeta samparke vicAra karachila| yAte rAtera velAYa kona kaomera meSa Dhuke par3echila| Ara Ami tAdera vicAra kAja dekhachilAma|

ataHpara Ami e viSaYera phaYasAlA sulAYamAnake vujhiYe diYechilAma| Ara Ami tAdera pratyekakei diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna| Ara Ami parvatamAlA o pAkhIderake dAUdera adhIna kare diYechilAma, tArA dAUdera sAthe AmAra tAsavIha pATha karata| Ara esavakichu Amii karachilAma|
Ara Amii tAke tomAdera janya varma vAnAno zikSA diYechilAma| yAte tA yuddhe tomAderake rakSA karate pAre| sutarAM tomarA ki kRtajJa have?
Ara Ami sulAYamAnera janya anugata kare diYechilAma pravala hAoYAke, yA tAra nirdeze pravAhita hata sei dezera dike, yekhAne Ami varakata rekhechi| Ara Ami pratyeka viSaYa samparkei avagata chilAma|
Ara zaYatAnadera madhye kataka tAra janya DuvurIra kAja karata, echAr3A anyAnya kAjao karata| Ara Amii tAdera janya hiphAyatakArI chilAma|
Ara smaraNa kara Aiuvera kathA, yakhana se tAra ravake AhavAna kare valechila, ‘Ami duHkha-kaSTe patita haYechi| Ara Apani to sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|

takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma| Ara tAra yata duHkha-kaSTa chila tA dUra kare dilAma evaM tAra parivAra-parijana tAke diYe dilAma| Ara tAdera sAthe tAdera mata Aro dilAma AmAra pakSa theke rahamata evaM ivAdAtakArIdera janya upadezasvarUpa|
Ara smaraNa kara isamAIla, idarIsa o yul kiphala era kathA, tAdera pratyekei dhairyazIla chila|
Ara tAderake Ami AmAra rahamate zAmila karechilAma| tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa|

Ara smaraNa kara yuna-nUna era kathA, yakhana se rAgAnvita avasthAYa cale giYechila evaM mane karechila ye, Ami tAra upara kSamatA praYoga karava nA| tArapara se andhakAra theke Deke valechila, ‘Apani chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei’| Apani pavitra mahAna| nizcaYa Ami chilAma yAlima’ |
ataHpara Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma evaM duzcintA theke tAke uddhAra karechilAma| Ara ebhAvei Ami muminaderake uddhAra kare thAki|
Ara smaraNa kara yAkAriYyAra kathA, yakhana se tAra ravake AhavAna kare valechila, ‘he AmAra rava! AmAke ekA rekho nA, tumi to zreSTha mAlikAnAra adhikArI’|

ataHpara Ami tAra AhavAne sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke dAna karechilAma iYAhaiYA| Ara tAra janya tAra strIke upayogI karechilAma| tArA satkAje pratiyogitA karata| Ara AmAke AzA o bhIti sahakAre DAkata| Ara tArA chila AmAra nikaTa vinaYI|
Ara smaraNa kara se nArIra kathA, ye nija satItva rakSA karechila| ataHpara Ami tAra madhye AmAra ‘rUha’ phu~ke diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra putrake vizvavAsIra janya karechilAma eka nidarzana |
nizcaYa tomAdera e jAti to ekai jAti| Ara Amii tomAdera rava| ataeva tomarA AmAra ivAdAta kara|
kintu tArA nijadera kAryakalApe parasparera madhye vibheda sRSTi kareche| sakalei AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartana karave|
sutarAM ye mumina avasthAYa satkAja kare tAra praceSTAke asvIkAra karA have nA| Ara Ami to tA likhe rAkhi|
Ara Ami ye janapadake dhvaMsa karechi tAra samparke niSedhAjJA raYeche ye, tAra adhivAsIvRnda Ara phire Asave nA|
avazeSe yakhana iYA’jUja o mA’jUjake mukti deYA have, Ara tArA pratiTi u~cu bhUmi hate chuTe Asave|
Ara satya oYAdAra samaYa nikaTe Asale haThAt kAphiradera cakSu sthira haYe yAve| tArA valave, ‘hAYa, AmAdera durbhoga! AmarA to e viSaYe udAsIna chilAma varaM AmarA chilAma yAlima’ |
nizcaYa tomarA evaM AllAha chAr3A tomarA yAdera pUjA kara, segulo to jAhAnnAmera jvAlAnI| tomarA sekhAne praveza karave|
yadi tArA ilAha hata tave tArA jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA| Ara tArA savAi tAte sthAYI haYe thAkave|
sekhAne thAkave tAdera ArtanAda, Ara sekhAne tArA zunate pAve nA|
AmAra pakSa theke yAdera janya pUrvei kalyANa nirdhArita raYeche tAderake tA theke dUre rAkhA have|
tArA jAhAnnAmera kSINatama zavdao zunate pAve nA| sekhAne tArA tAdera manaHputa vastura madhye cirakAla thAkave|
mahAbhIti tAderake perezAna karave nA| Ara pherezatArA tAderake abhyarthanA jAniYe valave, ‘eTAi tomAdera sei dina, yAra oYAdA tomAderake deYA haYechila’|

se dina Ami AsamAnasamUhake guTiYe neva, yebhAve guTiYe rAkhA haYa likhita dalIla-patrAdi| yebhAve Ami prathama sRSTira sUcanA karechilAma sebhAvei punarAYa sRSTi karava| oYAdA pAlana karA AmAra kartavya| Ami tA pAlana karavai|
Ara upadeza deYAra para Ami kitAve likhe diYechi ye, ‘AmAra yogyatara vAndAgaNai pRthivIra uttarAdhikArI have’|
nizcaYa ete ivAdAtakArI sampradAYera janya upadeza vANI raYeche|
Ara Ami to tomAke vizvavAsIra janya rahamata hisevei preraNa karechi|
vala, ‘AmAra prati ohI preraNa karA haYa ye, tomAdera ilAha ekaka ilAha| sutarAM tomarA ki AtmasamarpaNakArI have’?
tave tArA mukha phiriYe nile tumi vale dio, ‘Ami yathAyathabhAve tomAderake jAniYe diYechi| Ara Ami jAni nA tomAderake ye viSaYera oYAdA deYA haYeche tA ki nikaTavartI nA dUravartI’|
tini prakAzya kathA samparkeo jAnena evaM tomarA yA gopana kara tAo jAnena|
Ara Ami jAni nA haYato tA tomAdera janya eka parIkSA kichu kAlera janya upabhogera suyoga|
rAsUla valechila, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani nyAYasaGgatabhAve phaYasAlA kare dina’| Ara AmAdera rava to parama karuNAmaYa| tomarA yA valacha se viSaYe tinii ekamAtra sahAYasthala|
he mAnuSa, tomarA tomAdera ravake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa kiYAmatera prakampana eka bhaYaGkara vyApAra|

yedina tomarA tA dekhave sedina pratyeka stanya dAnakArinI Apana dugdhapoSya zizuke bhule yAve evaM pratyeka garbhadhAriNI tAra garbhapAta kare phelave, tumi dekhave mAnuSake mAtAla sadRza, athaca tArA mAtAla naYa| tave AllAhara AyAvai kaThina|
mAnuSera madhye kataka AllAha samparke tarka-vitarka kare nA jene evaM se anusaraNa kare pratyeka vidrohI zaYatAnera|
tAra samparke nirdhAraNa karA haYeche ye, ye tAra sAthe vandhutva karave se avazyai tAke pathabhraSTa karave evaM tAke prajjvalita Agunera zAstira dike paricAlita karave|

he mAnuSa! yadi tomarA punarutthAnera vyApAre sandehe thAka tave nizcaYai jene rekho, Ami tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechi, tArapara zukra theke, tArapara AlAkA* theke, tArapara pUrNAkRtiviziSTa athavA apUrNAkRtiviziSTa gozta theke| tomAdera nikaTa viSaYaTi suspaSTarUpe varNanA karAra nimitte| Ara Ami yA icchA kari tA ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla paryanta mAtRgarbhe avasthita rAkhi| ataHpara Ami tomAderake zizurUpe vera kari, pare yAte tomarA yauvane upanIta hao| tomAdera madhye kAro kAro mRtyu deYA haYa e vaYasei, AvAra kAuke kAuke phiriYe neYA haYa hInatama vaYase, yAte se jJAna lAbhera parao kichu nA jAne| tumi yamInake dekhate pAo zuSkAvasthAYa, ataHpara yakhanai Ami tAte pAni varSaNa kari, takhana tA Andolita o sphIta haYa evaM udagata kare sakala prakAra sudRzya udbhida| * علق mAne yukta o jhulanta vastu| pUrvavartI tAphasIrakArakadera aneke era artha karechena raktapinDa| tave Adhunika jIvavijJAnIdera mate, puruSera zukra o nArIra DimvAnu milita haYe mAtRgarbhe ye bhrUNera sRSTi haYa tA pare jarAYU gAtre saMyukta haYe par3e| e janya ‘AlAkA zavdera anuvAda ekhana karA haYa, emana kichu yA yukta haYe thAke|
eTi ejanya ye, AllAhai satya evaM tinii mRtake jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara kiYAmata Asavei, ete kona sandeha nei evaM kavare yArA Ache nizcaYai AllAha tAdera punarutthita karavena|
Ara mAnuSera madhye kataka AllAha samparke vitarka kare kona jJAna chAr3A, kona hidAYAta chAr3A evaM dIptimAna kitAva chAr3A|
se vitarka kare ghAr3a vA~kiYe, mAnuSake AllAhara patha theke bhraSTa karAra uddezye tAra janya raYeche duniYAte lAJchanA evaM kiYAmatera dina Ami tAke dahana yantraNA AsvAdana karAva|
(sedina tAke valA have), ‘eTi tomAra du’hAta yA pUrve preraNa kareche tAra kAraNe| Ara nizcaYai AllAha vAndAdera prati yulamakArI nana’|

mAnuSera madhye kataka emana raYeche, yArA dvidhAra sAthe AllAhara ivAdAta kare| yadi tAra kona kalyANa haYa tave se tAte prazAnta haYa| Ara yadi tAra kona viparyaYa ghaTe, tAhale se tAra Asala cehArAYa phire yAYa| se duniYA o AkhirAte kSatigrasta haYa| eTi hala suspaSTa kSati|
se AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke, yA tAra kona kSati karate pAre nA evaM kona upakArao karate pAre nA| eTii carama pathabhraSTatA|
se emana kichuke DAke yAra kSati tAra upakAra apekSA nikaTatara| katainA nikRSTa ei abhibhAvaka evaM katai nA nikRSTa ei saGgI!
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena emana jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita| nizcaYai AllAha yA icchA tAi karena|

ye dhAraNA kare ye, AllAha duniYA o AkhirAte kakhano tAke (rAsUlake) sAhAyya karavena nA, se AsamAnera dike ekaTi razi prasArita karuka, erapara tA keTe dika, ataHpara dekhuka tAra kauzala tAra Akroza dUra kare kinA|
ebhAvei Ami suspaSTa AYAtarUpe tA (kuraAna) nAyila karechi| Ara AllAha niHsandehe yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA iYAhUdI haYeche, yArA sAviI, khRsTAna o agnipUjaka evaM yArA muzarika haYeche- kiYAmatera dina AllAha tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena| niHsandehe AllAha sava kichui samyaka pratyakSakArI|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAhara uddezye sijadA kare yA kichu raYeche AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA kichu raYeche yamIne, sUrya, cA~da, tArakArAjI, parvatamAlA, vRkSalatA, jIvajantu o mAnuSera madhye aneke| AvAra anekera upara zAsti avadhArita haYe Ache| AllAha yAke apamAnita karena tAra sammAnadAtA keu nei| nizcaYa AllAha yA icchA tAi karena|[sAjadAha]

erA du’Ti vivadamAna pakSa, yArA tAdera rava samparke vitarka kare| tave yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya Agunera pozAka prasttata karA haYeche| tAdera mAthAra upara theke Dhele deYA have phuTanta pAni|
yAra dvArA tAdera peTera abhyantare yA kichu raYeche tA o tAdera cAmar3AsamUha vigalita karA have|
Ara tAdera janya thAkave lohAra hAtur3I|
yakhanai tArA yantraNAkAtara haYe tA theke vera haYe Asate cAive, takhanai tAderake tAte phiriYe deYA have evaM valA have, dahana-yantraNA AsvAdana kara|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare nizcaYa AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena emana jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita| yekhAne tAderake sonAra kA~kana o muktA dvArA alaMkRta karA have evaM yekhAne tAdera pozAka-paricchada have rezamera|
tAderake pavitra vANIra dike paricAlanA karA haYechila evaM tAderake mahA prazaMsita AllAhara patha dekhAno haYechila|

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kare evaM AllAhara patha theke o masajide hArAma theke vAdhA deYa, yAke Ami sthAnIYa o vahirAgata sakalera janya samAna karechi| Ara ye vyakti sImAlaGghana kare sekhAne pApakAja karate cAYa, tAke Ami yantraNAdAYaka AyAva AsvAdana karAva|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami ivarAhImake se gharera (vAYatullAhra) sthAna nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘AmAra sAthe kAuke zarIka karave nA evaM AmAra gharake pAka sApha rAkhave tAoYAphakArI, rukU-sijadA o dA~r3iYe sAlAta AdAYakArIra janya’|
‘Ara mAnuSera nikaTa hajjera ghoSaNA dAo; tArA tomAra kAche Asave pAYe he~Te evaM kRzakAYa uTe car3e dUra patha pAr3i diYe’|

‘yena tArA nijadera kalyANera sthAnasamUhe hAyira hate pAre evaM tini tAderake catuSpada jantu theke ye riyka diYechena tAra upara nirdiSTa dinasamUhe AllAhara nAma smaraNa karate pAre| ataHpara tomarA tA theke khAo evaM dustha-daridrake khete dAo’|

‘tArapara tArA yena pariSkAra-paricchanna haYa, tAdera mAnatasamUha pUraNa kare evaM prAcIna gharera* tAoYApha kare’| * البيت العتيق vA purAtana ghara valate AllAhara ivAdAtera janya tairIkRta savacAite purAtana ghara tathA kA‘vA gharake vujhAno haYeche| kAraNa ivAdAtera janya nirmita eTAi yamInera vuke sarvaprathama ghara|

eTii vidhAna Ara keu AllAha kartRka nirdhArita pavitra viSaYasamUhake sammAna karale tAra ravera nikaTa tA-i tAra janya uttama| Ara tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche catuSpada jantu; tave yA tomAdera kAche pATha karA haYa seguli chAr3A| sutarAM mUrtipUjAra apavitratA theke virata thAka evaM mithyA kathA parihAra kara-

AllAhara janya ekaniSTha haYe evaM tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka nA kare| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare, se yena AkAza theke par3ala| ataHpara pAkhi tAke cho~ mere niYe gela kimvA vAtAsa tAke dUrera kona jAYagAYa nikSepa karala|
eTAi hala AllAhara vidhAna; ye AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake sammAna kare, niHsandehe tA antarera tAkaoYA thekei|
esava catuSpada jantute nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tomAdera janya kalyANa raYeche, tArapara egulora kuravAnIra sthAna have prAcIna gharera nikaTa|

pratyeka jAtira janya Ami kuravAnIra niYama kare diYechi; yAte tArA AllAhara nAma smaraNa karate pAre, ye samasta jantu tini riyka hiseve diYechena tAra upara| tomAdera ilAha to eka ilAha; ataeva tA~rai kAche AtmasamarpaNa kara; Ara anugataderake susaMvAda dAo,
yAdera kAche AllAhara kathA ullekha karA hale tAdera antara ke~pe oThe, yArA tAdera vipada-Apade dhairyadhAraNa kare, yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA theke vyaYa kare|

Ara kuravAnIra uTake Ami tomAdera janya AllAhara anyatama nidarzana vAniYechi; tomAdera janya tAte raYeche kalyANa| sutarAM sArivaddhabhAve danDAYamAna avasthAYa segulira upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kara yakhana seguli kAta haYe par3e yAYa takhana tA theke khAo| ye abhAvI, mAnuSera kAche hAta pAte nA evaM ye abhAvI ceYe ver3AYa-tAderake khete dAo| ebhAvei Ami ogulike tomAdera anugata kare diYechi; yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

AllAhara kAche pau~che nA egulora gozta o rakta; varaM tA~ra kAche pau~che tomAdera tAkaoYA| ebhAvei tini se savake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena, yAte tomarA AllAhara tAkavIra pATha karate pAra, ejanya ye, tini tomAderake hidAYAta dAna karechena; sutarAM tumi satkarmazIladerake susaMvAda dAo|
nizcaYa AllAha muminaderake rakSA karena evaM kona vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|
yuddhera anumati deYA hala tAderake, yAderake AkramaNa karA hacche| kAraNa tAdera opara niryAtana karA haYeche| nizcaYa AllAha tAderake vijaYa dAne sakSama|

yAderake tAdera nija vAr3I-ghara theke anyAYabhAve zudhu e kAraNe vera kare deYA haYeche ye, tArA vale, ‘AmAdera rava AllAha’| Ara AllAha yadi mAnavajAtira ekadalake apara dala dvArA damana nA karatena, tave vidhasta haYe yeta khRsTAna sannyAsIdera Azrama, girjA, iYAhUdIdera upAsanAlaYa o masajidasamUha- yekhAne AllAhara nAma adhika smaraNa karA haYa| Ara AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karena, ye tAke sAhAyya kare| nizcaYa AllAha zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
tArA emana yAderake Ami yamIne kSamatA dAna karale tArA sAlAta kAYema karave, yAkAta deve evaM satkAjera Adeza deve o asatkAja theke niSedha karave; Ara sava kAjera pariNAma AllAharai adhikAre|
Ara tArA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tave tAdera pUrve asvIkAra karechila nUha, ‘Ada o chAmUdera kaoma|
Ara ivarAhImera kaoma o lUtera kaoma|
Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIrA| Ara asvIkAra karA haYechila mUsAke| tAi kAphiraderake Ami avakAza diYechilAma, tArapara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| ataeva kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

ataHpara kata janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi yegulira vAsindArA chila yAlima, tAi eisava janapada tAdera gharera chAdasaha dhvaMsastupe pariNata haYechila, kata kUpa parityakta haYeche evaM kata sudRr3ha prAsAda dhvaMsa haYeche!

tArA ki yamIne bhramaNa kareni? tAhale tAdera hata emana hRdaYa yA dvArA tArA upalavdhi karate pArata evaM emana kAna yA dvArA tArA zunate pArata| vasttata cokha to andha haYa nA, varaM andha haYa vakSasthita hRdaYa|
Ara tArA tomAke AyAva tarAnvita karate vale, athaca AllAha kakhano tA~ra oYAdA khelApha karena nA| Ara tomAra ravera nikaTa nizcaYa eka dina tomAdera gaNanAYa hAjAra vacharera samAna|
Ara Ami kata janapadake avakAza diYechi, athaca tArA chila yAlima; ataHpara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| Ara AmArai nikaTa pratyAvartanasthala |
vala, ‘he mAnuSa, Ami to kevala tomAdera janya suspaSTa satarkakArI’|
sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha kare deYAra ceSTA kare, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ara Ami tomAra pUrve ye rAsUla kiMvA navI pAThiYechi, se yakhanai (ohIkRta vANI) pATha kareche, zaYatAna tAra pAThe (kichu) nikSepa kareche| kintu zaYatAna yA nikSepa kare AllAha tA muche dena| ataHpara AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUhake sudRr3ha kare dena| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, ati prajJAmaYa|

eTA ejanya ye, zaYatAna yA nikSepa kare, tA yAte tini tAdera janya parIkSAra vastta vAniYe dena, yAdera antarasamUhe vyAdhi raYeche evaM yAdera hRdaYasamUha pASANa| Ara nizcaYa yAlimarA dustara matabhede lipta raYeche|

eTA ejanyao ye, yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche, tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, eTA avazyai tomAra ravera pakSa theke satya| ataHpara tArA yena era prati ImAna Ane evaM tAdera antara yena era prati anugata haYa| Ara yArA ImAna eneche, nizcaYa AllAha tAderake sarala patha pradarzanakArI|
Ara yArA kupharI kare, tArA ete sandeha poSaNa karate thAkave yatakSaNa nA tAdera nikaTa AkasmikabhAve kiYAmata ese par3ave athavA tAdera nikaTa ese par3ave eka vandhyA dinera AyAva|
se dinera vAdazAhI AllAharai| tinii tAdera madhye vicAra karavena| sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tArA niAmatapUrNa jAnnAtasamUhe avasthAna karave|
Ara yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare, tAdera janyei raYeche apamAnajanaka AyAva|
Ara yArA AllAhara pathe hijarata kare, ataHpara nihata haYa kiMvA mArA yAYa, tAderake avazyai AllAha uttama riyka dAna karavena| Ara nizcaYa AllAhai sarvotkRSTa riykadAtA|
tini avazyai tAderake emana sthAne praveza karAvena, yA tArA pachanda karave Ara AllAha to nizcaYa mahAjJAnI, parama sahanazIla|

eTAi prakRta avasthA| Ara ye vyakti nipIr3ita haYe tAra samaparimANa pratizodha grahaNa kare; ataHpara tAra upara AvAra nipIr3ana karA haYa tAhale AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karavena| nizcaYa AllAha pApa mocanakArI, atIva kSamAzIla|
eTA ejanya ye, nizcaYa AllAha rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna| Ara nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|
Ara eTA ejanya ye, nizcaYa AllAhai satya evaM tArA tA~ra parivarte yAke DAke, avazyai tA vAtila| Ara nizcaYa AllAha to samucca, sumahAna|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, yAra phale yamIna savuja-zyAmala haYe uThe| nizcaYa AllAha snehaparAYaNa, sarvaviSaYe samyakajJAta|
AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai| Ara nizcaYa AllAhai to abhAvamukta, sakala prazaMsAra adhikArI|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, yamIne yA kichu Ache evaM nauyAnagulo yA tA~rai nirdeze samudre vicaraNa kare savai AllAha tomAdera janya anugata kare diYechena| Ara tinii AsamAnake ATakiYe rekhechena, yAte tA~ra anumati chAr3A tA yamInera upara par3e nA yAYa| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati var3ai karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
Ara tinii tomAdera jIvana diYechena, ataHpara tinii tomAdera mRtyu devena, tArapara tinii tomAderake AvAra jIvana devena| nizcaYa mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka jAtira janya ivAdAtera niYama-kAnuna nirdhAraNa kare diYechi, tArA yAra anusaraNakArI| sutarAM tArA yena tomAra sAthe e vyApAre kona vitarka karate nA pAre| Ara tumi tomAra ravera dike AhavAna kara| nizcaYa tumi sarala pathei raYecha|
Ara tArA yadi tomAra sAthe vAkavitanDA kare, tAhale vala, ‘tomarA yA kara, se samparke AllAha samyaka avahita|’
tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karacha, AllAha se viSaYe kiYAmatera dina phaYasAlA kare devena|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu raYeche, AllAha tA jAnena? nizcaYa tA ekaTi kitAve raYeche| avazyai eTA AllAhara janya khuvai sahaja|
Ara tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kare, ye samparke tini kona pramANa nAyila karenani evaM ye vyApAre tAderao kona jJAna nei| Ara yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

Ara tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTarUpe tilAoYAta karA hale yArA kupharI kare tAdera mukhamanDale tumi asantoSa lakSya karave; tAdera kAche yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare, tAderake tArA AkramaNa karate udyata haYa| vala, tAhale ki Ami tomAderake era ceYeo khArApa kichura saMvAda deva? seTA Aguna| yArA kupharI kare, AllAha tAderake era oYAdA diYechena| Ara eTA kata nikRSTa ThikAnA!

he mAnuSa, ekaTi upamA peza karA hala, manoyoga diYe tA zona, tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tArA kakhano ekaTi mAchio sRSTi karate pArave nA| yadio tArA e uddezye ekatrita haYa| Ara yadi mAchi tAdera kAcha theke kichu chiniYe neYa, tArA tAra kAcha theke tAo uddhAra karate pArave nA| anveSaNakArI o yAra kAche anveSaNa karA haYa ubhaYei durvala|
tArA AllAhake yathAyatha maryAdA deYa nA| nizcaYa AllAha mahAkSamatAvAna, mahAparAkramazAlI|
AllAha pherezatA o mAnuSera madhya theke rAsUla manonIta karena| avazyai AllAha sarvazrotA sarvadraSTA|
tAdera sAmane evaM pechane yA kichu Ache tini tA jAnena| Ara savakichu AllAhara kAchei pratyAvartita have|
he muminagaNa, tomarA rukU‘ kara, sijadA kara, tomAdera ravera ivAdAta kara evaM bhAla kAja kara, AzA karA yAYa tomarA saphala hate pArave|[sAjadAha]

Ara tomarA AllAhara pathe jihAda kara yebhAve jihAda karA ucit| tini tomAderake manonIta karechena| dInera vyApAre tini tomAdera upara kona kaThoratA Aropa karenani| eTA tomAdera pitA ivarAhImera dIna| tinii tomAdera nAma rekhechena ‘musalima’ pUrve evaM e kitAveo| yAte rAsUla tomAdera janya sAkSI haYa Ara tomarA mAnuSera janya sAkSI hao| ataeva tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake majavutabhAve dhara| tinii tomAdera abhibhAvaka| Ara tini katai nA uttama abhibhAvaka evaM katai nA uttama sAhAyyakArI!
avazyai muminagaNa saphala haYeche,
yArA nijadera sAlAte vinaYAvanata|
Ara yArA anarthaka kathAkarma theke vimukha|
Ara yArA yAkAtera kSetre sakriYa|
Ara yArA tAdera nijadera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyatakArI|
tave tAdera strI o tAdera DAna hAta yAra mAlika haYeche tArA chAr3A, nizcaYa ete tArA nindita have nA|
ataHpara yArA edera chAr3A anyake kAmanA kare tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
Ara yArA nijadera AmAnatasamUha o aGgIkAre yatnavAna|
Ara yArA nijadera sAlAtasamUha hiphAyata kare|
tArAi have oYArisa|
yArA phiradAusera adhikArI have| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
Ara avazyai Ami mAnuSake mATira niryAsa theke sRSTi karechi|
tArapara Ami tAke zukrarUpe saMrakSita AdhAre sthApana karechi|

tArapara zukrake Ami ‘AlAkAYa pariNata kari| tArapara ‘AlAkAke gozatapinDe pariNata kari| tArapara gozatapinDake hAr3e pariNata kari| tArapara hAr3ake gozta diYe AvRta kari| ataHpara tAke anya eka sRSTirUpe gar3e tuli| ataeva sarvottama sraSTA AllAha kata varakatamaYa!
erapara avazyai tomarA marave|
tArapara kiYAmatera dina avazyai tomarA punarutthita have|
Ara avazyai Ami tomAdera upara sAtaTi stara sRSTi karechi| Ara Ami sRSTi samparke udAsIna chilAma nA|
Ara Ami AkAza theke parimitabhAve pAni varSaNa karechi| ataHpara Ami tA yamIne saMrakSaNa karechi| Ara avazyai Ami seTAke apasAraNa karateo sakSama|
tArapara Ami tA dvArA tomAdera janya khejura o AGgurera vAgAnasamUha sRSTi karechi| tAte tomAdera janya pracura phala thAke| Ara tA thekei tomarA khAo|
Ara eka vRkSa yA sinAi pAhAr3a hate udagata haYa, yA AhArakArIdera janya tela o tarakArI utpanna kare|

Ara nizcaYa gavAdipazura madhye tomAdera janya zikSaNIYa viSaYa raYeche| tAdera peTe yA Ache tA theke Ami tomAderake pAna karAi| Ara ete tomAdera janya pracura upakAritA raYeche evaM tA theke tomarA khAo|
Ara esava pazu o naukAYa tomAderake ArohaNa karAno haYa|

Ara avazyai Ami nUhake tAra kaomera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma| ataHpara se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei| tavuo ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?

tArapara tAra sampradAYera netRsthAnIYagaNa, yArA kupharI karechila- tArA valala, ‘eto tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa chAr3A kichui nA| se tomAdera upara zreSThatva lAbha karate cAYa| Ara AllAha icchA karale avazyai pherezatA nAyila karatena| e kathAto AmarA AmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSadera samaYeo zunini’|
‘se kevala emana eka loka, yAra madhye pAgalAmI raYeche| ataeva tomarA tAra samparke kichukAla apekSA kara’|
nUha valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAhAyya karuna| kenanA tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valeche’|

tArapara Ami tAra kAche ohI preraNa karalAma ye, tumi AmAra cokhera sAmane o AmAra ohI anuyAYI naukA tairI kara| tArapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asave evaM culA (pAnite) uthale uThave takhana pratyeka jIvera eka jor3A o tomAra parivAravargake nauyAne tule nio; tave tAdera madhye yAdera vyApAre pUrve siddhAnta haYe Ache tArA chAr3A| Ara yArA yulama kareche tAdera vyApAre tumi AmAke samvodhana karo nA| nizcaYa tArA nimajjita have|
ataHpara yakhana tumi o tomAra saGgIrA nauyAne ArohaNa karave takhana valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini AmAderake yAlima kaoma theke mukti diYechena’|
tumi Arao valave, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke varakatamaYa avataraNasthale avataraNa karAna| Ara Apanii sarvazreSTha avataraNakArI’|
nizcaYa era madhye aneka nidarzana raYeche| Ara nizcaYa Ami parIkSAkArI chilAma|
tArapara tAdera pare Ami anya prajanma sRSTi karechi|

ataHpara tAdera madhye tAderai ekajanake Ami rAsUlarUpe preraNa karechilAma ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta karave, tini chAr3A tomAdera anya kona (satya) ilAha nei| tavuo ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA|

Ara tAra sampradAYera netRsthAnIYa vyaktigaNa yArA kupharI kareche, AkherAtera sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche evaM Ami duniYAra jIvane yAdera bhoga vilAsitA diYechilAma, tArA valala, ‘se kevala tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa, se tAi khAYa yA theke tomarA khAo evaM se tAi pAna kare yA theke tomarA pAna kara’|
‘Ara yadi tomarA tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kara, tave tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta have’|
‘se ki tomAdera oYAdA deYa ye, tomarA yakhana mArA yAve evaM tomarA mATi o hAr3e pariNata haYe yAve| tomAderake avazyai vera karA have?’
aneka dUra, tomAdera ye oYAdA deYA haYeche tA aneka dUra|
‘e zudhu AmAdera duniYAra jIvana| AmarA mare yAi evaM ve~ce thAki| Ara AmarA punarutthita havAra nai’|
‘se zudhu eka vyakti ye AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa kareche; Ara AmarA tA~ra prati ImAna AnaYanakArI nai’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAhAyya karuna, kAraNa tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valeche’|
AllAha valalena, ‘kichu samaYera madhyei tArA nizcitarUpe anutapta have’|
ataHpara yathArthai tAderake eka vikaTa AoYAja peYe vasala, tArapara Ami tAderake khar3akuTAYa pariNata karalAma| sutarAM yAlima kaomera janya dhvaMsa|
tArapara tAdera pare Ami anya prajanma sRSTi karechi|
kona jAti theke tAra nirdiSTa meYAda egiYe Ase nA evaM vilamvitao haYa nA|

erapara Ami AmAdera rAsUladerake dhArAvAhikabhAve preraNa karechi, yakhanai kona jAtira kAche tAdera rAsUla Asata, takhanai tArA tAke asvIkAra karata| ataHpara Ami edera ekake aparera anusaraNe dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM tAderake kAhinIte pariNata karechi| sutarAM dhvaMsa hoka se kaoma yArA ImAna Ane nA|
tArapara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake AmAra nidarzanAvalI o suspaSTa pramANasaha preraNa karechi|
phira‘Auna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche; kintu tArA ahaGkAra karala evaM tArA chila uddhata kaoma|
ataHpara tArA valala, AmarA ki AmAdera matai du’jana mAnuSera prati ImAna Anava athaca tAdera kaoma AmAdera sevAdAsa|
ataeva tArA tAdera ubhaYake mithyAvAdI valala| phale tArA dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta haYe gela|
Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva pradAna karechilAma yAte tArA hidAYAtaprApta haYa|
Ara Ami mAraiYAma-putra o tAra mAke nidarzana vAnAlAma evaM tAderake AvAsayogya o jharnAviziSTa eka u~cu bhUmite AzraYa dilAma|
‘he rAsUlagaNa, tomarA pavitra o bhAla vastta theke khAo evaM satkarma kara| nizcaYa tomarA yA kara se sarmpake Ami samyaka jJAta|
tomAdera ei dIna to ekai dIna| Ara Ami tomAdera rava, ataeva tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|
tArapara lokerA tAdera mAjhe tAdera dInake vahubhAge vibhakta kareche| pratyeka dalai tAdera kAche yA Ache tA niYe utphulla|
sutarAM kichu samaYera janya tAderake svIYa vibhrAntite thAkate dAo|
tArA ki mane karache ye, dhana-sampada o santAna-santati theke yA Ami tAderake dei|
(tA dvArA) Ami tAdera kalyANe druta egiYe niYe yAcchi; varaM tArA upaladdhi karate pArache nA|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera ravera bhaYe bhIta-santrasta,
Ara yArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera sAthe ziraka kare nA,
Ara yArA yA dAna kare tA bhIta-kampita hRdaYe kare thAke ejanya ye, tArA tAdera ravera dike pratyAvartanazIla|
tArAi kalyANasamUhera dike druta egiYe yAcche| evaM tAte tArA agragAmI|
Ara Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyera vAire kona dAYitva dei nA| AmAra nikaTa Ache emana kitAva yA satya kathA vale evaM tArA atyAcArita have nA|
varaM tAdera antarasamUha e viSaYe vibhrAntite raYeche| echAr3A tAdera Arao Aneka Amala raYeche, yA tArA karache|
avazeSe yakhana Ami tAdera bhogavilAsapUrNa jIvanadhArIdera AyAva dvArA pAkar3Ao karava, takhana tArA sajore ArtanAda kare uThave|
Aja tomarA sajore ArtanAda karo nA| nizcaYa tomarA AmAra pakSa theke sAhAyyaprApta have nA|
AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAdera sAmane avazyai tilAoYAta karA hata, tArapara tomarA tomAdera pechana phire cale yete,
era upara ahaGkAravaze, rAta jege arthahIna galpa-gujava karate|
tArA ki e vANI samparke cintA-bhAvanA kare nA? nAki tAdera kAche emana kichu eseche yA tAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSadera kAche Aseni?
nAki tArA tAdera rAsUlake cinate pAreni, phale tArA tAke asvIkAra karache?
nAki tArA valache ye, tAra madhye kona pAgalAmI raYeche? nA, varaM se tAdera kAche satya niYei esechila| Ara tAdera adhikAMza lokai satyake apachandakArI|

Ara yadi satya tAdera kAmanA-vAsanAra anugAmI hata, tave AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o etadobhaYera madhyasthita sava kichu viparyasta haYe yeta; varaM Ami tAderake diYechi tAdera upadezavANI (kuraAna)| athaca tArA tAdera upadeza hate mukha phiriYe nicche|
nAki tumi tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAo? tave tomAra ravera pratidAna sarvottama| Ara tinii sarvottama riykadAtA|
Ara nizcaYa tumi tAdera sarala-saThika pathera dAoYAta diccha|
Ara nizcaYa yArA AkherAtera prati ImAna Ane nA, tArAi ei patha theke vicyuta|
Ara yadi Ami tAdera daYA karatAma evaM tAdera duHkha-durdazA theke mukta karatAma, tavuo tArA avAdhyatAYa vibhrAnta haYe ghure ver3Ata|
Ara avazyai Ami tAderake AyAva dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma, tavuo tArA tAdera ravera kAche nata haYani evaM vinIta prArthanAo kare nA|
avazeSe Ami yakhana tAdera janya kaThina AyAvera duYAra khule dei takhanai tAte tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
Ara tinii tomAdera janya kAna, cokhasamUha o antarasamUha sRSTi karechena; tomarA kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
Ara tinii pRthivIte tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake tA~rai kAche ekatra karA have|
