Ara tinii jIvana dena o mRtyu dena evaM rAta o dinera parivartana tA~rai adhikAre| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
varaM tArA tAi vale yemanaTi pUrvavartIrA valata|
tArA vale, yakhana AmarA mare yAva evaM AmarA mATi o hAr3e pariNata hava takhanao ki AmarA punarutthita hava?
avazyai AmAderake o itaHpUrve AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake ei oYAdA deYA haYechila| esava kevala purAna kAlera upAkhyAna chAr3A Ara kichu nA|
vala, ‘tomarA yadi jAna tave vala, ‘e yamIna o ete yArA Ache tArA kAra?’
acirei tArA valave, ‘AllAhara’| vala, ‘tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?’
vala, ‘ke sAta AsamAnera rava evaM mahA Arazera rava’?
tArA valave, ‘AllAha|’ vala, ‘tavuo ki tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’
vala, ‘tini ke yAra hAte sakala kichura kartRtva, yini AzraYa dAna karena evaM yA~ra opara kona AzraYadAtA nei?’ yadi tomarA jAna|
tArA valave, ‘AllAha|’ vala, ‘tavuo kIbhAve tomarA mohAcchanna haYe Acha?’
varaM Ami tAdera kAche satya pau~chiYechi, Ara nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karenani, tA~ra sAthe anya kona ilAhao nei| (yadi thAkata) tave pratyeka ilAha nijera sRSTike niYe pRthaka haYe yeta evaM eke anyera upara prAdhAnya vistAra karata; tArA yA varNanA kare tA theke AllAha kata pavitra!
tini gAYeva o upasthitera jJAnI, tArA yA zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
vala, ‘he AmAra rava, ye viSaYe tAderake oYAdA deYA hacche tA yadi AmAke dekhAte cAna,
‘he AmAra rava, tAhale AmAke yAlima sampradAYabhukta karavena nA|’
Ara ye viSaYe Ami tAderake oYAdA diYechi, avazyai Ami tA tomAke dekhAte sakSama|
yA uttama tA diYe manda pratihata kara; tArA yA vale Ami tA samparke adhika jJAnI|
Ara vala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami zaYatAnera prarocanA theke ApanAra kAche pAnAha cAi’|
Ara he AmAra rava, AmAra kAche tAdera upasthiti hate ApanAra kAche pAnAha cAi|’
avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAro mRtyu Ase, se vale, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke pherata pAThAna,
yena Ami satkAja karate pAri yA Ami cher3e diYechilAma|’ kakhano naYa, eTi ekaTi vAkya yA se valave| yedina tAderake punarutthita karA have sedina paryanta tAdera sAmane thAkave varayakha|
ataHpara yedina ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have sedina tAdera mAjhe kona AtmIYatAra vandhana thAkave nA, keu kAro viSaYe jAnate cAive nA|
ataHpara yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArAi have saphalakAma|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijadera kSati karala; jAhAnnAme tArA have sthAYI|
Aguna tAdera cehArA dagdha karave, sekhAne tArA have vIbhatsa cehArAviziSTa|
‘AmAra AYAtasamUha ki tomAdera kAche pATha karA hata nA?’ tArapara tomarA tA asvIkAra karate’|
tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, durbhAgya AmAderake peYe vasechila, Ara AmarA chilAma pathabhraSTa’|
‘he AmAdera rava, e theke AmAderake vera kare dina, tArapara yadi AmarA AvAra tA kari tave avazyai AmarA hava yAlima|’
AllAha valavena, ‘tomarA dhikRta avasthAYa ekhAnei thAka, Ara AmAra sAthe kathA valo nA|’
AmAra vAndAdera ekadala chila yArA valata, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA ImAna enechi, ataeva AmAderake kSamA o daYA karuna, Ara Apani sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
‘tArapara tAderake niYe tomarA ThATTA karate| avazeSe tA tomAderake AmAra smaraNa bhuliYe diYechila| Ara tomarA tAdera niYe hAsi-tAmAzA karate|’
nizcaYa Ami tAdera dhairyera kAraNe Aja tAderake puraskRta karalAma; nizcaYa tArAi hala saphalakAma|
AllAha valavena, ‘vacharera hisAve tomarA yamIne kata samaYa avasthAna karechile?’
tArA valave, ‘AmarA ekadina vA dinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi; sutarAM Apani gaNanAkArIderake jijJAsA karuna|’
tini valavena, ‘tomarA kevala alpakAlai avasthAna karechile, tomarA yadi nizcita jAnate!’
‘tomarA ki mane karechile ye, Ami tomAderake kevala anarthaka sRSTi karechi evaM tomarA AmAra dike pratyAvartita have nA’?
sutarAM satyikArera mAlika AllAha mahimAnvita, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; tini sammAnita ‘Arazera rava|
Ara ye AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake DAke, ye viSaYe tAra kAche pramANa nei; tAra hisAva kevala tAra ravera kAche| nizcaYa kAphirarA saphalakAma have nA|
Ara vala, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani kSamA karuna, daYA karuna evaM Apanii sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
eTi ekaTi sUrA, yA Ami nAyila karechi evaM eTAke avazya pAlanIYa karechi| Ara Ami ete suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI tAdera pratyekake ekaza’Ti kare vetrAghAta kara| Ara yadi tomarA AllAha o zeSa divasera prati ImAna ene thAka tave AllAhara dInera vyApAre tAdera prati daYA yena tomAderake peYe nA vase| Ara muminadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI kevala vyabhicAriNI athavA muzarika nArIke chAr3A viYe karave nA evaM vyabhicAriNIke kevala vyabhicArI athavA muzarika chAr3A viYe karave nA| Ara muminadera upara eTA hArAma karA haYeche|

Ara yArA saccaritra nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare, tArapara tArA cArajana sAkSI niYe Ase nA, tave tAderake AziTi vetrAghAta kara evaM tomarA kakhanai tAdera sAkSya grahaNa karo nA| Ara erAi halo phAsika|
tave yArA erapare tAovA kare evaM nijadera saMzodhana kare, tAhale nizcaYa AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara yArA nijadera strIra prati apavAda Aropa kare, athaca nijerA chAr3A tAdera Ara kona sAkSI nei, tAhale tAdera pratyekera sAkSya have AllAhara nAme cAravAra sAkSya deve ye, se nizcaYai satyavAdIdera antarbhukta|
Ara paJcamavAre sAkSya deve ye, se yadi mithyAvAdI haYa, tave nizcaYa tAra upara AllAhara lA‘nata|
Ara tArA strIlokaTi theke zAsti rahita karave, yadi se AllAhara nAme cAravAra sAkSya deYa ye, nizcaYa tAra svAmI mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta|
Ara paJcamavAre sAkSya deve ye, yadi tAra svAmI satyavAdI haYa, tave nizcaYa tAra upara AllAhara gayava|
yadi tomAdera upara AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra daYA nA thAkata, (tAhale tomarA dhvaMsa haYe yete) Ara nizcaYa AllAha adhika tAovA grahaNakArI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai yArA e apavAda* raTanA kareche, tArA tomAderai ekaTi dala| eTAke tomarA tomAdera janya akalyANakara mane karo nA, varaM eTA tomAdera janya kalyANakara| tAdera theke pratyeka vyaktira janya raYeche, yataTuku pApa se arjana kareche| Ara tAdera theke ye vyakti e vyApAre pradhAna bhUmikA pAlana kareche, tAra janya raYeche mahAAyAva| * eTi ummula muminIna AYezA (rA) era prati mithyA apavAdera ghaTanA| 6STha hijarIte rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma vanU mustAlika yuddha theke phirAra pathe ekasthAne rAtriyApanera janya avasthAna karena| rAtera zeSa bhAge AYezA (rA) prAkRtika praYojane ekaTu dUre yAna| kintu pathe tini tA~ra galAra hAraTi hAriYe phelena| tini tA~ra hAra khu~jate thAkena| edike kAphelA raonA haYe yAYa| tini hAodAra bhitarei Achena mane kare keu tA~ra kho~ja kareni kAraNa tA~ra zArIrika gar3ana chila hAlakA| hAra khu~je peYe tini ese dekhena ye, kAphelA cale geche| takhana tini chuTAchuTi nA kare sekhAnei vase par3ena| e AzAYa ye kAphelAra rekhe yAoYA mAlAmAlera sandhAne niYojita kona loka Asavena| avazeSe e kAje niYojita sAphaoYAna (rA.) sakAla velAYa AYezA (rA.) ke dekhate pelena evaM nijera uTe tA~ke ArohaNa kariYe nije pAYe heTe uTera razi Tene sasammAne tA~ke niYe kAphelAra sAthe milita hana| e ghaTanAke kendra kare munAphika sardAra AvdullAha ivane uvAi kaYekajanake sAthe niYe AYezA (rA.) era vyApAre mithyA apavAda raTAte thAke| avazeSe AllAha tA‘AlA e AYAtagulo nAyila kare AYezA (rA) ke nirdoSa ghoSaNA karena evaM apavAda raTanAkArIdera kaThora zAstira kathA jAniYe dena| ei ghaTanATi ‘iphaka’ era ghaTanA hiseve prasiddha|
yakhana tomarA eTA zunale, takhana kena mumina puruSa o mumina nArIrA tAdera nijadera samparke bhAla dhAraNA poSaNa karala nA evaM valala nA ye, ‘eTA to suspaSTa apavAda’?
tArA kena e vyApAre cArajana sAkSI niYe Asala nA? sutarAM yakhana tArA sAkSI niYe Aseni, takhana tArAi AllAhara kAche mithyAvAdI|
Ara yadi duniYA o AkherAte tomAdera upara AllAhara daYA o tA~ra anugraha nA thAkata, tave tomarA yAte lipta chile, tAra janya tomAderake avazyai kaThina AyAva sparza karata|

yakhana eTA tomarA tomAdera mukhe mukhe char3Acchile evaM tomarA tomAdera mukha diYe emana kathA valachile, yAte tomAdera kona jJAna chila nA; Ara tomarA eTAke khuvai tuccha mane karachile, athaca eTA AllAhara nikaTa khuvai gurutara|
Ara tomarA yakhana eTA zunale, takhana tomarA kena valale nA ye, ‘e niYe kathA valA AmAdera pakSe sambhava naYa| tumi ati pavitra mahAna, eTA eka gurutara apavAda’|
AllAha tomAderake upadeza dicchena ye, yadi tomarA mumina hao, tAhale Ara kakhano era punarAvRtti karave nA|
Ara AllAha tomAdera janya AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA karachena evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa yArA eTA pachanda kare ye, muminadera madhye azlIlatA char3iYe par3uka, tAdera janya duniYA o AkherAte raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva| Ara AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAna nA|
Ara yadi tomAdera upara AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra daYA nA thAkata, (tAhale tomarA dhvaMsa haYe yete) Ara nizcaYa AllAha var3a meheravAna, parama daYAlu|

he muminagaNa, tomarA zaYatAnera padAGkasamUha anusaraNa karo nA| Ara ye zaYatAnera padAGkasamUha anusaraNa karave, nizcaYa se azlIlatA o manda kAjera nirdeza deve| Ara yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o tA~ra daYA nA thAkata, tAhale tomAdera keui kakhano pavitra hate pArata nA; kintu AllAha yAke icchA karena, pavitra karena| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI|

Ara tomAdera madhye yArA maryAdA o prAcuryera adhikArI, tArA yena emana kasama nA kare ye, tArA nikaTAtmIYadera, misakInadera o AllAhara pathe hijaratakArIdera kichui deve nA| Ara tArA yena tAdera kSamA kare evaM tAdera doSatruTi upekSA kare| tomarA ki pachanda kara nA ye, AllAha tomAdera kSamA kare dena? Ara AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA saccaritrA saralamanA mumina nArIdera prati apavAda Aropa kare, tArA duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta| Ara tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|
yedina tAdera jihavAgulo, tAdera hAtagulo o tAdera pAgulo tArA yA karata, se vyApAre tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve|
sedina AllAha tAderake tAdera nyAyya pratidAna puropuri diYe devena, Ara tArA jAnave ye, AllAhai suspaSTa satya|

duzcaritrA nArIrA duzcaritra puruSadera janya evaM duzcaritra puruSarA duzcaritrA nArIdera janya| Ara saccaritrA nArIrA saccaritra puruSadera janya evaM saccaritra puruSarA saccaritrA nArIdera janya; lokerA yA vale, tArA tA theke mukta| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|

he muminagaNa, tomarA nijadera gRha chAr3A anya kArao gRhe praveza karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA anumati neve evaM gRhavAsIderake sAlAma deve| eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

ataHpara yadi tomarA sekhAne kAuke nA pAo tAhale tomAderake anumati nA deYA paryanta tomarA sekhAne praveza karo nA| Ara yadi tomAderake valA haYa, ‘phire yAo’ tAhale phire yAve| eTAi tomAdera janya adhika pavitra| tomarA yA kara AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avagata|
ye ghare keu vAsa kare nA, tAte tomAdera kona bhogasAmagrI thAkale, sekhAne tomAdera praveze kona pApa have nA| Ara AllAha jAnena yA tomarA prakAza kara Ara yA tomarA gopana kara|
mumina puruSaderake vala, tArA tAdera dRSTike saMyata rAkhave evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyata karave| eTAi tAdera janya adhika pavitra| nizcaYa tArA yA kare se samparke AllAha samyaka avahita|

Ara mumina nArIderake vala, yena tArA tAdera dRSTike saMyata rAkhave evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyata kare| Ara yA sAdhAraNata prakAza pAYa tA chAr3A tAdera saundarya tArA prakAza karave nA| tArA yena tAdera or3anA diYe vakSadezake AvRta kare rAkhe| Ara tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, nijadera chele, svAmIra chele, bhAi, bhAi era chele, vonera chele, Apana nArIgaNa, tAdera DAna hAta yAra mAlika haYeche, adhInastha yaunakAmanAmukta puruSa athavA nArIdera gopana aGga samparke ajJa vAlaka chAr3A kAro kAche nijadera saundarya prakAza nA kare| Ara tArA yena nijadera gopana saundarya prakAza karAra janya sajore padacAraNA nA kare| he muminagaNa, tomarA sakalei AllAhara nikaTa tAovA kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
Ara tomarA tomAdera madhyakAra avivAhita nArI-puruSa o satkarmazIla dAsa dAsIdera vivAha dAo| tArA abhAvI hale AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta kare devena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa o mahAjJAnI|

Ara yAdera vivAhera sAmarthya nei AllAha tAderake nija anugrahe abhAvamukta nA karA paryanta tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare| Ara tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIdera madhye yArA muktira janya likhita cukti karate cAYa tAdera sAthe tomarA likhita cukti kara, yadi tomarA tAdera madhye kalyANa Ache vale jAnate pAra evaM AllAha tomAderake ye sampada diYechena tA theke tomarA tAderake dAo| tomAdera dAsIrA satItva rakSA karate cAile tomarA duniYAra jIvanera sampadera kAmanAYa tAderake vyabhicAre vAdhya karo nA| Ara yArA tAderake vAdhya karave, nizcaYa tAderake vAdhya karAra para AllAha tAdera prati atyanta kSamAzIla parama daYAlu|
Ara nizcaYa Ami tomAdera kAche nAyila karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha evaM tomAdera pUrve yArA cale geche tAdera dRSTAnta o muttAkIdera janya upadeza|

AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamInera nUra| tA~ra nUrera upamA ekaTi tAkera matai| tAte raYeche ekaTi pradIpa, pradIpaTi raYeche ekaTi cimanira madhye| cimaniTi ujjvala tArakAra matai| pradIpaTi varakatamaYa yAitUna gAchera tela dvArA jvAlAno haYa, yA pUrva dikerao naYa evaM pazcima dikerao naYa| era tela yena Alo vikiraNa kare, yadio tAte Aguna sparza nA kare| nUrera upara nUra| AllAha yAke icchA hidAYAta karena tA~ra nUrera dike| Ara AllAha mAnuSera janya upamAsamUha upasthApana karena| Ara AllAha pratiTi vastu samparke samyaka jJAta|
sesava ghare yAke samunnata karate evaM yekhAne AllAhara nAma yikra karate AllAhai anumati diYechena| sekhAne sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kare-
sesava loka, yAderake vyavasA-vANijya o kraYa-vikraYa AllAhara yikra, sAlAta kAYema karA o yAkAta pradAna karA theke virata rAkhe nA| tArA sedinake bhaYa kare, yedina antara o dRSTisamUha ulTe yAve|
yAte tAdera kRta uttama Amalera janya AllAha tAderake pratidAna dena evaM tini svIYa anugrahe tAderake Aro vAr3iYe dena| Ara AllAha yAke icchA karena aparimita riyka dAna karena|

Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAdera AmalasamUha marubhUmira maricikAra mata, pipAsita vyakti yAke pAni mane kare| avazeSe yakhana se tAra kAche Asave, takhana se dekhave seTA kichui naYa| Ara se sekhAne AllAhake dekhate pAve| ataHpara tini tAke tAra hisAva paripUrNa kare devena| Ara AllAha ati druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

athavA (tAdera AmalasamUha) gabhIra samUdre ghanibhUta andhakArera mata, yAke Acchanna kare DheuYera upare Dheu, tAra upare meghamAlA| aneka andhakAra; eka starera upara apara stara| keu hAta vera karale Adau tA dekhate pAYa nA| Ara AllAha yAke nUra dena nA tAra janya kona nUra nei|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AsamAna o yamIne yArA Ache tArA evaM sArivaddha haYe ur3anta pAkhirA AllAhara tAsavIha pATha kare? pratyekei tA~ra sAlAta o tAsavIha jAne| tArA yA kare se samparke AllAha samyaka avagata|
Ara AsamAna o yamInera mAlikAnA AllAhara janyai| Ara AllAhara dikei pratyAvartana|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha meghamAlAke paricAlita karena, tArapara tini seguloke ekatre jur3e dena, tArapara segulo stupIkRta karena, tArapara tumi dekhate pAo tAra madhya theke vRSTira vera haYa| Ara tini AkAze sthita meghamAlAra pAhAr3a theke zilA varSaNa karena| tArapara tA dvArA yAke icchA AghAta karena| Ara yAra kAcha theke icchA tA sariYe dena| era vidyutera jhalaka dRSTizakti prAYa ker3e neYa|
AllAha dina o rAtera Avartana ghaTAna, nizcaYai ete antaradRSTisampannadera janya zikSA raYeche|

Ara AllAha pratyeka jIvake pAni theke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tAdera konaTi peTe bhara diYe cale, konaTi cale du’pAYera upara, AvAra konaTi cAra pAYera upara cale| AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
avazyai Ami suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karechi| Ara AllAha yAke icchA sarala saThika patha dekhAna|
tArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAha o rAsUlera prati ImAna enechi evaM AmarA Anugatya karechi’, tArapara tAdera ekaTi dala era pare mukha phiriYe neYa| Ara tArA mumina naYa|
Ara yakhana tAderake AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati e marme AhavAna karA haYa ye, tini tAdera madhye vicAramImAMsA karavena, takhana tAdera ekaTi dala mukha phiriYe neYa|
kintu yadi satya tAdera pakSe thAke, tAhale tArA tAra kAche ekAnta vinItabhAve chuTe Ase|
tAdera antare ki vyAdhi raYeche? nAki tArA sandeha poSaNa kare, nA tArA bhaYa kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera upara yulama karavena? varaM tArAi to yAlima|

muminaderake yakhana AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati e marme AhavAna karA haYa ye, tini tAdera madhye vicAra, mImAMsA karavena, tAdera kathA to ei haYa ye, takhana tArA vale: ‘AmarA zunalAma o Anugatya karalAma|’ Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
Ara ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM tA~ra tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, tArAi kRtakArya|

Ara tArA tAdera sudRr3ha zapathera mAdhyame AllAhara nAme kasama kare vale ye, ‘tumi yadi tAdera Adeza kara tave tArA vera havei| tumi vala, ‘tomarA kasama karo nA| [tomAdera] Anugatya to jAnAi Ache| tomarA yA kichu kara, nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe savizeSa avahita’|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara|’ tArapara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave se zudhu tAra upara arpita dAYitvera janya dAYI evaM tomAdera upara arpita dAYitvera janya tomarAi dAYI| Ara yadi tomarA tAra Anugatya kara tave tomarA hidAYAtaprApta have| Ara rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA|

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare AllAha tAderake e marme oYAdA diYechena ye, tini nizcitabhAve tAderake yamInera pratinidhitva pradAna karavena, yemana tini pratinidhitva pradAna karechilena tAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM tini avazyai tAdera janya zaktizAlI o supratiSThita karavena tAdera dInake, yA tini tAdera janya pachanda karechena evaM tini tAdera bhaYa-bhIti zAnti-nirApattAYa parivartita kare devena| tArA AmArai ivAdAta karave, AmAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karave nA| Ara erapara yArA kupharI karave tArAi phAsika|
Ara tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomarA rahamataprApta hate pAra|
tumi kAphiraderake yamIne apAragakArI mane karo nA; tAdera AzraYasthala Aguna| Ara katai nA nikRSTa ei pratyAvartanasthala!

he muminagaNa, tomAdera DAnahAta yAra mAlika haYeche evaM tomAdera madhye yArA prAptavaYaska haYani tArA yena avazyai tina samaYe anumati grahaNa kare| phajarera sAlAtera pUrve, dupure yakhana tomarA tomAdera pozAka khule rAkha, evaM ‘izAra sAlAtera para; ei tinaTi tomAdera [gopanIYatAra] samaYa| ei tina samaYera para tomAdera evaM tAdera kona doSa nei| tomAdera eke anyera kAche yAtAYAta karatei haYa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera uddezye tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara tomAdera santAna-santati yakhana prAptavaYaska haYa, takhana tArAo yena anumati cAYa yemanibhAve tAdera agrajarA anumati cAita| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara vRddhA nArIrA, yArA viYera pratyAzA kare nA, tAdera janya kona doSa nei, yadi tArA tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA kare tAdera kichu pozAka khule rAkhe evaM e theke virata thAkAi tAdera janya uttama| Ara AllAha sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI|

andhera janya kona doSa nei, paGgura janya kona doSa nei, rogAkrAntera janya kona doSa nei evaM tomAdera nijadera janyao kona doSa nei ye tomarA khAve tomAdera nijadera ghare, athavA tomAdera pitAdera ghare, athavA tomAdera mAYedera ghare, athavA tomAdera bhAidera ghare, athavA tomAdera vonadera ghare, athavA tomAdera cAcAdera ghare, athavA tomAdera phuphudera ghare, athavA tomAdera mAmAdera ghare, athavA tomAdera khAlAdera ghare, athavA sesava ghare yAra cAvi tomAdera adhikAre raYeche, athavA tomAdera vandhudera ghare| tomarA ekatre khAo athavA AlAdA AlAdA khAo tAte konao doSa nei| tave tomarA yakhana kona ghare praveza karave takhana tomarA nijadera upara sAlAma karave, AllAhara pakSa theke varakatapUrNa o pavitra abhivAdanasvarUpa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera uddezye tA~ra AYAtasamUha varNanA karena yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

mumina zudhu tArAi yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera opara ImAna Ane evaM tA~ra sAthe kona samaSTigata kAje thAkale anumati nA niYe cale yAYa nA| nizcaYa tomAra kAche yArA anumati cAYa tArAi kevala AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara ImAna Ane; sutarAM kona praYojane tArA tomAra kAche vAire yAoYAra anumati cAile tAdera madhye tomAra yAke icchA tumi anumati deve evaM tAdera janya AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|

tomarA parasparake yebhAve DAko rAsUlake sebhAve Deko nA; tomAdera madhye yArA cupisAre sare par3e AllAha avazyai tAderake jAnena| ataeva yArA tA~ra nirdezera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA yena tAdera opara viparyaYa neme AsA athavA yantraNAdAYaka AyAva pau~chAra bhaYa kare|

sAvadhAna, AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai; tomarA ye avasthAYa Acha tA tini avazyai jAnena evaM yedina tAderake tA~ra kAche phiriYe neYA have sedina tArA yA karata tini tAderake tA jAniYe devena| AllAha sava kichu samparke samyaka jJAta|
tini varakatamaYa yini tA~ra vAndAra upara phurakAna nAyila karechena yena se jagatavAsIra janya satarkakArI hate pAre|

yAra adhikAre raYeche AsamAna o yamInera mAlikAnA; Ara tini kona santAna grahaNa karenani evaM sArvabhaumatve tA~ra kona zarIka nei| tini sava kichu sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tA nipuNabhAve nirUpaNa karechena|

Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A aneka ilAha grahaNa kareche, yArA kichui sRSTi karate pAre nA, varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYeche; tArA nijadera kona kalyANa o akalyANa karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA evaM mRtyu, jIvana o punarutthAna karateo sakSama haYa nA|
kAphirarA vale ‘eTi to jaghanya mithyA yA se raTanA kareche Ara anya eka dala tAke sAhAyya kareche|’ ebhAve tArA yulama o mithyA niYe eseche|
tArA vale, ‘eTi prAcInakAlera upakathA yA se likhiYe niYeche; egulo sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra kAche pATha karA haYa|
vala, ‘yini AsamAna o yamInera rahasya jAnena tini eTi nAyila karechena; nizcaYa tini atIva kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’
Ara tArA vale, ‘e rAsUlera kI hala, se AhAra kare evaM hATe-vAjAre calApherA kare; tAra kAche ekajana pherezatA pAThAno hala nA kena, ye tA~ra sAthe satarkakArI hata’?
athavA tAke dhanabhAnDAra Dhele deYA haYa nA kena athavA tAra janya ekaTi vAgAna haYa nA kena yA theke se khete pAre?’ yAlimarA vale, ‘tomarA zudhu eka yAdugrasta lokera anusaraNa karacha’|
dekha, tomAra janya tArA kemana upamA peza kare; phale tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche, sutarAM tArA kona patha pete sakSama haYa nA|
tini varakatamaYa, yini icchA karale tomAra janya kare dite pArena tAra ceYe uttama vastta aneka vAgAna, yAra pAdadeze nadIsamUha pravAhita haYa evaM tini tomAke prAsAdasamUha dite pArena|
varaM tArA kiYAmatake asvIkAra kareche Ara kiYAmatake ye asvIkAra kare tAra janya Ami prastuta rekhechi jvalanta Aguna|
dUra hate Aguna yakhana tAderake dekhave takhana tArA tAra kruddha garjana o pracanDa citkAra zunate pAve|
Ara yakhana tAderake galAYa hAta pe~ciYe jAhAnnAmera saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have, sekhAne tArA nijadera dhvaMsa AhavAna karave|
‘ekavAra dhvaMsake Deko nA; varaM anekavAra dhvaMsake DAko|’
vala, ‘seTA uttama nA sthAYI jAnnAta, muttAkIderake yAra oYAdA deYA haYeche, tA have tAdera puraskAra o pratAvartanasthala|
sekhAne tArA yA cAive tA-i tAdera janya thAkave sthAYIbhAve; eTi tomAra ravera oYAdA,

Ara sedina tAderake evaM AllAha chAr3A yA kichura upAsanA tArA karata savAike tini ekatra karavena, tArapara valavena, ‘tomarA ki AmAra ei vAndAderake pathabhraSTa karecha’ nA tArA nijerAi pathabhraSTa haYeche?’

tArA valave, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna! Apani chAr3A anya kAuke abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa karA AmAdera ucita naYa, varaM Apani tAderake o tAdera pitRpuruSaderake bhogasambhAra diYechena, avazeSe ApanAra smaraNake tArA bhule giYechila evaM dhvaMsaprApta kaome pariNata haYechila|’
ataHpara tomarA yA vala tArA tA mithyA valeche| ataeva tomarA AyAva pherAte pArave nA evaM kona sAhAyyao karate pArave nA| Ara tomAdera madhye ye yulama karave tAke Ami mahAAyAva AsvAdana karAva|’

Ara tomAra pUrve yata navI Ami pAThiYechi, tArA savAi AhAra karata evaM hATa-vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami tomAdera ekajanake aparajanera janya parIkSAsvarUpa karechi| tomarA ki dhairyadhAraNa karave? Ara tomAra rava sarvadraSTA|

Ara yArA AmAra sAkSAt pratyAzA kare nA, tArA vale, ‘AmAdera nikaTa pherezatA nAyila haYa nA kena? athavA AmarA AmAdera ravake dekhate pAi nA kena’? avazyai tArA to tAdera antare ahaGkAra poSaNa kareche evaM tArA gurutara sImAlaMghana kareche|
yedina tArA pherezatAdera dekhave, sedina aparAdhIdera janya kona susaMvAda thAkave nA| Ara tArA valave, ‘hAYa kona vAdhA yadi tA ATake rAkhata’|
Ara tArA ye kAja kareche Ami sedike agrasara hava| ataHpara tAke vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata kare deva|
sedina jAnnAtavAsIrA vAsasthAna hiseve uttama evaM vizrAmasthala hiseve utkRSTa avasthAYa thAkave|
Ara sedina meghamAlA dvArA AkAza vidIrNa have evaM pherezatAderake dale dale avataraNa karAno have|
sedina prakRta sArvabhaumatva have parama karuNAmaYera| Ara se dinaTi kAphiradera janya var3ai kaThina|
Ara sedina yAlima nijera hAta du’To kAmar3iYe valave, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi rAsUlera sAthe kona patha avalamvana karatAma’!
hAYa AmAra durbhoga, Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma'|
‘avazyai se to AmAke upadezavANI theke vibhrAnta karechila, AmAra kAche tA AsAra para| Ara zaYatAna to mAnuSera janya carama pratAraka’|
Ara rAsUla valave, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa AmAra kaoma e kuraAnake parityAjya gaNya kareche|
Ara ebhAvei Ami pratyeka navIra janya aparAdhIdera madhya theke zatru vAniYechi| Ara pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArI hiseve tomAra ravai yatheSTa|
Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘tAra upara puro kuraAna ekasAthe kena nAyila karA hala nA? eTA ejanya ye, Ami era mAdhyame tomAra hRdaYake sudRr3ha karava| Ara Ami tA AvRtti karechi dhIre dhIre|
Ara tArA tomAra kAche ye kona viSaYai niYe Asuka nA kena, Ami era saThika samAdhAna o sundara vyAkhyA tomAra kAche niYe esechi|
yAderake mukhera upara bhara deYA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike ekatra karA have| erA maryAdAYa adhika nikRSTa evaM pathera dika theke savaceYe vezI pathabhraSTa|
Ara Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAra sAthe tAra bhAi hArUnake sAhAyyakArI vAniYechilAma|
ataHpara Ami valechilAma, tomarA du’jana sei kaomera nikaTa yAo, yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kareche| ataHpara Ami tAderake sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta kare diYechilAma|

Ara nUhera kaomake, yakhana tArA rAsUladerake asvIkAra karala, Ami tAderake DuviYe dilAma evaM tAderake mAnuSera janya nidarzana vAniYe dilAma| Ara Ami yAlimadera janya prastuta kare rekhechi yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara dhvaMsa ‘Ada, sAmUda, ‘rAsa’ era adhivAsI evaM tAdera madhyavartI kAlera vahu prajanmera uparao|
Ara Ami tAdera pratyekera janya dRSTAnta upasthApana karechi evaM tAdera pratyekakei Ami sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare diYechi|
Ara avazyai tArA se janapada diYe atikrama kareche, yAte akalyANera vRSTi varSita haYechila| tave ki tArA tA dekheni? varaM tArA punarutthAnera pratyAzA karata nA|
Ara tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe, takhana tArA tomAke ThATTA-vidrUpera pAtra hisevei grahaNa kare, ‘e-i ki sei loka, yAke AllAha rAsUla kare pAThiYechena’?
‘se to AmAderake AmAdera devatAdera theke dUre sariYe dita, yadi AmarA tAdera prati avicala nA thAkatAma’| Ara yakhana tArA AyAva dekhave, takhana avazyai jAnate pArave ke adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki tAke dekhani, ye tAra pravRttike nijera ilAharUpe grahaNa kareche? tavuo ki tumi tAra yimmAdAra have?
tumi ki mane kara ye, tAdera adhikAMza loka zone athavA vujhe? tArA kevala pazudera mato; varaM tArA Aro adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki tomAra ravake dekhani, kIbhAve tini chAYAke dIrgha karechena, Ara tini yadi cAitena, tAhale tAke avazyai sthira kare dite pAratena| ataHpara Ami sUryake tAra upara nirdezaka vAniYe diYechi|
tArapara Ami eTAke dhIre dhIre AmAra dike guTiYe Ani|
Ara tinii tomAdera janya rAtake AvaraNa o nidrAke ArAmaprada karechena evaM dinake karechena jAgrata thAkAra samaYa|
Ara tinii tA~ra rahamatera prAkkAle susaMvAdasvarUpa vAYu pAThiYechena evaM Ami AkAza theke pavitra pAni varSaNa karechi,
yAte tA dvArA mRta bhU-khanDake jIvita kari evaM Ami ye sakala jIvajantu o mAnuSa sRSTi karechi, tAra madhya theke anekake tA pAna karAi|
Ara Ami tA tAdera madhye vaNTana kari, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa karate pAre; tArapara adhikAMza loka zudhu akRtajJatAi prakAza kare|
Ara Ami icchA karale pratiTi janapade ekajana satarkakArI pAThAtAma|
sutarAM tumi kAphiradera Anugatya karo nA evaM tumi kuraAnera sAhAyye tAdera viruddhe kaThora saMgrAma kara|

Ara tinii du’To sAgarake ekasAthe pravAhita karechena| ekaTi supeYa susvAdu, aparaTi lavaNAkta kSAraviziSTa evaM tini etadobhaYera mAjhakhAne ekaTi antarAYa o ekaTi anatikramya sImAnA sthApana karechena|
Ara tinii pAni theke mAnuSa sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tini tAke vaMzagata o vaivAhika samparkayukta karechena| Ara tomAra rava hala prabhUta kSamatAvAna|
Ara tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kare, yA tAdera kona upakArao karate pAre nA evaM tAdera kona kSatio karate pAre nA| Ara kAphira to tAra ravera viruddhe sAhAyyakArI|
Ara Ami to tomAke zudhumAtra suMsavAdadAtA o satarkakArI rUpei preraNa karechi|
vala, ‘Ami era upara tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAi nA| tave yAra icchA tAra ravera dike patha avalamvana karuka|
Ara tumi bharasA kara emana ciraJjIva sattAra upara yini maravena nA| tA~ra prazaMsAYa tAsavIha pATha kara| tA~ra vAndAdera pApa samparke khavara rAkhAra vyApAre tini yatheSTa|

yini AsamAna, yamIna o ubhaYera madhyavartI savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| tArapara tini Araze uThechena| parama karuNAmaYa| sutarAM tA~ra samparke yini samyaka avahita, tumi tAkei jijJAsA kara|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, tomarA ‘rahamAna’ ke sijadA kara, takhana tArA vale, rahamAna kI AvAra? tumi AmAderake Adeza karalei ki AmarA sijadA karava? Ara eTA tAdera palAYanaparatAi vRddhi kare|[sAjadAha]
varakatamaYa se sattA yini AsamAne sRSTi karechena vizAlakAYa grahasamUha| Ara tAte pradIpa o Alo vikiraNakArI cA~da sRSTi karechena|
Ara tini divA-rAtrike parasparera anugAmI karechena| ye upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa athavA kRtajJa hate cAYa tAra janya|
Ara rahamAnera vAndA tArAi yArA pRthivIte namrabhAve calApherA kare evaM ajJa lokerA yakhana tAderake samvodhana kare takhana tArA vale ‘sAlAma’|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera janya sijadArata o danDAYamAna haYe rAtri yApana kare|
Ara yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, tumi AmAdera theke jAhAnnAmera AyAva phiriYe nAo| nizcaYa era AyAva hala avicchinna’|
‘nizcaYa tA avasthAnasthala o AvAsasthala hiseve atyanta nikRSTa’|
Ara tArA yakhana vyaYa kare takhana apavyaYa kare nA evaM kArpaNyao kare nA| varaM mAjhAmAjhi avasthAne thAke|

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake DAke nA evaM yArA AllAha ye nAphasake hatyA karA niSedha karechena yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A tAke hatyA kare nA| Ara yArA vyabhicAra kare nA| Ara ye tA karave se AyAvaprApta have|
kiYAmatera dina tAra AyAva vardhita karA have evaM sekhAne se apamAnita avasthAYa sthAYI have|
tave ye tAovA kare, ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare| pariNAme AllAha tAdera pApaguloke pUNya dvArA parivartana kare devena| AllAha atIva kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara ye tAovA kare evaM satkAja kare tave nizcaYa se paripUrNabhAve AllAhara dike pratyAvartana kare|
Ara yArA mithyAra sAkSya haYa nA evaM yakhana tArA anarthaka kathA-karmera pAza diYe cale takhana sasammAne cale yAYa|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUha smaraNa kariYe dile andha o vadhiradera mata par3e thAke nA|
Ara yArA vale, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake emana strI o santAnAdi dAna karuna yArA AmAdera cakSu zItala karave| Ara Apani AmAderake muttAkIdera netA vAniYe dina’|
tArAi, yAderake [jAnnAte] suucca kakSa pratidAna hisAve deYA have yehetu tArA savara karechila sejanya| Ara tAdera sekhAne abhyarthanA karA have abhivAdana o sAlAma dvArA|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| avasthAnasthala o AvAsasthala hiseve tA katainA utkRSTa!
vala, ‘yadi tomarA nA-i DAka tAhale AmAra rava tomAdera kona paraoYA karena nA| tArapara tomarA asvIkAra karecha| tAi acirei aparihArya have AyAva|
tva-sIna-mIma|
egulo suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
tArA mumina have nA vale haYata tumi AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
Ami icchA karale AsamAna theke tAdera upara emana nidarzana avatIrNa karatAma phale tAra prati tAdera ghAr3agulo nata haYe yeta|
Ara yakhanai tAdera kAche parama karuNAmaYera pakSa theke kona natuna upadeza Ase takhanai tArA tA theke vimukha haYa|
ataeva avazyai tArA asvIkAra kareche| kAjei tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata, tAra saMvAda acirei tAdera kAche ese par3ave|
tArA ki yamInera prati lakSa kareni? Ami tAte pratyeka prakArera vahu utkRSTa udbhida udagata karechi|
nizcaYa ete Ache nidarzana, Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mumina naYa|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini to mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava mUsAke Deke valalena, ‘tumi yAlima sampradAYera kAche yAo’|
‘phira‘Aunera sampradAYera kAche| tArA ki bhaYa karave nA’?
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Ami avazyai AzaGkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke asvIkAra karave’|
‘Ara AmAra vakSa saGkucita haYe yAcche| AmAra jihavA calache nA| sutarAM Apani hArunera prati ohI pAThAna’|
‘Ara AmAra viruddhe tAdera kAche ekaTi aparAdhera abhiyoga raYeche| phale Ami AzaGkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke hatyA kare phelave’|
AllAha valalena, ‘kakhano naYa| tomarA ubhaYe AmAra nidarzanAdisaha yAo| avazyai Ami Achi tomAdera sAthe zravaNakArI’|
‘sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe phira‘Aunera kAche giYe vala, nizcaYa AmarA vizvajagatera ravera rAsUla’|
‘yAte tumi vanI isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe pAThAo’|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘AmarA ki tomAke zaizave AmAdera mAjhe lAlana pAlana karini? Ara tumi tomAra jIvanera aneka vachara AmAdera madhye avasthAna karecha’|
‘Ara tumi tomAra karma yA karAra tA karecha evaM tumi akRtajJadera antarbhukta’|
mUsA valala, ‘Ami eTi takhana karechilAma, yakhana Ami chilAma vibhrAnta’|
‘ataHpara yakhana Ami tomAderake bhaYa karalAma, takhana Ami tomAdera theke pAliYe gelAma| tArapara AmAra rava AmAke prajJA dAna karalena evaM AmAke rAsUladera antarbhukta karalena’|
‘Ara ei to se anugraha yAra kho~TA tumi AmAke diccha ye, tumi vanI isarAIlake dAsa vAniYe rekhecha’|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘sRSTikulera rava ke?’
mUsA valala, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM etadobhaYera madhyavartI savakichura rava, yadi tomarA nizcita vizvAsI haYe thAka|’
phira‘Auna tAra AzepAze yArA chila tAderake valala, ‘tomarA ki manoyogasaha zunacha nA’?
mUsA valala, ‘tini tomAdera rava evaM tomAdera pitRpuruSaderao rava’|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘tomAdera kAche prerita tomAdera ei rAsUla nizcaYai pAgala’|
mUsA valala, ‘tini pUrva o pazcima evaM etadobhaYera madhyavartI savakichura rava, yadi tomarA vujhe thAka’|
phira‘Auna valala, ‘yadi tumi AmAke chAr3A kAuke ilAharUpe grahaNa kara, tAhale avazyai Ami tomAke kaYedIdera antarbhukta karava’|
mUsA valala, ‘yadi Ami tomAra kAche spaSTa kona viSaYa niYe Asi, tavuo’?
phira‘Auna valala, ‘tumi satyavAdI haYe thAkale tA niYe eso’|
ataHpara se tAra lAThi phele dila, phale tatkSaNAt tA ekaTi spaSTa ajagara haYe gela|
Ara se tAra hAta vera karala, phale tA tatkSaNAt darzakadera sAmane ujjvala-sAdA haYe dekhA dila|
phira‘Auna tAra AzapAzera pAriSadadera uddezye valala, ‘e to eka vijJa yAdukara|’
‘se tomAderake tAra yAdura mAdhyame tomAdera deza theke vera karate cAYa| ataeva, tomarA AmAke kI parAmarza dAo?’
tArA valala, ‘tAke o tAra bhAike kichu samaYera janya avakAza dAo, Ara saMgrahakArIderake nagare-nagare pAThiYe dAo|’
‘tArA tomAra nikaTa pratyeka vijJa yAdukarake niYe Asuka’|
ataHpara eka nirdhArita dinera nirdiSTa samaYe yAdukaradera ekatra karA hala|
Ara lokadera valA hala, ‘tomarA ki samaveta have?’
‘yAte AmarA yAdukaradera anusaraNa karate pAri, yadi tArA vijaYI haYa’|
ataHpara yakhana yAdukararA Asala,tArA phira‘Aunake valala,‘yadi AmarAi vijaYI hai, tave AmAdera janya ki satyii puraskAra Ache?’
se valala, ‘hyA~ evaM nizcaYa tomarA takhana AmAra ghaniSTajanadera antarbhukta have’|
mUsA tAdera valala, ‘tomarA yA nikSepa karAra tA nikSepa kara’|
ataHpara tArA tAdera razi o lAThi nikSepa karala evaM valala, ‘phira‘Aunera maryAdAra kasama! avazyai AmarA vijaYI hava|’
tArapara mUsA tAra lAThi phelala, phale tatkSaNAt tA tAdera mithyA pradarzanIgulo grAsa kare phelala|
phale yAdukararA sijadAvanata haYe par3ala|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma sakala sRSTira ravera prati’|
‘mUsA o hArunera rava’|

phira‘Auna valala, ‘Ami tomAderake anumati deYAra pUrvei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYa se tomAdera guru ye tomAdera yAdu zikSA diYeche| ataeva acirei tomarA jAnate pArave| Ami avazyai tomAdera hAtasamUha o tomAdera pAsamUha viparIta dika theke keTe phelava evaM avazyai tomAdera sakalake zUlividdha karava’|
tArA valala, ‘kona kSati nei tAte| avazyai AmarA to AmAdera ravera dikei phire yAva|’
‘AmarA AzA kari ye, AmAdera rava AmAdera aparAdhasamUha kSamA kare devena, kAraNa AmarA muminadera madhye prathama|’
Ara Ami mUsAra prati e marme ohI pAThiYechilAma ye, ‘AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAtrikAle yAtrA zuru kara, nizcaYai tomAdera pichu neYA have|’
ataHpara phira‘Auna nagare- nagare ekatrakArIderake pAThAla|
‘nizcaYai erA to kSudra ekaTi dala|’
‘Ara erA avazyai AmAdera krodhera udreka ghaTiYeche|’
‘Ara AmarA savAi to yatheSTa satarka|’
tArapara Ami tAderake udyAnamAlA o jharNAdhArAsamUha theke vera kare AnalAma|
Ara dhanabhAnDAra o maryAdApUrNa avasthAna theke|
erUpai evaM Ami vanI isarAIlake esavera oYArisa vAniYechilAma|
tArapara tArA sUryodaYera prAkkAle tAdera pichu nila|
ataHpara yakhana ubhaYa dala parasparake dekhala, takhana mUsAra sAthIrA valala, avazyai ‘AmarA dharA par3e gelAma!’
mUsA valala, ‘kakSano naYa; AmAra sAthe AmAra rava raYechena| nizcaYa acirei tini AmAke pathanirdeza devena’|
ataHpara Ami mUsAra prati ohI pAThAlAma, ‘tomAra lAThi dvArA samudre AghAta kara|’ phale tA vibhakta haYe gela| tArapara pratyeka bhAga vizAla pAhAr3asadRza haYe gela|
Ara Ami apara dalaTike sei jAYagAYa nikaTavartI karalAma,
Ara Ami mUsA o tAra sAthe yArA chila sakalake uddhAra karalAma,
tArapara apara dalaTike DuviYe dilAma|
nizcaYa era madhye raYeche nidarzana| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mumina naYa|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ara tumi tAdera nikaTa ivarAhImera ghaTanA varNanA kara,
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra kaomake valechila, ‘tomarA kisera ivAdAta kara?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA mUrtira pUjA kari| ataHpara egulora pUjAYa AmarA niSThAra sAthe rata thAki’|
se valala, ‘yakhana tomarA DAka takhana tArA ki tomAdera se DAka zunate pAYa?’
‘athavA tArA ki tomAdera upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre’?
tArA valala, ‘varaM AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSadera peYechi, tArA erUpai karata’|
ivarAhIma valala, ‘tomarA ki tAdera samparke bheve dekhecha, tomarA yAdera pUjA kara’|
‘tomarA evaM tomAdera atIta pitRpuruSerA?’
‘sakala sRSTira rava chAr3A avazyai tArA AmAra zatru’|
‘yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tinii AmAke hidAYAta diYechena|’
‘Ara yini AmAke khAoYAna evaM pAna karAna’|
‘Ara yakhana Ami asustha hai, takhana yini AmAke Arogya karena’|
‘Ara yini AmAra mRtyu ghaTAvena tArapara AmAke jIvita karavena’|
‘Ara yini AzA kari, vicAra divase AmAra truTi-vicyuti kSamA kare devena’|
‘he AmAra rava, AmAke prajJA dAna karuna evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera sAthe zAmila kare dina’|
‘evaM paravartIdera madhye AmAra sunAma-sukhyAti avyAhata rAkhuna’,
‘Ara Apani AmAke sukhamaYa jAnnAtera oYArisadera antarbhukta karuna’|
‘Ara AmAra pitAke kSamA karuna; nizcaYa se pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta chila’|
‘Ara yedina punarutthita karA have sedina AmAke lAJchita karavena nA’|
‘yedina dhana-sampada o santAna-santati kona upakAre Asave nA’|
‘tave ye AllAhara kAche Asave sustha antare’|
Ara muttAkIdera janya jAnnAta nikaTavartI karA have,
evaM pathabhraSTakArIdera janya jAhAnnAma unmocita karA have|
Ara tAderake valA have, ‘tArA kothAYa yAdera tomarA ivAdAta karate’?
AllAha chAr3A? tArA ki tomAderake sAhAyya karache, nA nijedera sAhAyya karate pArache?
ataHpara tAderake evaM pathabhraSTakArIderake upur3a kare jAhAnnAme nikSepa karA have,
Ara ivalIsera sakala sainyavAhinIke|
sekhAne paraspara jhagar3A karate giYe tArA valave,
AllAhara kasama! AmarA to suspaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa nimajjita chilAma',
‘yakhana AmarA tomAderake sakala sRSTira ravera samakakSa vAnAtAma’|
‘Ara aparAdhIrAi zudhu AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila’;
‘ataeva, AmAdera kona supArizakArI nei’|
‘evaM kona antaraGga vandhuo nei’|
‘hAYa, AmAdera yadi ArekaTi suyoga hata, tave AmarA muminadera arntabhukta hatAma’|
nizcaYa ete raYeche nidarzana, Ara tAdera adhikAMza mumina naYa|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nUha-era kaoma rAsUladerake asvIkAra karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi nUha tAderake valechila, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rAsUla’|
‘sutarAM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘Ara era upara Ami tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA; AmAra pratidAna zudhu sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa’|
‘sutarAM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki tomAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karava, athaca nimnazreNIra lokerA tomAke anusaraNa karache’?
nUha valala, ‘tArA ki kare tA jAnA AmAra kI praYojana’?
‘tAdera hisAva grahaNa to kevala AmAra ravera dAYitve, yadi tomarA jAnate’|
‘Ara Ami to muminaderake tAr3iYe deYAra nai’|
‘Ami to kevala suspaSTa satarkakArI’|
tArA valala, ‘he nUha, tumi yadi virata nA hao tave avazyai tumi prastarAghAte nihatadera antarbhukta have’|
nUha valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAra kaoma AmAke asvIkAra kareche’;
‘sutarAM Apani AmAra o tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare dina Ara AmAke o AmAra sAthe yesava mumina, Ache tAderake rakSA karuna’|
ataHpara Ami tAke evaM tAra sAthe yArA vojhAi naukAYa chila tAderake nAjAta dilAma|
tArapara vAkIdera DuviYe dilAma|
nizcaYa ete raYeche nidarzana, Ara tAdera vezIra bhAga mumina chila nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
‘Ada jAti rAsUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila,
yakhana tAdera bhAi hUda tAderake valechila, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rAsUla’|
‘sutarAM AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘Ara era upara Ami tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA; AmAra pratidAna kevala sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa’|
‘tomarA ki pratiTi u~cu sthAne vehudA stambha nirmANa karacha’?
‘Ara tomarA sudRr3ha prAsAda nirmANa karacha, yena tomarA sthAYI have’|
‘Ara tomarA yakhana kAuke pAkar3Ao kara, pAkar3Ao kara svecchAcArI haYe’|
‘sutarAM AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke anusaraNa kara’|
Ara tA~ke bhaYa kara yini tomAderake sAhAyya karechena emana kichu diYe, yA tomarA jAna'|
‘tini tomAderake sAhAyya karechena catuSpada jantu o santAna-santati dvArA’,
‘Ara udyAna o jharNA dvArA’|
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera upara eka mahAdivasera AyAvera bhaYa karachi’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAdera upadeza dAo athavA nA dAo, ubhaYai AmAdera janya samAna’|
‘eTi to pUrvavartIderai caritra,|
‘Ara AmarA AyAvaprAptadera antarbhukta hava nA’|
ataHpara tArA tAke asvIkAra karala, phale tAderake Ami dhvaMsa kare dilAma; nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche| Ara tAdera adhikAMza mumina chila nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava tini mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
sAmUda jAti rAsuladerake asvIkAra karechila,
yakhana tAdera bhAi sAliha tAderake valechila, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla’;
‘sutarAM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘Ara era upara Ami tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA; AmAra pratidAna kevala sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa’|
‘tomAderake ki ekhAne yA Ache tAte nirApade cher3e deYA have’?
‘udyAna o jharNAYa’,
‘Ara kSeta-khAmAra o komala zISaviziSTa khejura vAgAne’?
‘Ara tomarA naipuNyera sAthe pAhAr3a keTe vAr3I nirmANa karacha’|
‘sutarAM AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘evaM sImAlaMghanakArIdera nirdezera Anugatya karo nA’-
‘yArA pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi kare evaM zAnti sthApana kare nA’|
tArA valala, ‘tumito yAdugrastadera ekajana|
‘tumi to kevala AmAdera mata mAnuSa, sutarAM tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tave kona nidarzana niYe eso’|
sAliha valala, ‘eTi ekaTi uSTrI; tAra janya pAni pAnera pAlA ekadina Ara tomAdera pAni pAnera pAlA Areka nirdiSTa dine’|
‘Ara tomarA tAke kona aniSTa kichu karo nA; yadi kara tave eka mahAdivasera AyAva tomAderake peYe vasave’|
ataHpara tArA seTi javeha karala; phale tArA anutapta hala|
ataeva AyAva tAderake pAkar3Ao karala, nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche, Ara tAdera adhikAMza mumina chila nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
lUtera sampradAYa rAsUladerake asvIkAra karechila|
yakhana tAderake tAdera bhAi lUta valechila, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla’|
‘sutarAM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘Ara Ami era upara tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna kevala sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa’|
‘sRSTikulera madhye tomarA ki kevala puruSadera sAthe upagata hao’?
‘Ara tomAdera rava tomAdera janya ye strIdera sRSTi karechena tAderake tomarA tyAga kara, varaM tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa’|
tArA valala, ‘he lUta, tumi yadi virata nA hao, tAhale tumi avazyai vahiskRtadera antarbhukta have’|
lUta valala, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera kAjake ghRNA kari’|
‘he AmAra rava, tArA yA karache, tA theke AmAke o AmAra parivAra-parijanake tumi rakSA kara’|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivAra-parijana savAike rakSA karalAma|
pechane avasthAnakAriNI eka vRddhA chAr3A|
tArapara anyaderake Ami dhvaMsa kare dilAma|
Ara Ami tAdera upara zilAvRSTi varSaNa karalAma| sutarAM sei vRSTi bhaYa pradarzitadera janya katainA manda chila!
nizcaYa ete eka nidarzana raYeche| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mumina chila nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, tini to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
AikAra adhivAsIrA rAsUladerake asvIkAra karechila|
yakhana zu‘Aiva tAderake valala, ‘tomarA ki tAkaoYA avalamvana karave nA’?
‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla’|
‘sutarAM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘Ara Ami era upara tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna kevala sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa’|
‘mApa pUrNa kare dAo evaM yArA mApe ghATati kare, tomarA tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA’|
‘Ara saThika dA~r3i pAllAYa ojana kara’|
Ara lokaderake tAdera prApyavastu kama dio nA evaM yamIne phAsAda sRSTi karo nA'|
‘yini tomAderake o pUrvavartI prajanmasamUhake sRSTi karechena, tA~ra tAkaoYA avalamvana kara’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi to kevala yAdugrastadera antarbhukta’|
‘tumi kevala AmAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa| Ara AmarA tomAke avazyai mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta vale mane kari’|
‘ataeva, tumi yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AsamAna theke eka Tukaro AmAdera upara phele dAo’|
se valala, ‘tomarA yA kara, se samparke AmAra rava adhika jJAta’|
ataHpara tArA tAke asvIkAra karala| phale tAderake eka meghAcchanna divasera AyAva pAkar3Ao karala| avazyai tA chila eka mahA divasera AyAva|
nizcaYa ete aneka nidarzana raYeche| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mumina chila nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava tini to mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ara nizcaYa e kuraAna sRSTikulera raverai nAyilakRta|
vizvasta AtmA* eTA niYe avataraNa kareche| * ekhAne 'vizvasta AtmA'dvArA jivarIla (A:) ke vujhAno haYeche|
tomAra hRdaYe, yAte tumi satarkakArIdera antarbhukta hao|
suspaSTa AravI bhASAYa|
Ara avazyai tA raYeche pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhe|
eTA ki tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana naYa ye, vanI isarAIlera panDitagaNa tA jAne?
Ara Ami yadi eTAke kona anAravera prati nAyila karatAma|
ataHpara se tA tAdera nikaTa pATha karata| tavuo tArA ete mumina hata nA|
ebhAvei Ami viSaYaTi aparAdhIdera antare saJcAra karechi|
yatakSaNa nA tArA yantraNAdAYaka AyAva pratyakSa karave, tatakSaNa paryanta tArA ete ImAna Anave nA|
sutarAM tA AkasmikabhAve tAdera nikaTa ese par3ave, athaca tArA upaladdhi karate pArave nA|
takhana tArA valave, ‘AmAderake ki avakAza deYA have?’
tAhale ki tArA AmAra AyAva tvarAnvita karate cAYa?
tumi ki lakSya karecha, Ami yadi tAderake dIrghakAla bhoga-vilAsera suyoga ditAma|
ataHpara tAderake ye viSaYe oYAdA karA haYeche, tA tAdera nikaTa ese par3ata,
takhana yA tAdera bhoga-vilAsera janya deYA haYechila, tA tAdera konai kAje Asata nA|
Ara Ami emana kona janapadake dhvaMsa karini, yAte kona satarkakArI Aseni|
eTA upadezasvarUpa; Ara Ami yAlimadera antarbhukta chilAma nA|
Ara zaYatAnarA tA niYe avataraNa kareni|
Ara eTA tAdera janya ucit naYa evaM tArA era kSamatAo rAkhe nA|
nizcaYai tAderake era zravaNa theke Ar3Ale rAkhA haYeche|
ataeva, tumi AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAhake Deko nA, tAhale tumi AyAvaprAptadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
Ara tumi tomAra nikaTAtmIYaderake satarka kara|
Ara muminadera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa kare, tAdera prati tumi tomAra vAhuke avanata kara|
tArapara yadi tArA tomAra avAdhya haYa, tAhale vala, ‘tomarA yA kara, nizcaYa Ami tA theke sampUrNa mukta’|
‘Ara tumi mahAparAkramazAlI parama daYAlura upara tAoYAkkula kara,
‘yini tomAke dekhena yakhana tumi danDAYamAna hao’
‘evaM sijadAkArIdera madhye tomAra uThAvasA’|
‘nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI’|
‘Ami ki tomAderake saMvAda deva, kAra nikaTa zaYatAnarA avatIrNa haYa’?
tArA avatIrNa haYa pratyeka carama mithyAvAdI o pApIra nikaTa|
tArA kAna pete thAke evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
Ara vibhrAntarAi kavidera anusaraNa kare|
tumi ki lakSya karo ni ye, tArA pratyeka upatyakAYa udabhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa?
Ara nizcaYa tArA emana kathA vale, yA tArA kare nA|

tave yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkarma kareche, Ara AllAhake aneka smaraNa kareche| Ara tArA niryAtita haoYAra para pratizodha neYa| Ara yAlimarA zIghrai jAnate pArave kon pratyAvartana sthale tArA pratyAvartana karave|
tva-sIna; egulo Ala-kuraAna o suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
muminadera janya hidAYAta o susaMvAda|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM yAkAta deYa| Ara tArAi AkhirAtera prati nizcita vizvAsa rAkhe|
nizcaYa yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA Ami tAdera janya tAdera AmalasamUhake suzobhita kare diYechi| phale tArA vibhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa|
edera janyai raYeche nikRSTa AyAva| Ara erAi AkhirAte sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
Ara nizcaYa tumi prajJAmaYa mahAjJAnIra pakSa theke Ala-kuraAnaprApta|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valala, nizcaYa Ami Aguna dekhechi| zIghrai Ami sekhAna theke tomAdera janya kona khavara niYe Asava athavA tomAdera janya jvalanta AGgAra niYe Asava| yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|
tArapara se yakhana sekhAne ese pau~chala, takhana Deke valA hala, ‘varakatamaYa yA e Alora madhye o era cArapAze Ache| Ara sRSTikulera rava AllAha mahApavitra, mahimAnvita’|
he mUsA, nizcaYa Amii AllAha, mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|

Ara tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara| tArapara yakhana se oTAke sApera mata choTAchuTi karate dekhala, takhana se pechanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM phire tAkAla nA| ‘he mUsA! tumi bhaYa karo nA, nizcaYa AmAra kAche rAsUlagaNa bhaYa pAYa nA’|
‘tave ye yul‌ma kare| tArapara asatkAjera parivarte satkAja kare, tave avazyai Ami adhika kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

‘Ara tumi tomAra hAta vagale praveza karAo, tA doSamukta zubhra avasthAYa vera haYe Asave| phira‘Auna o tAra sampradAYera kAche AnIta naYaTi nidarzanera antarbhukta| nizcaYa tArA chila phAsika sampradAYa’|
tArapara yakhana AmAra nidarzanagulo dRzyamAna haYe tAdera kAche Asala, takhana tArA valala, eTA to suspaSTa yAdu|
Ara tArA anyAYa o uddhatabhAve nidarzanaguloke pratyAkhyAna karala| athaca tAdera antara tA nizcita vizvAsa karechila| ataeva dekha, phAsAda sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila|
Ara avazyai Ami dAUda o sulAimAnake jJAna dAna karechi evaM tArA ubhaYe valala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janyai, yini tA~ra aneka mumina vAndAdera upara AmAderake maryAdA dAna karechena’|
Ara sulAimAna dAUdera oYArisa hala evaM se valala, ‘he mAnuSa, AmAderake pAkhira bhASA zekhAno haYeche evaM AmAderake sakala kichu deYA haYeche| nizcaYa eTA suspaSTa anugraha’|
Ara sulAimAnera janya tAra senAvAhinI theke jina, mAnuSa o pAkhidera samaveta karA hala| tArapara ederake vinyasta karA hala|

avazeSe yakhana tArA pipar3Ara upatyakAYa pau~chala takhana eka pipar3A valala, ‘ohe pipar3Ara dala, tomarA tomAdera vAsasthAne praveza kara| sulAimAna o tAra vAhinI tomAderake yena ajJAtasAre piSTa kare mArate nA pAre’|

tArapara sulAimAna tAra kathAYa mucaki hAsala evaM valala, ‘he AmAra rava, tumi AmAra prati o AmAra pitA-mAtAra prati ye anugraha karecha tAra janya AmAke tomAra zukariYA AdAYa karAra tAophIka dAo| Ara Ami yAte emana satkAja karate pAri yA tumi pachanda kara| Ara tomAra anugrahe tumi AmAke tomAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAdera antarbhukta kara’|
Ara sulAimAna pAkhidera kho~ja khavara nila| tArapara se valala, ‘kI vyApAra, Ami hudahudake dekhachi nA; nAki se anupasthitadera antarbhukta’?
‘avazyai Ami tAke kaThina AyAva deva athavA tAke yaveha karava| athavA se AmAra kAche suspaSTa pramANa niYe Asave’|
tArapara anativilamve hudahuda ese valala, ‘Ami yA avagata haYechi Apani tA avagata nana, Ami sAvA theke ApanAra janya nizcita khavara niYe esechi’|
‘Ami eka nArIke dekhate pelAma, se tAdera upara rAjatva karache| tAke deYA haYeche sava kichu| Ara tAra Ache eka vizAla siMhAsana’|

‘Ami tAke o tAra kaomake dekhate pelAma tArA AllAhara parivarte sUryake sijadA karache| Ara zaYatAna tAdera kAryAvalIke tAdera janya saundaryamanDita kare diYeche evaM tAderake satpatha theke nivRta kareche, phale tArA hidAYAta pAYa nA’|
yAte tArA AllAhake sijadA nA kare, yini AsamAna o yamInera lukAYita vastuke vera karena| Ara tomarA yA gopana kara evaM tomarA yA prakAza kara tini savai jAnena|
AllAha chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| tini mahA Arazera rava|[sAjadAha]
sulAimAna valala, AmarA dekhava, ‘tumi ki satya valecha, nAki tumi mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta’|
‘tumi AmAra e patra niYe yAo| ataHpara eTA tAdera kAche nikSepa kara, tArapara tAdera kAcha theke sare thAka evaM dekha, tArA kI javAva deYa’?
se (rANI) valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga! nizcaYa AmAke eka sammAnajanaka patra deYA haYeche’|
‘nizcaYa eTA sulAimAnera pakSa theke| Ara nizcaYa eTA parama karuNAmaYa parama daYAlu AllAhara nAme’|
yAte tomarA AmAra prati uddhata nA hao evaM anugata haYe AmAra kAche Asa'|
se (rANI) valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, tomarA AmAra vyApAre AmAke abhimata dAo| tomAdera upasthiti chAr3A Ami kona viSaYe cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA zaktizAlI o kaThora yoddhA, Ara siddhAnta ApanAra kAchei| ataeva cintA kare dekhuna, Apani kI nirdeza devena’|
se valala, ‘nizcaYa rAjA-vAdazAharA yakhana kona janapade praveza kare takhana tAke viparyasta kare evaM sekhAnakAra sammAnita adhivAsIderake apadastha kare| Ara tA-i tArA karave’|
‘Ara nizcaYa Ami tAdera kAche upaDhaukana pAThAcchi, tArapara dekhi dUterA kI niYe phire Ase’|

ataHpara dUta yakhana sulAimAnera kAche Asala, takhana se valala, ‘tomarA ki AmAke sampada dvArA sAhAyya karate cAccha? sutarAM AllAha AmAke yA diYechena tA tomAderake yA diYechena tA theke uttama| varaM tomarA tomAdera upaDhaukana niYe khuzi hao’|

‘tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAo| tArapara Ami avazyai tAdera kAche emana sainyavAhinI niYe Asava yAra mukAvilA karAra zakti tAdera nei| Ara Ami avazyai tAderake sekhAna theke lAJchita avasthAYa vera kare deva Ara tArA apamAnita|’
sulAimAna valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, tArA AmAra kAche AtmasamarpaNa kare AsAra pUrve tomAdera madhye ke tAra (rANIra) siMhAsana AmAra kAche niYe Asate pArave’?
eka zaktizAlI jina valala, ‘Apani ApanAra sthAna theke uThAra pUrvei Ami tA ene deva| Ami nizcaYai ei vyApAre zaktimAna, vizvasta|

yAra kAche kitAvera eka vizeSa jJAna chila se valala, ‘Ami cokhera palaka par3Ara pUrvei tA ApanAra kAche niYe Asava’| ataHpara yakhana sulAimAna tA tAra sAmane sthira dekhate pela, takhana valala, ‘eTi AmAra ravera anugraha, yAte tini AmAke parIkSA karena ye, Ami ki kRtajJatA prakAza kari nA ki akRtajJatA prakAza kari| Ara ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare se to tAra nijera kalyANei tA kare, Ara ye keu akRtajJa have, tave nizcaYa AmAra rava abhAvamukta, adhika dAtA’|
sulAimAna valala, ‘tomarA tAra janya tAra siMhAsanera AkAra-AkRti parivartana kare dAo| dekhava se saThika dizA pAYa nAki tAdera antarbhukta haYe par3e, yArA saThika dizA pAYa nA’|

ataHpara yakhana se Asala, takhana tAke valA hala; ‘erUpai ki tomAra siMhAsana’? se valala, ‘eTi yena seTii’| Ara valala, ‘AmAderake tAra pUrvei jJAna dAna karA haYechila evaM AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechilAma’|
Ara AllAhake vAda diYe yAra pUjA se karata tA tAke ImAna theke nivRtta karechila| nizcaYa se chila kAphira sampradAYera antarbhukta|

tAke valA hala, ‘prAsAdaTite praveza kara’| ataHpara yakhana se tA dekhala, se tAke eka gabhIra jalAzaYa dhAraNA karala, evaM tAra pAYera gochAdvaYa anAvRta karala| sulAimAna valala, ‘eTi Asale svaccha kA~ca-nirmita prAsAda’| se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa Ami AmAra nijera prati yulama karechi| Ami sulAimAnera sAthe sRSTikulera rava AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karalAma’|
Ara avazyai Ami sAmUda sampradAYera nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihake pAThiYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| ataHpara tArA du’dale vibhakta haYe vitarka karachila|
se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA kalyANera pUrve kena akalyANake tarAnvita karate cAicha? kena tomarA AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karacha nA yena tomAderake rahamata karA haYa’?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA tumi o tomAra sAthe yArA Ache tAderake azubha mane karachi’| se valala, ‘tomAdera azubha AllAhara nikaTa| varaM tomarA emana eka kaoma yAdera parIkSA karA hacche’|
Ara sei zahare chila naYa netRsthAnIYa vyakti| yArA yamIne phAsAda sRSTi karata evaM saMskAra-saMzodhanamUlaka kichu karata nA|

tArA valala, ‘tomarA paraspara AllAhara kasama kara ye, AmarA rAtrikAle tAra o tAra parivArera upara avazyai AkramaNa karava, ataHpara AmarA tAra nikaTAtmIYadera valava, AmarA tAra parivAravargera hatyAkAnDa pratyakSa karini| Ara nizcaYai AmarA satyavAdI’|
Ara tArA eka cakrAnta karala evaM Amio kauzala avalamvana karalAma| athaca tArA upaladdhio karate pArala nA|
ataeva dekha, tAdera cakrAntera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche| Ami tAdera o tAdera kaomake ekatre dhvaMsa kare diYechi|
sutarAM aigulo tAdera vAr3Ighara, yA tAdera yulamera kAraNe virAna haYe Ache| nizcaYa era madhye nidarzana raYeche se kaomera janya yArA jJAna rAkhe|
Ara Ami muminadera mukti dilAma evaM tArA chila tAkaoYA avalamvanakArI|
Ara smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, yakhana se tAra kaomake valechila, ‘tomarA kena azlIla kAja karacha, athaca tA tomarA bhAlabhAve pratyakSa karacha’?
‘tomarA ki nArIdera vAda diYe puruSadera upara kAmatRptira janya upagata have? varaM tomarA emana eka kaoma yArA jAne nA’|
phale tAra kaomera javAva ekamAtra ei chila ye, ‘lUtera parivArake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| nizcaYa erA emana loka yArA pavitra thAkate cAYa’|
ataeva Ami mukti dilAma tAke o tAra parivArake, tave tAra strIke chAr3A| Ami tAke dhvaMsaprAptadera madhye sAvyasta kare rekhechilAma|
Ami tAdera upara muSaladhAre (pAtharera) vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma| bhIti pradarzitadera janya katainA nikRSTa chila ei vRSTi!
vala, ‘sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara nimitte| Ara zAnti tA~ra vAndAdera prati yAdera tini manonIta karechena| AllAha zreSTha, nA ki yAdera erA zarIka kare tArA’?

varaM tini (zreSTha), yini AsamAnasamUha o yamInake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya tini AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karena| ataHpara tA dvArA Ami manorama udyAna sRSTi kari| tAra vRkSAdi utpanna karAra kSamatA tomAdera nei| AllAhara sAthe ki anya kona ilAha Ache? varaM tArA emana eka kaoma yArA ziraka kare|

varaM tini, yini yamInake AvAsayogya karechena evaM tAra madhye pravAhita karechena nadI-nAlA| Ara tAte sthApana karechena sudRr3ha parvatamAlA evaM dui samudrera madhyakhAne antarAYa sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sAthe ki anya kona ilAha Ache? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

varaM tini, yini nirupAYera AhavAne sAr3A dena evaM vipada dUrIbhUta karena evaM tomAderake yamInera pratinidhi vAnAna| AllAhara sAthe ki anya kona ilAha Ache? tomarA kamai upadeza grahaNa kare thAka|

varaM tini, yini tomAderake sthale o samudrera andhakAre patha dekhAna evaM yini svIYa rahamatera prAkkAle susaMvAdavAhI vAtAsa preraNa karena| AllAhara sAthe ki anya kona ilAha Ache? tArA yA kichu zarIka kare AllAha tA theke Urdhve|

varaM tini, yini sRSTira sUcanA karena, tArapara tAra punarAvRtti karavena evaM yini tomAderake AsamAna o yamIna theke riyika dAna karena, AllAhara sAthe ki kona ilAha Ache? vala, ‘tomAdera pramANa niYe eso yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|’
vala, ‘AllAha chAr3A AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne yArA Ache tArA gAYeva jAne nA| Ara kakhana tAderake punarutthita karA have tA tArA anubhava karate pAre nA’|
varaM AkhirAta samparke tAdera jJAna niHzeSa haYeche| varaM se viSaYe tArA sandehe Ache; varaM e vyApAre tArA andha|
Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘AmarA o AmAdera pitRpuruSarA mATi haYe yAva takhano ki AmAderake utthita karA have’?
itopUrve AmAderake o AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake e viSaYe oYAdA deYA haYechila, ‘eTi prAcIna lokadera upakathA chAr3A kichui naYa’|
vala, ‘tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara, tArapara dekha, kirUpa haYechila aparAdhIdera pariNati|’
Ara tAdera janya duHkha karo nA evaM tArA ye Sar3ayantra kare tAte manakSuNNa haYo nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘tomarA satyavAdI hale (vala) ei oYAdA kakhana Asave’?
vala, ‘AzA karA yAYa, tomarA ye viSaYe tAr3Ahur3A karacha tAra kichu acirei have’|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu tAdera vezIra bhAgai zukariYA AdAYa kare nA|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra rava, avazyai jAnena tAdera antara yA gopana kare evaM yA tArA prakAza kare|
Ara AsamAna o yamIne emana kona gopana viSaYa nei yA suspaSTa kitAve lipivaddha nei|
nizcaYa e kuraAna tAdera kAche varNanA karache, vanI isarAIla yesava viSaYe vitarka kare tAra adhikAMzai|
Ara nizcaYa eTi muminadera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
nizcaYa tomAra rava nijera vicAra-prajJA dvArA tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena; Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
ataeva AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kara; kAraNa tumi suspaSTa satyera opara adhiSThita Acha|
nizcaYa tumi mRtake zonAte pArave nA, Ara tumi vadhirake AhavAna zonAte pArave nA, yakhana tArA piTha dekhiYe cale yAYa|
Ara tumi andhaderake tAdera bhraSTatA theke hidAYAtakArI nao; tumi kevala tAderake zonAte pArave yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe ImAna Ane, ataHpara tArAi AtmasamarpaNakArI|

Ara yakhana tAdera upara ‘vANI’ (AyAva) vAstavAYita have takhana Ami yamInera jantu (dAvvAtula Arada)* vera karava, ye tAdera sAthe kathA valave| kAraNa mAnuSa AmAra AYAtasamUhe sudRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhata nA| * kiYAmatera anyatama nidarzana hala ‘dAvavAtula Arada’ vera haoYA| imAma Ahamada (ra.) varNanA karechena ye, rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma valechena, dazaTi nidarzana nA dekhA paryanta kiYAmata have nA tanmadhye anyatama hala, dAvavAtula Arada vera haoYA| ivana kAchIra valena, zeSa yAmAnAYa yakhana mAnuSa satkAjera Adeza deve nA, asat kAja hate niSedha karave nA, satya dIna parivartana karave evaM cAradike phitanA-phAsAda char3iYe par3ave takhana ‘dAvvAtula Arada’ vera have|
Ara smaraNa kara sedinera kathA, yedina pratyeka jAtira madhya theke yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata tAderake Ami dale dale samaveta karava| ataHpara tAderake hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have|
avazeSe yakhana tArA Asave, takhana AllAha valavena, ‘tomarA ki AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechile, athaca se viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAnai chila nA? nAki tomarA Aro kI karechile?’
Ara tAdera upara vANI (AyAva) vAstavAYita have| kAraNa tArA yulama karechila| phale tArA kathA valate pArave nA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami rAtake sRSTi karechi, yena tArA tAte vizrAma nite pAre evaM dinake karechi Alokita? nizcaYa ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche sei kaomera janya yArA ImAna eneche|
Ara yedina ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have, sedina AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yArA Ache savAi bhIta have; tave AllAha yAderake cAivena tArA chAr3A| Ara savAi tA~ra kAche hIna avasthAYa upasthita have|

Ara tumi pAhAr3asamUke dekhacha, seguloke tumi sthira mane karacha| athaca tA meghamAlAra nyAYa calate thAkave| (eTA) AllAhara kAja, yini sava kichu dRr3habhAve karechena| nizcaYa tomarA yA kara, tini se samparke vizeSabhAve avahita|
ye vyakti satkAja niYe Asave tAra janya thAkave tA theke uttama pratidAna evaM sedinera bhItikara avasthA theke tArA nirApada thAkave|
Ara yArA manda kAja niYe Asave tAderake upur3a kare jAhAnnAme nikSepa karA have; (tAderake valA have) ‘tomarA ye Amala karecha tArai pratidAna tomAderake deYA hala’|

‘AmAke to nirdeza deYA haYeche ei zaharera rava-era ivAdAta karate yini eTike sammAnita karechena era sava kichu tA~rai adhikAre| Ara AmAke nirdeza deYA haYeche, Ami yena musalimadera antarbhukta hai’|
‘Ara Ami yena Ala-kuraAna adhyaYana kari, ataHpara ye hidAYAta lAbha karala se nijera janya hidAYAta lAbha karala; Ara ye pathabhraSTa hala tAke vala, ‘Ami to satarkakArIdera antarbhukta|’
Ara vala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara; acirei tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanasamUha dekhAvena, takhana tomarA tA cinate pArave Ara tomarA yA Amala kara se vyApAre tomAdera rava vekhavara nana|’
tva-sIna-mIma|
egulo suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami tomAra kAche pATha karachi mUsA o phira‘Aunera kichu vRttAnta yathAyathabhAve, emana lokadera janya yArA ImAna Ane|

nizcaYa phira‘Auna (mizara) deze uddhata haYechila evaM tAra adhivAsIke nAnA dale vibhakta karechila| tAdera ekadalake se durvala kare rekhechila, yAdera putraderake se hatyA karata Ara kanyAderake vA~ciYe rAkhata| nizcaYa se chila viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera anyatama|
Ara Ami cAilAma sei deze yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila tAdera prati anugraha karate evaM tAderake netA vAnAte, Ara tAderake uttarAdhikArI vAnAte|
Ara yamIne tAderake kSamatAYa adhiSThita karate evaM phira‘Auna, hAmAna o tAdera sainyaderake dekhiYe dite, yA tArA tAdera kAcha theke AzaGkA karachila|

Ara Ami mUsAra mAYera prati nirdeza pAThAlAma, ‘tumi tAke dudha pAna karAo| ataHpara yakhana tumi tAra vyApAre AzaGkA karave, takhana tAke dariYAYa nikSepa karave| Ara tumi bhaYa karave nA evaM cintA karave nA| nizcaYa Ami tAke tomAra kAche phiriYe deva evaM tAke rAsUladera antarbhukta karava’|
ataHpara phira‘Auna parivAra tAke uThiYe nila, pariNAme se tAdera zatru o duHzcintAra kAraNa have| nizcaYa phira‘Auna, hAmAna o tAdera sainyarA chila aparAdhI|

Ara phira‘Aunera strI valala, ‘e zizuTi AmAra o tomAra cakSu zItalakArI, tAke hatyA karo nA| AzA karA yAYa, se AmAdera kona upakAre Asave| athavA AmarA tAke santAna hiseve grahaNa karate pAri’| athaca tArA upalavdhi karate pAreni|
Ara mUsAra mAYera antara vicalita haYe uThechila| se to tAra paricaYa prakAza karei dita, yadi Ami tAra antarake dRr3ha kare nA ditAma, yAte se AsthAzIladera antarbhukta haYa|
Ara se mUsAra vonake valala, ‘era pichane pichane yAo’| se dUra theke tAke dekhachila, kintu tArA Tera pAYani|

Ara Ami tAra janya pUrva thekei dhAtrI (stanya pAna) niSiddha kare diYechilAma| tArapara mUsAra vona ese valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake emana ekaTi parivArera sandhAna deva, yArA e zizuTike tomAdera pakSe lAlana pAlana karave evaM tArA tAra zubhAkAGkSI have’|

ataHpara Ami tAke tAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se yena kona duzcintA nA kare| Ara se yena jAnate pAre ye, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
Ara mUsA yakhana yauvane padArpaNa karala evaM pariNata vaYaska halo, takhana Ami tAke vicAravuddhi o jJAna dAna karalAma| Ara ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladera puraskAra diYe thAki|

Ara se zahare praveza karala, yakhana tAra adhivAsIrA chila asatarka| takhana sekhAne se du’jana lokake saMgharSe lipta avasthAYa pela| ekajana tAra nijera dalera evaM aparajana tAra zatrudalera| takhana tAra nijera dalera lokaTi tAra zatrudalera lokaTira viruddhe tAra kAche sAhAyya cAila| ataHpara mUsA tAke ghuSi mArala phale se tAke mere phelala| mUsA valala, ‘eTA zaYatAnera kAja| nizcaYa se pathabhraSTakArI prakAzya zatru’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa Ami AmAra naphasera prati yulama karechi, sutarAM Apani AmAke kSamA kare dina’| ataHpara tini tAke kSamA karalena| nizcaYa tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani yehetu AmAra prati niAmata dAna karena, tAi Ami kakhano Ara aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|

ataHpara bhIta pratIkSArata avasthAYa sei zahare tAra sakAla hala| haThAt se zunate pela, ye lokaTi gatakAla tAra kAche sAhAyya ceYechila, se AvAra sAhAyyera janya citkAra karache| mUsA tAke valala, ‘nizcaYa tumi to ekajana spaSTa vibhrAnta vyakti’|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana ubhaYerai zatruke dharate cAila, takhana lokaTi vale uThala, ‘he mUsA, tumi ki AmAkeo hatyA karate cAo? yemana gatakAla ekaTi lokake tumi hatyA karecha? tumi to yamIne kevala svairAcArI hate cAccha| Ara tumi to saMzodhanakArIdera madhye antarbhukta hate cAccha nA’|

Ara zaharera dUraprAnta theke ekajana loka chuTe Asala| se valala, ‘he mUsA, nizcaYa pAriSadavarga tomAke hatyAra parAmarza karache, tAi tumi veriYe yAo, nizcaYa Ami tomAra janya kalyANakAmIdera ekajana’|
takhana se bhIta pratIkSArata avasthAYa zahara theke veriYe par3ala| valala, ‘he AmAra rava, Apani yAlima kaoma theke AmAke rakSA karuna’|
Ara yakhana mUsA mAdaiYAna abhimukhe raoYAnA karala, takhana valala, ‘AzA kari AmAra rava AmAke saThika patha pradarzana karavena’|

Ara yakhana se mAdaiYAnera pAnira nikaTa upanIta hala, takhana sekhAne ekadala lokake pela, yArA (pazudera) pAni pAna karAcche evaM tAdera chAr3A du’jana nArIke pela, yArA tAdera pazuguloke Agale rAkhache| se valala, ‘tomAdera vyApAra kI’? tArA valala, ‘AmarA (AmAdera pazugulora) pAni pAna karAte pAri nA| yatakSaNa nA rAkhAlarA tAdera (pazugulo) niYe sare yAYa| Ara AmAdera pitA ativRddha’|
takhana mUsA tAdera pakSe (pazuguloke) pAni pAna kariYe dila| tArapara chAYAYa phire gela evaM valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa Apani AmAra prati ye anugrahai nAyila karavena, Ami tAra mukhApekSI’|

ataHpara nArIdvaYera ekajana lAjukabhAve he~Te tAra kAche ese valala ye, AmAra pitA ApanAke DAkachena, yena tini ApanAke pArizramika dite pArena, AmAdera pazuguloke Apani ye pAni pAna kariYechena tAra vinimaYe’| ataHpara yakhana mUsA tAra nikaTa Asala evaM sakala ghaTanA tAra kAche khule valala, takhana se valala, ‘tumi bhaYa karo nA| tumi yAlima kaoma theke rehAi peYe gecha’|
nArIdvaYera ekajana valala, ‘he AmAra pitA, Apani tAke majura niyukta karuna| nizcaYa Apani yAderake majura niyukta karavena tAdera madhye se uttama, ye zaktizAlI vizvasta’|

se valala, ‘Ami AmAra ei kanyAdvaYera ekajanake tomAra sAthe viYe dite cAi ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAra majurI karave| Ara yadi tumi daza vachara pUrNa kara, tave seTA tomAra pakSa theke (atirikta)| Ami tomAke kaSTa dite cAi nA| tumi inazAAllAha AmAke satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta pAve’|
mUsA valala, ‘e cukti AmAra o ApanAra madhye raila| du’Ti meYAdera yeTii Ami pUraNa kari nA kena, tAte AmAra viruddhe abhiyoga thAkave nA| Ara AmarA ye viSaYe kathA valachi, AllAha tAra sAkSI’|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana meYAda pUrNa karala evaM saparivAre yAtrA karala, takhana se tUra parvatera pAze Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parivAra parijanake valala, ‘tomarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhate peYechi, sambhavata Ami tA theke tomAdera kAche Anate pArava kona khavara, athavA ekaTi jvalanta AGgAra; yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra’|
ataHpara yakhana mUsA Agunera nikaTa Asala, takhana upatyakAra DAna pArze pavitra bhUmite avasthita vRkSa theke tAke AhavAna kare valA halo, ‘he mUsA, nizcaYa Amii AllAha, sRSTikulera rava’|

‘Ara tumi tomAra lAThi phele dAo’| ataHpara yakhana se oTAke dekhala, sApera mata chuTAchuTi karache, takhana se pichanera dike chuTala evaM phireo tAkAla nA| (valA hala) ‘he mUsA, sAmane yAo evaM bhaYa peYo nA, nizcaYa tumi nirApada’|

‘tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, eTA truTimukta avasthAYa zubhrojjvala haYe veriYe Asave| Ara bhaYa theke rakSAra janya tomAra hAta tomAra nijera dike milAo| ataHpara e du’To tomAra ravera pakSa theke du’Ti pramANa, phira‘Auna o tAra pAriSadavargera janya| nizcaYa tArA phAsika kaoma’|
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa Ami tAdera eka vyaktike hatyA karechi, tAi Ami AzaGkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave’|
‘Ara AmAra bhAi hArUna, se AmAra ceYe spaSTabhASI, tAi tAke AmAra sAthe sAhAyyakArI hiseve preraNa karuna, se AmAke samarthana karave| Ami AzaGkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|

AllAha valalena, ‘Ami tomAra bhAiYera mAdhyame tomAra vAhu zaktizAlI karava evaM tomAdera du’janake kSamatA dAna karava, phale tArA tomAdera kAche pau~chate pArave nA| AmAra nidarzanAvalI dvArA tomarA o tomAdera anusArIrA vijaYI have’|
ataHpara mUsA yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanagulo niYe Asala, takhana tArA valala, ‘e to mithyA yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa evaM erUpa kathA AmAdera pitRpuruSadera madhyeo zunini’|
Ara mUsA valala, ‘AmAra rava samyaka avagata Achena, ke tA~ra kAcha theke hidAYAta niYe eseche evaM AkhirAte kAra pariNAma zubha have| nizcaYa yAlimarA saphala have nA’|

Ara phira‘Auna valala, ‘he pAriSadavarga, Ami chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha Ache vale Ami jAni nA| ataeva he hAmAna, AmAra janya tumi iTa por3Ao, tArapara AmAra janya ekaTi prAsAda tairI kara| yAte Ami mUsAra ilAhake dekhate pAi| Ara nizcaYa Ami mane kari se mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta’|
Ara phira‘Auna o tAra senAvAhinI anyAYabhAve yamIne ahaGkAra karechila evaM tArA mane karechila ye, tAderake AmAra nikaTa phiriYe AnA have nA|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra senAvAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma, tArapara tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| ataeva, dekha yAlimadera pariNAma kirUpa haYechila?
Ara Ami tAderake netA vAniYechilAma, tArA jAhAnnAmera dike AhavAna karata evaM kiYAmatera dina tAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|
e yamIne Ami tAdera pichane abhisampAta lAgiYe diYechi Ara kiYAmatera dina tArA have ghRNitadera antarbhukta|
Ara avazyai Ami pUrvavartI vahu prajanmake dhvaMsa karAra para mAnuSera janya AlokavartikA, hidAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma| yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ara (he navI) Ami yakhana mUsAke vidhAna diYechilAma takhana tumi (tUra pAhAr3era) pazcima pArze upasthita chile nA| Ara tumi pratyakSadarzIdera antarbhuktao chile nA|

kintu Ami aneka prajanmake sRSTi karechi| tArapara tAdera upara vahu yuga ativAhita haYechila| tumi to mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye avasthAnakArI chile nA ye, tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAtagulo tumi tilAoYAta karave| kintu Amii rAsUla preraNakArI|

Ara yakhana Ami (mUsAke) DekechilAma takhana tumi tUra parvatera pAze upasthita chile nA| kintu tomAra ravera pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa jAnAno haYeche, yAte tumi emana kaomake satarka karate pAra, yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni| sambhavata tArA upadeza grahaNa karave|

tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera upara kona vipada Asale tArA yAte valate nA pAre, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAdera kAche kona rAsUla pAThAlena nA kena? tAhale AmarA ApanAra AYAtasamUha anusaraNa karatAma Ara AmarA muminadera antarbhurkta hatAma’|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra nikaTa theke tAdera kAche satya Asala takhana tArA valala, ‘mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tAke(muhAmmAdake) kena serUpa deYA hala nA’? itaHpUrve mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tArA ki tA asvIkAra kareni? tArA valechila, ‘du’Tii yAdu, ekaTi aparaTike sAhAyya kare’| Ara tArA valechila, ‘AmarA savai asvIkArakArI’|
vala, ‘tAhale tomarA AllAhara kAcha theke emana ekaTi kitAva niYe Asa yA e du’To kitAva theke utkRSTa; Ami tArai anusaraNa karava, yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka’|

ataHpara tArA yadi tomAra AhavAne sAr3A nA deYa, tAhale jene rAkha, tArA to nijadera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare| Ara AllAhara dikanirdezanA chAr3A ye nijera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke? nizcaYa AllAha yAlima kaomake hidAYAta karena nA|
Ara Ami to tAdera kAche ekera para eka vANI pau~che diYechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
era pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA era prati ImAna Ane|
Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa tA tilAoYAta karA haYa takhana tArA vale, ‘AmarA era prati ImAna enechi, nizcaYa tA satya AmAdera ravera pakSa theke| nizcaYa AmarA era pUrveo AtmasamarpaNakArI chilAma’|
tAderake du’vAra pratidAna deYA have| e kAraNe ye, tArA dhairyadhAraNa kare evaM bhAla dvArA mandake pratihata kare| Ara Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA theke vyaYa kare|

Ara tArA yakhana anarthaka kathAvArtA zune takhana tA theke vimukha haYa evaM vale, ‘AmAdera Amala AmAdera janya, Ara tomAdera Amala tomAdera janya| tomAdera prati ‘sAlAma’| AmarA ajJadera sAhacarya cAi nA’|
nizcaYa tumi yAke bhAlavAsa tAke tumi hidAYAta dite pArave nA; varaM AllAhai yAke icchA hidAYAta dena| Ara hidAYAtaprAptadera vyApAre tini bhAla jAnena|

Ara tArA vale, ‘AmarA yadi tomAra sAthe hidAYAtera anusaraNa kari tave AmAderake AmAdera deza theke utkhAta karA have’| Ami ki tAdera janya eka nirApada ‘hArAma’ era suvyavasthA karini? sekhAne sava dharanera phalamUla AmadAnI karA haYa, AmAra pakSa theke riykasvarUpa? kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|

Ara Ami kata janapadake dhvaMsa karechi, yAra vAsindArA tAdera jIvana upakaraNa niYe dambha karata! egulo to tAdera vAsasthAna| tAdera pare (ekhAne) sAmAnyai vasavAsa karA haYeche| Ara Amii cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra oYArisa|

Ara tomAra rava kona janapadake dhvaMsa karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tini tAra mUla bhUkhanDe rAsUla preraNa karena, ye tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta kare| Ara kona janapadera adhivAsIrA yAlima nA hale Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kari nA|
Ara tomAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche tA duniYAra jIvanera bhoga o saundarya mAtra| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache tAi uttama o sthAYI| tomarA ki vujhave nA?
Ami yAke uttama oYAdA diYechi se tA pAvei; se ki tAra matai yAke Ami duniYAra jIvanera bhogasAmagrI diYechi? tArapara kiYAmatera dine se upasthitakRtadera madhye thAkave|
Ara se dina tini tAderake AhavAna karavena, ataHpara valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tArA kothAYa’?

yAdera janya (zAstira) vANI avadhArita have tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, orA to tArA yAderake AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma| tAderake AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma yemana AmarA vibhrAnta haYechilAma| AmarA ApanAra kAche dAYa mukti cAcchi| tArA to AmAdera ivAdAta karata nA’|
Ara valA have, ‘tomAdera devatAguloke DAka, ataHpara tArA tAderake DAkave, takhana tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA| Ara tArA AyAva dekhate pAve| hAYa, erA yadi satpatha prApta hata!
Ara sedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, ‘tomarA rAsUladerake kI javAva diYechile’?
ataHpara sedina sakala saMvAda tAdera kAcha theke gopana haYe yAve, takhana tArA parasparake jijJAsA karate pArave nA|
tave ye tAovA karechila, ImAna enechila evaM satkarma karechila, AzA karA yAYa se sAphalya arjanakArIdera antarbhukta have|
Ara tomAra rava yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM manonIta karena, tAdera kona ekhatiYAra nAi| AllAha pavitra mahAna evaM tArA yA zarIka kare tini tA theke Urdhve|
Ara tomAra rava jAnena, tAdera antara yA gopana kare Ara tArA yA prakAza kare|
Ara tinii AllAha, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| duniYA o AkhirAte samasta prazaMsA tA~rai; vidhAna tA~rai| Ara tA~ra kAchei tomarA pratyAvartita have|
vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi AllAha rAtake tomAdera upara kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI kare dena, tave tA~ra parivarte kona ilAha Ache ki ye tomAdera Alo ene deve? tavuo ki tomarA zunave nA’?

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi AllAha dinake tomAdera upara kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI kare dena, tave tA~ra parivarte kona ilAha Ache ki, ye tomAdera rAta ene deve yAte tomarA vizrAma karave? tavuo ki tomarA bheve dekhave nA’?
Ara tA~ra anugrahe tini tomAdera janya rAta o dina karechena yAte tomarA vizrAma nite pAra evaM tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yena tomarA zokara AdAYa karate pAra|
Ara sedina tini tAdera DAkavena| ataHpara valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tArA kothAYa’?

Ara Ami pratyeka jAti theke ekajana sAkSI vera kare neva| ataHpara Ami valava, ‘tomAdera pramANa niYe Asa’| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, nizcaYa satya AllAhara kAchei evaM tArA ye sava mithyA udbhAvana karata tA tAdera theke hAriYe yAve|

nizcaYa kArUna chila mUsAra kaomabhukta| ataHpara se tAdera upara auddhatya prakAza kare| athaca Ami tAke emana dhanabhAnDAra dAna karechilAma ye, nizcaYa tAra cAvigulo ekadala zaktizAlI lokera upara bhArI haYe yeta| smaraNa kara, yakhana tAra kaoma tAke valala, ‘dambha karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha dAmbhikadera bhAlavAsena nA’|

Ara AllAha tomAke yA dAna karechena tAte tumi AkhirAtera nivAsa anusandhAna kara| tave tumi duniYA theke tomAra aMza bhule yeYo nA| tomAra prati AllAha yerUpa anugraha karechena tumio serUpa anugraha kara| Ara yamIne phAsAda karate ceYo nA| nizcaYa AllAha phAsAdakArIdera bhAlavAsena nA’|

se valala, ‘Ami to ei dhanabhAnDAra prApta haYechi AmAra kAche thAkA jJAna dvArA’| se ki jAnata nA ye, AllAha tAra pUrve vahu prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechena, yArA chila tAra theke zaktimattAYa pravalatara evaM janasaMkhyAYa adhika| Ara aparAdhIderake tAdera aparAdha samparke prazna karA have nA|
ataHpara se tAra kaomera sAmane jA~kajamakera sAthe vera hala| yArA duniYAra jIvana cAita tArA valala, ‘AhA! kArUnake yemana deYA haYeche AmAderao yadi temana thAkata! nizcaYa se virATa sampadazAlI|’
Ara yArA jJAna prApta haYechila, tArA valala, ‘dhika tomAderake! AllAhara pratidAnai uttama ye ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAra janya| Ara tA zudhu savarakArIrAi pete pAre|’
