ataHpara Ami kArUna o tAra prAsAdake mATite dAviYe dilAma| takhana tAra janya emana kona dala chila nA, ye AllAhara mokAvilAYa tAke sAhAyya karate pArata evaM se nijeo nijeke sAhAyya karate sakSama chila nA|

Ara gatakAla yArA tAra mata hate pratyAzA karechila tArA valate lAgala, ‘Azcarya! dekhale to, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAra janya icchA riyka prasArita athavA saMkucita karena| yadi AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha nA karatena tave AmAderakeo tini dAviYe ditena| dekhale to, kAphirarA saphala haYa nA’|
ei hacche AkhirAtera nivAsa, yA Ami tAdera janya nirdhArita kari, yArA yamIne auddhatya dekhAte cAYa nA evaM phAsAdao cAYa nA| Ara zubha pariNAma muttAkIdera janya|
keu pUNya niYe Asale tAra janya thAkave tA theke uttama pratidAna| Ara keu pApa niYe Asale tave yArA mandakarma kareche tAdera zudhu tArai pratidAna deoYA have yA tArA kareche|

nizcaYa yini tomAra prati kuraAnake vidhAnasvarUpa diYechena, avazyai tini tomAke pratyAvartanasthale* phiriYe nevena| vala, ‘AmAra rava vezI jAnena, ke hidAYAta niYe eseche, Ara ke raYeche spaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa’| * معاد vA pratyAvartanasthala valate svadeza arthAt makkA nagarI athavA AkhirAtake vujhAno haYeche|
Ara tumi AzA karachile nA ye, tomAra prati kitAva (kuraAna) nAyila karA have, varaM tA tomAra ravera pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa| ataeva, tumi kakhano kAphiradera janya sAhAyyakArI haYo nA|
Ara AllAhara AYAtasamUha tomAra prati nAyila haoYAra para tArA yena tomAke tA theke virata rAkhate nA pAre, tomAra ravera prati tumi AhavAna kara evaM tumi muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|

AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAhake Deko nA, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tA~ra cehArA (sattvA)* chAr3A sava kichui dhvaMsazIla, siddhAnta tA~rai evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have| * AYAte ullikhita وجه zavdera artha cehArA| AllAhara cehArA Ache| Ara tA~ra cehArA yemana dhvaMsazIla naYa temani tA~ra sattvAo dhvaMsazIla naYa|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ valalei tAdera cher3e deYA have, Ara tAdera parIkSA karA have nA?
Ara Ami to tAdera pUrvavartIdera parIkSA karechi| phale AllAha avazyai jene nevena, kArA satya vale evaM avazyai tini jene nevena, kArA mithyAvAdI|
nAki yArA pApa kAja kare tArA mane kare ye, tArA AmAke rekhe sAmane cale yAve? katainA nikRSTa, yA tArA phaYasAlA kare!
ye AllAhara sAkSAt kAmanA kare (se jene rAkhuka) ataHpara nizcaYa AllAhara nirdhArita kAla Asave| Ara tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|
Ara ye ceSTA kare se to tAra nAphsera janya ceSTA kare| nizcaYa AllAha sRSTikula theke praYojanamukta|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, avazyai Ami tAdera theke tAdera pApasamUha dUra kare deva evaM Ami avazyai tAdera sei uttama Amalera pratidAna deva, yA tArA karata|

Ara Ami mAnuSake nirdeza diYechi tAra pitA-mAtAra sAthe sadAcaraNa karate| tave yadi tArA tomAra upara praceSTA cAlAYa AmAra sAthe emana kichuke zarIka karate yAra samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei, tAhale tumi tAdera Anugatya karave nA| AmAra dikei tomAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara tomarA yA karate Ami tA tomAderake jAniYe deva|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare, Ami avazyai tAderake satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karava|

Ara kichu loka Ache yArA vale, ‘AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi’, ataHpara yakhana AllAhara vyApAre tAdera kaSTa deYA haYa, takhana tArA mAnuSera nipIr3anake AllAhara AyAvera mata gaNya kare| Ara yadi tomAra ravera pakSa theke kona vijaYa Ase, takhana avazyai tArA vale, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAdera sAthe chilAma’| sRSTikulera antarasamUhe yA kichu Ache AllAha ki tA samparke samyaka avagata nana?
Ara AllAha avazyai jAnena, kArA ImAna eneche evaM tini munAphikaderakeo jAnena|
Ara kAphirarA muminaderake vale, ‘tomarA AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara evaM yena AmarA tomAdera pApa vahana kari|’ athaca tArA tAdera pApera kichui vahana karave nA| nizcaYa tArA mithyAvAdI|
Ara avazyai tArA vahana karave tAdera vojhA evaM tAdera vojhAra sAthe Aro kichu vojhA| Ara tArA kiYAmatera dina avazyai jijJAsita have se samparke, yA tArA mithyA vAnAta|

Ara Ami avazyai nUhake tAra kaomera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma| se tAdera madhye paJcAza kama eka hAjAra vachara avasthAna karechila| ataHpara mahA-plAvana tAdera grAsa karala, ematAvasthAYa ye tArA chila yAlima|
ataHpara tAke o naukA ArohIderake Ami rakSA karalAma, Ara eTAke karalAma sRSTikulera janya ekaTi nidarzana|
Ara (smaraNa kara) ivarAhImake, yakhana se tAra kaomake valechila, ‘tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ra tAkaoYA avalamvana kara; eTi tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi tomarA jAna’|

‘tomarA to AllAhake vAda diYe mUrtigulora pUjA karacha evaM mithyA vAnAccha| nizcaYa tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAdera upAsanA kara tArA tomAdera janya riyka-era mAlika naYa| tAi AllAhara kAche riyka tAlAza kara, tA~ra ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| tA~rai kAche tomarA pratyAvartita have|
Ara tomarA yadi mithyAropa kara, tave tomAdera pUrve aneka jAti mithyAropa karechila| Ara rAsUlera upara dAYitva to kevala suspaSTabhAve pau~chAno|
tArA ki dekhe nA, AllAha kibhAve sRSTira sUcanA karena? tArapara tini tAra punarAvRtti karavena| nizcaYa eTi AllAhara janya sahaja|
vala, ‘tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara, ataHpara dekha’ kIbhAve tini sRSTira sUcanA karechilena, tArapara AllAhai ArekavAra sRSTi karavena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tini yAke icchA AyAva devena evaM yAke icchA daYA karavena, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have|
tomarA (AllAhake) vyartha karate pAravenA pRthivIte athavA AkAze evaM AllAha vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
Ara yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha o tA~ra sAkSAta asvIkAra kare tArA AmAra rahamata theke hatAza have evaM tAdera janyai raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

ataHpara ivarAhImera kaomera javAva chila kevala ei ye, tArA valala, ‘oke hatyA kara athavA jvAliYe dAo|’ ataHpara AllAha Aguna theke tAke rakSA karalena; nizcaYa ete vahu nidarzana raYeche, yArA ImAna Ane, sei kaomera janya|

Ara ivarAhIma valala, ‘duniYAra jIvane tomAdera madhye mila-mahavvatera janyai to tomarA AllAha chAr3A mUrtiderake grahaNa karecha| tArapara kiYAmatera dina tomarA eke aparake asvIkAra karave evaM paraspara parasparake lA‘nata karave, Ara tomAdera nivAsa jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera janya thAkave nA kona sAhAyyakArI’|
ataHpara lUta tAra upara vizvAsa sthApana karala| Ara ivarAhIma valala, ‘Ami AmAra ravera dike hijarata karachi| nizcaYa tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|
Ara Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o ‘iYA‘kUvake evaM tAra vaMze navuoYAta o kitAva dilAma| Ara duniYAte tAke tAra pratidAna dilAma evaM nizcaYa se AkhirAte satkarmazIladera antarbhukta have|
Ara (smaraNa kara) lUta era kathA, yakhana se tAra kaomera lokaderake valechila, ‘nizcaYa tomarA emana azlIla kAja kara, yA sRSTikulera keu tomAdera Age kareni’|

‘tomarA to puruSera upara upagata hao evaM rAstAYa DAkAti kara; Ara nijadera vaiThake garhita kAja kara!’ tAra kaomera javAva chila kevala ei ye, tArA valala, ‘tumi AllAhara AyAva niYe Asa yadi tumi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hao’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAhAyya karuna phAsAda sRSTikArI kaomera viruddhe’|
Ara AmAra pherezatArA yakhana ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe esechila takhana tArA valechila, ‘nizcaYa AmarA e janapadera adhivAsIderake dhvaMsa karava, nizcaYa era adhivAsIrA yAlima’|

ivarAhIma valala, ‘nizcaYa sekhAne lUta Ache|’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA bhAlai jAni sekhAne kArA Ache, AmarA avazyai tAke o tAra parivArake rakSA karava; tave tAra strIke naYa, se have pichane par3e thAkA lokadera ekajana’|

Ara yakhana AmAra pherezatArA lUtera kAche Asala takhana tAdera janya se cintita haYe par3ala evaM tAdera rakSAYa nijeke akSama mane karala; Ara tArA valala, ‘bhaYa pAvena nA evaM cintita havena nA; ApanAke o ApanAra parivArake AmarA rakSA karava; tave ApanAra strIke naYa, se dhvaMsaprAptadera ekajana have’|
nizcaYa AmarA e janapadavAsIra upara AsamAna theke zAsti nAyila karava| kAraNa tArA pApAcAra karata|
Ara avazyai Ami ai janapade suspaSTa nidarzana rekhe diYechi se kaomera janya yArA vujhe|
Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIra kAche pAThiYechilAma tAdera bhAi zu‘Aivake; ataHpara se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, zeSa divasera AzA kara evaM yamIne phAsAda sRSTi kare ver3io nA|
ataHpara tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valala; phale bhUmikampa tAderake grAsa karala| ataHpara nijadera vAr3I-gharei tArA upur3a haYe mare raila|

Ara ‘Ada o sAmUdake (Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma), tAdera AvAsabhUmira kichu tomAdera janya unmocita haYeche| Ara zaYatAna tAdera kAja tAdera cokhe zobhita kare tAderake satpatha theke virata rekhechila, yadio tArA chila vidagdha|
Ara kArUna, phira‘Auna o hAmAnake (Ami dhvaMsa karechi) evaM avazyai tAdera kAche mUsA giYechila pramAnAdisaha| ataHpara tArA yamIne ahaMkAra karechila; etadsattveo tArA (AmAra AyAva) er3Ate pAreni|

ataHpara edera pratyekake nija nija pApera kAraNe Ami pAkar3Ao karechilAma; tAdera kAro upara Ami pAtharakucira jhar3a pAThiYechi, kAuke pAkar3Ao kareche vikaTa AoYAja, kAuke AvAra mATite dAviYe diYechi Ara kAuke pAnite DuviYe diYechi| AllAha emana nana ye, tAdera upara yulama karavena varaM tArA nijerA nijadera opara yul‌ma karata|
yArA AllAha chAr3A vahu abhibhAvaka grahaNa kare, tAdera dRSTAnta mAkar3asAra nyAYa, ye ghara vAnAYa evaM nizcaYa savacAite durvala ghara hala mAkar3asAra ghara, yadi tArA jAnata|
nizcaYa AllAha tAderake jAnena tA~ke chAr3A yAderake orA AhavAna kare; Ara tini mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ara esava dRSTAnta Ami mAnuSera janya peza kari; Ara jJAnI lokerA chAr3A keu tA vujhe nA|
AllAha yathAyathabhAve AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena; nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche muminadera janya|

tomAra prati ye kitAva ohI karA haYeche, tA theke tilAoYAta kara evaM sAlAta kAYema kara| nizcaYa sAlAta azlIla o mandakAja theke virata rAkhe| Ara AllAhara smaraNai to sarvazreSTha| AllAha jAnena yA tomarA kara|

Ara tomarA uttama panthA chAr3A Ahale kitAvadera sAthe vitarka karo nA| tave tAdera madhye orA chAr3A, yArA yulma kareche| Ara tomarA vala, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi AmAdera prati yA nAyila karA haYeche evaM tomAdera prati yA nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati evaM AmAdera ilAha o tomAdera ilAha to ekai| Ara AmarA tA~rai samIpe AtmasamarpaNakArI’|

Ara ebhAvei Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi| ataeva, Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA era prati ImAna rAkhe evaM ederao (makkAvAsIdera) keu keu era prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara kAphirarA chAr3A AmAra AYAtasamUhake keu asvIkAra kare nA|
Ara tumi to era pUrve kona kitAva tilAoYAta karani evaM tomAra nijera hAte tA likhani ye, vAtilapanthIrA ete sandeha poSaNa karave|
varaM yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche, tAdera antare tA suspaSTa nidarzana| Ara yAlimarA chAr3A AmAra AYAtasamUhake keu asvIkAra kare nA|
Ara tArA vale, ‘tAra kAche tAra ravera pakSa theke nidarzanasamUha nAyila haYa nA kena’? vala, ‘nidarzanasamUha to AllAhara kAche, Ara Ami to kevala ekajana prakAzya satarkakArI’|

eTA ki tAdera janya yatheSTa naYa ye, nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi, yA tAdera nikaTa tilAoYAta karA haYa? nizcaYa era madhye rahamata o upadeza raYeche sei kaomera janya, yArA ImAna Ane|
vala, ‘AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache, tA tini jAnena| Ara yArA vAtile vizvAsa kare evaM AllAhake asvIkAra kare, tArAi kSatigrasta’|
Ara tArA tomAke AyAva tvarAnvita karate vale| yadi nirdhArita samaYa nA thAkata, tave tAdera upara avazyai AyAva Asata evaM tA AkasmikabhAve tAdera upara Asavei| athaca tArA Terao pAve nA|
tArA tomAke AyAva tvarAnvita karate vale, Ara nizcaYa jAhAnnAma kAphiraderake pariveSTana karave|
yedina AyAva tAderake tAdera upara theke o tAdera pAYera nIce theke Acchanna kare phelave evaM tini valavena, ‘tomarA yA karate, tAra svAda AsvAdana kara’|
he AmAra vAndArA yArA ImAna eneche, nizcaYa AmAra yamIna prazasta, sutarAM tomarA AmArai ivAdAta kara|
pratiTi prANa mRtyura svAda AsvAdana karave, tArapara AmAra kAchei tomarA pratyAvartita have|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o sat karma kare, tAderake avazyai Ami jAnnAte kakSa vAniYe deva, yAra taladeza diYe nadIsamUha pravAhita have, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| katainA uttama AmalakArIdera pratidAna!
yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM tAdera ravera uparai tAoYAkkula kare|
Ara emana kata jIva-jantu raYeche, yArA nijadera riyka nijerA saJcaYa kare nA, AllAhai tAdera riyka dena evaM tomAderao| Ara tini sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI|
Ara yadi tumi tAderake prazna kara, ‘ke AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena evaM cA~da o sUryake niYojita karechena’? tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha’| tAhale kothAYa tAdera phirAno hacche?
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA karena riyka prazasta kare dena evaM yAra janya icchA sImita kare dena| nizcaYa AllAha sakala viSaYe samyaka avagata|

Ara tumi yadi tAderake prazna kara, ‘ke AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA yamInake tAra mRtyura para saJjIvita karena’? tave tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha’| vala, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara’| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA vujhe nA|
Ara e duniYAra jIvana khela-tAmAzA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa evaM nizcaYa AkhirAtera nivAsai halo prakRta jIvana, yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA yakhana nauyAne ArohaNa kare, takhana tArA ekaniSThabhAve AllAhake DAke| ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake sthale pau~che dena, takhanai tArA zirake lipta haYa|
yAte Ami tAderake yA diYechi, tA tArA asvIkAra karate pAre evaM tArA yena bhoga-vilAse matta thAkate pAre| ataHpara zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami ‘hArAma’ ke nirApada vAniYechi, athaca tAdera Aza pAza theke mAnuSaderake chiniYe neYA haYa? tAhale ki tArA asatyei vizvAsa karave evaM AllAhara niAmatake asvIkAra karave?
Ara se vyaktira ceYe yAlima Ara ke, ye AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa kare athavA tAra nikaTa satya AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare? jAhAnnAmera madhyei ki kAphiradera AvAsa naYa?
Ara yArA AmAra pathe sarvAtmaka praceSTA cAlAYa, tAderake Ami avazyai AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| Ara nizcaYa AllAha satkarmazIladera sAthei Achena|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|

romAnarA parAjita haYeche|* * 395 khRsTAvde romaka sAmrAjya theke pRthaka haYe vAYayAnaTAina nAme ye sAmrAjyaTi paricita haYechila, ekhAne الرومvalate tAke vujhAno haYeche| siriYA o pyAlesTAina e sAmrAjyera adhIna chila|

nikaTavartI aJcale*, Ara tArA tAdera e parAjaYera para acirei vijaYI have, * hijAyera uttara pazcima sImAnA saMlagna AyaruYAta o vusarAra madhyavartI sthAna| samrATa hirAkliYAsa o khasaru pArabhejera madhye ekhAne yuddha haYa| yuddhe khasaru pArabheja vijaYa lAbha kare| phale makkAra pauttalikarA khuzi haYe valate zuru kare, AmarA musalimaderake parAjita karava| takhana ukta AYAtagulo nAyila haYa|

kaYeka vacharera madhyei*| pUrvera o parera sava phaYasAlA AllAharai| Ara sedina muminarA Anandita have, * بضع سنين tina theke daza vachara| e AYAte bhaviSyadvANI karA haYa ye, anadhika naYa vacharera madhye romAnarA pArasikadera upara vijaYa lAbha karave| 623-24 khR e bhaviSyadvANI satye pariNata haYa| Ara se vacharai vadara yuddhe musalimarA muzarikaderake parAjita kare|
AllAhara sAhAyye| tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena| Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
AllAhara oYAdA| AllAha tA~ra oYAdA khelApha karena nA| kintu adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
tArA duniYAra jIvanera vAhyika dika samparke jAne, Ara AkhirAta samparke tArA gAphila|

tArA ki nijadera antare bheve dekhe nA, AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM e du’Yera madhyavartI sava kichui yathAyathabhAve o eka nirdiSTa samaYera janya sRSTi karechena? Ara nizcaYa vahu loka tAdera ravera sAkSAte avizvAsI|

tArA ki yamIne bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale tArA dekhata ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila| tArA zaktite tAdera ceYeo pravala chila| Ara tArA jami cASa karata evaM tArA edera AvAda karAra ceYeo vezI AvAda karata| Ara tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa pramANAdisaha esechila| vastutaH AllAha emana nana ye, tini tAdera prati yulama karavena, kintu tArA nijerAi nijadera prati yulama karata|
tArapara yArA manda kAja karechila tAdera pariNAma manda haYechila| kAraNa tArA AllAhara AYAtaguloke asvIkAra karechila evaM segulo niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
AllAha sRSTira sUcanA karena, tArapara tinii tAra punarAvRtti karavena| tArapara tA~ra kAchei tomarA pratyAvartita have|
Ara yedina kiYAmata saMghaTita have sedina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ara tAdera zarIkarA tAdera janya supArizakArI have nA evaM tArA tAdera zarIkaderake asvIkAra karave|
Ara yedina kiYAmata saMghaTita have sedina tArA vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ataeva yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche tAderake jAnnAte parituSTa karA have|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra AYAta o AkhirAtera sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche, tAderake AyAvera madhye upasthita karA have|
ataeva tomarA AllAhara tAsavIha kara, yakhana sandhyAYa upanIta have evaM sakAle uThave |
Ara aparAhne o yuharera samaYe; Ara AsamAna o yamIne sakala prazaMsA ekamAtra tA~rai|
tini mRta theke jIvitake vera karena evaM jIvita theke mRtake vera karena| Ara tini yamInake jIvita karena tAra mRtyura para| Ara ebhAvei tomarA utthita have|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena, tArapara tomarA mAnuSa haYe char3iYe par3acha|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAdera janya tomAdera thekei strIdera sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAdera kAche prazAnti pAo| Ara tini tomAdera madhye bhAlavAsA o daYA sRSTi karechena| nizcaYa era madhye nidarzanAvalI raYeche se kaomera janya, yArA cintA kare|
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche AsamAna o yamInera sRSTi evaM tomAdera bhASA o tomAdera varNera bhinnatA| nizcaYa era madhye nidarzanAvalI raYeche jJAnIdera janya |
Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche rAte o dine tomAdera nidrA evaM tA~ra anugraha theke tomAdera (jIvikA) anveSaNa| nizcaYa era madhye nidarzanAvalI raYeche se kaomera janya yArA zone|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche tini tomAderake bhaYa o bharasAsvarUpa vidyut dekhAna, Ara AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karena| ataHpara tA dvArA yamInake tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| nizcaYa era madhye nidarzanAvalI raYeche se kaomera janya yArA anudhAvana kare|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche, tA~rai nirdeze AsamAna o yamIna sthitizIla thAke| tArapara tini yakhana tomAderake yamIna theke vera haYe AsAra janya ekavAra AhavAna karavena takhanai tomarA vera haYe Asave|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai| sava kichui tA~ra anugata|
Ara tinii sRSTira sUcanA karena tArapara tinii era punarAvRtti karavena| Ara eTA to tA~ra janya adhikatara sahaja| AsamAna o yamIne sarvocca maryAdA tA~rai evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tini tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya theke ekaTi upamA varNanA karechena; Ami tomAderake ye riyka diYechi tAte tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIrA ki aMzIdAra? phale tomarA ki e viSaYe samAna? tomarA ki tAderake temanabhAve bhaYa kara yemanabhAve bhaYa kara tomAdera parasparake*? ebhAvei Ami nidarzanAvalI vistArita varNanA karechi se kaomera janya yArA upalavdhi kare| * dAsa-dAsIrA manivera sampadera aMzIdAra haYa nA evaM manivarA tAderake bhaYao kare nA| temanibhAve sArA jAhAnera mAlika AllAhara sAthe kAro aMzidAritva hate pAre nA|
varaM yAlimarA jJAna chAr3Ai tAdera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare| sutarAM yAke AllAha pathabhraSTa karena ke tAke hidAYAta karave? Ara tAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

ataeva tumi ekaniSTha haYe dInera janya nijake pratiSThita rAkha| AllAhara prakRti*, ye prakRtira upara tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sRSTira kona parivartana nei| eTAi pratiSThita dIna; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA| * فطرة svabhAva, prakRti| mahAna AllAha mAnuSake ye sahajAta prakRti diYe sRSTi karechena| tAkei فطرة الله valA haYeche| Ara فطرة الله era marmArtha hala isalAma|
tA~ra abhimukhI haYe tA~ke bhaYa kara, sAlAta kAYema kara, Ara muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
yArA nijadera dInake vibhakta kareche evaM yArA vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche (tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA)| pratyeka dalai nijadera yA Ache tA niYe Anandita|

Ara mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-kaSTa sparza kare takhana tArA tAdera ravera prati vinItabhAve phire ese tAke DAke| tArapara yakhana tini tAdera svIYa rahamata AsvAdana karAna, takhana tAdera madhyakAra ekaTi dala tAdera ravera sAthe zarIka kare;
phale Ami tAdera yA diYechi tAra prati tArA akRtajJa haYa| sutarAM tomarA bhoga kare nAo| zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave|
Ami ki tAdera prati emana kona pramANa nAyila karechi, yA tAdera zarIka karate vale?
Ara Ami yakhana mAnuSake rahamatera svAda AsvAdana karAi takhana tArA tAte Anandita haYa| Ara yadi tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera upara akalyANa pau~che takhana tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki dekheni, nizcaYa AllAha yAra janya icchA riyka prazasta karena evaM saGkucita karena| nizcaYa ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche sei kaomera janya, yArA ImAna Ane|
ataeva AtmIYa-svajanake tAdera haka diYe dAo evaM misakIna o musAphirakeo| eTi uttama tAdera janya, yArA AllAhara santuSTi cAYa evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara tomarA ye sUda diYe thAka, mAnuSera sampade vRddhi pAoYAra janya tA mUlataH AllAhara kAche vRddhi pAYa nA| Ara tomarA ye yAkAta diYe thAka AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare (tAi vRddhi pAYa) evaM tArAi vahuguNa sampada prApta|

AllAha sei sattA yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena, tArapara tomAderake riyka diYechena| erapara tini tomAdera mRtyu devena, pare AvAra tomAdera jIvana devena| tomAdera zarIkadera madhye emana keu Ache ki, ye e theke kona kichu karate pArave? tini pavitra evaM tArA yAdera zarIka kare tA theke tini Urdhve|
mAnuSera kRtakarmera daruna sthale o samudre phAsAda prakAza pAYa| yAra phale AllAha tAdera katipaYa kRtakarmera svAda tAderake AsvAdana karAna, yAte tArA phire Ase|
vala, ‘tomarA yamIne bhramaNa kara| ataHpara dekha pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYechila’| tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
tAi tumi tomAra nijake sarala-saThika dInera upara kAYema rAkha, AllAhara pakSa theke sedina AsAra pUrve, yA pherAno yAve nA| sedina tArA vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye kupharI kare tAra kupharIra pariNAma tAra uparai| Ara yArA satkarma kare tArA tAdera nijadera janya zayyA racanA kare|
yena tini svIYa anugrahe pratidAna dena, yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare tAderake| nizcaYa tini kAphiradera bhAlavAsena nA|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche, tini vAtAsa preraNa karena [vRSTira] susaMvAda vahanakArI hiseve evaM yAte tini tomAderake tA~ra rahamata AsvAdana karAte pArena evaM yAte tA~ra nirdeze nauyAnagulo calAcala kare, Ara yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha theke kichu sandhAna karate pAra| Ara yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|

Ara avazyai Ami tomAra pUrve rAsUlagaNake tAdera kaomera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| ataHpara tArA tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila| ataHpara yArA aparAdha karechila Ami tAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karalAma| Ara muminaderake sAhAyya karA to AmAra kartavya|

AllAha, yini vAtAsa preraNa karena phale tA meghamAlAke dhAoYA kare; ataHpara tini meghamAlAke yemana icchA AkAze char3iYe dena evaM tAke khanDa- vikhanDa kare dena, phale tumi dekhate pAo, tAra madhya theke nirgata haYa vAridhArA| ataHpara yakhana tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAdera upara icchA vAri varSaNa karena, takhana tArA haYa Anandita|
yadio era Age tAdera prati vRSTi varSaNera pUrve tArA chila nirAza|

ataeva tumi AllAhara rahamatera ci‎hnasamUhera prati dRSTi dAo| kibhAve tini yamInera mRtyura para tA jIvita karena| nizcaYa ebhAvei tini mRtake jIvita karena evaM tini sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
Ara yadi Ami emana vAtAsa preraNa kari yAra phale tArA zasyake haluda raGera dekhate pAYa| takhana to tArA akRtajJa haYe par3e|
nizcaYa tumi mRtake zunAte pArave nA, nA pArave vadhirake AhavAna zunAte, yakhana tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare phire yAYa|
Ara tumi andhaderakeo tAdera bhraSTatA theke hidAYAte Anate pArave nA, tumi zudhu tAderai zunAte pArave yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati ImAna Ane, kAraNa tArA AtmasamarpanakArI|

AllAha, yini tomAdera sRSTi karechena durvala vastu theke evaM durvalatAra para tini zakti dAna karena| Ara zaktira para tini AvAra dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM tinii sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
Ara yedina kiYAmata anuSThita have sedina aparAdhIrA kasama kare valave ye, tArA muhUrtakAlera vezI avasthAna kareni| ebhAvei tArA satyavimukha thekeche|
Ara yAderake jJAna o ImAna deYA haYeche tArA valave, ‘tomarA AllAhara vidhAna mata punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karecha| Ara eTi punarutthAna divasa| kintu tomarA jAnate nA|’
ataHpara yArA yulama kareche, sedina tAdera kona oyara-Apatti upakAre Asave nA evaM (AllAhake) santuSTa karateo tAderake valA have nA|
Ara Ami to mAnuSera janya ei kuraAne sava dharanera dRSTAnta peza karechi| Ara yadi tumi tAdera kAche kona AYAta niYe Asa, tave avazyai kAphirarA valave, ‘tomarA to vAtilapanthI’|
emanibhAve AllAha mohara mere dena tAdera hRdaYasamUhe yArA jAne nA|
ataeva, tumi savara kara| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA haka| Ara yArA dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kare nA tArA yena tomAke asthira karate nA pAre |
Alipha- lAma -mIma|
egulo prajJApUrNa kitAvera AYAta,
satkarmazIladera janya hidAYAta o rahamatasvarUpa,
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare evaM yAkAta deYa, Ara tArAi AkhirAte dRr3ha vizvAsa poSaNa kare;
tArAi tAdera ravera pakSa theke hidAYAtera opara evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara mAnuSera madhya theke keu keu nA jene AllAhara patha theke mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra janya vehudA kathA kharida kare, Ara tArA aiguloke hAsi-ThATTA hiseve grahaNa kare; tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara AyAva|

Ara tAra kAche yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana se dambhabhare mukha phiriYe neYa, yena se zunate pAYani, tAra du’kAne yena vadhiratA; sutarAM tAke yantraNAdAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda dAo|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera janya raYeche niAmatapUrNa jAnnAta;
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, AllAhara oYAdA yathArtha| Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tini khu~Ti chAr3A AsamAnasamUha sRSTi karechena, yA tomarA dekhacha, Ara yamIne sthApana karechena sudRr3ha pAhAr3a, yAte tA tomAderake niYe hele nA par3e, Ara tAte char3iYe diYechena pratyeka prakArera prANI; Ara AsamAna theke Ami pAni pAThAi| ataHpara tAte Ami jor3AYa jor3AYa kalyANakara udbhida janmAi|
e AllAhara sRSTi; ataeva AmAke dekhAo, tini chAr3A Ara yArA Ache tArA kI sRSTi kareche! varaM yAlimarA suspaSTa gomarAhIte raYeche|

Ami avazyai lukamAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma evaM valechilAmaH AllAhara prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare seto tA kare nijera janya evaM keha akRtajJa hale AllAhato abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana lukamAna tAra putrake upadeza dite giYe valechila, ‘priYa vatsa, AllAhara sAthe ziraka karo nA; nizcaYa ziraka hala var3a yulama'|

Ara Ami mAnuSake tAra mAtApitAra vyApAre (sadAcaraNera) nirdeza diYechi| tAra mA kaSTera para kaSTa bhoga kare tAke garbhe dhAraNa kare| Ara tAra dudha chAr3Ano haYa du’vachare; sutarAM AmAra o tomAra pitA-mAtAra zukariYA AdAYa kara| pratyAvartana to AmAra kAchei|

Ara yadi tArA tomAke AmAra sAthe ziraka karate jora ceSTA kare, ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei, takhana tAdera Anugatya karave nA evaM duniYAYa tAdera sAthe vasavAsa karave sadbhAve| Ara anusaraNa kara tAra patha, ye AmAra abhimukhI haYa| tArapara AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana| takhana Ami tomAderake jAniYe deva, yA tomarA karate|

‘he AmAra priYa vatsa, nizcaYa tA (pApa-puNya) yadi sariSA dAnAra parimANa haYa, ataHpara tA thAke pAtharera madhye kiMvA AsamAnasamUhe vA yamInera madhye, AllAha tAo niYe Asavena; nizcaYa AllAha sUkSmadarzI, sarvajJa’|
‘he AmAra priYa vatsa, sAlAta kAYema kara, satkAjera Adeza dAo, asatkAje niSedha kara evaM tomAra upara ye vipada Ase tAte dhairya dhara| nizcaYa egulo anyatama dRr3ha saMkalpera kAja’|
‘Ara tumi mAnuSera dika theke tomAra mukha phiriYe niYo nA| Ara yamIne dambhabhare calApherA karo nA; nizcaYa AllAha kona dAmbhika, ahaGkArIke pachanda karena nA’|
‘Ara tomAra calAra kSetre madhyapanthA avalamvana kara, tomAra AoYAja nIcu kara; nizcaYa savacAite nikRSTa AoYAja hala gAdhAra AoYAja’|

tomarA ki dekha nA, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera janya niYojita karechena AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache| Ara tomAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya niAmata vyApaka kare diYechena; mAnuSera madhye keu keu AllAha samparke tarka kare jJAna, hidAYAta o Alo dAnakArI kitAva chAr3A|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAha yA nAyila karechena tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara’ takhana tArA vale, ‘varaM AmarA tAra anusaraNa karava yAra opara AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake peYechi|’ zaYatAna tAderake prajvalita AyAvera dike AhavAna karaleo ki (tArA pitRpuruSaderake anusaraNa karave)?
Ara ye vyakti ekaniSTha o vizuddhacitte AllAhara kAche nijake samarpaNa kare, se to zakta razi A~kar3e dhare| Ara sakala viSaYera pariNAma AllAharai kAche|

Ara ye kupharI kare, tAra kupharI yena tomAke vyathita nA kare; AmAra kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara tArA ye Amala karata Ami tA tAderake jAniYe deva| nizcaYa AllAha antarasamUhe yA Ache tA samparke samyaka avahita|
Ami tAderake alpa bhoga karate dei, tArapara tAderake kaThora AyAva bhoga karate vAdhya karava|
Ara yadi tumi tAderake jijJAsA kara, ‘ke AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena?’ tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha|’ vala, ‘samasta prazaMsA AllAhara; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA’|
AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA Ache tA AllAhara; nizcaYa AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|

Ara yamIne yata gAcha Ache tA yadi kalama haYa, Ara samudra (haYa kAli), tAra sAthe kAlite pariNata haYa Aro sAta samudra, tavuo AllAhara vANIsamUha zeSa have nA| nizcaYa AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAdera sRSTi o tomAdera punarutthAna kevala ekaTi prANera (sRSTi o punarutthAnera) matai| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, draSTA|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna? Ara tini sUrya o cA~dake niYojita karechena| pratyekei calache ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta| Ara nizcaYa tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke sampUrNa avahita|
egulo pramANa kare ye, nizcaYa AllAhai satya evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAke DAke, tA mithyA| Ara nizcaYa AllAhai halena sarvocca, sumahAna|

tumi ki dekhani ye, nauyAnagulo AllAhara anugrahe samudre calAcala kare, yAte tini tA~ra kichu nidarzana tomAdera dekhAte pArena| nizcaYa ete pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|

Ara yakhana Dheu tAderake chAYAra mata Acchanna kare neYa, takhana tArA ekaniSTha avasthAYa Anugatyabhare AllAhake DAke| ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake uddhAra kare sthale pau~che dena, takhana tAdera keu keu (ImAna o kupharIra) madhyapathe thAke| Ara vizvAsaghAtaka o kAphira vyakti chAr3A keu AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra kare nA|

he mAnuSa, tomarA tomAdera ravake bhaYa kara evaM sei dinake bhaYa kara yedina pitA tAra santAnera kona upakAra karate pArave nA evaM santAnao tAra pitAra kona upakAre Asave nA| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| sutarAM duniYAra jIvana yena kichutei tomAderake dhokA dite nA pAre evaM mahApratAraka (zaYatAna) yena tomAderake AllAha samparke dhokAYa phelate nA pAre|

nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa kiYAmatera jJAna raYeche| Ara tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM jarAYUte yA Ache, tA tini jAnena| Ara keu jAne nA AgAmIkAla se kI arjana karave evaM keu jAne nA kon sthAne se mArA yAve| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, samyaka avahita|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
e kitAva sRSTikulera ravera pakSa theke avatIrNa, ete kona sandeha nei|

nAki tArA vale, ‘se tA racanA kareche?’ varaM tA tomAra ravera pakSa theke satya, yAte tumi emana kaomake satarka karate pAra, yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni| haYato tArA hidAYAta lAbha karave|

AllAha, yini AsamAna o yamIna evaM e du’Yera madhye yA kichu Ache, tA chaYadine sRSTi karechena| tArapara tini Arazera upara uThechena| tini chAr3A tomAdera janya kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM nei kona supArizakArI| tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tini AsamAna theke yamIna paryanta sakala kArya paricAlanA karena| tArapara tA ekadina tA~ra kAchei uThave| yedinera parimANa have tomAdera gaNanAYa hAjAra vachara|
tinii gAYeva o hAyira samparke jJAta, mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
yini tA~ra pratiTi sRSTike sundara kare sRSTi karechena evaM kAdA mATi theke mAnuSa sRSTira sUcanA karechena|
tArapara tini tAra vaMzadhara sRSTi karechena tuccha pAnira niryAsa theke|
tArapara tini tAke suThAma karechena evaM tAte nijera rUha theke phu~ke diYechena| Ara tini tomAdera janya kAna, cokha o antarasamUha sRSTi karechena| tomarA khuva sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
Ara tArA vale, ‘AmarA yakhana mATite mize yAva takhana ki AvAra natuna sRSTi hava’? varaM tArAto tAdera ravera sAkSAtke asvIkArakArI|
vala, ‘tomAderake mRtyu deve mRtyura pherezatA yAke tomAdera janya niYoga karA haYeche| tArapara tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAderake phiriYe AnA have’|

Ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera ravera sAmane mAthAnata haYe thAkave! (tArA valave) ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA dekhechi o zunechi, kAjei AmAderake punarAYa pAThiYe dina, AmarA satkarma karava| nizcaYa AmarA dRr3ha vizvAsI’|
Ara yadi Ami icchA karatAma, tAhale pratyeka vyaktike tAra hidAYAta dAna karatAma| kintu AmAra kathAi satye pariNata have ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami jina o mAnuSa ubhaYa dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava’|
kAjei tomarA tomAdera ei dinera sAkSAtake ye bhule giYechile, tAra svAda tomarA AsvAdana kara| nizcaYa Ami tomAderake bhule giYechi, Ara tomarA yA karate, tAra janya tomarA sthAYI AyAva bhoga kara|
AmAra AYAtasamUha kevala tArAi vizvAsa kare, yArA era dvArA tAderake upadeza deYA hale sijadAYa luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera ravera prazaMsAsaha tAsavIha kare| Ara tArA ahaGkAra kare nA|[sAjadAha]
tAdera pArzvadeza vichAnA theke AlAdA haYa| tArA bhaYa o AzA niYe tAdera ravake DAke| Ara Ami tAderake ye riyka dAna karechi, tA theke tArA vyaYa kare|
ataHpara kona vyakti jAne nA tAdera janya cokha jur3Ano kI jinisa lukiYe rAkhA haYeche, tArA yA karata, tAra vinimaYasvarUpa|
ye vyakti mumina se ki phAsika vyaktira mata? tArA samAna naYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, tAdera vAsasthAna have jAnnAta, tArA yA karata tAra ApyAYana hiseve|

Ara yArA pApakAja kare, tAdera vAsasthAna have Aguna; yakhanai tArA tA theke vera hate cAive, tAderake tAtei phiriYe deYA have evaM tAderake valA have, ‘tomarA Agunera AyAva AsvAdana kara, yAke tomarA asvIkAra karate|
Ara avazyai Ami tAderake gurutara AyAvera pUrve laghu AyAva AsvAdana karAva, yAte tArA phire Ase|
Ara tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke, yAke svIYa ravera AYAtasamUhera mAdhyame upadeza deYAra para tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa| nizcaYa Ami aparAdhIdera kAcha theke pratizodha grahaNakArI|
Ara Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataeva tumi tAra sAkSAtera vyApAre sandehe theko nA| Ara Ami oTAke vanI isarAIlera janya hidAYAtasvarUpa karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAdera madhya theke vahu netA karechilAma, tArA AmAra AdezAnuyAYI satpatha pradarzana karata, yakhana tArA dhairyadhAraNa karechila| Ara tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhata|
nizcaYa tomAra rava kiYAmatera dina tAdera mAjhe se viSaYera phaYasAlA kare devena ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karache|
eTA ki tAderake hidAYAta karala nA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve kata prajanmake dhvaMsa karechi yAdera vAsabhUmite tArA calApherA kare? nizcaYa ete vahu nidarzana raYeche| tavuo ki tArA zunave nA?
tArA ki lakSa kare nA ye, Ami zukano bhUmite pAni pravAhita kari| ataHpara tA diYe zaSya udagata kari, yA theke tAdera gavAdi pazu o tArA nijerA khAdya grahaNa kare? tavuo ki tArA lakSya karave nA|
Ara tArA vale, kakhana have e phaYasAlA? tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala|
vala, phaYasAlAra dine kAphiradera ImAna grahaNa tAdera kona upakAra karave nA| Ara tAderake avakAza deYA have nA|
ataeva tumi tAdera theke vimukha thAka, Ara apekSA kara, nizcaYa tArA apekSamANa|
he navI, AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM kAphira o munAphikadera Anugatya karo nA| nizcaYa AllAha samyaka jJAnI, mahAprajJAmaYa|
Ara tomAra ravera kAcha theke tomAra prati yA ohI karA haYa tumi tAra anusaraNa kara| nizcaYa tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha samyaka avahita|
Ara tumi AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kara evaM karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha kona mAnuSera abhyantare du’Ti hRdaYa sRSTi karenani| tomAdera strIdera madhye yAdera sAthe tomarA yihAra* kara, tini tAderake tomAdera jananI karenani| Ara tini tomAdera poSyaderake tomAdera putra karenani| egulo tomAdera mukhera kathA| Ara AllAhai satya kathA valena| Ara tinii saThika patha dekhAna| * strIke mAYera piThera sAthe tulanA karA, ‘tumi AmAra kAche AmAra mAYera piThera nyAYa’ valAkei yihAra vale|

tomarA tAderake tAdera pitR-paricaYe DAka; AllAhara kAche eTAi adhika inasAphapUrNa| ataHpara yadi tomarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna, tAhale tArA tomAdera dIni bhAi evaM tomAdera vandhu| Ara e viSaYe tomarA kona bhula karale tomAdera kona pApa nei; kintu tomAdera antare saMkalpa thAkale (pApa have)| Ara AllAha adhika kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

navI muminadera kAche tAdera nijadera ceYe ghaniSThatara| Ara tAra strIgaNa tAdera mAtAsvarUpa| Ara AllAhara vidhAna anusAre mumina o muhAjiradera tulanAYa AtnIYa svajanarA eke aparera nikaTatara| tave tomarA yadi vandhu-vAndhavadera sAthe bhAla kichu karate cAo (tA karate pAra)| eTA kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma navIdera theke evaM tomAra theke, nUha, ivarAhIma, mUsA o mAraiYAma putra IsA theke| Ara Ami tAdera kAcha theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma|
satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditA samparke jijJAsA karAra janya| Ara tini prastuta kare rekhechena kAphiradera janya yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

he muminagaNa, tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara niAmatake smaraNa kara, yakhana senAvAhinI tomAdera kAche ese giYechila, takhana Ami tAdera upara pravala vAYu o senAdala preraNa karalAma yA tomarA dekhani| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

yakhana tArA tomAdera kAche esechila tomAdera uparera dika theke evaM tomAdera nicera dika theke Ara yakhana cokhagulo vA~kA haYe par3echila evaM prANa kanTha paryanta pau~chechila| Ara tomarA AllAha samparke nAnA rakama dhAraNA poSaNa karachile|
takhana muminaderake parIkSA karA haYechila| Ara tArA bhISaNabhAve prakampita haYechila|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana munAphikarA o yAdera antare vyAdhi chila tArA valachila, ‘AllAha o tAra rAsUla AmAderake ye oYAdA diYechilena tA pratAraNA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa’|

Ara yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila, ‘he iYAsarivavAsI, ekhAne tomAdera kona sthAna nei, tAi tomarA phire yAo’| Ara tAdera ekadala navIra kAche anumati ceYe valachila, AmAdera vAr3i-ghara arakSita, athaca segulo arakSita chila nA| Asale pAliYe yAoYAi chila tAdera uddezya|
Ara yadi tAra vibhinna dika theke tAdera upara zatrura praveza ghaTata, tArapara tAderake phitanA sRSTira AhavAna jAnAno hata, tave tArA tAi karata| ete tArA kAla vilamva karata nA|
Ara erA pUrvei AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSTha pradarzana karave nA| Ara AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra samparke jijJAsA karA have|
vala, ‘yadi tomarA mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYe pAlAte cAo tave pAlAno tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA| Ara se kSetre tomAdera sAmAnyai bhoga karate deYA have’|

vala, ‘AllAha theke ke tomAderake rakSA karave yadi tini tomAdera kona kSati karate cAna? athavA tini tomAdera rahamata dAna karate icchA karena (ke tomAdera kSati karave)’| Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
AllAha avazyai jAnena tomAdera madhye kArA vAdhAdAnakArI evaM kArA tAdera bhAiderake vale, ‘AmAdera kAche Asa’ tArA khuva kamai yuddhe Ase-

tomAdera vyApAre [sAhAyya pradAna o vijaYa kAmanAYa] kRpaNatAra kAraNe| ataHpara yakhana bhIti Ase takhana tumi tAdera dekhave mRtyubhaYe tArA mUrchita vyaktira nyAYa cakSu ulTiYe tomAra dike tAkAYa| ataHpara yakhana bhIti cale yAYa takhana tArA sampadera lobhe kRpaNa haYe zANita bhASAYa tomAdera viddha kare| erA ImAna Aneni| phale AllAha tAdera AmalasamUha vinaSTa kare diYechena| Ara eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

tArA mane kare, sammilita vAhinI cale yAYani| tave sammilita vAhinI* yadi ese par3e takhana tArA kAmanA karave ye, nizcaYa yadi tArA maruvAsI veduInadera madhye avasthAna kare tomAdera khavara jijJAsA karate pArata [tave bhAlai hata]! Ara yadi erA tomAdera madhye thAkata tAhale tArA alpai yuddha karata| * khandaka yuddhe kurAizarA tAdera Aza-pAzera sakala gotrake ekatra kare mahAnavI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma era viruddhe abhiyAna cAlAYa| e kAraNe tAderake AhayAva vA sammilita vAhinI vale ullekha karA haYeche|
avazyai tomAdera janya rAsUlullAhara madhye raYeche uttama Adarza tAdera janya yArA AllAha o parakAla pratyAzA kare evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare|

Ara muminagaNa yakhana sammilita vAhinIke dekhala takhana tArA valala, ‘AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla AmAdera ye oYAdA diYechena eTi to tAi| Ara AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla satyai valechena’| ete tAdera ImAna o AtmasamarpaNai vRddhi pela|

muminadera madhye kichu loka raYeche yArA AllAhara sAthe kRta tAdera pratizruti satye vAstavAYana kareche| tAdera keu keu [yuddhe zAhAdAta varaNa kare] tAra dAYitva pUrNa kareche, AvAra keu keu [zAhAdAta varaNera] pratIkSAYa raYeche| tArA (pratizrutite) kona parivartanai kareni|

yAte AllAha satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditAra janya puraskRta karate pArena evaM tini cAile munAphikadera AyAva dite pArena athavA tAdera kSamA kare dite pArena| nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha kAphiraderake tAdera Akrozasaha phiriYe dilena, tArA kona kalyANa lAbha kareni| yuddhe muminadera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| AllAha pravala zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

Ara Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA tAdera sahayogitA karechila, AllAha tAderake avataraNa karAlena tAdera durgasamUha theke evaM tAdera antarasamUhe bhItira saJcAra karalena| phale tomarA hatyA karacha ekadalake, Ara vandI karacha anya dalake|
Ara tini tomAderake uttarAdhikArI karalena tAdera bhUmi, tAdera ghara-vAr3I o tAdera dhana-sampadera evaM emana bhUmira yAte tomarA padArpaNao karani| AllAha sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|

he navI, tumi tomAra strIderake vala, ‘yadi tomarA duniYAra jIvana o tAra cAkacikya kAmanA kara tave Asa, Ami tomAdera bhoga-vilAsera vyavasthA kare dei evaM uttama panthAYa tomAdera vidAYa kare dei’|
‘Ara yadi tomarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o parakAlIna nivAsa kAmanA kara, tave tomAdera madhya theke satkarmazIladera janya AllAha avazyai mahAna pratidAna prastuta kare rekhechena’|
he navI-patnIgaNa, tomAdera madhye ye keu prakAzya azlIla kAja karave, tAra janya AyAva dviguNa karA have| Ara eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
Ara tomAdera madhye ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave evaM neka Amala karave Ami tAke du’vAra tAra pratidAna deva evaM Ami tAra janya prastuta rekhechi sammAnajanaka riyka|

he navI-patnigaNa, tomarA anya kona nArIra mata nao| yadi tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave (parapuruSera sAthe) komala kaNThe kathA valo nA, tAhale yAra antare vyAdhi raYeche se praluvdha haYa| Ara tomarA nyAYasaGgata kathA valave|

Ara tomarA nija gRhe avasthAna karave evaM prAka-jAhelI yugera mata saundarya pradarzana karo nA| Ara tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara| he navI parivAra, AllAha to kevala cAna tomAdera theke apavitratAke dUrIbhUta karate evaM tomAderake sampUrNarUpe pavitra karate|
Ara tomAdera ghare AllAhara ye, AYAtasamUha o hikamata paThita haYa- tA tomarA smaraNa rekho| nizcaYai AllAha ati sUkSmadarzI, samyaka avahita|

nizcaYa musalima puruSa o nArI, mumina puruSa o nArI, anugata puruSa o nArI, satyavAdI puruSa o nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o nArI, vinaYAvanata puruSa o nArI, dAnazIla puruSa o nArI, siYAmapAlanakArI puruSa o nArI, nijadera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyatakArI puruSa o nArI, AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o nArI, tAdera janya AllAha mAgaphirAta o mahAna pratidAna prastuta rekhechena|

Ara AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla kona nirdeza dile kona mumina puruSa o nArIra janya nijadera vyApAre anya kichu ekhatiYAra karAra adhikAra thAke nA; Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake amAnya karala se spaSTai pathabhraSTa have|

Ara smaraNa kara, AllAha yAra upara niAmata diYechilena evaM tumio yAra prati anugraha karechile, tumi yakhana tAke valechile ‘tomAra strIke nijera kAche rekhe dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara’| Ara tumi antare yA gopana rAkhacha AllAha tA prakAzakArI evaM tumi mAnuSake bhaYa karacha athaca AllAhai adhikatara hakadAra ye, tumi tAke bhaYa karave; ataHpara yAYeda yakhana tAra strIra sAthe vivAha samparka chinna karala takhana Ami tAke tomAra sAthe vivAha vandhane Avaddha karalAma, yAte pAlaka putradera strIdera vyApAre muminadera kona asuvidhA nA thAke; yakhana tArA tAdera strIdera sAthe vivAhasamparka chinna kare|* Ara AllAhara nirdeza kAryakara haYe thAke| * فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا era AbhidhAnika artha hala: tAra (strIra) vyApAre yAYedera praYojana yakhana zeSa hala| bhAvArtha hala: viYera praYojanIYatA zeSe yAYeda yakhana tA~ra strIke tAlAka dila| yAYeda ivana hArisA rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma-era dAsa chilena; AllAha isalAmera pathe hidAYAta dAne tAra prati anugraha karechilena evaM rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma tAke mukta kare pAlaka putra ghoSaNA diYe tAra prati anugraha karechilena| yAYeda viYe karechilena rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma-era phuphAto vona yaYanava vin‌ta jAhazake| tAdera madhye vanivanA nA haoYAYa yAYeda yaYanavake tAlAka dena| pare AllAhara nirdeze rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma yaYanavake viYe karena| era mAdhyame AllAha tA‘AlA pAlaka putrera tAlAkaprAptA strIke viYe karAra vyApAre sAmAjika niSedhAjJA dUrIbhUta karena|

navIra kona pApa have nA AllAha tAra janya yA nirdhAraNa* karechena tA karale; pUrve ye sava navI ativAhita haYeche tAdera vyApAre eTii chila AllAhara niYama| Ara AllAhara vidhAna sunirdhArita, avazyambhAvI| * pAlakaputrera tAlAkaprAptA strIke vivAha karA|
yArA AllAhara vANI pau~chiYe deYa o tA~ke bhaYa kare evaM AllAha chAr3A kAuke bhaYa kare nA*, Ara hisAva grahaNakArIrUpe AllAhai yatheSTa| * e vAkyaTi pUrvollikhita navIdera vizleSaNa|

muhAmmAda tomAdera kona puruSera pitA naYa; tave AllAhara rAsUla o sarvazeSa navI|* Ara AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvajJa| * muhAmmAda sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma sarvazeSa navI; tA~ra para Ara kona navI Asavena nA-e viSaYaTi Ala-kuraAnera ei AYAta dvArA akATyabhAve pramANita|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhake adhika parimANe smaraNa kara|
Ara sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara kara|
tinii tomAdera prati anugraha karena evaM tA~ra pherezatArA tomAdera janya do‘A kare, tomAderake andhakAra theke AloYa AnAra janya; Ara tini muminadera prati atIva daYAlu|
yedina tArA tA~ra sAthe sAkSAt karave sedina tAdera abhivAdana have: ‘sAlAma’| Ara tini tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena sammAnajanaka pratidAna|
he navI, Ami tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSyadAtA, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe|
Ara AllAhara anumatikrame tA~ra dike AhavAnakArI o AlokadIpta pradIpa hiseve|
Ara tumi muminaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke raYeche virATa anugraha|
Ara tumi kAphira o munAphikadera Anugatya karo nA evaM tAdera niryAtana upekSA kara Ara AllAhara upara tAoYAkkula kara; tattvAvadhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

he muminagaNa, yakhana tomarA mumina nArIderake vivAha karave ataHpara tAderake sparza karAra pUrvei* tAlAka diYe deve tave tomAdera janya tAdera kona iddata nei yA tomarA gaNanA karave| sutarAM tAderake kichu upahAra sAmagrI pradAna kara evaM sundarabhAve tAderake vidAYa dAo| * sparza karAra pUrve arthAt sahavAsera pUrve|

he navI, Ami tomAra janya tomAra strIderake hAlAla karechi yAderake tumi moharAnA diYecha, Ara AllAha tomAke phAYa* hiseve yA diYechena tanmadhye yArA tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna tAderakeo tomAra janya hAlAla karechi evaM (viYera janya vaidha karechi) tomAra cAcAra kanyA, phuphura kanyA, mAmAra kanyA, khAlAra kanyAke, yArA tomAra sAthe hijarata kareche, Ara kona mumina nArI yadi navIra janya nijake hevA** kare, navI tAke viYe karate cAile seo tAra janya vaidha| eTA vizeSabhAve tomAra janya, anya muminadera janya naYa; Ami tAdera opara tAdera strIdera o tAdera DAna hAta yAra mAlika haYeche tAdera vyApAre yA dhArya karechi tA Ami nizcaYa jAni; yAte tomAra kona asuvidhA nA haYa| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu| * ‘phAYa’ hacche vinA yuddhe lavdha kAphiradera sampada|

strIdera madhya theke yAke icchA tAra pAlA tumi pichiYe dite pAra, yAke icchA kAche rAkhate pAra; yAke tumi sariYe rekhecha tAke yadi kAmanA kara tAte tomAra kona aparAdha nei; eTA nikaTatara ye, tAdera cakSu zItala have, tArA kaSTa pAve nA evaM tumi tAdera yA diYecha tAte tArA savAi santuSTa have| Ara tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAha tA jAnena evaM AllAha sarvajJa, parama sahanazIla|

erapara tomAra janya (edera atirikta) anya strI grahaNa hAlAla naYa evaM tomAra strIdera (tAlAka diYe) parivarte anya strI grahaNa karAo hAlAla naYa, yadio anyadera saundarya tomAke vimohita kare; tave tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI chAr3A| Ara AllAha sakala kichura upara sajAga dRSTi rAkhena|

he muminagaNa, tomarA navIra gharasamUhe praveza karo nA; avazya yadi tomAderake khAvArera anumati deYA haYa tAhale (praveza kara) khAvArera prasttatira janya apekSA nA kare| Ara yakhana tomAderake DAkA have takhana tomarA praveza kara evaM khAvAra zeSa hale cale yAo Ara kathAvArtAYa lipta haYo nA; kAraNa tA navIke kaSTa deYa, se tomAdera viSaYe saGkoca vodha kare; kintu AllAha satya prakAze saGkoca vodha karena nA| Ara yakhana navIpatnIdera kAche tomarA kona sAmagrI cAive takhana pardAra Ar3Ala theke cAive; eTi tomAdera o tAdera antarera janya adhikatara pavitra| Ara AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deYA evaM tAra (mRtyura) para tAra strIderake viYe karA kakhano tomAdera janya saGgata naYa| nizcaYa eTi AllAhara kAche gurutara pApa|
yadi tomarA kona kichu prakAza kara kiMvA gopana kara tave nizcaYa AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

navIra strIdera janya tAdera pitAdera, tAdera putradera, tAdera bhAidera, tAdera bhAiYera cheledera, tAdera vonera cheledera, tAdera nArIdera o tAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIdera velAYa (hijAva nA karAYa) kona aparAdha nei| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha sakala kichura pratyakSadarzI|

nizcaYa AllAha (Urdhva jagate pherezatAdera madhye) navIra prazaMsA karena evaM tA~ra pherezatAgaNa navIra janya do‘A kare*| he muminagaNa, tomarAo navIra upara darUda pATha kara evaM tAke yathAyathabhAve sAlAma jAnAo| * imAma vukhArI Avula ‘AliYA theke varNanA karena, rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma era upara AllAhara sAlAta’ valate vujhAno haYeche pherezatAdera kAche navIra prazaMsA evaM pherezatAdera sAlAta halo do‘A| Ara imAma tiramiyI suphiYAna saorI theke varNanA karena ye, ekhAne AllAhara sAlAta valate rahamata evaM pherezatAdera sAlAta valate istegaphAra vujhAno haYeche (tAphasIra ivana kAsIra)|
nizcaYa yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake kaSTa deYa, AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte lAnata karena evaM tini tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena apamAnajanaka AyAva|
Ara yArA mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake tAdera kRta kona anyAYa chAr3Ai kaSTa deYa, nizcaYa tArA vahana karave apavAda o suspaSTa pApa|

he navI, tumi tomAra strIderake, kanyAderake o muminadera nArIderake vala, ‘tArA yena tAdera jilavAve*ra kichu aMza nijedera upara jhuliYe deYa, tAderake cenAra vyApAre eTAi savaceYe kAchAkAchi panthA have| phale tAderake kaSTa deYA have nA| Ara AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu| * jilavAva hacche emana pozAka yA puro zarIrake AcchAdita kare|

yadi munAphikagaNa evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche tArA o zahare mithyA saMvAda pracArakArIrA virata nA haYa, tave Ami avazyai tAdera viruddhe tomAke kSamatAvAna kare deva| ataHpara tArA sekhAne tomAra prativezI haYe alpa samaYai thAkave,
abhizapta avasthAYa| tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve, pAkar3Ao karA have evaM nirmamabhAve hatyA karA have|
itaHpUrve yArA ativAhita haYe giYeche, tAdera kSetre eTAi chila AllAhara rIti, Ara tumi AllAhara rItite kakhanai kona parivartana pAve nA|
lokerA tomAke kiYAmata samparke jijJAsA kare, vala, ‘e viSaYera jJAna kevala AllAhara nikaTai Ache, Ara tomAra ki jAnA Ache, kiYAmata haYata khuva nikaTe!
nizcaYa AllAha kAphiraderake lA‘nata karechena evaM tAdera janya jvalanta Aguna prastuta rekhechena|
sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have| tArA nA pAve kona abhibhAvaka evaM nA kona sAhAyyakArI|
yedina tAdera cehArAgulo Agune upur3a kare deYA have, tArA valave, ‘hAYa, AmarA yadi AllAhara Anugatya karatAma evaM rAsUlera Anugatya karatAma’!
tArA Aro valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmarA AmAdera netRvarga o viziSTa lokadera Anugatya karechilAma, takhana tArA AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila’|
‘he AmAdera rava, Apani tAderake dviguNa AyAva dina evaM tAderake vezI kare lA‘nata karuna’|
he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA mUsAke kaSTa diYechila| ataHpara tArA yA valechila, tA theke AllAha tAke nirdoSa vale ghoSaNA karechena| Ara se chila AllAhara nikaTa maryAdAvAna|
he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM saThika kathA vala|
tini tomAdera janya tomAdera kAjaguloke zuddha kare devena evaM tomAdera pApagulo kSamA kare devena| Ara ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, se avazyai eka mahA sAphalya arjana karala|

nizcaYa Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o parvatamAlAra prati e AmAnata peza karechi, ataHpara tArA tA vahana karate asvIkAra kareche evaM ete bhIta haYeche| Ara mAnuSa tA vahana kareche| nizcaYa se chila atizaYa yAlima, ekAntai ajJa|
yAte AllAha munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIdera AyAva dena| Ara mumina puruSa o mumina nArIdera kSamA kare dena| AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
sava prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA kichu Ache tAra mAlika| Ara AkhirAteo sakala prazaMsA tA~rai evaM tini prajJAmaYa, samyaka avagata|
tini jAnena yamIne yA praveza kare evaM tA theke yA vera haYa; Ara AsamAna theke yA nAyila haYa evaM tAte yA uThe* | Ara tini parama daYAlu, atizaYa kSamAzIla|

Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘kiYAmata AmAdera kAche Asave nA|’ vala, ‘avazyai, AmAra ravera kasama! yini gAYeva samparke avagata, tA tomAdera kAche Asavei| AsamAnasamUha o yamIne anu parimANa kiMvA tadapekSA choTa athavA var3a kichui tA~ra agocare nei, varaM savai suspaSTa kitAve raYeche,
yAte tini pratidAna dena tAderake yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare| tAderai janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha kare deYAra ceSTA cAlAYa, tAderai janya raYeche kaThora pIr3AdAYaka AyAva|
Ara yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tArA jAne ye, tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra prati yA nAyila karA haYeche tA satya evaM tA mahAparAkramazAlI o prazaMsita AllAhara pathera dike hidAYAta kare|

Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘AmarA ki tomAderake emana eka vyaktira sandhAna deva, ye tomAderake saMvAda deYa ye, tomarA yakhana puropuri chinna bhinna haYe yAve takhana nizcaYa tomarA natunabhAve sRjita have’?
se ki AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare, nA ki tAra pAgalAmI raYeche? varaM yArA AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe nA tArA AyAva o sudUra vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|

tArA ki tAdera sAmane o tAdera pechane AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache tAra prati lakSya kare nA? yadi Ami icchA kari tAhale tAderake saha bhUmi dhasiYe deva athavA AsamAna theke eka khanDa (AyAva) tAdera upara nipatita karava, avazyai tAte raYeche AllAhamukhI pratyeka vAndAra janya nidarzana|

Ara avazyai Ami AmAra pakSa theke dAUdera prati anugraha karechilAma| (Ami Adeza karalAma) ‘he parvatamAlA, tomarA tAra sAthe AmAra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara’ evaM pAkhiderakeo (e Adeza diYechilAma)| Ara Ami tAra janya lohAkeo narama kare diYechilAma,
(e nirdeza diYe ye,) ‘tumi paripUrNa varma tairI kara evaM yathArtha parimANe prastuta kara’| Ara tomarA satkarma kara| tomarA yA kichu kara nizcaYa Ami tAra samyaka draSTA|

Ara sulAimAnera janya Ami vAtAsake anugata kare diYechilAma, yA sakAle eka mAsera patha evaM sandhyAYa eka mAsera patha atikrama karata| Ara Ami tAra janya galita tAmAra prasravaNa pravAhita karechilAma| Ara katipaYa jina tAra ravera anumatikrame tAra sAmane kAja karata| tAdera madhye ye AmAra nirdeza theke vicyuta haYa tAke Ami jvalanta Agunera AyAva AsvAdana karAva|

tArA tairI karata sulAimAnera icchAnuyAYI tAra janya prAsAda, bhAskarya, suvizAla hAuyera mata var3a pAtra o sthira hAr3i| ‘he dAUda parivAra, tomarA kRtajJatAsvarUpa Amala kare yAo evaM AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpai kRtajJa’|

tArapara yakhana Ami sulAimAnera mRtyura phaYasAlA karalAma takhana mATira pokA jinaderake tAra mRtyu samparke avahita karala, yA tAra lAThi khAcchila| ataHpara yakhana se par3e gela takhana jinarA vujhate pArala ye, tArA yadi gAYeva jAnata tAhale tArA lAJchanAdAYaka AyAve thAkata nA|

nizcaYa sAvA sampradAYera janya tAdera vAsabhUmite chila ekaTi nidarzana: du’Ti udyAna, ekaTi DAne o aparaTi vAme, (tAderake valA haYechila) ‘tomarA tomAdera ravera riyka theke khAo Ara tA~ra zokara kara| eTi uttama zahara evaM (tomAdera rava) kSamAzIla rava’|

tAraparao tArA mukha phiriYe nila| phale Ami tAdera upara vA~dhabhAGgA vanyA pravAhita karalAma| Ara Ami tAdera udyAna du’Tike parivartana kare dilAma emana du’Ti udyAne yAte utpanna haYa tikta phalera gAcha, jhAugAcha evaM sAmAnya kichu kula gAcha|
se AyAva Ami tAderake diYechilAma tAdera kupharIra kAraNe| Ara Ami akRtajJa chAr3A anya kAuke emana AyAva dei nA|

Ara tAdera o ye sava janapadera madhye Ami varakata diYechilAma segulora madhyavartIsthAne Ami aneka dRzyamAna janapada sthApana karechilAma evaM tAte bhramaNa karAra vyavasthA nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma| (tAderake valA haYechila) ‘tomarA esava janapade rAta-dina (yakhana icchA) nirApade bhramaNa kara’|

kintu tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera sapharera madhye dUratva vAr3iYe dina’| Ara tArA nijadera prati yulama karala| phale Ami tAderake kAhinI vAnAlAma evaM tAderake ekevAre chinnabhinna kare dilAma| nizcaYa ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJa vyaktira janya nidarzana raYeche|
Ara nizcaYa tAdera vyApAre ivalIsa tAra dhAraNA satya pramANa karala, phale muminadera ekaTi dala chAr3A savAi tAra anusaraNa karala|

Ara tAdera upara zaYatAnera kona kartRtva chila nA| tave ke AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhe Ara ke tAte sandeha poSaNa kare tA prakAza karAi chila AmAra uddezya| Ara tomAra rava sakala kichura hiphAyatakArI|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake ilAha mane karate tAderake AhavAna kara| tArA AsamAnasamUha o yamInera madhye aNu parimANa kona kichura mAlika naYa| Ara e du’Yera madhye tAdera kona aMzIdAritva nei evaM tAdera madhya theke keu tA~ra sAhAyyakArIo naYa|

Ara AllAha yAke anumati devena se chAr3A tA~ra kAche kona supAriza kAro upakAra karave nA| avazeSe yakhana tAdera antara theke bhaYa vidUrita have takhana tArA valave, ‘tomAdera rava kI valechena’? tArA valave, ‘satyai valechena’ evaM tini sumahAna o savaceYe var3a|
vala, ‘AsamAnasamUha o yamIna theke ke tomAderake riyka dena? vala, ‘AllAha’, Ara nizcaYa AmarA athavA tomarA satpathe pratiSThita athavA spaSTa vibhrAntite patita’|
vala, ‘AmarA ye aparAdha karachi se vyApAre tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA, Ara tomarA yA kara se samparke AmAderakeo jijJAsA karA have nA’|
vala, ‘AmAdera rava AmAderake ekatra karavena| tArapara tini AmAdera madhye saThikabhAve phaYasAlA karavena| Ara tinii zreSTha phaYasAlAkArI o samyaka parijJAta’|
vala, ‘tomarA AmAke dekhAo to, tomarA yAderake tA~ra sAthe zarIka hiseve yukta karecha (tArA kona sattA?) kakhano naYa, varaM tinii AllAha, mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|
Ara Ami to kevala tomAke samagra mAnavajAtira janya susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve preraNa karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA,
Ara tArA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave vala, e oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have’?
vala, ‘tomAdera janya raYeche ekaTi dinera oYAdA yA theke tomarA muhUrtakAla vilamvita karate pArave nA Ara tarAnvitao karate pArave nA’|

Ara kAphiragaNa vale, ‘AmarA kakhano e kuraAnera prati ImAna Anava nA evaM era pUvavartI kona kitAvera pratio nA’| Ara tumi yadi dekhate yAlimaderake, yakhana tAdera ravera kAche dA~r3a kariYe deYA have takhana tArA paraspara vAdAnuvAda karate thAkave| yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila tArA ahaGkArIderake valave, ‘tomarA nA thAkale avazyai AmarA mumina hatAma’|
yArA ahaGkArI chila tArA, tAderake valave, yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila, ‘tomAdera kAche hidAYAta AsAra para AmarA ki tomAderake tA theke vAdhA diYechilAma? varaM tomarAi chile aparAdhI’|

Ara yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila tArA, yArA ahaGkArI chila tAderake valave, ‘varaM e chila tomAdera dina-rAtera cakrAnta, yakhana tomarA AmAderake Adeza diYechile yena AmarA AllAhake asvIkAra kari evaM tA~ra samakakSa sthira kari’| Ara tArA yakhana AyAva dekhave takhana tArA anutApa gopana karave| Ara Ami kAphiradera galAYa zRGkhala pariYe deva| tArA yA karata kevala tArai pratiphala tAderake deYA have|
Ara Ami kona janapade satarkakArI preraNa karalei sekhAnakAra vittavAna adhivAsIrA valeche, ‘tomarA yA niYe prerita haYecha avazyai AmarA tA pratyAkhyAnakArI’|
tArA Aro valeche, ‘AmarA dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite adhika samRddhazAlI| Ara tAi AmarA AyAvaprApta hava nA’|
vala, ‘AmAra rava yAra janya icchA riyka prazasta karena athavA saGkucita karena| kintu adhikAMza loka tA jAne nA|’

Ara tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati emana vastu naYa yA tomAderake AmAra nikaTavartI kare deve| tave yArA ImAna Ane o neka Amala kare, tArAi tAdera Amalera vinimaYe pAve vahuguNa pratidAna| Ara tArA (jAnnAtera) suucca prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha kare dite praceSTA cAlAYa tAderake AyAvera madhye upasthita karA have|

vala, ‘nizcaYa AmAra rava tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA riyka prazasta karena evaM saGkucita karena| Ara tomarA yA kichu AllAhara janya vyaYa kara tini tAra vinimaYa devena evaM tinii uttama riykadAtA|’
Ara smaraNa kara, yedina tini tAdera sakalake samaveta karavena tArapara pherezatAderake valavena, ‘erA ki tomAderai pUjA karata?’
tArA (pherezatArA) valave, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna, Apanii AmAdera abhibhAvaka, tArA naYa| varaM tArA jinadera pUjA karata| edera adhikAMzai tAdera prati ImAna rAkhata’|
phale Aja tomAdera eke aparera kona upakAra kiMvA apakAra karAra kSamatA keu rAkhave nA| Ara Ami yAlimadera uddezye valava, ‘tomarA Agunera AyAva AsvAdana kara yA tomarA asvIkAra karate|’

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA hata takhana tArA valata, ‘eto emana eka vyakti ye tomAdera vAdhA dite cAYa tA theke yAra ivAdAta tomAdera pitRpuruSagaNa karata’| tArA Arao vale, ‘eTi vAnoYATa mithyA vai kichu naYa|’ Ara kAphiradera nikaTa yakhanai satya Ase takhana tArA vale, ‘eto kevala eka suspaSTa yAdu|’
Ara Ami tAderake kona kitAva deini yA tArA adhyaYana karata, evaM tomAra pUrve tAdera prati Ara kona satarkakArIo preraNa karini|

Ara tAdera pUrvavartIrAo asvIkAra kareche| athaca Ami tAdera [pUrvavartIdera] yA diYechilAma erA tAra eka dazamAMzao pAYani, tavuo tArA AmAra rAsUladera asvIkAra karechila| phale AmAra pratyAkhyAna (zAsti) kemana haYechila?

vala, ‘Ami to tomAderake ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchi, tomarA AllAhara uddezye du’jana athavA eka ekajana kare dA~r3iYe yAo, ataHpara cintA kare dekha, tomAdera sAthIra madhye kona pAgalAmI nei| se to Asanna kaThora AyAva samparke tomAdera ekajana satarkakArI vai kichu naYa|’
vala, ‘Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAini, varaM tA tomAderai| AmAra pratidAna to kevala AllAhara nikaTa evaM tini sava kichura uparai sAkSI|
vala, ‘AmAra rava satya pAThiYechena| tini yAvatIYa gAYeva samparke parijJAta|’
vala, ‘satya eseche evaM vAtila kichu sRSTi karate pAre nA, Ara kichu punarAvRttio karate pAre nA|’

vala, ‘yadi Ami pathabhraSTa haYe yAi tave AmAra akalyANei Ami pathabhraSTa hava| Ara yadi Ami hidAYAta prApta hai tave tA ejanya ye, AmAra rava AmAra prati ohI preraNa karena| nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA o ati nikaTavartI’|
Ara yadi tumi dekhate yakhana tArA bhIta-santrasta haYe par3ave takhana pAlAnora kona patha pAve nA evaM nikaTastha sthAna theke tAderake pAkar3Ao karA have|
Ara tArA valave, ‘AmarA tAte ImAna AnalAma’| kintu dUravartI sthAna theke tArA kibhAve ImAnera nAgAla pAve?
athaca tArA itaHpUrve tA asvIkAra karata evaM tArA dUravartI sthAna theke gAYeva samparke kuTamantavya chu~r3e mArata|

Ara tAdera o tArA yA kAmanA karata tAra madhye antarAla kare deYA have, yemana itaHpUrve tAdera samagotrIYadera kSetre karA haYechila| nizcaYa tArA chila vibhrAntikara sandehe patita| * yamIne yA praveza kare tanmadhye raYeche vRSTira pAni, vIja ityAdi| Ara tA theke vera haYa aGkura, udbhida ityAdi| AsamAna theke nAyila haYa riyaka o tAkadIra evaM AsamAne uThe pherezatA, rUha prabhRti|

samasta prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sraSTA, pherezatAderake vANIvAhakarUpe niyuktakArI, yArA dui dui, tina tina o cAra cAra pAkhAviziSTa| tini sRSTira madhye yA icchA vRddhi karena| nizcaYa AllAha sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
AllAha mAnuSera janya ye rahamata unmukta kare dena tA ATake rAkhAra keu nei| Ara tini yA ATake rAkhena, tArapara tA chAr3AvAra keu nei| Ara tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa, tomAdera upara AllAhara niAmatake tomarA smaraNa kara| AllAha chAr3A Ara kona sraSTA Ache ki, ye, tomAderake AsamAna o yamIna theke riyka dive? tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| ataeva tomAderake kothAYa phirAno hacche?
Ara yadi tArA tomAke mithyAvAdI vale, tave tomAra pUrvera rAsUlagaNakeo mithyAvAdI valA haYechila| Ara sakala viSaYa AllAhara-i kAche phiriYe neYA have|
he mAnuSa, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya; ataeva duniYAra jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei pratArita nA kare; Ara var3a pratAraka (zaYatAna) yena tomAderake AllAhara vyApAre pratAraNA nA kare|
nizcaYa zaYatAna tomAdera zatru; ataeva tAke zatru hiseve gaNya kara| se tAra dalake kevala ejanyai DAke yAte tArA jvalanta Agunera adhivAsI haYa|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya raYeche kaThina AyAva; Ara yArA ImAna Ane o neka Amala kare tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o var3a pratidAna|

kAuke yadi tAra asat kAja suzobhita kare dekhAno haYa ataHpara se oTAke bhAla mane kare, (se ki ai vyaktira samAna ye bhAlake bhAla evaM mandake manda dekhe?) kenanA AllAha yAke icchA gomarAha karena Ara yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna karena; ataeva tAdera janya Aphasosa kare nije dhvaMsa haYo nA| nizcaYa tArA yA kare AllAha tA jAnena|

Ara tinii AllAha yini vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara tA meghamAlA saJcAlita kare, tArapara tAke Ami mRta bhUmira dike paricAlita kari, ataHpara tA diYe Ami yamInake tAra mRtyura para jIvita kari; ebhAvei punarutthAna have|

keu yadi sammAna cAYa (tave tA yena AllAhara kAchei cAYa) kenanA sakala sammAna AllAharai| tA~rai pAne utthita haYa bhAla kathA* Ara neka Amala tA unnIta kare| Ara yArA mandakAjera cakrAnta kare tAdera janya raYeche kaThina AyAva Ara odera Sar3ayantra to nasyAt have| * bhAla kathA valate vujhAno haYeche ‘lA-ilAhA illAllAha’| kAro mate tA hala ‘suvahAnAllAha oYAla hAmadulillAha oYAlA ilAhA illAllAhu oYAllAhu AkavAra’| keu valena, tA hala AllAhara yikira o smaraNa| imAma zAokAnI valena, ye kona uttama o bhAla kathA ekhAne vujhAno haYeche|

Ara AllAha tomAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke tArapara zukravindu theke tArapara tomAderake jor3AYa jor3AYa sRSTi karechena evaM nArI tAra garbhe yA dhAraNa kare Ara yA prasava kare tA AllAhara jJAtasArei haYa| Ara kona vaYaska vyaktira vaYasa vAr3Ano haYa nA kiMvA kamAno haYa nA kintu tA to raYeche kitAve*; nizcaYa tA AllAhara janya sahaja| * ‘kitAva’ valate ekhAne ‘laohe mAhaphuya’ vA saMrakSita phalakake vujhAno haYeche|

Ara du’Ti samudra samAna naYa; ekaTi khuvai sumiSTa o supeYa, ArekaTi atyanta lavaNAkta Ara pratyekaTi theke tomarA tAjA gozata khAo evaM AharaNa kara alaGkAra* yA tomarA paridhAna kara| Ara tumi tAte dekha nauyAna pAni cire calAcala kare| yAte tomarA AllAhara anugraha tAlAza kara evaM yAte tomarA zokara kara| * muktA

tini rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna Ara tinii sUrya o cA~dake vazIbhUta kare diYechena; pratyeke paribhramaNa karache ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla paryanta| tini AllAha, tomAdera rava; samasta kartRtva tA~rai, Ara AllAhake chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAko tArA khejurera A~Tira AvaraNerao mAlika naYa|

yadi tomarA tAderake DAka, tArA tomAdera DAka zunave nA; Ara zunate peleo tomAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA evaM kiYAmatera dina tArA tomAdera zarIka karAke asvIkAra karave| Ara sarvajJa AllAhara nyAYa keu tomAke avahita karave nA|
he mAnuSa, tomarA AllAhara prati mukhApekSI Ara AllAha amukhApekSI o prazaMsita|
yadi tini cAna tomAderake sariYe devena evaM ekaTi natuna sRSTi niYe Asavena|
Ara tA AllAhara janya moTei kaThina naYa|

Ara kona vojhA vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA evaM kona bhArAkrAnta vyakti yadi tAra vojhA vahanera janya kAuke DAke tave tAra vojhAra kona aMzai vahana karA have nA yadio se AtmIYa haYa; tumi kevala tAderakei satarka karave yArA tAdera ravake nA dekheo bhaYa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare; Ara ye vyakti parizuddhi arjana kare se nijera janyai parizuddhi arjana kare| Ara AllAhara kAchei pratyAvartana|
Ara andha o dRSTizaktisampanna vyakti samAna naYa,
Ara andhakAra o Alo samAna naYa
Ara samAna naYa chAYA o raudra,

Ara jIvitarA o mRtarA eka naYa;* nizcaYa AllAha yAke icchA zunAte pArena, kintu ye vyakti kavare Ache tAke tumi zunAte pArave nA| * ei AYAta o Agera kaYekaTi AYAte ImAna o kupharIke nAnA upamAYa citrita karA haYeche; ImAna hala dRSTizakti, Alo, suzItala chAYA Ara prANavanta jIvanera nyAYa| pakSAntare kupharI hala andhatva, andhakAra, pracanDa kharatApa Ara mRtyutulya|
tumi to ekajana satarkakArI vai kichu nao|
Ami tomAke satyasaha pAThiYechi susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArIrUpe; Ara emana kona jAti nei yAra kAche satarkakArI Aseni|
Ara tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale tave tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo mithyAvAdI valechila; tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANAdi, granthAvalI o AlokadIpta kitAvasaha rAsUlagaNa esechilena|
tArapara yArA kupharI karechila tAderake Ami pAkar3Ao karechilAma; ataeva kemana chila AmAra zAsti?!

tumi ki dekhani AllAha AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karena, tArapara tA diYe Ami vicitra varNera phalamUla utpAdana kari Ara pAhAr3era madhye raYeche nAnA varNera zubhra o lAla patha evaM (kichu) mizakAlo|
Ara emanibhAve mAnuSa, vicaraNazIla prANI o catuSpada jantura madhyeo raYeche nAnA varNa| vAndAdera madhye kevala jJAnIrAi AllAhake bhaYa kare| nizcaYa AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla|
nizcaYa yArA AllAhara kitAva adhyaYana kare, sAlAta kAYema kare evaM AllAha ye riyka diYechena tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArA emana vyavasAra AzA karate pAre yA kakhano dhvaMsa have nA|
yAte tini tAderake tAdera pUrNa pratiphala dAna karena evaM nija anugrahe tAderake Aro vAr3iYe dena| nizcaYa tini ati kSamAzIla, mahAguNagrAhI|
Ara Ami ye kitAvaTi tomAra kAche ohI karechi tA satya, eTA tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI| nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre samyaka avahita, sarvadraSTA|

ataHpara Ami e kitAvaTira uttarAdhIkArI karechi AmAra vAndAdera madhye tAderake, yAderake Ami manonIta karechi| tArapara tAdera keu keu nijera prati yulamakArI evaM keu keu madhyapanthA avalamvanakArI| AvAra tAdera keu keu AllAhara anumatisApekSe kalyANakara kAje agragAmI| eTAi halo mahA anugraha|
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, ete tArA praveza karave| yekhAne tAderake svarNera cur3i o muktA dvArA alaGkRta karA have evaM sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
Ara tArA valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera duHkha-kaSTa dUra kare diYechena| nizcaYa AmAdera rava parama kSamAzIla, mahAguNagrAhI’|
‘yini nija anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI nivAse sthAna diYechena, yekhAne kona kaSTa AmAderake sparza kare nA evaM yekhAne kona klAntio AmAderake sparza kare nA’|

Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAdera prati emana kona phaYasAlA deYA have nA ye, tArA mArA yAve, evaM tAdera theke jAhAnnAmera AyAvao lAghava karA have nA| ebhAvei Ami pratyeka akRtajJake pratiphala diYe thAki|

Ara sekhAne tArA ArtanAda kare valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake vera kare dina, AmarA pUrve ye Amala karatAma, tAra parivarte AmarA neka Amala karava’| (AllAha valavena) ‘Ami ki tomAderake etaTA vaYasa deini ye, takhana keu zikSA grahaNa karate cAile zikSA grahaNa karate pArata? Ara tomAdera kAche to satarkakArI esechila| kAjei tomarA AyAva AsvAdana kara, Ara yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
nizcaYa AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamInera gAYevI viSaYera jJAnI, antarasamUhe yA raYeche se viSaYeo tini savizeSa avagata|

tinii tomAderake yamInera madhye khalIphA karechena| sutarAM ye kupharI karave, tAra kupharI tAra uparai (vartAve)| Ara kAphiradera janya tAdera kupharI tAdera ravera nikaTa kevala krodhai vRddhi kare evaM kAphiradera janya tAdera kupharI kevala kSatii vRddhi kare|

vala, ‘tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka, sei zarIkadera kathA bheve dekhecha ki? AmAke dekhAo tArA yamInera kI sRSTi kareche? athavA AsamAnasamUhera madhye ki tAdera kona aMzIdAritva Ache? athavA Ami ki tAderake kona kitAva diYechi, yAra kona suspaSTa pramANera upara tArA Ache’? varaM yAlimarA eke aparake kevala pratAraNAmUlaka oYAdAi diYe thAke|

nizcaYa AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamInake dhare rAkhena yAte egulo sthAnacyuta nA haYa| Ara yadi egulo sthAnacyuta haYa, tAhale tini chAr3A Ara ke Ache, ye eguloke dhare rAkhave? nizcaYa tini parama sahanazIla, atizaYa kSamAparAYaNa|

Ara tArA dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara nAme kasama kare valata ye, yadi tAdera kAche kona satarkakArI Ase, tAhale tArA avazyai anya ye kona jAtira ceYe adhika hidAYAtaprApta have; kintu yakhana tAdera nikaTa satarkakArI Asala, takhana tA kevala tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi karala-

yamIne uddhata AcaraNa o kUTacakrAntera kAraNe| kintu kUTacakrAnta kevala tAra dhArakakei pariveSTana karave| tave ki tArA pUrvavartIdera (upara AllAhara) vidhAnera apekSA karache? kintu tumi AllAhara vidhAnera kakhanai kona parivartana pAve nA evaM tumi AllAhara vidhAnera kakhanai kona vyatikramao dekhate pAve nA|

Ara tArA ki yamIne bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale tArA dekhata, kemana chila tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma| athaca tArA to zaktite chila edera ceYeo pravala| AllAha to emana nana ye, AsamAnasamUha o yamInera kona kichu tAke akSama kare deve| nizcaYa tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

Ara yadi AllAha mAnuSaderake tArA yA arjana kareche tAra janya pAkar3Ao karatena, tAhale yamInera upara ekaTi prANIkeo tini cher3e ditena nA| kintu tini ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tAderake vilamvita kare thAkena| ataHpara yakhana tAdera sei nirdiSTa samaYa ese yAYa (takhana tini tAdera pAkar3Ao karena), kenanA AllAha to tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre samyaka draSTA|
iYA-sIna|
vijJAnamaYa kuraAnera zapatha|
nizcaYa tumi rAsUladera antarbhukta|
sarala pathera upara pratiSThita|
(e kuraAna) mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAmaYa (AllAha) kartRka nAyilakRta|
yAte tumi emana eka kaomake satarka kara, yAdera pitRpuruSaderake satarka karA haYani, kAjei tArA udAsIna|
avazyai tAdera adhikAMzera upara (AllAhara) vANI avadhArita haYeche, phale tArA ImAna Anave nA|
nizcaYa Ami tAdera galAYa ver3i pariYe diYechi evaM tA civuka paryanta| phale tArA UrdhvamukhI haYe Ache|
Ara Ami tAdera sAmane ekaTi prAcIra o tAdera pichane ekaTi prAcIra sthApana karechi, ataHpara Ami tAderake Dheke diYechi, phale tArA dekhate pAYa nA|
Ara tumi tAderake satarka kara athavA nA kara tAdera kAche du’Toi samAna, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
tumi to kevala tAkei satarka karave ye upadeza mene cale evaM nA dekheo parama karuNAmaYa AllAhake bhaYa kare| ataeva tAke tumi kSamA o sammAnajanaka puraskArera susaMvAda dAo|
Amii to mRtake jIvita kari Ara likhe rAkhi yA tArA agre preraNa kare evaM yA pichane rekhe yAYa| Ara pratiTi vastukei Ami suspaSTa kitAve saMrakSaNa kare rekhechi|
Ara eka janapadera adhivAsIdera upamA tAdera kAche varNanA kara, yakhana tAdera kAche rAsUlagaNa esechila|

yakhana Ami tAdera kAche du’jana rAsUla pAThiYechilAma, takhana tArA tAderake mithyAvAdI valechila| tArapara Ami tAderake tRtIYa ekajanera mAdhyame zaktizAlI karechilAma| ataHpara tArA valechila, ‘nizcaYa AmarA tomAdera prati prerita rAsUla’|
tArA valala, ‘tomarA to AmAdera matai mAnuSa| Ara parama karuNAmaYa to kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA zudhu mithyAi valacha|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera rava jAnena, avazyai AmarA tomAdera kAche prerita rAsUla’|
‘Ara suspaSTabhAve pau~chiYe deYAi AmAdera dAYitva’|

tArA valala, ‘AmarA to tomAderake amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari| tomarA yadi virata nA hao tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karava evaM AmAdera pakSa theke tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva sparza karave’|
tArA valala, tomAdera amaGgalera kAraNa tomAdera sAthei| tomAderake upadeza deYA haYeche valei ki erUpa valacha? varaM tomarA sImAlaGghanakArI kaoma’|
Ara zaharera dUraprAnta theke eka vyakti daur3e ese valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma! tomarA rAsUladera anusaraNa kara|
‘tomarA tAdera anusaraNa kara yArA tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAYa nA Ara tArA satpathaprApta’|
‘Ara Ami kena tA~ra ivAdAta karava nA yini AmAke sRSTi karechena? Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have’|

Ami ki tA~ra parivarte anya ilAha grahaNa karava? yadi parama karuNAmaYa AmAra kona kSati karAra icchA karena, tAhale tAdera supAriza AmAra kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA AmAke uddhArao karate pArave nA’|

tAke valA hala, ‘jAnnAte praveza kara’| se valala, ‘hAYa! AmAra kaoma yadi jAnate pArata’,
‘AmAra rava AmAke kisera vinimaYe kSamA kare diYechena evaM AmAke sammAnitadera antarbhukta karechena’|
Ara Ami tAra (mRtyura) para tAra kaomera viruddhe AsamAna theke kona sainya pAThAini| Ara tA pAThAnora kona darakArao AmAra chila nA|
tA chila zudhui ekaTi vikaTa AoYAja, phale tArA nithara-nistavdha haYe par3ala|

yadi nA AmAra pakSa theke rahamata haYa evaM kichu samaYera janya upabhogera suyoga deYA haYa|

Ara Ami yadi cAitAma tave tAdera sva sva sthAne tAderake vikRta kare ditAma| phale tArA sAmaneo egiYe yete pArata nA evaM pichaneo phire Asate pArata nA|

Ami rAsUlake kAvya zikhAini evaM eTi tAra janya zobhanIYao naYa| e to kevala eka upadeza o spaSTa kuraAna mAtra|
yAte tA satarka karate pAre ai vyaktike ye jIvita evaM yAte kAphiradera viruddhe abhiyogavANI pramANita haYa|
tArA ki dekheni, AmAra hAtera tairI vastusamUhera madhye Ami tAdera janya catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechi| ataHpara tArA hala egulora mAlika|
Ara Ami eguloke tAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi| phale edera kataka tAdera vAhana evaM kataka tArA bhakSaNa kare|
Ara tAdera janya egulote raYeche Arao vahu upakAritA o pAnIYa upAdAna| tavuo ki tArA zokara AdAYa karave nA?
athaca tArA AllAhara parivarte anya sava ilAha grahaNa kareche, ei pratyAzAYa ye, tArA sAhAyyaprApta have|
erA tAdera kona sAhAyya karate sakSama have nA, varaM eguloke tAdera viruddhe vAhinIrUpe hAyira karA have|
sutarAM tAdera kathA tomAke yena cintita nA kare, nizcaYa Ami jAni tArA yA gopana kare evaM yA prakAza kare|
mAnuSa ki dekheni ye, Ami tAke sRSTi karechi zukravindu theke? athaca se (vane yAYa) ekajana prakAzya kuTatarkakArI|
Ara se AmAra uddezye upamA peza kare, athaca se tAra nijera sRSTi bhule yAYa| se vale, ‘hAr3agulo jarAjIrNa haoYA avasthAYa ke segulo jIvita karave’?
vala, ‘yini prathamavAra eguloke sRSTi karechena tinii segulo punarAYa jIvita karavena| Ara tini sakala sRSTi samparkei sarvajJAta|
yini savuja vRkSa theke tomAdera janya Aguna tairI karechena| phale tA theke tomarA Aguna jvAlAo|
yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena tini ki tAdera anurUpa sRSTi karate sakSama nana? hyA~, tinii mahAsraSTA, sarvajJAnI|

ataeva pavitra mahAna tini, yAra hAte raYeche sakala kichura rAjatva evaM tA~rai dike tomarA pratyAvartita have|

Ara se yadi (AllAhara) tAsavIha pAThakArIdera antarbhukta nA hata,
tAhale se punarutthAna divasa paryanta tAra peTei theke yeta|
ataHpara Ami tAke tRNalatAhIna prAntare nikSepa karalAma evaM se chila asustha|
Ara Ami ekaTi iYAkatIna* gAcha tAra upara udagata karalAma| * zasA, kA~kar3a o lAu jAtIYa gAchake iYakatIna vale| yA kAnDera upara dA~r3Ate pAre nA| tAra janya mAcA tairI karate haYa|
evaM tAke Ami eka lakSa vA tAra ceYeo vezI lokera kAche pAThAlAma|
ataHpara tArA ImAna Anala, phale Ami tAderake kichukAla paryanta upabhoga karate dilAma|
ataeva tAderake jijJAsA kara, ‘tomAra ravera janya ki kanyA santAna evaM tAdera janya putra santAna’?
athavA Ami ki pherezatAderake nArIrUpe sRSTi karechilAma Ara tArA tA pratyakSa karachila?
jene rAkha, tArA avazyai tAdera managar3A kathA vale ye,
‘AllAha santAna janma diYechena’ Ara tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tini ki putrasantAnadera upara kanyA santAnadera veche niYechena?
tomAdera kI hala? tomarA kemana phaYasAlA karacha!
tAhale ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
nAki tomAdera kona suspaSTa dalIla- pramANa Ache?
ataeva tomarA satyavAdI hale tomAdera kitAva niYe Asa|
Ara tArA AllAha o jina jAtira madhye ekaTA vaMzasamparka sAvyasta kareche, athaca jina jAti jAne ye, nizcaYa tAderakeo upasthita karA have|
AllAha se sava theke atipavitra o mahAna, yA tArA Aropa kare,
tave AllAhara (Anugatyera janya) nirvAcita vAndAgaNa chAr3A|
nizcaYa tomarA evaM tomarA yAdera ivAdAta kara tArA-
tomarA AllAhara vyApAre (muminadera) kAuke vibhrAnta karate pArave nA|
jvalanta Agune pravezakArI chAr3A|
AmAdera* pratyekera janyai ekaTA nirdhAritasthAna** raYeche| *eTA pherezatAdera vaktavya|
Ara avazyai AmarA sArivaddha |
Ara AmarA avazyai tAsavIha pAThakArI|
Ara tArA (makkAvAsIrA) valata,
‘yadi AmAdera kAche pUrvartIdera mata kona upadeza (kitAva) thAkata,
