tAhale avazyai AmarA AllAhara manonIta vAndA hatAma’|
ataHpara tArA tA asvIkAra karala ataeva zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave (era pariNAma)|
Ara nizcaYa AmAra prerita vAndAdera janya AmAra kathA pUrva nirdhArita haYeche ye,
‘avazyai tArA sAhAyyaprApta have’|
Ara nizcaYa AmAra vAhinIi vijaYI have|
ataeva kichu kAla paryanta tumi tAdera theke phire thAka|
Ara tAderake paryavekSaNa kara, acirei tArA dekhave (era pariNAma) |
tArA ki AmAra AyAva tvarAnvita karate cAYa?
Ara yakhana tA tAdera AGinAYa neme Asave takhana satarkakRtadera sakAla katai nA manda have!
Aro kichu kAla paryanta tumi tAdera theke phire thAka|
Ara tAderake paryavekSaNa kara, acirei tArA dekhave (era pariNAma)|
tArA yA vyakta kare tomAra rava tA theke pavitra mahAna, sammAnera mAlika|
Ara rAsUladera prati sAlAma|
Ara sakala prazaMsA sRSTikulera rava AllAhara janya|
soYAda; kasama upadezapUrNa kuraAnera|
vastuta kAphirarA AtmambharitA o virodhitAYa raYeche|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata prajanmake dhvaMsa karechi; takhana tArA ArtacitkAra karechila, kintu takhana palAYanera kona samaYa chila nA|
Ara tArA vismita hala ye, tAdera kAche tAdera madhya thekei ekajana satarkakArI eseche evaM kAphirarA vale, ‘e to yAdukara, mithyAvAdI’|
‘se ki sakala upAsyake eka ilAha vAniYe niYeche? nizcaYa e to eka Azcarya viSaYa’!
Ara tAdera pradhAnarA cale gela ekathA vale ye, ‘yAo evaM tomAdera upAsyagulora upara avicala thAka| nizcaYa e viSaYaTi uddezya praNodita’|
AmarA to sarvazeSa dharme emana kathA zunini*| eTA to vAnoYATa kathA chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| * tAdera janya sarvazeSa dharma chila khRsTadharma| kAro kAro mate tA chila kurAizadera dharma|
‘AmAdera madhya theke tAra uparai ki kuraAna nAyila karA hala’? varaM tArA AmAra kuraAnera vyApAre sandehe raYeche| varaM tArA ekhanao AmAra AyAva AsvAdana kareni|
tAdera kAche ki tomAra ravera rahamatera bhAnDAra raYeche yini mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma dAtA|
athavA AsamAna o yamIna evaM e du’Yera madhye yA Ache tAra mAlikAnA ki tAdera? tAhale tArA ArohaNa karuka (AsamAne uThAra) kona upAYa avalamvana kare|
e vAhinI to sekhAne* parAjita have (pUrvavartI) dalasamUhera mata| * هناك dvArA makkAra prati iGgita karA haYeche| kAro kAro mate vadara divasera dike iGgita karA haYeche|
tAdera pUrveo asvIkAra karechila nUhera kaoma, Ada o vahu aTTAlikAra adhipati phira‘Auna,
sAmUda, kaome lUta o AikAra adhivAsIrA| erAi chila (navIdera viruddhAcaraNakArI) dalasamUha |
pratyekei to rAsUladerake asvIkAra karechila| phale AmAra AyAva avadhArita haYechila|
Ara erA to kevala ekaTi vikaTa AoYAjera apekSA karache yAte kona virAma thAkave nA|
Ara tArA vale, he ‘AmAdera rava, hisAva divasera Agei AmAdera prApya AmAderake tAr3AtAr3i diYe dina’|
tArA yA vale se vyApAre tumi dhairyadhAraNa kara evaM AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAUdake smaraNa kara; se chila adhika AllAha abhimukhI|
Ami parvatamAlAke anugata karechilAma, tAra sAthe egulo sakAla-sandhyAYa AmAra tAsavIha pATha karata|
Ara samaveta pAkhIderakeo (anugata karechilAma); pratyekei chila adhika AllAha abhimukhI|
Ara Ami tAra rAjatvake sudRr3ha karechilAma evaM tAke prajJA o phaYasAlAkArI vAgmitA diYechilAma|
tomAra kAche ki vivadamAna lokadera saMvAda eseche? yakhana tArA prAcIra DiGiYe miharAve Asala|

yakhana tArA dAUdera kAche praveza karala, takhana se tAdera bhaYa peYe gela| tArA valala ‘Apani bhaYa karavena nA, AmarA vivadamAna du’pakSa| AmAdera eke anyera upara sImAlaGghana kareche| ataeva Apani AmAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karuna, avicAra karavena nA| Ara AmAderake sarala pathera nirdezanA dina’|

‘nizcaYa e AmAra bhAi| tAra nirAnavvaiTi bher3I Ache, Ara AmAra Ache mAtra ekaTA bher3I| tavuo se vale, ‘e bher3ITio AmAra tattvAvadhAne diYe dAo’, Ara tarke se AmAra upara prAdhAnya vistAra kareche’|

dAUda valala, ‘tomAra bher3Ike tAra bher3Ira pAlera sAthe yukta karAra dAvI kare se tomAra prati yulama kareche| Ara zarIkadera anekei eke anyera upara sImalaGghana kare thAke| tave kevala tArAi erUpa kare nA yArA ImAna Ane evaM neka Amala kare’| Ara erA saMkhyAYa khuvai kama| Ara dAUda jAnate pArala ye, Ami tAke parIkSA karechi| tArapara se tAra ravera kAche kSamA cAila, sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala evaM tA~ra abhimukhI hala| [sAjadAha]
takhana Ami tAke tA kSamA kare dilAma| Ara avazyai AmAra kAche tAra janya raYeche naikaTya o uttama pratyAvartanasthala|

(he dAUda), nizcaYa Ami tomAke yamIne khalIphA vAniYechi, ataeva tumi mAnuSera madhye nyAYavicAra kara Ara pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA, kenanA tA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| nizcaYa yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa tAdera janya kaThina AyAva raYeche| kAraNa tArA hisAva divasake bhule giYechila|
Ara AsamAna, yamIna evaM e du’Yera madhye yA Ache tA Ami anarthaka sRSTi karini| eTA kAphiradera dhAraNA, sutarAM kAphiradera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera durbhoga|
yArA ImAna Ane o neka Amala kare Ami ki tAderake yamIne viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera samatulya gaNya karava? nAki Ami muttAkIderake pApAcArIdera samatulya gaNya karava?
Ami tomAra prati nAyila karechi eka varakatamaYa kitAva, yAte tArA era AYAtasamUha niYe gabhIrabhAve cintA kare evaM yAte vuddhimAnagaNa upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ara Ami dAUdake dAna karalAma sulAimAna| se katai nA uttama vAndA! niHsandehe se chila atizaYa AllAha abhimukhI|
yakhana tAra sAmane sandhyAvelAYa peza karA hala drutagAmI utkRSTa ghor3AsamUha|
takhana se valala, ‘Ami to AmAra ravera smaraNa theke vimukha haYe aizvaryera preme magna haYe par3echi, edike sUrya pardAra Ar3Ale cale geche|* * arthAt sUrya Duve geche|

egulo AmAra kAche phiriYe Ana| ataHpara se eguloke pA o galadeza diYe yaveha karA zuru karala|* * sulAimAna A. jihAdera janya pAlita esava ghor3A kona eka vikAle paridarzana karate giYe aneka kAla kSepaNa karena evaM edike sUrya Duve yAYa| phale ghor3Ara kAraNe AllAhara yikara theke eta dIrgha samaYa virata thAkale tini anutapta hana evaM ghor3Aguloke punarAYa tAra sAmane upasthita kare seguloke tAra zarIYata anuyAYI yaveha kare dilena| Ara segulora gozta sadAkA kare dilena|

Ara Ami to sulAimAnake parIkSA karechilAma evaM tAra siMhAsanera upara rekhechilAma ekaTi deha*, ataHpara se AmAra abhimukhI hala| * Avu hurAirA sUtre vukhArI zarIphera varNanA mate hayarata sulAimAna ekadA tA~ra sakala strIra sAthe sahavAsa karAra dIpta kAmanA vyakta kare valena ye, era phale tAdera garbhe yesava santAna Asave tArA sava AllAhara pathe lar3Aku mujAhida have| tave tini inazAAllAha valate bhule yAna| phale ekamAtra eka strIra garbhei ekaTi santAna haYa, ye chila vikalAGga niSprANa prAYa| bhUmiSTa havAra para e santAnake sulAimAnera daravAre tAra siMhAsane ene rAkhA hale tini svIYa bhula vujhate pere anutapta hana evaM taovA karena|
sulAimAna valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke kSamA karuna evaM AmAke emana eka rAjatva dAna karuna yA AmAra para Ara kArao janyai prayojya have nA| nizcaYai Apani var3ai dAnazIla|
phale Ami vAYuke tAra anugata kare dilAma yA tAra Adeze mRdumandabhAve pravAhita hata, yekhAne se pau~chate cAita|
Ara (anugata kare dilAma) pratyeka prAsAda nirmANakArI o DuvurI zaYatAna [jina] samUhakeo
Ara zekale Avaddha Arao anekake|
eTi AmAra anugraha| ataeva tumi eTi anyera janya kharaca kara athavA nijera janya rekhe dAo, era kona hisAva dite have nA|
Ara AmAra nikaTa raYeche tAra janya naikaTya o zubha pariNAma|
Ara smaraNa kara AmAra vAndA Aiuvake, yakhana se tAra ravake Deke valechila, ‘zaYatAna to AmAke kaSTa o AyAvera cho~YA diYeche’|
[Ami valalAma], ‘tumi tomAra pA diYe (bhUmite) AghAta kara, e hacche gosalera suzItala pAni Ara pAnIYa’|
Ara AmAra pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa o vuddhimAnadera janya upadezasvarUpa Ami tAke dAna karalAma tAra parivAra-parijana o tAdera sAthe tAdera anurUpa anekake|
Ara tumi tomAra hAte eka muTho tRNalatA nAo evaM tA diYe AghAta kara| Ara kasama bhaMga karo nA| nizcaYa Ami tAke dhairyazIla peYechi| se katai nA uttama vAndA! nizcaYai se chila AmAra abhimukhI|
Ara smaraNa kara AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYA‘kUvake| tArA chila zaktimAna o sUkSmadarzI|
nizcaYa Ami tAderake vizeSa kare parakAlera smaraNera janya nirvAcita karechilAma|
Ara nizcaYa tArA chila AmAra manonIta, sarvottama vAndAdera antarbhukta|
Aro smaraNa kara isamAIla, Ala-iYAsA‘A o yula-kiphalera kathA| erA pratyekei chila sarvottamadera antarbhukta|
eTi eka smaraNa, Ara muttAkIdera janya avazyai raYeche uttama nivAsa-
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, yAra darajAsamUha thAkave tAdera janya unmukta|
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe AsIna thAkave, sekhAne tArA vahu phalamUla o pAnIYa cAive|
Ara tAdera nikaTe thAkave AnatanaYanA samavaYasIrA|
hisAva divasa samparke tomAderake e oYAdAi deYA haYechila|
nizcaYa eTi AmAra deYA riyka, yA niHzeSa havAra naYa|
emanai, Ara nizcaYa sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya raYeche nikRSTatama nivAsa|
jAhAnnAma, tArA sekhAne agnidagdha have| katai nA nikRSTa se nivAsa!
emanai, sutarAM tArA eTi AsvAdana karuka, phuTanta pAni o pu~ja|
Arao raYeche e jAtIYa vahurakama AyAva|
ei to eka dala tomAdera sAthei praveza karache, tAdera janya nei kona abhinandana| nizcaYa tArA Agune jvalave|
anusArIrA valave, ‘varaM tomarAo, tomAdera janyao to nei kona abhinandana| tomarAi AmAdera janya e vipada enecha| ataeva katai nA nikRSTa e AvAsasthala’!
tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, ye AmAdera janya e vipada eneche, jAhAnnAme tumi tAra AyAvake dviguNa vAr3iYe dAo|’
tArA Aro valave, ‘AmAdera kI hala ye, AmarA yAdera manda gaNya karatAma se sakala lokake ekhAne dekhachi nA|’
‘tave ki AmarA tAdera ThATTA-vidrUpera pAtra mane karatAma, nAki tAdera vyApAre [AmAdera] dRSTi vibhrama ghaTeche’?
nizcaYai eTi sunizcita satya- jAhAnnAmIdera ei pArasparika vAkavitanDA|
vala, ‘Ami to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra| AllAha chAr3A Ara kona (satya) ilAha nei| yini eka, pravala pratApazAlI|’
AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM etadobhaYera madhyasthita yA kichu raYeche sava kichura rava tini| tini mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAkSamAzIla|
vala, ‘eTi eka mahAsaMvAda’|
‘tomarA tA theke vimukha haYe Acha|’
‘Urdhvaloka samparke AmAra kona jJAnai chila nA yakhana tArA vAdAnuvAda* karachila’| * Adama A. era sRSTira prAkkAle pherezatAdera madhyakAra pArasparika AlocanAra prati iGgita karA haYeche|
AmAra kAche to e ohIi Ase ye, Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra’|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rava pherezatAdera uddezye valechilena, ‘Ami mATi hate mAnuSa sRSTi karava|’
‘yakhana Ami tAke suSama karava evaM tAra madhye AmAra rUha saJcAra karava, takhana tomarA tAra uddezye sijadAvanata haYe yAo’|
phale pherezatAgaNa sakalei sijadAvanata hala|
ivalIsa chAr3A, se ahaGkAra karala evaM kAphiradera antarbhukta haYe par3ala|
AllAha valalena, ‘he ivalIsa, AmAra du’hAte Ami yAke sRSTi karechi tAra prati sijadAvanata hate kise tomAke vAdhA dila? tumi ki ahaGkAra karale, nA tumi adhikatara ucca maryAdAsampanna?’
se valala, ‘Ami tAra ceYe zreSTha| Apani AmAke sRSTi karechena agni theke Ara tAke sRSTi karechena mATi theke|’
tini valalena, ‘tumi ekhAna theke vera haYe yAo| kenanA nizcaYa tumi vitAr3ita|
Ara nizcaYa vicAra divasa paryanta tomAra prati AmAra lA‘nata valavat thAkave|
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke se dina paryanta avakAza dina yedina tArA punarutthita have|’
tini valalena, AcchA tumi avakAzaprAptadera antarbhukta hale-
‘nirdhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|’
se valala, ‘ApanAra ijjatera kasama! Ami tAdera sakalakei vipathagAmI kare chAr3ava|’
tAdera madhya theke ApanAra ekaniSTha vAndArA chAr3A|
AllAha valalena, ‘eTi satya Ara satya-i Ami vali’
‘tomAke diYe evaM tAdera madhye yArA tomAra anusaraNa karata tAdera diYe nizcaYa Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|’
vala, ‘era vinimaYe Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA Ara Ami bhAnakArIdera antarbhukta nai|
sRSTikulera janya e to upadeza chAr3A Ara kichu naYa|
Ara alpakAla pare tumi avazyai era saMvAda jAnave|
ei kitAva avatIrNa AllAhara pakSa theke yini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa Ami tomAra kAche yathAyathabhAve ei kitAva nAyila karechi; ataeva AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara tA~rai Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe|

jene rekha, AllAhara janyai vizuddha ivAdAta-Anugatya| Ara yArA AllAha chAr3A anyaderake abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa kare tArA vale, ‘AmarA kevala ejanyai tAdera ‘ivAdAta kari ye, tArA AmAderake AllAhara nikaTavartI kare deve|’ ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karache AllAha nizcaYa se vyApAre tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena| ye mithyAvAdI kAphira, nizcaYa AllAha tAke hidAYAta dena nA|
AllAha yadi santAna grahaNa karate cAitena, tAhale tini yA sRSTi karechena tA theke yAke icchA veche nitena; kintu tini pavitra mahAna| tinii AllAha, tini eka, pravala parAkrAnta|

tini yathAyathabhAve AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena| tini rAtake dinera upara evaM dinake rAtera upara jar3iYe diYechena evaM niYantraNAdhIna karechena sUrya o cA~dake| pratyeke eka nirdhArita samaYa paryanta calache| jene rAkha, tini mahAparAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla|

tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena eka nAphsa theke, tArapara tA theke tAra jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM catuSpada jantu theke tomAdera janya diYechena ATa jor3A*; tini tomAderake sRSTi karena tomAdera mAtRgarbhe; eka sRSTira para Areka sRSTi, trividha andhakAre**; tinii AllAha; tomAdera rava; rAjatva tA~rai; tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tAraparao tomAderake kothAYa phirAno hacche?*** * ATa jor3A catuSpada jantu: meSera du’Ti o chAgalera du’Ti, uTera du’Ti o garura du’Ti|

tomarA yadi kupharI kara tave (jene rAkha) AllAha tomAdera theke amukhApekSI; Ara tini tA~ra vAndAdera janya kupharI pachanda karena nA evaM tomarA yadi zokara kara tave tomAdera janya tini tA pachanda karena; Ara kona vojhA vahanakArI aparera vojhA vahana kare nA| tArapara tomAdera ravera dikei tomAdera pratyAvartana have| takhana tomarA ye Amala karate tini tA tomAderake jAniYe devena| nizcaYa antare yA Ache tA tini samyaka avagata|

Ara yakhana mAnuSake sparza kare duHkha-durdazA, takhana se ekAgracitte tAra ravake DAke, tArapara tini yakhana tAke nijera pakSa theke niAmata dAna karena takhana se bhule yAYa itaHpUrve ki kAraNe tA~ra kAche doYA karechila, Ara AllAhara samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare, tA~ra patha theke vicyuta karAra janya| vala, ‘tomAra kupharI upabhoga kara kSaNakAla; nizcaYa tumi jAhAnnAmIdera antarbhukta|’

ye vyakti rAtera prahare sidajAvanata haYe o dA~r3iYe Anugatya prakAza kare, AkhirAtake bhaYa kare evaM tAra rava-era rahamata pratyAzA kare (se ki tAra samAna ye erUpa kare nA) vala, ‘yArA jAne Ara yArA jAne nA tArA ki samAna?’ vivekavAna lokerAi kevala upadeza grahaNa kare|

vala, ‘he AmAra mumina vAndArA yArA ImAna enecha, tomarA tomAdera ravake bhaYa kara| yArA e duniYAYa bhAla kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa| Ara AllAhara yamIna prazasta, kevala dhairyazIladerakei tAdera pratidAna pUrNarUpe deYA have kona hisAva chAr3Ai|’
vala, ‘nizcaYa AmAke nirdeza deYA haYeche Ami yena AllAhara ivAdAta kari tA~ra-i janya Anugatyake ekaniSTha kare’|
‘AmAke Aro nirdeza deYA haYeche yena Ami prathama musalima hai|’
vala, ‘Ami yadi AmAra ravera avAdhya hai tave Ami eka mahAdivasera AyAvera AzaGkA kari|’
vala, ‘Ami AllAhara-i ivAdAta kari, tA~rai janya AmAra Anugatya ekaniSTha kare|’

‘ataeva tA~ke vAda diYe anya yA kichura icchA tomarA ‘ivAdAta kara’| vala, ‘nizcaYa tArA kSatigrasta yArA kiYAmata divase nijaderake o tAdera parivAravargake kSatigrasta pAve| jene rekha, eTAi spaSTa kSati’|

tAdera janya tAdera uparera dike thAkave Agunera AcchAdana Ara tAdera nicera dikeo thAkave (Agunera) AcchAdana; edvArA AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake bhaYa dekhAna| ‘he AmAra vAndArA, tomarA AmAkei bhaYa kara’|
Ara yArA tAgUtera upAsanA parihAra kare evaM AllAha abhimukhI haYa tAdera janya Ache susaMvAda; ataeva AmAra vAndAderake susaMvAda dAo|
yArA manoyoga sahakAre kathA zone ataHpara tAra madhye yA uttama tA anusaraNa kare tAderakei AllAha hidAYAta dAna karena Ara tArAi vuddhimAna|
yAra vyApAre AyAvera hukuma sAvyasta haYeche, tumi ki tAke uddhAra karate pArave, ye Ache jAhAnnAme?
kintu yArA nijadera ravake bhaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche kakSasamUha yAra upara nirmita Ache Aro kakSa| tAra nica diYe nadI pravAhita| eTi AllAhara oYAdA; AllAha oYAdA khelApha karena nA|

tumi ki dekha nA, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara yamIne tA prasravana hiseve pravAhita karena tArapara tA diYe nAnA varNera phasala utpanna karena, tArapara tA zukiYe yAYa| phale tomarA tA dekhate pAo haluda varNera tArapara tini tA khar3a-khuTAYa pariNata karena| ete avazyai upadeza raYeche vuddhimAnadera janya|

AllAha isalAmera janya yAra vakSa khule diYechena phale se tAra ravera pakSa theke nUrera upara raYeche, (se ki tAra samAna, ye erUpa naYa?) ataeva dhvaMsa se lokadera janya yAdera hRdaYa kaThina haYe geche AllAhara smaraNa theke| tArA spaSTa vibhrAntite nipatita|

AllAha nAyila karechena uttama vANI, sAdRzyapUrNa ekaTi kitAva (Ala kuraAna), yA vAravAra AvRtti karA haYa| yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kare, tAdera gA ete ziharita haYa, tArapara tAdera deha o mana AllAhara smaraNe vinamra haYe yAYa| eTA AllAhara hidAYAta, tini yAke cAna tAke era dvArA hidAYAta karena| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra janya kona hidAYAtakArI nei|

ye vyakti kiYAmatera dina tAra mukhamanDala dvArA kaThina AyAva ThekAte cAive (se ki tAra mata ye zAsti theke nirApada?) Ara yAlimaderake valA have, ‘tomarA yA arjana karate, tAra svAda AsvAdana kara|
tAdera pUrve yArA chila, tArAo asvIkAra karechila, phale tAdera prati emana bhAve AyAva esechila ye, tArA anubhava karate pAreni|
phale tAderake AllAha duniYAra jIvane lAJchanA AsvAdana karAlena, Ara AkhirAtera AyAva nizcaYa Aro var3a, yadi tArA jAnata|
Ara nizcaYa Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janya pratyeka prakAra dRSTAnta varNanA karechi, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|
vakratAmukta AravI kuraAna| yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAre|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta upasthApana karechena: eka vyakti yAra maniva aneka, yArA paraspara virodhI; evaM Areka vyakti, ye eka manivera anugata, e du’janera avasthA ki samAna? sakala prazaMsA AllAhara; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
nizcaYa tumi maraNazIla evaM tArAo maraNazIla|
tArapara kiYAmatera dina nizcaYa tomarA tomAdera ravera sAmane jhagar3A karave|
sutarAM tAra ceYe adhika yAlima Ara ke, ye AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa kare evaM tAra kAche satya AsAra para tA asvIkAra kare? jAhAnnAmei ki kAphiradera AvAsasthala naYa?
Ara ye satya niYe eseche evaM ye tA satya vale mene niYeche, tArAi hala muttAkI|
tAdera janya tAdera ravera kAche tA-i raYeche yA tArA cAive| eTAi muminadera puraskAra|
yAte tArA yesava manda kAja karechila, AllAha tA Dheke dena evaM tArA ye sarvottama Amala karata tAra pratidAne tAderake puraskRta karena|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAra janya yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA tomAke AllAhara parivarte anyadera bhaYa dekhAYa| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra janya kona hidAYAtakArI nei|
Ara AllAha yAke hidAYAta karena, tAra janya kona pathabhraSTakArI nei| AllAha ki mahAparAkramazAlI pratizodha grahaNakArI nana?

Ara tumi yadi tAderake jijJAsA kara, ke AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi kareche? tArA avazyai valave ‘AllAha’| vala, ‘tomarA ki bheve dekhecha- AllAha AmAra kona kSati cAile tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAdera DAka tArA ki sei kSati dUra karate pArave? athavA tini AmAke rahamata karate cAile tArA sei rahamata pratirodha karate pArave’? vala, ‘AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa’| tAoYAkkulakArIgaNa tA~ra uparai tAoYAkkula kare|
vala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA tomAdera sthale kAja kare yAo, nizcaYa Amio AmAra kAja karava| ataHpara zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave’|
kAra upara lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva Asave evaM kAra upara sthAYI AyAva Apatita have?

nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati yathAyathabhAve kitAva nAyila karechi mAnuSera janya; tAi ye satpatha avalamvana kare, se tA nijera janyai kare evaM ye pathabhraSTa haYa se nijera kSatira janyai pathabhraSTa haYa| Ara tumi tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nao|

AllAha jIvasamUhera prANa haraNa karena tAdera mRtyura samaYa evaM yArA mareni tAdera nidrAra samaYa| tArapara yAra janya tini mRtyura phaYasAlA karena tAra prANa tini rekhe dena evaM anyagulo phiriYe dena ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta| nizcaYa ete cintAzIla kaomera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|
tave ki tArA AllAha chAr3A anyaderake supArizakArI vAniYeche? vala, ‘tArA kona kichura mAlika nA haleo evaM tArA nA vujhaleo’?
vala, ‘sakala supAriza AllAhara mAlikAnAdhIna| AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva ekamAtra tA~rai| tArapara tomarA tA~ra kAchei pratyAvartita have’|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, eka AllAhara kathA valA hale tAdera antara saGkucita haYe yAYa| Ara AllAha chAr3A anya upAsyagulora kathA valA hale takhanai tArA Anande utphulla haYa|
vala, ‘he AllAha, AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTikartA, gAYeva o upasthita viSaYAdira jJAnI; tumi tomAra vAndAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare deve yAte tArA matavirodha karache’|

Ara yArA yulama kareche, yadi yamIne yA Ache tA sava evaM era samaparimANao tAdera janya haYa; tave kiYAmatera dina kaThina AyAva theke vA~cAra janya muktipaNasvarUpa tArA tA diYe deve| sekhAne AllAhara kAche theke tAdera janya emana kichu prakAzita have, yA tArA kakhano kalpanAo karata nA|
Ara tArA yA arjana karechila tAra manda phala tAdera kAche prakAza haYe par3ave evaM yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tA-i tAderake pariveSTana karave|

ataHpara kona vipadApada mAnuSake sparza karale se AmAke DAke| tArapara yakhana Ami AmAra pakSa theke ni‘Amata diYe tAke anugraha kari takhana se vale, ‘jJAnera kAraNei kevala AmAke tA deYA haYeche’| varaM eTA eka parIkSA| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
avazyai tAdera pUrvavartIrA eTA valechila| kintu tArA yA arjana kareche tA tAdera kona kAje Aseni|

sutarAM tAdera kRtakarmera manda phala tAdera upara Apatita haYechila| edera madhyeo yArA yulama kare tAdera upareo tAdera arjanera sava mandaphala zIghrai Apatita have| Ara tArA akSama karate pArave nA|
tArA ki jAne nA, AllAha yAra janya icchA karena riyka prazasta kare dena Ara saGkucita kare dena? nizcaYa ete mumina sampradAYera janya nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
vala, ‘he AmAra vAndAgaNa, yArA nijadera upara vAr3AvAr3i karecha tomarA AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA| avazyai AllAha sakala pApa kSamA kare devena| nizcaYa tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
Ara tomarA tomAdera ravera abhimukhI hao evaM tomAdera upara AyAva AsAra pUrvei tAra kAche AtmasamarpaNa kara| tAra (AyAva AsAra) pare tomAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|
Ara anusaraNa kara uttama yA nAyila karA haYeche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke, tomAdera upara atarkitabhAve AyAva AsAra pUrve| athaca tomarA upalavdhi karate pArave nA|
yAte kAukeo valate nA haYa, ‘hAYa Aphasosa! AllAhara haka AdAYe Ami ye zaithilya karechilAma tAra janya| Ara Ami kevala ThATTA-vidrUpakArIdera madhye antarbhukta chilAma’|
athavA yAte kAuke ekathAo valate nA haYa, ‘AllAha yadi AmAke hidAYAta ditena tAhale avazyai Ami muttAkIdera antarbhukta hatAma’|
athavA AyAva pratyakSa karAra samaYa yAte kAuke ekathAo valate nA haYa, ‘yadi ekavAra phire yAoYAra suyoga AmAra hata, tAhale Ami muminadera antarbhukta hatAma’|
hyA~, avazyai tomAra kAche AmAra nidarzanAvalI esechila, ataHpara tumi seguloke asvIkAra karechile evaM tumi ahaGkAra karechile| Ara tumi kAphiradera antarbhukta chile|
Ara yArA AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare kiYAmatera dina tumi tAdera cehArAgulo kAlo dekhate pAve| ahaGkArIdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAmera madhye naYa ki?
Ara AllAha muttAkIderake tAdera sAphalyasaha nAjAta devena| kona amaGgala tAderake sparza karave nA| Ara tArA cintitao have nA|
AllAha sava kichura sraSTA evaM tini sava kichura tattvAvadhAYaka|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera cAvisamUha tA~rai kAche| Ara yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare tArAi kSatigrasta|
vala, ‘he ajJarA, tomarA ki AmAke AllAha chAr3A anyera ivAdAta karAra Adeza karacha’?
Ara avazyai tomAra kAche evaM tomAra pUrvavartIdera kAche ohI pAThAno haYeche ye, tumi zirka karale tomAra karma niSphala havei| Ara avazyai tumi kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|
varaM tumi AllAharai ivAdAta kara evaM kRtajJadera antarbhukta hao|

Ara tArA AllAhake yathAyogya maryAdA deYani| athaca kiYAmatera dina goTA pRthivIi thAkave tA~ra muSTite evaM AkAzasamUha tA~ra DAna hAte bhA~ja karA thAkave| tini pavitra, tArA yAderake zarIka kare tini tAdera Urdhve|

Ara ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have| phale AllAha yAderake icchA karena tArA chAr3A AsamAnasamUhe yArA Ache evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache sakalei vehu~za haYe par3ave| tArapara AvAra ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have, takhana tArA dA~r3iYe tAkAte thAkave|
Ara yamIna tAra ravera nUre Alokita have, AmalanAmA upasthita karA have evaM navI o sAkSIgaNake AnA have, tAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have| ematAvasthAYa ye, tAdera prati yulama karA have nA|
Ara pratyekake tAra Amalera pUrNa pratiphala deYA have evaM tArA yA kare se samparke tinii sarvAdhika parijJAta|

Ara kAphiraderake dale dale jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have| avazeSe tArA yakhana jAhAnnAmera kAche ese pau~chave takhana tAra darajAgulo khule deYA have evaM jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA tAderake valave, ‘tomAdera madhya theke tomAdera kAche ki rAsUlagaNa Aseni, yArA tomAdera kAche tomAdera ravera AYAtagulo tilAoYAta karata evaM e dinera sAkSAt samparke tomAderake satarka karata’? tArA valave, ‘avazyai esechila’; kintu kAphiradera upara AyAvera vANI satye pariNata hala|
valA have, ‘tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAsamUhe praveza kara, tAtei sthAYIbhAve thAkAra janya| ataeva ahaGkArIdera AvAsasthala katai nA nikRSTa’!

Ara yArA tAdera ravake bhaYa kareche tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| avazeSe tArA yakhana sekhAne ese pau~chave evaM era darajAsamUha khule deYA have takhana jAnnAtera rakSIrA tAderake valave, ‘tomAdera prati sAlAma, tomarA bhAla chile| ataeva sthAYIbhAve thAkAra janya ekhAne praveza kara’|

Ara tArA valave, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya, yini AmAdera prati tAra oYAdAke satya karechena| Ara AmAderake yamInera adhikArI karechena| AmarA jAnnAte yekhAne icchA vasavAsera jAYagA kare neva| ataeva (neka) AmalakArIdera pratiphala katainA uttama’!

Ara tumi pherezatAderake Arazera cArapAza ghire tAdera ravera prazaMsAYa tAsavIha pATha karate dekhate pAve| Ara tAdera madhye nyAYasaGgatabhAve vicAra kare deYA have evaM valA have ‘sakala prazaMsA sRSTikulera rava AllAhara janya’|
hA-mIma|
mahAparAkramazAlI sarvajJAnI AllAhara pakSa theke ei kitAva nAyilakRta|
tini pApa kSamAkArI, tAovA kavUlakArI, kaThora AyAvadAtA, anugraha varSaNakArI| tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tA~ra dikei pratyAvartana|
kAphirarAi kevala AllAhara AYAtasamUha niYe vitarke lipta haYa| sutarAM deze deze tAdera avAdha vicaraNa yena tomAke dho~kAYa nA phele|

edera pUrve nUhera kaoma evaM tAdera pare aneka dalao asvIkAra karechila| pratyeka ummatai sva sva rAsUlake pAkar3Ao karAra saMkalpa karechila evaM satyake vidUrIta karAra uddezye tArA asAra vitarke lipta haYechila| phale Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma| sutarAM kemana chila AmAra AyAva!
Ara ebhAve kAphiradera kSetre tomAra ravera vANI satye pariNata hala ye, nizcaYa erA jAhAnnAmI|

yArA Arazake dhAraNa kare evaM yArA era cArapAze raYeche, tArA tAdera ravera prazaMsAsaha tAsavIha pATha kare evaM tA~ra prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara muminadera janya kSamA ceYe vale ye, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani rahamata o jJAna dvArA sava kichuke parivyapta kare raYechena| ataeva yArA tAovA kare evaM ApanAra patha anusaraNa kare Apani tAderake kSamA kare dina| Ara jAhAnnAmera AyAva theke Apani tAderake rakSA karuna’|

‘he AmAdera rava, Ara Apani tAderake sthAYI jAnnAte praveza karAna, yAra oYAdA Apani tAderake diYechena| Ara tAdera pitA-mAtA, pati-patni o santAna-santatidera madhye yArA satkarma sampAdana kareche tAderakeo| nizcaYa Apani mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|’
‘Ara Apani tAdera aparAdhera AyAva hate rakSA karuna evaM sedina Apani yAke aparAdhera AyAva theke rakSA karavena, avazyai tAke anugraha karavena| Ara eTii mahAsAphalya|’

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche tAderake uccakaNThe valA have; ‘tomAdera nijadera prati tomAdera (Ajakera) e asantoSa apekSA avazyai AllAhara asantoSa adhikatara chila, yakhana tomAderake ImAnera prati AhavAna karA haYechila tArapara tomarA tA asvIkAra karechile’|

tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake du’vAra mRtyu diYechena evaM du’vAra jIvana diYechena| ataHpara AmarA AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi| ataeva (jAhAnnAma theke) vera havAra kona patha Ache ki’?

[tAderake valA have] ‘eTA to ejanya ye, yakhana AllAhake ekakabhAve DAkA hata takhana tomarA tA~ke asvIkAra karate Ara yakhana tA~ra sAthe zarIka karA hata takhana tomarA vizvAsa karate| sutarAM yAvatIYa kartRtva samucca, mahAna AllAhara’|
tinii tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna evaM AkAza theke tomAdera janya riyaka pAThAna| Ara ye AllAha abhimukhI sei kevala upadeza grahaNa kare thAke|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake DAka, tA~ra uddezye dInake ekaniSThabhAve nivedita kare| yadio kAphirarA apachanda kare|
AllAha suucca maryAdAra adhikArI, Arazera adhipati, tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAra prati icchA Apana nirdeze tini ohI pAThAna, yena se mahAmilana samparke satarka karena|
ye dina lokerA prakAza haYe par3ave| se dina AllAhara nikaTa tAdera kichui gopana thAkave nA| ‘Aja rAjatva kAra’? pravala pratApazAlI eka AllAhara|
Aja pratyeka vyaktike tAra arjana anusAre pratidAna deYA have| Aja kona yulma nei| nizcaYa AllAha druta hisAvagrahaNakArI|

Ara tumi tAdera Asanna dina samparke satarka kare dAo| yakhana tAdera prANa kaNThAgata have duHkha, kaSTa saMvaraNa avasthAYa| yAlimadera janya nei kona akRtrima vandhu, nei emana kona supArizakArI yAke grAhya karA have|
cakSusamUhera kheYAnata evaM antarasamUha yA gopana rAkhe tini tA jAnena|
Ara AllAha saThikabhAve phaYasAlA karena evaM tA~ke vAda diYe tArA yAdera DAke tArA kona kichura phaYasAlA karate pArave nA| nizcaYa AllAha, tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

erA ki yamIne vicaraNa kare nA? tAhale dekhata, tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNati kemana haYechila? tArA edera tulanAYa yamIne zaktimattA o prabhAva vistAre pravalatara chila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera pAkar3Ao karalena tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe| Ara tAdera janya chila nA AllAhara pakSa theke kona rakSAkArI|

eTi e kAraNe ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe Asata, kintu tArA tAderake pratyAkhyAna karata| phale AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karalena| nizcaYa tini zaktimAna, AyAvadAne kaThora|
Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI o spaSTa pramANasaha preraNa karechilAma|
phira‘Auna, hAmAna o kArUnera prati| ataHpara tArA valala, ‘se eka yAdukara, carama mithyAvAdI’|

ataHpara yakhana mUsA AmAra kAcha theke satya niYe tAdera kAche upasthita haYechila, takhana tArA valala, ‘yArA tAra sAthe ImAna eneche tomarA tAdera chele-santAnaderake hatyA kara evaM tAdera meYe-santAnaderake jIvita rAkha’| Ara kAphiradera Sar3ayantra kevala vyarthai have|
Ara phira‘Auna valala, ‘AmAke cher3e dAo, Ami mUsAke hatyA kari evaM se tAra ravake DAkuka; nizcaYa Ami AzaGkA kari, se tomAdera dIna pAlTe deve athavA se yamIne viparyaYa char3iYe deve|
mUsA valala, ‘Ami AmAra rava o tomAdera ravera kAche AzraYa prArthanA karachi pratyeka ahaGkArI theke, ye vicAra dinera prati ImAna rAkhe nA’|

‘Ara phira‘Auna vaMzera eka mumina vyakti ye tAra ImAna gopana rAkhachila se valala, ‘tomarA ki ekaTi lokake kevala e kAraNe hatyA karave ye se vale, ‘AmAra rava AllAha’ athaca se tomAdera ravera pakSa theke suspaSTa pramANa niYe tomAdera kAche eseche? se yadi mithyAvAdI haYa tave tAra uparai vartAve tAra mithyA; Ara se yadi satyavAdI haYa tave ye viSaYe se tomAderake oYAdA dicche tAra kichu tomAdera upara Apatita have| nizcaYa AllAha tAke hidAYAta dena nA, ye sImAlaMghanakArI, mithyAvAdI’|

‘he AmAra kaoma, Aja tomAdera rAjatva; yamIne tomarAi kartRtvazIla; kintu AllAhara AyAva Asale ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave’? phira‘Auna valala, ‘yA Ami saThika mane kari tA-i Ami tomAderake dekhAi Ara Ami tomAderake kevala saThika pathai dekhAi’|
Ara ye vyakti ImAna enechila se Aro valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, nizcaYa Ami tomAdera vyApAre pUrvavartI dalasamUhera dinera anurUpa AzaGkA kari’;
‘yemana ghaTechila nUha, ‘Ada o chAmUda-era kaoma evaM tAdera paravartIdera| Ara AllAha vAndAdera upara kona yulama karate cAna nA|’
‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, Ami tomAdera janya pArasparika bhaYArta AhavAna dinera AzaGkA kari’|
‘yedina tomarA pichane pAlAte cAive AllAhara theke tomAderake rakSA karAra janya keu thAkave nA; Ara AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra janya kona hidAYAtakArI nei’|

Ara avazyai pUrve tomAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANAdisaha iusupha esechila, se yA niYe tomAdera kAche esechila tA niYe tomarA sandehe sthira chile; emanaki yakhana se mArA gela takhana tomarA valale, ‘AllAha tAra pare kakhano kona rAsUla pAThAvena nA’| ye sImAlaMghanakArI, saMzaYavAdI, AllAha tAke ebhAvei pathabhraSTa karena|

yArA nijadera kAche Agata kona dalIla-pramANa chAr3A AllAhara nidarzanAvalI samparke vitarke lipta haYa| tAdera e kAja AllAha o muminadera dRSTite atizaYa ghRNArha| ebhAvei AllAha pratyeka ahaGkArI svairAcArIra antare sIla mere dena|
phira‘Auna Arao valala, ‘he hAmAna, AmAra janya ekaTi u~cu imArata vAnAo yAte Ami avalamvana pAi’|

‘AsamAne AroharaNera avalamvana, yAte Ami mUsAra ilAhake dekhate pAi, Ara Ami kevala tAke mithyAvAdI mane kari’| Ara ebhAve phira‘Aunera kAche tAra manda kAja zobhita kare deYA haYechila evaM tAke vAdhA deYA haYechila satpatha theke| Ara phira‘Aunera Sar3ayantra kevala vyarthai haYechila|
Ara ye vyakti ImAna enechila, se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, tomarA AmAra Anugatya kara; Ami tomAderake saThika patha dekhAva’|
‘he AmAra kaoma, e duniYAra jIvana kevala kSaNakAlera bhoga; Ara nizcaYa AkhirAtai hala sthAYI AvAsa’|
‘keu pApa kAja karale tAke zudhu pApera samAna pratidAna deYA have Ara ye puruSa athavA nArI mumina haYe satkAja karave, tave tArA jAnnAte praveza karave, sekhAne tAderake agaNita riyka deYA have|’
‘Ara he AmAra kaoma, AmAra kI hala ye, Ami tomAderake muktira dike DAkachi Ara tomarA AmAke DAkacha Agunera dike!’
‘tomarA AmAke DAkacha Ami yena AllAhara sAthe kupharI kari, tA~ra sAthe zarIka kari ye vyApAre AmAra kona jJAna nei; Ara Ami tomAderake DAkachi mahAparAkramazAlI o parama kSamAzIlera dike|’

‘e vyApAre kona sandeha nei ye, yAra dike tomarA AmAke DAkacha, se duniYA vA AkhirAte kAro DAkera yogya naYa| Ara AmAdera pratyAvartana have AllAhara dike evaM nizcaYa sImAlaMghanakArIrA have Agunera sAthI’|
‘Ami tomAderake yA valachi, acirei tomarA tA smaraNa karave| Ara AmAra viSaYaTi Ami AllAhara nikaTa samarpaNa karachi; nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre sarvadraSTA|’
ataHpara tAdera Sar3ayantrera azubha pariNAma theke AllAha tAke rakSA karalena Ara phira‘Aunera anusArIderake ghire phelala kaThina AyAva|
Aguna, tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra sAmane upasthita karA haYa, Ara yedina kiYAmata saMghaTita have (sedina ghoSaNA karA have), ‘phira‘Aunera anusArIderake kaThoratama AyAve praveza karAo|’

Ara jAhAnnAme tArA yakhana vAnAnuvAde lipta have takhana durvalarA, yArA ahaGkAra karechila, tAderake valave, ‘AmarA to tomAdera anusArI chilAma, ataeva tomarA ki AmAdera theke Agunera kiYadaMza vahana karave’?
ahaGkArIrA valave, ‘AmarA savAi ete Achi; nizcaYa AllAha vAndAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare phelechena|’
Ara yArA Agune thAkave tArA Agunera dAroYAnaderake valave, ‘tomAdera ravake ekaTu DAko nA! tini yena ekaTi dina AmAdera AyAva lAghava kare dena|’

tArA valave, ‘tomAdera kAche ki suspaSTa pramANAdisaha tomAdera rAsUlagaNa Aseni’? jAhAnnAmIrA valave, ‘hyA~ avazyai’| dAroYAnarA valave, ‘tave tomarAi do‘A kara| Ara kAphiradera do‘A kevala niSphalai haYa’|
nizcaYa Ami AmAra rAsUladerake o muminaderake duniYAra jIvane evaM yedina sAkSIgaNa danDAYamAna have sedina sAhAyya karava|
yedina yAlimadera kona oyara-Apatti tAdera upakAra karave nA| Ara tAdera janya raYeche lA‘nata evaM tAdera janya raYeche nikRSTa nivAsa|
Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke hidAYAta dAna karechilAma evaM vanI isarAIlake kitAvera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma,
yA jJAna-vuddhisampannadera janya hidAYAta o upadeza|
kAjei tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| Ara tumi tomAra truTira janya kSamA prArthanA kara evaM sakAla- sandhyAYa tomAra ravera prazaMsAsaha tAsavIha pATha kara|

nizcaYa yArA tAdera nikaTa AsA kona dalIla- pramANa chAr3Ai AllAhara nidarzanAvalI samparke vitarka kare, tAdera antarasamUhe Ache kevala ahaGkAra, tArA kichutei sekhAne (sAphalyera manayile) pau~chave nA| kAjei tumi AllAhara kAche AzraYa cAo, nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
avazyai AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karA mAnuSa sRSTi karAra ceYe var3a viSaYa; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai tA jAne nA|
Ara samAna haYa nA andha o dRSTizaktisampanna vyakti evaM yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, Ara yArA aparAdhI| tomarA khuva sAmAnyai upadeza grahaNa kare thAka|
nizcaYa kiYAmata Asavei, ete kona sandeha nei| kintu adhikAMza loka ImAna Ane nA|

Ara tomAdera rava valechena, ‘tomarA AmAke DAka, Ami tomAdera janya sAr3A deva| nizcaYa yArA ahaGkAra vazataH AmAra ivAdAta theke vimukha thAke, tArA acirei lAJchita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme praveza karave|’

AllAha, yini tomAdera janya rAta vAniYechena yAte tomarA tAte vizrAma karate pAra evaM dinake karechena Alokojjvala| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuSera prati var3ai anugrahazIla; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tini AllAha, tomAdera rava; sava kichura sRSTikartA, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| sutarAM tomAderake kothAYa phiriYe neYA hacche?
yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kare, tAderake ebhAvei phiriYe neYA haYa|

AllAha, yini tomAdera janya yamInake sthitizIla karechena evaM AsamAnake karechena chAda| Ara tini tomAderake AkRti diYechena, ataHpara tomAdera AkRtike sundara karechena evaM tini pavitra vastu theke tomAderake riyka dAna karechena| tinii AllAha, tomAdera rava| sutarAM sRSTikulera rava AllAha kata varakatamaYa;
tini ciraJjIva, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| sutarAM tomarA dInake tA~ra janya ekaniSTha kare tA~ke DAka| sakala prazaMsA AllAhara yini sRSTikulera rava|

vala, ‘yehetu AmAra ravera pakSa theke AmAra kAche suspaSTa pramANAdi eseche, tAi tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake AhavAna kara, nizcaYa tAdera ivAdAta karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche| Ara sRSTikulera ravera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karate Ami AdiSTa haYechi’|

tinii tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena| tArapara zukravindu theke, tArapara ‘AlAkA’* theke| ataHpara tini tomAderake zizurUpe vera kare Anena| tArapara yena tomarA tomAdera yauvane padArpaNa kara, ataHpara yena tomarA vRddha haYe yAo| Ara tomAdera keu keu era pUrvei mArA yAYa| Ara yAte tomarA nirdhArita samaYe pau~che yAo| Ara yAte tomarA anudhAvana kara| * ‘AlAkA’ samparke dra. sUrA mu’minUna 23 era 14 naM AYAtera TIkA|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu dena| Ara tini yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta nena, takhana tini ejanya valena ‘hao’, phale tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalI samparke vAkavitanDA kare? tAderake kothAYa phirAno hacche?
yArA kitAva evaM AmAra rAsUlagaNake yA diYe Ami preraNa karechi tA asvIkAra kare, ataeva tArA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
yakhana tAdera galadeze ver3I o zikala thAkave, tAderake Tene niYe yAoYA have-
phuTanta pAnite, ataHpara tAderake Agune por3Ano have|
tArapara tAderake valA have, ‘kothAYa tArA, yAderake tomarA zarIka karate-
AllAha chAr3A’? tArA valave, ‘tArA to AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche’, varaM era pUrve AmarA kona kichuke AhavAna karini’| ebhAvei AllAha kAphiraderake pathabhraSTa karena|
eTA e janya ye, tomarA yamIne ayathA ullAsa karate evaM ejanya ye, tomarA ahaGkAra karate|
tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAsamUha diYe praveza kara cirakAla tAte avasthAnera janya| ataeva ahaGkArIdera vAsasthAna katainA nikRSTa!
ataeva tumi dhairyadhAraNa kara| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya| Ara Ami tAderake ye oYAdA dei, tAra kichu aMza yadi tomAke dekhAi athavA tomAke mRtyu dei, tAhaleo tArA AmAra kAche pratyAvartita have|

Ara avazyai Ami tomAra pUrve aneka rAsUla pAThiYechi| tAdera madhye kAro kAro kAhinI Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karechi Ara kAro kAro kAhinI tomAra kAche varNanA karini| Ara AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana niYe AsA kona rAsUlera ucit naYa| tArapara yakhana AllAhara nirdeza Asave, takhana nyAYasaGgatabhAve phaYasAlA karA have| Ara takhanai vAtilapanthIrA kSatigrasta have|
AllAhai tomAdera janya gavAdi pazu sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA edera katakera upara ArohaNa karate pAra Ara kataka tomarA khete pAra|

Ara ete tomAdera janya raYeche aneka upakAra evaM yAte tomarA nijadera antare ye praYojana anubhava kara, ogulo dvArA tA pUrNa karate pAra| ogulora upara Ara nauyAnera upara tomAderake vahana karA haYa|
Ara tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna| ataeva tomarA AllAhara kon kon nidarzanake asvIkAra karave?

tArA ki yamIne bhramaNa kareni, tA hale tArA dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila? tArA yamIne chila tAdera ceYe saMkhyAYa adhika, Ara zaktite o kIrtite tAdera ceYe adhika pravala| ataHpara tArA yA arjana karata tA tAdera kona kAje Aseni|

tArapara tAdera kAche yakhana tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa pramANAdisaha Asala takhana tArA tAdera nijadera kAche ye vidyA chila tAtei utphulla haYe uThala| Ara yA niYe tA~rA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tA-i tAderake pariveSTana karala|
tArapara tArA yakhana AmAra AyAva dekhala takhana valala, ‘AmarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna AnalAma, Ara yAderake AmarA tAra sAthe zarIka karatAma tAderake pratyAkhyAna karalAma’|
sutarAM tArA yakhana AmAra AyAva dekhala takhana tAdera ImAna tAdera kona upakAra karala nA| eTA AllAhara vidhAna, tA~ra vAndAdera madhye cale Asache| Ara takhanai kAphirarA kSatigrasta haYeche|
hA-mIma|
(e grantha) parama karuNAmaYa asIma daYAlura pakSa theke nAyilakRta|
emana eka kitAva, yAra AYAtagulo jJAnI kaomera janya vizadabhAve varNanA karA haYeche, kuraAnarUpe AravI bhASAYa|
susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI| ataHpara tAdera adhikAMzai mukha phiriYe niYeche, ataeva tArA zunave nA|

Ara tArA vale, ‘tumi AmAderake yAra prati AhavAna karacha se viSaYe AmAdera antarasamUha AcchAdita, AmAdera kAnera madhye raYeche vadhiratA Ara tomAra o AmAdera madhye raYeche antarAYa| ataeva tumi (tomAra) kAja kara, nizcaYa AmarA (AmAdera) kAja karava|

vala, ‘Ami kevala tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa| AmAra kAche ohI pAThAno haYa ye, tomAdera ilAha kevalamAtra eka ilAha| ataeva tomarA tA~ra pathe dRr3habhAve aTala thAka evaM tA~ra kAche kSamA cAo’| Ara muzarikadera janya dhvaMsa,
yArA yAkAta deYa nA| Ara tArAi AkhirAtera asvIkArakArI|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche niravacchinna pratidAna|
vala, ‘tomarA ki tA~ke asvIkAra karave yini du’dine yamIna sRSTi karechena? Ara tomarA ki tA~ra samakakSa vAnAte cAccha? tinii sRSTikulera rava’|
Ara tAra uparibhAge tini dRr3ha parvatamAlA sthApana karechena evaM tAte varakata diYechena, Ara tAte cAradine prArthIdera janya samabhAve khAdya nirUpaNa kare diYechena|

tArapara tini AsamAnera dike manoniveza karena| tA chila dho~YA| tArapara tini AsamAna o yamInake valalena, ‘tomarA ubhaYe svecchAYa athavA anicchAYa Asa’| tArA ubhaYe valala, ‘AmarA anugata haYe AsalAma’|

tArapara tini du’dine AsamAnasamUhake sAta AsamAne pariNata karalena| Ara pratyeka AsamAne tAra kAryAvalI ohIra mAdhyame jAniYe dilena| Ara Ami nikaTavartI AsamAnake pradIpamAlAra dvArA susajjita karechi Ara surakSita karechi| e hala mahA parAkramazAlI sarvajJera nirdhAraNa|
tavuo yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tumi vale dAo, ‘Ada o sAmUdera dhvaMsera matai eka mahAdhvaMsa samparke Ami tomAderake satarka karachi’|

yakhana tAdera agra o pazcAt theke rAsUlagaNa tAdera kAche ese valechila ye, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta karo nA’| tArA valechila, ‘yadi AmAdera rava icchA karatena tAhale avazyai pherezatA nAyila karatena| ataeva, tomAderake yA diYe pAThAno haYeche nizcaYa AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna karalAma|

Ara ‘Ada sampradAYa, tArA yamIne ayathA ahaGkAra karata evaM valata, ‘AmAdera ceYe adhika zaktizAlI ke Ache’? tave ki tArA lakSya kareni ye, nizcaYa AllAha yini tAderake sRSTi karechena tAdera ceYe adhika zaktizAlI? Ara tArA AmAra AYAtaguloke asvIkAra karata|

tArapara Ami tAdera upara azubha dinagulote jhaJjhAvAYu pAThAlAma yAte tAderake duniYAra jIvane lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva AsvAdana karAte pAri| Ara AkhirAtera AyAva to adhikatara lAJchanAdAYaka evaM tAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|

Ara sAmUda sampradAYa, Ami tAderake saThika pathera nirdezanA diYechilAma; kintu tArA saThika pathe calAra parivarte andha pathe calAi pachanda karechila| phale tAdera arjanera kAraNei lAJchanAdAYaka AyAvera vajrAghAta tAderake pAkar3Ao karala|
Ara Ami tAderake rakSA karalAma yArA ImAna enechila evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata|
Ara yedina AllAhara duzamanaderake Agunera dike samaveta karA have takhana tAderake vibhinna dale vinyasta karA have|
avazeSe tArA yakhana jAhAnnAmera kAche pau~chave, takhana tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha o tAdera cAmar3A tAdera viruddhe tAdera kRtakarma samparke sAkSya deve|

Ara tArA tAdera cAmar3Aguloke valave, ‘kena tomarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya dile’? tArA valave, ‘AllAha AmAdera vAkazakti diYechena yini savakichuke vAkazakti diYechena| tini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena evaM tA~rai prati tomarA pratyAvartita have|’

tomarA kichui gopana karate nA ei vizvAse ye, tomAdera kAna, cokhasamUha o cAmar3AsamUha tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve nA, varaM tomarA mane karechile ye, tomarA yA kichu karate AllAha tAra aneka kichui jAnena nA|
Ara tomAdera e dhAraNA yA tomarA tomAdera rava samparke poSaNa karate, tAi tomAdera dhvaMsa kareche| phale tomarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe gele|
ataHpara yadi tArA dhairyadhAraNa kare tave Agunai have tAdera AvAsa evaM yadi tArA AllAhake santuSTa karate cAYa, tavuo tArA AllAhara santoSaprAptadera antarbhukta have nA|

Ara Ami tAdera janya manda sahacaravRnda nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma, yArA tAdera sAmane o pichane yA Ache tA tAdera dRSTite cAkacikyamaYa kare diYechila| Ara tAdera upare AyAvera vANI satye pariNata hala, tAdera pUrve gata haoYA jina o mAnuSera vibhinna jAtira nyAYa, nizcaYa erA chila kSatigrasta|
Ara kAphirarA vale, ‘tomarA e kuraAnera nirdeza zuna nA evaM era AvRtti kAle zoragola sRSTi kara, yena tomarA jaYI hate pAra|’
sutarAM Ami avazyai kAphiraderake kaThina AyAva AsvAdana karAva evaM Ami avazyai tAdera kAjera nikRSTatama pratidAna deva|
ei Aguna, AllAhara duzamanadera pratidAna| sekhAne thAkave tAdera janya sthAYI nivAsa tArA ye AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra karata tArai pratiphalasvarUpa|

Ara kAphirarA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, jina o mAnuSera madhye yArA AmAderake pathabhraSTa kareche tAderake AmAdera dekhiYe dina| AmarA tAdera ubhaYake AmAdera pAYera nIce rAkhava, yAte tArA nikRSTadera antarbhukta haYa|

nizcaYa yArA vale, ‘AllAhai AmAdera rava’ ataHpara avicala thAke, pherezatArA tAdera kAche nAyila haYa (evaM vale,) ‘tomarA bhaYa peYo nA, duzcintA karo nA evaM sei jAnnAtera susaMvAda grahaNa kara tomAderake yAra oYAdA deYA haYechila’|
‘AmarA duniYAra jIvane tomAdera vandhu evaM AkhirAteo| sekhAne tomAdera janya thAkave yA tomAdera mana cAive evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya Aro thAkave yA tomarA dAvI karave|
parama kSamAzIla o asIma daYAlu AllAhara pakSa theke ApyAYanasvarUpa|
Ara tAra ceYe kAra kathA uttama, ye AllAhara dike dAoYAta deYa, satkarma kare evaM vale, avazyai Ami musalimadera antarbhukta’?
Ara bhAla o manda samAna hate pAre nA| mandake pratihata kara tA dvArA yA utkRSTatara, phale tomAra o yAra madhye zatrutA raYeche se yena haYe yAve tomAra antaraGga vandhu|
Ara eTi tArAi prApta have yArA dhairyadhAraNa karave, Ara era adhikArI kevala tArAi haYa yArA mahAbhAgyavAna|
Ara yadi zaYatAnera pakSa theke kona kumantraNA kakhano tomAke prarocita kare, tAhale tumi AllAhara nikaTa AzraYa prArthanA karave| nizcaYai tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJAta|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche rAta o dina, sUrya o cA~da | tomarA nA sUryake sijadA karave, nA cA~dake| Ara tomarA AllAhake sijadA kara yini egulo sRSTi karechena, yadi tomarA kevalamAtra tA~rai ivAdAta kara|
ataHpara yadi erA ahaGkAra kareo tave yArA tomAra ravera nikaTe raYeche tArA dina-rAta tA~rai tAsavIha pATha karache evaM tArA klAnti vodha kare nA|[sAjadAha]

tA~ra ArekaTi nidarzana hala ei ye, tumi yamInake dekhate pAo zuSka-anurvara, ataHpara yakhana Ami tAra upara pAni varSaNa kari takhana tA Andolita o sphIta haYa| nizcaYai yini yamInake jIvita karena tini mRtaderao jIvitakArI| nizcaYa tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|

nizcaYa yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha vikRta kare tArA AmAra agocare naYa| ye agnite nikSipta have se ki uttama, nA ye kiYAmata divase nirApadabhAve upasthita have? tomAdera yA icchA Amala kara| nizcaYa tomarA yA Amala kara tini tAra samyaka draSTA|
nizcaYa yArA upadeza [kuraAna] AsAra parao tA asvIkAra kare [ tAderake avazyai era pariNAma bhoga karate have]| Ara eTi nizcaYa eka sammAnita grantha|
vAtila ete anupraveza karate pAre nA, nA sAmane theke, nA pichana theke| eTi prajJAmaYa, saprazaMsitera pakSa theke nAyilakRta|
tomAke yA valA hacche, tomAra pUrvavartI rAsUladerakeo tAi valA haYechila| nizcaYa tomAra rava ekAntai kSamAzIla evaM yantraNAdAYaka AyAva dAtA|

Ara Ami yadi eTAke anAravI bhASAra kuraAna vAnAtAma tave tArA nizcitabhAvei valata, ‘era AYAtasamUha vizadabhASAYa varNita haYani kena’? eTi anAravI bhASAYa Ara rAsUla AravI bhASI! vala, ‘eTi muminadera janya hidAYAta o pratiSedhaka| Ara yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera kAne raYeche vadhiratA Ara kuraAna tAdera janya have andhatva| tAderakei DAkA have dUravartI sthAna theke|

Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma| ataHpara tAte matabheda karA haYa| Ara yadi tomAra ravera pakSa theke ekaTi vANI pUrvei nA hata, tave edera madhye phaYasAlA haYe yeta| Ara erA nizcaYa se samparke vibhrAntikara saMzaYei lipta raYeche|
ye satkarma kare se tAra nijera janyai tA kare| Ara ye asatkarma kare tA tAra uparai vartAve| tomAra rava tA~ra vAndAdera prati moTei yAlima nana|

kiYAmatera jJAna tA~rai dike pratyAvartita haYa| tA~ra ajJAtasAre AvaraNa hate phalasamUha vera haYa nA, kona nArI garbhadhAraNa kare nA evaM santAna prasavao kare nA evaM sedina yakhana tini tAderake AhavAna kare valavena, ‘AmAra zarIkarA kothAYa?’ tArA valave, ‘AmarA ApanAke jAnAcchi ye, e vyApAre AmAdera theke kona sAkSI nei|’
Ara pUrve yAderake tArA DAkata tArA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve evaM tArA vizvAsa karave, tAdera palAYanera kona jAYagA nei|
kalyANa prArthanAYa mAnuSa virakta haYa nA; Ara yadi akalyANa tAke sparza kare tAhale se nirAza o hatAza haYe par3e|

AvAra Ami yadi tAke Apatita akalyANera para rahamatera svAda AsvAdana karAi takhana se avazyai vale thAke, ‘eTi AmAra prApya, AmAra mane haYa nA kiYAmata have, AmAke yadi AmAra ravera kAche phiriYeo neYA haYa tavuo tAra kAche AmAra janya kalyANai thAkave|’ (AllAha valena) ‘Ami avazyai kAphiraderake tAdera Amala samparke avahita karava evaM avazyai tAderake kaThina AyAvera svAda AsvAdana karAva|
Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se vimukha haYa evaM dUre sare yAYa; Ara yakhana akalyANa tAke sparza kare takhana se dIrgha doAkArI haYa|
vala, ‘tomarA ki lakSya karecha, tA yadi (kuraAna) AllAhara kAcha theke ese thAke Ara tomarA tA asvIkAra kara, tave ye vyakti ghora virodhitAYa lipta tAra ceYe adhika bhraSTa Ara ke’?

vizvajagate o tAdera nijadera madhye Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva yAte tAdera kAche suspaSTa haYa ye, eTi (kuraAna) satya; tomAra ravera janya eTAi yatheSTa naYa ki ye, tini sakala viSaYe sAkSI?
jene rAkha, nizcaYa tArA tAdera ravera sAkSAtera viSaYe sandehe raYeche; jene rAkha, nizcaYa tini savakichuke pariveSTana kare Achena|
hA-mIma|
‘Aina-sIna-kApha|
emanibhAve mahAparAkramazAlI o prajJAmaYa AllAha tomAra kAche ohI preraNa karena evaM tomAra pUrvavartIdera kAcheo|
AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache evaM yamIne yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai| tinii samunnata, sumahAna|

upara theke AsamAna pheTe par3Ara upakrama haYa; Ara pherezatArA tAdera ravera prazaMsAYa tAsavIha pATha kare evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kare; jene rekha, AllAha, tini to ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara yArA tA~ra parivarte anyaderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAha tAdera prati samyaka dRSTidAtA evaM tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

Ara ebhAvei Ami tomAra opara AravI bhASAYa kuraAna nAyila karechi yAte tumi mUla janapada o tAra AzapAzera vAsindAderake satarka karate pAra, Ara yAte ‘ekatrita haoYAra dina’ era vyApAre satarka karate pAra, yAte kona sandeha nei, ekadala thAkave jAnnAte Areka dala jvalanta Agune|
AllAha icchA karale tAderake eka jAtibhukta karate pAratena; kintu tini yAke cAna tA~ra rahamate praveza karAna Ara yAlimadera janya kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tArA ki tA~ke vAda diYe vahu abhibhAvaka grahaNa kareche? kintu AllAha, tinii halena prakRta abhibhAvaka; tinii mRtake jIvita karena Ara tini sakala viSaYe sarvakSamatAvAna|
Ara ye kona viSaYei tomarA matavirodha kara, tAra phaYasAlA AllAhara kAche; tinii AllAha, AmAra rava; tA~rai upara Ami tAoYAkkula karechi evaM Ami tA~rai abhimukhI hai|

tini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sraSTA; tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya theke jor3A vAniYechena evaM catuSpada jantu thekeo jor3A vAniYechena, (ebhAvei) tini tomAderake char3iYe diYechena| tA~ra mata kichu nei Ara tini sarvazrotA o sarvadraSTA|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera cAvi tA~ra kAche; yAra janya icchA tini riyka prazasta karena evaM niYantrita karena; nizcaYa tini sakala viSaYe sarvajJAta|

tini tomAdera janya dIna vidhivaddha kare diYechena; ye viSaYe tini nUhake nirdeza diYechilena, Ara Ami tomAra kAche ye ohI pAThiYechi evaM ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsAke ye nirdeza diYechilAma tA hala, tomarA dIna kAYema karave evaM ete vicchinna have nA| tumi muzarikaderake yedike AhavAna karacha tA tAdera kAche kaThina mane haYa; AllAha yAke cAna tAra dike niYe Asena| Ara ye tA~ra abhimukhI haYa tAke tini hidAYAta dAna karena|

Ara tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parao tArA kevala nijadera madhyakAra vidveSera kAraNe matabheda kareche; ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla paryanta avakAza samparke tomAra ravera pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale tAdera viSaYe phaYasAlA haYe yeta| Ara tAdera pare yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYechila, tArA se samparke vibhrAntikara sandehe raYeche|

e kAraNe tumi AhavAna kara evaM dRr3ha thAka yemana tumi AdiSTa haYecha| Ara tumi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa karo nA evaM vala, ‘AllAha ye kitAva nAyila karechena Ami tAte ImAna enechi evaM tomAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karate Ami AdiSTa haYechi| AllAha AmAdera rava evaM tomAdera rava| AmAdera karma AmAdera evaM tomAdera karma tomAdera; AmAdera o tomAdera madhye kona vivAda-visamvAda nei; AllAha AmAderake ekatra karavena evaM pratyAvartana tA~rai kAche’|
Ara AllAhara AhavAne sAr3A deYAra para AllAha samparke yArA vitarka kare, tAdera dalIla-pramANa tAdera ravera nikaTa asAra| tAdera upara (AllAhara) gayava evaM tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|
AllAha, yini satyasaha kitAva o mIyAna* nAyila karechena| Ara kise tomAke jAnAve, haYata kiYAmata khuvai nikaTavartI? * sanada, nyAYa vicAra, inasApha, ityAdi|

yArA ete ImAna Ane nA, tArAi tA tvarAnvita karate cAYa| Ara yArA ImAna eneche, tArA eke bhaYa kare evaM tArA jAne ye, eTA avazyai satya| jene rekha, nizcaYa yArA kiYAmata samparke vAka-vitanDA kare tArA sudUra pathabhraSTatAYa nipatita|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati ati daYAlu| tini yAke icchA riyka dAna karena| Ara tini mahAzaktidhara, mahAparAkramazAlI|
ye AkhirAtera phasala kAmanA kare, Ami tAra janya tAra phasale pravRddhi dAna kari, Ara ye duniYAra phasala kAmanA kare Ami tAke tA theke kichu dei evaM AkhirAte tAra janya kona aMzai thAkave nA|

tAdera janya ki emana kichu zarIka Ache, yArA tAdera janya dInera vidhAna diYeche, yAra anumati AllAha denani? Ara phaYasAlAra ghoSaNA nA thAkale tAdera vyApAre siddhAnta haYei yeta| Ara nizcaYa yAlimadera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

tumi yAlimaderake tAdera kRta karmera janya bhIta-santrasta dekhate pAve| athaca tA (tAdera karmera zAsti) tAdera upara patita havei| Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tArA jAnnAtera udyAnasamUhe thAkave| tArA yA cAive, tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera janya tAi thAkave| eTAi to mahAanugraha|

eTA tAi, yAra susaMvAda AllAha tAra vAndAderake dena- yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare| vala, ‘Ami era janya tomAdera kAche AtmIYatAra sauhArda chAr3A anya kona pratidAna cAi nA’| ye uttama kAja kare, Ami tAra janya tAte kalyANa vAr3iYe dei| nizcaYa AllAha ati kSamAzIla, var3ai guNagrAhI|

tArA ki ekathA vale ye, se AllAha samparke mithyA udbhAvana kareche? athaca yadi AllAha cAitena tomAra hRdaYe mohara mere ditena| Ara AllAha mithyAke muche dena evaM nija vANI dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| nizcaYa tini antarasamUhe yA Ache, se samparke savizeSa avahita|
Ara tinii tA~ra vAndAdera tAovA kavUla karena evaM pApasamUha kSamA kare dena| Ara tomarA yA kara, tA tini jAnena|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAdera AhavAne tini sAr3A dena evaM tAdera prati tA~ra anugraha vRddhi karena| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche kaThina AyAva|

Ara AllAha yadi tAra vAndAdera janya riyka prazasta kare ditena, tAhale tArA yamIne avazyai vidroha karata| kintu tini nirdiSTa parimANe yA icchA nAyila karena| nizcaYa tini tA~ra vAndAdera vyApAre pUrNa avagata, samyaka draSTA|
Ara tArA nirAza haYe par3ale tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM tA~ra rahamata char3iYe dena| Ara tinii to abhibhAvaka, prazaMsita|

Ara tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTi evaM etadobhaYera madhye tini ye sava jIva-jantu char3iYe diYechena segulo| tini yakhana icchA takhanai eguloke ekatra karate sakSama|
Ara tomAdera prati ye musIvata Apatita haYa, tA tomAdera kRtakarmerai phala| Ara aneka kichui tini kSamA kare dena|
tomarA yamIne (AllAhara karma parikalpanAke) vyartha karate pArave nA| Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye Aro raYeche samudre calAcalakArI parvatamAlAra mata jAhAjasamUha|
tini yadi cAna vAtAsake thAmiYe dite pArena| phale jAhAjagulo samudrapRSThe gatihIna haYe par3ave| nizcaYa ete parama dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|
athavA tAdera kRtakarmera janya seguloke tini dhvaMsa kare dite pArena, AvAra anekake tini kSamAo karena|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha samparke vAka vitanDA kare tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, tAdera kona AzraYasthala nei|
Ara tomAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche tA duniYAra jIvanera bhogya sAmagrI mAtra| Ara AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tA utkRSTa o sthAYI tAdera janya yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera ravera upara tAoYAkkula kare|
Ara yArA gurutara pApa o azlIla kAryakalApa theke ve~ce thAke evaM yakhana rAgAnvita haYa takhana tArA kSamA kare deYa|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera AhavAne sAr3A deYa, sAlAta kAYema kare, tAdera kAryAvalI tAdera pArasparika parAmarzera bhittite sampanna kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA theke tArA vyaYa kare|
Ara tAdera upara atirikta vAr3AvAr3i karA hale tArA tAra pratividhAna kare|
Ara mandera pratiphala anurUpa manda| ataHpara ye kSamA kare deYa evaM Aposa nispatti kare, tAra puraskAra AllAhara nikaTa raYeche| nizcaYa AllAha yAlimadera pachanda karena nA|
tave atyAcArita havAra para yArA pratividhAna kare, tAdera viruddhe kona vyavasthA grahaNa karA have nA|
kevala tAdera viruddhei vyavasthA grahaNa karA have, yArA mAnuSera upara yulama kare evaM yamIne anyAYabhAve sImAlaGghana kare ver3AYa| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
Ara ye dhairyadhAraNa kare evaM kSamA kare, tA nizcaYa dRr3hasaMkalperai kAja|
Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tArapara tAra janya kona abhibhAvaka nei| Ara tumi yAlimaderake dekhave, yakhana tArA AyAva pratyakSa karave takhana valave, ‘phire yAoYAra kona patha Ache ki’?

tumi tAderake Aro dekhave ye, tAderake apamAne avanata avasthAYa jAhAnnAme upasthita karA hacche, tArA Ar3a cokhe tAkAcche| Ara kiYAmatera dina muminagaNa valave, tArAi to kSatigrasta yArA nijadera o parivAra-parijanera kSati sAdhana kareche| sAvadhAna! yAlimarAi thAkave sthAYI AyAve|
Ara AllAha chAr3A tAderake sAhAyya karAra janya tAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra kona patha nei|

tomarA tomAdera ravera DAke sAr3A dAo, AllAhara pakSa theke sedina AsAra pUrveri, yAke phiriYe deYAra kono upAYa nei| sedina tomAdera janya kona AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM tomAdera janya pratirodhakArIo thAkave nA|

Ara yadi tArA vimukha haYa, tave Ami to tomAke tAdera rakSaka hiseve pAThAini| vANI pau~che deYAi tomAra dAYitva| Ara Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra rahamata AsvAdana karAi takhana se khuzi haYa| Ara yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera janya tAdera upara kona vipada Ase takhana mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa haYa|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva AllAharai| tini yA cAna sRSTi karena| tini yAke icchA kanyA santAna dAna karena evaM yAke icchA putra santAna dAna karena|
athavA tAderake putra o kanyA ubhaYai dAna karena evaM yAke icchA vandhyA karena| tini to sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

kona mAnuSera e maryAdA nei ye, AllAha tAra sAthe sarAsari kathA valavena, ohIra mAdhyama, pardAra Ar3Ala athavA kona dUta pAThAno chAr3A| tArapara AllAhara anumati sApekSe tini yA cAna tAi ohI preraNa karena| tini to mahIYAna, prajJAmaYa|

anurUpabhAve (uparokta tinaTi paddhatite) Ami tomAra kAche AmAra nirdeza theke ‘rUha’ke ohI yoge preraNa karechi| tumi jAnate nA kitAva kI evaM ImAna kI? kintu Ami eke Alo vAniYechi, yAra mAdhyame Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA hidAYAta dAna kari| Ara nizcaYa tumi sarala pathera dika nirdezanA dAo|
sei AllAhara patha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache tAra mAlika| sAvadhAna! sava viSaYai AllAhara kAche phire yAve|
hA-mIma|
suspaSTa kitAvera kasama!
nizcaYa Ami to eke AravI kuraAna vAniYechi, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
Ara nizcaYa tA AmAra kAche ummula kitAve suucca maryAdAsampanna, prajJApUrNa|
tomarA sImAlaGghanakArI jAti, e kAraNe ki Ami tomAdera kAcha theke e upadezavANI sampUrNarUpe pratyAhAra kare neva?
Ara pUrvavartIdera madhye Ami vahu navI pAThiYechilAma|
Ara yakhanai tAdera kAche kona navI eseche tArA tAke niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa kareche|
phale tAdera ceYeo zaktite pravaladerake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma| Ara pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta atIta haYe geche|
Ara tumi yadi jijJAsA kara, AsamAnasamUha o yamIna ke sRSTi karechena? tArA avazyai valave, mahAparAkramazAlI sarvajJai kevala egulo sRSTi karechena|
yini yamInake tomAdera janya zayyA vAniYechena evaM tAte tomAdera janya vAniYechena calAra patha, yAte tomarA saThika patha pete pAra|
Ara yini AsamAna theke parimitabhAve pAni varSaNa karena| ataHpara Ami tA dvArA mRta janapadake saJjIvita kari| ebhAvei tomAderake vera karA have|
Ara yini sava kichui jor3A jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tini tomAdera janya nauyAna o gRhapAlita jantu sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA ArohaNa kara,

yAte tomarA era piThe sthira thAkate pAra tArapara tomAdera ravera anugraha smaraNa karave, yakhana tomarA era upara sthira haYe vasave Ara valave, ‘pavitra-mahAna sei sattA yini eguloke AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena| Ara AmarA eguloke niYantraNa karate sakSama chilAma nA’|
Ara nizcaYa AmarA AmAdera ravera kAchei pratyAvartanakArI|
Ara tArA tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke tA~ra aMza sAvyasta kareche| nizcaYai mAnuSa spaSTa akRtajJa|
tini ki yA sRSTi karechena tA theke kanyA santAna grahaNa karechena, Ara tomAderake viziSTa karechena putra santAna dvArA?
Ara yakhana tAdera kAuke susaMvAda deYA haYa, yA rahamAnera prati tArA dRSTAnta peza kare, takhana tAra mukhamanDala malina haYe yAYa| ematAvasthAYa ye, se duHsaha yAtanApiSTa|
Ara ye alaMkAre lAlita pAlita haYa; evaM vitarkakAle suspaSTa vaktavya pradAne akSama|
Ara tArA gaNya kareche rahamAnera vAndA pherezatAderake nArI| tArA ki tAdera sRSTi pratyakSa kareche? tAdera sAkSya avazyai likhe rAkhA have evaM tAderake jijJAsAvAda karA have|
tArA Ara vale, ‘parama karuNAmaYa AllAha icchA karale AmarA edera ivAdAta karatAma nA’, e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna nei| tArA zudhu managar3A kathA valache|
Ami ki tAderake kuraAnera pUrve kona kitAva diYechi, ataHpara tArA tA dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare Ache?
varaM tArA vale, ‘AmarA nizcaYa AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake eka matAdarzera upara peYechi, Ara nizcaYa AmarA tAdera padAGka anusaraNe hidAYAtaprApta hava’|

Ara ebhAvei tomAdera pUrve yakhanai Ami kona janapade satarkakArI pAThiYechi, takhanai sekhAnakAra vilAsapriYarA valeche, ‘nizcaYa AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake eka matAdarzera upara peYechi evaM nizcaYa AmarA tAdera padAGka anusaraNa karava’|

takhana se (satarkakArI) valeche, ‘tomarA tomAdera pitRpuruSaderake ye matAdarze peYecha, Ami yadi tomAdera kAche tAra ceYe utkRSTa pathe niYe Asi tavuo ki’? (tomarA tAdera anusaraNa karave?) tArA valeche, ‘nizcaYa tomAderake yA diYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tAra asvIkArakArI’|
phale Ami tAdera theke pratizodha nilAma| ataeva dekha, mithyAropakArIdera pariNati kemana haYechila?
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma svIYa pitA o tAra kaomake valechila, ‘tomarA yegulora ivAdAta kara, nizcaYa Ami tAdera theke samparkamukta’|
‘tave (tini chAr3A) yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara nizcaYa tini AmAke zIghrai hidAYAta divena|’
Ara eTike se tAra uttarasUrIdera madhye eka cirantana vANI vAniYe rekhe gela, yAte tArA pratyAvartana karate pAre|
varaM tAdera kAche satya o spaSTa varNanAkArI rAsUla Agamana nA karA paryanta Ami tAdera evaM tAdera pitRpuruSadera bhoga karAra suyoga diYechilAma|
athaca yakhana satya tAdera kAche Asala takhana tArA valala, ‘eto yAdu evaM nizcaYa AmarA tA asvIkAra karachi|’
Ara tArA valala, ‘e kuraAna kena dui janapadera madhyakAra kona mahAna vyaktira upara nAyila karA hala nA’?|

tArA ki tomAra ravera rahamata bhAga-vaNTana kare? Amii duniYAra jIvane tAdera madhye tAdera jIvikA vaNTana kare dei evaM tAdera ekajanake apara janera upara maryAdAYa unnIta kari yAte eke aparake adhinastha hiseve grahaNa karate pAre| Ara tArA yA saJcaYa kare tomAra ravera rahamata tA apekSA utkRSTa|

yadi sava mAnuSa ekai jAtite pariNata haYe yAoYAra AzaGkA nA thAkata, tave yArA parama karuNAmaYera prati kupharI kare Ami tAdera gRhasamUhera janya raupyanirmita chAda o Urdhve ArohaNera si~r3i tairI kare ditAma|
Ara tAdera gRhasamUhera janya darajA o pAlaGka, yAte tArA helAna deYa|
Ara tAdera janya svarNanirmita era sava kaYaTii duniYAra jIvanera bhoga-sAmagrI| Ara AkhirAta to tomAra ravera kAche muttAkIdera janya |
Ara ye parama karuNAmaYera yikira theke vimukha thAke Ami tAra janya eka zaYatAnake niYojita kari, phale se haYe yAYa tAra saGgI|
Ara nizcaYa tArAi (zaYatAna) mAnuSaderake AllAhara patha theke vAdhA deYa| athaca mAnuSa mane kare tArA hidAYAtaprApta|
avazeSe yakhana se AmAra nikaTa Asave takhana se [tAra zaYatAna saMgIke uddezya kare] valave, ‘hAYa, AmAra o tomAra madhye yadi pUrva-pazcimera vyavadhAna thAkata’ sutarAM katainA nikRSTa se saGgI!
Ara Aja tA [tomAdera ei anutApa] tomAdera kona upakArei Asave nA| yehetu tomarA yulama karechile| nizcaYa tomarA AyAve paraspara aMzIdAra haYe thAkave|
tumi ki vadhirake zunAte pArave athavA hidAYAta karate pArave andhake evaM tAke ye spaSTa pathabhraSTatAYa raYeche?
ataHpara yadi Ami tomAke niYe yAi, tave nizcaYa Ami tAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karava|
athavA Ami tAdera ye zAstira oYAdA diYechi tA yadi tomAke pratyakSa karAi, tave nizcaYa Ami tAdera upara pUrNa kSamatAvAna thAkava|
ataeva tomAra prati yA ohI karA haYeche tAke tumi sudRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara| nizcaYa tumi sarala pathera upara raYecha|
nizcaYa e kuraAna tomAra janya evaM tomAra kaomera janya upadeza| Ara acirei tomAderake jijJAsA karA have|
Ara tomAra pUrve Ami rAsUlagaNa theke yAdera preraNa karechilAma tumi tAderake jijJAsA kare dekha, Ami ki rahamAnera parivarte anya kona upAsya nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma, yAdera ivAdAta karA yAve?
Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYe phira‘Auna o tAra netRvargera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma| se valechila, ‘nizcaYa Ami sRSTikulera ravera ekajana rAsUla’|
ataHpara yakhana se AmAra nidarzanAvalI niYe tAdera kAche Asala, takhana tArA tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami tAdera ye nidarzanai dekhAinA kena tA chila tAra anurUpa nidarzana apekSA zreSThatara| Ara Ami tAderake AyAvera mAdhyame pAkar3Ao karalAma, yAte tArA phire Ase|
Ara tArA valala, ‘he yAdukara, tomAra ravera kAche tumi AmAdera janya tAi prArthanA kara, yAra oYAdA tini tomAra sAthe karechena| nizcaYa AmarA hidAYAtera pathe Asava|’
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera theke AyAva sariYe nilAma, takhanai tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga kare vasala|
Ara phira‘Auna tAra kaomera madhye ghoSaNA diYe valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma, misarera rAjatva ki AmAra naYa? Ara e sava nada-nadI ki AmAra pAdadeza diYe pravAhita hacche nA, tomarA ki dekhacha nA’?
‘Ami ki ei vyakti theke zreSTha nai, ye hIna evaM spaSTa varNanA karate prAYa akSama’?
‘tave tAke kena svarNavalaYa pradAna karA hala nA athavA dalavaddhabhAve pherezatAgaNa tAra sAthe kena Asala nA?’
ebhAvei se tAra kaomake vokA vAnAlo, phale tArA tAra Anugatya karala| nizcaYa tArA chila eka phAsika kaoma|
tArapara yakhana tArA AmAke krodhAnvita karala, takhana Ami tAdera theke pratizodha grahaNa karalAma evaM tAdera sakalake nimajjita kare dilAma|
phale Ami tAderake paravartIdera janya atIta itihAsa o dRSTAnta vAnAlAma|
Ara yakhanai mAraiYAma putrake dRSTAntasvarUpa peza karA haYa, takhana tomAra kaoma zoragola zuru kare deYa|
Ara tArA vale, ‘AmAdera upAsyarA zreSTha nAki IsA’? tArA kevala kUTatarkera khAtirei tAke tomAra sAmane peza kare| varaM erAi eka jhagar3ATe sampradAYa|
se kevala AmAra eka vAndA| Ami tAra upara anugraha karechilAma evaM vanI isarAIlera janya tAke dRSTAnta vAniYechilAma|
Ara yadi Ami cAitAma, tave Ami tomAdera parivarte pherezatA sRSTi kare pAThAtAma yArA yamIne tomAdera uttarAdhikAra hata|
Ara nizcaYa se (IsA) have kiYAmatera eka sunizcita AlAmata| sutarAM tomarA kiYAmata samparke saMzaYa poSaNa karo nA| tomarA AmArai anusaraNa kara| eTii sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena tomAdera kichutei vAdhA dite nA pAre| nizcaYa se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

Ara yakhana IsA suspaSTa pramANAdi niYe Asala, takhana se valala, ‘Ami avazyai tomAdera kAche hikamata niYe esechi evaM esechi tomarA ye kataka viSaYe matavirodhe lipta tA spaSTa kare dite| ataeva tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|
‘nizcaYa AllAha, tinii AmAra rava o tomAdera rava| ataeva tA~ra ivAdAta kara; eTii sarala patha’|
ataHpara tAdera madhyakAra kataguli dala matabheda karechila| sutarAM yAlimadera janya yantraNAdAYaka dinera AyAvera durbhoga!
tArA to tAdera ajJAtasAre akasmAt kiYAmata AsAra apekSA karache|
sedina vandhurA eke anyera zatru have, muttAkIrA chAr3A|
he AmAra vAndAgaNa, Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA cintitao have nA|
yArA AmAra AYAte ImAna enechila evaM yArA chila musalima|
tomarA sastrIka sAnande jAnnAte praveza kara|
svarNakhacita thAlA o pAnapAtra niYe tAderake pradakSiNa karA have, sekhAne mana yA cAYa Ara yAte cokha tRpta haYa tA-i thAkave evaM sekhAne tomarA have sthAYI|
Ara eTii jAnnAta, nijadera Amalera phalasvarUpa tomAderake era adhikArI karA haYeche|
sekhAne tomAdera janya raYeche aneka phalamUla, yA theke tomarA khAve|
nizcaYa aparAdhIrA jAhAnnAmera AyAve sthAYI have;
tAdera theke AyAva kamAno have nA evaM tAte tArA hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ara Ami tAdera upara yulama karini; kintu tArAi chila yAlima|
tArA citkAra kare valave, ‘he mAlika, tomAra rava yena AmAderake zeSa kare dena’| se valave, ‘nizcaYa tomarA avasthAnakArI’|
‘avazyai tomAdera kAche Ami satya niYe esechilAma; kintu tomAdera adhikAMzai chile satya apachandakArI*| * kathATi AllAhara| artha Amito tomAdera kAche satyavANI pau~chiYechilAma|
nA ki tArA kona vyApAre pAkA siddhAnta niYeche? nizcaYa Ami cUr3Anta siddhAntakArI|
nA ki tArA mane kare, Ami tAdera gopanIYa viSaYa o nibhRta salAparAmarza zunate pAi nA? avazyai hyA~, Ara AmAra pherezatAgaNa tAdera kAche theke likhache|
vala, ‘rahamAnera yadi santAna thAkata tave Ami prathama tA~ra ivAdAtakArI hatAma|
tArA yA Aropa kare, AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rava evaM Arazera rava tA theke pavitra-mahAna|
ataeva tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA magna thAkuka vehudA kathAYa Ara khela-tAmAzAYa matta thAkuka yatakSaNa nA sedinera sAthe tArA sAkSAt kare yAra pratizruti tAderake deYA haYeche|
Ara tinii AsamAne ilAha evaM tinii yamIne ilAha; Ara tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Ara tini varakatamaYa, yAra kartRtve raYeche AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o e du’Yera madhyavartI savakichu; Ara kiYAmatera jJAna kevala tA~rai Ache evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake phiriYe neYA have|
Ara tini chAr3A yAderake tArA AhavAna kare tArA supArizera mAlika have nA; tave tArA chAr3A yArA jene-zune satya sAkSya deYa |
Ara tumi yadi tAderake jijJAsA kara, ke tAderake sRSTi kareche? tArA avazyai valave, ‘AllAha|’ tavu tArA kIbhAve vimukha haYa?
Ara tAra (rAsUlera) vANI ‘he AmAra rava, nizcaYa erA emana kaoma yArA ImAna Anave nA|’
ataeva tumi tAderake er3iYe cala evaM vala, ‘sAlAma’; tave tArA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
hA-mIma|
suspaSTa kitAvera kasama!
nizcaYa Ami eTi nAyila karechi varakatamaYa rAte; nizcaYa Ami satarkakArI|
se rAte pratyeka prajJApUrNa viSaYe siddhAnta anumodita haYa,
AmAra nirdeze| nizcaYa Ami rAsUla preraNakArI|
tomAra ravera kAcha theke rahamata hiseve; nizcaYa tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yini AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o e du‘Yera madhyavartI savakichura rava; yadi tomarA dRr3ha vizvAsa poSaNakArI hao|
tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei; tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu dena| tini tomAdera rava evaM tomAdera pitRpuruSadera rava|
tArA varaM sandehera vazavartI haYe khelatAmAzA karache|
ataeva apekSA kara sedinera yedina spaSTa dho~YAYa Acchanna have AkAza|
yA mAnuSaderake Acchanna kare phelave: eTi yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
(takhana tArA valave) ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera theke AyAva dUra karuna; nizcaYa AmarA mumina hava|’
ekhana kIbhAve tArA upadeza grahaNa karave, athaca itaHpUrve tAdera kAche suspaSTabhAve varNanAkArI rAsUla esechila?
tArapara tArA tA~ra dika theke vimukha haYechila evaM valechila ‘e zikSAprApta pAgala’|
nizcaYa Ami kSaNakAlera janya AyAva dUra karava; nizcaYa tomarA pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAve|
sedina Ami pravalabhAve pAkar3Ao karava; nizcaYa Ami hava pratizodha grahaNakArI|
Ara avazyai edera pUrve Ami phira‘Aunera kaomake parIkSA karechilAma evaM tAdera kAche esechila eka sammAnita rAsUla,
(se valechila) ‘AllAhara vAndAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe dAo; nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|’
‘Ara AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya prakAza karo nA| nizcaYa Ami tomAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa niYe Asava|’
Ara tomAdera prastarAghAta theke Ami AmAra rava o tomAdera ravera kAche AzraYa cAcchi|
‘Ara tomarA yadi AmAra upara vizvAsa nA rAkha, tave AmAke cher3e yAo|’
ataHpara se tAra ravake Deke valala, ‘nizcaYa erA eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|’
(AllAha valalena) ‘tAhale AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAte veriYe par3a; nizcaYa tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have’|
Ara samudrake rekhe dAo zAnta, nizcaYa tArA have eka Duvanta vAhinI’|
tArA aneka vAgAna o jharnA rekhechila|
zyAmala zasyakSeta o suramya vAsasthAna,
Ara nAnA vilAsa-sAmagrI, yAte tArA Ananda upabhoga karata|
emanaTii haYechila evaM Ami egulora uttarAdhikArI karechilAma anya kaomake|
ataHpara AsamAna o yamIna tAdera janya kA~deni evaM tArA avakAzaprApta chila nA|
Ara avazyai Ami vanI isarAIlake lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva theke uddhAra karechilAma,
phira‘Auna theke, nizcaYa se chila sImAlaGghanakArIdera zIrSasthAnIYa|
Ara Ami jJAtasArei tAderake sakala sRSTira upara nirvAcita karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAderake emana nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma yAte chila suspaSTa parIkSA|
nizcaYa tArA valei thAke,
‘AmAdera prathama mRtyu chAr3A Ara kichui nei evaM AmarA punarutthita havAra nai’|
‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao, tave AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake niYe eso’|
tArA ki zreSTha nA tuvvA sampradAYa evaM tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArA? Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechilAma| nizcaYa tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ara Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamIna evaM etadobhaYera madhye yA kichu Ache tA khelAcchale sRSTi karini|
Ami e du’Toke yathAyathabhAvei sRSTi karechi, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
nizcaYa phaYasAlAra dinaTi tAdera sakalera janyai nirdhArita samaYa|
sedina eka vandhu apara vandhura kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|
se chAr3A, yAra prati AllAha anugraha karena| nizcaYa tinii mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yAkkUma vRkSa
pApIra khAdya;
galita tAmAra mata, udarasamUhe phuTate thAkave|
phuTanta pAnira mata
(valA have) ‘oke dhara, ataHpara tAke jAhAnnAmera madhyasthale Tene niYe yAo’|
tArapara tAra mAthAra upara phuTanta pAnira AyAva Dhele dAo|
(valA have) ‘tumi AsvAdana kara, nizcaYa tumii sammAnita, abhijAta’|
nizcaYa eTA tA-i ye viSaYe tomarA sandeha karate|
nizcaYa muttAkIrA thAkave nirApada sthAne,
vAga-vAgicA o jharnAdhArAra madhye,
tArA paridhAna karave pAtalA o puru rezamI vastra evaM vasave mukhomukhI haYe|
erUpai ghaTave, Ara Ami tAderake viYe deva DAgara naYanA hUradera sAthe|
sekhAne tArA prazAntacitte sakala prakArera phalamUla Anate valave|
prathama mRtyura para sekhAne tArA Ara mRtyu AsvAdana karave nA| Ara tini tAderake jAhAnnAmera AyAva theke rakSA karavena|
tomAra ravera anugrahasvarUpa, eTAi to mahA sAphalya|
ataHpara Ami to tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
ataeva tumi apekSA kara, tArAo apekSAkArI|
hA-mIma|
mahAparAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara pakSa theke e kitAva nAyilakRta|
nizcaYa AsamAnasamUha o yamIne muminadera janya nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
Ara tomAdera sRSTite evaM ye jIva jantu char3iYe raYeche tAte nidarzanAvalI raYeche se kaomera janya yArA nizcita vizvAsa sthApana kare|

Ara rAta o dinera parivartane, AllAha AsamAna theke ye pAni varSaNa karena tArapara tA dvArA yamInake tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena tAte evaM vAtAsera parivartane se kaomera janya nidarzanAvalI raYeche yArA vojhe|
egulo AllAhara AYAta, Ami tA yathAyathabhAvei tomAra kAche tilAoYAta karachi| ataeva tArA AllAha o tA~ra AYAtera para Ara kon kathAYa vizvAsa karave?
durbhoga pratyeka carama mithyuka pApAcArIra janya!
se zone AllAhara AYAtasamUha yA tAra sAmane tilAoYAta karA hacche, tArapara se auddhatyera sAthe avicala thAke, yena se tA zunate pAYani| ataeva tumi tAke eka yantraNAdAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda dAo|
Ara yakhana se AmAra AYAtasamUhera kichu jAnate pAre, takhana se eTAke parihAsera pAtrarUpe grahaNa kare| edera janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva|
tAdera sAmane raYeche jAhAnnAma| tArA yA upArjana kareche athavA AllAhara parivarte tArA yAdera abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa kareche, esava tAdera kona kAje Asave nA| tAdera janya raYeche mahAAyAva|
ei (kuraAna) hidAYAta dAnakArI| Ara yArA tAdera ravera AYAtasamUhera sAthe kupharI kare tAdera janya raYeche atizaYa yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

AllAha, yini samudrake tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena yAte tA~rai Adezakrame tAte nauyAnasamUha calAcala karate pAre evaM yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna kare ver3Ate pAra evaM yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa karate pAra|
Ara yA kichu raYeche AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA kichu raYeche yamIne, tAra savai tini tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena| cintAzIla kaomera janya nizcaYa ete nidarzanAvalI raYeche|
yArA ImAna eneche tAderake vala, ‘yArA AllAhara divasasamUha pratyAzA kare nA, erA yena tAdera kSamA kare deYa, yAte AllAha pratyeka kaomake tAdera kRtakarmera janya pratidAna dite pArena|
ye satkarma kare, se tAra nijera janyai tA kare evaM ye mandakarma kare tA tAra upara vartAve| tArapara tomarA tomAdera ravera prati pratyAvartita have|
Ara Ami vanI isarAIlake kitAva, prajJA o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma evaM tAdera riyka pradAna karechilAma uttama vastu theke evaM diYechilAma tAderake sakala sRSTira upara zreSThatva|

Ara Ami tAderake dInera yAvatIYa viSaYe suspaSTa pramANAdi diYechilAma| tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parao kevala pArasparika hiMsA-vidveSavazata tArA matavirodha karechila| tArA ye sava viSaYe matavirodha karata tomAra rava kiYAmatera dine se sava viSaYe mImAMsA kare devena|
tArapara Ami tomAke dInera eka vizeSa vidhAnera upara pratiSThita karechi| sutarAM tumi tAra anusaraNa kara evaM yArA jAne nA tAdera kheYAla- khuzIra anusaraNa karo nA|
tArA AllAhara mukAvilAYa tomAra kona kAje Asave nA| Ara nizcaYa yAlimarA mUlata eke aparera vandhu evaM AllAha muttAkIdera vandhu|
e kuraAna mAnavajAtira janya AlokavartikA evaM nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYera janya hidAYAta o rahamata|
yArA duSkarma kareche tArA ki mane kare ye, jIvana o mRtyura kSetre Ami tAderake e sava lokera samAna gaNya karava, yArA ImAna Ane evaM satkarma kare? tAdera vicAra katainA manda!
Ara AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamInake yathArthabhAve sRSTi karechena evaM yAte pratyeka vyakti se yA upArjana kareche tadanuyAYI pratidAnaprApta haYa, Ara tArA sAmAnyatamao yulamera zikAra nA haYa|

tave tumi ki tAke lakSya karecha, ye tAra pravRttike Apana ilAha vAniYe niYeche? tAra kAche jJAna AsAra para AllAha tAke pathabhraSTa karechena evaM tini tAra kAna o antare mohara mere diYechena| Ara tAra cokhera upara sthApana karechena AvaraNa| ataeva AllAhara para ke tAke hidAYAta karave? tAraparao ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
Ara tArA vale, ‘duniYAra jIvanai AmAdera ekamAtra jIvana| AmarA mari o vA~ci ekhAnei| Ara kAla-i kevala AmAderake dhvaMsa kare|’ vastuta e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna nei| tArA zudhu dhAraNAi kare|

Ara tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa, takhana tAdera e kathA valA chAr3A Ara kona yukti thAke nA ye, ‘tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAkale AmAdera pitRpuruSadera jIvita kare niYe eso’|
