vala, ‘AllAhai tomAdera jIvana dena tArapara tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| tArapara tini tomAderake kiYAmatera dine ekatra karavena, yAte kona sandeha nei; kintu adhikAMza lokai jAne nA|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamInera mAlikAnA AllAharai evaM yedina kiYAmata saMghaTita have sedina vAtilapanthIrA kSatigrasta have|
Ara tumi pratiTi jAtike dekhave bhaYe natajAnu; pratyeka jAtike svIYa AmalanAmAra dike AhavAna karA have| (evaM valA have) ‘tomarA ye Amala karate Aja tAra pratidAna deYA have’|
‘eTi AmAra lekhanI, yA tomAdera vyApAre satya sahakAre kathA valave; nizcaYa tomarA yA karate Ami tA likhe rAkhatAma’|
ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche tAdera rava pariNAme tAderake svIYa rahamate praveza karAvena| eTii suspaSTa sAphalya|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche (tAderake valA have), ‘tomAdera kAche ki AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYani? ataHpara tomarA ahaGkAra karechile| Ara tomarA chile eka aparAdhI kaoma’|
Ara yakhana valA haYa, ‘AllAhara oYAdA satya, Ara kiYAmate kona sandeha nei’| takhana tomarA vale thAka, ‘AmarA jAni nA kiYAmata kI? AmarA kevala anumAna kari evaM AmarA to dRr3ha vizvAsI nai|’
Ara tAdera kRtakarmera kuphala tAdera janya prakAzita have, Ara tArA yA niYe vidrUpa karata tA tAderake ghire rAkhave|
Ara valA have, ‘Aja Ami tomAderake cher3e yAva yemana tomarA tomAdera e dinera sAkSAtera viSaYaTi cher3e giYechile| Ara tomAdera nivAsa have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArIo thAkave nA’|

eTA ejanyai ye, tomarA AllAhara AYAtake ThATTA-vidrUpera pAtra vAniYechile evaM duniYAra jIvana tomAderake pratArita karechila’| sutarAM Aja tAderake tA (jAhAnnAma) theke vera karA have nA evaM tAderake AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera suyoga deYA have nA|
ataeva AllAharai janya sakala prazaMsA, yini AsamAnasamUhera rava, yamInera rava o sakala sRSTira rava|
Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sakala ahaGkAra tA~ra; tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mIma|
ei kitAva mahA parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa theke nAyilakRta|

Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamIna o etadobhaYera madhye yA kichu Ache, tA yathAyathabhAve o ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYera janya sRSTi karechi| Ara yArA kupharI kare, tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tA theke tArA vimukha|

vala, ‘tomarA AmAke saMvAda dAo tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka AmAke dekhAo to tArA yamIne kI sRSTi kareche? athavA AsamAnasamUhe tAdera kona aMzIdAritva Ache ki? era pUrvavartI kona kitAva athavA paramparAgata kona jJAna tomarA AmAra kAche niYe eso, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke, ye AllAhara parivarte emana kAuke DAke, ye kiYAmata divasa paryantao tAra DAke sAr3A deve nA? Ara tArA tAdera AhavAna samparke udAsIna|
Ara yakhana mAnuSake ekatra karA have, takhana e upAsyagulo tAdera zatru have evaM tArA tAdera ivAdAta asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa| takhana yArA kupharI kare tAdera nikaTa satya AsAra para vale, ‘eTAto prakAzya yAdu’|

tave ki tArA vale ye, ‘se eTA nije udbhAvana kareche’? vala, ‘yadi Ami eTA udbhAvana kare thAki, tave tomarA AmAke AllAhara (AyAva) theke vA~cAte sAmAnya kichurao mAlika nao| tomarA ye viSaYe AlocanAYa matta Acha, tini se viSaYe samyaka avagata| AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve tinii yatheSTa| Ara tini ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

vala, ‘Ami rAsUladera madhye natuna nai| Ara Ami jAni nA AmAra o tomAdera vyApAre kI karA have| AmAra prati yA ohI karA haYa, Ami kevala tArai anusaraNa kari| Ara Ami ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI mAtra’|

vala, tomarA AmAke jAnAo, yadi e kuraAna AllAhara kAcha theke ese thAke, Ara tomarA eTAke asvIkAra karale, athaca vanI isarAIlera ekajana sAkSI e vyApAre anurUpa sAkSya dila| ataHpara se ImAna Anala Ara tomarA ahaGkAra karale| nizcaYa AllAha yAlima kaomake hedAYAta karena nA|

Ara yArA kupharI kareche tArA yArA ImAna eneche tAdera samparke vale, ‘yadi eTA bhAla hata tave tArA AmAdera theke agraNI hate pArata nA’| Ara yakhana tArA era dvArA hedAYAta prApta haYani, takhana tArA acirei valave, ‘eTA to eka purAtana mithyA’|

Ara era pUrve esechila mUsAra kitAva pathapradarzaka o rahamatasvarUpa| Ara eTi tAra satyAYanakArI kitAva, AravI bhASAYa; yAte eTA yAlimaderake satarka karate pAre evaM tA inasAphakArIdera janya eka susaMvAda|
nizcaYa yArA vale, ‘AmAdera rava AllAha’ ataHpara avicala thAke, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tAte tArA sthAYIbhAve thAkave, tArA yA Amala karata tAra puraskArasvarUpa|

Ara Ami mAnuSake tAra mAtA-pitAra prati sadaYa vyavahArera nirdeza diYechi| tAra mA tAke atikaSTe garbhe dhAraNa kareche evaM ati kaSTe tAke prasava kareche| tAra garbhadhAraNa o dudhapAna chAr3Anora samaYa lAge triza mAsa| avazeSe yakhana se tAra zaktira pUrNatAYa pau~che evaM calliza vachare upanIta haYa, takhana se vale, ‘he AmAra rava, AmAke sAmarthya dAo, tumi AmAra upara o AmAra mAtA-pitAra upara ye niAmata dAna karecha, tomAra se niAmatera yena Ami zokara AdAYa karate pAri evaM Ami yena satkarma karate pAri, yA tumi pachanda kara| Ara AmAra janya tumi AmAra vaMzadharadera madhye saMzodhana kare dAo| nizcaYa Ami tomAra kAche tAovA karalAma evaM nizcaYa Ami musalimadera antarbhukta’|
erAi, yAdera utkRSTa Amalagulo Ami kavUla kari evaM tAdera manda kAjagulo kSamA kare dei| tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta| tAderake ye oYAdA deYA haYeche, tA satya oYAdA|

Ara ye vyakti tAra mAtA-pitAke vale, ‘tomAdera janya Aphasosa’! tomarA ki AmAke ei pratizruti dAo ye, Ami punarutthita hava’ athaca AmAra pUrve aneka prajanma gata haYe geche’? Ara tArA du’jana AllAhara kAche phariYAda kare vale, ‘durbhoga tomAra janya! tumi ImAna Ana| nizcaYa AllAhara oYAdA satya’| takhana se vale, ‘eTA kevala atItakAlera kalpakAhinI chAr3A Ara kichu naYa’|
tAdera pUrve ye jina o mAnavajAti gata haYe geche, tAdera mata edera pratio AllAhara vANI satya haYeche| nizcaYa erA chila kSatigrasta|
Ara sakalera janyai tAdera Amala anusAre maryAdA raYeche| Ara AllAha yena tAderake tAdera karmera pUrNa pratiphala dite pArena| Ara tAdera prati kona yulama karA have nA|

Ara yedina kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane peza karA have (tAderake valA have) ‘tomarA tomAdera duniYAra jIvane tomAdera sukha sAmagrIgulo niHzeSa karecha evaM segulo bhoga karecha| tomarA yehetu anyAYabhAve yamIne ahaGkAra karate evaM tomarA yehetu nApharamAnI karate, sehetu tAra pratiphalasvarUpa Aja tomAderake apamAnajanaka AyAva pradAna karA have’|

Ara smaraNa kara ‘A’da sampradAYera bhAiYera kathA, yakhana se AhakAphera svIYa sampradAYake satarka karechila| Ara emana satarkakArIrA tAra pUrve evaM tAra pareo gata haYeche ye, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdAta karo nA| nizcaYa Ami tomAdera upara eka bhaYAvaha dinera AyAvera AzaGkA karachi’|
tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera upAsyadera theke nivRtta karate AmAdera nikaTa esecha? tumi yadi satyavAdIdera antarbhukta hao, tAhale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccha tA niYe eso’|
se valala, ‘e jJAna ekamAtra AllAhara kAche| Ara yA diYe AmAke pAThAno haYeche, Ami tomAdera kAche tA-i pracAra kari, kintu Ami dekhachi, tomarA eka mUrkha sampradAYa’|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera upatyakAra dike meghamAlA dekhala takhana tArA valala, ‘e meghamAlA AmAderake vRSTi deve’| (hUda valala,) varaM eTi tA-i yA tomarA tvarAnvita karate ceYechile| e eka jhar3a, yAte yantraNAdAYaka AyAva raYeche’|

eTA tAra ravera nirdeze sava kichu dhvaMsa kare deve’| phale tArA emana (dhvaMsa) haYe gela ye, tAdera AvAsasthala chAr3A Ara kichui dekhA yAcchila nA| ebhAvei Ami aparAdhI kaomake pratiphala diYe thAki|

Ara Ami avazyai tAderake yAte pratiSThita karechilAma, tomAderake tAte pratiSThita karini| Ara Ami tAderake kAna, cokha o hRdaYa diYechilAma, kintu tArA yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata, takhana tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha o tAdera hRdaYasamUha tAdera kona upakAre Aseni| Ara tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tA-i tAderake pariveSTana karala|
Ara avazyai Ami tomAdera pArzvavartI janapadasamUha dhvaMsa karechilAma| Ara Ami vibhinnabhAve AYAtasamUhake varNanA karechilAma yAte tArA phire Ase|

ataHpara tArA AllAhara sAnnidhya lAbhera janya AllAhara parivarte yAderake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila, tArA kena tAderake sAhAyya karala nA? varaM tArA tAdera theke adRzya haYe gela, Ara eTA tAdera mithyAcAra evaM tAdera managar3A udbhAvana|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami jinadera ekaTi dalake tomAra kAche phiriYe diYechilAma| tArA kuraAna pATha zunachila| yakhana tArA tAra kAche upasthita hala, takhana tArA valala, ‘cupa kare zona| tArapara yakhana pATha zeSa hala takhana tArA tAdera kaomera kAche satarkakArI hiseve phire gela|
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera kaoma, AmarA to eka kitAvera vANI zunechi, yA mUsAra pare nAyila karA haYeche| yA pUrvavartI kitAvake satyAYana kare Ara satya o sarala pathera prati hidAYAta kare’|
‘he AmAdera kaoma, AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra prati sAr3A dAo evaM tAra prati ImAna Ana, AllAha tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena| Ara tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva theke rakSA karavena’|
Ara ye AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra DAke sAr3A deve nA se yamIne tAke apAragakArI naYa| Ara AllAha chAr3A tAra kona abhibhAvaka nei| erAi spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, nizcaYa AllAha, yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena Ara egulora sRSTite tini klAnta hanani, tini mRtaderake jIvana dite sakSama? avazyai hyA~, nizcaYa tini sakala kichura opara kSamatAvAna|

Ara yedina kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera kAche peza karA have (valA have), ‘eTA ki satya naYa’? tArA valave, ‘avazyai hyA~, AmAdera ravera kasama tini valavena, ‘tAhale AyAva AsvAdana kara, yehetu tomarA kupharI karachile’|

ataeva tumi dhairyadhAraNa kara, yemana dhairyadhAraNa karechila sudRr3ha saMkalpera adhikArI rAsUlagaNa| Ara tAdera janya tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYechila, yedina tArA tA pratyakSa karave, mane have tArA pRthivIte eka dinera kichu samaYa avasthAna kareche| sutarAM eTA eka ghoSaNA, tAi pApAcArI kaomakei dhvaMsa karA have|
yArA kupharI kareche evaM AllAhara patha theke vAraNa kareche, tini tAdera AmalasamUha vyartha kare diYechena|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche, satkarma kareche evaM muhAmmAdera prati yA nAyila karA haYeche tAte vizvAsa sthApana kareche ‘Ara tA tAdera ravera pakSa hate (prerita) satya, tini tAdera theke tAdera manda kAjagulo dUra kare devena evaM tini tAdera avasthA saMzodhana kare devena|
tA ejanya ye, yArA kupharI kare tArA vAtilera anusaraNa kare, Ara yArA ImAna Ane tArA tAdera ravera prerita hakera anusaraNa kare| ebhAvei AllAha mAnuSera janya tAdera dRSTAntasamUha varNanA karena|

ataeva tomarA yakhana kAphiradera sAthe yuddhe avatIrNa hao, takhana tAdera ghAr3e AghAta kara| parizeSe tomarA yakhana tAderake sampUrNabhAve paryudasta karave takhana tAderake zaktabhAve ve~dhe nAo| tArapara haYa anugraha nA haYa muktipaNa AdAYa, yatakSaNa nA yuddha tAra vojhA rekhe deYa*| eTAi vidhAna| Ara AllAha icchA karale tAdera kAcha theke pratizodha grahaNa karate pAratena, kintu tini tomAdera ekajanake anyera dvArA parIkSA karate cAna| Ara yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYa tini kakhano tAdera AmalasamUha vinaSTa karavena nA| * artha yuddha vandha haoYA|
acirei tini tAderake hidAYAta divena evaM tAdera avasthA saMzodhana kare divena|
Ara tini tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra paricaYa tini tAderake diYechena|
he muminagaNa, yadi tomarA AllAhake sAhAyya kara tave AllAhao tomAderake sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera pA sudRr3ha kare devena|
Ara yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya raYeche dhvaMsa evaM tini tAdera AmalasamUha vyartha kare diYechena|
tA ejanya ye, AllAha yA nAyila karechena tArA tA apachanda kare| ataeva tini tAdera AmalasamUha vinaSTa kare diYechena|

tave ki tArA yamIne bhramaNa kareni, tArapara dekheni yArA tAdera pUrve chila tAdera pariNAma kemana haYechila? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechena| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche era anurUpa pariNAma|
tA ejanya ye, nizcaYa AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka| Ara nizcaYa kAphiradera kona abhibhAvaka nei|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche, AllAha tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karavena| yAra nimnadeze naharasamUha pravAhita haYa| kintu yArA kupharI kare tArA bhoga-vilAse matta thAke evaM tArA AhAra kare yemana catuSpada janturA AhAra kare| Ara jAhAnnAmai tAdera vAsasthAna|
Ara tomAra janapada yA theke tArA tomAke vahiSkAra kareche tAra tulanAYa zaktimattAYa pravalatara aneka janapada chila, Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma, phale tAdera konai sAhAyyakArI chila nA|

ye vyakti tAra ravera pakSa theke Agata suspaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita se ki tAra mata, yAra manda Amala tAra janya cAkacikyamaYa kare deYA haYeche evaM yArA tAdera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare?

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera oYAdA deYA haYeche tAra dRSTAnta hala, tAte raYeche nirmala pAnira naharasamUha, dudhera jharnAdhArA, yAra svAda parivartita haYani, pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu surAra naharasamUha evaM Ache parizodhita madhura jharnAdhArA| tathAYa tAdera janya thAkave sava dharanera phalamUla Ara tAdera ravera pakSa theke kSamA| tArA ki tAdera nyAYa, yArA jAhAnnAme sthAYI have evaM tAderake phuTanta pAni pAna karAno have phale tA tAdera nAr3ibhu~r3i chinna-vicchinna kare deve?

Ara tAdera madhye emana kataka raYeche, yArA tomAra prati manoyoga diYe zune| avazeSe yakhana tArA tomAra kAcha theke vera haYe yAYa takhana tArA yAdera jJAna dAna karA haYeche tAdera uddezye vale, ‘ei mAtra se kI valala?’ erAi tArA, yAdera antarasamUhe AllAha mohara mere diYechena evaM tArA nijadera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kareche|
Ara yArA hidAYAtaprApta haYeche AllAha tAdera hidAYAta prApti Aro vRddhi karena evaM tAderake tAdera tAkaoYA pradAna karena|

sutarAM tArA ki kevala ei apekSA karache ye, kiYAmata tAdera upara AkasmikabhAve ese par3uka? athaca kiYAmatera AlAmatasamUha to esei par3eche| sutarAM kiYAmata ese par3ale tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?

ataeva jene rAkha, niHsandehe AllAha chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| tumi kSamA cAo tomAra o mumina nArI-puruSadera truTi-vicyutira janya| AllAha tomAdera gatividhi evaM nivAsa samparke avagata raYechena|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche tArA vale, ‘kena ekaTi sUrA nAyila karA haYani?’ ataHpara yakhana dvyarthahIna kona suspaSTa sUrA nAyila karA haYa evaM tAte yuddhera ullekha thAke, takhana tumi dekhave yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche tArA tomAra dike mRtyubhaYe mUrchita vyaktira dRSTite tAkAcche| sutarAM dhvaMsa tAdera janya|

Anugatya o nyAYasaGgata kathA (tAdera janya) uttama| ataHpara yakhana siddhAnta cUr3Anta haYa, takhana yadi tArA AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA satye pariNata karata, tave tA tAdera janya kalyANakara hata|
tave ki tomarA pratyAzA karacha ye, yadi tomarA zAsana kartRtva pAo, tave tomarA yamIne viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM tomAdera AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave?
erAi yAderake AllAha lAnata karechena, phale tAderake vadhira o tAdera dRSTisamUhake andha kare diYechena|
tave ki tArA kuraAna niYe gabhIra cintA- bhAvanA kare nA? nAki tAdera antarasamUhe tAlA raYeche?
nizcaYa yArA hidAYAtera patha suspaSTa haoYAra para tAdera pRSTapradarzanapUrvaka mukha phiriYe neYa, zaYatAna tAdera kAjake camatkRta kare dekhAYa evaM tAderake mithyA AzA diYe thAke|

eTi e janya ye, AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA yArA apachanda kare| tAdera uddezye, tArA vale, ‘acirei AmarA katipaYa viSaYe tomAdera Anugatya karava’| AllAha tAdera gopanIYatA samparke avahita raYechena|
ataHpara tAdera avasthA kemana have, yakhana pherezatArA tAdera mukhamanDala o pRSThadezasamUhe AghAta karate karate tAdera jIvanAvasAna ghaTAve?
eTi e janya ye, tArA emana sava viSaYera anusaraNa kareche yA AllAhake krodhAnvita kareche evaM tArA tA~ra santoSake apachanda kareche| phale AllAha tAdera karmasamUha niSphala kare diYechena|
nAki yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche tArA dhAraNA kareche ye, AllAha tAdera gopana vidveSabhAva prakAza kare divena nA?

Ara yadi Ami cAitAma tave Ami tomAke edera dekhiYe dite pAratAma| phale lakSaNa dekhei tumi tAdera cinate pArate| tave tumi avazyai kathAra bhaGgite tAdera cinate pArave| AllAha tomAdera AmalasamUha jAnena|
Ara Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava yatakSaNa nA Ami prakAza kare dei tomAdera madhye kArA jihAdakArI o dhairyazIla evaM Ami tomAdera kathA- kAja parIkSA kare neva|

nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche, AllAhara pathe vAdhA diYeche evaM tAdera nikaTa hidAYAtera patha suspaSTa haoYAra parao rAsUlera virodhitA kareche, tArA AllAhara konai kSati sAdhana karate pArave nA| Ara zIghrai tini tAdera AmalasamUha niSphala kare devena|
he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara| Ara tomarA tomAdera AmalasamUha vinaSTa karo nA|
nizcaYai yArA kupharI kareche evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA diYeche| tArapara kAphira avasthAYai mArA geche, AllAha kakhanai tAdera kSamA karavena nA|
ataeva tomarA hInavala haYo nA o sandhira AhavAna jAnio nA evaM tomarAi pravala| Ara AllAha tomAdera sAthei raYechena evaM kakhanai tini tomAdera karmaphala hrAsa karavena nA|

duniYAra jIvana to kevala khela-tAmAzA o arthahIna kathAvArtA| Ara yadi tomarA ImAna Ana evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave tini tomAderake tomAdera pratidAna divena evaM tini tomAdera kAche dhana-sampada cAivena nA|
yadi tini tomAdera nikaTa tA cAna, ataHpara tini tomAdera opara pravala cApa dena, tAhale to tomarA kArpaNya karave| Ara tini tomAdera gopana vidveSasamUha vera kare devena|

tomarAi to tArA, tomAdera AhavAna karA hacche ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karave| athaca tomAdera keu keu kArpaNya karache| tave ye kArpaNya karache se to nijera pratii kArpaNya karache| Ara AllAha abhAvamukta evaM tomarA abhAvagrasta| yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tave tini tomAdera chAr3A anya kona kaomake sthalAbhiSikta karavena| tArapara tArA tomAdera anurUpa have nA|
nizcaYa Ami tomAke suspaSTa vijaYa diYechi;
yena AllAha tomAra pUrvera o parera pApa kSamA karena, tomAra upara tA~ra niAmata pUrNa karena Ara tomAke sarala pathera hidAYAta dena|
evaM tomAke pravala sAhAyya dAna karena|
tinii muminadera antare prazAnti nAyila karechilena yena tAdera ImAnera sAthe ImAna vRddhi pAYa; evaM AsamAnasamUha o yamInera vAhinIgulo AllAharai; Ara AllAha halena sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yena tini mumina nArI o puruSake jAnnAte praveza karAvena yAra nica diYe naharasamUha pravAhita; sekhAne tArA sthAYI have; Ara tini tAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena; Ara eTi chila AllAhara nikaTa eka mahAsAphalya|

Ara yena tini zAsti dite pArena munAphika nArI-puruSa o muzarika nArI-puruSake yArA AllAha samparke manda dhAraNA poSaNa kare; tAdera uparai aniSTatA Apatita haYa| Ara AllAha tAdera upara rAga karechena evaM tAderake lA‘nata karechena, Ara tAdera janya prastuta karechena jAhAnnAma; evaM gantavya hiseve tA katainA nikRSTa!
Ara AllAharai janya AsamAnasamUha o yamInera yAvatIYa sainyavAhinI; evaM AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa Ami tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSyadAtA, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI rUpe|
yAte tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera opara ImAna Ana, tAke sAhAyya o sammAna kara evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara tAsavIha pATha kara|

Ara yArA tomAra kAche vAi‘YAta grahaNa kare, tArA zudhu AllAharai kAche vAi‘YAta grahaNa kare; AllAhara hAta tAdera hAtera upara; ataHpara ye keu oYAdA bhaGga karale tAra oYAdA bhaGgera pariNAma vartAve tArai upara| Ara ye AllAhake deYA oYAdA pUraNa karave acirei AllAha tAke mahA puraskAra devena|

pichane par3e thAkA veduInarA tomAke acirei valave, ‘AmAdera dhana-sampada o parivAra-parijana AmAderake vyasta rekhechila; ataeva AmAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karuna|’ tArA mukhe tA vale yA tAdera antare nei| vala, ‘AllAha yadi tomAdera kona kSati karate cAna kiMvA kona upakAra karate cAna, tave ke AllAhara mokAvilAYa tomAdera janya kona kichura mAlika have’? varaM tomarA ye Amala kara AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avahita|’

varaM tomarA mane karechile rAsUla o muminarA tAdera parivArera kAche kakhano phire Asave nA; Ara eTi tomAdera antare zobhita kare deYA haYechila; Ara tomarA manda dhAraNA karechile evaM tomarA chile dhaMsommukha kaoma |
Ara ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara ImAna Ane nA tave nizcaYa Ami kAphiradera janya prastuta karechi jvalanta Aguna|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sArvabhaumatva AllAhara; tini yAke icchA kSamA karena, Ara yAke icchA zAsti dena| Ara AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana yuddhalavdha sampada saMgrahe udyogI have takhana pichane yArA par3echila acirei tArA valave, ‘AmAderake tomAdera anusaraNa karate dAo|’ tArA AllAhara vANI parivartana karate cAYa| vala, ‘tomarA kakhano AmAdera anusaraNa karave nA; AllAha Agei emanaTi valechena|’ ataHpara acirei tArA valave, ‘varaM tomarA hiMsA karacha|’ varaM tArA khuva kamai vujhe|

pechane par3e thAkA veduInaderake vala, ‘eka kaThora yoddhA jAtira viruddhe zIghrai tomAderake DAkA have; tomarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha karave athavA tArA AtmasamarpaNa karave| ataHpara tomarA yadi Anugatya kara tave AllAha tomAderake uttama pratidAna devena| Ara pUrve tomarA yemana phire giYechile temani yadi phire yAo tave tini tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva devena|

andhera kona aparAdha nei, leMr3Ara kona aparAdha nei, asusthera kona aparAdha nei| ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave tini tAke emana jAnnAte dAkhila karAvena yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita| Ara ye vyakti pichane phire yAve tini tAke yantraNAdAYaka AyAva devena|

avazyai AllAha muminadera upara santuSTa haYechena, yakhana tArA gAchera nice ApanAra hAte vAi‘Ata grahaNa karechila; ataHpara tini tAdera antare kI chila tA jene niYechena, phale tAdera upara prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAderake puraskRta karalena nikaTavartI vijaYa diYe|
Ara vipula parimANa yuddhalavdha sampada diYe yA tArA grahaNa karave; Ara AllAha halena mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha tomAderake prabhUta ganImatera oYAdA diYechena yA tomarA grahaNa karave; ataHpara eguli Age diYechena; Ara mAnuSera hAta tomAdera theke phiriYe rekhechena evaM yAte eTi muminadera janya ekaTi nidarzana haYa, Ara tini tomAderake sarala patha dekhAna|
Ara ArekaTi ekhano tomarA yA arjana karate sakSama haoni| kintu AllAha tA veSTana kare rekhechena| Ara AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche tArA yadi tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare tave avazyai tArA piTha dekhiYe pAlAve| tArapara tArA kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche tAdera vyApAre eTi AllAhara niYama; Ara tumi AllAhara niYame kona parivartana pAve nA|

Ara tinii makkA upatyakAYa tomAderake tAdera upara vijaYI karAra para tAdera hAta tomAdera theke evaM tomAdera hAta tAdera theke phirAYe rekhechena| Ara tomarA yA Amala kara, AllAha halena tAra samyaka draSTA|

tArAito kupharI karechila evaM tomAderake Ala-mAsajidula hArAma theke vAdhA diYechila Ara kuravAnIra pazuguloke kuravAnIra sthAne pau~chate vAdhA diYechila| yadi mumina puruSarA o mumina nArIrA nA thAkata, yAdera samparke tomarA jAna nA ye, tomarA ajJAtasAre tAderake padadalita karave, phale tAdera kAraNe tomarA doSI hate kintu Ami tAdera upara kartRtva diYechi yAte AllAha yAke icchA svIYa rahamate praveza karAvena| yadi tArA pRthaka thAkata, tAhale tAdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tAderake Ami avazyai yantraNAdAYaka AyAva ditAma|

yakhana kAphirarA tAdera antare Atma-ahamikA poSaNa karechila, jAhilI yugera AhamikA| takhana AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera upara o muminadera upara svIYa prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAkaoYAra vANI tAdera janya aparihArya karalena, Ara tArAi chila era sarvAdhika upayukta o era adhikArI| Ara AllAha halena pratyeka viSaYe sarvajJa|

avazyai AllAha tA~ra rAsUlake svapnaTi yathAyathabhAve satye pariNata kare diYechena| tomarA inazAAllAha nirApade tomAdera mAthA munDana kare evaM cula che~Te nirbhaYe Ala-mAsajidula hArAme avazyai praveza karave| ataHpara AllAha jenechena yA tomarA jAnate nA| sutarAM e chAr3Ao tini dilena eka nikaTavartI vijaYa|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake hidAYAta o satya dInasaha preraNa karechena, yAte tini eTAke sakala dInera upara vijaYI karate pArena| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmada AllAhara rAsUla evaM tAra sAthe yArA Ache tArA kAphiradera prati atyanta kaThora; parasparera prati sadaYa, tumi tAderake rukUkArI, sijadAkArI avasthAYa dekhate pAve| tArA AllAhara karuNA o santuSTi anusandhAna karache| tAdera AlAmata hacche, tAdera cehArAYa sijadAra ci‎hna thAke| eTAi tAorAte tAdera dRSTAnta| Ara inajIle tAdera dRSTAnta halo ekaTi cArAgAchera mata, ye tAra ka~cipAtA udagata kareche o zakta kareche, ataHpara tA puSTa haYeche o svIYa kAnDera upara majavutabhAve dA~r3iYeche, yA cASIke Ananda deYa| yAte tini tAdera dvArA kAphiraderake krodhAnvita karate pArena| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera janya kSamA o mahApratidAnera oYAdA karechena|
he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAmane agravartI haYo nA evaM tomarA AllAhara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA navIra AoYAjera upara tomAdera AoYAja u~cu karo nA evaM tomarA nijerA paraspara yemana uccasvare kathA vala, tA~ra sAthe serakama uccasvare kathA valo nA| e AzaGkAYa ye tomAdera sakala Amala-niSphala haYe yAve athaca tomarA upalavdhio karate pArave nA|
nizcaYa yArA AllAhara rAsUlera nikaTa nijadera AoYAja avanamita kare, AllAha tAderai antaraguloke tAkaoYAra janya vAchAi karechena, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahApratidAna|
nizcaYa yArA tomAke hujarAsamUhera pichana theke DAkADAki kare tAdera adhikAMzai vujhe nA|
tumi tAdera kAche vera haYe AsA paryanta yadi tArA dhairyadhAraNa karata, tAhale seTAi tAdera janya uttama hata| Ara AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa, yadi kona phAsika tomAdera kAche kona saMvAda niYe Ase, tAhale tomarA tA yAcAi kare nAo| e AzaGkAYa ye, tomarA ajJatAvazata kona kaomake AkramaNa kare vasave, phale tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera janya lajjita have|

Ara tomarA jene rAkha ye, tomAdera madhye AllAhara rAsUla raYechena| se yadi adhikAMza viSaYe tomAdera kathA mene nita, tAhale tomarA avazyai kaSTe patita hate| kintu AllAha tomAdera kAche ImAnake priYa kare diYechena evaM tA tomAdera antare suzobhita karechena| Ara tomAdera kAche kupharI, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAke apachandanIYa kare diYechena| tArAi to satya pathaprApta|
AllAhara pakSa theke karuNA o niAmata svarUpa| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yadi muminadera du’dala yuddhe lipta haYa, tAhale tomarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dAo| ataHpara yadi tAdera ekadala apara dalera upara vAr3AvAr3i kare, tAhale ye dalaTi vAr3AvAr3i karave, tAra viruddhe tomarA yuddha kara, yatakSaNa nA se dalaTi AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase| tArapara yadi dalaTi phire Ase tAhale tAdera madhye inasAphera sAthe mImAMsA kara evaM nyAYavicAra kara| nizcaYa AllAha nyAYavicArakArIdera bhAlavAsena|
nizcaYa muminarA paraspara bhAi bhAi| kAjei tomarA tomAdera bhAidera madhye ApoSa- mImAMsA kare dAo| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AzA karA yAYa tomarA anugrahaprApta have|

he ImAnadAragaNa, kona sampradAYa yena apara kona sampradAYake vidrUpa nA kare, hate pAre tArA vidrUpakArIdera ceYe uttama| Ara kona nArIo yena anya nArIke vidrUpa nA kare, hate pAre tArA vidrUpakArIdera ceYe uttama| Ara tomarA eke aparera nindA karo nA evaM tomarA eke aparake manda upanAme Deko nA| ImAnera para manda nAma katainA nikRSTa! Ara yArA tAovA kare nA, tArAi to yAlima|

he muminagaNa, tomarA adhika anumAna theke dUre thAka| nizcaYa kona kona anumAna to pApa| Ara tomarA gopana viSaYa anusandhAna karo nA evaM eke aparera gIvata karo nA| tomAdera madhye ki keu tAra mRta bhAiYera gozta khete pachanda karave? tomarA to tA apachandai kare thAka| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYa AllAha adhika tAovA kavUlakArI, asIma daYAlu|

he mAnuSa, Ami tomAderake eka nArI o eka puruSa theke sRSTi karechi Ara tomAderake vibhinna jAti o gotre vibhakta karechi| yAte tomarA paraspara paricita hate pAra| tomAdera madhye AllAhara kAche sei adhika maryAdAsampanna ye tomAdera madhye adhika tAkaoYA sampanna| nizcaYa AllAha to sarvajJa, samyaka avahita|

veduInarA valala, ‘AmarA ImAna AnalAma’| vala, ‘tomarA ImAna Anani’| varaM tomarA vala, ‘AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karalAma’| Ara ekhana paryanta tomAdera antare ImAna praveza kareni| Ara yadi tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, tAhale tini tomAdera AmalasamUhera kona kichui hrAsa karavena nA| nizcaYa AllAha adhika kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mumina kevala tArAi yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna eneche, tArapara sandeha poSaNa kareni| Ara nijedera sampada o nijedera jIvana diYe AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kareche| erAi satyaniSTha|
vala, ‘tomarA ki tomAdera dIna samparke AllAhake zikSA diccha? athaca AllAha jAnena yA kichu Ache AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA kichu Ache yamIne| Ara AllAha sakala kichu samparke samyaka avagata’|

(tArA mane kare) ‘tArA isalAma grahaNa kare tomAke dhanya kareche’| vala, ‘tomarA isalAma grahaNa kare AmAke dhanya karecha mane karo nA’| varaM AllAhai tomAderake ImAnera dike paricAlita kare tomAderake dhanya karechena, tomarA yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka’|
nizcaYa AllAha AsamAnasamUha o yamInera gAYeva samparke avagata Achena| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
kApha; maryAdApUrNa kuraAnera kasama|
varaM tArA vismita haYeche ye, tAdera madhya theke ekajana satarkakArI tAdera kAche eseche| ataHpara kAphirarA valala, ‘eto eka vismaYakara vastu’!
‘AmarA yakhana mArA yAva evaM mATite pariNata hava takhano ki (AmarA punarutthita hava)? e phire yAoYA sudUraparAhata’|
avazyai Ami jAni mATi tAdera theke yataTuku kSaYa kare| Ara AmAra kAche Ache adhika saMrakSaNakArI kitAva|
varaM tArA satyake asvIkAra kareche, yakhanai tAdera kAche satya eseche| ataeva tArA saMzaYayukta viSaYera madhye raYeche|
tArA ki tAdera upare AsamAnera dike tAkAYa nA, kibhAve Ami tA vAniYechi evaM tA suzobhita karechi? Ara tAte kona phATala nei|
Ara Ami yamInake vistRta karechi, tAte parvatamAlA sthApana karechi evaM tAte pratyeka prakArera sudRzya udbhida udagata karechi|
AllAha abhimukhI pratiTi vAndAra janya jJAna o upadeza hiseve|
Ara Ami AsamAna theke varakatamaYa pAni nAyila karechi| ataHpara tA dvArA Ami utpanna kari vAga-vAgicA o kartanayogya zasyadAnA|
Ara samunnata khejuragAcha, yAte Ache guccha guccha khejura char3A,
AmAra vAndAdera janya riykasvarUpa| Ara Ami pAni dvArA mRta zahara saJjIvita kari| ebhAvei utthAna ghaTave|
tAdera pUrve satya pratyAkhyAna karechila nUhera sampradAYa, rAs era adhivAsI o sAmUda sampradAYa|
‘Ada, phira‘Auna o lUta sampradAYa|
AikAra adhivAsI o tuvvA‘ sampradAYa| sakalei rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valechila|
Ami ki prathamavAra sRSTi karei klAnta haYe par3echi? varaM tArA natuna sRSTira viSaYe sandehe nipatita|

Ara avazyai Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi evaM tAra pravRtti tAke ye kumantraNA deYa tAo Ami jAni| Ara Ami* tAra galAra dhamanI hateo adhika kAche| * ivane kAsIra valena, ekhAne نحن vale AllAhara pherezatAderake vujhAno haYeche|
yakhana DAne o vAme vasA du’jana lipivaddhakArI paraspara grahaNa karave|
se ye kathAi uccAraNa kare tAra kAche sadA upasthita saMrakSaNakArI raYeche|
Ara mRtyura yantraNA yathAyathai Asave| yA theke tumi palAYana karate cAite|
Ara ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have| eTAi hala pratizruta dina|
Ara pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tAra sAthe thAkave ekajana cAlaka o ekajana sAkSI|
avazyai tumi e divasa samparke udAsIna chile, ataeva Ami tomAra pardA tomAra theke unmocana kare dilAma| phale Aja tomAra dRSTi khuva prakhara|
Ara tAra sAthI (pherezatA) valave, ei to AmAra kAche (Amala nAmA) prastuta|
tomarA jAhAnnAme nikSepa kara pratyeka uddhata kAphirake,
kalyANakara kAje pravala vAdhAdAnakArI sImAlaGghanakArI, sandeha poSaNakArIke|
ye AllAhara sAthe anya ilAha grahaNa karechila, tomarA tAke kaThina AyAve nikSepa kara|
tAra saGgI (zaYatAna) valave, ‘he AmAdera ‘rava’, Ami tAke vidrohI kare tulini, varaM se nijei chila sudUra pathabhraSTatAra madhye’|
AllAha valavena, ‘tomarA AmAra kAche vAka-vitanDA karo nA| avazyai Ami pUrvei tomAderake satarka kare diYechilAma’|
‘AmAra kAche kathA radavadala haYa nA, Ara Ami vAndAra prati yulamakArIo nai’|
sedina Ami jAhAnnAmake valava, ‘tumi ki paripUrNa haYecha’? Ara se valave, ‘Aro vezi Ache ki’?
Ara jAnnAtake muttAkIdera adUre, kAchei AnA have|
eTAi, yAra oYAdA tomAderake deYA haYechila| pratyeka AllAha abhimukhI adhika saMrakSaNazIladera janya|
ye nA dekhei rahamAnake bhaYa karata evaM vinIta hRdaYe upasthita hata|
tomarA tAte zAntira sAthe praveza kara| eTAi sthAYitvera dina|
tArA yA cAive, sekhAne tAdera janya tAi thAkave evaM AmAra kAche raYeche Arao adhika|
Ami tAdera pUrve vahu prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi yArA pAkar3Ao karAra kSetre edera tulanAYa chila pravalatara, tArA deza-videza caSe ver3Ata| tAdera ki kona palAYanasthala chila?
nizcaYa ete upadeza raYeche tAra janya, yAra raYeche antara athavA ye niviSTacitte zravaNa kare|
Ara avazyai Ami AsamAnasamUha o yamIna evaM etadobhaYera madhyasthita savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechi| Ara AmAke konarUpa klAnti sparza kareni|
ataeva erA yA vale, tAte tumi dhairyadhAraNa kara evaM sUrya udaYera pUrve o astamita haoYAra pUrve tumi tomAra ravera prazaMsAsaha tAsavIha pATha kara|
evaM rAtera ekAMzeo tumi tA~ra tAsavIha pATha kara evaM sAlAtera pazcAteo|
manoniveza kara, yedina ekajana ghoSaka nikaTavartI kona sthAna theke DAkate thAkave|
sedina tArA satyisatyii mahAcitkAra zunave| seTii utthita havAra dina|
Amii jIvana dei evaM Amii mRtyu ghaTAi, Ara AmAra dikei cUr3Anta pratyAvartana|
sedina tAdera theke yamIna vidIrNa have evaM lokerA digvidik chuTAchuTi karate thAkave| eTi emana eka samAveza yA AmAra pakSe atIva sahaja|
erA yA vale Ami tA savaceYe bhAla jAni| Ara tumi tAdera upara kona jora- javaradastikArI nao| sutarAM ye AmAra dhamakake bhaYa kare tAke kuraAnera sAhAyye upadeza dAo|
kasama dhUlijhar3era,
ataHpara, pAnira vojhA vahanakArI meghamAlAra,
ataHpara mRdugatite calamAna nauyAnasamUhera,
ataHpara [AllAhara] nirdeza vaNTanakArI pherezatAgaNera|
tomarA ye oYAdAprApta haYecha tA avazyai satya|
nizcaYa pratidAna avazyambhAvI|
kasama saundaryamanDita AkAzera
nizcaYa tomarA matavirodhapUrNa kathAYa lipta|
ye pathabhraSTa haYeche tAkei tA theke phiriYe neYA haYeche|
mithyAcArIrA dhvaMsa hoka!
yArA sandeha-saMzaYe nipatita, udAsIna|
tArA jijJAsA kare, ‘pratidAna divasa’ kave’?
‘ye dina tArA agnite sAjAprApta have’|
valA have, ‘tomAdera AyAva AsvAdana kara, eTito ‘tomarA tvarAnvita karate ceYechile|’
nizcaYa muttAkIrA thAkave jAnnAtasamUhe o jharNAdhArAYa,
tAdera rava tAdera yA divena tA tArA khuzIte grahaNakArI have| itaHpUrve erAi chila satkarmazIla|
rAtera sAmAnya aMzai erA ghumiYe kATAto|
Ara rAtera zeSa prahare erA kSamA cAoYAYa rata thAkata|
Ara tAdera dhanasampade raYeche prArthI o vaJcitera haka|
sunizcita vizvAsIdera janya yamIne aneka nidarzana raYeche|
tomAdera nijadera madhyeo| tomarA ki cakSuSmAna have nA?
AkAze raYeche tomAdera riyka o pratizruta sava kichu|
ataeva AsamAna o yamInera ravera kasama, tomarA ye kathA vale thAka tAra matai eTi satya|
tomAra kAche ki ivarAhImera sammAnita mehamAnadera vRttAnta eseche?
yakhana tArA tAra kAche Asala evaM valala, ‘sAlAma’, uttare seo valala, ‘sAlAma’| erA to aparicita loka|
ataHpara se druta cupisAre nija parivAravargera kAche gela evaM ekaTi moTA-tAjA go-vAchura (bhAjA) niYe Asala|
ataHpara se tA tAdera sAmane peza karala evaM valala, ‘tomarA ki khAve nA?’
ete tAdera samparke se mane mane bhIta hala| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa peYonA, tArA tAke eka vidvAna putra santAnera susaMvAda dila’|
takhana tAra strI citkAra karate karate egiYe Asala evaM nija mukha cApar3iYe valala, ‘vRddhA-vandhyA’|
tArA valala, ‘tomAra rava erUpai valechena| nizcaYai tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa’|
ivarAhIma valala, ‘he prerita pherezatAgaNa, tomAdera uddezya kI?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA eka aparAdhI kaomera prati prerita haYechi’|
‘yAte tAdera upara mATira zakta DhelA nikSepa kari’|
‘yA tomAra ravera pakSa theke ci‎‎‎hnita sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya’|
ataHpara sekhAne yesava mumina chila Ami tAderake vera kare niYe AsalAma|
tave Ami sekhAne ekaTi vAr3I chAr3A kona musalamAna pAini|
Ara Ami tAdera janya sekhAne ekaTi nidarzana rekhechi yArA yantraNAdAYaka AyAvake bhaYa kare |
Ara mUsAra kAhinIteo nidarzana raYeche, yakhana Ami tAke suspaSTa pramANasaha phira‘Aunera kAche pAThiYechilAma|
kintu se tAra dalavalasaha mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, ‘e vyakti yAdukara athavA ummAda|’
phale Ami tAke o tAra sainya-sAmantake pAkar3Ao karalAma| ataHpara tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| se to chila tiraskRta|
Ara ‘Ada jAtira ghaTanAYao (nidarzana raYeche), yakhana Ami tAdera upara preraNa karechilAma amaGgalajanaka vAYu|
ai vAYu yAra upare esechila tAke rekhe yAYani, varaM savakichuke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare diYechila|
Ara sAmUda jAtira ghaTanAYao (nidarzana raYeche)| yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, ‘ekaTi nirdiSTa kAla paryanta bhoga kare nAo’|
ataHpara tArA tAdera ravera Adeza samparke auddhatya prakAza karala| phale vajrAghAta tAderake pAkar3Ao karala, Ara tArA tA dekhachila|
ataHpara tArA uThe dA~r3Ate pArala nA evaM pratirodhao karate pArala nA|
Ara itaHpUrve nUhera kaomakeo (Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma)| nizcaYa tArA chila phAsika kaoma|
Ara Ami hAtasamUha dvArA AkAza nirmANa karechi evaM nizcaYa Ami mahAsamprasAraNakArI|
Ara Ami yamInake vichiYe diYechi| Ami katainA sundara vichAnA prastutakArI!
Ara pratyeka vastu theke Ami jor3AYa jor3AYa sRSTi karechi| AzA karA yAYa, tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave|
ataeva tomarA AllAhara dike dhAvita hao| Ami to tA~ra pakSa theke tomAdera janya eka spaSTa satarkakArI|
Ara tomarA AllAhara sAthe kona ilAha nirdhAraNa karo nA; Ami tA~ra pakSa theke tomAdera janya eka spaSTa satarkakArI|
ebhAve tAdera pUrvavartIdera madhya theke ye rAsUlai eseche, tArA valeche, ‘e to ekajana yAdukara athavA unmAda|’
tArA ki eke anyake e viSaYe osiYAta kareche? varaM tArA sImAlaMghanakArI kaoma|
ataeva, tumi odera theke mukha phiriYe nAo, ete tumi tiraskRta have nA|
evaM upadeza dite thAka, kAraNa upadeza muminadera upakAre Ase|
Ara jina o mAnuSake kevala ejanyai sRSTi karechi ye tArA AmAra ivAdAta karave|
Ami tAdera kAche kona riyka cAi nA; Ara Ami cAi nA ye, tArA AmAke khAvAra dive|
nizcaYa AllAhai riykadAtA, tini zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|
yArA yulama kareche tAdera janya raYeche tAdera samamanAdera anurUpa AyAva; sutarAM tArA yena AmAra kAche (AyAvera) tAr3Ahur3A nA kare|
ataeva, yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya dhvaMsa sedinera yedinera oYAdA tAderake deYA haYeche|
kasama tUra parvatera,
Ara kasama kitAvera yA lipivaddha Ache|
unmukta pAtAYa|
kasama AvAda gRhera,* * AvAda gRha valate saptAkAzera vAYatula mA‘mUrake vujhAno haYeche| agaNita pherezatA niravacchinna ivAdAte yA AvAda rekheche|
Ara samunnata AkAzera;
kasama taraGga-vikSuvdha sAgarera,* * anya tAphasIra mate-Agunera sAgara yA duniYAte hate pAre, athavA kiYAmate|
nizcaYa tomAra ravera AyAva avazyambhAvI|
yAra kona pratirodhakArI nei|
yedina tIvrabhAve AkAza prakampita have,
Ara parvatamAlA druta paribhramaNa karave,
ataeva mithyAropakArIdera janya sedinera dhvaMsa,
yArA khela-tAmAzAYa matta thAke|
sedina tAderake jAhAnnAmera Agunera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have|
‘eTi sei jAhAnnAma yA tomarA asvIkAra karate|’
‘eTi ki yAdu, nAki tomarA dekhate pAccha nA!’

tomarA Agune praveza kara*, tArapara tomarA dhairyadhAraNa kara vA nA kara, ubhaYai tomAdera janya samAna; tomAderake to kevala tomAdera Amalera pratiphala deYA hacche| * anya tAphasIra mate- ‘‘tomarA era uttApa bhoga kara’’|
nizcaYa muttAkIrA (thAkave) jAnnAte o prAcurye|
tAdera rava tAderake yA diYechena tA upabhoga karave, Ara tAdera rava tAderake vA~cAvena jvalanta Agunera AyAva theke|
tomarA tRpti sahakAre khAo o pAna kara, tomarA ye Amala karate tAra vinimaYe|
sArivaddha pAlaGke tArA helAna diYe vasave; Ara Ami tAderake milAYe deva DAgaracokhA hUra-era sAthe|

Ara yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera santAna-santati ImAnera sAthe tAdera anusaraNa kare, AmarA tAdera sAthe tAdera santAnadera milana ghaTAva evaM tAdera karmera kona aMzai kamAva nA| pratyeka vyakti tAra kAmAiYera vyApAre dAYI thAkave|
Ara Ami tAderake atirikta deva phalamUla o gozata yA tArA kAmanA karave|
tArA parasparera madhye pAnapAtra vinimaYa karave; sekhAne thAkave nA kona vehudA kathAvArtA evaM kona pApakAja|
Ara tAdera sevAYa cArapAze ghurave vAlakadala; tArA yena surakSita muktA|
Ara tArA eke aparera mukhomukhi haYe jijJAsAvAda karave,
tArA valave, ‘pUrve AmarA AmAdera parivArera madhye zaGkita chilAma|’
‘ataHpara AllAha AmAdera prati daYA karechena evaM Agunera AyAva theke AmAderake rakSA karechena|’
nizcaYa pUrve AmarA tA~ke DAkatAma; nizcaYa tini ihasAnakArI, parama daYAlu|
ataeva, tumi upadeza dite thAka; kAraNa tomAra ravera anugrahe tumi gaNaka nao evaM unmAdao nao|
tArA ki valache, ‘se (muhAmmAda) ekajana kavi? AmarA tAra mRtyura pratIkSA karachi|’
vala, ‘tomarA apekSAYa thAka! Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSAkArIdera antarbhukta railAma|’
tAdera viveka ki tAderake e Adeza deYa, nA tArA sImAlaMghanakArI kaoma?
tArA ki vale, ‘se eTA vAniYe valache?’ varaM tArA ImAna Ane nA|
ataeva, tArA yadi satyavAdI haYa tave tAra anurUpa vANI niYe Asuka|
tArA ki sraSTA chAr3A sRSTi haYeche, nA tArAi sraSTA?
tArA ki AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi kareche? varaM tArA dRr3ha vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAra ravera guptabhAnDAra ki tAdera kAche Ache, nA tArA sava kichu niYantraNakArI?
nAki tAdera Ache si~r3i, yAte car3e tArA (Urdhvalokera kathA) zunate pAYa; tAdera zrotA spaSTa pramANa niYe Asuka nA?
tave ki kanyAsantAna tA~ra; Ara putrasantAna tomAdera?
tave ki tumi tAdera kAche pratidAna cAo ye, tArA tA bhArI jarimAnA mane kare?
nAki tAdera kAche Ache gAYevera jJAna, yA tArA likhache?
nAki tArA Sar3ayantra karate cAYa? ataeva yArA kupharI kare tArAi have Sar3ayantrera zikAra|
nAki tAdera janya AllAha chAr3A anya ilAha Ache? tArA ye ziraka kare tA theke AllAha pavitra|
Ara kona AkAzakhanDa bheGge par3ate dekhale tArA valave, ‘eTi to eka puJjIbhUta megha’!
ataeva, tAderake cher3e dAo sedina paryanta yedina tArA dhvaMsa have|
yedina tAdera pakSa theke kRta tAdera Sar3ayantra kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|
Ara nizcaYa yArA yulama karave tAdera janya thAkave echAr3A Aro AyAva; kintu tAdera vezIrabhAgai jAne nA|
Ara tomAdera ravera siddhAntera janya dhairyadhAraNa kara; kAraNa tumi AmAra cokhera sAmanei Acha, tumi yakhana jege oTha takhana tomAra ravera saprazaMsa tAsavIha pATha kara|
Ara rAtera kichu aMze evaM nakSatrera asta yAvAra para tAra tAsavIha pATha kara|
kasama nakSatrera, yakhana tA asta yAYa|
tomAdera saGgI pathabhraSTa haYani evaM vipathagAmIo haYani|
Ara se managar3A kathA vale nA|
tAto kevala ohI, yA tAra prati ohIrUpe preraNa karA haYa|
tAke zikSA diYeche pravala zaktidhara,
prajJAra adhikArI*| ataHpara se sthira haYechila, * jivarIla|
takhana se Urdhva digante|
tArapara se nikaTavartI hala, ataHpara Aro kAche ela|
takhana se naikaTya chila du’ dhanukera parimANa, athavA tArao kama|
ataHpara tini tA~ra vAndAra prati yA ohI karAra tA ohI karalena|
se yA dekheche, antakaraNa se samparke mithyA valeni|
se yA dekheche, se samparke tomarA ki tAra sAthe vitarka karave?
Ara se to tAke* ArekavAra** dekhechila| * jivarIlake|

sidarAtula munatAhAra* nikaTa| * sidarAtula munatAhA hala saptama AkAze Arazera DAna dike ekaTi kula jAtIYa vRkSa, sakala sRSTira jJAnera sImAra zeSa prAnta| tArapara ki Ache, ekamAtra AllAhai jAnena|
yAra kAche jAnnAtula mA’oYA* avasthita| * pherezatA, zahIdadera rUha o muttAkIdera avasthAnasthala|
yakhana kula gAchaTike yA AcchAdita karAra tA AcchAdita karechila|
tAra dRSTi edika-sedika yAYani evaM sImAo atikrama kareni|
nizcaYa se tAra ravera var3a var3a nidarzanasamUha theke dekheche|
tomarA lAta o ‘uyayA samparke AmAke vala’?
Ara mAnAta samparke, yA tRtIYa ArekaTi?
tomAdera janya ki putra Ara AllAhara janya kanyA?
eTAto tAhale eka asaGgata vaNTana!

egulo kevala katipaYa nAma, ye nAmagulo tomarA o tomAdera pitRpuruSerA rekhecha| e vyApAre AllAha kona dalIla-pramANa nAyila karenani| tArA to kevala anumAna evaM nijerA yA cAYa, tAra anusaraNa kare| athaca tAdera kAche tAdera ravera pakSa theke hidAYAta eseche|
mAnuSera janya tA ki haYa, yA se cAYa?
vastutaH parakAla o ihakAla to AllAharai|
Ara AsamAnasamUhe aneka pherezatA raYeche, tAdera supAriza konai kAje Asave nA| tave AllAha yAke icchA karena evaM yAra prati tini santuSTa, tAra vyApAre anumati deYAra para|
nizcaYa yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, tArAi pherezatAderake nArIvAcaka nAme nAmakaraNa kare thAke|
athaca e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAnai nei| tArA to kevala anumAnerai anusaraNa kare| Ara nizcaYa anumAna satyera mokAvelAYa konai kAje Ase nA|
ataeva tumi tAke upekSA kare cala, ye AmAra smaraNa theke vimukha haYa evaM kevala duniYAra jIvanai kAmanA kare|
eTAi tAdera jJAnera zeSasImA| nizcaYa tomAra ravai savaceYe bhAla jAnena tAra samparke, ye tAra patha theke vicyuta haYeche evaM tinii savaceYe bhAla jAnena tAra samparke, ye hidAYAtaprApta haYeche|

Ara AsamAnasamUhe yA raYeche evaM yamIne yA raYeche, tA AllAharai| yAte tini tAdera kAjera pratiphala dite pArena yArA manda kAja kare evaM tAderake tini uttama puraskAra dite pArena yArA satkarma kare |

yArA choTa khATa doSa-truTi chAr3A var3a var3a pApa o azlIla kAryakalApa theke virata thAke, nizcaYa tomAra rava kSamAra vyApAre udAra, tini tomAdera vyApAre samyaka avagata| yakhana tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena evaM yakhana tomarA tomAdera mAtRgarbhe bhrUNarUpe chile| kAjei tomarA AtmaprazaMsA karo nA| ke tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche, se samparke tinii samyaka avagata|
tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecha, ye mukha phiriYe neYa?
Ara sAmAnya dAna kare, tArapara vandha kare deYa?
tAra kAche ki Ache gAYevera jJAna ye, se dekhache?
nAki mUsAra kitAve yA Ache, se samparke tAke avahita karA haYani?
Ara ivarAhImera kitAve, ye (nirdeza) pUrNa karechila|
tA ei ye, kona vojhA vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA|
Ara ei ye, mAnuSa yA ceSTA kare, tAi se pAYa|
Ara ei ye, tAra praceSTAra phala zIghrai tAke dekhAno have|
tArapara tAke pUrNa pratiphala pradAna karA have|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra ravera nikaTai halo zeSa gantavya|
Ara nizcaYa tinii hAsAna evaM tinii kA~dAna|
Ara nizcaYa tinii mRtyu dena evaM tinii jIvana dena|
Ara tinii yugala sRSTi karena- puruSa o nArI|
zukravindu theke yakhana tA nikSipta haYa|
Ara nizcaYa punarAYa sRSTira dAYitva tA~ra uparai|
Ara tinii abhAvamukta karena o sampada dAna karena|
Ara tinii zirAra* rava| * ekaTi nakSatrera nAma|
Ara tinii prAcIna ‘Ada jAtike dhvaMsa karechena|
Ara sAmUda jAtikeo| kAuke tini avaziSTa rAkhena ni|
Ara pUrve nUhera kaomakeo| nizcaYa tArA chila atizaYa yAlima o carama avAdhya|
Ara tini ulTAno AvAsabhUmike* nikSepa karechilena| * sAmUda sampradAYera janapada|
ataHpara seTAke Acchanna karechila, yA Acchanna karAra chila|
tAhale tumi tomAra ravera kon anugraha samparke sandeha poSaNa karave?
atIta satarkakArIdera mata ei navIo ekajana satarkakArI|
kiYAmata nikaTavartI|
AllAha chAr3A keui tA prakAza karate sakSama naYa|
tomarA ki e kathAYa vismaYa vodha karacha?
Ara hAsacha evaM kA~dacha nA?
Ara tomarA to gAphila|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhara uddezye sijadA kara evaM ivAdAta kara|[sAjadAha]
kiYAmata nikaTavartI haYeche evaM cA~da vidIrNa haYeche|
Ara tArA kona nidarzana dekhale mukha phiriYe neYa evaM vale, ‘calamAna yAdu’|
Ara tArA asvIkAra kare evaM nija nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare| athaca pratiTi viSaYa (zeSa sImAYa) sthira have|
Ara tAdera kAche to saMvAdasamUha eseche, yAte raYeche upadezavANI,
paripUrNa hikamAta| tave satarkavANI tAdera kona upakAre Aseni|
ataeva tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo, sedina AhavAnakArI AhavAna karave eka vibhISikAmaYa viSaYera dike,
tArA tAdera dRSTi avanata avasthAYa kavara theke vera haYe Asave| mane have yena tArA vikSipta paGgapAla|
tArA AhavAnakArIra dike bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa chuTe Asave| kAphirarA valave, ‘eTi var3ai kaThina dina’|
tAdera pUrve nUhera kaomao asvIkAra karechila| tArA AmAra vAndAke asvIkAra karechila evaM valechila, ‘pAgala’| Ara tAke humaki deYA haYechila|
ataHpara se tAra ravake AhavAna karala ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami parAjita, ataeva tumii pratizodha grahaNa kara’|
phale Ami varSaNazIla vAridhArAra mAdhyame AsamAnera darajAsamUha khule dilAma|
Ara bhUmite Ami jharnA utsArita karalAma| phale sakala pAni milita hala nirdhArita nirdezanA anusAre|
Ara Ami tAke (nUhake) kATha o pereka nirmita nauyAne ArohaNa karAlAma|
yA AmAra cAkSusa tattvAvadhAne calata, tAra janya puraskArasvarUpa, yAke pratyAkhyAna karA haYechila|
Ara Ami tAke nidarzana hiseve rekhechi| ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
ataeva AmAra AyAva o bhaYa pradarzana kemana chila?
Ara Ami to kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya| ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
‘Ada jAti asvIkAra karechila, ataeva AmAra AyAva o bhaYa pradarzana kirUpa haYechila?
nizcaYa Ami tAdera opara pAThiYechilAma pracanDa zItala jhar3o hAoYA, avyAhata eka amaGgala dine|
tA mAnuSake utkhAta karechila| yena tArA utpATita khejuragAchera kAnDa|
ataeva AmAra AyAva o bhaYa pradarzana kirUpa haYechila?
Ara Ami to kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya| ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
sAmUda jAtio satarkakArIderake mithyAvAdI valechila|
ataHpara tArA valechila, ‘AmarA ki AmAderai madhya theke eka vyaktira anusaraNa karava? tAhale nizcaYa AmarA pathabhraSTatA o ummattatAra madhye par3ava’|
‘AmAdera madhya theke ki tAra oparai upadezavANI pAThAno haYeche? varaM se carama mithyAvAdI ahaGkArI’|
AgAmI dina tArA jAnate pArave, ke carama mithyAvAdI, ahaGkArI|
nizcaYa Ami tAdera janya parIkSAsvarUpa uSTrI pAThAcchi| ataeva tumi tAdera vyApAre apekSA kara evaM dhairyadhAraNa kara|
Ara tAderake jAniYe dAo ye, tAdera madhye pAni vaNTana sunirdiSTa| pratyekei (pAlAkrame) pAnira aMze upasthita have|
ataHpara tArA tAdera sAthIke Deke Anala| takhana se uSTrIke dharala, tArapara hatyA karala|
ataeva AmAra AyAva o bhaYa pradarzana kirUpa haYechila?
nizcaYa Ami tAdera kAche pAThiYechilAma eka vikaTa AoYAja, phale tArA khoYAr3a prastutakArIra khanDita zuSka khar3era mata haYe gela|
Ara Ami to kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya| ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
lUtera kaoma satarkakArIderake mithyAvAdI valechila|
nizcaYa Ami tAdera upara kaMkara-jhar3a pAThiYechilAma, tave lUta parivArera upara naYa| Ami tAderake zeSa rAte nAjAta diYechilAma,
AmAra kAcha theke anugrahasvarUpa| ebhAvei Ami tAke pratidAna dei, ye kRtajJa haYa|
Ara lUta to tAderake AmAra kaThina pAkar3Ao samparke sAvadhAna karechila, tAraparao tArA sAvadhAna vANI samparke sandeha poSaNa karechila|
Ara tArA tAra kAche tAra mehamAnaderake (asaduddezye) dAvI karala| takhana Ami tAdera cokhaguloke andha kare dilAma| (Ara valalAma) AmAra AyAva o sAvadhAnavANIra pariNAma AsvAdana kara|
Ara sakAla velA tAdera upara avirata AyAva neme Asala|
‘Ara AmAra AyAva o sAvadhAnavANIra pariNAma AsvAdana kara’|
Ara Ami to kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi, upadeza grahaNera janya| ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
phira‘Auna goSThIra kAcheo to sAvadhAnavANI esechila|
tArA AmAra sakala nidarzanake asvIkAra karala, ataeva Ami mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvazaktimAnera matai tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma|
tomAdera (makkAra) kAphirarA ki tAdera ceYe bhAla? nA ki tomAdera janya muktira kona ghoSaNA raYeche (AsamAnI) kitAvasamUhera madhye?
nA ki tArA vale, ‘AmarA saMghavaddha vijaYI dala’?
saMghavaddha dalaTi zIghrai parAjita have evaM piTha dekhiYe pAlAve|
varaM kiYAmata tAdera pratizruta samaYa| Ara kiYAmata ati bhaYaGkara o tiktatara|
nizcaYa aparAdhIrA raYeche pathabhraSTatA o (parakAle) prajjvalita Agune|
sedina tAderake upur3a kare Tene hi~car3e jAhAnnAme neYA have| (valA have) jAhAnnAmera cho~YA AsvAdana kara|
nizcaYa Ami sava kichu sRSTi karechi nirdhArita parimANa anuyAYI|
Ara AmAra Adeza to kevala ekaTi kathA, cokhera palakera mata|
Ara Ami to tomAdera mata anekake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, ataeva kona upadeza grahaNakArI Ache ki?
Ara tArA yA kareche, sava kichui ‘AmalanAmAYa’ raYeche|
Ara choTa var3a sava kichui likhita Ache|
nizcaYa muttAkIrA thAkave vAga-vAgicA o jharNAdhArAra madhye|
yathAyogya Asane, sarvazaktimAna mahAadhipatira nikaTe|
parama karuNAmaYa,
tini zikSA diYechena kuraAna,
tini sRSTi karechena mAnuSa,
tini tAke zikhiYechena bhASA|

sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?

sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
Ara samudre calamAna pAhAr3asama jAhAjasamUha tA~rai|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
