Ara theke yAve zudhu mahAmahima o mahAnubhava tomAra ravera cehArA*| *cehArA valate kona kona tAphasIrakAra AllAhara sattAke vujhiYechena|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugrahake asvIkAra karave?
AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yArA raYeche, savAi tA~ra kAche cAYa| pratidina tini kona nA kona kAje rata|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
he mAnuSa o jina, Ami acirei tomAdera (hisAva-nikAza grahaNera) prati manoniveza karava|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
he jina o mAnavajAti, yadi tomarA AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sImAnA theke vera hate pAra, tAhale vera hao| kintu tomarA to (AllAhara deYA) zakti chAr3A vera hate pArave nA|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
tomAdera ubhaYera prati preraNa karA have agnizikhA o kAlo dho~YA, takhana tomarA pratirodha karate pArave nA|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ye dina AkAza vidIrNa haYe yAve, ataHpara tA raktima golApera nyAYa lAla cAmar3Ara mata have|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ataHpara sedina nA mAnuSake tAra aparAdha samparke jijJAsAvAda karA have, nA jinake|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugrahake asvIkAra karave?
aparAdhIderake cenA yAve tAdera ci‎‎hna‎‎ra sAhAyye| ataHpara tAderake mAthAra agrabhAgera cula o pA dhare neYA have|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ei sei jAhAnnAma, yAke aparAdhIrA asvIkAra karata|
tArA ghurate thAkave jAhAnnAma o phuTanta pAnira madhye|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
Ara ye tAra ravera sAmane dA~r3Ate bhaYa kare, tAra janya thAkave du’Ti jAnnAta|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYai vahu phaladAra zAkhAviziSTa|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYera madhye thAkave du’Ti jharNAdhArA yA pravAhita have|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYera madhye pratyeka phala theke thAkave du’ prakArera|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
sekhAne puru rezamera AstaraviziSTa vichAnAYa tArA helAna deYA avasthAYa thAkave evaM dui jAnnAtera phala-phalAdi thAkave nikaTavartI|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
sekhAne thAkave svAmIra prati dRSTi sImitakArI mahilAgaNa, yAderake itaHpUrve sparza kareni kona mAnuSa Ara nA kona jina|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
tArA yena hIrA o pravAla|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
uttama kAjera pratidAna uttama chAr3A Ara kI hate pAre?
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
Ara ai du’Ti jAnnAta chAr3Ao Aro du’Ti jAnnAta raYeche|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
jAnnAta du’Ti gAr3ha savuja|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
e du’Tite thAkave avirAma dhArAYa ucchalamAna du’Ti jharNAdhArA|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
e du’Tite thAkave phalamUla, khejura o AnAra|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
sei jAnnAtasamUhe thAkave uttama caritravatI anindya sundarIgaNa|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
tArA hUra, tA~vute thAkave surakSitA|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
yAderake itaHpUrve sparza kareni kona mAnuSa Ara nA kona jina |
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon niAmatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
tArA savuja vAlize o sundara kArukArya khacita gAlicAra upara helAna deYA avasthAYa thAkave|
sutarAM tomAdera ravera kon ni‘Amatake tomarA ubhaYe asvIkAra karave?
tomAra ravera nAma varakatamaYa, yini mahAmahima o mahAnubhava|
yakhana kiYAmata saMghaTita have|
tAra saMghaTanera konai asvIkArakArI thAkave nA|
tA kAuke bhUluNThita karave evaM kAuke karave samunnata|
yakhana yamIna prakampita have pravala prakampane|
Ara parvatamAlA cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe par3ave|
ataHpara tA vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata have|
Ara tomarA vibhakta haYe par3ave tina dale|
sutarAM DAna pArzvera dala, DAna pArzvera dalaTi kata saubhAgyavAna!
Ara vAma pArzvera dala, vAma pArzvera dalaTi kata hatabhAgya!
Ara agragAmIrAi agragAmI|
tArAi sAnnidhyaprApta|
tArA thAkave niAmatapUrNa jAnnAtasamUhe |
vahusaMkhyaka have pUrvavartIdera madhya theke,
Ara alpasaMkhyaka have paravartIdera madhya theke|
svarNa o dAmI pAtharakhacita Asane!
tArA sekhAne helAna diYe AsIna thAkave mukhomukhi avasthAYa|
tAdera Aza-pAze ghorApherA karave cira kizorarA,
pAnapAtra, jaga o pravAhita jharNAra zarAvapUrNa peYAlA niYe,
tA pAne nA tAdera mAthA vyathA karave, Ara nA tArA mAtAla have|
Ara (ghorApherA karave) tAdera pachandamata phala niYe|
Ara pAkhira goz‌ta niYe, yA tArA kAmanA karave|
Ara thAkave DAgaracokhA hUra,
yena tArA surakSita muktA,
tArA ye Amala karata tAra pratidAnasvarUpa|
tArA sekhAne zunate pAve nA kona vehudA kathA, evaM nA pApera kathA;
zudhu ei vANI chAr3A, ‘sAlAma, sAlAma’
Ara DAna dikera dala; kata bhAgyavAna DAna dikera dala!
tArA thAkave kA~TAvihIna kulagAchera nice,
Ara kA~dipUrNa kalAgAchera nice,
Ara vistRta chAYAYa,
Ara sadA pravAhita pAnira pAze,
Ara pracura phalamUle,
yA zeSa have nA evaM niSiddhao have nA|
(tArA thAkave) suucca zayyAsamUhe;
nizcaYa Ami hUraderake vizeSabhAve sRSTi karava|
ataHpara tAderake vAnAva kumArI,
sohAginI o samavaYasI|
DAnadikera lokadera janya|
tAdera aneke have pUrvavartIdera madhya theke|
Ara aneke have paravartIdera madhya theke|
Ara vAma dikera dala, kata hatabhAgya vAma dikera dala!
tArA thAkave tIvra garama hAoYA evaM pracanDa uttapta pAnite,
Ara pracanDa kAlo dho~YAra chAYAYa,
yA zItalao naYa, sukhakarao naYa|
nizcaYa tArA itaHpUrve vilAsitAYa magna chila,
Ara tArA jaghanya pApe lege thAkata|
Ara tArA valata, ‘AmarA yakhana mare yAva evaM mATi o hAr3e pariNata hava takhanao ki AmarA punarutthita hava?’
‘AmAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSarAo?’
vala, ‘nizcaYa pUrvavartIrA o paravartIrA,
eka nirdhArita dinera nirdiSTa samaYe avazyai ekatra have’|
tArapara he pathabhraSTa o asvIkArakArIrA,
tomarA avazyai yAkkUma gAcha theke khAve,
ataHpara tA diYe peTa bharti karave|
tadupari pAna karave pracanDa uttapta pAni|
ataHpara tomarA tA pAna karave tRSNAtura uTera nyAYa|
pratiphala divase ei have tAdera mehamAnadArI,
Amii tomAderake sRSTi karechi: tAhale kena tomarA tA vizvAsa karacha nA?
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, tomarA ye vIryapAta karacha se samparke?
tA ki tomarA sRSTi kara, nA Amii tAra sraSTA?
Ami tomAdera madhye mRtyu nirdhAraNa karechi evaM AmAke akSama karA yAve nA,
tomAdera sthAne tomAdera vikalpa AnaYana karate evaM tomAderake emanabhAve sRSTi karate yA tomarA jAna nA|
Ara tomarA to prathama sRSTi samparke jenecha, tave kena tomarA upadeza grahaNa karacha nA?
tomarA AmAke vala, tomarA yamIne yA vapana kara se vyApAre,
tomarA tA aGkurita kara, nA Ami aGkurita kari?
Ami cAile tA khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata karate pAri, takhana tomarA paritApa karate thAkave-
(ei vale,) ‘nizcaYa AmarA dAYagrasta haYe gelAma’|
‘varaM AmarA mAharUma haYechi’|
tomarA ye pAni pAna kara se vyApAre AmAke vala|
vRSTibharA megha theke tomarA ki tA varSaNa kara, nA Ami vRSTi varSaNakArI?
icchA karale Ami tA lavaNAkta kare dite pAri: tavuo kena tomarA kRtajJa hao nA?
tomarA ye Aguna jvAlAo se vyApAre AmAke vala,
tomarAi ki era (lAkar3ira gAcha) utpAdana kara, nA Ami kari?
eke Ami karechi eka smAraka o maruvAsIra praYojanIYa vastu|
ataeva tomAra mahAna ravera nAme tAsavIha pATha kara|
sutarAM Ami kasama karachi nakSatrarAjira astAcalera,
Ara nizcaYa eTi eka mahAkasama, yadi tomarA jAnate,
nizcaYa eTi mahimAnvita kuraAna,
yA Ache surakSita kitAve,
keu tA sparza karave nA pavitragaNa chAr3A|
tA sRSTikulera ravera kAcha theke nAyilakRta|
tave ki tomarA ei vANI tuccha gaNya karacha?
Ara tomarA tomAdera riyka vAniYe niYecha ye, tomarA mithyA Aropa karave|
sutarAM kena naYa- yakhana rUha kaNThadeze pau~che yAYa?
Ara takhana tomarA kevala ceYe thAka|
Ara tomAdera cAite Ami tAra khuva kAche; kintu tomarA dekhate pAo nA|
tomAdera yadi pratiphala deYA nA haYa, tAhale tomarA kena
phiriYe Anacha nA rUhake, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?
ataHpara se yadi naikaTyaprAptadera anyatama haYa,
tave tAra janya thAkave vizrAma, uttama jIvanopakaraNa o sukhamaYa jAnnAta|
Ara se yadi haYa DAnadikera ekajana,
tave (tAke valA have), ‘tomAke sAlAma, yehetu tumi DAnadikera ekajana’|
Ara se yadi haYa asvIkArakArI o pathabhraSTa,
tave tAra mehamAnadArI have pracanDa uttapta pAni diYe,
Ara jvalanta Agune prajjvalane|
nizcaYa eTi avadhArita satya|
ataeva tomAra mahAna ravera nAme tAsavIha pATha kara|
AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache, savai AllAhara tAsavIha pATha kare| Ara tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva tA~rai| tinii jIvana dena evaM tinii mRtyu dena| Ara tini sakala kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
tinii prathama o zeSa evaM prakAzya o gopana; Ara tini sakala viSaYe samyaka avagata|

tinii AsamAnasamUha o yamIna chaYa dine sRSTi karechena, tArapara tini Araze uThechena| tini jAnena yamIne yA kichu praveza kare evaM tA theke yA kichu vera haYa; Ara AsamAna theke yA kichu avatIrNa haYa evaM tAte yA kichu utthita haYa| Ara tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, tini tomAdera sAthei Achena| Ara tomarA yA kara, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
AsamAnasamUha o yamInera rAjatva tA~rai evaM AllAharai dike sakala viSaYa pratyAvartita have|
tini rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna| Ara tini antarasamUhera viSaYAdi samparke samyaka avagata|

tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana evaM tini tomAderake yA kichura uttarAdhikArI karechena, tA theke vyaYa kara| ataHpara tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche virATa pratiphala|

Ara tomAdera kI halo ye, tomarA AllAhara prati ImAna Anacha nA? athaca rAsUla tomAderake tomAdera ravera prati ImAna Anate AhavAna karache| Ara tini tomAdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karechena, yadi tomarA mumina hao|

tinii tA~ra vAndAra prati suspaSTa AYAtasamUha nAyila karena, yAte tini tomAderake andhakAra theke Alora dike vera kare Anate pArena| Ara nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera prati atizaYa daYAlu, parama karuNAmaYa|

tomAdera kI halo ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karacha nA? athaca AsamAnasamUha o yamInera uttarAdhikArato AllAharai? tomAdera madhye yArA makkA vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche evaM yuddha kareche tArA samAna naYa| tArA maryAdAYa tAdera ceYe zreSTha, yArA pare vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche| tave AllAha pratyekera janyai kalyANera oYAdA karechena| Ara tomarA yA kara, se samparke AllAha savizeSa avagata|
emana ke Ache ye, AllAhake uttama karaya dive? tAhale tini tAra janya tA vahuguNe vRddhi kare divena evaM tAra janya raYeche sammAnajanaka pratidAna|

sedina tumi mumina puruSadera o mumina nArIdera dekhate pAve ye, tAdera sAmane o tAdera DAna pArzve tAdera nUra chuTate thAkave| (valA have) ‘Aja tomAdera susaMvAda hala jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe nadIsamUha pravAhita, tathAYa tomarA sthAYI have| eTAi hala mahAsAphalya|

sedina munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIgaNa ImAnadAradera valave, ‘tomarA AmAdera janya apekSA kara, tomAdera nUra theke AmarA ekaTu niYe nei’, valA have, ‘tomarA tomAdera pichane phire yAo evaM nUrera sandhAna kara,’ tArapara tAdera mAjhakhAne ekaTi prAcIra sthApana kare deYA have, yAte ekaTi darajA thAkave| tAra bhitarabhAge thAkave rahamata evaM tAra vahirbhAge thAkave AyAva|

munAphikarA muminaderake Deke valave, ‘AmarA ki tomAdera sAthe chilAma nA? tArA valave ‘hyA~, kintu tomarA nijerAi nijaderake vipadagrasta karecha| Ara tomarA apekSA karechile* evaM sandeha poSaNa karechile evaM AkAGkSA tomAderake pratArita karechila, avazeSe AllAhara nirdeza ese gela| Ara mahA pratAraka** tomAderake AllAha samparke pratArita karechila| *AmAdera amaGgalera| **zaYatAna|

sutarAM Aja tomAdera kAcha theke kona muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM yArA kupharI karechila tAdera kAcha thekeo nA| jAhAnnAmai tomAdera AvAsasthala| seTAi tomAdera upayukta sthAna| Ara katai nA nikRSTa sei gantavyasthala!

yArA ImAna eneche tAdera hRdaYa ki AllAhara smaraNe evaM ye satya nAyila haYeche tAra kAraNe vigalita haoYAra samaYa haYani? Ara tArA yena tAdera mata nA haYa, yAderake itaHpUrve kitAva deYA haYechila, tArapara tAdera upara diYe dIrghakAla atikrAnta hala, ataHpara tAdera antarasamUha kaThina haYe gela| Ara tAdera adhikAMzai phAsika|
tomarA jene rAkha ye, AllAh yamInake tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| Ami nidarzanasamUha tomAdera kAche suspaSTabhAve varNanA karechi, AzA karA yAYa tomarA vujhate pArave|
nizcaYa dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIla nArI evaM yArA AllAhake uttama karaya deYa, tAdera janya vahuguNa vAr3iYe deYA have evaM tAdera janya raYeche sammAnajanaka pratidAna|

Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUladera prati ImAna Ane, tArAi tAdera ravera nikaTa siddIka o zahIda| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera pratiphala evaM tAdera nUra| Ara yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

tomarA jene rAkha ye, duniYAra jIvana krIr3A kautuka, zobhA-saundarya, tomAdera pArasparika garva-ahaGkAra evaM dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite Adhikyera pratiyogitA mAtra| era upamA hala vRSTira mata, yAra utpanna phasala kRSakaderake Ananda deYa, tArapara tA zukiYe yAYa, takhana tumi tA haluda varNera dekhate pAo, tArapara tA khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata haYa| Ara AkhirAte Ache kaThina AyAva evaM AllAhara pakSa theke kSamA o santuSTi| Ara duniYAra jIvanaTA to dhokAra sAmagrI chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

tomarA tomAdera ravera pakSa theke kSamA o sei jAnnAtera dike pratiyogitAYa avatIrNa hao, yAra prazastatA AsamAna o yamInera prazastatAra mata| tA prastata karA haYeche yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUladera prati ImAna Ane tAdera janya| eTA AllAhara anugraha| tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|
yamIne evaM tomAdera nijadera madhye emana kona musIvata Apatita haYa nA, yA Ami saMghaTita karAra pUrve kitAve lipivaddha rAkhi nA| nizcaYa eTA AllAhara pakSe khuvai sahaja|
yAte tomarA Aphasosa nA kara tAra upara yA tomAdera theke hAriYe geche evaM tomarA utphulla nA hao tini tomAderake yA diYechena tAra kAraNe| Ara AllAha kona uddhata o ahaGkArIke pachanda karena nA|
yArA kRpaNatA kare evaM mAnuSake kRpaNatAra nirdeza deYa, Ara ye mukha phiriYe neYa, tAhale AllAha nizcaYa abhAvamukta, saprazaMsita|

nizcaYa Ami AmAra rAsUladerake spaSTa pramANAdisaha pAThiYechi evaM tAdera sAthe kitAva o (nyAYera) mAnadanDa nAyila karechi, yAte mAnuSa suvicAra pratiSThA kare| Ami Aro nAyila karechi lohA, tAte pracanDa zakti o mAnuSera janya vahu kalyANa raYeche| Ara yAte AllAha jene nite pArena, ke nA dekheo tA~ke o tA~ra rAsUladerake sAhAyya kare| avazyai AllAha mahAzaktidhara, mahAparAkramazAlI|

Ara Ami to nUha o ivarAhImake rAsUlarUpe pAThiYechilAma evaM tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYAta o kitAva diYechilAma| tArapara tAdera madhye keu keu saThika patha avalamvanakArI chila, Ara tAdera adhikAMzai chila phAsika|

tArapara tAdera pichane Ami AmAra rAsUladerake anugAmI karechilAma evaM mAraiYAma putra IsAkeo anugAmI karechilAma| Ara tAke inajIla kitAva diYechilAma evaM yArA tAra anusaraNa karechila tAdera antarasamUhe karuNA o daYAmAYA diYechilAma| AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera AzAYa tArAi vairAgyavAdera pravartana karechila| eTA Ami tAdera opara lipivaddha kare deini| tArapara tAo tArA yathAyathabhAve rakSaNAvekSaNa kareni| Ara tAdera madhye yArA ImAna enechila tAderake Ami tAdera pratidAna diYechilAma evaM tAdera madhye adhikAMzai chila phAsika|

he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana, tini svIYa rahamate tomAderake dviguNa puraskAra devena, Ara tomAderake nUra devena yAra sAhAyye tomarA calate pArave evaM tini tomAderake kSamA kare devena| Ara AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(tA ejanya ye,) Ahale kitAvagaNa yena jene nite pAre, AllAhara anugrahera kona vastutei tArA kSamatA rAkhe nA| Ara nizcaYa anugraha AllAhara hAtei, yAke icchA tini tA dena| Ara AllAha mahAanugrahera adhikArI|

AllAha avazyai se ramanIra kathA zunechena ye tAra svAmIra vyApAre tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karachila Ara AllAhara kAche phariYAda karachila| AllAha tomAdera kathopakathana zonena| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tomAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe yihAra* kare, tAdera strIgaNa tAdera mAtA naYa| tAdera mAtA to kevala tArAi yArA tAderake janma diYeche| Ara tArA avazyai asaGgata o asatya kathA vale| Ara nizcaYa AllAha adhika pApa mocanakArI, var3ai kSamAzIla| * strIke mAYera sAthe athavA mAYera kona aMgera sAthe tulanA karAke ‘yihAra’ vale| prAcIna Arava samAje strIke mAYera sAthe tulanA karAra mAdhyame vaivAhika samparka chinna karA hata| isalAme era mAdhyame sarAsari vaivAhika samparka chinna haYa nA| tave asaGgata kathA valAra kAraNe kAphphArA dite haYa|

Ara yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe ‘yihAra’ kare ataHpara tArA yA valeche tA theke phire Ase, tave eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekaTi dAsa mukta karave| era mAdhyame tomAderake upadeza deYA hacche| Ara tomarA yA kara, se samparke AllAha samyaka avahita|

kintu ye tA pAve nA, se lAgAtAra du’mAsa siYAma pAlana karave, eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve| Ara ye (erUpa karAra) sAmarthya rAkhe nA se SATajana misakInake khAvAra khAoYAve| e vidhAna e janya ye, tomarA yAte AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana| Ara egulo AllAhara (nirdhArita) sImA evaM kAphiradera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare tAderake apadastha karA have yebhAve apadastha karA haYechila tAdera pUrvavartIderake| Ara Ami nAyila karechi suspaSTa pramANAdi| Ara kAphiradera janya raYeche apamAnajanaka AyAva|

ye dina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarujjIvita kare uThAvena ataHpara tArA ye Amala karechila tA tAderake jAniYe devena| AllAha tA hisAva kare rekhechena yadio tArA tA bhule geche| Ara AllAha pratyeka viSaYe pratyakSadarzI|

tumi ki lakSya karani ye, AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache nizcaYa AllAha tA jAnena? tina janera kona gopana parAmarza haYa nA yAte caturthajana hiseve AllAha thAkena nA, Ara pA~ca janerao haYa nA, yAte SaSThajana hiseve tini thAkena nA| era ceYe kama hoka kiMvA vezi hoka, tini to tAdera saGgei Achena, tArA yekhAnei thAkuka nA kena| tArapara kiYAmatera dina tini tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samparke jAniYe devena| nizcaYa AllAha sava viSaYe samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani, yAderake gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila? tAraparao tArA tArai punarAvRtti karala yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYechila| Ara tArA pApAcAra, sImAlaGghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNera janya gopana parAmarza kare| Ara tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase takhana tArA tomAke emana (kathAra dvArA) abhivAdana jAnAYa yebhAve AllAha tomAke abhivAdana karenani| Ara tArA mane mane vale, ‘AmarA yA vali tAra janya AllAha AmAderake zAsti dena nA kena? tAdera janya jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa| tArA tAte praveza karave| Ara tA katainA nikRSTa gantavyasthala!

he muminagaNa, tomarA yakhana gopane parAmarza karave takhana tomarA yena gunAha, sImAlaGghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNera vyApAre gopana parAmarza nA kara| Ara tomarA satkarma o tAkaoYAra viSaYe gopana parAmarza kara| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yA~ra kAche tomAderake samaveta karA have|

gopana parAmarza to hala muminarA yAte duHkha pAYa se uddezye kRta zaYatAnera kumantraNA mAtra| Ara AllAhara anumati chAr3A se tAdera kichui kSati karate pAre nA| ataeva AllAharai opara muminarA yena tAoYAkkula kare|

he muminagaNa, tomAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘majalise sthAna kare dAo’, takhana tomarA sthAna kare deve| AllAha tomAdera janya sthAna kare devena| Ara yakhana tomAderake valA haYa, ‘tomarA uThe yAo’, takhana tomarA uThe yAve| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche evaM yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche AllAha tAderake maryAdAYa samunnata karavena| Ara tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke samyaka avahita|

he muminagaNa, tomarA yakhana rAsUlera sAthe ekAnte kathA valate cAo, takhana tomAdera erUpa kathAra pUrve kichu sadAkA peza kara| eTi tomAdera janya zreYatara o pavitratara; kintu yadi tomarA sakSama nA hao tave AllAha parama kSamAzIla, atizaYa daYAlu|

tomarA ki bhaYa peYe gele ye, ekAnta parAmarzera pUrve sadAkA peza karave? hyA~, yakhana tomarA tA karate pArale nA, Ara AllAhao tomAdera kSamA kare dilena, takhana tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara| tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAdera lakSya karani, yArA emana eka kaomera sAthe vandhutva kare yAdera upara AllAhara gayava nipatita haYeche? tArA tomAdera dalabhukta naYa evaM tomarAo tAdera dalabhukta nao| Ara tArA jene zunei mithyAra upara kasama kare|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThora AyAva prastuta kare rekhechena| nizcaYa tArA yA karata tA katainA manda!
tArA tAdera kasamaguloke DhAla hiseve niYeche| ataHpara tArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA pradAna kareche| phale tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka AyAva|
AllAhara viparIte tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati tAdera Adau kona kAje Asave nA| erAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI| tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|

sedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarutthita karavena, takhana tArA AllAhara nikaTa emana kasama karave yemana kasama tomAdera nikaTa kare thAke evaM tArA mane kare ye, tArA kona kichura upara Ache| jene rAkha, nizcaYa erA mithyAvAdI|
zaYatAna edera opara cepe vaseche evaM tAderake AllAhara yikira bhuliYe diYeche| erAi zaYatAnera dala| jene rAkha, nizcaYa zaYatAnera dala kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare tArA carama lAJchitadera antarbhukta|
AllAha likhe diYechena ye, ‘Ami o AmAra rAsUlagaNa avazyai vijaYI hava|’ nizcaYa AllAha mahA zaktimAna, mahA parAkramazAlI|

tumi pAve nA emana jAtike yArA AllAha o parakAlera prati ImAna Ane, vandhutva kare tAra sAthe ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhItA kare, yadio tArA tAdera pitA, athavA putra, athavA bhAi, athavA jJAti-goSThI haYa| erAi, yAdera antare AllAha ImAna likhe diYechena evaM tA~ra pakSa theke rUha dvArA tAdera zaktizAlI karechena| tini tAdera praveza karAvena emana jAnnAtasamUhe yAra nice diYe jharNAdhArAsamUha pravAhita haYa| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa haYeche| erAi AllAhara dala| jene rAkha, nizcaYa AllAhara dalai saphalakAma|
AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara tAsavIha pATha karache evaM tini mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tinii tAderake tAdera ghara-vAr3I theke vera kare diYechilena prathamavArera mata| tomarA dhAraNAo karani ye, tArA veriYe yAve| Ara tArA dhAraNA karechila ye, tAdera durgagulo tAderake AllAhara AyAva theke rakSA karave| kintu AllAhara AyAva emana eka dika theke Asala yA tArA kalpanAo karate pAreni evaM tini tAdera antarasamUhe trAsera saJcAra karalena, phale tArA tAdera vAr3I-ghara Apana hAte o muminadera hAte dhvaMsa karate zuru karala| ataeva he dRSTimAna lokerA tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|’
Ara AllAha yadi tAdera janya nirvAsana lipivaddha nA karatena, tave tini tAderake duniYAte zAsti ditena evaM tAdera janya AkhirAte raYeche Agunera zAsti|
eTi e janya ye, tArA satyii AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa karechila| Ara ye AllAhara viruddhAcaraNa kare, tave nizcaYa AllAha AyAva pradAne kaThora|
tomarA ye sava natuna khejura gAcha keTe phelacha athavA seguloke tAdera mUlera opara dA~r3iYe thAkate diYecha| tA to chila AllAhara anumatikrame evaM yAte tini phAsikadera lAJchita karate pArena|

AllAha iYAhudIdera nikaTa theke tA~ra rAsUlake phAYa* hiseve yA diYechena tomarA tAra janya kona ghor3A vA uTe ArohaNa kare abhiyAna paricAlanA karani| varaM AllAha tA~ra rAsUlagaNake yAdera opara icchA katRtva pradAna karena| AllAha sakala kichura opara sarvazaktimAna| *yuddha chAr3Ai ye dhana-sampada arjita haYa tAke في vale| eTi sAdhAraNata vAYatula mAle jamA rAkhA haYa evaM rAsUla svIYa tattvAvadhAne rASTrIYa praYojane tA vyavahAra karatena| Ara yuddhera mAdhyame yA arjita haYa tAke ganimata غنيمت valA haYa|

AllAha janapadavAsIdera nikaTa theke tA~ra rAsUlake phAYa hiseve yA diYechena tA AllAhara, rAsUlera, AtmIYa-svajanadera, iYAtImadera, misakIna o musAphiradera eTi e janya ye, yAte dhana-sampada tomAdera madhyakAra vittazAlIdera mAjhei kevala Avartita nA thAke| rAsUla tomAdera yA deYa tA grahaNa kara, Ara yA theke se tomAdera niSedha kare tA theke virata hao evaM AllAhakei bhaYa kara, nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAne kaThora|

ei sampada niHsva muhAjiragaNera janya o yAderake nijedera ghara-vAr3I o dhana-sampatti theke vera kare deYA haYechila| athaca erA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTira anveSaNa kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake sAhAyya karena| erAi to satyavAdI|

Ara muhAjiradera Agamanera pUrve yArA madInAke nivAsa hiseve grahaNa karechila evaM ImAna enechila (tAdera janyao e sampade aMza raYeche), Ara yArA tAdera kAche hijarata kare eseche tAderake bhAlavAse| Ara muhAjariderake yA pradAna karA haYeche tAra janya erA tAdera antare kona IrSA anubhava kare nA| evaM nijedera abhAva thAkA sattveo nijedera opara tAderake agrAdhikAra deYa| yAdera manera kArpaNya theke rakSA karA haYeche, tArAi saphalakAma|

yArA tAdera pare eseche tArA vale: ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAderake o AmAdera bhAi yArA ImAna niYe AmAdera pUrve atikrAnta haYeche tAderake kSamA karuna; evaM yArA ImAna enechila tAdera janya AmAdera antare kona vidveSa rAkhavena nA; he AmAdera rava, nizcaYa Apani daYAvAna, parama daYAlu|

tumi ki munAphikaderake dekhani yArA Ahale kitAvera madhya hate tAdera kAphira bhAiderake vale, ‘tomAderake vera kare deYA hale AmarAo tomAdera sAthe avazya veriYe yAva evaM tomAdera vyApAre AmarA kakhanoi kAro Anugatya karava nA| Ara tomAdera sAthe yuddha karA hale AmarA avazyai tomAderake sAhAyya karava|’ Ara AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, tArA mithyAvAdI|

tArA (ihudirA) yadi vahiSkRta haYa tave erA (munAphikarA) kakhano tAdera sAthe veriYe yAve nA Ara tAdera (iYAhudIdera) sAthe yadi yuddha karA haYa erA (munAphikarA) kakhano tAderake sAhAyya karave nA| Ara yadi tAderake sAhAyya kare tave tArA avazyai piTha dekhiYe pAlAve; erapara tArA kona sAhAyyai pAve nA|
prakRtapakSe tAdera antare AllAhara cAite tomAdera bhaYa vezI; eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA avujha sampradAYa|

tArA sammilitibhAve tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karave nA tave surakSita janapadera madhye avasthAna kare vA deYAlera pechana hate; tArA nijerA nijederake pravala zaktidhara mane kare; tumi tAderake aikyavaddha mane karacha athaca tAdera antarasamUha vicchinna| eTi ejanya ye, tArA nirvodha sampradAYa|
tAdera avyavahita pUrvasUridera nyAYa, yArA nijedera kRtakarmera kuphala AsvAdana kareche; Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|
(erA) zaYatAna-era nyAYa, se mAnuSake valechila, ‘kuphari kara’, ataHpara yakhana se kuphari karala takhana se valala, Ami tomAra theke mukta; nizcaYa Ami sakala sRSTira rava AllAhake bhaYa kari|
tAdera du’janera pariNati chila ei ye, tArA du’janei jAhAnnAmI have, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have; Ara eTAi yAlimadera pratidAna|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara; Ara pratyekera ucita cintA kare dekhA se AgAmIkAlera janya ki preraNa kareche; tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| tomarA yA kara nizcaYa AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avahita|
tomarA tAdera mata haio nA, yArA AllAhake bhule giYechila phale AllAhao tAderake AtmavismRta kare diYechilena; Ara tArAi hala phAsika|
jAhAnnAmavAsI o jAnnAtavAsIrA samAna naYa; jAnnAtavAsIrAi saphalakAma|
e kuraAnake yadi Ami pAhAr3era opara nAyila karatAma tave tumi avazyai tAke dekhate, AllAhara bhaYe vinIta o vidIrNa| mAnuSera janya Ami e udAharaNaguli peza kari; haYata tArA cintAbhAvanA karave|
tinii AllAha, yini chAr3A kona ilAha nei; dRzya-adRzyera jJAtA; tinii parama karuNAmaYa, daYAlu|

tinii AllAha; yini chAr3A kona ilAha nei, tinii vAdazAha, mahApavitra, truTimukta, nirApattAdAnakArI, rakSaka, mahAparAkramazAlI, mahApratApazAlI, atIva mahimAnvita, tArA yA zarIka kare tA hate pavitra mahAna|
tinii AllAha, sraSTA, udbhAvanakartA, AkRtidAnakArI; tA~ra raYeche sundara nAmasamUha; AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache savai tAra mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA AmAra o tomAdera zatruderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare tAdera prati bhAlovAsA pradarzana karo nA, athaca tomAdera kAche ye satya eseche tA tArA asvIkAra kareche evaM rAsUlake o tomAderake vera kare diYeche ejanya ye, tomarA tomAdera rava AllAhara prati ImAna enecha| tomarA yadi AmAra pathe saMgrAme o AmAra santuSTira sandhAne vera hao (tave kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA) tomarA gopane tAdera sAthe vandhutva prakAza kara athaca tomarA yA gopana kara evaM yA prakAza kara tA Ami jAni| tomAdera madhye ye emana karave se sarala patha hate vicyuta have|
tArA yadi tomAderake vAge pAYa tave tomAdera zatru have evaM manda niYe tomAdera dike tAdera hAta o yavAna vAr3Ave; tArA kAmanA kare yadi tomarA kuphari karate!
kiYAmata divase tomAdera AtnIYatA o santAna-santati tomAdera kona upakAra karate pArave nA| tini tomAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA kare devena| tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

ivarAhIma o tAra sAthe yArA chila tAdera madhye tomAdera janya raYeche uttama Adarza| tArA yakhana svIYa sampradAYake valachila, ‘tomAdera sAthe evaM AllAhara parivarte tomarA yA kichura upAsanA kara tA hate AmarA samparkamukta| AmarA tomAderake asvIkAra kari; evaM udreka hala AmAdera- tomAdera mAjhe zatrutA o vidveSa cirakAlera janya; yatakSaNa nA tomarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna Ana| tave svIYa pitAra prati ivarAhImera uktiTi vyatikrama: ‘Ami avazyai tomAra janya AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karava Ara tomAra vyApAre AllAhara kAche Ami kona adhikAra rAkhi nA|’ he AmAdera pratipAlaka, AmarA ApanAra oparai bharasA kari, ApanArai abhimukhI hai Ara pratyAvartana to ApanArai kAche|
he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAderake kAphiradera utpIr3anera pAtra vAnAvena nA| he AmAdera rava, Apani AmAdera kSamA kare dina| nizcaYa Apani mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa tomAdera janya tAdera madhye* uttama Adarza raYeche, yArA AllAha o zeSa divasera pratyAzA kare, Ara ye mukha phiriYe neYa, (se jene rAkhuka) nizcaYa AllAha to abhAvamukta, saprazaMsita| *ivarAhIma A. o tA~ra anusArIdera madhye
yAdera sAthe tomarA zatrutA karacha, AzA karA yAYa AllAha tomAdera o tAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare devena| Ara AllAha sarva zaktimAna evaM AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

dInera vyApAre yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareni evaM tomAderake tomAdera vAr3i-ghara theke vera kare deYani, tAdera prati sadaYa vyavahAra karate evaM tAdera prati nyAYavicAra karate AllAha tomAderake niSedha karachena nA| nizcaYa AllAha nyAYa parAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAha kevala tAdera sAthei vandhutva karate niSedha karechena, yArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareche evaM tomAderake tomAdera ghara-vAr3I theke vera kare diYeche o tomAderake vera kare deYAra vyApAre sahAYatA kareche| Ara yArA tAdera sAthe vandhutva kare, tArAi to yAlima|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomAdera kAche mu’mina mahilArA hijarata kare Asale tomarA tAderake parIkSA kare dekha| AllAha tAdera ImAna samparke adhika avagata| ataHpara yadi tomarA jAnate pAra ye, tArA mumina mahilA, tAhale tAderake Ara kAphiradera nikaTa pherata pAThio nA| tArA kAphiradera janya vaidha naYa evaM kAphirarAo tAdera janya hAlAla naYa| tArA* yA vyaYa kareche, tA tAderake phiriYe dAo| tomarA tAderake viYe karale tomAdera kona aparAdha have nA, yadi tomarA tAderake tAdera mohara pradAna kara| Ara tomarA kAphira nArIdera sAthe vaivAhika samparka vajAYa rekha nA, tomarA yA vyaYa karecha, tA tomarA pherata cAo, Ara tArA yA vyaYa kareche, tA yena tArA ceYe neYa| eTA AllAhara vidhAna| tini tomAdera mAjhe phaYasAlA karena| Ara AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa| *kAphira svAmIrA

Ara tomAdera strIdera madhye yadi keu hAtachAr3A haYe kAphiradera nikaTa cale yAYa, ataHpara yadi tomarA yuddhajaYI haYe ganImata lAbha kara, tAhale yAdera strIrA cale geche, tAderake tArA yA vyaYa kareche, tAra samaparimANa pradAna kara| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAra prati tomarA vizvAsI|

he navI, yakhana mumina nArIrA tomAra kAche ese ei marme vAiAta kare ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe kona kichu zarIka karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, nijedera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA, tArA jene zune kona apavAda racanA kare raTAve nA evaM satkAje tArA tomAra avAdhya have nA| takhana tumi tAdera vAiAta grahaNa kara evaM tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYa AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA sei sampradAYera sAthe vandhutva karo nA, yAdera prati AllAha rAgAnvita haYechena| tArA to AkhirAta samparke nirAza haYe par3eche, yemanibhAve kAphirarA kavaravAsIdera samparke nirAza haYeche|
AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache o yamIne yA kichu Ache, savai AllAhara tAsavIha pATha karache| Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA tA kena vala, yA tomarA kara nA?
tomarA yA kara nA, tA valA AllAhara nikaTa var3ai krodhera viSaYa|
nizcaYa AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena, yArA tA~ra pathe sArivaddha haYe yuddha kare yena tArA sIsA DhAlA prAcIra|

Ara mUsA yakhana tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa, tomarA AmAke kena kaSTa diccha, athaca tomarA nizcaYa jAna ye, Ami avazyai tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara rAsUla’| ataHpara tArA yakhana vA~kApatha avalamvana karala, takhana AllAha tAdera hRdaYaguloke vA~kA kare dilena| Ara AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|

Ara yakhana mAraiYAma putra IsA valechila, ‘he vanI isarAIla, nizcaYa Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara rAsUla| AmAra pUrvavartI tAorAtera satyAYanakArI evaM ekajana rAsUlera susaMvAdadAtA yini AmAra pare Asavena, yAra nAma Ahamada’| ataHpara se yakhana suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe Agamana karala, takhana tArA valala, ‘eTAto spaSTa yAdu’|
sei vyaktira ceYe adhika yAlima Ara ke? ye AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare, athaca tAke isalAmera dike AhavAna karA haYa| Ara AllAha yAlima sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|
tArA tAdera mukhera phutkAre AllAhara nUrake nibhiYe dite cAYa, kintu AllAha tA~ra nUrake pUrNatAdAnakArI| yadio kAphirarA tA apachanda kare|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake hidAYAta o satyadvIna diYe preraNa karechena, yAte tini sakala dvInera upara tA vijaYI kare dena| yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|
he ImAnadAragaNa, Ami ki tomAderake emana eka vyavasAYera sandhAna deva, yA tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva theke rakSA karave?
tomarA AllAhara prati o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Anave evaM tomarA tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda karave| eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara, yadi tomarA jAnate|

tini tomAdera janya tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare divena| Ara tomAderake emana jAnnAtasamUhe praveza karAvena yAra taladeze naharasamUha pravAhita evaM cirasthAYI jAnnAtasamUhe uttama AvAsaguloteo (praveza karavena)| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
evaM Aro ekaTi (arjana) yA tomarA khuva pachanda kara| (arthAt) AllAhara pakSa theke sAhAyya o nikaTavartI vijaYa| Ara muminaderake tumi susaMvAda dAo|

he muminagaNa, tomarA AllAhara sAhAyyakArI hao| yemana mAraiYAma putra IsA hAoYArIderake* valechila, AllAhara pathe kArA AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? hAoYArIgaNa valala, AmarAi AllAhara sAhAyyakArI| tArapara vanI-IsarAilera madhya theke ekadala ImAna Anala evaM apara eka dala pratyAkhyAna karala| ataHpara yArA ImAna Anala Ami tAderake tAdera zatruvAhinIra opara zaktizAlI karalAma| phale tArA vijaYI hala| *IsAH (AH) era khAsa anusArIderake hAoYArI valA hata|
AsamAnasamUhe evaM yamIne yA Ache savai pavitratA ghoSaNA kare AllAhara| yini vAdazAha, mahApavitra, mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii ummIdera* mAjhe ekajana rAsUla pAThiYechena tAdera madhya theke, ye tAdera kAche telAoYAta kare tA~ra AYAtasamUha, tAderake pavitra kare evaM tAderake zikSA deYa kitAva o hikamAta| yadio itaHpUrve tArA spaSTa gomarAhIte chila| *ummI dvArA Aravera lokaderake vujhAno haYeche|
evaM tAdera madhya hate anyAnyadera janyao, (e rAsUlakei pAThAno haYeche) yArA ekhano tAdera sAthe milita haYani| Ara tinii mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAhara anugraha, yAke icchA tini tA dAna karena| Ara AllAha mahA anugrahera adhikArI|

yAderake tAorAtera dAYitvabhAra deYA haYechila tArapara tArA tA vahana kareni, tArA gAdhAra mata! ye vahu kitAvera vojhA vahana kare| se sampradAYera upamA katainA nikRSTa, yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare| Ara AllAha yAlima sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|
vala, he iYAhudIrA, yadi tomarA mane kara ye, (anya) mAnuSerA naYa, kevala tomarAi AllAhara vandhu, tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
Ara tArA, tAdera hAta yA Age pAThiYeche se kAraNe kakhano mRtyu kAmanA karave nA| Ara AllAha yAlimadera samparke samyaka avahita|

vala ye mRtyu hate tomarA palAYana karacha tA avazyai tomAdera sAthe sAkSAt karave| tArapara tomAderake adRzya o dRzya samparke parijJAta AllAhara kAche phiriYe neYA have| tArapara tini tomAderake jAniYe devena yA tomarA karate|

he muminagaNa, yakhana jumu‘Ara dine sAlAtera janya AhavAna karA haYa, takhana tomarA AllAhara smaraNera dike dhAvita hao| Ara vecA-kenA varjana kara| eTAi tomAdera janya sarvottama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
ataHpara yakhana sAlAta samApta have takhana tomarA pRthivIte char3iYe par3a Ara AllAhara anugraha hate anusandhAna kara evaM AllAhake vezi vezi smaraNa kara, yAte tomarA saphala hate pAra|

Ara tArA yakhana vyavasAYa athavA krIr3A kautuka dekhe takhana tArA tAra dike chuTe yAYa, Ara tomAke dA~r3Ana avasthAYa rekhe yAYa| vala, AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA krIr3A- kautuka o vyavasAYa apekSA uttama| Ara AllAha sarvottama riyakadAtA|

yakhana tomAra kAche munAphikarA Ase, takhana vale, AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye, nizcaYa Apani AllAhara rAsUla evaM AllAha jAnena ye, avazyai tumi tA~ra rAsUla| Ara AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, avazyai munAphikarA mithyAvAdI|
tArA nijadera zapathake DhAla hiseve vyavahAra kare| ataHpara tArA AllAhara patha theke virata rAkhe| tArA yA karache, nizciYa tA katainA manda!
tA e janya ye, tArA ImAna enechila tArapara kupharI karechila| phale tAdera antarasamUhe mohara lAgiYe deYA haYeche| tAi tArA vujhate pArache nA|

Ara yakhana tumi tAdera prati tAkiYe dekhave takhana tAdera zarIra tomAke mugdha karave| Ara yadi tArA kathA vale tumi tAdera kathA (Agraha niYe) zunave| tArA deYAle Thesa deYA kAThera matai| tArA mane kare pratiTi AoYAjai tAdera viruddhe| erAi zatru, ataeva edera samparke satarka hao| AllAha ederake dhvaMsa karuna| tArA kibhAve satya theke phire yAcche|

Ara tAderake yakhana valA haYa esa, AllAhara rAsUla tomAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karavena, takhana tArA tAdera mAthA nAr3e*| Ara tumi tAderake dekhate pAve, ahaGkAravazata vimukha haYe cale yete| *tArA asvIkAra svarUpa mAthA nAr3e|
tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara athavA nA kara, ubhaYaTi tAdera kSetre samAna| AllAha tAderake kakhano kSamA karavena nA| avazyai AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hedAYAta dena nA|

tArAi vale, yArA AllAhara rAsUlera kAche Ache tomarA tAdera janya kharaca karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA sare yAYa| Ara AsamAnasamUha o yamInera dhana-bhAnDAra to AllAharai, kintu munAphikarA tA vujhe nA|
tArA vale, yadi AmarA madInAYa phire yAi tAhale avazyai sekhAna theke pravala durvalake vahiSkAra karave| kintu sakala maryAdA to AllAhara, tA~ra rAsUlera o muminadera| kintu munAphikarA tA jAne nA|
he muminagaNa, tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna- santati yena tomAderake AllAhara smaraNa theke udAsIna nA kare| Ara yArA erUpa kare tArAi to kSatigrasta|

Ara Ami tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi tA theke vyaYa kara, tomAdera kAro mRtyu AsAra pUrve| kenanA takhana se valave, he AmAra rava, yadi Apani AmAke Aro kichu kAla paryanta avakAza ditena, tAhale Ami dAna-sadAkA karatAma| Ara sat lokadera antarbhukta hatAma|
Ara AllAha kakhano kona prANakei avakAza devena nA, yakhana tAra nirdhArita samaYa ese yAve| Ara tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha samyaka avahita|
yA kichu raYeche AsamAnasamUhe evaM yA kichu raYeche yamIne, savai AllAhara janya pavitratA ghoSaNA kare| vAdazAhI tA~rai evaM prazaMsA tA~rai| tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tomAdera madhye kataka kAphira evaM kataka mu’mina| Ara tomarA ye Amala karacha AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
tini AsamAnasamUha o yamInake yathArthabhAve sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake AkRti dAna karechena evaM sundara karechena tomAdera AkRti| Ara pratyAvartana to tA~rai nikaTa|
AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache tini tA jAnena evaM tini jAnena yA tomarA gopana kara evaM yA tomarA prakAza kara| AllAha antarasamUhe yA kichu Ache se viSaYe samyaka jJAta|
itaHpUrve yArA kupharI kareche, tAdera saMvAda ki tomAdera nikaTa pau~cheni| tArA tAdera karmera manda pariNAma AsvAdana karechila evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka AyAva|

eTi e janya ye, tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI niYe Asata, athaca tArA valata, mAnuSai ki AmAdera patha pradarzana karave? ataHpara tArA kupharI karala evaM mukha phiriYe nila| Ara AllAha ve-paraoYAi dekhAlena evaM AllAha abhAvamukta parama, prazaMsita|

kAphirarA dhAraNA karechila ye, tArA kakhanoi punarutthita have nA| vala, ‘hyA~, AmAra ravera kasama, tomarA avazyai punarutthita have| ataHpara tomarA yA Amala karechile tA avazyai tomAdera jAnAno have| Ara eTi AllAhara pakSe khuvai sahaja|
ataeva tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera evaM Ami ye nUra avatIrNa karechi tAra prati ImAna Ana| Ara tomarA ye Amala karacha AllAha se viSaYe samyaka avahita|

smaraNa kara, yedina samAveza divasera uddezye AllAha tomAdera samaveta karavena, ai dinai hacche lAbha-kSatira dina| Ara ye AllAhara prati ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tini tAra pApasamUha mocana kare divena evaM tAke praveza karAvena jAnnAtasamUhe, yAra pAdadeza diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita haYa, tathAYa tArA sthAYI have| eTAi mahAsAphalya|
kintu yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI| tathAYa tArA sthAYI have| Ara tA katainA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|
AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona vipadai Apatita haYa nA| ye AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, AllAha tAra antarake satpathe paricAlita karena| AllAha pratyeka viSaYe sarvajJa|
tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara| kintu tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo, tave AmAra rAsUlera to ekamAtra dAYitva hacche spaSTabhAve vANI pau~che deYA|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona ilAha nei evaM AllAhara uparai muminarA yena tAoYAkkula kare|

he muminagaNa, tomAdera svAmI-strI o santAna-santatidera keu keu tomAdera duzamana|* ataeva tomarA tAdera vyApAre satarkatA avalamvana kara| Ara yadi tomarA mArjanA kara, er3iYe yAo evaM mApha kare dAo tave nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu| *arthAt tArA kakhano kakhano AllAhara pathe calA, tA~ra Anugatya karA athavA AllAhara yikara o AkhirAtera smaraNa theke tomAdera virata rAkhate pAre| e AYAte zatrutA o duzamani valate era pratii iGgita karA haYeche|
tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati to kevala parIkSA vizeSa| Ara AllAhara nikaTai mahAna pratidAna|
ataeva tomarA yathAsAdhya AllAhake bhaYa kara, zravaNa kara, Anugatya kara evaM tomAdera nijadera kalyANe vyaYa kara, Ara yAderake antarera kArpaNya theke rakSA karA haYa, tArAi mUlata saphalakAma|
yadi tomarA AllAhake uttama RNa dAo, tini tA tomAdera janya dviguna kare divena evaM tomAdera kSamA kare divena| AllAha guNagrAhI, parama dhairyazIla|
dRzya o adRzyera jJAnadhArI, mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he navI, (vala), tomarA yakhana strIderake tAlAka deve, takhana tAdera iddata anusAre tAdera tAlAka dAo evaM ‘iddata hisAva kare rAkhave evaM tomAdera rava AllAhake bhaYa karave| tomarA tAderake tomAdera vAr3I-ghara theke vera kare diYo nA evaM tArAo vera have nA| yadi nA tArA kona spaSTa azlIlatAYa lipta haYa| Ara egulo AllAhara sImArekhA| Ara ye AllAhara (nirdhArita) sImArekhAsamUha atikrama kare se avazyai tAra nijera opara yulama kare| tumi jAna nA, haYato era para AllAha, (phire AsAra) kona patha tairI kare divena|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera iddatera zeSa sImAYa pau~chave, takhana tomarA tAdera nyAYAnuga pa‎nthAYa rekhe deve athavA nyAYAnuga pa‎nthAYa tAdera parityAga karave evaM tomAdera madhya theke nyAYaparAYaNa duijanake sAkSI vAnAve| Ara AllAhara janya saThika sAkSya deve| tomAdera madhye ye AllAha o AkhirAta divasera prati ImAna Ane eTi dvArA tAke upadeza deYA hacche| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra janya uttaraNera patha tairI kare dena|

evaM tini tAke emana utsa theke riyaka divena yA se kalpanAo karate pArave nA| Ara ye AllAhara opara tAoYAkkula kare AllAha tAra janya yatheSTa| AllAha tA~ra uddezya pUrNa karavenai| nizcaYa AllAha pratyeka jinisera janya ekaTi samaYasImA nirdhAraNa kare diYechena|

tomAdera strIdera madhye yArA RtuvartI haoYAra kAla atikrama kare geche, tAdera iddata samparke tomarA yadi saMzaYe thAka evaM yArA ekhanao Rtura vaYase pau~cheni tAdera iddatakAlao have tina mAsa| Ara garbhadhArinIdera iddatakAla santAna prasava paryanta| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra janya tAra kAjake sahaja kare dena|
eTi AllAhara nirdeza, tini tA tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena| Ara ye AllAhake bhaYa kare tini tAra gunAhasamUha mocana kare dena evaM tAra pratidAnake mahAna kare dena|

tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI yekhAne tomarA vasavAsa kara sekhAne tAderakeo vAsa karate dAo, tAderake saGkaTe phelAra janya kaSTa diYo nA| Ara tArA garbhavatI hale tAdera santAna prasava karA paryanta tAdera janya tomarA vyaYa kara; Ara tArA tomAdera janya santAnake dudha pAna karAle tAdera pAonA tAderake diYe dAo evaM (santAnera kalyANera janya) saMgatabhAve tomAdera mAjhe paraspara parAmarza kara| Ara yadi tomarA paraspara kaThora hao tave pitAra pakSe anya kona nArI dudhapAna karAve|

sAmarthyavAna yena nija sAmarthya anuyAYI vyaYa kare Ara yAra riyka saMkIrNa karA haYeche se yena AllAha tAke yA diYechena tA hate vyaYa kare| AllAha kAro opara vojhA cApAte cAna nA tini tAke yA diYechena tAra cAite vezI| AllAha kaThina avasthAra para sahajatA dAna karavena|
Ara aneka janapada tAdera rava o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera nirdezera viruddhe giYeche| phale Ami tAdera kAcha theke kaThora hisAva niYechi evaM tAderake Ami kaThina AyAva diYechi|
ataeva tArA nijadera kRtakarmera AyAva AsvAdana kareche Ara kSatii chila tAdera kAjera pariNati|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThina AyAva prastuta rekhechena; sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, he vuddhisampanna lokerA, yArA ImAna eneche; nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera kAche pAThiYechena ekaTi upadeza|

ekajana rAsUla, ye tomAdera kAche AllAhara suspaSTa AYAtasamUha telAoYAta kare; yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare yAte tini tAderake andhakAra hate Alote vera kare Anate pArena| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara prati ImAna Anave evaM satkAja karave tini tAke emana jAnnAte praveza karAvena yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita; sekhAne tArA sthAYI have; AllAha to tAke ati uttama riyka devena|

tini AllAha, yini sAta AsamAna evaM anurUpa yamIna sRSTi karechena; egulira mAjhe tA~ra nirdeza avatIrNa haYa yena tomarA jAnate pAra ye, AllAha sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna evaM AllAhara jJAnato sava kichuke veSTana kare Ache|
he navI, AllAha tomAra janya yA hAlAla karechena tomAra strIdera santuSTi kAmanAYa tumi kena tA hArAma karacha? Ara AllAha atIva kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa tomAdera janya zapatha hate muktira vidhAna diYechena; Ara AllAha tomAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tini sarvajJa, prajJAvAna|

Ara yakhana navI tAra eka strIke gopane ekaTi kathA valechilena; ataHpara yakhana se (strI) anyake tA jAniYe dila evaM AllAha tAra (navIra) kAche eTi prakAza kare dilena, takhana navI kichuTA tAra strIke avahita karala Ara kichu er3iYe gela| yakhana se tAke viSaYaTi jAnAla takhana se valala, ‘ApanAke e saMvAda ke dila?’ se valala, ‘mahAjJAnI o sarvajJa AllAha AmAke jAniYechena|’

yadi tomarA ubhaYe AllAhara kAche taovA kara (tave tA tomAdera janya uttama)| kAraNa tomAdera ubhaYera antara vA~kA haYeche, Ara tomarA yadi tAra viruddhe parasparake sAhAyya kara tave AllAhai tAra abhibhAvaka evaM jivrIla o satkarmazIla mu’minarAo| tAchAr3A anyAnya pherezatArAo tAra sAhAyyakArI|

se yadi tomAderake tAlAka deYa, tave AzA karA yAYa tAra rava tomAdera parivarte tomAdera cAite uttama strI tAke divena, yArA musalima, muminA, anugata, tAovAkArI, ‘ivAdatakArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, akumArI o kumArI|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA nijederake o tomAdera parivAra-parijanake Aguna hate vA~cAo yAra jvAlAni have mAnuSa o pAthara; yekhAne raYeche nirmama o kaThora pherezatAkUla, AllAha tAderake ye nirdeza diYechena tArA se vyApAre tAra avAdhya haYa nA| Ara tArA tA-i kare yA tAderake Adeza karA haYa|
he kAphiragaNa, Aja tomarA ojara peza karo nA; tomarA ye ‘Amala karate tAra pratiphalai tomAderake deYA hacche|

he ImAnadAragaNa, tomarA AllAhara kAche tAovA kara, khA~Ti tAovA; AzA karA yAYa tomAdera rava tomAdera pApasamUha mocana karavena evaM tomAderake emana jAnnAtasamUhe praveza karAvena yAra pAdadeze naharasamUha pravAhita, navI o tAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAderake sedina AllAha lAJchita karavena nA| tAdera Alo tAdera sAmane o DAne dhAvita have| tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera rava, AmAdera janya AmAdera Alo pUrNa kare dina evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna; nizcaYa Apani sarvaviSaYe sarvakSamatAvAna|’
‘he navI, kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM tAdera vyApAre kaThora hao; Ara tAdera AzraYasthala have jAhAnnAma evaM tA kata nikRSTa gantavyasthala!

yArA kuphari kare tAdera janya AllAha nUhera strIra o lUtera strIra udAharaNa peza karena; tArA AmAra vAndAdera madhya hate du’jana satvAndAra adhIne chila, kintu tArA ubhaYe tAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila, ataHpara AllAhara AyAva hate rakSAYa nUha o lUta tAdera kona kAje Aseni| valA hala, ‘tomarA ubhaYe pravezakArIdera sAthe jAhAnnAme praveza kara|’

Ara yArA ImAna Ane tAdera janya AllAha phira‘Aunera strIra udAharaNa peza karena, yakhana se valechila, ‘he AmAra rava, ApanAra kAche AmAra janya jAnnAte ekaTi vAr3i nirmANa karuna evaM AmAke phira‘Auna o tAra karma hate nAjAta dina, Ara AmAke nAjAta dina yAlima sampradAYa hate|

(AllAha Aro udAharaNa peza karena) imarAna kanyA mAraYAma-era, ye nijera satItva rakSA karechila, phale Ami tAte AmAra rUha theke phu~ke diYechilAma| Ara se tAra ravera vANIsamUha o tA~ra kitAvasamUhera satyatA svIkAra karechila evaM se chila anugatadera antarbhukta|
varakatamaYa tini yAra hAte sarvamaYa kartRtva| Ara tini sava kichura upara sarvazaktimAna|
yini mRtyu o jIvana sRSTi karechena yAte tini tomAderake parIkSA karate pArena ye, ke tomAdera madhye Amalera dika theke uttama| Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, atizaYa kSamAzIla|
yini sAta AsamAna stare stare sRSTi karechena| parama karuNAmaYera sRSTite tumi kona asAmaJjasya dekhate pAve nA| tumi AvAra dRSTi phirAo, kona truTi dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara tumi dRSTi phirAo ekera para eka, sei dRSTi avanamita o klAnta haYe tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ami nikaTavartI AsamAnake pradIpapuJja dvArA suzobhita karechi evaM seguloke zaYatAnadera prati nikSepera vastu vAniYechi| Ara tAdera janya prastuta kare rekhechi jvalanta Agunera AyAva|
Ara yArA tAdera ravake asvIkAra kare, tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera AyAva| Ara katainA nikRSTa sei pratyAvartanasthala!
yakhana tAderake tAte nikSepa karA have, takhana tArA tAra vikaTa zavda zunate pAve| Ara tA uthaliYe uThave|
krodhe tA chinna-bhinna havAra upakrama have| yakhanai tAte kona dalake nikSepa karA have, takhana tAra praharIrA tAderake jijJAsA karave, ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki kona satarkakArI Aseni’?

tArA valave, ‘hyA~, AmAdera nikaTa satarkakArI esechila| takhana AmarA (tAderake) mithyAvAdI AkhyAYita karechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘AllAha kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA to ghora vibhrAntite raYecha’|
Ara tArA valave, ‘yadi AmarA zunatAma athavA vujhatAma, tAhale AmarA jvalanta Agunera adhivAsIdera madhye thAkatAma nA’|
ataHpara tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave| ataeva dhvaMsa jvalanta Agunera adhivAsIdera janya|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera ravake nA dekhei bhaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o var3a pratidAna|
Ara tomarA tomAdera kathA gopana kara athavA tA prakAza kara, nizcaYa tini antarasamUhe yA Ache se viSaYe samyaka avagata|
yini sRSTi karechena, tini ki jAnena nA? athaca tini ati sUkSmadarzI, pUrNa avahita|
tinii to tomAdera janya yamInake sugama kare diYechena, kAjei tomarA era pathe-prAntare vicaraNa kara evaM tA~ra riyka theke tomarA AhAra kara| Ara tA~ra nikaTai punarutthAna|

yini AsamAne Achena,* tini tomAdera saha yamIna dhasiYe deYA theke ki tomarA nirApada haYe gecha, ataHpara AkasmikabhAve tA thara thara kare kA~pate thAkave? *‘yini AsamAne Achena’ dvArA AllAhake vujhAno haYeche| era dvArA AllAha ye AsamAne Achena, tA pramANita haYa|
yini AsamAne Achena, tini tomAdera upara pAthara nikSepakArI jhar3o hAoYA pAThAno theke tomarA ki nirApada haYe gecha, takhana tomarA jAnate pArave kemana chila AmAra satarkavANI?
Ara avazyai tAdera pUrvavartIrAo asvIkAra karechila| phale kemana chila AmAra pratyAkhyAna (era zAsti)?
tArA ki lakSya kareni tAdera uparastha pAkhidera prati, yArA DAnA vistAra kare o guTiYe neYa? parama karuNAmaYa chAr3A anya keu ederake sthira rAkhe nA| nizcaYa tini sava kichura samyaka draSTA|
parama karuNAmaYa chAr3A tomAdera ki Ara kona sainya Ache, yArA tomAderake sAhAyya karave? kAphirarA zudhu to dho~kAYa nipatita|
athavA emana ke Ache, ye tomAderake riyka dAna karave yadi AllAha tA~ra riyka vandha kare dena? varaM tArA ahamikA o anIhAYa nimajjita haYe Ache|
ye vyakti upur3a haYe mukhera upara bhara diYe cale se ki adhika hidAYAtaprApta nAki sei vyakti ye sojA haYe sarala pathe cale?
vala, ‘tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya zravaNa o dRSTizakti evaM antakaraNasamUha diYechena| tomarA khuva alpai zokara kara’|
vala, ‘tinii tomAderake yamIne sRSTi karechena evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake samaveta karA have’|
Ara tArA vale, ‘se oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
vala, ‘e viSaYera jJAna AllAharai nikaTa| Ara Ami to spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra’|
ataHpara tArA yakhana tA* Asanna dekhate pAve, takhana kAphiradera cehArA malina haYe yAve evaM valA have, ‘eTAi hala tA, yA tomarA dAvI karachile’| *kiYAmatera zAsti|

vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki’? yadi AllAha AmAke evaM AmAra sAthe yArA Ache, tAderake dhvaMsa kare dena athavA AmAdera prati daYA karena, tAhale kAphiraderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva theke ke rakSA karave’?
vala, ‘tinii parama karuNAmaYa| AmarA tA~ra prati ImAna enechi evaM tA~ra upara tAoYAkkula karechi| kAjei tomarA acirei jAnate pArave ke spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche’?
vala, ‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi tomAdera pAni bhUgarbhe cale yAYa, tAhale ke tomAderake vahamAna pAni ene dive’?
nUna; kalamera kasama evaM tArA yA likhe tAra kasama!
tomAra ravera anugrahe tumi pAgala nao|
Ara nizcaYa tomAra janya raYeche aphuranta puraskAra|
Ara nizcaYa tumi mahAna caritrera upara adhiSThita|
ataHpara zIghrai tumi dekhate pAve evaM tArAo dekhate pAve-
tomAdera madhye ke vikAragrasta?
nizcaYa tomAra ravai samyaka parijJAta tAdera vyApAre yArA tA~ra patha theke vicyuta haYeche, Ara tini hidAYAtaprAptadera samparkeo samyaka jJAta|
ataeva tumi mithyAropakArIdera Anugatya karo nA|
tArA kAmanA kare, yadi tumi ApoSakAmI hao, tave tArAo ApoSakArI have|
Ara tumi Anugatya karo nA pratyeka emana vyaktira ye adhika kasamakArI, lAJchita|
pichane nindAkArI o ye cogalakhurI kare ver3AYa,
bhAla kAje vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaGghanakArI aparAdhI,
duSTa prakRtira, tArapara jAraja|
e kAraNe ye, se chila dhana-sampada o santAna- santatira adhikArI|
yakhana tAra kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa takhana se vale, egulo pUrvavartIdera kalpakAhinImAtra|
acirei Ami tAra zu~r3era* upara dAga diYe deva| *arthAt nAkera upara| vidrUpAtmaka arthe vyavahRta|
nizcaYa Ami ederake parIkSA karechi, yebhAve parIkSA karechilAma vAgAnera mAlikaderake| yakhana tArA kasama karechila ye, avazyai tArA sakAla velA vAgAnera phala AharaNa karave|
Ara tArA ‘inazAAllAha’ valeni|
ataHpara tomAra ravera pakSa theke eka pradakSiNakArI (Aguna) vAgAnera opara diYe pradakSiNa kare gela, Ara tArA chila ghumanta|
phale tA (pur3e) kAlo varNera haYe gela|
tArapara sakAla velA tArA eke aparake Deke valala,
‘tomarA yadi phala AharaNa karate cAo tAhale sakAla sakAla tomAdera vAgAne yAo’|
tArapara tArA calala, nimnasvare ekathA valate valate-
ye, ‘Aja sekhAne tomAdera kAche kona abhAvI yena praveza karate nA pAre’|
Ara tArA bhora velA dRr3ha icchA zakti niYe sakSama avasthAYa (vAgAne) gela|
tArapara tArA yakhana vAgAnaTi dekhala, takhana tArA valala, ‘avazyai AmarA pathabhraSTa’|
‘varaM AmarA vaJcita’|
tAdera madhye savaceYe bhAla vyaktiTi valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, tomarA kena (AllAhara) tAsavIha pATha karacha nA’?
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera ravera pavitratA ghoSaNA karachi| avazyai AmarA yAlima chilAma’|
tArapara tArA eke aparera prati doSAropa karate lAgala|
tArA valala, ‘hAYa, AmAdera dhvaMsa! nizcaYa AmarA sImAlaGghanakArI chilAma’|
sambhavataH AmAdera rava AmAderake era ceYeo utkRSTatara vinimaYa devena| avazyai AmarA AmAdera ravera prati AgrahI|
ebhAvei haYa AyAva| Ara parakAlera AyAva avazyai Aro var3a, yadi tArA jAnata|
nizcaYa muttAkIdera janya tAdera ravera kAche raYeche niAmatapUrNa jAnnAta|
tave ki Ami musalimaderake (anugataderake) avAdhyadera matai gaNya karava?
tomAdera kI hala, tomarA kibhAve phaYasAlA karacha?
tomAdera kAche ki kona kitAva Ache yAte tomarA pATha karacha?
ye, nizcaYa tomAdera janya sekhAne raYeche yA tomarA pachanda kara?
athavA tomAdera janya ki AmAra upara kiYAmata paryanta valavat kona aGgIkAra raYeche ye, avazyai tomAdera janya thAkave tomarA yA phaYasAlA karave?
tumi tAderake jijJAsA kara, ke e vyApAre yimmAdAra?
athavA tAdera janya ki aneka zarIka Ache? tAhale tArA tAdera zarIkaderake upasthita karuka yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa|

se dina pAYera gochA* unmocana karA have| Ara tAderake sijadA karAra janya AhavAna jAnAno have, kintu tArA sakSama have nA| *e kathAra vyApAre imAma vukhArI ekaTi hAdIsa varNanA karena| tA hala, Avu sAIda khudarI rA. valena, mahAnavI sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma valechena, AmAdera rava tA~ra pAYera gochA unmukta karavena, takhana pratyeka mumina nara-nArI tA~ke sijadA karave...|
tAdera dRSTisamUha avanata avasthAYa thAkave, apamAna tAderake Acchanna karave| athaca tAderake to nirApada avasthAYa sijadA karAra janya AhavAna karA hata (takhana to tArA sijadA kareni)|
ataeva cher3e dAo AmAke evaM yArA e vANI pratyAkhyAna kare tAderake| Ami tAderake dhIre dhIre emanabhAve pAkar3Ao karava ye, tArA jAnate pArave nA|
Ara Ami tAderake avakAza deva| avazyai AmAra kauzala atyanta valiSTha|
tumi ki tAdera kAche pArizramika cAccha? phale tArA RNera kAraNe bhArAkrAnta haYe par3ache|
athavA tAdera kAche ki ‘gAYeva’ (laohe mAhaphuya) Ache ye, tArA likhe rAkhache|
ataeva tumi tomAra ravera hukumera janya dhairyadhAraNa kara| Ara tumi mAchaoYAlAra mata haYo nA, yakhana se duHkhe kAtara haYe Dekechila|
yadi tAra ravera anugraha tAra kAche nA pau~chata, tAhale se nindita avasthAYa unmukta prAntare nikSipta hata|
tArapara tAra rava tAke manonIta karalena evaM tAke satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karalena|
Ara kAphirarA yakhana upadezavANI zune takhana tArA yena tAdera dRSTi dvArA tomAke Achar3e phelave, Ara tArA vale, ‘e to eka pAgala’|
Ara e kuraAna to sRSTikulera janya zudhui upadezavANI|
avazyambhAvI ghaTanA (kiYAmata)|
avazyambhAvI ghaTanA kI?
Ara kise tomAke jAnAve avazyambhAvI ghaTanA kI?
sAmUda o ‘Ada sampradAYa sajore AghAtakArI (kiYAmata)ke asvIkAra karechila|
Ara sAmUda sampradAYa, tAderake vikaTa zavda dvArA dhvaMsa karA haYechila|
Ara ‘Ada sampradAYa, tAderake dhvaMsa karA haYechila pracanDa ThAnDA jhaJjhAvAYu dvArA|
tini tAdera upara tA sAta rAta o ATa dina virAmahInabhAve cApiYe diYechilena| phale tumi ukta sampradAYake sekhAne luTiYe par3A avasthAYa dekhate pete yena tArA sArazUnya khejura gAchera mata|
tArapara tumi ki tAdera janya kona avaziSTa kichu dekhate pAo?
Ara phira‘Auna, tAra pUrvavartIrA evaM ulTe deYA janapadavAsIrA pApAcAre lipta haYechila|
Ara tArA tAdera ravera rAsUlake amAnya karechila| sutarAM tini tAderake atyanta kaThorabhAve pAkar3Ao karalena|
yakhana jalocchvAsa hala, avazyai takhana Ami tomAderake nauyAne ArohaNa kariYechi|
eke tomAdera nimitte upadeza vAnAnora janya evaM saMrakSaNakArI kAna tA saMrakSaNa karAra janya|
ataHpara yakhana ziMgAYa phu~ka deYA have- ekaTi mAtra phu~ka|
Ara yamIna o parvatamAlAke sariYe neYA have evaM mAtra ekaTi AghAte egulo cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe yAve|
phale se dina mahAghaTanA saMghaTita have|
Ara AsamAna vidIrNa haYe yAve| phale sedina tA haYe yAve durvala vikSipta|
pherezatAgaNa AsamAnera vibhinna prAnte thAkave| sedina tomAra ravera Arazake ATajana pherezatA tAdera urdhve vahana karave|
sedina tomAderake upasthita karA have| tomAdera kona gopanIYatAi gopana thAkave nA|
takhana yAra AmalanAmA tAra DAna hAte deYA have se valave, ‘nAo, AmAra AmalanAmA par3e dekha’|
‘AmAra dRr3ha vizvAsa chila ye, Ami AmAra hisAvera sammukhIna hava’|
sutarAM se santoSajanaka jIvane thAkave|
suucca jAnnAte,
tAra phalasamUha nikaTavartI thAkave|
(valA have,) ‘vigata dinasamUhe tomarA yA agre preraNa karecha tAra vinimaYe tomarA tRpti sahakAre khAo o pAna kara’|
kintu yAra AmalanAmA tAra vAma hAte deYA have se valave, ‘hAYa, AmAke yadi AmAra AmalanAmA deYA nA hata’!
‘Ara yadi Ami nA jAnatAma AmAra hisAva’!
‘hAYa, mRtyui yadi AmAra cUr3Anta phaYasAlA hata’!
‘AmAra sampada AmAra kona kAjei Asala nA!’
‘AmAra kSamatAo AmAra theke cale gela!
(valA have,) ‘tAke dhara ataHpara tAke ver3i pariYe dAo|’
‘tArapara tAke tomarA nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme’|
‘tArapara tAke vA~dha emana eka zekale yAra dairghya have sattara hAta|’
se to mahAna AllAhara prati ImAna poSaNa karata nA,
Ara misakInake khAdyadAne utsAhita karata nA|
ataeva Aja ekhAne tAra kona antaraGga vandhu thAkave nA|
Ara kSata-niMsRta pU~ja chAr3A kona khAdya thAkave nA,
aparAdhIrAi zudhu tA khAve|
ataeva tomarA yA dekhacha, Ami tAra kasama karachi|
Ara yA tomarA dekhacha nA tArao,
nizcaYai eTi eka sammAnita rAsUlera vANI|
Ara eTi kona kavira kathA naYa| tomarA kamai vizvAsa kara|
Ara kona gaNakera kathAo naYa| tomarA kamai upadeza grahaNa kara|
eTi sRSTikulera ravera pakSa theke nAyilakRta|
yadi se AmAra nAme kona mithyA racanA karata,
tave Ami tAra DAna hAta pAkar3Ao karatAma|
tArapara avazyai Ami tAra hRdapinDera zirA keTe phelatAma|
ataHpara tomAdera madhye keui tAke rakSA karAra thAkata nA|
Ara eTito muttAkIdera janya eka nizcita upadeza|
Ara Ami avazyai jAni ye, tomAdera madhye kataka raYeche mithyAropakArI|
Ara eTi nizcaYa kAphiradera janya eka nizcita anuzocanAra kAraNa|
Ara nizcaYa eTi sunizcita satya|
ataeva tumi tomAra mahAna ravera nAme tAsavIha pATha kara|
eka praznakArI jijJAsA karala emana AyAva samparke, yA Apatita have-* *AYAtaTira Areka artha hala, ‘ekajana prArthanAkArI emana AyAvera do‘A karala yA Apatita have’|
kAphiradera upara, yAra kona pratirodhakArI nei|
UrdhvArohaNera sopAnasamUhera adhikArI AllAhara pakSa theke,
pherezatAgaNa o rUha emana eka dine AllAhara pAne UrdhvagAmI haYa, yAra parimANa paJcAza hAjAra vachara|
ataeva tumi uttamarUpe dhairyadhAraNa kara|
tArA to eTike sudUraparAhata mane kare|
Ara Ami dekhachi tA Asanna|
sedina AsamAna haYe yAve galita dhAtura nyAYa|
evaM parvatasamUha haYe yAve raGina pazamera nyAYa|
Ara antaraGga vandhu antaraGga vandhuke jijJAsA karave nA|
tAderake eke aparera dRSTigocara karA have| aparAdhI cAive yadi se sedinera zAsti theke tAra santAna-santatike paNa hiseve diYe mukti pete,
Ara tAra strI o bhAike,
Ara tAra jJAti-goSThIke, yArA tAke AzraYa dita|
Ara yamIne yArA Ache tAdera savAike, yAte eTi tAke rakSA kare|
kakhano naYa! eTito lelihAna Aguna|
yA mAthAra cAmar3A khasiYe neve|
jAhAnnAma tAke DAkave ye pRSTha pradarzana karechila evaM mukha phiriYe niYechila |
Ara sampada jamA karechila, ataHpara tA saMrakSaNa kare rekhechila|
nizcaYa mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche asthira kare|
yakhana tAke vipada sparza kare takhana se haYe par3e atimAtrAYa utkanThita|
Ara yakhana kalyANa tAke sparza kare takhana se haYe par3e atizaYa kRpaNa|
sAlAta AdAYakArIgaNa chAr3A,
yArA tAdera sAlAtera kSetre niYamita|
Ara yAdera dhana-sampade raYeche nirdhArita haka,
yAcaJAkArI o vaJcitera,
Ara yArA pratiphala-divasake satya vale vizvAsa kare|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera AyAva samparke bhIta-santrasta|
nizcaYa tAdera ravera AyAva theke keu nirApada naYa|
Ara yArA tAdera yaunAMgasamUhera hiphAyatakArI|
tave tAdera strI o tAdera DAna hAta yAdera mAlika haYeche se dAsIgaNera kSetra chAr3A| tAhale tArA se kSetre nindanIYa have nA|
tave ye keu edera vAire anyake kAmanA kare, tArAi to sImAlaMghanakArI|
Ara yArA nijadera AmAnata o oYAdA rakSAkArI,
Ara yArA tAdera sAkSyadAne aTala,
Ara yArA nijadera sAlAtera hiphAyata kare,
tArAi jAnnAtasamUhe sammAnita have|
kAphiradera kI hala ye, tArA tomAra dike chuTache,
DAne o vAme dale dale?
tAdera pratyeka vyakti ki AzA kare ye, tAke prAcuryamaYa jAnnAte dAkhila karA have?
kakhano naYa, nizcaYa Ami tAderake sRSTi karechi tArA yA jAne tA theke|
ataeva, Ami udaYasthala o astAcalasamUhera ravera kasama karachi ye, Ami avazyai sakSama!
tAdera cAite uttamaderake tAdera sthale niYe Asate evaM Ami akSama nai|
ataeva tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA (vehudA kathAYa) matta thAkuka Ara khela-tAmAzA karuka yatakSaNa nA tArA dekhA pAYa sedinera, yAra pratizruti tAderake deYA haYeche|
yedina drutavege tArA kavara theke vera haYe Asave, yena tArA kona lakSyera dike chuTache,
avanata cokhe| lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave! eTii sedina yAra oYAdA tAderake deYA haYechila|
nizcaYa Ami nUhake pAThiYechilAma tAra kaomera kAche (e kathA vale), ‘tomAra kaomake satarka kara, tAdera nikaTa yantraNAdAYaka AyAva AsAra pUrve’|
se valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma! nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya eka spaSTa satarkakArI-
ye, tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tA~ke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara’|

‘tini tomAdera janya tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena evaM tomAderake nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza devena; AllAhara nirdhArita samaYa Asale kichutei tA vilamvita karA haYa nA, yadi tomarA jAnate’!
se valala, ‘he AmAra rava! Ami to AmAra kaomake rAta-dina AhavAna karechi|
‘ataHpara AmAra AhavAna kevala tAdera palAYanai vAr3iYe diYeche’|

‘Ara yakhanai Ami tAderake AhavAna karechi ‘yena Apani tAderake kSamA karena’, tArA nijadera kAne AGgula DhukiYe diYeche, nijaderake pozAke AvRta kareche, (avAdhyatAYa) anar3a thekeche evaM dambhabhare auddhatya prakAza kareche’|
‘tArapara Ami tAderake prakAzye AhavAna karechi’|
ataHpara tAderake Ami prakAzye evaM ati gopaneo AhavAna karechi|
Ara valechi, ‘tomAdera ravera kAche kSamA cAo; nizcaYa tini parama kSamAzIla’|
‘tini tomAdera upara muSaladhAre vRSTi varSaNa karavena,
‘Ara tomAderake dhana-sampada o santAna- santati diYe sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera janya vAga-vAgicA devena Ara devena nadI-nAlA’|
‘tomAdera kI hala, tomarA AllAhara zreSThatvera paroYA karacha nA’?
‘athaca tini tomAderake nAnA stare sRSTi karechena’|
‘tomarA ki lakSya kara nA ye, kIbhAve AllAha stare stare saptAkAza sRSTi karechena’?
Ara egulora madhye cA~dake sRSTi karechena Alo Ara sUryake sRSTi karechena pradIparUpe’|
‘Ara AllAha tomAderake udagata karechena mATi theke’|
‘tArapara tini tomAderake tAte phiriYe nevena evaM nizcitabhAve tomAderake punarutthita karavena’|
‘Ara AllAha pRthivIke tomAdera janya vistRta karechena,
yena tomarA sekhAne prazasta pathe calate pAra’|
nUha valala, ‘he AmAra rava! tArA AmAra avAdhya haYeche evaM emana ekajanera anusaraNa kareche yAra dhana-sampada o santAna-santati kevala tAra kSatii vAr3iYe deYa’|
‘Ara tArA bhaYAnaka Sar3ayantra kareche’|
Ara tArA vale, ‘tomarA tomAdera upAsyadera varjana karo nA; varjana karo nA oYAda, suoYA‘, iYAgUcha, iYA‘Uka o nAsarake’|
‘vastuta tArA anekake pathabhraSTa kareche, Ara (he AllAha) Apani yAlimaderake bhraSTatA chAr3A Ara kichui vAr3Avena nA’|
tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake DuviYe deYA hala ataHpara Agune praveza karAno hala; tArA nijadera sAhAyyakArI hiseve AllAha chAr3A Ara kAuke pAYani|
Ara nUha valala, ‘he AmAra rava! yamInera upara kona kAphirake avaziSTa rAkhavena nA’|
‘Apani yadi tAderake avaziSTa rAkhena tave tArA ApanAra vAndAderake pathabhraSTa karave evaM durAcArI o kAphira chAr3A anya kAro janma deve nA’|
‘he AmAra rava! AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtAke, ye AmAra ghare ImAnadAra haYe praveza karave tAke evaM mumina nArI-puruSake kSamA karuna evaM dhvaMsa chAr3A Apani yAlimadera Ara kichui vAr3iYe devena nA|’
vala, ‘AmAra prati ohI karA haYeche ye, nizcaYa jinadera ekaTi dala manoyoga sahakAre zuneche| ataHpara valeche, ‘AmarA to eka vismaYakara kuraAna zunechi,
yA satyera dike hidAYAta kare; ataHpara AmarA tAte ImAna enechi| Ara AmarA kakhano AmAdera ravera sAthe kAuke zarIka karava nA’|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmAdera ravera maryAdA samucca| tini kona saMginI grahaNa karenani evaM nA kona santAna’|
‘Ara AmAdera madhyakAra nirvodherA AllAhara vyApAre avAstava kathA- vArtA valata’|
‘athaca AmarA to dhAraNA karatAma ye, mAnuSa o jina kakhano AllAha samparke mithyA Aropa karave nA’|
Ara nizcaYa katipaYa mAnuSa katipaYa jinera AzraYa nita, phale tArA tAdera ahaMkAra vAr3iYe diYechila|
Ara nizcaYa tArA dhAraNA karechila yemana tomarA dhAraNA karecha ye, AllAha kAuke kakhanai punarutthita karavena nA|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmarA AkAza sparza karate ceYechilAma*, kintu AmarA seTAke pelAma ye, tA kaThora praharI evaM ulkApinDa dvArA paripUrNa’| *AkAzera saMvAda saMgraha karAra ceSTA karechilAma|
Ara AmarA to saMvAda zonAra janya AkAzera vibhinna ghATite vasatAma, kintu ekhana ye zunate cAive, se tAra janya prastuta jvalanta ulkApinDa pAve’|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmarA jAni nA, yamIne yArA raYeche tAdera janya akalyANa cAoYA haYeche, nAki tAdera rava tAdera vyApAre maGgala ceYechena’|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmAdera katipaYa satkarmazIla evaM katipaYa era vyatikrama| AmarA chilAma vibhinna mata o pathe vibhakta’|
‘Ara AmarA to vujhate perechi ye, AmarA kichutei yamInera madhye AllAhake apAraga karate pArava nA evaM pAliYeo kakhano tAke apAraga karate pArava nA’|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmarA yakhana hidAYAtera vANI zunalAma, takhana tAra prati ImAna AnalAma| Ara ye tAra ravera prati ImAna Ane, se nA kona kSatira AzaMkA karave evaM nA kona anyAYera’|
‘Ara nizcaYa AmAdera madhye kichu saMkhyaka Ache AtmasamarpaNakArI evaM AmAdera madhye kichu saMkhyaka sImAlaMghanakArI| kAjei yArA AtmasamarpaNa kareche, tArAi saThika patha veche niYeche’|
‘Ara yArA sImAlaGghanakArI, tArA to jAhAnnAmera indhana’|
Ara tArA yadi saThika pathe avicala thAkata, tAhale Ami avazyai tAderake pracura parimANe pAni pAna karAtAma|
yAte Ami tA diYe tAderake parIkSA karate pAri| Ara ye tAra ravera smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neYa, tAke tini kaThina AyAve praveza karAvena|
Ara nizcaYa masajidagulo AllAharai janya| kAjei tomarA AllAhara sAthe anya kAuke Deko nA|
Ara nizcaYa AllAhara vAndA* yakhana tA~ke DAkAra janya dA~r3Ala, takhana tArA** tAra nikaTa bhir3a jamAla| *rAsUlullAha sAllAllAhu AlAihi oYAsAllAma| **kAphiragaNa|
vala, ‘nizcaYa Ami AmAra ravake DAki evaM tAra sAthe kAuke zarIka kari nA’|
vala, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya nA kona akalyANa karAra kSamatA rAkhi evaM nA kona kalyANa karAra’|
vala, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara kAcha theke keu AmAke rakSA karate pArave nA evaM tini chAr3A kakhano Ami kona AzraYao pAva nA|
kevala AllAhara vANI o tA~ra risAlAta pau~chAnoi dAYitva| Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake amAnya kare, tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAte tArA cirasthAYI have|
avazeSe yakhana tArA tA pratyakSa karave, ye samparke tAderake sAvadhAna karA haYechila| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, sAhAyyakArI hiseve ke adhikatara durvala evaM saMkhyAYa kArA savaceYe kama|
vala, ‘Ami jAni nA tomAderake yAra pratizruti deYA haYeche, tA ki nikaTavartI nAki era janya AmAra rava kona dIrgha meYAda nirdhAraNa karavena’|
tini adRzyera jJAnI, Ara tini tA~ra adRzyera jJAna kAro kAche prakAza karena nA|
tave tA~ra manonIta rAsUla chAr3A| Ara tini takhana tAra sAmane o tAra pichane praharI niyukta karavena|

yAte tini eTA jAnate pArena ye, tArA* tAdera ravera risAlAta pau~chiYeche kinA| Ara tAdera kAche yA raYeche, tA tini pariveSTana kare rekhechena evaM tini pratiTi vastu guNe guNe hisAva kare rekhechena| *rAsUlagaNa|
he cAdara AvRta!
rAte sAlAte dA~r3Ao kichu aMza chAr3A|
rAtera ardheka kiMvA tAra ceYe kichuTA kama|
athavA tAra ceYe ekaTu vAr3Ao| Ara spaSTabhAve dhIre dhIre kuraAna AvRtti kara|
nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati eka atibhArI vANI nAyila karachi|
nizcaYa rAta-jAgaraNa AtmasaMyamera janya adhikatara pravala evaM spaSTa valAra janya adhikatara upayogI|
nizcaYa tomAra janya dinera velAYa raYeche dIrgha karmavyastatA|
Ara tumi tomAra ravera nAma smaraNa kara evaM ekAgracitte tA~ra prati nimagna hao|
tini pUrva o pazcimera rava, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei| sutarAM tA~kei tumi kArya sampAdanakArIrUpe grahaNa kara|
Ara tArA yA vale, tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM sundarabhAve tAderake parihAra kare cala|
Ara cher3e dAo AmAke evaM vilAsa sAmagrIra adhikArI mithyAropakArIderake| Ara tAderake kichukAla avakAza dAo|
nizcaYa AmAra nikaTa raYeche zikalasamUha o prajjvalita Aguna|
o kA~TAyukta khAdya evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
yedina yamIna o parvatamAlA prakampita have evaM pAhAr3agulo calamAna vAlukArAzite pariNata have|
nizcaYa Ami tomAdera janya svAkSIsvarUpa tomAdera kAche rAsUla pAThiYechi yemanibhAve phira‘Aunera kAche rAsUla pAThiYechilAma|
kintu phira‘Auna rAsUlake amAnya karala| tAi Ami tAke atyanta zaktabhAve pAkar3Ao karalAma|
ataeva tomarA yadi kupharI kara, tAhale tomarA sedina kibhAve AtmarakSA karave yedina kizoraderake vRddhe pariNata karave|
yAra kAraNe AsamAna have vidIrNa, AllAhara oYAdA have vAstavAYita|
nizcaYa e eka upadeza| ataeva ye cAYa se tAra ravera dike patha avalamvana karuka|

nizcaYa tomAra rava jAnena ye, tumi rAtera dui tRtIYAMzera kichu kama, athavA ardharAta athavA rAtera eka tRtIYAMza sAlAte dA~r3iYe thAka evaM tomAra sAthe yArA Ache tAdera madhya theke ekaTi dalao| Ara AllAha rAta o dina nirUpaNa karena| tini jAnena ye, tomarA tA karate sakSama have nA| tAi tini tomAderake kSamA karalena| ataeva tomarA kuraAna theke yataTuku sahaja tataTuku par3a| tini jAnena tomAdera madhye keu keu asustha haYe par3ave| Ara keu keu AllAhara anugraha sandhAne pRthivIte bhramaNa karave, Ara keu keu AllAhara pathe lar3Ai karave| ataeva tomarA kuraAna theke yataTuku sahaja tataTuku par3a| Ara sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake uttama RNa dAo| Ara tomarA nijadera janya maGgalajanaka yA kichu agre pAThAve tomarA tA AllAhara kAche pAve pratidAna hiseve utkRSTatara o mahattara rUpe| Ara tomarA AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo| nizcaYa AllAha atIva kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he vastrAvRta!
uTha, ataHpara satarka kara|
Ara tomAra ravera zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara|
Ara tomAra pozAka-paricchada pavitra kara|
Ara apavitratA varjana kara|

Ara tomAra ravera janyai dhairyadhAraNa kara|
ataHpara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have,
Ara sedina have kaThina dina|
kAphiradera janya sahaja naYa|
AmAke evaM yAke Ami sRSTi karechi tAke ekAkI cher3e dAo|
Ara Ami tAke diYechi aDhela sampada,
Ara upasthita aneka putra|
Ara tAra janya (jIvanake) sugama svAcchandyamaYa karechi|
esavera pareo se AkAMkhA kare ye, Ami Aro vAr3iYe dei|
kakhano naYa, nizcaYa se chila AmAra nidarzanAvalIra viruddhAcArI|
acirei Ami tAke jAhAnnAmera picchila pAthare ArohaNa karate vAdhya karava|
nizcaYa se cintA bhAvanA karala evaM siddhAnta grahaNa karala|
ataHpara se dhvaMsa hoka! kIbhAve se siddhAnta grahaNa karala?
tArapara se dhvaMsa hoka! kIbhAve se siddhAnta grahaNa karala?
tArapara se tAkAla|
tArapara se bhrUkuJcita karala evaM mukha vikRta karala|
tArapara se pichane phirala evaM ahaMkAra karala|
ataHpara se valala, ‘e to loka paramparAYaprApta yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa’|
‘eTA to mAnuSera kathAmAtra’|
acirei Ami tAke jAhAnnAmera Agune praveza karAva|
kise tomAke jAnAve jAhAnnAmera Aguna kI?
eTA avaziSTao rAkhave nA evaM cher3eo deve nA|
cAmar3Ake dagdha kare kAlo kare deve|
tAra upara raYeche Unizajana (praharI)|

Ara Ami pherezatAderakei jAhAnnAmera tattvAvadhAYaka vAniYechi| Ara kAphiradera janya parIkSAsvarUpa Ami tAdera saMkhyA nirdhAraNa karechi| yAte kitAvaprAptarA dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kare; Ara muminadera ImAna ver3e yAYa evaM kitAvaprAptarA o muminarA sandeha poSaNa nA kare| Ara yena yAdera antare roga Ache tArA evaM avaziSTarA vale, erUpa upamA dvArA AllAha kI icchA karechena? ebhAvei AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena Ara yAke icchA saThika pathe paricAlita karena| Ara tomAra ravera vAhinI samparke tini chAr3A keu jAnena nA| Ara e hacche mAnuSera janya upadezamAtra|
kakhano naYa, cA~dera kasama!
rAtera kasama, yakhana tA sare cale yAYa,
prabhAtera kasama, yakhana tA udbhAsita haYa|
nizcaYa jAhAnnAma mahAvipadasamUhera anyatama|
mAnuSera janya satarkakArIsvarUpa|
tomAdera madhye ye cAYa agrasara hate athavA pichiYe thAkate, tAra janya|
pratiTi prANa nija arjanera kAraNe dAYavaddha|
kintu DAna dikera lokerA naYa,
vAga-vAgicAra madhye tArA eke aparake jijJAsA karave,
aparAdhIdera samparke,

‘Ara AmarA anarthaka AlApakArIdera sAthe (vehudA AlApe) magna thAkatAma’|

yArA siMhera bhaYe palAYana kareche|
varaM tAdera madhyakAra pratyeka vyaktii kAmanA kare ye tAke unmukta grantha pradAna karA hoka|
kakhanao naYa! varaM tArA AkhirAtake bhaYa kare nA|
kakhanao naYa! eTito upadeza mAtra|
ataeva yAra icchA se tA theke upadeza grahaNa karuka|

kuraAna tAr3AtAr3i AYatta karAra uddezye tumi tomAra jihavAke druta Andolita karo nA|
nizcaYai era saMrakSaNa o pATha AmAra dAYitve|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tA pATha kari takhana tumi tAra pAThera anusaraNa kara|
tArapara tAra varNanAra dAYitva AmArai|
kakhano nA, varaM tomarA duniYAra jIvanake bhAlavAsa|
Ara tomarA cher3e diccha AkhirAtake|
sedina kataka mukhamanDala have hAsyojjvala|
tAdera ravera prati dRSTinikSepakArI|
Ara sedina aneka mukhamanDala have vivarNa-viSanna|
tArA dhAraNA karave ye, eka viparyaYa tAdera upara Apatita karA have|
kakhanai nA, yakhana prANa kaNThAgata have|
Ara valA have, ‘ke tAke vA~cAve’?
Ara se mane karave, eTii vidAYakSaNa|
Ara pAYera gochAra saMge pAYera gochA jar3iYe yAve|
sedina tomAra ravera kAchei sakalake hA~kiYe neYA have|
sutarAM se vizvAsao kareni evaM sAlAtao AdAYa kareni|
varaM se satya pratyAkhyAna karechila evaM phire giYechila|
tArapara se dambhabhare parivAra-parijanera kAche cale giYechila|
durbhoga tomAra janya evaM durbhoga!
tAraparao durbhoga tomAra janya evaM durbhoga!
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, tAke emani cher3e deYA have?
se ki vIryera zukravindu chila nA yA skhalita haYa?
ataHpara se ‘AlAkAYa pariNata haYa| tArapara AllAha tAke sundara AkRtite sRSTi karechena evaM suvinyasta karechena|
ataHpara tini tA theke sRSTi karena jor3AYa jor3AYa puruSa o nArI|
tini ki mRtadera jIvita karate sakSama nana?
mAnuSera upara ki kAlera emana kona kSaNa Aseni yakhana se ullekhayogya kichui chila nA?
Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi mizra zukravindu theke, Ami tAke parIkSA karava, phale Ami tAke vAniYechi zravaNa o dRSTizaktisampanna|
avazyai Ami tAke patha pradarzana karechi, haYa se zokarakArI athavA akRtajJa|
Ami kAphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechi zekala, ver3i o prajvalita agni|
nizcaYa satkarmazIlarA pAna karave emana pAnapAtra theke yAra mizraNa have kAphUra|
emana eka jharNA yA theke AllAhara vAndAgaNa pAna karave, tArA eTike yathA icchA pravAhita karave|
tArA mAnata pUrNa kare evaM sedinake bhaYa kare yAra akalyANa have suvistRta|
tArA khAdyera prati Asakti thAkA sattveo misakIna, iYAtIma o vandIke khAdya dAna kare|
tArA vale,‘AmarA to AllAhara santuSTira uddezye tomAderake khAdya dAna kari| AmarA tomAdera theke kona pratidAna cAi nA evaM kona zokarao nA|
AmarA AmAdera ravera pakSa theke eka bhaYaMkara bhItiprada divasera bhaYa kari|
sutarAM sei divasera akalyANa theke AllAha tAdera rakSA karalena evaM tAdera pradAna karalena ujjvalatA o utphullatA|
Ara tArA ye dhairyadhAraNa karechila tAra pariNAme tini tAderake jAnnAta o rezamI vastrera puraskAra pradAna karavena|
tArA sekhAne suucca Asane helAna diYe AsIna thAkave| tArA sekhAne nA dekhave atizaYa garama, Ara nA atyadhika zIta|
tAdera upara sannihita thAkave udyAnera chAYA evaM tAra phalamUlera thokAsamUha tAdera sampUrNa AYattAdhIna karA have|
tAdera cArapAze Avartita have raupyapAtra o sphaTika svaccha pAnapAtra-
rUpAra nyAYa zubhra sphaTika pAtra; yAra parimApa tArA nirdhAraNa karave|
sekhAne tAderake pAna karAno have pAtrabharA AdA-mizrita surA,
sekhAnakAra eka jharNA yAra nAma have sAlasAvIla|
